      let touching = false;
      for (let k = 0; k < w.arms && !touching; k++) {
        const ang = w.ang + k * Math.PI * 2 / w.arms;
        const arm = wheelArm(w, ang);
        const endD = (arm.len + 8) * grow;
        const startD = Math.min(22, endD * 0.55);
        const steps = Math.max(3, Math.ceil((endD - startD) / 5));
        for (let j = 0; j <= steps; j++) {
          const d = startD + (endD - startD) * (j / steps);
          const ax = w.cx + arm.ca * d;
          const ay = w.cy + arm.sa * d;
          if (dist(s.x, s.y, ax, ay) < 9) { touching = true; break; }
        }
        // 骨尖也算一个判定点
        if (!touching && dist(s.x, s.y, w.cx + arm.ca * endD, w.cy + arm.sa * endD) < 10) touching = true;
      }
      if (touching && p.wheelCd <= 0 && p.invuln <= 0) {
        // 风车单独给一段受击冷却，避免同一根骨头连续判定秒杀
        p.wheelCd = 0.6;
        w.flash = 0.2;
        hurt(a && a.brutal ? 2 : 1, false, p);
        if (state !== 'attack') return;
      }
    }
    if (w.flash > 0) w.flash -= dt;
    if (w.t >= w.life) wheels.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

/* ---- 黄色灵魂的射击：打掉可破坏弹幕 ---- */
function bulletHp(b) {
  if (b.hp != null) return b.hp;
  if (b.kind === 'bone') return 3;
  if (b.kind === 'paw') return 3;
  return 1;
}

function updateShots(dt) {
  for (let i = shots.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const s = shots[i];
    s.x += s.vx * dt;
    s.y += s.vy * dt;
    s.life -= dt;
    const bb = arenaBoxes[s.arena || 0] || box;
    if (s.life <= 0 || s.x < bb.x - 10 || s.x > bb.x + bb.w + 10 ||
        s.y < bb.y - 10 || s.y > bb.y + bb.h + 10) {
      shots.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }

    let consumed = false;
    for (let j = bullets.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
      const b = bullets[j];
      if ((b.arena || 0) !== (s.arena || 0)) continue;
      if (b.delay > 0) continue;
      if (b.outer) {
        // 场外飞入的弹幕同样可以打掉，按圆心距离判定
        const cr = b.kind === 'bone' ? Math.max(b.w, b.h) * 0.5 : (b.r || 6);
        if (dist(s.x, s.y, b.x + (b.w || 0) / 2, b.y + (b.h || 0) / 2) > cr + s.r) continue;
      } else if (b.kind === 'bone') {
        if (!(s.x > b.x - 2 && s.x < b.x + b.w + 2 && s.y > b.y - 2 && s.y < b.y + b.h + 2)) continue;
      } else {
        if (dist(s.x, s.y, b.x, b.y) > (b.r || 6) + s.r) continue;
      }

      const hp = bulletHp(b) - 1;
      b.hp = hp;
      b.hitT = 0.12;
      Sound.pop();
      addRing(s.x, s.y, 3, hp <= 0 ? 26 : 14, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)', 0.28, 2);
      for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
        sparks.push({
          x: s.x, y: s.y,
          vx: rand(-90, 90), vy: rand(-90, 90),
          life: rand(0.12, 0.3), color: C.yellow
        });
      }
      if (hp <= 0) {
        bullets.splice(j, 1);
        for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
          sparks.push({
            x: s.x, y: s.y,
            vx: rand(-140, 140), vy: rand(-140, 140),
            life: rand(0.15, 0.4), color: b.color || C.white
          });
        }
      }
      consumed = true;
      break;
    }
    if (consumed) shots.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

function shrinkBox(a) {
  const targetW = a.brutal ? 300 : (a.hard ? 360 : 430);
  const targetH = a.brutal ? 96 : (a.hard ? 106 : 120);
  const k = clamp(a.t / 5.5, 0, 1);
  const back = a.t > a.dur - 2.2 ? clamp((a.dur - a.t) / 2.2, 0, 1) : 1;
  const tw = BOX.w - (BOX.w - targetW) * k;
  const th = BOX.h - (BOX.h - targetH) * k;
  box.w = BOX.w - (BOX.w - tw) * back;
  box.h = BOX.h - (BOX.h - th) * back;
  box.x = (W - box.w) / 2;
  box.y = BOX.y + BOX.h - box.h;
  if (player) {
    player.x = clamp(player.x, box.x + 8, box.x + box.w - 8);
    player.y = clamp(player.y, box.y + 8, box.y + box.h - 8);
  }
}

// 骨栅：从战斗框一侧长出一排骨墙，只在缺口处留活路。
// 单独抽出来，方便激光战里也穿插侧边骨墙。
function spawnBoneWall(ai, b, edge, opts) {
  opts = opts || {};
  const brutal = opts.brutal != null ? opts.brutal : (enraged || thirdPhase);
  const hard = difficulty === 1;
  const depth = opts.depth != null ? opts.depth : (brutal ? 62 : (hard ? 52 : 42));
  const along = (edge === 'top' || edge === 'bottom') ? b.w : b.h;
  const origin = (edge === 'top' || edge === 'bottom') ? b.x : b.y;
  const gapW = Math.min(opts.gapW != null ? opts.gapW : (brutal ? 52 : (hard ? 64 : 80)), along - 30);
  const nGaps = opts.gaps != null ? opts.gaps : (brutal ? 2 : 1);
  const growSpeed = opts.growSpeed != null ? opts.growSpeed : (brutal ? 10 : 8.5);
  const gaps = [];
  for (let g = 0; g < nGaps; g++) {
    const minC = origin + 16 + gapW / 2;
    const maxC = origin + along - 16 - gapW / 2;
    let c = rand(minC, maxC);
    if (gaps.length) {
      for (let tries = 0; tries < 24 && Math.abs(c - gaps[0]) < gapW + 24; tries++) c = rand(minC, maxC);
    }
    gaps.push(c);
  }
  gaps.sort((p, q) => p - q);
  const make = (s, e) => {
    const len = e - s;
    if (len < 12) return;
    const target = {
      kind: 'bone', arena: ai, color: 'white',
      edge, seg: s, len, depth,
      x: 0, y: 0, w: 0, h: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0,
      grow: 0, growState: 'warn', growSpeed,
      holdMax: opts.holdMax != null ? opts.holdMax : (brutal ? 0.45 : (hard ? 0.52 : 0.6)),
      delay: opts.delay != null ? opts.delay : (brutal ? 0.5 : (hard ? 0.56 : 0.66))
    };
    if (edge === 'left') { target.x = b.x; target.y = s; target.w = depth; target.h = len; }
    else if (edge === 'right') { target.x = b.x + b.w - depth; target.y = s; target.w = depth; target.h = len; }
    else if (edge === 'top') { target.x = s; target.y = b.y; target.w = len; target.h = depth; }
    else { target.x = s; target.y = b.y + b.h - depth; target.w = len; target.h = depth; }
    bullets.push(target);
  };
  let start = origin;
  for (const gc of gaps) {
    make(start, gc - gapW / 2);
    start = gc + gapW / 2;
  }
  make(start, origin + along);
  return { edge, gaps, gapW, depth };
}

function spawnForAttack(a) {
  for (let ai = 0; ai < arenaBoxes.length; ai++) {
    spawnOne(a, arenaBoxes[ai], ai);
  }
}

// 混合弹幕：借用另一套攻击的生成器，但按自己的节奏刷新
function spawnMix(a) {
  const m = a.mix;
  for (let ai = 0; ai < arenaBoxes.length; ai++) {
    const proxy = {
      id: m.id, t: a.t, dur: a.dur,
      next: m.next, angle: m.angle, aimT: m.aimT || 1.2, beamT: m.beamT || 2.6,
      spawnT: 0, hard: a.hard, brutal: a.brutal
    };
    spawnOne(proxy, arenaBoxes[ai], ai);
    m.next = proxy.next;
    m.angle = proxy.angle;
    m.aimT = proxy.aimT;
    m.beamT = proxy.beamT;
  }
}

function spawnOne(a, b, ai) {
  const hard = a.hard;
  const brutal = a.brutal;

  if (a.id === 'bones') {
    const gap = Math.min(brutal ? 52 : (hard ? 62 : 82), b.h - 58);
    const speed = brutal ? 300 : (hard ? 220 : 165);
    const gy = b.y + 20 + Math.random() * Math.max(8, b.h - gap - 38);
    bullets.push({ kind: 'bone', arena: ai, x: b.x + b.w + 12, y: b.y, w: 15, h: gy - b.y, vx: -speed, vy: 0, color: 'white' });
    bullets.push({ kind: 'bone', arena: ai, x: b.x + b.w + 12, y: gy + gap, w: 15, h: b.y + b.h - (gy + gap), vx: -speed, vy: 0, color: 'white' });
    if (hard) {
      bullets.push({ kind: 'bone', arena: ai, x: b.x + b.w + 74, y: b.y, w: 13, h: Math.max(0, gy - b.y - 10), vx: -speed, vy: 0, color: 'white' });
    }
    if (brutal) {
      const gy2 = b.y + 14 + Math.random() * Math.max(6, b.h - gap - 28);
      bullets.push({ kind: 'bone', arena: ai, x: b.x + b.w + 132, y: b.y, w: 12, h: gy2 - b.y, vx: -speed, vy: 0, color: 'white' });
      bullets.push({ kind: 'bone', arena: ai, x: b.x + b.w + 132, y: gy2 + gap, w: 12, h: b.y + b.h - (gy2 + gap), vx: -speed, vy: 0, color: 'white' });
    }
    a.spawnT = brutal ? 0.28 : (hard ? 0.36 : 0.55);
    Sound.menu();
  }

  else if (a.id === 'rain') {
    const blue = Math.random() < 0.27;
    const x = rand(b.x + 14, b.x + b.w - 14);
    bullets.push({
      kind: 'bone', arena: ai, x, y: b.y - 64, w: 13,
      h: rand(26, 54), vx: 0,
      vy: blue ? (hard ? 235 : 180) : (hard ? 315 : 235),
      color: blue ? 'blue' : 'white', delay: 0.24
    });
    if (brutal) {
      const x2 = rand(b.x + 14, b.x + b.w - 14);
      bullets.push({
        kind: 'bone', arena: ai, x: x2, y: b.y - 94, w: 12, h: rand(24, 46),
        vx: 0, vy: hard ? 330 : 250, color: 'white', delay: 0.5
      });
    }
    a.spawnT = brutal ? 0.085 : (hard ? 0.115 : 0.2);
  }

  else if (a.id === 'blueorange') {
    const w = Math.min(rand(54, 112), b.w - 20);
    const color = (a.next++ % 2 === 0) ? 'blue' : 'orange';
    bullets.push({
      kind: 'bone', arena: ai, x: rand(b.x + 8, b.x + b.w - w - 8),
      y: b.y - 16, w, h: 12, vx: 0,
      vy: brutal ? 250 : (hard ? 210 : 160), color
    });
    if (brutal && a.next % 3 === 0) {
      const w2 = Math.min(rand(44, 84), b.w - 20);
      bullets.push({
        kind: 'bone', arena: ai, x: rand(b.x + 8, b.x + b.w - w2 - 8),
        y: b.y - 62, w: w2, h: 11, vx: 0, vy: 210,
        color: (a.next % 2 === 0) ? 'blue' : 'orange'
      });
    }
    a.spawnT = brutal ? 0.34 : (hard ? 0.42 : 0.62);
  }

  else if (a.id === 'blasters') {
    const dirs = ['top', 'top', 'bottom', 'bottom', 'left', 'right'];
    const dir = dirs[randi(0, dirs.length - 1)];
    const width = hard ? 38 : 34;
    let pos;
    if (dir === 'top' || dir === 'bottom') pos = rand(b.x + 14, b.x + b.w - 14 - width);
    else pos = rand(b.y + 14, b.y + b.h - 14 - width);
    beams.push({
      dir, pos, width, arena: ai,
      warn: brutal ? 0.46 : (hard ? 0.6 : 0.85),
      fire: 0.28, t: 0, hit: false
    });
    if (brutal) {
      const dir2 = dir === 'top' || dir === 'bottom' ? 'left' : 'top';
      const pos2 = dir2 === 'left' || dir2 === 'right'
        ? rand(b.y + 12, b.y + b.h - 50)
        : rand(b.x + 12, b.x + b.w - 50);
      beams.push({
        dir: dir2, pos: pos2, width: 30, arena: ai,
        warn: 0.7, fire: 0.26, t: 0, hit: false
      });
    }
    Sound.blaster();
    screenPulse = 0.16;
    if (brutal) {
      const dir3 = dirs[randi(0, dirs.length - 1)];
      const pos3 = (dir3 === 'top' || dir3 === 'bottom')
        ? rand(b.x + 12, b.x + b.w - 40)
        : rand(b.y + 12, b.y + b.h - 40);
      beams.push({ dir: dir3, pos: pos3, width: 26, arena: ai, warn: 0.95, fire: 0.24, t: 0, hit: false });
    }
    a.spawnT = brutal ? 0.4 : (hard ? 0.52 : 0.76);
  }

  else if (a.id === 'spiral') {
    // 螺旋球：两臂旋转，弹幕之间留出足够大的缝隙；
    // 中间穿插审判烙印、白羽和一段侧边骨墙，避免只会转圈
    const cx = b.x + b.w / 2;
    const cy = b.y + b.h / 2;
    a.angle += brutal ? 0.5 : (hard ? 0.46 : 0.4);
    const speed = brutal ? 126 : (hard ? 110 : 90);
    const arms = 2;
    const tick = brutal ? 0.12 : (hard ? 0.16 : 0.22);
    for (let m = 0; m < arms; m++) {
      const ang = a.angle + m * Math.PI;
      // 生成半径必须大于灵魂判定半径：毂心 8px 生成等于站在中心就必中。
      // 26px 让中心成为可站的“风眼”，但瞄准弹仍会把这里赶走。
      bullets.push({
        kind: 'orb', arena: ai,
        x: cx + Math.cos(ang) * 26, y: cy + Math.sin(ang) * 26,
        r: 5, vx: Math.cos(ang) * speed, vy: Math.sin(ang) * speed,
        color: C.white
      });
    }
    a.spawnT = tick;
    a.aimT -= tick;
    if (a.aimT <= 0) {
      a.aimT = brutal ? 0.95 : (hard ? 1.35 : 1.9);
      const target = soulForArena(ai) ? soulPos(soulForArena(ai)) : { x: cx, y: cy };
      const ang = Math.atan2(target.y - cy, target.x - cx) + rand(-0.12, 0.12);
      const as = brutal ? 245 : (hard ? 205 : 155);
      // 同理，瞄准弹从圈外 26px 起步，不在灵魂身上生成
      bullets.push({
        kind: 'orb', arena: ai, x: cx + Math.cos(ang) * 26, y: cy + Math.sin(ang) * 26, r: 6,
        vx: Math.cos(ang) * as, vy: Math.sin(ang) * as,
        color: C.white, karmic: true
      });
      if (brutal) {
        bullets.push({
          kind: 'orb', arena: ai, x: cx + Math.cos(ang + 0.28) * 26, y: cy + Math.sin(ang + 0.28) * 26, r: 5,
          vx: Math.cos(ang + 0.28) * as, vy: Math.sin(ang + 0.28) * as,
          color: C.white
        });
      }
    }
    // 审判烙印：框内随机落点，倒数完炸开成一圈碎晶
    a.sigilT = (a.sigilT == null ? 1.3 : a.sigilT) - tick;
    if (a.sigilT <= 0) {
      a.sigilT = brutal ? 2.0 : (hard ? 2.6 : 3.4);
      bullets.push({
        kind: 'sigil', arena: ai,
        x: rand(b.x + 34, b.x + b.w - 34), y: rand(b.y + 28, b.y + b.h - 28),
        r: 10, warnT: brutal ? 0.62 : (hard ? 0.74 : 0.86),
        burst: brutal ? 7 : 5, ang: rand(0, Math.PI * 2), speed: 120
      });
    }
    // 侧边骨墙：时不时压进来一半，配合旋转球收窄空间
    a.wallT = (a.wallT == null ? 3.0 : a.wallT) - tick;
    if (a.wallT <= 0) {
      a.wallT = brutal ? 4.2 : (hard ? 5.2 : 6.5);
      spawnBoneWall(ai, b, ['left', 'right', 'bottom'][a.next++ % 3], {
        depth: brutal ? 40 : (hard ? 34 : 30),
        gapW: brutal ? 64 : (hard ? 72 : 82)
      });
      Sound.boneWall();
    }
  }

  else if (a.id === 'dual') {
    const gap = Math.min(hard ? 62 : 80, b.h - 50);
    const speed = brutal ? 270 : (hard ? 200 : 155);
    const gy = b.y + 16 + Math.random() * Math.max(6, b.h - gap - 30);
    bullets.push({ kind: 'bone', arena: ai, x: b.x + b.w + 12, y: b.y, w: 14, h: gy - b.y, vx: -speed, vy: 0, color: 'white' });
    bullets.push({ kind: 'bone', arena: ai, x: b.x + b.w + 12, y: gy + gap, w: 14, h: b.y + b.h - (gy + gap), vx: -speed, vy: 0, color: 'white' });
    if (a.next % 3 === 0) {
      const p = soulForArena(ai);
      const t = p ? soulPos(p) : { x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y + b.h / 2 };
      const ang = Math.atan2(t.y - (b.y - 8), t.x - (b.x + b.w / 2)) + rand(-0.1, 0.1);
      bullets.push({
        kind: 'orb', arena: ai, x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y - 8, r: 5,
        vx: Math.cos(ang) * (hard ? 165 : 130),
        vy: Math.sin(ang) * (hard ? 165 : 130),
        color: C.white
      });
    }
    a.next++;
    a.spawnT = brutal ? 0.42 : (hard ? 0.55 : 0.76);
  }

  else if (a.id === 'green') {
    // 回到原来的手感：从随机一条边、随机位置瞄准灵魂射来，每次只来一个方向
    const side = a.next++ % 4;
    const p = soulForArena(ai);
    const t = p ? soulPos(p) : { x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y + b.h / 2 };
    let sx, sy;
    if (side === 0) { sx = rand(b.x + 18, b.x + b.w - 18); sy = b.y - 72; }
    else if (side === 2) { sx = rand(b.x + 18, b.x + b.w - 18); sy = b.y + b.h + 72; }
    else if (side === 3) { sx = b.x - 72; sy = rand(b.y + 18, b.y + b.h - 18); }
    else { sx = b.x + b.w + 72; sy = rand(b.y + 18, b.y + b.h - 18); }
    const count = brutal ? 3 : (hard ? 2 : 1);
    const speed = brutal ? 225 : (hard ? 185 : 148);
    const base = Math.atan2(t.y - sy, t.x - sx);
    for (let k = 0; k < count; k++) {
      const ang = base + (k - (count - 1) / 2) * 0.16 + rand(-0.03, 0.03);
      bullets.push({
        kind: 'orb', arena: ai, outer: true,
        x: sx + Math.cos(ang) * 8, y: sy + Math.sin(ang) * 8, r: 7,
        vx: Math.cos(ang) * speed, vy: Math.sin(ang) * speed,
        color: C.white
      });
    }
    a.spawnT = brutal ? 0.46 : (hard ? 0.58 : 0.82);
  }

  else if (a.id === 'claw') {
    const p = soulForArena(ai);
    const t = p ? soulPos(p) : { x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y + b.h / 2 };
    const fromRight = Math.random() < 0.6;
    const sx = fromRight ? b.x + b.w + 140 : b.x - 140;
    const sy = rand(b.y - 110, b.y + b.h + 80);
    const base = Math.atan2(t.y - sy, t.x - sx);
    const speed = brutal ? 390 : (hard ? 315 : 248);
    const pushPaw = (turnOff) => bullets.push({
      kind: 'paw', arena: ai, outer: true, x: sx, y: sy, r: 11,
      vx: Math.cos(base + turnOff) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(base + turnOff) * speed,
      rot: base, life: 3.2,
      color: C.white
    });
    pushPaw(0);
    if (brutal) { pushPaw(rand(-0.3, 0.3)); pushPaw(rand(-0.5, 0.5)); }
    else if (hard && Math.random() < 0.35) pushPaw(rand(-0.26, 0.26));
    addRing(sx, sy, 6, 34, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)', 0.34, 3);
    a.spawnT = brutal ? 0.34 : (hard ? 0.48 : 0.7);
  }

  else if (a.id === 'whip') {
    const n = a.next++;
    const sweepCycle = n % 3 === 2;
    if (sweepCycle) {
      // 横扫鞭单独出场：鞭身贴中线以上扫过，下半个框始终是安全跑道
      const fromLeft = (n % 2 === 1);
      const sxp = fromLeft ? b.x + 22 : b.x + b.w - 22;
      const exp = fromLeft ? b.x + b.w - 22 : b.x + 22;
      const midY = b.y + b.h * 0.42;
      lashes.push({
        arena: ai, side: 0, sweep: true,
        sx: sxp, sy: b.y + 18,
        ex: exp, ey: midY,
        tipX: sxp, tipY: b.y + 18,
        bend: (fromLeft ? 1 : -1) * rand(46, 78),
        warn: brutal ? 0.5 : (hard ? 0.68 : 0.88),
        fire: brutal ? 0.36 : (hard ? 0.42 : 0.5),
        t: 0, hit: false
      });
    } else {
      const side = n % 4;
      const mkLash = (sd) => lashes.push({
        arena: ai, side: sd,
        tipX: rand(b.x + 34, b.x + b.w - 34),
        tipY: rand(b.y + 32, b.y + b.h - 32),
        bend: (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1) * rand(35, 85),
        warn: brutal ? 0.55 : (hard ? 0.72 : 0.95),
        fire: 0.24, t: 0, hit: false
      });
      mkLash(side);
      // 追加的鞭子只从同一侧甩入，合起来仍是一道单向鞭墙，另一侧始终可退
      if (brutal) { mkLash(side); mkLash(side); }
      else if (hard && Math.random() < 0.4) mkLash(side);
    }
    a.spawnT = brutal ? 0.62 : (hard ? 0.82 : 1.05);
    Sound.blaster();
  }

  else if (a.id === 'laser') {
    const vertical = Math.random() < 0.55;
    const width = brutal ? 56 : (hard ? 46 : 38);
    const fire = 0.34;
    const warn = brutal ? 0.6 : (hard ? 0.8 : 1.0);
    const mkLaser = () => {
      if (vertical) {
        beams.push({
          full: true, dir: 'top', pos: rand(b.x + 26, b.x + b.w - 26 - width),
          width, arena: ai, warn, fire, t: 0, hit: false
        });
      } else {
        beams.push({
          full: true, dir: 'left', pos: rand(b.y + 12, b.y + b.h - 12 - width),
          width, arena: ai, warn, fire, t: 0, hit: false
        });
      }
    };
    mkLaser();
    if (brutal && Math.random() < 0.8) mkLaser();
    else if (hard && Math.random() < 0.4) mkLaser();
    // 激光为主时，隔一波从框侧压进一排骨栅：只靠躲光束会被逼到边上
    a.next = (a.next || 0) + 1;
    if (a.next % 2 === 0) {
      const side = (a.next % 4 === 0) ? 'left' : 'right';
      spawnBoneWall(ai, b, side, {
        gaps: 1,
        depth: brutal ? 50 : (hard ? 42 : 36),
        gapW: brutal ? 62 : (hard ? 70 : 82),
        delay: brutal ? 0.42 : (hard ? 0.5 : 0.6),
        holdMax: brutal ? 0.5 : 0.62
      });
      Sound.boneWall();
    }
    // 每第三波：猫爪从另一侧横着扑过审判之光，逼你换位
    if (a.next % 3 === 0) {
      const p = soulForArena(ai);
      const t = p ? soulPos(p) : { x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y + b.h / 2 };
      const fromLeft = Math.random() < 0.5;
      const px = fromLeft ? b.x - 34 : b.x + b.w + 34;
      const py = rand(b.y + 26, b.y + b.h - 26);
      const base = Math.atan2(t.y - py, t.x - px);
      const n = brutal ? 2 : 1;
      for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
        const aa = base + (k - (n - 1) / 2) * 0.22;
        bullets.push({
          kind: 'paw', arena: ai, outer: true, x: px, y: py, r: 12, rot: aa,
          vx: Math.cos(aa) * (brutal ? 240 : 195), vy: Math.sin(aa) * (brutal ? 240 : 195),
          color: C.white, tr: []
        });
      }
      Sound.pop();
    }
    a.spawnT = brutal ? 0.72 : (hard ? 0.98 : 1.4);
    Sound.blaster();
    screenPulse = 0.18;
  }

  else if (a.id === 'fall') {
    // 蓝魂跳跃一次约 0.59s；困难 0.4s 一根会让落地正好压在下一根上。
    // 0.46s 仍然紧，但留出了“落地→再起跳”的窗口。
    const speed = brutal ? 320 : (hard ? 240 : 195);
    if (a.next++ % 3 === 2) {
      // 竖直光柱：落下的审判之光，靠横向走位躲开，不干扰跳跃
      const x = rand(b.x + 26, b.x + b.w - 56);
      beams.push({
        dir: 'top', pos: x, width: 30, arena: ai,
        warn: brutal ? 0.5 : 0.72, fire: 0.3, t: 0, hit: false
      });
      Sound.blaster();
    } else {
      const barH = 24;
      bullets.push({
        kind: 'bone', arena: ai,
        x: b.x + b.w + 12, y: b.y + b.h - barH,
        w: 18, h: barH, vx: -speed, vy: 0, color: 'white'
      });
      if (brutal) {
        bullets.push({
          kind: 'bone', arena: ai,
          x: b.x + b.w + 60, y: b.y + b.h - barH,
          w: 18, h: barH, vx: -speed, vy: 0, color: Math.random() < 0.4 ? 'blue' : 'white'
        });
      }
    }
    a.spawnT = brutal ? 0.3 : (hard ? 0.46 : 0.56);
  }

  else if (a.id === 'shards') {
    const p = soulForArena(ai);
    const t = p ? soulPos(p) : { x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y + b.h / 2 };
    // 贴边刷弹是必中：生成点必须离灵魂足够远，否则换个边。
    // 硬难度 265 速下 115px 约等于 0.39 秒反应时间，还能躲。
    const pickEdge = () => {
      const e = randi(0, 3);
      if (e === 0) return { x: rand(b.x, b.x + b.w), y: b.y - 12 };
      if (e === 1) return { x: rand(b.x, b.x + b.w), y: b.y + b.h + 12 };
      if (e === 2) return { x: b.x - 12, y: rand(b.y, b.y + b.h) };
      return { x: b.x + b.w + 12, y: rand(b.y, b.y + b.h) };
    };
    let pt = pickEdge();
    if (Math.hypot(pt.x - t.x, pt.y - t.y) < 115) {
      let bestD = -1;
      for (let e = 0; e < 4; e++) {
        const q = pickEdge();
        const d = Math.hypot(q.x - t.x, q.y - t.y);
        if (d > bestD) { bestD = d; pt = q; }
      }
    }
    const x = pt.x, y = pt.y;
    const ang = Math.atan2(t.y - y, t.x - x) + rand(-0.1, 0.1);
    const speed = brutal ? 350 : (hard ? 265 : 215);
    // 困难不要双发：同一波两枚 0.18 弧度夹在灵魂两侧时，缝隙会被压成 0，读不出来。
    const count = brutal ? 3 : 1;
    for (let k = 0; k < count; k++) {
      bullets.push({
        kind: 'shard', arena: ai, x, y, r: 6,
        rot: 0, rotv: rand(-9, 9),
        vx: Math.cos(ang + k * 0.18) * speed,
        vy: Math.sin(ang + k * 0.18) * speed,
        // 两种白都画成白色；保留一次随机数消耗，别打乱已经验证过的弹幕序列
        color: Math.random() < 0.5 ? C.white : '#ffffff',
        karmic: true
      });
    }
    a.spawnT = brutal ? 0.16 : (hard ? 0.24 : 0.3);
  }

  else if (a.id === 'gravity') {
    const speed = brutal ? 300 : (hard ? 230 : 165);
    const barH = 24;
    bullets.push({
      kind: 'bone', arena: ai,
      x: b.x + b.w + 12, y: b.y + b.h - barH,
      w: 18, h: barH, vx: -speed, vy: 0, color: 'white'
    });
    if (hard && Math.random() < 0.15) {
      bullets.push({
        kind: 'bone', arena: ai,
        x: b.x + b.w + 62, y: b.y + b.h - barH,
        w: 18, h: barH, vx: -speed, vy: 0, color: 'white'
      });
    }
    a.spawnT = brutal ? 0.38 : (hard ? 0.66 : 0.64);
    a.beamT -= a.spawnT;
    if (a.beamT <= 0) {
      a.beamT = brutal ? 1.8 : (hard ? 2.7 : 3.8);
      const dir = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'top' : 'bottom';
      beams.push({
        dir, pos: rand(b.x + 24, b.x + b.w - 52), width: 28, arena: ai,
        warn: 0.6, fire: 0.26, t: 0, hit: false
      });
      Sound.blaster();
    }
  }

  else if (a.id === 'orange') {
    // 橙色灵魂一直在抖、也一直算“移动中”：这里全部用白色弹幕
    const p = soulForArena(ai);
    const t = p ? soulPos(p) : { x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y + b.h / 2 };
    const mode = a.next++ % 4;
    // 困难没有无敌帧，还带着 1.08 倍速：从贴着灵魂的边刷弹幕等于必中。
    // 统一从离灵魂更远的一侧进场，留出反应距离。
    const farEdge = (() => {
      const cand = [
        [0, t.y - b.y],
        [2, b.y + b.h - t.y],
        [3, t.x - b.x],
        [1, b.x + b.w - t.x]
      ].sort((u, v) => v[1] - u[1]);
      return Math.random() < 0.78 ? cand[0][0] : cand[1][0];
    })();

    if (mode === 3) {
      // 白色贴地骨头墙，留一个很窄的缝；从离灵魂更远的一侧扫来
      const gap = Math.min(brutal ? 50 : (hard ? 62 : 78), b.h - 54);
      const gy = b.y + 18 + Math.random() * Math.max(6, b.h - gap - 36);
      const speed = brutal ? 300 : (hard ? 225 : 170);
      const fromRight = (b.x + b.w - t.x) >= (t.x - b.x);
      const wx = fromRight ? b.x + b.w + 12 : b.x - 25;
      const wvx = fromRight ? -speed : speed;
      bullets.push({ kind: 'bone', arena: ai, x: wx, y: b.y, w: 13, h: gy - b.y, vx: wvx, vy: 0, color: 'white' });
      bullets.push({ kind: 'bone', arena: ai, x: wx, y: gy + gap, w: 13, h: b.y + b.h - (gy + gap), vx: wvx, vy: 0, color: 'white' });
    } else if (mode === 2) {
      // 三连白色碎晶，从远处的一条边追着抖动的灵魂来
      const edge = farEdge;
      let sx, sy;
      if (edge === 0) { sx = t.x + rand(-50, 50); sy = b.y - 14; }
      else if (edge === 1) { sx = t.x + rand(-50, 50); sy = b.y + b.h + 14; }
      else if (edge === 2) { sx = b.x - 14; sy = t.y + rand(-30, 30); }
      else { sx = b.x + b.w + 14; sy = t.y + rand(-30, 30); }
      const base = Math.atan2(t.y - sy, t.x - sx);
      const speed = brutal ? 300 : (hard ? 245 : 190);
      for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
        bullets.push({
          kind: 'shard', arena: ai, x: sx, y: sy, r: 6,
          rot: 0, rotv: rand(-10, 10),
          vx: Math.cos(base + (k - 1) * 0.14) * speed,
          vy: Math.sin(base + (k - 1) * 0.14) * speed,
          color: C.white, karmic: true
        });
      }
    } else {
      // 成排的白色弹珠，从离灵魂最远的一条边瞄准
      const side = farEdge;
      let sx, sy;
      if (side === 0) { sx = rand(b.x + 20, b.x + b.w - 20); sy = b.y - 40; }
      else if (side === 2) { sx = rand(b.x + 20, b.x + b.w - 20); sy = b.y + b.h + 40; }
      else if (side === 3) { sx = b.x - 40; sy = rand(b.y + 20, b.y + b.h - 20); }
      else { sx = b.x + b.w + 40; sy = rand(b.y + 20, b.y + b.h - 20); }
      const base = Math.atan2(t.y - sy, t.x - sx);
      const count = brutal ? 5 : (hard ? 3 : 3);
      const speed = brutal ? 235 : (hard ? 200 : 160);
      for (let k = 0; k < count; k++) {
        const ang = base + (k - (count - 1) / 2) * 0.13;
        bullets.push({
          kind: 'orb', arena: ai, outer: true,
          x: sx + Math.cos(ang) * 6, y: sy + Math.sin(ang) * 6, r: 6,
          vx: Math.cos(ang) * speed, vy: Math.sin(ang) * speed,
          color: k % 2 ? C.white : '#fff1f2'
        });
      }
    }
    a.spawnT = brutal ? 0.24 : (hard ? 0.38 : 0.46);
  }

  else if (a.id === 'yellow') {
    // 弹幕量大，但都可以被空格射掉
    const p = soulForArena(ai);
    const t = p ? soulPos(p) : { x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y + b.h / 2 };
    const mode = a.next++ % 4;

    if (mode === 0) {
      // 中心扩散环：先停 0.2 秒给玩家反应
      const cx = b.x + b.w / 2, cy = b.y + b.h / 2;
      const n = brutal ? 16 : (hard ? 12 : 9);
      const speed = brutal ? 105 : (hard ? 90 : 72);
      a.angle += 0.34;
      for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
        const ang = a.angle + k * Math.PI * 2 / n;
        bullets.push({
          kind: 'orb', arena: ai, r: 5,
          x: cx + Math.cos(ang) * 34, y: cy + Math.sin(ang) * 26,
          vx: Math.cos(ang) * speed, vy: Math.sin(ang) * speed,
          color: C.white, delay: 0.2
        });
      }
    } else if (mode === 1) {
      // 快速瞄准齐射
      const side = randi(0, 3);
      let sx, sy;
      if (side === 0) { sx = rand(b.x + 20, b.x + b.w - 20); sy = b.y - 50; }
      else if (side === 2) { sx = rand(b.x + 20, b.x + b.w - 20); sy = b.y + b.h + 50; }
      else if (side === 3) { sx = b.x - 50; sy = rand(b.y + 18, b.y + b.h - 18); }
      else { sx = b.x + b.w + 50; sy = rand(b.y + 18, b.y + b.h - 18); }
      const base = Math.atan2(t.y - sy, t.x - sx);
      const speed = brutal ? 265 : (hard ? 225 : 180);
      const count = brutal ? 5 : (hard ? 4 : 3);
      for (let k = 0; k < count; k++) {
        const ang = base + (k - (count - 1) / 2) * 0.15;
        bullets.push({
          kind: 'orb', arena: ai, outer: true,
          x: sx, y: sy, r: 5,
          vx: Math.cos(ang) * speed, vy: Math.sin(ang) * speed,
          color: C.white
        });
      }
    } else if (mode === 2) {
      // 慢速碎晶雨，适合练枪
      const n = brutal ? 5 : (hard ? 4 : 3);
      for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
        bullets.push({
          kind: 'shard', arena: ai,
          x: rand(b.x + 16, b.x + b.w - 16), y: b.y - 20 - k * 16,
          r: 6, rot: rand(0, 6), rotv: rand(-7, 7),
          vx: rand(-24, 24), vy: brutal ? 175 : (hard ? 145 : 110),
          color: C.white
        });
      }
    } else {
      // 带缝的白骨墙
      const gap = Math.min(brutal ? 52 : (hard ? 64 : 80), b.h - 54);
      const gy = b.y + 18 + Math.random() * Math.max(6, b.h - gap - 36);
      const speed = brutal ? 290 : (hard ? 220 : 165);
      bullets.push({ kind: 'bone', arena: ai, x: b.x + b.w + 10, y: b.y, w: 14, h: gy - b.y, vx: -speed, vy: 0, color: 'white' });
      bullets.push({ kind: 'bone', arena: ai, x: b.x + b.w + 10, y: gy + gap, w: 14, h: b.y + b.h - (gy + gap), vx: -speed, vy: 0, color: 'white' });
    }
    a.spawnT = brutal ? 0.3 : (hard ? 0.38 : 0.55);
  }

  else if (a.id === 'carousel') {
    // 大风车：骨臂从中心一直扫到框边，角落也会被切到
    const cx = b.x + b.w / 2;
    const cy = b.y + b.h / 2;
    const dir = (a.next++ % 2 === 0) ? 1 : -1;
    wheels.push({
      arena: ai, cx, cy,
      hw: b.w / 2, hh: b.h / 2,
      arms: brutal ? 5 : (hard ? 4 : 3),
      ang: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
      speed: dir * (brutal ? 1.85 : (hard ? 1.55 : 1.25)),
      thick: hard ? 9 : 8,
      t: 0,
      // 困难：风车存活时间必须短于刷新间隔，否则两个同心风车叠在一起，
      // 8 根骨臂把外圈缝隙压到 45°（间隔 0.5s），灵魂速度根本追不上，
      // 只能缩在毂心那个不到 12px 的核里——那不是可玩的路子。
      life: brutal ? 4.6 : (hard ? 2.85 : 4.0),
      flash: 0
    });
    if (brutal && Math.random() < 0.5) {
      wheels.push({
        arena: ai, cx, cy,
        hw: b.w * 0.3, hh: b.h * 0.55,
        arms: 3, ang: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
        speed: -dir * 2.1, thick: 7,
        t: 0, life: 3.6, flash: 0
      });
    }
    // 每第三轮风车：框内同时亮起审判烙印，转与炸一起逼位
    if (a.next % 3 === 1) {
      const m = brutal ? 3 : 1;
      for (let k = 0; k < m; k++) {
        const ang = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
        bullets.push({
          kind: 'sigil', arena: ai,
          x: cx + Math.cos(ang) * b.w * 0.24,
          y: cy + Math.sin(ang) * b.h * 0.2,
          r: 11, warnT: 0.78 + k * 0.14, burst: 6, ang: ang, color: C.red
        });
      }
    }
    // 困难以上：中心飞出安魂音符，跟着风车一起缠人
    if (hard || brutal) {
      for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
        // 音符从毂心外 44px 处生成，而不是直接在坐标原点生成：
        // 风车的安全位就是毂心那一小圈，子弹生成在灵魂身上等于无法反应的必中判。
        const nAng = time * 1.4 + k * Math.PI;
        bullets.push({
          kind: 'note', arena: ai,
          x: cx + Math.cos(nAng) * 44, y: cy + Math.sin(nAng) * 44, r: 6,
          vx: Math.cos(nAng) * 78, vy: Math.sin(nAng) * 78,
          home: brutal ? 46 : 34, wobA: 16, wobF: 2,
          phase: rand(0, 6.28), rot: 0, rotv: 2,
          color: C.white
        });
      }
    }
    a.spawnT = brutal ? 2.6 : (hard ? 3.0 : 3.4);
    Sound.blaster();
    screenPulse = 0.14;
    addRing(cx, cy, 16, 54, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)', 0.5, 2);
  }

  else if (a.id === 'ricochet') {
    // 回响球：从框边射入，撞墙反弹
    const p = soulForArena(ai);
    const t = p ? soulPos(p) : { x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y + b.h / 2 };
    const side = a.next++ % 4;
    let x, y, ang;
    if (side === 0) { x = b.x + 16; y = rand(b.y + 20, b.y + b.h - 20); ang = rand(-0.55, 0.55); }
    else if (side === 1) { x = b.x + b.w - 16; y = rand(b.y + 20, b.y + b.h - 20); ang = Math.PI + rand(-0.55, 0.55); }
    else if (side === 2) { x = rand(b.x + 20, b.x + b.w - 20); y = b.y + 16; ang = Math.PI / 2 + rand(-0.55, 0.55); }
    else { x = rand(b.x + 20, b.x + b.w - 20); y = b.y + b.h - 16; ang = -Math.PI / 2 + rand(-0.55, 0.55); }
    const aim = Math.atan2(t.y - y, t.x - x);
    ang = ang * 0.5 + aim * 0.5;
    const speed = brutal ? 190 : (hard ? 155 : 125);
    const n = brutal ? 3 : (hard ? 2 : 1);
    for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
      const aa = ang + (k - (n - 1) / 2) * 0.42;
      bullets.push({
        kind: 'orb', arena: ai, x, y, r: 6,
        vx: Math.cos(aa) * speed, vy: Math.sin(aa) * speed,
        bounce: brutal ? 4 : 3,
        splitOnBounce: (brutal || hard) ? 2 : 0,
        color: C.white
      });
    }
    Sound.pop();
    a.spawnT = brutal ? 0.44 : (hard ? 0.56 : 0.8);
  }

  else if (a.id === 'requiem') {
    // 安魂曲：会慢慢跟人的音符
    const count = brutal ? 4 : (hard ? 3 : 2);
    for (let k = 0; k < count; k++) {
      bullets.push({
        kind: 'note', arena: ai,
        x: rand(b.x + 24, b.x + b.w - 24), y: b.y - 18 - k * 14,
        r: 7, vx: 0, vy: brutal ? 90 : (hard ? 72 : 56),
        home: brutal ? 58 : (hard ? 44 : 32),
        wobA: rand(18, 34), wobF: rand(1.5, 2.4), phase: rand(0, 6.28),
        rot: rand(-0.2, 0.2), rotv: rand(-0.5, 0.5),
        color: C.white,
        delay: k * 0.16
      });
    }
    Sound.bell();
    a.next = (a.next || 0) + 1;
    // 每第三波：地上亮起一枚审判烙印，倒计时后炸成一圈碎晶
    if (a.next % 3 === 2) {
      bullets.push({
        kind: 'sigil', arena: ai,
        x: rand(b.x + 44, b.x + b.w - 44), y: rand(b.y + 46, b.y + b.h - 56),
        r: 12, warnT: brutal ? 0.72 : (hard ? 0.86 : 1.0),
        burst: brutal ? 8 : 6, ang: rand(0, Math.PI * 2), color: C.red
      });
      Sound.bell();
    }
    a.spawnT = brutal ? 0.95 : (hard ? 1.2 : 1.6);
  }

  else if (a.id === 'palisade') {
    // 骨栅：从框边压进来，只在缺口处留活路；
    // 再叠猫爪、审判烙印和回响球，缺口不再是安全屋
    const edges = ['left', 'right', 'top', 'bottom'];
    const opposite = { left: 'right', right: 'left', top: 'bottom', bottom: 'top' };
    const wave = a.next++;
    const e1 = edges[wave % 4];
    const wall = spawnBoneWall(ai, b, e1, {});
    Sound.boneWall();

    // 隔一波：对面同时压进第二排骨栅，把战场压成一条窄道
    let wall2 = null;
    if (wave % 2 === 1) {
      wall2 = spawnBoneWall(ai, b, opposite[e1], {
        depth: brutal ? 46 : (hard ? 40 : 34),
        gapW: brutal ? 72 : (hard ? 88 : 104),
        delay: 0.34
      });
    }

    // 猫爪从还没被封住的一侧扑进来，和骨栅一挤一扑
    const p = soulForArena(ai);
    if (p) {
      const t = soulPos(p);
      const closed = wall2 ? [e1, wall2.edge] : [e1];
      const open = edges.filter((e) => closed.indexOf(e) < 0);
      const pe = open[wave % Math.max(1, open.length)] || edges[wave % 4];
      let px, py;
      if (pe === 'left') { px = b.x - 28; py = rand(b.y + 22, b.y + b.h - 22); }
      else if (pe === 'right') { px = b.x + b.w + 28; py = rand(b.y + 22, b.y + b.h - 22); }
      else if (pe === 'top') { px = rand(b.x + 26, b.x + b.w - 26); py = b.y - 28; }
      else { px = rand(b.x + 26, b.x + b.w - 26); py = b.y + b.h + 28; }
      const pa = Math.atan2(t.y - py, t.x - px);
      const pspeed = brutal ? 270 : (hard ? 225 : 185);
      bullets.push({
        kind: 'paw', arena: ai, outer: true, x: px, y: py, r: 11, rot: pa,
        vx: Math.cos(pa) * pspeed, vy: Math.sin(pa) * pspeed,
        color: C.white, tr: [], delay: 0.42
      });
      Sound.pop();
    }

    // 审判烙印落在缺口内侧：想蹲缺口就有代价
    if (wall && wall.gaps && wall.gaps.length) {
      const gc = wall.gaps[wave % wall.gaps.length];
      const horiz = wall.edge === 'top' || wall.edge === 'bottom';
      const gx = horiz ? gc : (wall.edge === 'left' ? b.x + wall.depth + 24 : b.x + b.w - wall.depth - 24);
      const gy = horiz ? (wall.edge === 'top' ? b.y + wall.depth + 22 : b.y + b.h - wall.depth - 22) : gc;
      bullets.push({
        kind: 'sigil', arena: ai, x: gx, y: gy, r: 10,
        warnT: brutal ? 0.7 : (hard ? 0.84 : 1.0),
        burst: brutal ? 6 : 5, ang: rand(0, Math.PI * 2), speed: 122
      });
    }

    // 每第三波从对面缺口射一颗会反弹的回响球，封死直线
    if (wave % 3 === 2) {
      const src = wall2 || wall;
      if (src && src.gaps && src.gaps.length) {
        const horiz = src.edge === 'top' || src.edge === 'bottom';
        const gc = src.gaps[0];
        const ox = horiz ? gc : (src.edge === 'left' ? b.x + 6 : b.x + b.w - 6);
        const oy = horiz ? (src.edge === 'top' ? b.y + 6 : b.y + b.h - 6) : gc;
        const t = p ? soulPos(p) : { x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y + b.h / 2 };
        const ra = Math.atan2(t.y - oy, t.x - ox) + rand(-0.2, 0.2);
        const rs = brutal ? 190 : (hard ? 158 : 128);
        bullets.push({
          kind: 'orb', arena: ai, x: ox, y: oy, r: 6,
          vx: Math.cos(ra) * rs, vy: Math.sin(ra) * rs,
          bounce: 3, splitOnBounce: brutal ? 2 : 0,
          color: C.white, delay: 0.3
        });
      }
    }

    a.spawnT = brutal ? 1.35 : (hard ? 1.7 : 2.1);
  }

  else if (a.id === 'drift') {
    // 移动战场：骨墙、碎晶、白羽都跟着框一起漂
    const mode = a.next++ % 4;
    if (mode === 0) {
      const gap = Math.min(brutal ? 50 : (hard ? 60 : 76), b.h - 54);
      const gy = b.y + 16 + Math.random() * Math.max(6, b.h - gap - 32);
      const speed = brutal ? 275 : (hard ? 205 : 160);
      bullets.push({ kind: 'bone', arena: ai, x: b.x + b.w + 12, y: b.y, w: 14, h: gy - b.y, vx: -speed, vy: 0, color: 'white' });
      bullets.push({ kind: 'bone', arena: ai, x: b.x + b.w + 12, y: gy + gap, w: 14, h: b.y + b.h - (gy + gap), vx: -speed, vy: 0, color: 'white' });
      if (brutal) {
        bullets.push({ kind: 'bone', arena: ai, x: b.x + b.w + 78, y: b.y, w: 12, h: Math.max(0, gy - b.y - 12), vx: -speed, vy: 0, color: 'white' });
      }
    } else if (mode === 1) {
      const fromTop = Math.random() < 0.5;
      const speed = brutal ? 300 : (hard ? 230 : 175);
      const n = brutal ? 3 : (hard ? 2 : 1);
      for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
        const x = rand(b.x + 16, b.x + b.w - 16);
        const y = fromTop ? b.y - 10 - k * 18 : b.y + b.h + 10 + k * 18;
        bullets.push({
          kind: 'bone', arena: ai, x, y, w: 14, h: rand(26, 56),
          vx: 0, vy: fromTop ? speed : -speed, color: 'white', delay: 0.14
        });
      }
    } else if (mode === 2) {
      const p = soulForArena(ai);
      const t = p ? soulPos(p) : { x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y + b.h / 2 };
      // 同样不能贴着灵魂刷瞄准弹：随机边太近就改用最远的一条
      const at = (sd) => {
        if (sd === 0) return { x: rand(b.x + 20, b.x + b.w - 20), y: b.y - 26 };
        if (sd === 2) return { x: rand(b.x + 20, b.x + b.w - 20), y: b.y + b.h + 26 };
        if (sd === 3) return { x: b.x - 26, y: rand(b.y + 18, b.y + b.h - 18) };
        return { x: b.x + b.w + 26, y: rand(b.y + 18, b.y + b.h - 18) };
      };
      let pt = at(randi(0, 3));
      if (Math.hypot(pt.x - t.x, pt.y - t.y) < 110) {
        let bestD = -1;
        for (let sd = 0; sd < 4; sd++) {
          const q = at(sd);
          const d = Math.hypot(q.x - t.x, q.y - t.y);
          if (d > bestD) { bestD = d; pt = q; }
        }
      }
      const sx = pt.x, sy = pt.y;
      const base = Math.atan2(t.y - sy, t.x - sx);
      const speed = brutal ? 300 : (hard ? 245 : 190);
      // 困难 3 发加一发猫爪会从同一个点形成扇形封口，缩回 2 发。
      const count = brutal ? 4 : 2;
      for (let k = 0; k < count; k++) {
        const ang = base + (k - (count - 1) / 2) * 0.16;
        bullets.push({
          kind: 'shard', arena: ai, outer: true, x: sx, y: sy, r: 6,
          rot: 0, rotv: rand(-9, 9),
          vx: Math.cos(ang) * speed, vy: Math.sin(ang) * speed,
          color: C.white, karmic: true
        });
      }
      if (brutal) {
        const pa = base + rand(-0.14, 0.14);
        bullets.push({
          kind: 'paw', arena: ai, outer: true, x: sx, y: sy, r: 11, rot: pa,
          vx: Math.cos(pa) * speed * 1.15, vy: Math.sin(pa) * speed * 1.15,
          color: C.white, tr: []
        });
      }
    } else {
      if (brutal) {
        const fromRight = Math.random() < 0.5;
        const px = fromRight ? b.x + b.w + 30 : b.x - 30;
        const py = rand(b.y + 26, b.y + b.h - 26);
        const pa = Math.atan2(b.y + b.h / 2 - py, b.x + b.w / 2 - px);
        bullets.push({
          kind: 'paw', arena: ai, outer: true, x: px, y: py, r: 11, rot: pa,
          vx: Math.cos(pa) * 240, vy: Math.sin(pa) * 240,
          color: C.white, tr: []
        });
      }
    }
    a.spawnT = brutal ? 0.34 : (hard ? 0.44 : 0.6);
  }

  else if (a.id === 'bisect') {
    // 分裂球：先沿着直线飞，随后一分为三
    const p = soulForArena(ai);
    const t = p ? soulPos(p) : { x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y + b.h / 2 };
    const side = a.next++ % 4;
    let x, y;
    if (side === 0) { x = rand(b.x + 26, b.x + b.w - 26); y = b.y + 24; }
    else if (side === 1) { x = rand(b.x + 26, b.x + b.w - 26); y = b.y + b.h - 24; }
    else if (side === 2) { x = b.x + 24; y = rand(b.y + 22, b.y + b.h - 22); }
    else { x = b.x + b.w - 24; y = rand(b.y + 22, b.y + b.h - 22); }
    const base = Math.atan2(t.y - y, t.x - x) + rand(-0.12, 0.12);
    const speed = brutal ? 150 : (hard ? 125 : 105);
    const count = brutal ? 2 : 1;
    for (let k = 0; k < count; k++) {
      const ang = base + (k - (count - 1) / 2) * 0.5;
      bullets.push({
        kind: 'orb', arena: ai, x, y, r: 7,
        vx: Math.cos(ang) * speed, vy: Math.sin(ang) * speed,
        split: 3, splitT: brutal ? 0.55 : (hard ? 0.66 : 0.78),
        splitR: 5, sigilOnSplit: (brutal || hard), color: C.white, tr: [], delay: 0.1
      });
    }
    Sound.bell();
    a.spawnT = brutal ? 0.55 : (hard ? 0.7 : 0.95);
  }

  else if (a.id === 'final') {
    const gap = Math.min(brutal ? 46 : (hard ? 58 : 74), b.h - 50);
    const speed = brutal ? 340 : (hard ? 265 : 195);
    const gy = b.y + 16 + Math.random() * Math.max(6, b.h - gap - 30);
    bullets.push({ kind: 'bone', arena: ai, x: b.x + b.w + 12, y: b.y, w: 14, h: gy - b.y, vx: -speed, vy: 0, color: 'white' });
    bullets.push({ kind: 'bone', arena: ai, x: b.x + b.w + 12, y: gy + gap, w: 14, h: b.y + b.h - (gy + gap), vx: -speed, vy: 0, color: 'white' });
    if (brutal) {
      bullets.push({ kind: 'bone', arena: ai, x: b.x + b.w + 70, y: b.y, w: 12, h: Math.max(0, gy - b.y - 12), vx: -speed, vy: 0, color: Math.random() < 0.3 ? 'blue' : 'white' });
    }
    a.spawnT = brutal ? 0.27 : (hard ? 0.34 : 0.5);
    a.beamT -= a.spawnT;
    if (a.beamT <= 0) {
      a.beamT = brutal ? 1.05 : (hard ? 1.65 : 2.4);
      const dir = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'top' : 'bottom';
      const width = hard ? 34 : 30;
      beams.push({
        dir, pos: rand(b.x + 10, b.x + b.w - 10 - width),
        width, arena: ai,
        warn: brutal ? 0.4 : 0.55, fire: 0.26, t: 0, hit: false
      });
      Sound.blaster();
      screenPulse = 0.12;
    }
  }

  if (a.spawnT <= 0) a.spawnT = 0.5;
}

function endAttack() {
  attack = null;
  bullets = [];
  beams = [];
  lashes = [];
  wheels = [];
  shots = [];
  sparks = [];
  layout = 'normal';
  dualMode = false;
  Object.assign(box, BOX);
  arenaBoxes = [box];
  setCamera(0, 0, 1);

  const hp = player ? player.hp : PLAYER_HP;
  const max = player ? player.max : PLAYER_HP;
  const kr = player ? player.kr : 0;
  const krTick = player ? player.krTick : 0;
  player = makeSoul(0, 'red', box);
  player.hp = hp;
  player.max = max;
  player.kr = kr;
  player.krTick = krTick;
  player2 = null;

  if (state !== 'attack') return;
  state = 'menu';
  menuIndex = 0;
  if (thirdPhase) {
    if (turn % 2 === 0) {
      queueDialog([L('boss', THIRD_MID[Math.floor(turn / 2) % THIRD_MID.length])], () => { state = 'menu'; });
    }
    return;
  }
  if (turn % 3 === 0) {
    const lines = [
      '……还站着啊。',
      '哼，算你有点本事。',
      '别得意，下一轮可不会这样了。',
      '……呼吸乱了。调整一下。'
    ];
    queueDialog([L('boss', lines[Math.floor(turn / 3) % lines.length])], () => { state = 'menu'; });
  }
}


/* ===== render.js ===== */
'use strict';

/* =========================================================
   JUDGEMENT — LFELKEEA
   Render: white stage / original box / souls / endings
   ========================================================= */

function darkMode() {
  return (enraged || thirdPhase) && !['title', 'difficulty', 'ending', 'gameover'].includes(state);
}

function applyCameraTransform() {
  ctx.translate(W / 2, H / 2);
  ctx.scale(camera.zoom, camera.zoom);
  ctx.translate(-W / 2 + camera.x, -H / 2 + camera.y);
}

function drawDevTag() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  ctx.font = `bold 10px ${MONO}`;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,207,31,0.9)';
  ctx.fillText('DEV · INVINCIBLE', W - 18, 16);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawDevBanner() {
  const a = Math.min(1, devBanner / 0.4);
  const w = 230, h = 26, x = W / 2 - w / 2, y = 450;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = a;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(16,12,12,0.86)';
  rr(x, y, w, h, 5);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,207,31,0.7)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  rr(x, y, w, h, 5);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.font = `bold 11px ${MONO}`;
  ctx.fillStyle = C.yellow;
  ctx.fillText('DEVELOPER MODE · INVINCIBLE', W / 2, y + h / 2 + 0.5);
  ctx.restore();
}

function render() {
  ctx.setTransform(RS, 0, 0, RS, 0, 0);
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
  drawBackground();

  // 场景单独套运镜，HUD 固定在屏幕上
  ctx.save();
  applyCameraTransform();

  ctx.save();
  if (shake > 0.2) ctx.translate(rand(-shake, shake) * 0.5, rand(-shake, shake) * 0.5);

  if (state === 'title') {
    drawTitle();
  } else if (state === 'difficulty') {
    drawDifficulty();
  } else if (state === 'ending') {
    drawEnding();
  } else if (state === 'gameover') {
    drawGameOver();
  } else if (state === 'enemycard') {
    drawEnemyCard();
  } else {
    if (state === 'attack' && layout === 'fall') {
      drawFallScene();
    } else {
      drawStageCharacter();
      if (state === 'attack') drawAttackScene();
      else {
        drawBox(box);
        if (state === 'dialog') drawDialog();
        else if (state === 'menu') drawMenu();
        else if (state === 'act') drawActMenu();
        else if (state === 'item') drawItemMenu();
        else if (state === 'mercy') drawMercyMenu();
        else if (state === 'fight') drawFight();
      }
    }
  }

  drawEffects();
  drawSparks();
  if (hitFx) drawHitFx();

  ctx.restore();
  ctx.restore();

  if (!['title', 'difficulty', 'ending', 'gameover', 'enemycard'].includes(state)) {
    drawBossHp();
    drawPlayerHp();
    if (devMode) drawDevTag();
    if (devBanner > 0) drawDevBanner();
  }

  if (screenPulse > 0) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = screenPulse * 0.9;
    ctx.strokeStyle = C.red;
    ctx.lineWidth = 10;
    ctx.strokeRect(5, 5, W - 10, H - 10);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  if (flashScreen > 0) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = flashScreen * 4;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff2030';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.restore();
  }
  if (flashWhite > 0) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = flashWhite;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // Sans 式切场：白闪 → 压黑 → 硬切进下一套弹幕
  if (cutFx) {
    const k = clamp(cutFx.t / cutFx.dur, 0, 1);
    ctx.save();
    if (k < 0.34) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1 - k / 0.34;
      ctx.fillStyle = thirdPhase ? '#ff2a3c' : '#ffffff';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    } else if (k < 0.54) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.72 * (1 - (k - 0.34) / 0.2);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    }
    const edge = Math.max(0, 1 - k * 2.6);
    if (edge > 0) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = edge * 0.85;
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.lineWidth = 12;
      ctx.strokeRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.globalAlpha = edge * 0.5;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const y = (i * 97 + cutFx.t * 900) % H;
        ctx.fillRect(0, y, W, 1.5);
      }
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  if (storyHit) drawStoryHit();

  if (paused) drawPause();

  if (Sound.muted) {
    ctx.font = `10px ${MONO}`;
    ctx.fillStyle = darkMode() ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
    ctx.fillText('MUTED [M]', 12, 464);
  }
}

/* ========================= BACKGROUND ========================= */

function drawBackground() {
  if (darkMode()) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#070407';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(320, 180, 20, 320, 180, 430);
    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(120,8,22,0.4)');
    g.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(52,4,12,0.25)');
    g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.16;
    ctx.strokeStyle = C.red;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
      const y = ((i * 41 + time * 95) % 620) - 70;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-40, y);
      ctx.lineTo(240, y - 120);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(W + 40, y);
      ctx.lineTo(W - 240, y - 120);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();

    drawLattice('rgba(255,42,62,0.55)', 0.22, 2);

    // 第三阶段：背后展开的白色羽翼、放射状斩击与飘落的羽毛
    if (thirdPhase) {
      drawPhase3Wings(320, 150, 1.5, 0.22 + 0.05 * Math.sin(time * 1.5));

      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.1 + 0.04 * Math.sin(time * 2);
      ctx.translate(320, 140);
      for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        const a = (i / 16) * Math.PI * 2 + time * 0.06;
        const len = 200 + (i % 4) * 40;
        ctx.strokeStyle = i % 4 === 0 ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)' : 'rgba(220,20,40,0.6)';
        ctx.lineWidth = i % 4 === 0 ? 2 : 5;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(Math.cos(a) * 40, Math.sin(a) * 40);
        ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(a) * len, Math.sin(a) * len);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.restore();

      ctx.save();
      for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) {
        const x = ((i * 61 + time * (10 + (i % 5) * 6)) % (W + 80)) - 40;
        const y = ((i * 43 + time * (24 + (i % 4) * 9)) % (H + 60)) - 30;
        ctx.globalAlpha = (0.22 + 0.22 * Math.sin(time * 2 + i)) * (1 - fadeProgress * 0.45);
        ctx.fillStyle = i % 3 ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)' : 'rgba(255,150,170,0.7)';
        ctx.fillRect(Math.round(x), Math.round(y), 3, 9);
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }

    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.07;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      const x = (i * 97 + Math.sin(time * (0.5 + i * 0.1)) * 40 + 640) % 640;
      const y = (i * 53 + time * (30 + i * 3)) % 480;
      ctx.fillRect(x - 30, y, 60, 1);
    }
    ctx.restore();
    return;
  }

  ctx.fillStyle = C.paper;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // 棋盘底纹（参考图 1 的白底格子）
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,17,16,0.026)';
  for (let y = 0; y < STAGE_H; y += 24) {
    for (let x = 0; x < W; x += 24) {
      if (((x / 24) + (y / 24)) % 2 === 0) ctx.fillRect(x, y, 24, 24);
    }
  }
  ctx.restore();

  // 参考图 1：立绘背后的红色像素电路纹路（左右镜像）
  drawLattice(C.red, 0.5, 2);

  // faint grid, kept only as light decoration
  ctx.save();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(20,17,16,0.035)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let x = 32; x < W; x += 32) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + 0.5, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(x + 0.5, STAGE_H);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (let y = 32; y < STAGE_H; y += 32) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, y + 0.5);
    ctx.lineTo(W, y + 0.5);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();

  // red frame around the stage
  ctx.save();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(200,18,31,0.5)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(12, STAGE_H - 12);
  ctx.lineTo(12, 12);
  ctx.lineTo(W - 12, 12);
  ctx.lineTo(W - 12, STAGE_H - 12);
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.strokeStyle = C.red;
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  const corner = 26;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(12, 12 + corner); ctx.lineTo(12, 12); ctx.lineTo(12 + corner, 12);
  ctx.moveTo(W - 12 - corner, 12); ctx.lineTo(W - 12, 12); ctx.lineTo(W - 12, 12 + corner);
  ctx.moveTo(12, STAGE_H - 12 - corner); ctx.lineTo(12, STAGE_H - 12); ctx.lineTo(12 + corner, STAGE_H - 12);
  ctx.moveTo(W - 12 - corner, STAGE_H - 12); ctx.lineTo(W - 12, STAGE_H - 12); ctx.lineTo(W - 12, STAGE_H - 12 - corner);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();

  // faint diagonal accents
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.06;
  ctx.strokeStyle = C.red;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(40 + i * 92, STAGE_H - 16);
    ctx.lineTo(110 + i * 92, 16);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

/* 红色像素电路纹路：左半边的折线数据，绘制时按 640 镜像 */
const LATTICE_SEGS = [
  [[236, 42], [236, 206]],
  [[206, 72], [206, 152]],
  [[236, 58], [214, 58], [214, 82], [196, 82]],
  [[236, 58], [258, 58], [258, 74]],
  [[236, 96], [214, 96], [214, 112], [190, 112]],
  [[236, 132], [210, 132], [210, 158], [184, 158]],
  [[236, 168], [216, 168], [216, 188]],
  [[236, 190], [236, 206]],
  [[170, 80], [170, 172]],
  [[170, 92], [154, 92], [154, 72], [140, 72]],
  [[170, 132], [186, 132], [186, 148], [202, 148]],
  [[170, 152], [154, 152], [154, 130]],
  [[222, 74], [222, 86]],
  [[250, 74], [250, 86]],
  [[222, 140], [222, 152]],
  [[250, 140], [250, 152]],
  [[264, 118], [264, 126]],
  [[150, 108], [150, 116]]
];

function drawLattice(color, alpha, lw) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
  ctx.strokeStyle = color;
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.lineWidth = lw;
  ctx.lineJoin = 'miter';
  ctx.lineCap = 'butt';

  for (let m = 0; m < 2; m++) {
    const mx = (x) => (m === 0 ? x : W - x);
    for (const seg of LATTICE_SEGS) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(Math.round(mx(seg[0][0])), Math.round(seg[0][1]));
      for (let i = 1; i < seg.length; i++) {
        ctx.lineTo(Math.round(mx(seg[i][0])), Math.round(seg[i][1]));
      }
      ctx.stroke();

      // 末端箭头
      const n = seg.length;
      if (n >= 2) {
        const a = seg[n - 2], b = seg[n - 1];
        const ang = Math.atan2(b[1] - a[1], mx(b[0]) - mx(a[0]));
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(Math.round(mx(b[0])), Math.round(b[1]));
        ctx.lineTo(Math.round(mx(b[0]) + Math.cos(ang + 2.45) * 8), Math.round(b[1] + Math.sin(ang + 2.45) * 8));
        ctx.moveTo(Math.round(mx(b[0])), Math.round(b[1]));
        ctx.lineTo(Math.round(mx(b[0]) + Math.cos(ang - 2.45) * 8), Math.round(b[1] + Math.sin(ang - 2.45) * 8));
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      // 节点小方块
      for (const pt of seg) ctx.fillRect(Math.round(mx(pt[0])) - 1, Math.round(pt[1]) - 1, 2, 2);
    }
    // 两个小菱形
    for (const d of [[176, 188, 7], [272, 106, 5]]) {
      const cx = Math.round(mx(d[0])), cy = Math.round(d[1]), r = d[2];
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - r);
      ctx.lineTo(cx + r, cy);
      ctx.lineTo(cx, cy + r);
      ctx.lineTo(cx - r, cy);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

/* 第三阶段的巨大羽翼：阶梯状羽片，保持像素感 */
function drawPhase3Wings(cx, cy, scale, alpha) {
  const flap = 1 + Math.sin(time * 1.3) * 0.045;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
  ctx.translate(cx, cy);
  ctx.scale(scale * flap, scale * flap);
  for (const dir of [-1, 1]) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.scale(dir, 1);
    for (let layer = 0; layer < 3; layer++) {
      const off = layer * 13;
      const len = 148 - layer * 24;
      ctx.fillStyle = layer === 0 ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)'
        : layer === 1 ? 'rgba(255,238,240,0.72)'
          : 'rgba(255,186,198,0.5)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(10 + off * 0.4, -6 + off * 0.5);
      for (let i = 0; i <= 10; i++) {
        const px = 20 + (i / 10) * len;
        const py = -28 - Math.sin((i / 10) * Math.PI) * (48 - layer * 8) + (i % 2) * 6;
        ctx.lineTo(px, py + off * 0.5);
      }
      for (let i = 10; i >= 0; i--) {
        const px = 20 + (i / 10) * len;
        const py = -2 + Math.sin((i / 10) * Math.PI) * (58 - layer * 10) + off * 0.6 + (i % 2) * 5;
        ctx.lineTo(px, py);
      }
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.16)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      for (let f = 0; f < 6; f++) {
        const fx = 32 + f * 20;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(fx, -8);
        ctx.lineTo(fx + 16, 30 - f * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

/* ========================= STAGE / BOSS ========================= */

// 二阶段暗化：先用 multiply 吃掉立绘的白色底，再把四边溶进暗红背景
function enragedBlend(x, y, w, h) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.rect(x, y, w, h);
  ctx.clip();

  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'multiply';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a070d';
  ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';

  const edge = Math.min(52, w * 0.2, h * 0.2);
  const gx1 = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, 0, x + edge, 0);
  gx1.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(10,2,5,1)');
  gx1.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(10,2,5,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = gx1;
  ctx.fillRect(x, y, edge, h);

  const gx2 = ctx.createLinearGradient(x + w - edge, 0, x + w, 0);
  gx2.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(10,2,5,0)');
  gx2.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(10,2,5,1)');
  ctx.fillStyle = gx2;
  ctx.fillRect(x + w - edge, y, edge, h);

  const gy1 = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, y, 0, y + edge);
  gy1.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(10,2,5,1)');
  gy1.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(10,2,5,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = gy1;
  ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, edge);

  const gy2 = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, y + h - edge, 0, y + h);
  gy2.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(10,2,5,0)');
  gy2.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(10,2,5,1)');
  ctx.fillStyle = gy2;
  ctx.fillRect(x, y + h - edge, w, edge);

  const vig = ctx.createRadialGradient(x + w / 2, y + h * 0.42, Math.min(w, h) * 0.12, x + w / 2, y + h * 0.42, Math.max(w, h) * 0.62);
  vig.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(10,2,5,0)');
  vig.addColorStop(0.66, 'rgba(10,2,5,0.22)');
  vig.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(10,2,5,0.88)');
  ctx.fillStyle = vig;
  ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.16)';
  for (let sy = y; sy < y + h; sy += 4) ctx.fillRect(x, sy, w, 1);

  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,40,60,' + (0.035 + 0.025 * Math.sin(time * 9)) + ')';
  ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';

  // 刻意的红色边框：让这块区域读作“被侵蚀的立绘框”而不是残留白底
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,52,66,' + (0.55 + 0.2 * Math.sin(time * 7)) + ')';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.strokeRect(x + 1, y + 1, w - 2, h - 2);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,8,18,0.9)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 6;
  ctx.strokeRect(x - 2, y - 2, w + 4, h + 4);
  ctx.restore();
}

// 第三阶段的舞台装饰：缓慢反向旋转的审判之环、上浮的红色余烬、飘落的白羽
function drawThirdAura() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,70,95,0.16)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.setLineDash([12, 16]);
  ctx.lineDashOffset = -time * 32;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(320, 158, 152, 84, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,220,230,0.12)';
  ctx.lineDashOffset = time * 48;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(320, 158, 118, 64, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);

  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
  for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
    const px = 120 + ((i * 71 + time * 14) % 400);
    const py = 252 - ((i * 43 + time * (18 + (i % 3) * 7)) % 232);
    const a = 0.12 + 0.12 * Math.sin(time * 3 + i);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,60,80,${Math.max(0.04, a)})`;
    ctx.fillRect(Math.round(px), Math.round(py), 2, 5);
  }
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';

  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    const px = 90 + ((i * 121 + time * 11) % 470);
    const py = 18 + ((i * 67 + time * 13) % 226);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(px, py);
    ctx.rotate(Math.sin(time * 1.7 + i) * 0.5);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.12 + 0.09 * Math.sin(time * 2 + i);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillRect(-1, -6, 2, 10);
    ctx.fillRect(-4, -4, 8, 1.4);
    ctx.fillRect(-3, 0, 6, 1.2);
    ctx.restore();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawStageCharacter() {
  const x = SPRITE.x + (boss.shake > 0 ? rand(-4, 4) : 0);
  const y = SPRITE.y + (boss.shake > 0 ? rand(-3, 3) : 0);

  const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(320, 150, 20, 320, 150, 190);
  glow.addColorStop(0, thirdPhase ? 'rgba(255,70,95,0.2)' : enraged ? 'rgba(200,18,31,0.22)' : 'rgba(200,18,31,0.07)');
  glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = glow;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, STAGE_H);

  if (thirdPhase) drawThirdAura();

  if (stageArt.ready) {
    const art = enraged && stageArt.red ? stageArt.red : stageArt.canvas;
    if (thirdPhase) {
      // 闪避残影
      if (dodgeFx) {
        const dx = dodgeFx.side * (40 + dodgeFx.t * 120);
        ctx.save();
        ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, 0.3 - dodgeFx.t * 0.5);
        ctx.drawImage(art, x - dx, y, SPRITE.w, SPRITE.h);
        ctx.restore();
      }
      drawDissolvingArt(art, x, y, SPRITE.w, SPRITE.h);
    } else {
      ctx.save();
      if (enraged) {
        ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(220,20,40,0.6)';
        ctx.shadowBlur = 24;
      }
      ctx.drawImage(art, x, y, SPRITE.w, SPRITE.h);
      ctx.restore();
    }
  } else if (stageImg.complete && stageImg.naturalWidth) {
    if (thirdPhase) {
      drawDissolvingArt(stageImg, x, y, SPRITE.w, SPRITE.h);
    } else {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.rect(SPRITE.x - 26, 0, SPRITE.w + 52, STAGE_H);
      ctx.clip();
      ctx.drawImage(stageImg, x, y, SPRITE.w, SPRITE.h);
      ctx.restore();
      if (enraged) enragedBlend(SPRITE.x - 26, 0, SPRITE.w + 52, STAGE_H);
    }
  }

  if (boss.flash > 0) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(0.75, boss.flash * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillRect(SPRITE.x, 0, SPRITE.w, STAGE_H);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  if (state === 'mercy' && spareReady()) drawMercyBloom();

  if (thirdPhase) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
    ctx.font = `bold 13px ${MONO}`;
    const a = 0.5 + 0.3 * Math.sin(time * 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,90,110,${a})`;
    ctx.fillText('PHASE 3', 320, 10);
    ctx.font = `10px ${MONO}`;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    ctx.fillText('FADING', 320, 28);
    ctx.restore();
  } else if (enraged) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
    ctx.font = `bold 14px ${MONO}`;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,60,70,' + (0.65 + 0.3 * Math.sin(time * 6)) + ')';
    ctx.fillText('ENEMY  ATTACK', 320, 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
    ctx.fillText('ENEMY  ATTACK', 320 + Math.sin(time * 30) * 1.5, 10);
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

// 第三阶段：立绘按横条一点点缺失，像身体正在被时间擦掉
function drawDissolvingArt(art, x, y, w, h) {
  const aw = art.width || art.naturalWidth || w;
  const ah = art.height || art.naturalHeight || h;
  const bands = 26;
  ctx.save();
  for (let i = 0; i < bands; i++) {
    if (hash01(i * 7 + 3) < fadeProgress * 1.12) {
      // 缺掉的位置漏出一点红光
      if (hash01(i * 13 + 5) < fadeProgress * 0.5) {
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.1;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff3048';
        ctx.fillRect(x, y + (i / bands) * h, w, h / bands + 0.6);
      }
      continue;
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.94 - fadeProgress * 0.25;
    ctx.drawImage(
      art,
      0, (i / bands) * ah, aw, ah / bands,
      x, y + (i / bands) * h, w, h / bands + 0.7
    );
  }
  ctx.restore();

  // 消散的光点
  ctx.save();
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
    if (hash01(i * 11 + 4) > fadeProgress) continue;
    const px = x + hash01(i * 5 + 1) * w;
    const py = y + ((hash01(i * 3 + 2) * h + time * 26) % h);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.45;
    ctx.fillStyle = i % 2 ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)' : 'rgba(255,90,110,0.8)';
    ctx.fillRect(Math.round(px), Math.round(py), 2, 4);
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawPlayerHp() {

  const ratio = clamp(player.hp / player.max, 0, 1);
  ctx.fillStyle = player.hp <= 5 ? '#ff5240' : C.yellow;
  ctx.fillRect(x + 2, y + 2, Math.max(0, (w - 4) * ratio), h - 4);

    const krW = (w - 4) * clamp(player.kr / player.max, 0, 1);
    ctx.fillStyle = C.purple;
    ctx.fillRect(x + w - 2 - krW, y + 2, krW, h - 4);
  }

  ctx.strokeStyle = dark ? C.white : C.ink;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.strokeRect(x - 1, y - 1, w + 2, h + 2);

  ctx.font = `12px ${MONO}`;
  ctx.fillStyle = dark ? C.white : C.ink;
  ctx.fillText(Math.max(0, Math.ceil(player.hp)) + ' / ' + player.max, x + w + 12, y + 2);

  if (player.kr > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = C.purple;
    ctx.font = `bold 10px ${MONO}`;
    ctx.fillText('KR ' + player.kr, x + w + 74, y + 3);
  }

  ctx.font = `10px ${CN}`;
  ctx.fillStyle = dark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)' : C.dim;
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText(difficulty === 1 ? '审判' : '普通', W - 18, y + 2);
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
}

function drawDiffCard(x, y, w, h, idx) {
  const sel = menuIndex === idx;
  const hard = idx === 1;
  ctx.save();
  if (sel) {
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(200,18,31,0.35)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 18;
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = sel ? '#fffdf8' : '#f7f4ec';
  rr(x, y, w, h, 8);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  ctx.strokeStyle = sel ? C.red : '#cfc8bb';
  ctx.lineWidth = sel ? 3 : 1;
  rr(x, y, w, h, 8);
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  ctx.font = `bold 25px ${CN}`;
  ctx.fillStyle = sel ? C.red : C.dim;
  ctx.fillText(hard ? '审判' : '普通', x + w / 2, y + 22);

  ctx.font = `bold 11px ${MONO}`;
  ctx.fillStyle = sel ? C.ink : C.dim;
  ctx.fillText(hard ? 'JUDGEMENT' : 'NORMAL', x + w / 2, y + 58);

  ctx.font = `11px ${CN}`;
  ctx.fillStyle = sel ? '#3a3530' : C.dim;
  const lines = hard
    ? ['弹幕更快、更密。', '她的 HP：520。', '多段攻击：骨门 / 骨雨 / 双屏 /', '护盾 / 坠落 / 回响 / 骨栅 /', '移动框 / 分裂 / 终极。', '屠杀路线二阶段进入黑红形态，', '容错极低。']
    : ['弹幕较慢、较疏。', '她的 HP：160。', '保留全部机制：', '双屏、护盾、坠落、蓝橙骨、骨栅。', '适合先熟悉节奏。'];
  lines.forEach((line, i) => ctx.fillText(line, x + w / 2, y + 92 + i * 20));

  if (sel && Math.floor(time * 2) % 2 === 0) {
    ctx.font = `bold 12px ${CN}`;
    ctx.fillStyle = C.red;
    ctx.fillText('按 Z 确认', x + w / 2, y + h - 28);
  }
}

/* ========================= BOX ========================= */

function drawBox(b) {
  ctx.fillStyle = '#050407';
  ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
  ctx.strokeStyle = C.white;
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.strokeRect(b.x - 2, b.y - 2, b.w + 4, b.h + 4);
  if (enraged) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,40,60,0.55)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeRect(b.x + 4.5, b.y + 4.5, b.w - 9, b.h - 9);
  }
  if (thirdPhase) {
    // 第三阶段：框外多一圈流动的审判刻度，四角压出审判印记
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,90,110,${0.24 + 0.14 * Math.sin(time * 3.2)})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.setLineDash([10, 9]);
    ctx.lineDashOffset = -time * 26;
    ctx.strokeRect(b.x - 11, b.y - 11, b.w + 22, b.h + 22);
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,210,220,0.34)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    const L = 12;
    const corners = [
      [b.x - 15, b.y - 15, 1, 1],
      [b.x + b.w + 15, b.y - 15, -1, 1],
      [b.x - 15, b.y + b.h + 15, 1, -1],
      [b.x + b.w + 15, b.y + b.h + 15, -1, -1]
    ];
    for (const [cx, cy, sx, sy] of corners) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx, cy + sy * L);
      ctx.lineTo(cx, cy);
      ctx.lineTo(cx + sx * L, cy);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

function drawHint(text) {
  if (!text) return;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = attack && attack.hintT > 0 ? Math.min(1, attack.hintT / 0.6) : 0.92;
  ctx.font = `10px ${CN}`;
  const tw = ctx.measureText(text).width;
  const w = Math.min(460, tw + 26);
  const h = 20;
  const y = layout === 'fall' ? 28 : (layout === 'dual' ? DUAL_A.y - 34 : box.y - 34);
  const x = W - 16 - w;

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.94)';
  rr(x, y, w, h, 10);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(20,17,16,0.16)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  rr(x, y, w, h, 10);
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#3f3a34';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText(text, x + w / 2, y + h / 2 + 0.5);
  ctx.restore();
}

/* ========================= DIALOG / MENUS ========================= */

function drawDialog() {
  if (!dialog) return;
  const line = dialog.lines[dialog.idx];
  if (!line) return;
  const isBoss = line.who === 'boss';
  // 打字机计数只统计台词本身，"* " 前缀始终直接显示，否则会吞掉最后两个字
  const prefix = isBoss ? '' : '* ';
  const text = prefix + line.text;
  const font = `16px ${CN}`;
  const maxW = box.w - 52;

  if (isBoss) {
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
    ctx.font = `bold 12px ${MONO}`;
    ctx.fillStyle = spareReady() ? C.yellow : '#ff4656';
    ctx.fillText('LFELKEEA', box.x + 24, box.y + 12);
  }

  const lines = wrapText(text, maxW, font);
  let remain = Math.floor(dialog.shown) + prefix.length;
  let y = box.y + (isBoss ? 36 : 22);
  ctx.font = font;
  ctx.fillStyle = isBoss ? C.white : '#dcd8d0';
  for (const ln of lines) {
    if (remain <= 0) break;
    ctx.fillText(ln.slice(0, remain), box.x + 24, y);
    remain -= ln.length;
    y += 23;
  }

  if (dialog.shown >= line.text.length && Math.floor(time * 2) % 2 === 0) {
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.font = `13px ${MONO}`;
    ctx.fillStyle = C.red;
    ctx.fillText('▼', box.x + box.w - 22, box.y + box.h - 26);
  }
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
}
