CURSEFORGE_MANIFEST = "manifest.json"
MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_TOTAL_FILES = 100_000
MAX_TOTAL_BYTES = 64 * 1024**3
CONTENT_DIRS = (
    "mods",
    "config",
    "defaultconfigs",
    "resourcepacks",
    "shaderpacks",
    "saves",
)
_RESERVED_OVERRIDE_DIRS = {"versions", "libraries", "assets", "logs", "crash-reports"}
_WINDOWS_RESERVED = {
    "CON",
    "PRN",
    "AUX",
    "NUL",
    *(f"COM{i}" for i in range(1, 10)),
    *(f"LPT{i}" for i in range(1, 10)),
}

ProgressCallback = Callable[[int, str], None]
LogCallback = Callable[[str], None]


class CurseForgePackError(Exception):
    pass


@dataclass
class CurseForgeFile:
    project_id: str
    file_id: str
    required: bool = True


@dataclass
class CurseForgeOverride:
    member: str
    relative: str
    size: int


@dataclass
class CurseForgePackInfo:
    path: Path
    manifest: dict[str, Any]
    files: list[CurseForgeFile]
    overrides: list[CurseForgeOverride]
    counts: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    total_files: int = 0
    total_bytes: int = 0
    archive_bytes: int = 0

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return str(self.manifest.get("name") or self.path.stem or "CurseForge 整合包")

    @property
    def description(self) -> str:
        text = str(self.manifest.get("author") or "").strip()
        return f"作者：{text}" if text else ""

    @property
    def version_id(self) -> str:
        return str(self.manifest.get("version") or "")

    @property
    def created_at(self) -> str:
        return ""

    @property
    def created_with(self) -> str:
        return "CurseForge"

    @property
    def minecraft_version(self) -> str:
        minecraft = self.manifest.get("minecraft") or {}
        if not isinstance(minecraft, dict):
            return ""
        return str(minecraft.get("version") or "")

    @property
    def loader_key(self) -> str:
        minecraft = self.manifest.get("minecraft") or {}
        if not isinstance(minecraft, dict):
            return ""
        loaders = minecraft.get("modLoaders") or []
        if not isinstance(loaders, list):
            return ""
        chosen = next(
            (
                item
                for item in loaders
                if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("primary")
            ),
            loaders[0] if loaders else None,
        )
        if not isinstance(chosen, dict):
            return ""
        raw = str(chosen.get("id") or "").strip().lower()
        for key in ("neoforge", "fabric", "forge", "quilt"):
            if raw.startswith(key + "-"):
                return key
        return ""

    @property
    def loader(self) -> str:
        return {
            "fabric": "Fabric",
            "forge": "Forge",
            "neoforge": "NeoForge",
            "quilt": "Quilt",
        }.get(self.loader_key, "")

    @property
    def loader_version(self) -> str:
        minecraft = self.manifest.get("minecraft") or {}
        if not isinstance(minecraft, dict):
            return ""
        loaders = minecraft.get("modLoaders") or []
        if not isinstance(loaders, list) or not loaders:
            return ""
        chosen = next(
            (
                item
                for item in loaders
                if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("primary")
            ),
            loaders[0],
        )
        if not isinstance(chosen, dict):
            return ""
        raw = str(chosen.get("id") or "").strip()
        prefix = self.loader_key + "-"
        if prefix and raw.lower().startswith(prefix):
            return raw[len(prefix) :]
        return ""


def _safe_path(name: str, label: str = "整合包") -> str:
    value = str(name or "").replace("\\", "/")
    if not value or value.startswith("/") or re.match(r"^[A-Za-z]:", value):
        raise CurseForgePackError(f"{label}内包含非法路径：{name}")
    parts = PurePosixPath(value).parts
    if any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in parts):
        raise CurseForgePackError(f"{label}内包含越界路径：{name}")
    for part in parts:
        if (
            re.search(r'[<>:"|?*\x00-\x1f]', part)
            or part.endswith((" ", "."))
            or part.split(".", 1)[0].upper() in _WINDOWS_RESERVED
        ):
            raise CurseForgePackError(f"{label}内包含 Windows 无法使用的路径：{name}")
    return "/".join(parts)


def _read_manifest(zf: zipfile.ZipFile, info: zipfile.ZipInfo) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if info.file_size > MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES:
        raise CurseForgePackError("manifest.json 过大，已拒绝读取")
    if info.flag_bits & 0x1:
        raise CurseForgePackError("整合包中的文件被加密，无法读取")
    try:
        raw = zf.read(info)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise CurseForgePackError(f"读取 CurseForge 清单失败：{exc}") from exc
    try:
        data = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8-sig"))
    except Exception as exc:
        raise CurseForgePackError("manifest.json 不是有效的 JSON") from exc
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise CurseForgePackError("manifest.json 格式不正确")
    return data


def _parse_files(manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> list[CurseForgeFile]:
    raw_files = manifest.get("files")
    if not isinstance(raw_files, list):
        raise CurseForgePackError("CurseForge 清单缺少 files 列表")
    result: list[CurseForgeFile] = []
    seen: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
    for item in raw_files:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise CurseForgePackError("CurseForge 清单里的文件条目格式不正确")
        project_id = str(item.get("projectID") or item.get("projectId") or "").strip()
        file_id = str(item.get("fileID") or item.get("fileId") or "").strip()
        if not project_id or not file_id:
            continue
        key = (project_id, file_id)
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        result.append(
            CurseForgeFile(
                project_id=project_id,
                file_id=file_id,
                required=bool(item.get("required", True)),
            )
        )
    return result


def _load_archive(path: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], list[CurseForgeOverride]]:
    archive = Path(path)
    if not archive.is_file():
        raise CurseForgePackError("整合包文件不存在")
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as zf:
            infos = zf.infolist()
            if len(infos) > MAX_TOTAL_FILES:
                raise CurseForgePackError("整合包内文件数量过多，已拒绝读取")
            seen: set[str] = set()
            total = 0
            manifest_info: zipfile.ZipInfo | None = None
            for info in infos:
                name = _safe_path(info.filename, "整合包")
                key = name.lower()
                if key in seen:
                    raise CurseForgePackError(f"整合包内存在重复文件：{name}")
                seen.add(key)
                mode = (info.external_attr >> 16) & 0o170000
                if mode == 0o120000:
                    raise CurseForgePackError(f"整合包内不允许符号链接：{name}")
                if info.is_dir():
                    continue
                if info.flag_bits & 0x1:
                    raise CurseForgePackError("整合包中的文件被加密，无法导入")
                total += max(0, int(info.file_size))
                if total > MAX_TOTAL_BYTES:
                    raise CurseForgePackError("整合包解压后体积超过 64 GB，已拒绝导入")
                if name.lower() == CURSEFORGE_MANIFEST:
                    manifest_info = info
            if manifest_info is None:
                raise CurseForgePackError(
                    "这不是 CurseForge 整合包：缺少 manifest.json"
                )
            manifest = _read_manifest(zf, manifest_info)
            raw_override_dir = str(manifest.get("overrides") or "overrides")
            override_dir = _safe_path(raw_override_dir.strip("/"), "整合包")
            prefix = override_dir + "/"
            overrides: list[CurseForgeOverride] = []
            for info in infos:
                name = _safe_path(info.filename, "整合包")
                if info.is_dir() or not name.startswith(prefix):
                    continue
                relative = name[len(prefix) :]
                if not relative:
                    continue
                relative = _safe_path(relative, "整合包")
                reserved = relative.split("/", 1)[0].lower()
                if reserved in _RESERVED_OVERRIDE_DIRS:
                    raise CurseForgePackError(
                        f"整合包覆盖文件写入了保留目录：{relative}"
                    )
                overrides.append(
                    CurseForgeOverride(
                        member=info.filename,
                        relative=relative,
                        size=max(0, int(info.file_size)),
                    )
                )
    except CurseForgePackError:
        raise
    except zipfile.BadZipFile as exc:
        raise CurseForgePackError("文件不是有效的 ZIP 压缩包") from exc
    except OSError as exc:
        raise CurseForgePackError(f"无法打开整合包：{exc}") from exc
    return manifest, overrides


def looks_like_curseforge_pack(path: Path | str) -> bool:
    archive = Path(path)
    if not archive.is_file():
        return False
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as zf:
            info = next(
                (
                    item
                    for item in zf.infolist()
                    if item.filename.replace("\\", "/").lower()
                    == CURSEFORGE_MANIFEST
                ),
                None,
            )
            if info is None or info.file_size > MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES:
                return False
            data = json.loads(zf.read(info).decode("utf-8-sig"))
            return (
                isinstance(data, dict)
                and str(data.get("manifestType") or "") == "minecraftModpack"
            )
    except Exception:
        return False


def inspect_curseforge_pack(path: Path | str) -> CurseForgePackInfo:
    archive = Path(path)
    manifest, overrides = _load_archive(archive)
    if str(manifest.get("manifestType") or "") != "minecraftModpack":
        raise CurseForgePackError("这个压缩包不是 CurseForge Minecraft 整合包")
    try:
        manifest_version = int(manifest.get("manifestVersion") or 0)
    except Exception:
        manifest_version = 0
    if manifest_version != 1:
        raise CurseForgePackError(
            f"CurseForge 整合包格式版本 {manifest_version or '未知'} 不受支持"
        )
    minecraft = manifest.get("minecraft") or {}
    if not isinstance(minecraft, dict):
        raise CurseForgePackError("CurseForge 清单缺少 minecraft 配置")
    mc_version = str(minecraft.get("version") or "").strip()
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9A-Za-z._-]{1,40}", mc_version):
        raise CurseForgePackError(f"Minecraft 版本号不正确：{mc_version or '未知'}")
    files = _parse_files(manifest)
    if not files and not overrides:
        raise CurseForgePackError("整合包里没有任何需要导入的内容")

    counts = {name: 0 for name in CONTENT_DIRS}
    for item in overrides:
        first = item.relative.split("/", 1)[0]
        if first in counts:
            counts[first] += 1
    counts["mods"] += len(files)

    return CurseForgePackInfo(
        path=archive,
        manifest=manifest,
        files=files,
        overrides=overrides,
        counts=counts,
        total_files=len(files) + len(overrides),
        total_bytes=sum(item.size for item in overrides),
        archive_bytes=archive.stat().st_size,
    )


@dataclass
class CurseForgeImportResult:
    version_id: str
    imported_files: int
    skipped_files: int
    imported_bytes: int
    downloaded_files: int


def _inside(root: Path, path: Path) -> Path:
    try:
        path.resolve().relative_to(root.resolve())
    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise CurseForgePackError(f"整合包路径越界：{path}") from exc
    return path


def _write_version_wrapper(
    game_dir: Path, version_id: str, inherits_from: str
) -> Path:
    path = version_json_path(game_dir, version_id)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    data = {
        "id": version_id,
        "inheritsFrom": inherits_from,
        "type": "release",
        "name": version_id,
    }
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return path


def import_curseforge_pack(
    pack_path: Path | str,
    game_dir: Path | str,
    version_id: str,
    *,
    java_path: str = "",
    overwrite: bool = False,
    resume: bool = False,
    isolated: bool = True,
    source: str = "official",
    threads: int = 8,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    log_cb: LogCallback | None = None,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
    loader_installer: Callable[..., str] | None = None,
    download_func: Callable[..., int] | None = None,
    file_fetcher: Callable[..., dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
    installer: Any | None = None,
) -> CurseForgeImportResult:
    game_dir = Path(game_dir)
    info = inspect_curseforge_pack(pack_path)
    version_id = normalize_version_id(version_id)
    version_dir = game_dir / "versions" / version_id
    if version_dir.exists() and not resume:
        raise CurseForgePackError(f"版本 {version_id} 已经存在，请换一个导入名称")
    if resume and not version_dir.exists():
        # 上次取消得早，目标目录还没建出来；按全新导入继续即可。
        resume = False

    progress = progress_cb or (lambda _p, _m: None)
    log = log_cb or (lambda _m: None)
    cancel = cancel_event or threading.Event()
    loader_installer = loader_installer or install_loader
    download_func = download_func or download_to_file
    fetch_meta = file_fetcher or fetch_file
    connections = min(6, max(2, max(1, int(threads)) // 2))

    def check_cancel() -> None:
        if cancel.is_set():
            raise CurseForgePackError("导入已取消")

    def loader_progress(percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        check_cancel()
        progress(loader_stage_percent(percent), message)

    mc_version = info.minecraft_version
    loader_kind = info.loader_key
    if loader_kind == "quilt":
        raise CurseForgePackError(
            "这个整合包使用 Quilt 加载器，当前启动器还不支持 Quilt。"
            "可以尝试使用 Prism 等其他启动器。"
        )
    log(
        f"CurseForge 整合包：{info.name} · Minecraft {mc_version} · "
        f"{info.loader or '原版'}"
        + (f" {info.loader_version}" if info.loader_version else "")
    )
    progress(2, "检查整合包与加载器…")
    check_cancel()

    inherits_from = ""
    if loader_kind:
        if loader_kind in ("forge", "neoforge") and not java_path:
            raise CurseForgePackError(
                f"安装 {info.loader} 需要 Java，请先在设置里选择 Java。"
            )
        progress(3, f"安装 Minecraft {mc_version} + {info.loader}…")
        inherits_from = loader_installer(
            game_dir,
            mc_version,
            loader_kind,
            info.loader_version,
            java_path=java_path,
            source=source,
            progress_cb=loader_progress,
            log_cb=log,
            cancel_event=cancel,
        )
        check_cancel()
    else:
        progress(3, f"安装 Minecraft {mc_version}…")
        target_installer = installer or Installer(
            game_dir,
            source=source,
            progress_cb=loader_progress,
            log_cb=log,
            cancel_event=cancel,
            threads=threads,
        )
        target_installer.install(mc_version)
        check_cancel()
        inherits_from = mc_version

    if inherits_from == version_id:
        raise CurseForgePackError("导入名称不能和加载器版本名称相同，请换一个名称")
    progress(46, "写入版本骨架…")
    _write_version_wrapper(game_dir, version_id, inherits_from)
    log(f"已创建版本 {version_id}，继承 {inherits_from}")

    run_dir = version_game_dir(game_dir, version_id, isolated)
    run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    mods_dir = run_dir / "mods"

    imported = 0
    skipped = 0
    imported_bytes = 0
    downloaded = 0
    total_files = max(1, len(info.files))

    def resolve(item: CurseForgeFile) -> tuple[CurseForgeFile, dict[str, Any]]:
        check_cancel()
        try:
            version = fetch_meta(
                item.project_id, item.file_id, content_type="mod"
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            raise CurseForgePackError(
                f"读取 CurseForge 文件 {item.project_id}/{item.file_id} 失败：{exc}"
            ) from exc
        files = [
            entry
            for entry in version.get("files") or []
            if isinstance(entry, dict)
        ]
        file = next(
            (entry for entry in files if entry.get("primary") and entry.get("url")),
            next((entry for entry in files if entry.get("url")), None),
        )
        if not isinstance(file, dict):
            raise CurseForgePackError(
                f"作者未开放文件 {item.project_id}/{item.file_id} 的第三方下载，"
                "请到 CurseForge 页面手动下载"
            )
        return item, file

    resolved: list[tuple[CurseForgeFile, dict[str, Any]]] = []
    if info.files:
        metadata_workers = min(8, max(2, int(threads)), len(info.files))
        if metadata_workers > 1:
            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=metadata_workers) as pool:
                resolved = list(pool.map(resolve, info.files))
        else:
            resolved = [resolve(item) for item in info.files]

    pending: list[BatchDownload] = []
    seen_dest: set[str] = set()
    for item, file in resolved:
        check_cancel()
        filename = Path(str(file.get("filename") or "")).name
        if not filename:
            raise CurseForgePackError(
                f"CurseForge 文件 {item.file_id} 的文件名无效"
            )
        destination = _inside(run_dir, mods_dir / filename)
        size = int(file.get("size") or 0)
        sha1 = str((file.get("hashes") or {}).get("sha1") or "")
        if destination.is_file() and size and destination.stat().st_size == size:
            skipped += 1
            continue
        key = str(destination).lower()
        if key in seen_dest:
            skipped += 1
            continue
        seen_dest.add(key)

        raw_url = str(file.get("url") or "")
        if not candidate_download_urls(raw_url):
            raise CurseForgePackError(f"文件 {filename} 没有可用的下载地址")

        def candidates(url: str = raw_url) -> list[str]:
            return candidate_download_urls(url)

        pending.append(
            BatchDownload(
                dest=destination,
                urls=candidates,
                sha1=sha1,
                size=size,
                label=f"mods/{filename}",
            )
        )

    if pending:
        start_percent = 48 + int(44 * skipped / total_files)
        downloaded, failures = download_batch(
            pending,
            cancel_event=cancel,
            connections=connections,
            max_workers=min(8, max(2, int(threads))),
            progress_cb=progress,
            percent_range=(start_percent, 92),
            log_cb=log,
            label="下载整合包文件",
            download_func=download_func,
        )
        imported += downloaded
        imported_bytes += sum(max(0, int(task.size)) for task in pending)
        if failures:
            detail = failures[0]
            raise CurseForgePackError(
                f"{len(failures)} 个文件下载失败：{detail}"
            )
    else:
        downloaded = 0

    override_total = sum(max(0, item.size) for item in info.overrides) or 1
    jobs: list[ExtractJob] = []
    groups: dict[str, list[int]] = {}
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(info.path) as zf:
            indexes: dict[str, int] = {}
            for item in info.overrides:
                check_cancel()
                destination = _inside(run_dir, run_dir / item.relative)
                reserved = item.relative.split("/", 1)[0].lower()
                if reserved in _RESERVED_OVERRIDE_DIRS:
                    raise CurseForgePackError(
                        f"整合包覆盖文件写入了保留目录：{item.relative}"
                    )
                if item.relative.lower() == f"{version_id}.json".lower():
                    raise CurseForgePackError(
                        "整合包覆盖文件试图替换版本 JSON，已拒绝导入"
                    )
                try:
                    entry = zf.getinfo(item.member)
                except KeyError as exc:
                    raise CurseForgePackError(
                        f"整合包里找不到覆盖文件：{item.relative}"
                    ) from exc
                job = ExtractJob(entry, destination, item.relative)
                key = item.relative.lower()
                if key in indexes:
                    jobs[indexes[key]] = job
                    groups[key][0] += 1
                    groups[key][1] += max(0, item.size)
                else:
                    indexes[key] = len(jobs)
                    groups[key] = [
                        1,
                        max(0, item.size),
                        1 if destination.exists() else 0,
                    ]
                    jobs.append(job)
    except CurseForgePackError:
        raise
    except zipfile.BadZipFile as exc:
        raise CurseForgePackError("整合包在导入过程中损坏") from exc
    except OSError as exc:
        raise CurseForgePackError(f"读取整合包文件失败：{exc}") from exc

    check_cancel()

    def override_progress(done_bytes: int, _files: int, label: str) -> None:
        if label:
            progress(
                min(99, 92 + int(7 * done_bytes / override_total)),
                f"放入 {label}",
            )

    extract_threads = max(
        1, min(DEFAULT_EXTRACT_THREADS, int(threads or DEFAULT_EXTRACT_THREADS))
    )
    try:
        stats = extract_zip_entries(
            info.path,
            jobs,
            threads=extract_threads,
            overwrite=overwrite,
            cancel_event=cancel,
            progress_cb=override_progress,
        )
    except ZipExtractCancelled as exc:
        raise CurseForgePackError("导入已取消") from exc
    except ZipExtractError as exc:
        raise CurseForgePackError(f"解压覆盖文件失败：{exc}") from exc
    imported += stats.added
    skipped += stats.skipped
    imported_bytes += stats.bytes_written
    for count, size, existed in groups.values():
        if count <= 1:
            continue
        if existed and not overwrite:
            skipped += count - 1
        else:
            imported += count - 1
            imported_bytes += size

    check_cancel()
    progress(100, "猫猫已经把 CurseForge 整合包搬进猫窝")
    log(
        f"导入完成：{version_id} · 下载 {downloaded} 个文件 · "
        f"新增 {imported} 个文件"
        + (f" · 跳过 {skipped} 个已存在文件" if skipped else "")
    )
    return CurseForgeImportResult(
        version_id=version_id,
        imported_files=imported,
        skipped_files=skipped,
        imported_bytes=imported_bytes,
        downloaded_files=downloaded,
    )


################################################################################
# FILE: darkitten/decompiler.py
################################################################################
"""把 JAR 反编译成可浏览的源码目录，用于模组学习与排错。

只依赖 JDK 和 Vineflower（下载到 cache 目录，不随程序分发）。
所有输出都写在用户指定的目录里，不会修改原始 JAR。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Callable

from .config import APP_DIR
from .downloader import download_to_file
from . import java as java_mod

ProgressCallback = Callable[[int, str], None]

VINEFLOWER_VERSION = "1.11.1"
VINEFLOWER_URL = (
    "https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/org/vineflower/vineflower/"
    f"{VINEFLOWER_VERSION}/vineflower-{VINEFLOWER_VERSION}.jar"
)
VINEFLOWER_SHA1 = ""
MAX_JAR_BYTES = 512 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_NESTED_JARS = 24
CREATE_NO_WINDOW = getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0)

CLASS_ENTRY_RE = re.compile(r"^[\w/$-]+\.class$")
SAFE_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"[^\w.\-]+", re.UNICODE)


class DecompileError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def _progress(callback: ProgressCallback | None, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
    if callback is None:
        return
    try:
        callback(max(0, min(100, int(percent))), str(message))
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - 进度回调不应该影响主流程
        pass


def cache_dir() -> Path:
    path = APP_DIR / "cache" / "vineflower"
    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return path


def vineflower_jar() -> Path:
    return cache_dir() / f"vineflower-{VINEFLOWER_VERSION}.jar"


def ensure_vineflower(
    progress: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    cancel: object | None = None,
) -> Path:
    target = vineflower_jar()
    if target.is_file() and target.stat().st_size > 1024 * 1024:
        return target
    _progress(progress, 2, "正在下载反编译器 Vineflower…")
    temp = target.with_name(target.name + ".part")
    try:
        download_to_file(
            VINEFLOWER_URL,
            temp,
            cancel_event=cancel,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            connections=4,
        )
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - 统一成可读错误
        try:
            temp.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        except OSError:
            pass
        raise DecompileError(f"反编译器下载失败：{exc}") from exc
    temp.replace(target)
    _progress(progress, 8, "反编译器已就绪")
    return target


def java_executable(config=None) -> str:
    """挑一个能用的 Java：配置优先，其次 JAVA_HOME，最后自动探测。"""
    preferred = str(getattr(config, "java_path", "") or "").strip()
    candidates: list[str] = []
    if preferred:
        candidates.append(preferred)
        candidates.append(str(Path(preferred) / "bin" / "java.exe"))
    env_home = os.environ.get("JAVA_HOME", "").strip()
    if env_home:
        candidates.append(str(Path(env_home) / "bin" / "java.exe"))
        candidates.append(str(Path(env_home) / "bin" / "java"))
    which = shutil.which("java")
    if which:
        candidates.append(which)
    for item in candidates:
        if item and Path(item).is_file():
            return str(Path(item))
    try:
        installs = java_mod.detect_java_installs(preferred, max_workers=4)
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        installs = []
    usable = [item for item in installs if getattr(item, "major", 0) >= 17]
    if not usable:
        usable = list(installs)
    if usable:
        return max(usable, key=lambda item: getattr(item, "major", 0)).path
    raise DecompileError("没有找到可用的 Java。请先在启动器设置里选择 JDK，或安装 JDK 17+。")


def safe_name(value: str, fallback: str = "mod") -> str:
    text = SAFE_NAME_RE.sub("-", str(value or "").strip()).strip(".-_")
    return text or fallback


def _class_count(jar: Path) -> int:
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(jar) as archive:
            return sum(1 for name in archive.namelist() if CLASS_ENTRY_RE.match(name))
    except (OSError, zipfile.BadZipFile):
        return 0


def _nested_jars(jar: Path) -> list[tuple[str, bytes]]:
    """提取 META-INF/jarjar 等位置的嵌套 JAR，用于一起反编译。"""
    result: list[tuple[str, bytes]] = []
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(jar) as archive:
            for name in archive.namelist():
                lower = name.lower()
                if not lower.endswith(".jar"):
                    continue
                if not (lower.startswith("meta-inf/jarjar/") or lower.startswith("meta-inf/jars/")):
                    continue
                try:
                    data = archive.read(name)
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                    continue
                if len(data) <= MAX_JAR_BYTES:
                    result.append((name, data))
                if len(result) >= MAX_NESTED_JARS:
                    break
    except (OSError, zipfile.BadZipFile):
        return []
    return result


def _run_vineflower(
    java: str,
    vineflower: Path,
    jar: Path,
    out_dir: Path,
    *,
    log_path: Path,
    timeout: int = 1800,
) -> None:
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    command = [
        java,
        "-Xmx1g",
        "-jar",
        str(vineflower),
        "-dgs=1",
        "-hdc=0",
        "-rsy=1",
        "-asc=1",
        "-jrt=1",
        "-log=WARN",
        str(jar),
        str(out_dir),
    ]
    try:
        with log_path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as log:
            result = subprocess.run(
                command,
                stdout=log,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                timeout=timeout,
                creationflags=CREATE_NO_WINDOW,
            )
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
        raise DecompileError("反编译超时（超过 30 分钟），已停止。") from exc
    except OSError as exc:
        raise DecompileError(f"无法启动 Java：{exc}") from exc
    if result.returncode != 0 and not any(out_dir.rglob("*.java")):
        detail = ""
        try:
            detail = log_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")[-800:]
        except OSError:
            pass
        raise DecompileError(f"反编译失败：{detail.strip() or '未知错误'}")


def decompile_jar(
    jar: str | Path,
    out_dir: str | Path,
    *,
    config=None,
    progress: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    timeout: int = 1800,
) -> dict:
    """反编译 JAR，返回源码目录、类数量和索引文件。"""
    source = Path(str(jar)).expanduser()
    if not source.is_file():
        raise DecompileError(f"JAR 不存在：{source}")
    if source.stat().st_size > MAX_JAR_BYTES:
        raise DecompileError("JAR 超过 512MB，无法在这个工具里反编译。")
    target = Path(str(out_dir)).expanduser()
    target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    vineflower = ensure_vineflower(progress)
    java = java_executable(config)

    _progress(progress, 12, f"正在反编译 {source.name}…")
    log_path = target / "_decompile.log"
    nested = _nested_jars(source)
    _run_vineflower(java, vineflower, source, target, log_path=log_path, timeout=timeout)

    nested_info: list[dict] = []
    for index, (name, data) in enumerate(nested, start=1):
        label = safe_name(Path(name).stem, f"nested-{index}")
        sub = target / "_nested" / label
        temp_jar = sub / f"{label}.jar"
        sub.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        temp_jar.write_bytes(data)
        _progress(
            progress,
            12 + int(70 * index / max(1, len(nested))),
            f"正在反编译嵌套包 {index}/{len(nested)}：{Path(name).name}",
        )
        try:
            _run_vineflower(
                java,
                vineflower,
                temp_jar,
                sub / "src",
                log_path=sub / "_decompile.log",
                timeout=timeout,
            )
            nested_info.append({"name": name, "dir": str(sub / "src")})
        except DecompileError as exc:
            nested_info.append({"name": name, "dir": "", "error": str(exc)})

    sources = sorted(target.rglob("*.java"))
    classes = _class_count(source)
    index = target / "INDEX.md"
    lines = [
        f"# {source.name} 反编译索引",
        "",
        f"- 原始 JAR：`{source}`",
        f"- Java 类文件：{classes} 个",
        f"- 生成源码：{len(sources)} 个 .java",
        "- 反编译器：Vineflower " + VINEFLOWER_VERSION,
        "",
        "> 反编译源码仅用于本地学习与排错，请遵守原模组许可证，不要重新分发。",
        "",
    ]
    if nested_info:
        lines.append("## 嵌套 JAR")
        for item in nested_info:
            if item.get("dir"):
                lines.append(f"- `{item['name']}` → `{item['dir']}`")
            else:
                lines.append(f"- `{item['name']}` 失败：{item.get('error') or '未知错误'}")
        lines.append("")
    lines.append("## 源码目录")
    for item in sources[:400]:
        lines.append(f"- `{item.relative_to(target).as_posix()}`")
    if len(sources) > 400:
        lines.append(f"- ……另有 {len(sources) - 400} 个文件")
    index.write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
    _progress(progress, 100, f"反编译完成：{len(sources)} 个源码文件")
    return {
        "jar": str(source),
        "source_dir": str(target),
        "index": str(index),
        "classes": classes,
        "files": len(sources),
        "nested": nested_info,
    }


def write_learn_index(root: Path, entry: dict) -> Path:
    """维护学习库索引，启动器桥和界面都从这里读取历史记录。"""
    root = Path(root)
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path = root / "index.json"
    try:
        data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        data = []
    if not isinstance(data, list):
        data = []
    entry = dict(entry)
    entry["updated"] = entry.get("updated") or ""
    key = (entry.get("project") or entry.get("jar") or "").lower()
    data = [item for item in data if str(item.get("project") or item.get("jar") or "").lower() != key]
    data.insert(0, entry)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data[:200], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return path

def has_chinese(text: str) -> bool:
    return bool(re.search(r"[\u3400-\u9fff]", str(text or "")))


def _human_number(value: Any) -> str:
    try:
        number = int(value)
    except Exception:
        return ""
    if number >= 1_000_000:
        return f"{number / 1_000_000:.1f}M"
    if number >= 1_000:
        return f"{number / 1_000:.1f}K"
    return str(number)


def _text_list(value: Any, limit: int = 0) -> list[str]:
    if not isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)):
        return []
    items = [str(item).strip() for item in value if str(item).strip()]
    return items[:limit] if limit else items


def category_labels(categories: Any, limit: int = 3) -> list[str]:
    result: list[str] = []
    for item in _text_list(categories):
        label = CATEGORY_ZH.get(item.lower().replace("_", "-"))
        if label and label not in result:
            result.append(label)
        if len(result) >= limit:
            break
    return result


def loader_labels(loaders: Any, fallback: str = "", limit: int = 3) -> list[str]:
    result: list[str] = []
    for item in _text_list(loaders) or ([fallback] if fallback else []):
        label = LOADER_LABELS.get(item.lower(), item)
        if label and label not in result:
            result.append(label)
        if len(result) >= limit:
            break
    return result


def _project_keys(data: dict) -> list[str]:
    keys: list[str] = []
    for name in ("project_id", "id", "slug", "title"):
        value = str(data.get(name) or "").strip().lower()
        if value and value not in keys:
            keys.append(value)
    return keys


def _versions_text(data: dict, fallback: str = "", limit: int = 4) -> str:
    versions = _text_list(data.get("game_versions"))
    if not versions and fallback:
        versions = [fallback]
    if not versions:
        return ""
    shown = versions[:limit]
    if len(versions) > limit:
        return "、".join(shown) + f" 等 {len(versions)} 个版本"
    return "、".join(shown)


def project_zh_intro(
    data: dict,
    content_type: str = "mod",
    loader: str = "",
    game_version: str = "",
    limit: int = 0,
) -> str:
    """根据项目元数据生成中文介绍；常用 Mod 使用人工整理文案。"""
    data = data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}
    for key in _project_keys(data):
        curated = CURATED.get(key)
        if curated:
            return _trim(curated, limit)
        cleaned = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", key).strip("-")
        if cleaned and cleaned in CURATED:
            return _trim(CURATED[cleaned], limit)

    title = str(data.get("title") or data.get("slug") or "这个项目").strip()
    kind = CONTENT_KIND.get(str(content_type or "mod").lower(), "Mod")
    categories = category_labels(data.get("categories"), 2)
    loaders = loader_labels(data.get("loaders"), loader)
    versions = _versions_text(data, game_version)
    author = str(data.get("author") or "").strip()
    downloads = _human_number(data.get("downloads"))

    parts: list[str] = []
    if content_type == "resourcepack":
        parts.append(f"{title} 是一款 Minecraft 材质包")
        if categories:
            parts.append(f"，整体偏向{('、'.join(categories))}风格")
    elif content_type == "shader":
        parts.append(f"{title} 是一款 Minecraft 光影包")
        if categories:
            parts.append(f"，画面风格以{('、'.join(categories))}为主")
    elif content_type == "plugin":
        parts.append(f"{title} 是一个 Minecraft 服务器插件")
        if categories:
            parts.append(f"，功能偏向{('、'.join(categories))}")
    elif content_type == "modpack":
        parts.append(f"{title} 是一个 Minecraft 整合包")
        if loaders:
            parts.append(f"，基于 {' / '.join(loaders)} 加载器")
    else:
        parts.append(f"{title} 是一个")
        if loaders:
            parts.append(f"面向 {' / '.join(loaders)} 的")
        parts.append(f"{('、'.join(categories) + '类') if categories else '综合性'} Mod")

    if versions:
        parts.append(f"，支持 Minecraft {versions}")
    parts.append("。")
    if author:
        parts.append(f"作者是 {author}。")
    if downloads:
        parts.append(f"项目累计下载约 {downloads} 次。")
    if not author and not downloads:
        parts.append("详细信息可以在项目页面查看，安装前请确认前置与游戏版本。")
    return _trim("".join(parts), limit)


def local_mod_zh_intro(
    name: str,
    loader: str = "",
    version: str = "",
    description: str = "",
) -> str:
    """为本地导入的 Mod 生成中文说明；原简介本身是中文时直接使用。"""
    if has_chinese(description):
        return _trim(description, 140)
    title = str(name or "这个 Mod").strip()
    loader_text = f"{loader} 平台的 " if loader else ""
    version_text = f"（版本 {version}）" if version else ""
    return (
        f"{title}{version_text} 是一个 {loader_text}本地 Mod，"
        "文件已经放入当前游戏版本的 mods 文件夹，启用后会被游戏加载。"
    )


def _trim(text: str, limit: int) -> str:
    text = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
    if limit and len(text) > limit:
        return text[: max(1, limit - 1)] + "…"
    return text

# FILE: darkitten/developer.py

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import hmac
from urllib.parse import quote

DEVELOPER_KEY_HASH = "81ce9dc6a39406b41cc60168771496fad2ecc539bab6fb88ada317a85795ba7f"
FEEDBACK_TABLE_URL = "https://lfelkeea.github.io/darkitten-launcher/feedback.html"
FEEDBACK_TABLE_SALT = "DKL::feedback-table::"

_developer_mode = False


def verify_developer_key(value: str) -> bool:
    """校验开发者口令，源码中只保存 SHA-256，不保存明文。"""
    text = str(value or "").strip()
    if not text:
        return False
    digest = hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    return hmac.compare_digest(digest, DEVELOPER_KEY_HASH)


def developer_page_token(value: str) -> str:
    """把口令派生为反馈表访问令牌，令牌本身不会写进网站源码。"""
    text = str(value or "").strip()
    return hashlib.sha256((FEEDBACK_TABLE_SALT + text).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def unlock_developer(config, key: str) -> bool:
    if not verify_developer_key(key):
        return False
    config.developer_unlocked = True
    config.developer_page_token = developer_page_token(key)
    set_developer_mode(True)
    return True


def lock_developer(config) -> None:
    config.developer_unlocked = False
    config.developer_page_token = ""
    set_developer_mode(False)


def feedback_table_url(config) -> str:
    token = str(getattr(config, "developer_page_token", "") or "").strip()
    if not token:
        return FEEDBACK_TABLE_URL
    return f"{FEEDBACK_TABLE_URL}#key={quote(token, safe='')}"


def set_developer_mode(enabled: bool) -> None:
    global _developer_mode
    _developer_mode = bool(enabled)


def developer_mode() -> bool:
    return _developer_mode

def redact(text: str) -> str:
    """移除常见令牌与密钥，诊断包可以安全地发给开发者。"""
    patterns = (
        (
            r"(?i)(access_token|refresh_token|id_token|client_secret|client_?token|sakura_token)"
            r"([\"']?\s*[:=]\s*[\"']?)[^\s\"',}]+",
            r"\1\2<已隐藏>",
        ),
        (r"(?i)(authorization\s*:\s*bearer\s+)[^\s]+", r"\1<已隐藏>"),
        (r"(?i)(token=)[^\s&]+", r"\1<已隐藏>"),
    )
    result = text
    for pattern, replacement in patterns:
        result = re.sub(pattern, replacement, result)
    return result


def _read_tail(path: Path, limit: int = MAX_LOG_BYTES) -> str:
    try:
        size = path.stat().st_size
        with path.open("rb") as fp:
            if size > limit:
                fp.seek(-limit, os.SEEK_END)
            raw = fp.read()
    except OSError:
        return ""
    return redact(raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))


def _system_info() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "app": APP_NAME,
        "version": APP_VERSION,
        "python": sys.version.split()[0],
        "frozen": bool(getattr(sys, "frozen", False)),
        "platform": platform.platform(),
        "system": platform.system(),
        "release": platform.release(),
        "machine": platform.machine(),
        "processor": platform.processor(),
        "cwd": os.getcwd(),
        "app_dir": str(APP_DIR),
    }


def _java_info(java_installs: Iterable[Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    result: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for item in java_installs or []:
        result.append(
            {
                "path": str(getattr(item, "path", "")),
                "version": str(getattr(item, "version", "")),
                "major": int(getattr(item, "major", 0) or 0),
                "arch": str(getattr(item, "arch", "")),
                "vendor": str(getattr(item, "vendor", "")),
            }
        )
    return result


def _mods_list(config, version_id: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    if not version_id:
        return []
    try:
        from .mods import list_mods

        mods = list_mods(config.mods_path(version_id))
    except Exception:
        return []
    result: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for mod in mods:
        result.append(
            {
                "file": mod.filename,
                "name": mod.name,
                "version": mod.version,
                "loader": mod.loader,
                "enabled": bool(mod.enabled),
            }
        )
    return result


def _install_problems(config, version_id: str) -> list[str]:
    if not version_id:
        return []
    try:
        resolved = resolve_version(config.game_path, version_id)
        return list(check_installation(config.game_path, resolved))
    except Exception as exc:
        return [f"检查失败：{exc}"]


def build_summary(
    config,
    java_installs: Iterable[Any] = (),
    selected_version: str = "",
    loader_id: str = "",
) -> tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    version_id = selected_version or config.last_version
    game_path = config.version_game_path(version_id) if version_id else config.game_path
    info: dict[str, Any] = {
        "app": APP_NAME,
        "version": APP_VERSION,
        "generated_at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
        "system": _system_info(),
        "game_dir": str(config.game_path),
        "version_game_dir": str(game_path),
        "selected_version": version_id,
        "loader": loader_id,
        "memory_mb": config.memory_mb,
        "jvm_args": config.jvm_args,
        "version_isolation": bool(config.version_isolation),
        "download_source": config.download_source,
        "download_threads": config.download_threads,
        "theme": config.theme,
        "update_url": config.update_url,
        "java": _java_info(java_installs),
        "source_health": health_summary(),
        "mods": _mods_list(config, version_id),
        "install_problems": _install_problems(config, version_id),
    }
    lines = [
        f"{APP_NAME} 诊断信息",
        f"生成时间：{info['generated_at']}",
        f"启动器版本：{APP_VERSION}",
        f"Python：{info['system']['python']}",
        f"系统：{info['system']['platform']}",
        f"运行目录：{APP_DIR}",
        f"游戏目录：{config.game_path}",
        f"当前版本：{version_id or '未选择'}",
        f"加载器：{loader_id or '原版'}",
        f"内存：{config.memory_mb} MB",
        f"下载源：{config.download_source}（{info['source_health']}）",
        f"版本隔离：{'开启' if config.version_isolation else '关闭'}",
        "",
        "Java：",
    ]
    if info["java"]:
        for item in info["java"]:
            lines.append(
                f"  - Java {item['version']} ({item['arch']}) · {item['path']}"
            )
    else:
        lines.append("  - 未检测到")
    lines.extend(["", f"Mod 数量：{len(info['mods'])}"])
    for item in info["mods"]:
        flag = "启用" if item["enabled"] else "禁用"
        lines.append(f"  - {item['file']} · {item['name']} {item['version']} · {flag}")
    lines.extend(["", "文件检查："])
    if info["install_problems"]:
        lines.extend(f"  - {item}" for item in info["install_problems"])
    else:
        lines.append("  - 未发现缺失文件")
    lines.extend(
        [
            "",
            "隐私说明：诊断包已隐藏访问令牌、刷新令牌、LittleSkin 登录令牌、樱花 Token 等敏感信息；",
            "不包含账户密码、皮肤文件、世界存档和 Mod 本体。",
        ]
    )
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n", info


def _crash_reports(game_path: Path) -> list[Path]:
    folder = game_path / "crash-reports"
    if not folder.is_dir():
        return []
    files = [path for path in folder.glob("*.txt") if path.is_file()]
    files.sort(key=lambda path: path.stat().st_mtime, reverse=True)
    return files[:MAX_CRASH_REPORTS]


def create_bundle(
    config,
    java_installs: Iterable[Any] = (),
    selected_version: str = "",
    loader_id: str = "",
) -> tuple[Path, str]:
    """生成诊断 ZIP，返回（压缩包路径，摘要文本）。"""
    summary, info = build_summary(
        config, java_installs, selected_version, loader_id
    )
    out_dir = APP_DIR / "diagnostics"
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
    path = out_dir / f"dkl-diagnostics-{stamp}.zip"
    index = 1
    while path.exists():
        path = out_dir / f"dkl-diagnostics-{stamp}-{index}.zip"
        index += 1

    version_id = info["selected_version"]
    game_path = Path(info["version_game_dir"])
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
        archive.writestr("summary.txt", summary)
        archive.writestr(
            "system.json",
            json.dumps(info, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2).encode("utf-8"),
        )
        if LOG_FILE.exists():
            archive.writestr("launcher.log", _read_tail(LOG_FILE))
        latest_log = game_path / "logs" / "latest.log"
        if latest_log.exists():
            archive.writestr("game-latest.log", _read_tail(latest_log))
        crash_lines: list[str] = []
        for crash in _crash_reports(game_path):
            text = _read_tail(crash, 256 * 1024)
            archive.writestr(f"crash-reports/{crash.name}", text)
            crash_lines.append(f"{crash.name} · {crash.stat().st_size} 字节")
        if crash_lines:
            archive.writestr(
                "crash-reports/index.txt", "\n".join(crash_lines) + "\n"
            )
        archive.writestr(
            "config-safe.json",
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "memory_mb": config.memory_mb,
                    "jvm_args": redact(config.jvm_args),
                    "download_source": config.download_source,
                    "download_threads": config.download_threads,
                    "version_isolation": config.version_isolation,
                    "last_version": config.last_version,
                    "version_loaders": config.version_loaders,
                    "update_url": config.update_url,
                    "theme": config.theme,
                },
                ensure_ascii=False,
                indent=2,
            ).encode("utf-8"),
        )
        if version_id:
            archive.writestr("version.txt", f"{version_id}\n{loader_id}\n")
    return path, summary
