def minecraftseedmap_version(platform: str) -> str | None:
    """把 Chunkbase 平台 ID 降级成 MinecraftSeedMap 支持的大版本。"""
    return _SEEDMAP_PLATFORM_VERSIONS.get(normalize_chunkbase_platform(platform))


def minecraftseedmap_url(seed: int | str, version: str | None = None) -> str:
    base = f"https://minecraftseedmap.org/seed/{urllib.parse.quote(str(seed))}"
    major = minecraftseedmap_version(version) if version else None
    return f"{base}/{major}" if major else base

    ("教程", 4),

    ("用户", 6),
    ("社群", 7),
)


def mcmod_search_url(query: str, filter_id: int = 0, page: int = 1) -> str:
    keyword = urllib.parse.quote((query or "").strip())
    page = max(1, int(page or 1))
    return (
        "https://search.mcmod.cn/s?key="
        f"{keyword}&filter={max(0, int(filter_id or 0))}&page={page}"
    )


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class MCModResult:
    title: str
    url: str
    summary: str
    category: str = ""
    meta: str = ""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class MCModPage:
    results: tuple[MCModResult, ...]
    keyword: str
    filter_id: int
    page: int
    total_pages: int
    total_text: str


def _strip_html(text: str) -> str:
    text = re.sub(r"<script[\s\S]*?</script>", " ", text or "", flags=re.I)
    text = re.sub(r"<style[\s\S]*?</style>", " ", text, flags=re.I)
    text = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", "", text)
    text = html_module.unescape(text)
    text = re.sub(r"\[h\d+=([^\]]*)\]", r"【\1】", text)
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()


def _mcmod_category(url: str) -> str:
    path = urllib.parse.urlparse(url).path
    if "/modpack/" in path:
        return "整合包"
    if "/class/" in path:
        return "模组"
    if "/post/" in path:
        return "教程"
    if "/author/" in path:
        return "作者"
    if "/user/" in path:
        return "用户"
    if "/group/" in path:
        return "社群"
    if any(part in path for part in ("/item/", "/block/", "/entity/", "/fluid/")):
        return "资料"
    return "其他"


def _parse_mcmod_page(page: str, keyword: str, filter_id: int) -> MCModPage:
    blocks = re.findall(
        r'<div class="result-item">([\s\S]*?)(?=<div class="result-item">|'
        r'<div class="search-result-pages"|</body>)',
        page,
    )
    results: list[MCModResult] = []
    for block in blocks:
        head = re.search(
            r'<div class="head">([\s\S]*?)<div class="body">', block
        )
        if not head:
            continue
        chosen = None
        for href, raw_title in re.findall(
            r'<a[^>]*href="([^"]+)"[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)</a>', head.group(1)
        ):
            title = _strip_html(raw_title)
            if title:
                chosen = (href, title)
                break
        if chosen is None:
            continue
        url = html_module.unescape(chosen[0]).strip()
        title = chosen[1]
        if not url:
            continue
        if url.startswith("//"):
            url = "https:" + url
        elif url.startswith("/"):
            url = "https://www.mcmod.cn" + url
        body = re.search(r'<div class="body">([\s\S]*?)</div>', block)
        summary = _strip_html(body.group(1)) if body else ""
        if len(summary) > 320:
            summary = summary[:320].rstrip() + "…"
        foot = re.search(r'<div class="foot">([\s\S]*?)</div>', block)
        meta_parts = []
        if foot:
            for label, value in re.findall(
                r'<span>([^<]+)</span>\s*<span class="value">([\s\S]*?)</span>',
                foot.group(1),
            ):
                clean_label = _strip_html(label).rstrip("：:")
                clean_value = _strip_html(value)
                if clean_value and clean_label:
                    meta_parts.append(f"{clean_label}：{clean_value}")
        results.append(
            MCModResult(
                title=title,
                url=url,
                summary=summary,
                category=_mcmod_category(url),
                meta=" · ".join(meta_parts[:3]),
            )
        )

    info = re.search(r'<p class="info">([\s\S]*?)</p>', page)
    info_text = _strip_html(info.group(1)) if info else ""
    total_pages = 1
    page_match = re.search(r"共约?\s*(\d+)\s*页", info_text)
    if page_match:
        total_pages = max(1, int(page_match.group(1)))
    total_match = re.search(r"找到约?\s*([\d,]+)\s*条结果", info_text)
    total_text = (
        f"找到约 {total_match.group(1)} 条结果"
        if total_match
        else (info_text.split("[")[0].strip() or "搜索完成")
    )
    return MCModPage(
        results=tuple(results),
        keyword=keyword,
        filter_id=filter_id,
        page=max(1, int(re.search(r"&page=(\d+)", page).group(1)) if re.search(r"&page=(\d+)", page) else 1),
        total_pages=total_pages,
        total_text=total_text,
    )


def search_mcmod_page(
    query: str,
    *,
    filter_id: int = 0,
    page: int = 1,
    timeout: int = 15,
) -> MCModPage:
    """在启动器内抓取一页 MC百科搜索结果，包含分类与总页数。"""
    keyword = (query or "").strip()
    if not keyword:
        raise ValueError("请输入要搜索的关键词")
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        mcmod_search_url(keyword, filter_id, page),
        headers={
            "User-Agent": (
                "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) "
                "AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) "
                "Chrome/126.0 Safari/537.36"
            ),
            "Accept-Language": "zh-CN,zh;q=0.9",
        },
    )
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=max(5, timeout)) as response:
            html = response.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
    except urllib.error.URLError as error:
        raise RuntimeError(f"连接 MC百科失败：{error.reason}") from error
    except OSError as error:
        raise RuntimeError(f"请求 MC百科失败：{error}") from error
    data = _parse_mcmod_page(html, keyword, filter_id)
    return MCModPage(
        results=data.results,
        keyword=data.keyword,
        filter_id=data.filter_id,
        page=max(1, min(int(page or 1), data.total_pages)),
        total_pages=data.total_pages,
        total_text=data.total_text,
    )


def search_mcmod(query: str, limit: int = 12, timeout: int = 15) -> list[MCModResult]:
    """兼容旧调用：返回单页结果，按 limit 截断。"""
    data = search_mcmod_page(query, timeout=timeout)
    return list(data.results)[: max(1, int(limit))]

# 指令目录

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CommandSpec:
    name: str
    usage: str
    summary: str
    example: str
    category: str = "基础"
    aliases: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    keywords: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    note: str = ""

    @property
    def search_text(self) -> str:
        return " ".join(
            (self.name, self.usage, self.summary, self.example, self.category, *self.aliases, *self.keywords)
        ).lower()

COMMAND_BY_NAME: dict[str, CommandSpec] = {}
for _spec in COMMANDS:
    COMMAND_BY_NAME[_spec.name] = _spec
    for _alias in _spec.aliases:
        COMMAND_BY_NAME.setdefault(_alias, _spec)

COMMAND_ROOTS = set(COMMAND_BY_NAME)


def search_commands(query: str, category: str = "全部", limit: int = 80) -> list[CommandSpec]:
    text = (query or "").strip().lower()
    result: list[CommandSpec] = []
    for spec in COMMANDS:
        if category and category not in ("全部", "all") and spec.category != category:
            continue
        if text and text not in spec.search_text:
            continue
        result.append(spec)
    return result[: max(1, int(limit))]


def command_categories() -> list[str]:
    seen: list[str] = ["全部"]
    for spec in COMMANDS:
        if spec.category not in seen:
            seen.append(spec.category)
    return seen


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 指令校验

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ValidationIssue:
    level: str  # error / warn / info
    message: str

    @property
    def icon(self) -> str:
        return {"error": "×", "warn": "!", "info": "i"}.get(self.level, "i")


_COORD_RE = re.compile(r"^[~^]?-?\d*(?:\.\d+)?$")
_SELECTOR_RE = re.compile(r"@[praes](?:\[[^\]]*\])?")


def _brackets_balanced(text: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    pairs = {"(": ")", "[": "]", "{": "}"}
    closing = {value: key for key, value in pairs.items()}
    stack: list[str] = []
    quote = ""
    escaped = False
    for char in text:
        if escaped:
            escaped = False
            continue
        if char == "\\":
            escaped = True
            continue
        if quote:
            if char == quote:
                quote = ""
            continue
        if char in ("'", '"'):
            quote = char
            continue
        if char in pairs:
            stack.append(char)
        elif char in closing:
            if not stack or stack[-1] != closing[char]:
                return False, f"括号不匹配：多出来的 {char}"
            stack.pop()
    if quote:
        return False, "引号没有闭合"
    if stack:
        return False, f"括号没有闭合：还差 {''.join(reversed(stack))}"
    return True, ""


def _numeric_coordinate(token: str) -> float | None:
    if not _COORD_RE.match(token):
        return None
    if token.startswith("~") or token.startswith("^"):
        return None
    if token in ("", "+", "-"):
        return None
    try:
        return float(token)
    except ValueError:
        return None


def validate_command(command: str) -> list[ValidationIssue]:
    issues: list[ValidationIssue] = []
    text = (command or "").strip()
    if not text:
        return [ValidationIssue("error", "指令为空")]
    if "\n" in text or "\r" in text:
        issues.append(ValidationIssue("error", "一条指令里不能换行；多条请分开填写"))
        text = text.replace("\r", " ").replace("\n", " ")
    if text.startswith("/"):
        text = text[1:].lstrip()
    if not text:
        return [ValidationIssue("error", "斜杠后面没有内容")]

    if len(text) > 32500:
        issues.append(ValidationIssue("error", "超过命令方块 32500 字符上限"))
    elif len(text) > 256:
        issues.append(ValidationIssue("warn", "超过聊天栏 256 字符上限，只能放进命令方块或函数"))

    ok, reason = _brackets_balanced(text)
    if not ok:
        issues.append(ValidationIssue("error", reason))

    parts = text.split()
    root = parts[0].lower()
    if root not in COMMAND_ROOTS:
        issues.append(ValidationIssue("warn", f"未收录的指令根节点：{root}（可能是模组指令）"))
    elif root == "execute" and " run " not in f" {text} ":
        issues.append(ValidationIssue("error", "execute 必须以 run <指令> 结尾"))

    if root in ("fill", "clone"):
        coords = parts[1:7]
        numbers = [_numeric_coordinate(token) for token in coords]
        if len(numbers) == 6 and all(value is not None for value in numbers):
            xs = sorted((numbers[0], numbers[3]))  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            ys = sorted((numbers[1], numbers[4]))  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            zs = sorted((numbers[2], numbers[5]))  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            volume = (xs[1] - xs[0] + 1) * (ys[1] - ys[0] + 1) * (zs[1] - zs[0] + 1)
            if volume > 32768:
                issues.append(ValidationIssue("error", f"区域体积 {int(volume)} 超过 32768 上限"))

    for selector in _SELECTOR_RE.findall(text):
        if selector.startswith("@e") and not re.search(r"\[[^\]]*(type|limit|distance|tag|name|predicate)=", selector):
            issues.append(ValidationIssue("warn", "@e 没有加 type/limit/distance 等过滤，可能选中大量实体"))
            break

    if not issues:
        issues.append(ValidationIssue("info", "看起来没问题"))
    return issues


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 指令模板

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TemplateField:
    key: str
    label: str
    default: str = ""
    placeholder: str = ""
    required: bool = True
    kind: str = "text"  # text / int / choice / picker / component
    options: tuple[game_ids.Option, ...] = ()
    picker: str = ""
    help: str = ""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CommandTemplate:
    id: str
    name: str
    description: str
    fields: tuple[TemplateField, ...]
    builder: Callable[[dict[str, str]], str]


def _value(values: dict[str, str], key: str, default: str = "") -> str:
    return (values.get(key) or default).strip()


def _json_text(text: str) -> str:
    return json.dumps({"text": text}, ensure_ascii=False)


def _tpl_give(values: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    target = _value(values, "target", "@s")
    item = _value(values, "item", "minecraft:diamond_sword")
    count = _value(values, "count", "1")
    extra = _value(values, "extra")
    command = f"/give {target} {item}{extra} {count}"
    return command


def _tpl_tp(values: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    return (
        f"/tp {_value(values, 'target', '@s')} "
        f"{_value(values, 'x', '~')} {_value(values, 'y', '~')} {_value(values, 'z', '~')}"
    )


def _tpl_setblock(values: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    return (
        f"/setblock {_value(values, 'x', '~')} {_value(values, 'y', '~')} {_value(values, 'z', '~')} "
        f"{_value(values, 'block', 'minecraft:stone')} {_value(values, 'mode', 'replace')}"
    )


def _tpl_fill(values: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    return (
        f"/fill {_value(values, 'x1', '~-5')} {_value(values, 'y1', '~')} {_value(values, 'z1', '~-5')} "
        f"{_value(values, 'x2', '~5')} {_value(values, 'y2', '~5')} {_value(values, 'z2', '~5')} "
        f"{_value(values, 'block', 'minecraft:glass')} {_value(values, 'mode', 'replace')}"
    )


def _tpl_summon(values: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    extra = _value(values, "nbt")
    base = (
        f"/summon {_value(values, 'entity', 'minecraft:zombie')} "
        f"{_value(values, 'x', '~')} {_value(values, 'y', '~1')} {_value(values, 'z', '~')}"
    )
    return f"{base} {extra}" if extra else base


def _tpl_effect(values: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    return (
        f"/effect give {_value(values, 'target', '@s')} {_value(values, 'effect', 'minecraft:speed')} "
        f"{_value(values, 'duration', '30')} {_value(values, 'amplifier', '1')}"
    )


def _tpl_enchant(values: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    return (
        f"/enchant {_value(values, 'target', '@s')} {_value(values, 'enchantment', 'minecraft:sharpness')} "
        f"{_value(values, 'level', '5')}"
    )


def _tpl_title(values: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    position = _value(values, "position", "title")
    text = _value(values, "text", "欢迎来到喵喵世界")
    return f"/title {_value(values, 'target', '@a')} {position} {_json_text(text)}"


def _tpl_tellraw(values: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    return f"/tellraw {_value(values, 'target', '@a')} {_json_text(_value(values, 'text', '你好'))}"


def _tpl_playsound(values: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    return (
        f"/playsound {_value(values, 'sound', 'minecraft:entity.player.levelup')} "
        f"{_value(values, 'source', 'master')} {_value(values, 'target', '@a')} ~ ~ ~ "
        f"{_value(values, 'volume', '1')} {_value(values, 'pitch', '1')}"
    )


def _tpl_particle(values: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    return (
        f"/particle {_value(values, 'particle', 'minecraft:flame')} "
        f"{_value(values, 'x', '~')} {_value(values, 'y', '~1')} {_value(values, 'z', '~')} "
        f"{_value(values, 'dx', '0.2')} {_value(values, 'dy', '0.2')} {_value(values, 'dz', '0.2')} "
        f"{_value(values, 'speed', '0.01')} {_value(values, 'count', '30')}"
    )


def _tpl_execute(values: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    return (
        f"/execute as {_value(values, 'target', '@a')} at @s "
        f"if {_value(values, 'condition', 'entity @s type=minecraft:player')} "
        f"run {_value(values, 'command', 'say hello')}"
    )


def _tpl_scoreboard_add(values: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    return (
        f"/scoreboard objectives add {_value(values, 'objective', 'kills')} "
        f"{_value(values, 'criterion', 'dummy')}"
    )


def _tpl_scoreboard_set(values: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    return (
        f"/scoreboard players set {_value(values, 'target', '@s')} "
        f"{_value(values, 'objective', 'kills')} {_value(values, 'value', '0')}"
    )


def _tpl_spawnpoint(values: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    return (
        f"/spawnpoint {_value(values, 'target', '@s')} "
        f"{_value(values, 'x', '~')} {_value(values, 'y', '~')} {_value(values, 'z', '~')}"
    )


def _tpl_locate(values: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    return f"/locate {_value(values, 'type', 'structure')} {_value(values, 'id', 'minecraft:stronghold')}"


def _tpl_worldborder(values: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    return f"/worldborder set {_value(values, 'diameter', '2000')}"


def _tpl_time(values: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    return f"/time set {_value(values, 'value', 'day')}"


def _tpl_weather(values: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    return (
        f"/weather {_value(values, 'type', 'clear')} "
        f"{_value(values, 'duration', '600')}"
    )


def _tpl_gamerule(values: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    return f"/gamerule {_value(values, 'rule', 'keepInventory')} {_value(values, 'value', 'true')}"


def _tpl_clear(values: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    return (
        f"/clear {_value(values, 'target', '@s')} "
        f"{_value(values, 'item', 'minecraft:dirt')} {_value(values, 'count', '64')}"
    )


def _tpl_xp(values: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    return (
        f"/xp add {_value(values, 'target', '@s')} {_value(values, 'amount', '30')} "
        f"{_value(values, 'unit', 'levels')}"
    )


def _tpl_damage(values: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    return (
        f"/damage {_value(values, 'target', '@s')} {_value(values, 'amount', '5')} "
        f"{_value(values, 'type', 'minecraft:magic')}"
    )

        kind="choice",
        options=game_ids.TARGETS,
        help="常用选择器都在列表里，选完下方会显示它代表什么。",
    )

TEMPLATE_BY_ID = {item.id: item for item in COMMAND_TEMPLATES}

# 模板结构：花括号里是该模板可编辑参数的键，其余文字是指令关键字和固定语法。
# 界面按这份结构渲染“可改 / 不可改”两部分，生成后仍然可以整条手改。
TEMPLATE_SKELETONS: dict[str, str] = {
    "give": "/give {target} {item}{extra} {count}",
    "tp": "/tp {target} {x} {y} {z}",
    "setblock": "/setblock {x} {y} {z} {block} {mode}",
    "fill": "/fill {x1} {y1} {z1} {x2} {y2} {z2} {block} {mode}",
    "summon": "/summon {entity} {x} {y} {z} {nbt}",
    "effect": "/effect give {target} {effect} {duration} {amplifier}",
    "enchant": "/enchant {target} {enchantment} {level}",
    "title": "/title {target} {position} {text}",
    "tellraw": "/tellraw {target} {text}",
    "playsound": "/playsound {sound} {source} {target} ~ ~ ~ {volume} {pitch}",
    "particle": "/particle {particle} {x} {y} {z} {dx} {dy} {dz} {speed} {count}",
    "execute": "/execute as {target} at @s if {condition} run {command}",
    "scoreboard_add": "/scoreboard objectives add {objective} {criterion}",
    "scoreboard_set": "/scoreboard players set {target} {objective} {value}",
    "spawnpoint": "/spawnpoint {target} {x} {y} {z}",
    "locate": "/locate {type} {id}",
    "worldborder": "/worldborder set {diameter}",
    "time": "/time set {value}",
    "weather": "/weather {type} {duration}",
    "gamerule": "/gamerule {rule} {value}",
    "clear": "/clear {target} {item} {count}",
    "xp": "/xp add {target} {amount} {unit}",
    "damage": "/damage {target} {amount} {type}",
}


def template_skeleton(template: CommandTemplate) -> str:
    """返回模板结构；没有登记时退回仅列出参数名的通用写法。"""
    skeleton = TEMPLATE_SKELETONS.get(template.id)
    if skeleton:
        return skeleton
    names = " ".join(f"{{{field.key}}}" for field in template.fields)
    return f"/{template.id} {names}".strip()


def default_template_values(template: CommandTemplate) -> dict[str, str]:
    return {field.key: field.default for field in template.fields}


def build_from_template(template_id: str, values: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    template = TEMPLATE_BY_ID.get(template_id)
    if template is None:
        raise ValueError(f"未知模板：{template_id}")
    merged = default_template_values(template)
    merged.update({key: value for key, value in values.items() if value is not None})
    command = template.builder(merged).strip()
    return command if command.startswith("/") else "/" + command


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 命令方块链 / 函数 / 数据包

def _nbt_quote(text: str) -> str:
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"')


_FACING_OFFSETS = {
    "east": (1, 0, 0),
    "west": (-1, 0, 0),
    "south": (0, 0, 1),
    "north": (0, 0, -1),
    "up": (0, 1, 0),
    "down": (0, -1, 0),
}


def build_chain_blocks(
    commands: Iterable[str],
    origin: tuple[int, int, int] = (0, 64, 0),
    first: str = "repeating",
    conditional: bool = False,
    auto: bool = True,
    facing: str = "east",
) -> list[str]:
    """生成一排命令方块的 /setblock 放置指令。

    ``first``：repeating（循环）或 impulse（脉冲）。后续统一使用连锁方块。
    ``facing``：方块朝向，决定链的延伸方向。
    """
    clean = [str(item).strip().lstrip("/") for item in commands if str(item).strip()]
    if not clean:
        raise ValueError("至少需要一条指令")
    if any("\n" in item for item in clean):
        raise ValueError("命令方块里的指令不能换行")
    direction = facing if facing in _FACING_OFFSETS else "east"
    dx, dy, dz = _FACING_OFFSETS[direction]
    ox, oy, oz = origin
    auto_value = "1b" if auto else "0b"
    lines: list[str] = []
    for index, command in enumerate(clean):
        block = (
            "repeating_command_block"
            if index == 0 and first == "repeating"
            else ("command_block" if index == 0 else "chain_command_block")
        )
        x = ox + dx * index
        y = oy + dy * index
        z = oz + dz * index
        # facing / conditional 是方块状态，Command / auto 才是方块实体 NBT。
        block_state = (
            f"[facing={direction},"
            f"conditional={'true' if conditional and index else 'false'}]"
        )
        nbt = f'{{Command:"{_nbt_quote(command)}",auto:{auto_value}}}'
        lines.append(
            f"/setblock {x} {y} {z} minecraft:{block}{block_state}{nbt} replace"
        )
    return lines


def build_mcfunction(commands: Iterable[str], header: bool = True) -> str:
    lines: list[str] = []
    if header:
        lines.append("# Generated by Darkitten Launcher - Game Assistant")
    for command in commands:
        text = str(command).strip()
        if not text:
            continue
        if text.startswith("#"):
            lines.append(text)
        else:
            # .mcfunction 里的指令不能带开头的斜杠。
            lines.append(text[1:] if text.startswith("/") else text)
    return "\n".join(lines) + ("\n" if lines else "")


_VERSION_RE = re.compile(r"(\d+)\.(\d+)")

# 官方数据包版本号（来自 Mojang 的 pack.mcmeta）。26.x 换成新的年份版本号后
# 不能再按 1.x 的区间推算，所以这里按版本号精确查表。
PACK_FORMATS: dict[str, int] = {
    "26.3": 121,
    "26.2": 107,
    "26.1.2": 101,
    "26.1.1": 101,
    "26.1": 101,
    "1.21.11": 94,
    "1.21.10": 88,
    "1.21.9": 88,
    "1.21.8": 81,
    "1.21.7": 81,
    "1.21.6": 80,
    "1.21.5": 71,
    "1.21.4": 61,
    "1.21.3": 57,
    "1.21.2": 57,
    "1.21.1": 48,
    "1.21": 48,
    "1.20.6": 41,
    "1.20.5": 41,
    "1.20.4": 26,
    "1.20.3": 26,
    "1.20.2": 18,
    "1.20.1": 15,
    "1.20": 15,
    "1.19.4": 12,
    "1.19.3": 10,
    "1.19.2": 10,
    "1.19.1": 10,
    "1.19": 10,
    "1.18.2": 9,
    "1.18.1": 8,
    "1.18": 8,
    "1.17.1": 7,
    "1.17": 7,
    "1.16.5": 6,
    "1.16.4": 6,
    "1.16.3": 6,
    "1.16.2": 6,
    "1.16.1": 5,
    "1.16": 5,
    "1.15.2": 5,
    "1.15.1": 5,
    "1.15": 5,
    "1.14.4": 4,
    "1.14.3": 4,
    "1.14.2": 4,
    "1.14.1": 4,
    "1.14": 4,
}


def _version_tuple(version: str) -> tuple[int, int]:
    match = _VERSION_RE.search(version or "")
    if not match:
        return (1, 21)
    return (int(match.group(1)), int(match.group(2)))


def _version_sort_key(version: str) -> tuple:
    text = str(version or "").strip().lower()
    parts = re.findall(r"\d+|[a-z]+", text)
    return tuple(
        (0, int(part), "") if part.isdigit() else (1, 0, part) for part in parts
    )


def _base_version(version: str) -> str:
    match = re.match(r"\d+(?:\.\d+){0,2}", str(version or "").strip())
    return match.group(0) if match else ""


def datapack_folders(version: str = "1.21.4") -> tuple[str, str]:
    """返回（函数目录, 函数标签目录），1.21 起改成单数。"""
    if _version_tuple(version) >= (1, 21):
        return ("function", "function")
    return ("functions", "functions")


def pack_format_for(version: str = "1.21.4") -> int:
    key = _base_version(version)
    if key in PACK_FORMATS:
        return PACK_FORMATS[key]
    # 未知的新版本按“不高于它的最近版本”取格式号，至少不会退回 4。
    target = _version_sort_key(key)
    best_key: tuple | None = None
    best_format = 4
    for known, pack_format in PACK_FORMATS.items():
        known_key = _version_sort_key(known)
        if known_key <= target and (best_key is None or known_key > best_key):
            best_key = known_key
            best_format = pack_format
    return best_format


_NAMESPACE_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9_.-]+$")


def build_datapack(
    name: str,
    commands: Iterable[str],
    namespace: str = "dkl",
    version: str = "1.21.4",
    load: bool = False,
    tick: bool = False,
    description: str = "由 Darkitten Launcher 游戏助手生成",
    extra_files: dict[str, str] | None = None,
) -> bytes:
    """把一个函数打包成最小可用的数据包 zip，返回字节。"""
    function_name = (name or "main").strip().lower()
    function_name = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9_.-]+", "_", function_name) or "main"
    namespace = (namespace or "dkl").strip().lower()
    if not _NAMESPACE_RE.match(namespace):
        raise ValueError("命名空间只能使用小写字母、数字、下划线、点和短横线")
    function_dir, tag_dir = datapack_folders(version)
    clean_commands = [str(item).strip() for item in commands if str(item).strip()]
    if not clean_commands:
        raise ValueError("没有可导出的指令")
    body = build_mcfunction(clean_commands)

    meta = {
        "pack": {
            "pack_format": pack_format_for(version),
            "supported_formats": {"min_inclusive": 4, "max_inclusive": 999},
            "description": description,
        }
    }
    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(buffer, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
        archive.writestr("pack.mcmeta", json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
        archive.writestr(f"data/{namespace}/{function_dir}/{function_name}.mcfunction", body)
        if load:
            archive.writestr(
                f"data/minecraft/tags/{tag_dir}/load.json",
                json.dumps({"values": [f"{namespace}:{function_name}"]}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
            )
        if tick:
            archive.writestr(
                f"data/minecraft/tags/{tag_dir}/tick.json",
                json.dumps({"values": [f"{namespace}:{function_name}"]}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
            )
        for path, content in (extra_files or {}).items():
            archive.writestr(path, content)
    return buffer.getvalue()

class AICommandError(RuntimeError):
    pass


@dataclass
class AIConfig:
    base_url: str = DEFAULT_AI_CONFIG["base_url"]
    model: str = DEFAULT_AI_CONFIG["model"]
    api_key: str = ""
    temperature: float = 0.2
    timeout: int = 90

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> "AIConfig":
        data = data or {}
        return cls(
            base_url=str(data.get("base_url") or DEFAULT_AI_CONFIG["base_url"]).strip(),
            model=str(data.get("model") or DEFAULT_AI_CONFIG["model"]).strip(),
            api_key=str(data.get("api_key") or ""),
            temperature=float(data.get("temperature", 0.2)),
            timeout=int(data.get("timeout", 90)),
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "base_url": self.base_url,
            "model": self.model,
            "api_key": self.api_key,
            "temperature": self.temperature,
            "timeout": self.timeout,
        }

    @property
    def endpoint(self) -> str:
        base = (self.base_url or "").rstrip("/")
        if base.endswith("/chat/completions"):
            return base
        if base.endswith("/v1"):
            return base + "/chat/completions"
        if "api.openai.com" in base:
            return base + "/v1/chat/completions"
        return base + "/chat/completions"


def load_assistant_settings() -> dict[str, Any]:
    data: dict[str, Any] = {}
    try:
        if ASSISTANT_CONFIG_PATH.exists():
            loaded = json.loads(ASSISTANT_CONFIG_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            if isinstance(loaded, dict):
                data = loaded
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        data = {}
    merged = deepcopy(data)
    ai = dict(DEFAULT_AI_CONFIG)
    if isinstance(data.get("ai"), dict):
        ai.update(data["ai"])
    merged["ai"] = ai
    return merged


def save_assistant_settings(settings: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    current = load_assistant_settings()
    current.update({key: value for key, value in settings.items() if key != "ai"})
    if "ai" in settings and isinstance(settings["ai"], dict):
        current["ai"] = {**current.get("ai", {}), **settings["ai"]}
    ASSISTANT_CONFIG_PATH.write_text(
        json.dumps(current, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
    )


AI_SYSTEM_PROMPT = (
    "你是 Minecraft Java 版指令专家。请根据用户需求生成可以直接执行的指令。"
    "规则：只输出指令或注释，不要解释，不要 Markdown 代码围栏。"
    "每条指令独占一行，以 / 开头。需要多条指令时按执行顺序排列。"
    "优先使用当前版本存在的语法；不确定版本差异时在注释里说明。"
    "不要生成破坏存档、外挂、盗号或攻击服务器的内容。"
)


def build_ai_messages(
    request: str,
    version: str = "1.21.4",
    context: str = "",
) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    detail = f"目标版本：{version}。"
    if context.strip():
        detail += f"\n额外上下文：{context.strip()}"
    return [
        {"role": "system", "content": AI_SYSTEM_PROMPT},
        {"role": "user", "content": f"{detail}\n需求：{request.strip()}"},
    ]


def clean_ai_output(text: str) -> str:
    """去掉 Markdown 围栏、编号和多余解释，只保留指令行。"""
    lines: list[str] = []
    for raw in (text or "").replace("\r\n", "\n").split("\n"):
        line = raw.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("```"):
            continue
        line = re.sub(r"^(?:[-*]\s+|\d+[.)]\s+)", "", line)
        if not line:
            continue
        if line.startswith("/") or line.startswith("#") or line.startswith("//"):
            lines.append(line)
    return "\n".join(lines)


def ai_generate_commands(
    request: str,
    config: AIConfig,
    version: str = "1.21.4",
    context: str = "",
) -> str:
    if not (request or "").strip():
        raise AICommandError("请先写清楚要生成什么指令")
    if not config.base_url:
        raise AICommandError("还没有配置 AI 接口地址")
    payload = {
        "model": config.model,
        "messages": build_ai_messages(request, version, context),
        "temperature": max(0.0, min(2.0, float(config.temperature))),
    }
    data = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
    headers = {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "Accept": "application/json",
        "User-Agent": "DarkittenLauncher-GameAssistant/1.0",
    }
    if config.api_key:
        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {config.api_key}"
    request_obj = urllib.request.Request(
        config.endpoint, data=data, headers=headers, method="POST"
    )
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request_obj, timeout=max(10, config.timeout)) as response:
            raw = response.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        detail = ""
        try:
            detail = error.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")[:500]
        except Exception:
            pass
        raise AICommandError(f"AI 接口返回 HTTP {error.code}：{detail or error.reason}") from error
    except urllib.error.URLError as error:
        raise AICommandError(f"连接 AI 接口失败：{error.reason}") from error
    except TimeoutError as error:
        raise AICommandError("AI 接口超时，请检查网络或调大超时时间") from error
    except OSError as error:
        raise AICommandError(f"AI 请求失败：{error}") from error

    try:
        parsed = json.loads(raw)
        content = parsed["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
    except (ValueError, KeyError, IndexError, TypeError) as error:
        raise AICommandError("AI 返回的内容不是预期的 Chat Completions 格式") from error
    if isinstance(content, list):
        content = "".join(
            part.get("text", "") if isinstance(part, dict) else str(part)
            for part in content
        )
    cleaned = clean_ai_output(str(content))
    return cleaned or str(content).strip()

def enchcracker_dir() -> Path:
    return APP_DIR / "tools" / "enchcracker"


def find_enchcracker() -> Path | None:
    candidates = [
        enchcracker_dir() / ENCHCRACKER_JAR,
        enchcracker_dir() / "enchcracker.jar",
        APP_DIR / "tools" / ENCHCRACKER_JAR,
    ]
    for path in candidates:
        try:
            if path.exists() and path.stat().st_size > 10000:
                return path
        except OSError:
            continue
    return None


def find_clientcommands_mods(game_dir: str | os.PathLike[str] | None) -> list[Path]:
    if not game_dir:
        return []
    root = Path(game_dir)
    if not root.exists():
        return []
    found: list[Path] = []
    for pattern in ("mods/*clientcommands*.jar", "mods/**/*clientcommands*.jar"):
        try:
            found.extend(path for path in root.glob(pattern) if path.is_file())
        except OSError:
            continue
    unique: dict[str, Path] = {}
    for path in found:
        unique[str(path.resolve()).lower()] = path
    return sorted(unique.values(), key=lambda item: item.name.lower())


def launch_enchcracker(java_path: str, jar_path: Path | None = None) -> subprocess.Popen:
    jar = jar_path or find_enchcracker()
    if jar is None:
        raise FileNotFoundError("没有找到 EnchCracker jar，请重新安装启动器")
    if not java_path:
        raise FileNotFoundError("没有可用的 Java，请先在设置里配置 Java 路径")
    command = [
        java_path,
        "-Xms1G",
        "-Xmx1G",
        "-classpath",
        str(jar),
        "enchcracker.EnchCrackerWindow",
    ]
    kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {"cwd": str(jar.parent)}
    if os.name == "nt":
        kwargs["creationflags"] = CREATE_NO_WINDOW
    return subprocess.Popen(command, **kwargs)

def seed_fingerprint(seed: int) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256(str(int(seed)).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    return digest[:16]


def chunk_summary(seed: int, chunk_x: int, chunk_z: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "seed": int(seed),
        "chunk": (int(chunk_x), int(chunk_z)),
        "block_origin": (chunk_to_block(chunk_x), chunk_to_block(chunk_z)),
        "block_center": (chunk_center(chunk_x), chunk_center(chunk_z)),
        "slime": is_slime_chunk(seed, chunk_x, chunk_z),
    }

"""从在线数据源拉取 Minecraft 全量注册表。

内置的 ``game_ids`` 只是常用条目，避免第一次打开就必须联网。这个模块负责
按目标版本从 PrismarineJS/minecraft-data 拉取完整的物品、方块、实体、效果、
附魔、粒子和音效清单，再配合 Minecraft 官方中文语言文件补上中文名。

数据会缓存在 ``cache/game_catalog`` 下，之后打开选择窗口可以直接用本地缓存；
点“刷新清单”会重新下载。模块本身不依赖 Qt，方便单元测试。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import time
import urllib.request
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from .config import APP_DIR
from .game_ids import Entry

CACHE_DIR = APP_DIR / "cache" / "game_catalog"
CACHE_TTL = 7 * 24 * 3600

_DATA_PATHS_URLS = (
    "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/PrismarineJS/minecraft-data@master/data/dataPaths.json",
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PrismarineJS/minecraft-data/master/data/dataPaths.json",
)

_REGISTRY_FILES = (
    ("blocks", "blocks.json"),
    ("items", "items.json"),
    ("entities", "entities.json"),

    ("enchantments", "enchantments.json"),
    ("particles", "particles.json"),

    ("biomes", "biomes.json"),
)

_USER_AGENT = "DarkittenLauncher/1.14 (+https://lfelkeea.github.io/darkitten-launcher/)"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CatalogResult:
    entries: dict[str, tuple[Entry, ...]]
    version: str
    data_version: str
    fetched_at: float
    source: str  # network / cache


def _version_key(version: str) -> tuple:
    text = str(version or "").strip().lower()
    parts = re.findall(r"\d+|[a-z]+", text)
    key: list[tuple[int, int, str]] = []
    for part in parts:
        if part.isdigit():
            key.append((0, int(part), ""))
        else:
            key.append((1, 0, part))
    return tuple(key)


def _snake(name: str) -> str:
    text = re.sub(r"(?<=[a-z0-9])(?=[A-Z])", "_", str(name or "").strip())
    return text.replace(" ", "_").replace("-", "_").lower()


def _prettify(name: str) -> str:
    return str(name or "").replace("_", " ").strip().title()


def _get_json(urls: tuple[str, ...], timeout: int = 45) -> Any:
    error: Exception | None = None
    for url in urls:
        try:
            request = urllib.request.Request(
                url, headers={"User-Agent": _USER_AGENT}
            )
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=timeout) as response:
                return json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
        except Exception as exc:  # 换下一个镜像
            error = exc
    raise RuntimeError(str(error) if error else "下载失败")


def _registry_urls(data_path: str, filename: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    return (
        f"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/PrismarineJS/minecraft-data@master/data/{data_path}/{filename}",
        f"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PrismarineJS/minecraft-data/master/data/{data_path}/{filename}",
    )


def _language_urls(version: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    return (
        f"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/InventivetalentDev/minecraft-assets@{version}/assets/minecraft/lang/zh_cn.json",
        f"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/InventivetalentDev/minecraft-assets/{version}/assets/minecraft/lang/zh_cn.json",
    )


def resolve_data_version(version: str, data_paths: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    """把用户版本映射到 minecraft-data 里最近的一份可用数据。"""
    pc = data_paths.get("pc") if isinstance(data_paths, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(pc, dict) or not pc:
        return str(version or "")
    text = str(version or "").strip()
    if text in pc:
        return text
    match = re.match(r"\d+(?:\.\d+){0,2}", text)
    if match and match.group(0) in pc:
        return match.group(0)
    candidates = [
        item
        for item in pc
        if re.fullmatch(r"\d+(?:\.\d+){0,2}", str(item))
    ]
    if not candidates:
        return text
    candidates.sort(key=_version_key, reverse=True)
    target = _version_key(text)
    for item in candidates:
        if _version_key(item) <= target:
            return item
    return candidates[-1]


def _block_category(name: str, material: str) -> str:
    text = str(name or "").lower()
    if text.endswith("_ore") or text in {"ancient_debris"}:
        return "矿石"
    if any(
        token in text
        for token in ("_planks", "_log", "_wood", "_leaves", "_sapling", "_sign")
    ) or text in {"bookshelf", "crafting_table", "chest", "barrel", "ladder"}:
        return "木质与植物"
    if any(
        token in text
        for token in (
            "_slab",
            "_stairs",
            "_wall",
            "_fence",
            "_door",
            "_trapdoor",
            "_button",
            "_pressure_plate",
        )
    ):
        return "建筑方块"
    if "glass" in text or text.endswith("_pane"):
        return "玻璃"
    if any(
        token in text
        for token in ("_wool", "_carpet", "_bed", "_banner")
    ):
        return "羊毛与装饰"
    if any(
        token in text
        for token in ("_terracotta", "_concrete", "_glazed", "_stained_")
    ):
        return "染色方块"
    if "coral" in text or text in {"sponge", "wet_sponge"}:
        return "珊瑚与海绵"
    mapping = {
        "mineable/pickaxe": "镐类方块",
        "mineable/axe": "斧类方块",
        "mineable/shovel": "锹类方块",
        "mineable/hoe": "锄类方块",
        "incorrect_for_wooden_tool": "高硬度方块",
        "wool": "羊毛与装饰",
        "leaves;mineable/hoe": "木质与植物",
        "plant;mineable/axe": "木质与植物",
        "gourd;mineable/axe": "作物",
        "vine_or_glow_lichen;plant;mineable/axe": "木质与植物",
        "sword_instantly_mines": "作物",
        "coweb": "特殊方块",
        "default": "其他方块",
    }
    return mapping.get(str(material or ""), "其他方块")


def _item_category(name: str, block_names: set[str]) -> str:
    text = str(name or "").lower()
    if text == "air":
        return "其他物品"
    if text in block_names:
        return "方块物品"
    if text.endswith("_spawn_egg"):
        return "刷怪蛋"
    if text.endswith(("_sword", "_axe", "_pickaxe", "_shovel", "_hoe")):
        return "工具与武器"
    if text.endswith(("_helmet", "_chestplate", "_leggings", "_boots")):
        return "盔甲"
    if text.endswith(
        ("_potion", "_splash_potion", "_lingering_potion", "_tipped_arrow")
    ):
        return "药水与箭"
    if text.endswith("_bucket"):
        return "桶"
    if text.endswith(("_boat", "_minecart", "_rail", "_wagon", "minecart")):
        return "交通"
    if text.endswith("_dye"):
        return "染料"
    if "music_disc" in text:
        return "唱片"
    if text.endswith("_banner") or text == "shield":
        return "装饰"
    if text.endswith(
        (
            "_seeds",
            "apple",
            "bread",
            "carrot",
            "potato",
            "beef",
            "porkchop",
            "chicken",
            "mutton",
            "rabbit",
            "cod",
            "salmon",
            "cookie",
            "cake",
            "pie",
            "stew",
            "soup",
        )
    ):
        return "食物"
    return "其他物品"

def _name_from_lang(zh: dict[str, str], keys: tuple[str, ...], fallback: str) -> str:
    for key in keys:
        value = zh.get(key)
        if value:
            return str(value).replace("\n", " ").strip()
    return str(fallback or "").strip()


def build_entries(
    registries: dict[str, Any], zh: dict[str, str]
) -> dict[str, tuple[Entry, ...]]:
    """把 minecraft-data 的注册表转成界面使用的条目。"""
    blocks_raw = list(registries.get("blocks") or [])
    items_raw = list(registries.get("items") or [])
    entities_raw = list(registries.get("entities") or [])
    effects_raw = list(registries.get("effects") or [])
    enchantments_raw = list(registries.get("enchantments") or [])
    particles_raw = list(registries.get("particles") or [])
    sounds_raw = list(registries.get("sounds") or [])
    biomes_raw = list(registries.get("biomes") or [])

    block_names = {
        str(item.get("name") or "").strip()
        for item in blocks_raw
        if isinstance(item, dict) and str(item.get("name") or "").strip()
    }

    blocks: list[Entry] = []
    for item in blocks_raw:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        name = str(item.get("name") or "").strip()
        if not name:
            continue
        display = str(item.get("displayName") or _prettify(name))
        zh_name = _name_from_lang(
            zh, (f"block.minecraft.{name}",), display
        )
        blocks.append(
            Entry(
                f"minecraft:{name}",
                zh_name,
                _block_category(name, str(item.get("material") or "")),
                "",
            )
        )

    items: list[Entry] = []
    for item in items_raw:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        name = str(item.get("name") or "").strip()
        if not name or name == "air":
            continue
        display = str(item.get("displayName") or _prettify(name))
        zh_name = _name_from_lang(
            zh,
            (f"item.minecraft.{name}", f"block.minecraft.{name}"),
            display,
        )
        stack = item.get("stackSize")
        help_text = f"最大堆叠：{stack}" if isinstance(stack, int) and stack > 1 else ""
        items.append(
            Entry(
                f"minecraft:{name}",
                zh_name,
                _item_category(name, block_names),
                help_text,
            )
        )

    entities: list[Entry] = []
    for item in entities_raw:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        name = str(item.get("name") or "").strip()
        if not name or name == "player":
            continue
        display = str(item.get("displayName") or _prettify(name))
        zh_name = _name_from_lang(zh, (f"entity.minecraft.{name}",), display)
        raw_category = str(item.get("category") or "")
        category = _ENTITY_CATEGORIES.get(raw_category, "其他实体")
        entities.append(Entry(f"minecraft:{name}", zh_name, category, ""))

    effects: list[Entry] = []
    for item in effects_raw:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        raw_name = str(item.get("name") or "").strip()
        if not raw_name:
            continue
        name = _snake(raw_name)
        display = str(item.get("displayName") or _prettify(name))
        zh_name = _name_from_lang(zh, (f"effect.minecraft.{name}",), display)
        kind = str(item.get("type") or "")
        category = {"good": "增益", "bad": "负面", "neutral": "中性"}.get(
            kind, "状态效果"
        )
        effects.append(Entry(f"minecraft:{name}", zh_name, category, ""))

    enchantments: list[Entry] = []
    for item in enchantments_raw:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        name = str(item.get("name") or "").strip()
        if not name:
            continue
        display = str(item.get("displayName") or _prettify(name))
        zh_name = _name_from_lang(
            zh, (f"enchantment.minecraft.{name}",), display
        )
        category = _ENCHANT_CATEGORIES.get(
            str(item.get("category") or ""), "其他附魔"
        )
        helps: list[str] = []
        max_level = item.get("maxLevel")
        if isinstance(max_level, int):
            helps.append(f"最高 {max_level} 级")
        if item.get("curse"):
            helps.append("诅咒附魔")
        elif item.get("treasureOnly"):
            helps.append("仅可通过宝箱 / 交易获得")
        enchantments.append(
            Entry(f"minecraft:{name}", zh_name, category, "，".join(helps))
        )

    particles: list[Entry] = []
    for item in particles_raw:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        name = str(item.get("name") or "").strip()
        if not name:
            continue
        particles.append(
            Entry(f"minecraft:{name}", _prettify(name), "粒子", "")
        )

    sounds: list[Entry] = []
    for item in sounds_raw:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        name = str(item.get("name") or "").strip()
        if not name:
            continue
        display = _prettify(name)
        zh_name = _name_from_lang(
            zh, (f"subtitles.{name}",), display
        )
        prefix = name.split(".", 1)[0]
        sounds.append(
            Entry(
                f"minecraft:{name}",
                zh_name,
                _SOUND_CATEGORIES.get(prefix, "其他音效"),
                "",
            )
        )

    # 群系也放进“结构”选择器：/locate biome 会用到，按 ID 搜索更方便。
    structures: list[Entry] = []
    for item in biomes_raw:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        name = str(item.get("name") or "").strip()
        if not name:
            continue
        display = str(item.get("displayName") or _prettify(name))
        zh_name = _name_from_lang(zh, (f"biome.minecraft.{name}",), display)
        structures.append(Entry(f"minecraft:{name}", zh_name, "群系", ""))

    return {
        "block": tuple(blocks),
        "item": tuple(items),
        "entity": tuple(entities),
        "effect": tuple(effects),
        "enchantment": tuple(enchantments),
        "particle": tuple(particles),
        "sound": tuple(sounds),
        "structure": tuple(structures),
    }


def _cache_path(version: str) -> Path:
    safe = re.sub(r"[^0-9A-Za-z._+-]", "_", str(version or "").strip()) or "latest"
    return CACHE_DIR / f"{safe}.json"


def load_cached(version: str) -> CatalogResult | None:
    path = _cache_path(version)
    try:
        data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return None
    kinds = data.get("kinds")
    if not isinstance(kinds, dict):
        return None
    entries: dict[str, tuple[Entry, ...]] = {}
    for kind, rows in kinds.items():
        if not isinstance(rows, list):
            continue
        collected: list[Entry] = []
        for row in rows:
            if not isinstance(row, list) or len(row) < 2:
                continue
            collected.append(
                Entry(
                    str(row[0]),
                    str(row[1]),
                    str(row[2]) if len(row) > 2 else "",
                    str(row[3]) if len(row) > 3 else "",
                )
            )
        entries[str(kind)] = tuple(collected)
    if not entries:
        return None
    return CatalogResult(
        entries=entries,
        version=str(data.get("version") or version),
        data_version=str(data.get("data_version") or ""),
        fetched_at=float(data.get("fetched_at") or 0),
        source="cache",
    )


def _save_cache(result: CatalogResult) -> None:
    CACHE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    payload = {
        "version": result.version,
        "data_version": result.data_version,
        "fetched_at": result.fetched_at,
        "kinds": {
            kind: [[entry.value, entry.name, entry.category, entry.help] for entry in entries]
            for kind, entries in result.entries.items()
        },
    }
    path = _cache_path(result.version)
    temporary = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(
        json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    temporary.replace(path)


def fetch_catalog(version: str, force: bool = False) -> CatalogResult:
    """拉取指定版本的完整清单；网络失败时退回旧缓存。"""
    cached = load_cached(version)
    if (
        cached is not None
        and not force
        and time.time() - cached.fetched_at < CACHE_TTL
    ):
        return cached

    try:
        data_paths = _get_json(_DATA_PATHS_URLS)
        data_version = resolve_data_version(version, data_paths)
        pc = data_paths.get("pc") or {}
        relative = ""
        if isinstance(pc, dict) and isinstance(pc.get(data_version), dict):
            relative = str(pc[data_version].get("blocks") or "")
        if not relative:
            relative = f"pc/{data_version}"
        registries: dict[str, Any] = {}
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=7) as pool:
            futures = {
                key: pool.submit(_get_json, _registry_urls(relative, filename))
                for key, filename in _REGISTRY_FILES
            }
            zh_future = pool.submit(_get_json, _language_urls(data_version))
            for key, future in futures.items():
                try:
                    registries[key] = future.result()
                except Exception:
                    registries[key] = []
            try:
                zh = zh_future.result()
            except Exception:
                zh = {}
        entries = build_entries(registries, zh if isinstance(zh, dict) else {})
        result = CatalogResult(
            entries=entries,
            version=str(version or data_version),
            data_version=data_version,
            fetched_at=time.time(),
            source="network",
        )
        _save_cache(result)
        return result
    except Exception:
        if cached is not None:
            return cached
        raise


def default_version() -> str:
    try:
        from .mc_versions import release_versions

        versions = release_versions()
        if versions:
            return versions[0]
    except Exception:
        pass
    return "26.3"

# FILE: darkitten/game_context.py

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Iterable

from .mods import load_mod_meta

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from .config import Config
    from .versions import VersionSummary

LOADER_KEYS = {
    "Fabric": "fabric",
    "Forge": "forge",
    "NeoForge": "neoforge",
    "Quilt": "quilt",
}
LOADER_NAMES = {value: key for key, value in LOADER_KEYS.items()}


def loader_key(loader: str) -> str:
    text = str(loader or "").strip()
    if text in LOADER_KEYS:
        return LOADER_KEYS[text]
    low = text.lower()
    return low if low in LOADER_KEYS.values() else ""


def loader_candidates(loader: str) -> list[str]:
    """Quilt 可以直接加载 Fabric 的 Mod，其余加载器只用自己的键。"""
    key = loader_key(loader)
    if key == "quilt":
        return ["quilt", "fabric"]
    return [key] if key else []


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LoaderContext:
    """一个游戏实例实际使用的加载器、MC 版本与目录。"""

    version_id: str
    launch_id: str
    mc_version: str
    loader: str
    loader_key: str
    game_dir: Path
    mods_dir: Path
    resourcepacks_dir: Path
    shaderpacks_dir: Path
    options_path: Path

    @property
    def has_loader(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.loader_key)

    @property
    def loader_label(self) -> str:
        return self.loader or "原版"

    @property
    def display_version(self) -> str:
        return self.mc_version or self.version_id


def resolve_context(
    version_id: str,
    versions: Iterable[VersionSummary],
    config: Config,
) -> LoaderContext:
    """按启动器的绑定关系解析实例真正使用的加载器。"""
    version_id = str(version_id or "").strip()
    by_id = {item.id: item for item in versions}
    summary = by_id.get(version_id)
    if summary is None:
        raise ValueError(f"找不到游戏版本 {version_id or '（未选择）'}")

    launch_id = version_id
    profile = None
    if not summary.is_loader_profile and not summary.loader:
        bound = config.loader_for(version_id)
        candidate = by_id.get(bound)
        if (
            candidate is not None
            and candidate.is_loader_profile
            and candidate.base_id == summary.base_id
        ):
            profile = candidate
            launch_id = candidate.id

    if summary.loader:
        loader_name = summary.loader
        mc_version = summary.base_id or summary.id
    elif profile is not None:
        loader_name = profile.loader
        mc_version = profile.base_id or profile.id
    else:
        loader_name = ""
        mc_version = summary.base_id or summary.id

    game_dir = Path(config.version_game_path(version_id))
    return LoaderContext(
        version_id=version_id,
        launch_id=launch_id,
        mc_version=str(mc_version or ""),
        loader=str(loader_name or ""),
        loader_key=loader_key(loader_name),
        game_dir=game_dir,
        mods_dir=game_dir / "mods",
        resourcepacks_dir=game_dir / "resourcepacks",
        shaderpacks_dir=game_dir / "shaderpacks",
        options_path=game_dir / "options.txt",
    )


def file_sha1(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha1()
    try:
        with Path(path).open("rb") as fp:
            while True:
                chunk = fp.read(1024 * 1024)
                if not chunk:
                    break
                digest.update(chunk)
    except OSError:
        return ""
    return digest.hexdigest()


def normalize_token(value: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "", str(value or "").lower())


def filename_matches(filename: str, *tokens: str) -> bool:
    """用文件名里的关键字识别手动放进 mods 的同名 Mod。"""
    normalized = normalize_token(filename)
    for token in tokens:
        key = normalize_token(token)
        if len(key) >= 4 and key in normalized:
            return True
    return False


def enabled_mod_files(mods_dir: Path) -> list[Path]:
    try:
        return sorted(
            (
                path
                for path in Path(mods_dir).iterdir()
                if path.is_file() and path.name.lower().endswith(".jar")
            ),
            key=lambda path: path.name.lower(),
        )
    except OSError:
        return []


def all_mod_files(mods_dir: Path) -> list[Path]:
    try:
        return sorted(
            (
                path
                for path in Path(mods_dir).iterdir()
                if path.is_file()
                and path.name.lower().endswith((".jar", ".jar.disabled"))
            ),
            key=lambda path: path.name.lower(),
        )
    except OSError:
        return []


def installed_meta_keys(mods_dir: Path) -> set[str]:
    """收集已安装 Mod 的 project/slug 标识，供去重使用。"""
    keys: set[str] = set()
    for path in all_mod_files(mods_dir):
        meta = load_mod_meta(Path(mods_dir), path.name)
        for field in ("project_id", "slug", "version_id", "file_id"):
            value = str(meta.get(field) or "").strip().lower()
            if value:
                keys.add(value)
        keys.add(path.name.lower())
    return keys

"""游戏助手用的 ID 清单与选项说明。

这里的条目不是“全量注册表”，而是启动器里最常用、最容易被写错的一批：
物品、方块、实体、药水效果、附魔、粒子、音效、游戏规则、伤害类型和结构。
每条都带中文名，搜索时可以按中文、英文或命名空间 ID 匹配。

清单不依赖 Qt，方便单元测试和后续从 jar 里补充。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Entry:
    value: str
    name: str
    category: str = ""
    help: str = ""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Option:
    value: str
    label: str
    help: str = ""


def _entries(
    raw: str, category: str = "", *, third_is_category: bool = False
) -> tuple[Entry, ...]:
    """把 ``id|中文|分类或说明`` 的紧凑文本展开成 Entry 元组。

    物品/方块/实体/附魔的第三列是分类，其余数据集第三列是说明。
    """
    items: list[Entry] = []
    for line in raw.strip().splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        value, _, rest = line.partition("|")
        name, _, extra = rest.partition("|")
        extra = extra.strip()
        items.append(
            Entry(
                value=value.strip(),
                name=name.strip(),
                category=extra if third_is_category else category,
                help="" if third_is_category else extra,
            )
        )
    return tuple(items)

# 运行时从网站拉取的全量清单。为空时继续使用上面的常用清单，
# 这样第一次打开、断网或接口失败都不会影响基本使用。
_DYNAMIC: dict[str, tuple[Entry, ...]] = {}
_DYNAMIC_VERSION = ""


def set_catalog(entries: dict[str, tuple[Entry, ...]], version: str = "") -> None:
    global _DYNAMIC, _DYNAMIC_VERSION
    _DYNAMIC = {
        str(kind): tuple(rows) for kind, rows in dict(entries or {}).items() if rows
    }
    _DYNAMIC_VERSION = str(version or "")


def clear_catalog() -> None:
    global _DYNAMIC, _DYNAMIC_VERSION
    _DYNAMIC = {}
    _DYNAMIC_VERSION = ""


def catalog_version() -> str:
    return _DYNAMIC_VERSION


def catalog_loaded(kind: str | None = None) -> bool:
    if kind is None:
        return bool(_DYNAMIC)
    return bool(_DYNAMIC.get(str(kind or "")))


def _merged_dataset(kind: str) -> tuple[Entry, ...]:
    key = str(kind or "")
    dynamic = _DYNAMIC.get(key)
    if not dynamic:
        return DATASETS.get(key, ())
    curated = {entry.value: entry for entry in DATASETS.get(key, ())}
    result: list[Entry] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for entry in dynamic:
        if entry.value in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(entry.value)
        base = curated.get(entry.value)
        if base is not None:
            entry = Entry(
                entry.value,
                base.name or entry.name,
                entry.category or base.category,
                base.help or entry.help,
            )
        result.append(entry)
    # 注册表已经覆盖的类别不再混入内置旧条目，避免出现当前版本已删除的 ID；
    # 结构清单只从 biomes 拉到了群系，要塞/村庄等仍由内置条目补齐。
    if key == "structure":
        for entry in DATASETS.get(key, ()):
            if entry.value not in seen:
                seen.add(entry.value)
                result.append(entry)
    return tuple(result)


def dataset(kind: str) -> tuple[Entry, ...]:
    return _merged_dataset(kind)


def categories(kind: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    entries = dataset(kind)
    if not entries:
        return CATEGORIES.get(str(kind or ""), ("全部",))
    result: list[str] = ["全部"]
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for entry in entries:
        category = str(entry.category or "").strip()
        if not category or category in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(category)
        result.append(category)
    return tuple(result)


def picker_title(kind: str) -> str:
    return PICKER_TITLES.get(str(kind or ""), "选择 ID")


def search(kind: str, query: str = "", category: str = "全部") -> list[Entry]:
    """按中文名、英文 ID 或说明搜索；空关键词返回全部。"""
    needle = " ".join(str(query or "").split()).lower()
    wanted = str(category or "全部")
    found: list[Entry] = []
    for entry in dataset(kind):
        if wanted and wanted != "全部" and entry.category != wanted:
            continue
        if needle:
            haystack = " ".join(
                (entry.value, entry.name, entry.category, entry.help)
            ).lower()
            if needle not in haystack:
                continue
        found.append(entry)
    return found


def entries_for_options(options: tuple[Option, ...]) -> tuple[Entry, ...]:
    return tuple(Entry(item.value, item.label, "", item.help) for item in options)

from __future__ import annotations

from PySide6.QtGui import QImage

from .installer import _http_open

MAX_IMAGE_BYTES = 16 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_ICON_BYTES = 1024 * 1024


class ImageFetchError(Exception):
    pass


def fetch_image_bytes(
    url: str, timeout: int = 30, limit: int = MAX_ICON_BYTES
) -> bytes:
    """下载并校验图片，返回原始字节，供图标等需要本地缓存的场景使用。"""
    if not url:
        raise ImageFetchError("图片地址为空。")
    try:
        with _http_open(
            url,
            timeout=timeout,
            headers={"Accept": "image/*"},
        ) as response:
            raw = response.read(max(1, int(limit)) + 1)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ImageFetchError(f"图片下载失败：{exc}") from exc
    if not raw:
        raise ImageFetchError("图片内容为空。")
    if len(raw) > int(limit):
        raise ImageFetchError("图片过大，已跳过。")
    if QImage.fromData(raw).isNull():
        raise ImageFetchError("无法解析图片格式。")
    return raw


def fetch_image(url: str, timeout: int = 30) -> QImage:
    if not url:
        raise ImageFetchError("图片地址为空。")
    try:
        with _http_open(
            url,
            timeout=timeout,
            headers={"Accept": "image/*"},
        ) as response:
            raw = response.read(MAX_IMAGE_BYTES + 1)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ImageFetchError(f"图片下载失败：{exc}") from exc
    if not raw:
        raise ImageFetchError("图片内容为空。")
    if len(raw) > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES:
        raise ImageFetchError("图片过大，已跳过。")
    image = QImage.fromData(raw)
    if image.isNull():
        raise ImageFetchError("无法解析图片格式。")
    return image
