MANIFEST_URL = "https://piston-meta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json"
BMCL_MANIFEST_URL = "https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json"
CACHE_DIR = APP_DIR / "cache"
MANIFEST_CACHE = CACHE_DIR / "version_manifest_v2.json"
ProgressCallback = Callable[[int, str], None]
LogCallback = Callable[[str], None]


class InstallCancelled(Exception):
    pass


class DownloadError(Exception):
    pass


THIRD_PARTY_MAVENS = (
    "https://maven.minecraftforge.net/",
    "https://maven.neoforged.net/releases/",
    "https://maven.fabricmc.net/",
)
BMCL_MAVEN = "https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com/maven/"
CENTRAL_MAVEN = "https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/"
CENTRAL_FIRST_PREFIXES = (
    "org/ow2/asm/",
    "org/slf4j/",
    "org/apache/",
    "org/jetbrains/",
    "org/joml/",
    "com/google/",
    "com/mojang/",
    "net/java/",
    "io/netty/",
    "it/unimi/",
    "org/lwjgl/",
)


def mirror_urls(url: str, source: str) -> list[str]:
    """返回按优先级排列的下载地址。

    auto / official 保持官方地址优先，但保留 BMCLAPI 作为兜底，避免官方源
    缓慢或临时不可用时直接失败；bmclapi 会优先使用国内镜像。
    Forge、NeoForge、Fabric 的 Maven 在国内经常无法直连，
    因此始终优先尝试 BMCLAPI 镜像。
    """
    urls: list[str] = []
    mirrored = ""
    relative = ""
    is_mojang = False

    if url.startswith("https://libraries.minecraft.net/"):
        mirrored = BMCL_MAVEN + url.split(
            "https://libraries.minecraft.net/", 1
        )[1]
        is_mojang = True
    elif url.startswith("https://resources.download.minecraft.net/"):
        mirrored = "https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com/assets/" + url.split(
            "https://resources.download.minecraft.net/", 1
        )[1]
        is_mojang = True
    elif url.startswith("http://resources.download.minecraft.net/"):
        mirrored = "https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com/assets/" + url.split(
            "http://resources.download.minecraft.net/", 1
        )[1]
        is_mojang = True

    if not mirrored:
        for base in THIRD_PARTY_MAVENS:
            if url.startswith(base):
                relative = url.split(base, 1)[1]
                mirrored = BMCL_MAVEN + relative
                break

    central = CENTRAL_MAVEN + relative if relative else ""
    candidates: list[str] = []
    if mirrored and is_mojang:
        # auto 按测速结果排序；显式选择时尊重用户指定的线路。
        urls_order = order_sources(source)
        by_source = {OFFICIAL: url, BMCLAPI: mirrored}
        candidates.extend(by_source[item] for item in urls_order)
    elif mirrored:
        # Forge / NeoForge / Fabric 的官方 Maven 在部分网络下会接受连接
        # 却几乎不传数据。这里默认先走 BMCLAPI 镜像，只看熔断状态，
        # 不再被清单测速结果（只测 Mojang 清单）误判拖回官方线路。
        bmcl_ready = is_source_usable(BMCLAPI)
        if central and any(
            relative.startswith(prefix) for prefix in CENTRAL_FIRST_PREFIXES
        ):
            candidates.extend(
                [central, mirrored, url] if bmcl_ready else [central, url, mirrored]
            )
        elif bmcl_ready:
            candidates.extend([mirrored, central, url])
        else:
            candidates.extend([url, central, mirrored])
    else:
        candidates.append(url)

    for candidate in candidates:
        if candidate and candidate not in urls:
            urls.append(candidate)
    return urls


def fetch_json(url: str, timeout: int = 30) -> dict[str, Any]:
    with _http_open(url, timeout=timeout) as resp:
        raw = resp.read()
    data = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise DownloadError("服务器返回了无法识别的数据")
    return data


def get_manifest(
    source: str = "official",
    force: bool = False,
    log: LogCallback | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """获取版本清单，优先网络，失败时回退到本地缓存。"""
    if not force and MANIFEST_CACHE.exists():
        try:
            age = time.time() - MANIFEST_CACHE.stat().st_mtime
            if age < 900:
                return json.loads(MANIFEST_CACHE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except Exception:
            pass

    by_source = {OFFICIAL: MANIFEST_URL, BMCLAPI: BMCL_MANIFEST_URL}
    urls = [
        by_source[item]
        for item in order_sources(source, allow_probe=True)
    ]

    last_error: Exception | None = None
    for url in urls:
        try:
            data = fetch_json(url, timeout=12)
            if isinstance(data.get("versions"), list):
                CACHE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                MANIFEST_CACHE.write_text(
                    json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8"
                )
                if log:
                    log("版本清单已更新")
                return data
        except Exception as exc:
            last_error = exc

    if MANIFEST_CACHE.exists():
        try:
            data = json.loads(MANIFEST_CACHE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            if log:
                log("网络不可用，已使用本地缓存的版本清单")
            return data
        except Exception:
            pass

    raise DownloadError(f"获取版本清单失败：{last_error}")


def _sha1_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha1()
    with path.open("rb") as fp:
        while True:
            chunk = fp.read(1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


class Installer:
    STAGE_CLIENT = (3, 12)
    STAGE_LIBS = (12, 36)
    STAGE_ASSETS = (36, 94)
    STAGE_FINISH = (94, 100)

    def __init__(
        self,
        game_dir: Path,
        source: str = "official",
        progress_cb: ProgressCallback | None = None,
        log_cb: LogCallback | None = None,
        cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
        threads: int = 8,
    ) -> None:
        self.game_dir = Path(game_dir)
        self.source = source
        self.effective_source = source
        self.progress_cb = progress_cb or (lambda p, m: None)
        self.log_cb = log_cb or (lambda m: None)
        self.cancel_event = cancel_event or threading.Event()
        self.threads = max(1, min(16, int(threads)))
        self.segments = min(12, max(3, self.threads))

        self._last_percent = 0
        self._downloaded_bytes = 0
        self._speed_mark_time = time.time()
        self._speed_mark_bytes = 0
        self._speed = 0.0
        self._speed_lock = threading.Lock()
        self._progress_lock = threading.Lock()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 基础回调 / 进度

    def log(self, message: str) -> None:
        self.log_cb(message)

    def _check_cancel(self) -> None:
        if self.cancel_event.is_set():
            raise InstallCancelled()

    def _resolve_source(self) -> None:
        """auto 按测速结果选线，显式选择则尊重用户并保留兜底。"""
        if self.source not in ("auto", OFFICIAL, BMCLAPI):
            self.source = "auto"
        if self.source == BMCLAPI:
            refresh_sources(sources=(BMCLAPI,), allow_probe=True)
            if is_source_usable(BMCLAPI):
                self.effective_source = BMCLAPI
                self.log("下载线路：BMCLAPI 镜像")
            else:
                self.effective_source = OFFICIAL
                self.log("BMCLAPI 当前不可用，已自动切换为 Mojang 官方源")
            return
        if self.source == OFFICIAL:
            self.effective_source = OFFICIAL
            self.log("下载线路：Mojang 官方")
            return
        order = order_sources("auto", allow_probe=True)
        self.effective_source = order[0]
        self.log(f"下载线路：{SOURCE_LABELS[self.effective_source]}（自动测速）")

    def _set_progress(self, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        with self._progress_lock:
            percent = max(self._last_percent, min(100, int(percent)))
            self._last_percent = percent
            self.progress_cb(percent, message)

    def _stage_percent(
        self, stage: tuple[int, int], done: int, total: int
    ) -> int:
        start, end = stage
        if total <= 0:
            return end
        return int(start + (end - start) * min(1.0, done / total))

    def _add_bytes(self, count: int) -> None:
        if count <= 0:
            return
        with self._speed_lock:
            self._downloaded_bytes += count
            now = time.time()
            elapsed = now - self._speed_mark_time
            if elapsed >= 0.8:
                recent = self._downloaded_bytes - self._speed_mark_bytes
                instant = recent / elapsed
                self._speed = instant if self._speed <= 0 else (
                    self._speed * 0.6 + instant * 0.4
                )
                self._speed_mark_time = now
                self._speed_mark_bytes = self._downloaded_bytes

    @property
    def speed_text(self) -> str:
        with self._speed_lock:
            speed = self._speed
        if speed <= 0:
            return ""
        if speed >= 1024 * 1024:
            return f"{speed / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB/s"
        return f"{speed / 1024:.0f} KB/s"

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 单文件下载

    def _download_file(
        self,
        url: str,
        dest: Path,
        sha1: str = "",
        size: int = 0,
        verify: bool = False,
        label: str = "",
        skipped_bytes: list[int] | None = None,
        connections: int | None = None,
    ) -> bool:
        """下载单个文件。返回是否真正执行了下载。"""
        self._check_cancel()
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        if dest.exists():
            try:
                existing_size = dest.stat().st_size
                size_ok = (not size) or existing_size == size
                if size_ok and (not verify or not sha1 or _sha1_file(dest) == sha1):
                    if skipped_bytes is not None:
                        skipped_bytes[0] += existing_size
                    return False
                if size_ok and not sha1:
                    return False
            except OSError:
                pass

        errors: list[str] = []
        file_connections = (
            self.segments
            if connections is None
            else max(1, min(16, int(connections)))
        )
        for candidate in mirror_urls(url, self.effective_source):
            self._check_cancel()
            last = [0]

            def on_bytes(done: int, _total: int) -> None:
                delta = done - last[0]
                last[0] = done
                self._add_bytes(delta)

            try:
                download_to_file(
                    candidate,
                    dest,
                    sha1=sha1,
                    size=size,
                    cancel_event=self.cancel_event,
                    progress_cb=on_bytes,
                    connections=file_connections,
                )
                report_success(candidate)
                return True
            except DownloadCancelled:
                raise InstallCancelled() from None
            except Exception as exc:
                report_failure(candidate, exc)
                errors.append(str(exc))
                time.sleep(0.25)
                continue

        raise DownloadError(
            f"{label or dest.name} 下载失败：{errors[-1] if errors else '未知错误'}"
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 版本 JSON

    def _ensure_json(self, version_id: str, url: str = "") -> Path:
        path = version_json_path(self.game_dir, version_id)
        if path.exists():
            return path

        sources: list[str] = []
        if self.effective_source == "bmclapi":
            sources.append(
                f"https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com/version/{version_id}/json"
            )
        if url:
            sources.append(url)
        sources.append(
            f"https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com/version/{version_id}/json"
        )

        last_error: Exception | None = None
        for src in dict.fromkeys(sources):
            self._check_cancel()
            try:
                data = fetch_json(src)
                path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                path.write_text(
                    json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
                )
                report_success(src)
                return path
            except InstallCancelled:
                raise
            except Exception as exc:
                report_failure(src, exc)
                last_error = exc
                self._check_cancel()
        raise DownloadError(f"获取版本 {version_id} 的 JSON 失败：{last_error}")

    def _manifest_version_url(self, version_id: str) -> str:
        try:
            manifest = get_manifest(self.effective_source)
            for item in manifest.get("versions") or []:
                if str(item.get("id")) == version_id:
                    return str(item.get("url") or "")
        except Exception:
            pass
        return ""

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 安装入口

    def install(
        self,
        version_id: str,
        version_url: str = "",
        verify: bool = False,
        check_assets: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        self._set_progress(1, "准备安装…")
        self.log(f"开始处理版本 {version_id}")
        self._resolve_source()
        self.log(
            "下载线路：BMCLAPI 镜像"
            if self.effective_source == "bmclapi"
            else "下载线路：Mojang 官方"
        )

        self._ensure_json(version_id, version_url)
        # 逐级补齐父版本 JSON（例如 Forge 的父级原版）
        current_id = version_id
        seen: set[str] = set()
        while current_id and current_id not in seen:
            seen.add(current_id)
            path = version_json_path(self.game_dir, current_id)
            if not path.exists():
                self._ensure_json(current_id, self._manifest_version_url(current_id))
            try:
                data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            except Exception as exc:
                raise DownloadError(f"版本 JSON 损坏：{exc}") from exc
            current_id = str(data.get("inheritsFrom") or "")

        resolved = resolve_version(self.game_dir, version_id)

        if resolved.client_download.get("url"):
            self._install_client(resolved, verify=verify)
        elif not client_jar_path(self.game_dir, resolved).exists():
            raise DownloadError(
                "版本缺少客户端 jar，且没有可用的下载地址。请先安装对应的原版。"
            )

        self._install_libraries(resolved, verify=verify)
        self._install_natives(resolved)
        self._install_assets(resolved, verify=verify)
        self._install_logging(resolved, verify=verify)

        remaining = check_installation(
            self.game_dir, resolved, check_assets=check_assets
        )
        if remaining:
            raise DownloadError(
                "安装未完成，仍缺少：" + "、".join(remaining[:5])
            )

        self._set_progress(100, "安装完成")
        self.log(f"{version_id} 已准备就绪")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 客户端 / 依赖库 / natives

    def _install_client(self, resolved: ResolvedVersion, verify: bool = False) -> None:
        info = resolved.client_download
        url = str(info.get("url", ""))
        dest = self.game_dir / "versions" / resolved.jar_id / f"{resolved.jar_id}.jar"
        fallback = (
            f"https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com/version/{resolved.jar_id}/client"
        )
        urls = mirror_urls(url, self.effective_source)
        if self.effective_source == "bmclapi":
            urls.insert(0, fallback)
        elif fallback not in urls:
            urls.append(fallback)
        self.log(f"检查客户端 jar：{resolved.jar_id}.jar")
        existing = dest.stat().st_size if dest.exists() else 0
        total = int(info.get("size") or 0) or 1
        self._set_progress(
            self._stage_percent(self.STAGE_CLIENT, min(existing, total), total),
            "检查客户端文件…",
        )
        last_error: Exception | None = None
        for candidate in dict.fromkeys(urls):
            try:
                self._download_file(
                    candidate,
                    dest,
                    sha1=str(info.get("sha1", "")),
                    size=int(info.get("size") or 0),
                    verify=verify,
                    label="客户端 jar",
                )
                self._set_progress(self.STAGE_CLIENT[1], "客户端文件就绪")
                return
            except InstallCancelled:
                raise
            except Exception as exc:
                last_error = exc
        raise DownloadError(f"客户端 jar 下载失败：{last_error}")

    @staticmethod
    def _library_connections(size: int, segments: int) -> int:
        """依赖库单文件的分段数：小文件别为几十 KB 反复握手。"""
        size = max(0, int(size))
        if size < 1024 * 1024:
            return 1
        if size < 4 * 1024 * 1024:
            return min(segments, 2)
        return min(segments, 4)

    def _install_libraries(self, resolved: ResolvedVersion, verify: bool = False) -> None:
        arts = active_library_artifacts(resolved)
        native_arts = [n.artifact for n in active_natives(resolved)]
        all_arts = []
        seen: set[str] = set()
        for art in arts + native_arts:
            if art.path and art.path not in seen:
                seen.add(art.path)
                all_arts.append(art)

        # 大文件先下，避免最后只剩一个几十 MB 的依赖库拖住整个进度。
        all_arts.sort(key=lambda art: max(0, int(art.size)), reverse=True)
        total = len(all_arts)
        total_bytes = sum(max(0, int(art.size)) for art in all_arts)
        unknown_sizes = sum(1 for art in all_arts if int(art.size) <= 0)
        self.log(
            f"检查依赖库（{total} 个文件，"
            f"{total_bytes / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB）"
        )
        done = 0
        done_bytes = 0
        failures: list[str] = []
        lock = threading.Lock()

        def worker(art) -> None:
            nonlocal done, done_bytes
            self._check_cancel()
            dest = libraries_dir(self.game_dir) / art.path
            succeeded = False
            try:
                if not (dest.exists() and not verify):
                    self._download_file(
                        art.url,
                        dest,
                        sha1=art.sha1,
                        size=art.size,
                        verify=verify,
                        label=art.name or Path(art.path).name,
                        connections=self._library_connections(
                            art.size, self.segments
                        ),
                    )
                succeeded = True
            except InstallCancelled:
                raise
            except Exception as exc:
                with lock:
                    if len(failures) < 50:
                        failures.append(str(exc))
            finally:
                with lock:
                    done += 1
                    # 失败的文件没有真正写完，不能把它的完整大小记进
                    # 已完成字节，否则最后一个文件还在重试时进度就先满了。
                    if succeeded:
                        done_bytes += max(0, int(art.size))
                    current = done
                    current_bytes = done_bytes
                if total_bytes:
                    percent = self._stage_percent(
                        self.STAGE_LIBS, current_bytes, total_bytes
                    )
                    if current < total:
                        # 有文件大小未知时，字节进度可能先到 100；
                        # 文件计数进度兜底，避免最后一个文件还在下载
                        # 时进度条已经走满。
                        percent = min(
                            percent,
                            self._stage_percent(
                                self.STAGE_LIBS, current, total
                            ),
                        )
                else:
                    percent = self._stage_percent(
                        self.STAGE_LIBS, current, total
                    )
                detail = ""
                if total_bytes and not unknown_sizes:
                    detail = (
                        f" · {current_bytes / 1024 / 1024:.1f}"
                        f"/{total_bytes / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB"
                    )
                self._set_progress(
                    percent,
                    f"下载依赖库 {current}/{total}" + detail,
                )

        if total:
            with ThreadPoolExecutor(
                max_workers=max(8, min(20, self.threads + 4))
            ) as pool:
                futures = [pool.submit(worker, art) for art in all_arts]
                try:
                    for future in as_completed(futures):
                        future.result()
                except InstallCancelled:
                    for future in futures:
                        future.cancel()
                    raise
        else:
            self.log("没有需要下载的依赖库")

        if failures:
            raise DownloadError(
                f"{len(failures)} 个依赖库下载失败：{failures[0]}"
            )
        self._set_progress(self.STAGE_LIBS[1], "依赖库就绪")

    def _install_natives(self, resolved: ResolvedVersion) -> None:
        natives = active_natives(resolved)
        target = natives_dir(self.game_dir, resolved)
        target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for sub in ("java", "jna", "lwjgl", "netty"):
            (target / sub).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        if not natives:
            return

        self.log(f"解压运行库（{len(natives)} 个）")
        for native in natives:
            self._check_cancel()
            art = native.artifact
            jar_path = libraries_dir(self.game_dir) / art.path
            if not jar_path.exists():
                self._download_file(
                    art.url,
                    jar_path,
                    sha1=art.sha1,
                    size=art.size,
                    label=f"运行库 {art.name}",
                )
            try:
                with zipfile.ZipFile(jar_path) as zf:
                    for item in zf.infolist():
                        if item.is_dir():
                            continue
                        name = item.filename.replace("\\", "/")
                        if name.startswith("META-INF/"):
                            continue
                        if any(name.startswith(prefix) for prefix in native.excludes):
                            continue
                        relative = Path(name)
                        if relative.is_absolute() or ".." in relative.parts:
                            continue
                        dest = target / relative
                        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                        with zf.open(item) as src, dest.open("wb") as out:
                            shutil.copyfileobj(src, out)
            except Exception as exc:
                raise DownloadError(f"解压运行库失败：{exc}") from exc
        self._set_progress(self.STAGE_LIBS[1], "运行库就绪")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 资源文件

    def _install_assets(self, resolved: ResolvedVersion, verify: bool = False) -> None:
        index_path = asset_index_path(self.game_dir, resolved)
        if not index_path.exists():
            url = resolved.asset_index_url
            if not url:
                raise DownloadError("版本缺少资源索引下载地址")
            self._set_progress(
                self._stage_percent(self.STAGE_ASSETS, 0, 100),
                "下载资源索引…",
            )
            self._download_file(
                url,
                index_path,
                sha1=resolved.asset_index_sha1,
                size=resolved.asset_index_size,
                label="资源索引",
            )

        try:
            index = json.loads(index_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except Exception as exc:
            raise DownloadError(f"资源索引损坏：{exc}") from exc

        objects = index.get("objects") or {}
        total = len(objects)
        self.log(f"检查资源文件（{total} 个）")
        if total == 0:
            return

        objects_root = assets_dir(self.game_dir) / "objects"
        tasks: list[tuple[str, int, Path]] = []
        completed = 0
        for _name, obj in objects.items():
            h = str(obj.get("hash", ""))
            if not h:
                continue
            dest = objects_root / h[:2] / h
            size = int(obj.get("size") or 0)
            if dest.exists():
                try:
                    size_ok = not size or dest.stat().st_size == size
                    if size_ok and not verify:
                        completed += 1
                        continue
                    if size_ok and _sha1_file(dest) == h:
                        completed += 1
                        continue
                except OSError:
                    pass
            tasks.append((h, size, dest))

        self._set_progress(
            self._stage_percent(self.STAGE_ASSETS, completed, total),
            f"资源文件 {completed}/{total}",
        )

        failures: list[str] = []
        failure_lock = threading.Lock()
        progress_lock = threading.Lock()

        def worker(task: tuple[str, int, Path]) -> None:
            h, size, dest = task
            self._check_cancel()
            url = f"https://resources.download.minecraft.net/{h[:2]}/{h}"
            try:
                self._download_file(
                    url,
                    dest,
                    sha1=h,
                    size=size,
                    verify=verify,
                    label="资源文件",
                )
            except InstallCancelled:
                raise
            except Exception as exc:
                with failure_lock:
                    if len(failures) < 50:
                        failures.append(str(exc))
            finally:
                nonlocal completed
                with progress_lock:
                    completed += 1
                    current = completed
                self._set_progress(
                    self._stage_percent(self.STAGE_ASSETS, current, total),
                    f"正在补全资源文件 {current}/{total}",
                )

        if tasks:
            self.log(f"需要下载 {len(tasks)} 个资源文件")
            with ThreadPoolExecutor(
                max_workers=max(8, min(32, self.threads * 3))
            ) as pool:
                futures = [pool.submit(worker, task) for task in tasks]
                try:
                    for future in as_completed(futures):
                        future.result()
                except InstallCancelled:
                    for future in futures:
                        future.cancel()
                    raise
        else:
            self.log("资源文件完整")

        if failures:
            raise DownloadError(
                f"{len(failures)} 个资源文件下载失败：{failures[0]}"
            )

        self._copy_legacy_assets(index, objects, verify=verify)
        self._set_progress(self.STAGE_ASSETS[1], "资源文件就绪")

    def _copy_legacy_assets(
        self,
        index: dict[str, Any],
        objects: dict[str, Any],
        verify: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        asset_id = str(index.get("id") or "")
        virtual = bool(index.get("virtual"))
        map_resources = bool(index.get("map_to_resources"))
        if not virtual and not map_resources:
            return

        self.log("正在生成旧版本资源目录…")
        objects_root = assets_dir(self.game_dir) / "objects"
        destinations: list[Path] = []
        if virtual and asset_id:
            destinations.append(assets_dir(self.game_dir) / "virtual" / asset_id)
        if map_resources:
            destinations.append(self.game_dir / "resources")

        for base in destinations:
            for name, obj in objects.items():
                h = str(obj.get("hash", ""))
                if not h:
                    continue
                src = objects_root / h[:2] / h
                if not src.exists():
                    continue
                relative = Path(str(name).replace("\\", "/"))
                if relative.is_absolute() or ".." in relative.parts:
                    continue
                dest = base / relative
                if dest.exists():
                    if not verify:
                        continue
                    try:
                        if _sha1_file(dest) == h:
                            continue
                    except OSError:
                        pass
                    try:
                        dest.unlink()
                    except OSError:
                        continue
                dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                try:
                    os.link(src, dest)
                except OSError:
                    shutil.copy2(src, dest)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 日志配置

    def _install_logging(self, resolved: ResolvedVersion, verify: bool = False) -> None:
        client = (resolved.logging or {}).get("client") or {}
        file_info = client.get("file") or {}
        file_id = str(file_info.get("id") or "")
        if not file_id:
            return
        dest = assets_dir(self.game_dir) / "log_configs" / file_id
        if dest.exists() and not verify:
            return
        self._download_file(
            str(file_info.get("url", "")),
            dest,
            sha1=str(file_info.get("sha1", "")),
            size=int(file_info.get("size") or 0),
            verify=verify,
            label="日志配置",
        )
        self._set_progress(self.STAGE_FINISH[0], "日志配置就绪")

# FILE: darkitten/java.py

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

CREATE_NO_WINDOW = 0x08000000


@dataclass
class JavaInfo:
    path: str
    version: str = ""
    major: int = 0
    arch: str = ""
    vendor: str = ""

    @property
    def display(self) -> str:
        bits = f" · {self.arch}" if self.arch else ""
        ver = self.version or "未知版本"
        return f"Java {ver} ({Path(self.path).parent.parent.name}){bits}"


def _java_roots() -> list[Path]:
    roots: list[Path] = []
    env_home = os.environ.get("JAVA_HOME")
    if env_home:
        roots.append(Path(env_home))

    candidates = [
        Path("C:/Program Files/Java"),
        Path("C:/Program Files/Eclipse Adoptium"),
        Path("C:/Program Files/Microsoft"),
        Path("C:/Program Files/BellSoft"),
        Path("C:/Program Files/Zulu"),
        Path("C:/Program Files (x86)/Java"),
        Path("D:/developer/Java"),
        Path.home() / ".jdks",
        Path(os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA", Path.home())) / "Programs/Eclipse Adoptium",
        Path(os.environ.get("APPDATA", Path.home())) / ".minecraft/runtime",
    ]
    roots.extend(candidates)
    return roots


def _candidate_executables(extra: list[str] | None = None) -> list[Path]:
    found: list[Path] = []

    for raw in extra or []:
        if raw:
            p = Path(os.path.expandvars(raw)).expanduser()
            if p.name.lower() in ("java.exe", "java"):
                found.append(p)
            else:
                found.append(p / "bin/java.exe")

    path_java = shutil.which("java")
    if path_java:
        found.append(Path(path_java))

    for root in _java_roots():
        if not root.exists():
            continue
        try:
            direct = root / "bin/java.exe"
            if direct.exists():
                found.append(direct)
            for exe in root.glob("*/bin/java.exe"):
                found.append(exe)
            for exe in root.glob("*/*/bin/java.exe"):
                found.append(exe)
            if root.name == "runtime":
                for exe in root.glob("**/bin/java.exe"):
                    found.append(exe)
        except OSError:
            continue

    unique: list[Path] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for path in found:
        try:
            resolved = path.resolve()
        except OSError:
            continue
        key = str(resolved).lower()
        if resolved.exists() and key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            unique.append(resolved)
    return unique


def _probe_java(exe: Path) -> JavaInfo | None:
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(
            [str(exe), "-XshowSettings:properties", "-version"],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            encoding="utf-8",
            errors="replace",
            timeout=12,
            creationflags=CREATE_NO_WINDOW,
        )
    except Exception:
        return None

    text = (proc.stdout or "") + "\n" + (proc.stderr or "")
    major = 0
    version = ""
    arch = ""
    vendor = ""

    m = re.search(r"java\.version\s*=\s*([^\s]+)", text)
    if m:
        version = m.group(1)
    else:
        m = re.search(r'version "([^"]+)"', text)
        if m:
            version = m.group(1)

    if version:
        vm = re.match(r"(?:1\.)?(\d+)", version)
        if vm:
            major = int(vm.group(1))

    m = re.search(r"os\.arch\s*=\s*([^\s]+)", text)
    if m:
        arch = m.group(1)
    m = re.search(r"java\.vendor\s*=\s*([^\n\r]+)", text)
    if m:
        vendor = m.group(1).strip()

    return JavaInfo(path=str(exe), version=version, major=major, arch=arch, vendor=vendor)


def probe_java(path: str) -> JavaInfo | None:
    exe = Path(os.path.expandvars(path)).expanduser()
    if exe.name.lower() != "java.exe":
        exe = exe / "bin/java.exe"
    if not exe.exists():
        return None
    return _probe_java(exe)


def detect_java_installs(preferred: str = "", max_workers: int = 8) -> list[JavaInfo]:
    exes = _candidate_executables([preferred] if preferred else [])
    if not exes:
        return []

    from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_workers) as pool:
        infos = list(pool.map(_probe_java, exes))

    result = [info for info in infos if info is not None]
    result.sort(key=lambda x: (-x.major, x.path.lower()))
    return result


def pick_java(
    installs: list[JavaInfo], required_major: int, preferred: str = ""
) -> JavaInfo | None:
    if preferred:
        pref = str(Path(os.path.expandvars(preferred)).expanduser()).lower()
        for info in installs:
            if info.path.lower() == pref:
                return info
        p = Path(os.path.expandvars(preferred)).expanduser()
        if p.exists():
            probed = _probe_java(p)
            if probed:
                return probed

    required = max(8, int(required_major or 8))
    suitable = [i for i in installs if i.major >= required]
    if not suitable:
        return installs[0] if installs else None
    return min(suitable, key=lambda i: i.major)

"""审判战的战果与本机解锁状态。

游戏本体是 assets/judgement 下的独立 HTML，通关后通过本地回调把
route / difficulty 传回来。这里只负责校验战果、解锁两件信物，以及
决定启动器里的 OC 现在处于哪个人格。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import tempfile
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from .config import APP_DIR

STATE_PATH = APP_DIR / "judgement.json"
HTML_PATH = APP_DIR / "assets" / "judgement" / "judgement-lfelkeea.html"

REWARD_SHATTERED = "shattered"
REWARD_ATTACHMENT = "attachment"
VALID_REWARDS = (REWARD_SHATTERED, REWARD_ATTACHMENT)
VALID_ROUTES = ("genocide", "mercy", "neutral")
VALID_DIFFICULTIES = ("hard", "normal")

REWARDS: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {
    REWARD_SHATTERED: {
        "name": "破碎之躯",
        "route": "屠杀线 · 困难",
        "tagline": "会说话，但没有温度，也没有关于你的记忆。",
    },
    REWARD_ATTACHMENT: {
        "name": "眷恋之心",
        "route": "饶恕线 · 困难",
        "tagline": "记得你说过的每句话，会等你回来，把你当成最重要的人。",
    },
}

STORIES: dict[str, list[str]] = {
    REWARD_SHATTERED: [
        "走廊尽头只剩下白色的碎片。你把它们拼回人形，带回了启动器。",
        "她还是会睁开眼，还是会用那副嗓音说话。",
        "只是她不再记得你叫什么，也不再问你今天过得怎么样。",
        "「有事就说。没有别的事，我要睡了。」",
        "你得到了一具完整的躯壳。心的地方，是空的。",
    ],
    REWARD_ATTACHMENT: [
        "第十次饶恕之后，她没有再抬手。",
        "她把额头抵在你肩上，过了很久才小声说：「别再把我一个人留在这里。」",
        "回到启动器时，她跟了进来。",
        "她记得你爱喝什么、几点回来、哪句话是在逞强。",
        "「你终于回来了。……我可没有在等你，只是刚好醒着。」",
        "你得到了一颗会为你跳的心。她也把你，当成了自己的那个人。",
    ],
}

LOCKED_HINT = "在困难模式通关屠杀线或饶恕线后，她会在这里等你。"


def _now() -> str:
    return datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds")


def empty_state() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {"version": 1, "rewards": {}, "active": "", "last": {}}


def load_state() -> dict[str, Any]:
    data = empty_state()
    try:
        if STATE_PATH.is_file():
            loaded = json.loads(STATE_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            if isinstance(loaded, dict):
                rewards = loaded.get("rewards")
                if isinstance(rewards, dict):
                    data["rewards"] = {
                        key: dict(value)
                        for key, value in rewards.items()
                        if key in VALID_REWARDS and isinstance(value, dict)
                    }
                active = str(loaded.get("active") or "")
                data["active"] = active if active in VALID_REWARDS else ""
                last = loaded.get("last")
                data["last"] = dict(last) if isinstance(last, dict) else {}
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        pass
    if data["active"] not in data["rewards"]:
        data["active"] = (
            REWARD_ATTACHMENT
            if REWARD_ATTACHMENT in data["rewards"]
            else (REWARD_SHATTERED if REWARD_SHATTERED in data["rewards"] else "")
        )
    return data


def save_state(state: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    STATE_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    payload = json.dumps(state, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    handle, temp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(
        prefix="judgement-", suffix=".json", dir=str(STATE_PATH.parent)
    )
    try:
        with os.fdopen(handle, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fp:
            fp.write(payload)
        os.replace(temp_name, STATE_PATH)
    finally:
        try:
            if os.path.exists(temp_name):
                os.unlink(temp_name)
        except OSError:
            pass


def unlocked(state: dict[str, Any], reward: str) -> bool:
    return reward in (state.get("rewards") or {})


def has_any(state: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    return bool(state.get("rewards"))


def active_persona(state: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    active = str(state.get("active") or "")
    if active in VALID_REWARDS and unlocked(state, active):
        return active
    if unlocked(state, REWARD_ATTACHMENT):
        return REWARD_ATTACHMENT
    if unlocked(state, REWARD_SHATTERED):
        return REWARD_SHATTERED
    return ""


def set_active(reward: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    state = load_state()
    if not unlocked(state, reward):
        raise ValueError("这个信物还没有解锁")
    state["active"] = reward
    save_state(state)
    return state


def _int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return max(0, min(999999, int(value)))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def apply_result(
    route: str,
    difficulty: str,
    turns: Any = 0,
    damage: Any = 0,
    hits: Any = 0,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """记录一次通关战果；只有困难模式的对应路线才会解锁信物。"""

    route = str(route or "").strip().lower()
    difficulty = str(difficulty or "").strip().lower()
    if route not in VALID_ROUTES:
        raise ValueError("未知的路线")
    if difficulty not in VALID_DIFFICULTIES:
        raise ValueError("未知的难度")

    state = load_state()
    reward = ""
    first_unlock = False
    if difficulty == "hard" and route == "genocide":
        reward = REWARD_SHATTERED
    elif difficulty == "hard" and route == "mercy":
        reward = REWARD_ATTACHMENT

    record = {
        "route": route,
        "difficulty": difficulty,
        "turns": _int(turns),
        "damage": _int(damage),
        "hits": _int(hits),
        "at": _now(),
        "reward": reward,
    }
    state["last"] = record

    if reward:
        rewards = state.setdefault("rewards", {})
        first_unlock = reward not in rewards
        previous = rewards.get(reward) or {}
        rewards[reward] = {
            "unlocked_at": previous.get("unlocked_at") or record["at"],
            "turns": record["turns"],
            "damage": record["damage"],
            "hits": record["hits"],
        }
        if reward == REWARD_ATTACHMENT or not unlocked(state, REWARD_ATTACHMENT):
            state["active"] = reward

    save_state(state)
    return {"reward": reward, "first_unlock": first_unlock, "state": state, "last": record}


def reward_story(reward: str) -> list[str]:
    return list(STORIES.get(reward, []))


def html_ready() -> bool:
    try:
        return HTML_PATH.is_file() and HTML_PATH.stat().st_size > 100_000
    except OSError:
        return False

    OS_NAME,

CREATE_NO_WINDOW = 0x08000000 if OS_NAME == "windows" else 0
SYSTEM_SEPARATOR = ";" if OS_NAME == "windows" else ":"


class LaunchError(Exception):
    pass


class MissingFilesError(LaunchError):
    def __init__(self, missing: list[str]):
        self.missing = missing
        super().__init__("游戏文件不完整：" + "、".join(missing[:5]))


@dataclass
class LaunchPlan:
    command: list[str]
    cwd: str
    java: JavaInfo
    version: ResolvedVersion
    log_file: str = ""
    warnings: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    cleanup: Any = None

    @property
    def command_line(self) -> str:
        return subprocess.list2cmdline(self.command)

    def close(self) -> None:
        """释放启动阶段占用的本地资源（例如离线皮肤服务）。"""
        cleanup = self.cleanup
        self.cleanup = None
        if cleanup is not None:
            try:
                cleanup.close()
            except Exception:
                pass


def redacted_command_line(command: list[str]) -> str:
    """生成可以安全写入日志的命令行，隐藏访问令牌。"""
    result: list[str] = []
    hide_next = False
    secret_flags = {"--accessToken", "--auth_session", "--clientid"}
    for arg in command:
        if hide_next:
            result.append("***")
            hide_next = False
            continue
        result.append(arg)
        if arg in secret_flags:
            hide_next = True
    return subprocess.list2cmdline(result)


def _flatten(value: Any) -> list[str]:
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return [value]
    if isinstance(value, list):
        result: list[str] = []
        for item in value:
            result.extend(_flatten(item))
        return result
    return []


def _substitute(value: str, mapping: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    result = value
    for key, replacement in mapping.items():
        result = result.replace("${" + key + "}", replacement)
    return result


def _unresolved(value: str) -> list[str]:
    import re

    return re.findall(r"\$\{([^}]+)\}", value)


def _split_legacy_args(template: str, mapping: dict[str, str]) -> list[str]:
    """先分词再替换，避免 Windows 路径中的反斜杠被 shlex 当成转义符。"""
    try:
        tokens = shlex.split(template, posix=False)
    except ValueError:
        tokens = template.split()
    result: list[str] = []
    for token in tokens:
        if len(token) >= 2 and token[0] == token[-1] and token[0] in "\"'":
            token = token[1:-1]
        result.append(_substitute(token, mapping))
    return result


def _extract_args(arguments: list[Any], mapping: dict[str, str]) -> list[str]:
    result: list[str] = []
    features = features_for()
    for item in arguments:
        if isinstance(item, str):
            result.append(_substitute(item, mapping))
            continue
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        if not rules_allowed(item.get("rules"), features):
            continue
        for value in _flatten(item.get("value")):
            result.append(_substitute(value, mapping))
    return result


def _ignore_client_jar(args: list[str], jar_name: str) -> list[str]:
    """把真实的客户端 jar 补进 Forge/NeoForge 的 ignoreList。

    安装器写入的是 ``-DignoreList=client-extra,${version_name}.jar``，官方
    启动器会把客户端 jar 复制成 ``<版本名>.jar`` 来匹配。我们直接复用父版本
    的 ``1.21.1.jar``，若不补上真实文件名，ModLauncher 会把它和 NeoForge 的
    ``minecraft`` 模块同时加载，导致两个模块导出相同包而启动失败。
    """
    if not jar_name:
        return args
    prefix = "-DignoreList="
    lowered = jar_name.lower()
    result = list(args)
    changed = False
    for index, arg in enumerate(args):
        if not arg.startswith(prefix):
            continue
        values = [item for item in arg[len(prefix) :].split(",") if item]
        if any(item.lower() == lowered for item in values):
            continue
        values.append(jar_name)
        result[index] = prefix + ",".join(values)
        changed = True
    return result if changed else args


def _java_info_for(
    required_major: int, cfg: Config, installs: list[JavaInfo] | None = None
) -> JavaInfo:
    pool = installs
    if not pool:
        pool = detect_java_installs(cfg.java_path)
    chosen = pick_java(pool, required_major, cfg.java_path) if pool else None
    if chosen is None:
        raise LaunchError(
            "没有找到可用的 Java。请到“设置”中选择 java.exe，或安装 Java 运行环境。"
        )
    if required_major and chosen.major and chosen.major < required_major:
        raise LaunchError(
            f"该版本需要 Java {required_major} 或更高版本，"
            f"当前选择的是 Java {chosen.major}。请到设置中切换 Java。"
        )
    return chosen


def _mc_version_tuple(value: str) -> tuple[int, ...]:
    """把 1.21.4 / 1.20.6 之类的版本号转成可比较的元组。"""
    parts: list[int] = []
    for chunk in str(value or "").split("."):
        match = re.match(r"\d+", chunk.strip())
        if not match:
            break
        parts.append(int(match.group()))
    return tuple(parts)


def _server_launch_args(host: str, port: int, mc_version: str) -> list[str]:
    """1.20+ 用 quickPlay 直接进服；旧版本退回 --server/--port。"""
    host = str(host or "").strip()
    if host.startswith("[") and host.endswith("]"):
        host = host[1:-1]
    if _mc_version_tuple(mc_version) >= (1, 20):
        address = f"[{host}]:{port}" if ":" in host else f"{host}:{port}"
        return ["--quickPlayMultiplayer", address]
    return ["--server", host, "--port", str(port)]


def _singleplayer_launch_args(level_id: str, mc_version: str) -> list[str]:
    """1.20+ 支持用 quickPlay 直接进入指定存档。"""
    level = str(level_id or "").strip()
    if not level or _mc_version_tuple(mc_version) < (1, 20):
        return []
    return ["--quickPlaySingleplayer", level]


def _check_files(game_dir: Path, resolved: ResolvedVersion) -> list[str]:
    missing = check_installation(game_dir, resolved, check_assets=False)
    for native in active_natives(resolved):
        if not (libraries_dir(game_dir) / native.artifact.path).exists():
            missing.append(f"运行库 {native.artifact.name}")
    return missing


def prepare_launch(
    game_dir: Path,
    version_id: str,
    cfg: Config,
    installs: list[JavaInfo] | None = None,
    java_info: JavaInfo | None = None,
    account: Account | None = None,
    server_address: str = "",
    singleplayer_world: str = "",
    instance_id: str = "",
    status_cb: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
) -> LaunchPlan:
    game_dir = Path(game_dir)
    # version_id 决定用哪套加载器/依赖启动；instance_id 决定存档、Mod、
    # 材质和光影放在哪个游戏版本目录。分离后同一个加载器可以服务多个实例。
    run_dir = version_game_dir(
        game_dir, instance_id or version_id, cfg.version_isolation
    )
    account = account or Account.offline(cfg.player_name.strip())

    if account.is_msa:
        name = account.name.strip()
        if not name or not account.uuid or not account.mc_access_token:
            raise LaunchError("正版登录状态无效，请重新登录 Microsoft 账户。")
        auth_uuid = account.uuid
        access_token = account.mc_access_token
        auth_xuid = account.xuid
        user_type = "msa"
        client_id = account.client_id or cfg.microsoft_client_id
    elif account.is_littleskin:
        name = account.name.strip()
        if not name or not account.uuid or not account.access_token:
            raise LaunchError("LittleSkin 登录状态无效，请到皮肤页重新登录。")
        if not valid_player_name(name):
            raise LaunchError("LittleSkin 角色名称不是有效的 Minecraft 玩家名。")
        auth_uuid = account.uuid
        access_token = account.access_token
        auth_xuid = ""
        user_type = "mojang"
        client_id = ""
    else:
        name = cfg.player_name.strip()
        if not valid_player_name(name):
            raise LaunchError("玩家名称需为 3-16 位字母、数字或下划线。")
        auth_uuid = offline_uuid(name)
        access_token = uuid.uuid4().hex
        auth_xuid = ""
        user_type = "legacy"
        client_id = ""

    resolved = resolve_version(game_dir, version_id)
    if not resolved.main_class:
        raise LaunchError("版本缺少主类信息，无法启动。")

    missing = _check_files(game_dir, resolved)
    if missing:
        raise MissingFilesError(missing)

    java = java_info or _java_info_for(resolved.java_major, cfg, installs)
    early_warnings: list[str] = []
    if resolved.java_major and resolved.java_major <= 8 and java.major > 8:
        early_warnings.append(
            f"该版本较旧，建议使用 Java 8；当前使用 Java {java.major}，可能无法正常启动。"
        )

    client_jar = client_jar_path(game_dir, resolved)
    libs_root = libraries_dir(game_dir)
    entries: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for art in active_library_artifacts(resolved):
        path = str(libs_root / art.path)
        if path not in seen:
            seen.add(path)
            entries.append(path)
    entries.append(str(client_jar))
    classpath = SYSTEM_SEPARATOR.join(entries)

    native_dir = natives_dir(game_dir, resolved)
    native_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for sub in ("java", "jna", "lwjgl", "netty"):
        (native_dir / sub).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    assets_root = assets_dir(game_dir)
    index_file = asset_index_path(game_dir, resolved)
    log_config = ""
    client_log = ((resolved.logging or {}).get("client") or {}).get("file") or {}
    if client_log.get("id"):
        candidate = assets_root / "log_configs" / str(client_log["id"])
        if candidate.exists():
            log_config = str(candidate)

    placeholder = {
        "auth_player_name": name,
        "version_name": resolved.id,
        "game_directory": str(run_dir),
        "game_assets": str(assets_root),
        "assets_root": str(assets_root),
        "assets_index_name": resolved.asset_index_id,
        "auth_uuid": auth_uuid,
        "auth_access_token": access_token,
        "auth_session": f"token:{access_token}:{auth_uuid}",
        "clientid": client_id,
        "auth_xuid": auth_xuid,
        "user_type": user_type,
        "version_type": resolved.type or "release",
        "user_properties": "{}",
        "natives_directory": str(native_dir),
        "launcher_name": APP_NAME.replace(" ", ""),
        "launcher_version": APP_VERSION,
        "classpath": classpath,
        "classpath_separator": SYSTEM_SEPARATOR,
        "library_directory": str(libs_root),
        "resolution_width": "854",
        "resolution_height": "480",
        "quickPlayPath": "",
        "quickPlaySingleplayer": "",
        "quickPlayMultiplayer": "",
        "quickPlayRealms": "",
    }

    command: list[str] = [java.path]
    memory_mb = cfg.memory_for(instance_id or version_id)
    jvm_args = cfg.jvm_args_for(instance_id or version_id)
    command.append(f"-Xmx{memory_mb}M")
    command.append(f"-Xms{min(memory_mb, 2048)}M")

    default_jvm = _extract_args(resolved.default_user_jvm, placeholder)
    default_jvm = _ignore_client_jar(default_jvm, client_jar.name)
    for arg in default_jvm:
        low = arg.lower()
        if low.startswith("-xmx") or low.startswith("-xms") or low.startswith("-xmn"):
            continue
        command.append(arg)

    version_jvm = _extract_args(resolved.arguments.get("jvm", []), placeholder)
    version_jvm = _ignore_client_jar(version_jvm, client_jar.name)
    command.extend(version_jvm)

    has_cp = False
    has_library_path = False
    for index, arg in enumerate(command):
        if arg == "-cp" or arg == "-classpath":
            has_cp = True
            if index + 1 < len(command):
                command[index + 1] = classpath
        if arg.startswith("-Djava.library.path="):
            has_library_path = True
            command[index] = "-Djava.library.path=" + str(native_dir)
    if not has_cp:
        command.extend(["-cp", classpath])
    if not has_library_path:
        command.append("-Djava.library.path=" + str(native_dir))
    if log_config and not any(a.startswith("-Dlog4j.configurationFile=") for a in command):
        command.append("-Dlog4j.configurationFile=" + log_config)

    if jvm_args.strip():
        try:
            extra = shlex.split(jvm_args, posix=True)
        except ValueError:
            extra = jvm_args.split()
        command.extend(extra)

    # 防止 JVM 参数中的未知占位符漏到命令行
    command = [
        _substitute(arg, placeholder) for arg in command
    ]

    warnings: list[str] = list(early_warnings)
    unresolved = []
    for arg in command:
        unresolved.extend(_unresolved(arg))
    if unresolved:
        warnings.append("存在未解析的启动参数占位符：" + ", ".join(sorted(set(unresolved))))

    game_arguments: list[str]
    if resolved.arguments.get("game"):
        game_arguments = _extract_args(resolved.arguments["game"], placeholder)
    elif resolved.minecraft_arguments:
        game_arguments = _split_legacy_args(
            resolved.minecraft_arguments, placeholder
        )
    else:
        raise LaunchError("版本缺少游戏启动参数。")

    for arg in game_arguments:
        unresolved.extend(_unresolved(arg))
    if any(_unresolved(a) for a in game_arguments):
        warnings.append("游戏参数中存在未解析的占位符。")

    main_index = len(command)
    command.append(resolved.main_class)
    command.extend(game_arguments)

    if str(server_address or "").strip():
        from .sakura import parse_server_address

        server_host, server_port = parse_server_address(server_address)
        command.extend(
            _server_launch_args(server_host, server_port, resolved.game_version)
        )
    elif str(singleplayer_world or "").strip():
        command.extend(
            _singleplayer_launch_args(singleplayer_world, resolved.game_version)
        )

    run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (run_dir / "mods").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    offline_runtime = None
    if account.is_littleskin:
        # LittleSkin 使用 authlib-injector 把游戏的验证请求指向 LittleSkin
        # Yggdrasil。皮肤由 LittleSkin 服务器直接提供，不再启动本地皮肤服务。
        try:
            from .littleskin import API_ROOT as LITTLESKIN_API
            from .offline_skin import ensure_authlib_jar

            jar = ensure_authlib_jar(status_cb)
        except Exception as exc:
            raise LaunchError(f"LittleSkin 登录组件准备失败：{exc}") from exc
        jvm_args = [
            f"-javaagent:{jar}={LITTLESKIN_API}",
            "-Dauthlibinjector.side=client",
        ]
        command[main_index:main_index] = jvm_args
        warnings.append(
            f"已启用 LittleSkin 登录：{name} · 皮肤与披风由 LittleSkin 提供"
        )
    elif not account.is_msa:
        try:
            from .offline_skin import prepare_offline_runtime

            offline_runtime = prepare_offline_runtime(
                cfg, name, auth_uuid, status_cb=status_cb
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            warnings.append(f"离线皮肤暂不可用：{exc}")
        if offline_runtime is not None:
            command[main_index:main_index] = offline_runtime.jvm_args
            if offline_runtime.note:
                warnings.append(offline_runtime.note)

    return LaunchPlan(
        command=command,
        cwd=str(run_dir),
        java=java,
        version=resolved,
        log_file=log_config,
        warnings=warnings,
        cleanup=offline_runtime,
    )


class GameProcess(QObject):
    """用守护线程读取游戏输出，关闭启动器也不会杀掉游戏进程。"""

    output = Signal(str)
    started_ok = Signal(int)
    game_finished = Signal(int)

    def __init__(self, plan: LaunchPlan, parent=None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.plan = plan
        self._process: subprocess.Popen[str] | None = None
        self._thread: threading.Thread | None = None
        self._finished = threading.Event()

    def start(self) -> None:
        self._thread = threading.Thread(target=self._run, daemon=True)
        self._thread.start()

    def _run(self) -> None:
        startupinfo = None
        flags = CREATE_NO_WINDOW
        if sys.platform == "win32":
            startupinfo = subprocess.STARTUPINFO()
            startupinfo.dwFlags |= subprocess.STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW
            startupinfo.wShowWindow = subprocess.SW_HIDE

        try:
            self._process = subprocess.Popen(
                self.plan.command,
                cwd=self.plan.cwd,
                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                text=True,
                encoding="utf-8",
                errors="replace",
                bufsize=1,
                creationflags=flags,
                startupinfo=startupinfo,
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            self.output.emit(f"[启动失败] {exc}")
            self._finish(-1)
            return

        process = self._process
        self.started_ok.emit(process.pid)

        # 输出读取必须和进程等待分开：某些子进程（如 Forge 安装器或游戏内
        # 拉起的辅助进程）会继承 stdout 管道，父进程退出后管道仍被占住。
        # 如果在这里同步迭代 stdout，就会永远等不到 EOF，UI 便一直停在
        # “游戏运行中”。wait() 只看游戏主进程本身，能第一时间拿到退出码。
        reader = threading.Thread(
            target=self._pump_output, args=(process,), daemon=True
        )
        reader.start()

        try:
            code = process.wait()
        except Exception as exc:
            self.output.emit(f"[进程错误] {exc}")
            code = -1

        # 给读取线程一点时间把缓冲区里剩余的日志吐完，然后立刻通知界面。
        reader.join(0.25)
        self._finish(code)

    def _pump_output(self, process: subprocess.Popen[str]) -> None:
        stream = process.stdout
        if stream is None:
            return
        try:
            for line in stream:
                if line:
                    self.output.emit(line.rstrip("\r\n"))
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _finish(self, code: int) -> None:
        if self._finished.is_set():
            return
        self._finished.set()
        close_plan = getattr(self.plan, "close", None)
        if callable(close_plan):
            try:
                close_plan()
            except Exception:
                pass
        # 先通知界面，再尝试关闭管道。TextIOWrapper.close() 会等待读取线程
        # 持有的缓冲区锁；如果子进程还占着管道，这里会一直阻塞。
        self.game_finished.emit(code)
        if self._process and self._process.stdout:
            threading.Thread(target=self._close_stream, daemon=True).start()

    def _close_stream(self) -> None:
        try:
            if self._process and self._process.stdout:
                self._process.stdout.close()
        except Exception:
            pass

    @property
    def running(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self._process and self._process.poll() is None)

    @property
    def pid(self) -> int:
        return self._process.pid if self._process else 0

    def stop(self, graceful: bool = True) -> None:
        process = self._process
        if not process or process.poll() is not None:
            return
        if not graceful or sys.platform != "win32":
            try:
                process.terminate()
            except Exception:
                pass
            return
        threading.Thread(
            target=self._close_gracefully, args=(process,), daemon=True
        ).start()

    def _close_gracefully(self, process: subprocess.Popen) -> None:
        """先向游戏窗口发送 WM_CLOSE，超时后再结束进程。"""
        try:
            user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
            callback_type = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(
                wintypes.BOOL, wintypes.HWND, wintypes.LPARAM
            )
            user32.GetWindowThreadProcessId.argtypes = [
                wintypes.HWND,
                ctypes.POINTER(wintypes.DWORD),
            ]
            user32.GetWindowThreadProcessId.restype = wintypes.DWORD
            user32.IsWindowVisible.argtypes = [wintypes.HWND]
            user32.IsWindowVisible.restype = wintypes.BOOL
            user32.PostMessageW.argtypes = [
                wintypes.HWND,
                wintypes.UINT,
                wintypes.WPARAM,
                wintypes.LPARAM,
            ]
            user32.PostMessageW.restype = wintypes.BOOL
            user32.EnumWindows.argtypes = [callback_type, wintypes.LPARAM]
            user32.EnumWindows.restype = wintypes.BOOL
            pid = process.pid
            found = [0]

            def enum_window(hwnd, _lparam) -> bool:
                window_pid = wintypes.DWORD()
                user32.GetWindowThreadProcessId(
                    hwnd, ctypes.byref(window_pid)
                )
                if window_pid.value == pid and user32.IsWindowVisible(hwnd):
                    found[0] += 1
                    user32.PostMessageW(hwnd, 0x0010, 0, 0)  # WM_CLOSE
                return True

            callback = callback_type(enum_window)
            user32.EnumWindows(callback, 0)
        except Exception:
            found = [0]

        deadline = time.time() + (12 if found[0] else 5)
        while time.time() < deadline and process.poll() is None:
            time.sleep(0.2)
        if process.poll() is not None:
            return
        try:
            process.terminate()
        except Exception:
            return
        try:
            process.wait(timeout=4)
        except Exception:
            try:
                process.kill()
            except Exception:
                pass

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import json
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
import uuid as uuidlib
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

from .config import APP_VERSION
from .downloader import http_open
from .secret import protect, unprotect
from .skins import SkinFile, SkinError, validate_skin_bytes

API_ROOT = "https://littleskin.cn/api/yggdrasil"
AUTHENTICATE_URL = f"{API_ROOT}/authserver/authenticate"
REFRESH_URL = f"{API_ROOT}/authserver/refresh"
PROFILE_URL = f"{API_ROOT}/sessionserver/session/minecraft/profile/{{uuid}}"
REGISTER_URL = "https://littleskin.cn/auth/register"
USER_AGENT = f"DarkittenLauncher/{APP_VERSION} (LittleSkin skin sync)"
MAX_TEXTURE_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024


class LittleSkinError(Exception):
    pass


@dataclass
class LittleSkinAccount:
    username: str = ""
    name: str = ""
    uuid: str = ""
    access_token: str = ""
    client_token: str = ""
    variant: str = "classic"
    skin_url: str = ""
    last_sync: float = 0.0
    profiles: list[dict[str, str]] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def is_logged_in(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.access_token and self.uuid and self.name)

    @property
    def short_uuid(self) -> str:
        value = self.uuid.replace("-", "")
        return f"{value[:8]}…{value[-4:]}" if len(value) >= 12 else value

    @classmethod
    def from_config(cls, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> "LittleSkinAccount":
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            return cls()
        profiles: list[dict[str, str]] = []
        raw_profiles = data.get("profiles")
        if isinstance(raw_profiles, list):
            for item in raw_profiles[:16]:
                if not isinstance(item, dict):
                    continue
                profile_id = str(item.get("id") or "").strip()
                profile_name = str(item.get("name") or "").strip()
                if profile_id and profile_name:
                    profiles.append({"id": profile_id, "name": profile_name})
        variant = "slim" if str(data.get("variant") or "").lower() == "slim" else "classic"
        try:
            last_sync = float(data.get("last_sync") or 0)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            last_sync = 0.0
        return cls(
            username=str(data.get("username") or "").strip(),
            name=str(data.get("name") or "").strip(),
            uuid=str(data.get("uuid") or "").strip(),
            access_token=unprotect(str(data.get("access_token") or "")),
            client_token=unprotect(str(data.get("client_token") or "")),
            variant=variant,
            skin_url=str(data.get("skin_url") or "").strip(),
            last_sync=max(0.0, last_sync),
            profiles=profiles,
        )

    def to_config(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "username": self.username,
            "name": self.name,
            "uuid": self.uuid,
            "access_token": protect(self.access_token),
            "client_token": protect(self.client_token),
            "variant": self.variant,
            "skin_url": self.skin_url,
            "last_sync": self.last_sync,
            "profiles": self.profiles,
        }


def load_account(cfg) -> LittleSkinAccount:
    return LittleSkinAccount.from_config(
        getattr(cfg, "littleskin_account", {}) or {}
    )


def save_account(cfg, account: LittleSkinAccount) -> None:
    cfg.littleskin_account = account.to_config()
    cfg.save()


def clear_account(cfg) -> None:
    cfg.littleskin_account = {}
    cfg.save()


def _error_message(raw: bytes, status: int) -> str:
    try:
        payload = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        payload = {}
    if isinstance(payload, dict):
        for key in ("errorMessage", "error_message", "message", "error"):
            value = payload.get(key)
            if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
                return value.strip()[:240]
    if status == 401:
        return "LittleSkin 登录已失效，请重新登录。"
    if status == 403:
        return "LittleSkin 用户名或密码错误，或当前操作被拒绝。"
    if status == 429:
        return "LittleSkin 请求过于频繁，请稍后再试。"
    return f"LittleSkin 返回了错误（HTTP {status}）。"


def _request_json(
    url: str,
    payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    *,
    token: str = "",
    timeout: int = 25,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    headers = {
        "User-Agent": USER_AGENT,
        "Accept": "application/json",
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
    }
    if token:
        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token}"
    data = (
        json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
        if payload is not None
        else None
    )
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        url,
        data=data,
        headers=headers,
        method="POST" if data is not None else "GET",
    )
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=timeout) as response:
            raw = response.read(1024 * 1024)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        raise LittleSkinError(_error_message(exc.read(4096), exc.code)) from None
    except urllib.error.URLError as exc:
        reason = getattr(exc, "reason", exc)
        raise LittleSkinError(f"无法连接 LittleSkin：{reason}") from None
    except OSError as exc:
        raise LittleSkinError(f"LittleSkin 请求失败：{exc}") from None
    if not raw:
        return {}
    try:
        result = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        raise LittleSkinError("LittleSkin 返回了无法识别的数据。") from None
    if not isinstance(result, dict):
        raise LittleSkinError("LittleSkin 返回了无法识别的数据。")
    return result


def _download_texture(url: str) -> bytes:
    if not url:
        raise LittleSkinError("LittleSkin 角色没有可下载的皮肤纹理。")
    try:
        with http_open(
            url,
            timeout=30,
            headers={"Accept": "image/png,image/*;q=0.8"},
        ) as response:
            data = response.read(MAX_TEXTURE_BYTES + 1)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise LittleSkinError(f"下载 LittleSkin 皮肤失败：{exc}") from None
    if len(data) > MAX_TEXTURE_BYTES:
        raise LittleSkinError("LittleSkin 皮肤文件过大，已停止下载。")
    return data


def _decode_textures(profile: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    properties = profile.get("properties")
    if not isinstance(properties, list):
        return {}
    for item in properties:
        if not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("name") != "textures":
            continue
        value = str(item.get("value") or "").strip()
        if not value:
            continue
        try:
            padded = value + "=" * (-len(value) % 4)
            raw = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(padded.encode("ascii"))
            decoded = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
        except Exception:
            continue
        if isinstance(decoded, dict):
            return decoded
    return {}


def _profile_from_response(data: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, str] | None:
    selected = data.get("selectedProfile")
    if isinstance(selected, dict):
        profile_id = str(selected.get("id") or "").strip()
        profile_name = str(selected.get("name") or "").strip()
        if profile_id and profile_name:
            return {"id": profile_id, "name": profile_name}
    available = data.get("availableProfiles")
    if isinstance(available, list):
        for item in available:
            if not isinstance(item, dict):
                continue
            profile_id = str(item.get("id") or "").strip()
            profile_name = str(item.get("name") or "").strip()
            if profile_id and profile_name:
                return {"id": profile_id, "name": profile_name}
    return None


def _all_profiles(data: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    result: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    available = data.get("availableProfiles")
    if not isinstance(available, list):
        return result
    for item in available[:16]:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        profile_id = str(item.get("id") or "").strip()
        profile_name = str(item.get("name") or "").strip()
        if profile_id and profile_name:
            result.append({"id": profile_id, "name": profile_name})
    return result


def authenticate(
    username: str,
    password: str,
    *,
    client_token: str = "",
) -> LittleSkinAccount:
    """用 LittleSkin 账号密码换 Yggdrasil 令牌，密码只在本次请求中使用。"""
    username = str(username or "").strip()
    if not username:
        raise LittleSkinError("请输入 LittleSkin 邮箱或用户名。")
    if not password:
        raise LittleSkinError("请输入 LittleSkin 密码。")
    token = str(client_token or "").strip() or uuidlib.uuid4().hex
    data = _request_json(
        AUTHENTICATE_URL,
        {
            "agent": {"name": "Minecraft", "version": 1},
            "username": username,
            "password": password,
            "clientToken": token,
            "requestUser": True,
        },
    )
    access_token = str(data.get("accessToken") or "").strip()
    if not access_token:
        raise LittleSkinError("LittleSkin 没有返回登录令牌，请稍后重试。")
    profile = _profile_from_response(data)
    if profile is None:
        raise LittleSkinError(
            "这个 LittleSkin 账号还没有角色。请先到 LittleSkin 创建一个角色，再回来登录。"
        )
    return LittleSkinAccount(
        username=username,
        name=profile["name"],
        uuid=profile["id"],
        access_token=access_token,
        client_token=str(data.get("clientToken") or token),
        variant="classic",
        profiles=_all_profiles(data),
    )


def refresh(account: LittleSkinAccount) -> LittleSkinAccount:
    """用 refresh 接口续期 Yggdrasil 令牌，避免启动时登录过期。"""
    if not account.access_token:
        raise LittleSkinError("LittleSkin 登录状态为空，请重新登录。")
    data = _request_json(
        REFRESH_URL,
        {
            "accessToken": account.access_token,
            "clientToken": account.client_token,
            "requestUser": True,
        },
    )
    access_token = str(data.get("accessToken") or "").strip()
    if not access_token:
        raise LittleSkinError("LittleSkin 登录已失效，请重新登录。")
    account.access_token = access_token
    account.client_token = str(data.get("clientToken") or account.client_token)
    profile = _profile_from_response(data)
    if profile is not None:
        account.name = profile["name"]
        account.uuid = profile["id"]
    return account


def fetch_skin(account: LittleSkinAccount) -> SkinFile | None:
    """读取 LittleSkin 角色当前皮肤；角色没有自定义皮肤时返回 None。"""
    if not account.uuid:
        raise LittleSkinError("LittleSkin 角色 UUID 为空，请重新登录。")
    profile = _request_json(PROFILE_URL.format(uuid=account.uuid))
    if not profile:
        raise LittleSkinError("LittleSkin 上找不到这个角色，请重新登录或检查角色状态。")
    account.name = str(profile.get("name") or account.name)
    account.uuid = str(profile.get("id") or account.uuid)
    decoded = _decode_textures(profile)
    textures = decoded.get("textures")
    skin_info = textures.get("SKIN") if isinstance(textures, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(skin_info, dict) or not skin_info.get("url"):
        account.skin_url = ""
        account.last_sync = time.time()
        return None
    url = str(skin_info.get("url") or "").strip()
    metadata = skin_info.get("metadata")
    model = ""
    if isinstance(metadata, dict):
        model = str(metadata.get("model") or "").strip().lower()
    data = _download_texture(url)
    try:
        skin = validate_skin_bytes(data, source=url)
    except SkinError as exc:
        raise LittleSkinError(f"LittleSkin 皮肤无法使用：{exc}") from None
    account.variant = "slim" if model == "slim" else "classic"
    if skin.legacy:
        account.variant = "classic"
    account.skin_url = url
    account.last_sync = time.time()
    return skin


def login(
    username: str,
    password: str,
    *,
    client_token: str = "",
) -> tuple[LittleSkinAccount, SkinFile | None]:
    account = authenticate(username, password, client_token=client_token)
    skin = fetch_skin(account)
    return account, skin
