LIVE_SCOPE = "service::user.auth.xboxlive.com::MBI_SSL"
XBOX_USER_URL = "https://user.auth.xboxlive.com/user/authenticate"
XSTS_URL = "https://xsts.auth.xboxlive.com/xsts/authorize"
MC_LOGIN_URL = "https://api.minecraftservices.com/authentication/login_with_xbox"
MC_PROFILE_URL = "https://api.minecraftservices.com/minecraft/profile"
SCOPE = "XboxLive.signin offline_access"
USER_AGENT = f"DarkittenLauncher/{APP_VERSION} (Minecraft Launcher)"

LEGACY_CLIENT_ID_RE = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-fA-F]{16}$")
CLIENT_ID_RE = re.compile(
    r"^(?:"
    r"[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-"
    r"[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}"
    r"|[0-9a-fA-F]{16}"
    r")$"
)

XSTS_MESSAGES = {
    2148916233: "该 Microsoft 账户还没有 Xbox 账户，请先在 xbox.com 创建。",
    2148916235: "该账户所在地区无法使用 Xbox Live。",
    2148916236: "该账户需要先在 Xbox 页面完成年龄验证。",
    2148916237: "该账户需要先在 Xbox 页面完成年龄验证。",
    2148916238: "该账户是儿童账户，需要由家庭组中的成年人授权。",
}


class MicrosoftAuthError(Exception):
    pass


class MicrosoftAuthCancelled(Exception):
    pass


@dataclass
class DeviceCode:
    device_code: str
    user_code: str
    verification_uri: str
    verification_uri_complete: str
    expires_in: int
    interval: int
    message: str
    # Live Connect 会用 cookie 绑定设备码与轮询请求，v2 流程留空。
    cookie: str = ""


@dataclass
class TokenResult:
    access_token: str
    refresh_token: str
    expires_in: int


class _HttpFailure(Exception):
    def __init__(self, status: int, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        self.status = status
        self.payload = payload
        super().__init__(str(payload.get("error") or status))


def is_legacy_client_id(value: str) -> bool:
    """16 位十六进制应用 ID 属于旧版 Live SDK，需要走 Live Connect。"""
    return bool(LEGACY_CLIENT_ID_RE.fullmatch((value or "").strip()))


def normalize_client_id(value: str) -> str:
    client_id = (value or "").strip()
    if not client_id:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(
            "还没有填写客户端 ID。请在设置页或登录窗口中填写应用注册的客户端 ID。"
        )
    if not CLIENT_ID_RE.fullmatch(client_id):
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(
            "客户端 ID 格式不正确，应为 GUID 或 16 位十六进制应用 ID。"
        )
    return client_id


def _decode(raw: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        data = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        return {}
    return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}


def _request_raw(
    url: str,
    *,
    data: bytes | None = None,
    headers: dict[str, str] | None = None,
    timeout: int = 30,
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], Any]:
    merged = {
        "User-Agent": USER_AGENT,
        "Accept": "application/json",
    }
    if headers:
        merged.update(headers)
    request = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, headers=merged, method="POST" if data else "GET")
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=timeout) as response:
            raw = response.read()
            response_headers = response.headers
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        payload = _decode(exc.read())
        raise _HttpFailure(exc.code, payload) from None
    except urllib.error.URLError as exc:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(f"无法连接 Microsoft 服务：{exc.reason}") from exc
    except OSError as exc:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(f"网络请求失败：{exc}") from exc
    payload = _decode(raw)
    if not payload:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError("Microsoft 服务返回了无法识别的数据。")
    return payload, response_headers


def _request(
    url: str,
    *,
    data: bytes | None = None,
    headers: dict[str, str] | None = None,
    timeout: int = 30,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload, _ = _request_raw(
        url, data=data, headers=headers, timeout=timeout
    )
    return payload


def _cookie_header(headers: Any) -> str:
    """把响应里的 Set-Cookie 压成一个 Cookie 请求头。"""
    if headers is None:
        return ""
    cookies: list[str] = []
    for raw in headers.get_all("Set-Cookie") or []:
        first = str(raw).split(";", 1)[0].strip()
        if first and "=" in first:
            cookies.append(first)
    return "; ".join(cookies)


def _post_form(
    url: str,
    fields: dict[str, str],
    timeout: int = 30,
    headers: dict[str, str] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    body = urllib.parse.urlencode(fields).encode("utf-8")
    merged = {"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"}
    if headers:
        merged.update(headers)
    return _request(url, data=body, headers=merged, timeout=timeout)


def _post_form_with_cookie(
    url: str, fields: dict[str, str], timeout: int = 30
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], str]:
    body = urllib.parse.urlencode(fields).encode("utf-8")
    payload, response_headers = _request_raw(
        url,
        data=body,
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"},
        timeout=timeout,
    )
    return payload, _cookie_header(response_headers)


def _post_json(
    url: str, payload: dict[str, Any], timeout: int = 30
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return _request(
        url,
        data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
        headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "x-xbl-contract-version": "1",
        },
        timeout=timeout,
    )


def _oauth_message(failure: _HttpFailure) -> str:
    code = str(failure.payload.get("error") or "")
    description = str(failure.payload.get("error_description") or "").strip()
    friendly = {
        "invalid_client": "客户端 ID 无效，或该应用不允许当前登录方式。",
        "unauthorized_client": (
            "该应用不允许当前登录方式。GUID 应用请启用公共客户端流程，"
            "16 位应用 ID 请使用验证码登录。"
        ),
        "invalid_grant": "登录授权已失效或被拒绝，请重新登录 Microsoft 账户。",
        "invalid_request": "登录请求无效，请检查客户端 ID、重定向 URI 与网络环境。",
        "unsupported_response_type": "登录方式不受支持，请检查应用配置。",
        "temporarily_unavailable": "Microsoft 登录服务暂时不可用，请稍后重试。",
    }
    if code in friendly:
        return friendly[code]
    if description:
        return description.splitlines()[0][:240]
    return f"Microsoft 登录失败（HTTP {failure.status}）。"


def request_device_code(client_id: str) -> DeviceCode:
    client_id = normalize_client_id(client_id)
    legacy = is_legacy_client_id(client_id)
    cookie = ""
    try:
        if legacy:
            payload, cookie = _post_form_with_cookie(
                LIVE_DEVICE_CODE_URL,
                {
                    "client_id": client_id,
                    "scope": LIVE_SCOPE,
                    "response_type": "device_code",
                },
            )
        else:
            payload = _post_form(
                DEVICE_CODE_URL, {"client_id": client_id, "scope": SCOPE}
            )
    except _HttpFailure as exc:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(_oauth_message(exc)) from None
    device_code = str(payload.get("device_code") or "")
    user_code = str(payload.get("user_code") or "")
    if not device_code or not user_code:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(
            str(payload.get("error_description") or "无法获取 Microsoft 登录验证码。")
        )
    uri = str(
        payload.get("verification_uri")
        or ("https://www.microsoft.com/link" if legacy else "https://microsoft.com/devicelogin")
    )
    complete = str(payload.get("verification_uri_complete") or "")
    try:
        expires_in = int(payload.get("expires_in") or 900)
    except Exception:
        expires_in = 900
    try:
        interval = max(1, int(payload.get("interval") or 5))
    except Exception:
        interval = 5
    return DeviceCode(
        device_code=device_code,
        user_code=user_code,
        verification_uri=uri,
        verification_uri_complete=complete,
        expires_in=expires_in,
        interval=interval,
        message=str(payload.get("message") or ""),
        cookie=cookie,
    )


def poll_device_code(
    client_id: str,
    device_code: str,
    *,
    interval: int = 5,
    expires_in: int = 900,
    cookie: str = "",
    cancel_event=None,
    on_status: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
) -> TokenResult:
    client_id = normalize_client_id(client_id)
    legacy = is_legacy_client_id(client_id)
    token_url = (
        LIVE_TOKEN_URL + "?" + urllib.parse.urlencode({"client_id": client_id})
        if legacy
        else TOKEN_URL
    )
    fields = {
        "grant_type": "urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code",
        "client_id": client_id,
        "device_code": device_code,
    }
    headers = {"Cookie": cookie} if legacy and cookie else None
    deadline = time.monotonic() + max(30, expires_in)
    delay = max(1, interval)
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        if cancel_event is not None:
            if cancel_event.wait(delay):
                raise MicrosoftAuthCancelled()
        else:
            time.sleep(delay)
        try:
            payload = _post_form(token_url, fields, headers=headers)
        except _HttpFailure as exc:
            error = str(exc.payload.get("error") or "")
            if error == "authorization_pending":
                if on_status:
                    on_status("等待在浏览器中完成登录…")
                continue
            if error == "slow_down":
                delay += 5
                if on_status:
                    on_status("登录服务要求降低轮询频率，继续等待…")
                continue
            if error == "authorization_declined":
                raise MicrosoftAuthError("你取消了 Microsoft 登录授权。") from None
            if error == "expired_token":
                raise MicrosoftAuthError("登录验证码已过期，请重新登录。") from None
            if error == "bad_verification_code":
                raise MicrosoftAuthError("验证码无效，请重新登录。") from None
            raise MicrosoftAuthError(_oauth_message(exc)) from None
        # Live Connect 有时会用 200 返回错误对象，而不是 HTTP 错误码。
        error = str(payload.get("error") or "")
        if error == "authorization_pending":
            if on_status:
                on_status("等待在浏览器中完成登录…")
            continue
        if error == "slow_down":
            delay += 5
            if on_status:
                on_status("登录服务要求降低轮询频率，继续等待…")
            continue
        if error == "authorization_declined":
            raise MicrosoftAuthError("你取消了 Microsoft 登录授权。")
        if error == "expired_token":
            raise MicrosoftAuthError("登录验证码已过期，请重新登录。")
        if error == "bad_verification_code":
            raise MicrosoftAuthError("验证码无效，请重新登录。")
        token = str(payload.get("access_token") or "")
        if not token:
            raise MicrosoftAuthError(
                str(payload.get("error_description") or "Microsoft 没有返回访问令牌。")
            )
        try:
            expires = int(payload.get("expires_in") or 3600)
        except Exception:
            expires = 3600
        return TokenResult(
            access_token=token,
            refresh_token=str(payload.get("refresh_token") or ""),
            expires_in=expires,
        )
    raise MicrosoftAuthError("登录验证码已过期，请重新登录。")


class _OAuthCallbackServer(http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer):
    daemon_threads = True

    def __init__(self, address: tuple[str, int]) -> None:
        super().__init__(address, _OAuthCallbackHandler)
        self.result: dict[str, str] = {}
        self.done = threading.Event()


class _OAuthCallbackHandler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    server: _OAuthCallbackServer

    def do_GET(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - BaseHTTPRequestHandler API
        parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(self.path)
        params = {
            key: values[0]
            for key, values in urllib.parse.parse_qs(
                parsed.query, keep_blank_values=True
            ).items()
        }
        if parsed.path not in ("", "/"):
            self.send_response(204)
            self.end_headers()
            return
        if not any(key in params for key in ("code", "error")):
            self._respond(
                400,
                "等待登录结果",
                "没有收到 Microsoft 登录结果，请回到启动器重新发起登录。",
            )
            return

        self.server.result = params
        self.server.done.set()
        error = params.get("error")
        if error:
            message = (
                params.get("error_description")
                or "Microsoft 登录没有完成，请回到启动器重试。"
            )
            self._respond(200, "登录未完成", message)
        else:
            self._respond(
                200,
                "登录完成",
                "已完成 Microsoft 授权，可以关闭此页面并返回启动器。",
            )

    def _respond(self, status: int, title: str, message: str) -> None:
        safe_title = html.escape(title)
        safe_message = html.escape(message[:500])
        body = f"""<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>{safe_title} · Darkitten Launcher</title>
<style>
  body {{ margin: 0; min-height: 100vh; display: grid; place-items: center;
         background: #f4f6fa; color: #1b2433;
         font-family: "Microsoft YaHei UI", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }}
  .card {{ width: min(460px, calc(100% - 40px)); padding: 36px 32px;
          background: #fff; border-radius: 16px; text-align: center;
          box-shadow: 0 14px 40px rgba(20, 35, 60, .10); }}
  h1 {{ margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 22px; }}
  p {{ margin: 0; color: #5c6b80; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.7; }}
</style>
</head>
<body><div class="card"><h1>{safe_title}</h1><p>{safe_message}</p></div></body>
</html>"""
        raw = body.encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(raw)))
        self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
        self.end_headers()
        try:
            self.wfile.write(raw)
        except OSError:
            pass

    def log_message(self, format: str, *args: Any) -> None:
        return


def _base64url(raw: bytes) -> str:
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(raw).rstrip(b"=").decode("ascii")


def _pkce_pair() -> tuple[str, str]:
    verifier = secrets.token_urlsafe(64)
    challenge = _base64url(hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode("ascii")).digest())
    return verifier, challenge


def _browser_error_message(error: str, description: str) -> str:
    if error in ("access_denied", "consent_required", "interaction_required"):
        return "你取消了 Microsoft 授权，或需要重新确认登录。"
    friendly = {
        "invalid_request": "Microsoft 登录请求无效，请检查 Azure 重定向 URI 是否为 http://localhost。",
        "unauthorized_client": (
            "该 Azure 应用不允许浏览器登录，请启用公共客户端流，"
            "并添加 http://localhost 重定向 URI。"
        ),
        "invalid_client": "客户端 ID 无效，或应用没有启用公共客户端流程。",
        "server_error": "Microsoft 登录服务出错，请稍后重试。",
        "temporarily_unavailable": "Microsoft 登录服务暂时不可用，请稍后重试。",
    }
    if error in friendly:
        return friendly[error]
    if description:
        return description.splitlines()[0][:240]
    return f"Microsoft 登录没有完成（{error}）。"


def login_with_browser(
    client_id: str,
    *,
    login_hint: str = "",
    on_url: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
    on_status: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
    timeout: int = 300,
) -> Account:
    """通过系统浏览器 + PKCE + 本地回调完成 Microsoft 登录。

    Microsoft 不允许第三方应用直接收集账户密码；这里会把邮箱作为 login_hint
    预填到 Microsoft 官方登录页，授权完成后由本机回环地址自动接收授权码。
    """
    client_id = normalize_client_id(client_id)
    if is_legacy_client_id(client_id):
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(
            "16 位应用 ID 需要使用验证码登录；浏览器回调方式只支持 GUID 应用。"
        )
    login_hint = (login_hint or "").strip()

    try:
        server = _OAuthCallbackServer(("127.0.0.1", 0))
    except OSError as exc:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(f"无法启动本地登录回调服务：{exc}") from None

    port = int(server.server_address[1])
    redirect_uri = f"http://localhost:{port}"
    verifier, challenge = _pkce_pair()
    state = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    query = {
        "client_id": client_id,
        "response_type": "code",
        "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
        "response_mode": "query",
        "scope": SCOPE,
        "state": state,
        "code_challenge": challenge,
        "code_challenge_method": "S256",
    }
    if login_hint:
        query["login_hint"] = login_hint
    url = AUTHORIZE_URL + "?" + urllib.parse.urlencode(query)

    thread = threading.Thread(
        target=server.serve_forever, kwargs={"poll_interval": 0.1}, daemon=True
    )
    thread.start()
    try:
        if on_url:
            on_url(url)
        try:
            opened = bool(webbrowser.open(url))
        except Exception:
            opened = False
        if on_status:
            on_status(
                "已打开系统浏览器，请在 Microsoft 页面完成登录…"
                if opened
                else "无法自动打开浏览器，请点击“重新打开登录页”。"
            )

        deadline = time.monotonic() + max(60, int(timeout))
        while not server.done.is_set():
            if cancel_event is not None:
                if cancel_event.wait(0.25):
                    raise MicrosoftAuthCancelled()
            else:
                time.sleep(0.25)
            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                raise MicrosoftAuthError(
                    "等待 Microsoft 登录超时。请重试，并确认浏览器已完成授权。"
                )
        result = dict(server.result)
    finally:
        try:
            server.shutdown()
        except Exception:
            pass
        server.server_close()
        thread.join(timeout=1)

    if str(result.get("state") or "") != state:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError("登录回调校验失败，请重新登录 Microsoft 账户。")
    error = str(result.get("error") or "")
    if error:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(
            _browser_error_message(
                error, str(result.get("error_description") or "").strip()
            )
        )
    code = str(result.get("code") or "")
    if not code:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError("Microsoft 登录没有返回授权码，请重试。")

    if on_status:
        on_status("正在完成 Microsoft 与 Minecraft 账户验证…")
    try:
        payload = _post_form(
            TOKEN_URL,
            {
                "grant_type": "authorization_code",
                "client_id": client_id,
                "code": code,
                "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
                "code_verifier": verifier,
                "scope": SCOPE,
            },
        )
    except _HttpFailure as exc:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(_oauth_message(exc)) from None

    access_token = str(payload.get("access_token") or "")
    if not access_token:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError("Microsoft 没有返回访问令牌，请重新登录。")
    try:
        expires_in = int(payload.get("expires_in") or 3600)
    except Exception:
        expires_in = 3600
    account = Account(
        kind="msa",
        access_token=access_token,
        refresh_token=str(payload.get("refresh_token") or ""),
        client_id=client_id,
        expires_at=time.time() + expires_in,
    )
    return _complete_chain(account)


def refresh_microsoft_token(client_id: str, refresh_token: str) -> TokenResult:
    client_id = normalize_client_id(client_id)
    if not refresh_token:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError("登录状态已失效，请重新登录 Microsoft 账户。")
    legacy = is_legacy_client_id(client_id)
    try:
        payload = _post_form(
            LIVE_TOKEN_URL if legacy else TOKEN_URL,
            {
                "grant_type": "refresh_token",
                "client_id": client_id,
                "refresh_token": refresh_token,
                "scope": LIVE_SCOPE if legacy else SCOPE,
            },
        )
    except _HttpFailure as exc:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(_oauth_message(exc)) from None
    token = str(payload.get("access_token") or "")
    if not token:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError("无法刷新 Microsoft 登录状态，请重新登录。")
    try:
        expires = int(payload.get("expires_in") or 3600)
    except Exception:
        expires = 3600
    return TokenResult(
        access_token=token,
        refresh_token=str(payload.get("refresh_token") or refresh_token),
        expires_in=expires,
    )


def _xbox_user_token(
    ms_access_token: str, *, legacy: bool = False
) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
    last: _HttpFailure | None = None
    # Live Connect 的令牌使用 t=，微软身份平台 v2 的令牌使用 d=。
    tickets = (
        (f"t={ms_access_token}", f"d={ms_access_token}", ms_access_token)
        if legacy
        else (f"d={ms_access_token}", ms_access_token)
    )
    for ticket in tickets:
        try:
            payload = _post_json(
                XBOX_USER_URL,
                {
                    "Properties": {
                        "AuthMethod": "RPS",
                        "SiteName": "user.auth.xboxlive.com",
                        "RpsTicket": ticket,
                    },
                    "RelyingParty": "http://auth.xboxlive.com",
                    "TokenType": "JWT",
                },
            )
            break
        except _HttpFailure as exc:
            last = exc
    else:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(
            f"Xbox Live 身份验证失败（HTTP {last.status if last else '?'}）。"
        )
    token = str(payload.get("Token") or "")
    claims = (payload.get("DisplayClaims") or {}).get("xui") or []
    uhs = str((claims[0] if claims else {}).get("uhs") or "")
    xuid = str((claims[0] if claims else {}).get("xid") or "")
    if not token or not uhs:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError("Xbox Live 没有返回有效的用户令牌。")
    return token, uhs, xuid


def _xsts_token(user_token: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
    try:
        payload = _post_json(
            XSTS_URL,
            {
                "Properties": {
                    "SandboxId": "RETAIL",
                    "UserTokens": [user_token],
                },
                "RelyingParty": "rp://api.minecraftservices.com/",
                "TokenType": "JWT",
            },
        )
    except _HttpFailure as exc:
        try:
            xerr = int(exc.payload.get("XErr") or 0)
        except Exception:
            xerr = 0
        message = XSTS_MESSAGES.get(xerr)
        if message:
            raise MicrosoftAuthError(message) from None
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(
            f"Xbox 安全令牌验证失败（HTTP {exc.status}"
            + (f"，XErr {xerr}" if xerr else "")
            + "）。"
        ) from None
    token = str(payload.get("Token") or "")
    claims = (payload.get("DisplayClaims") or {}).get("xui") or []
    uhs = str((claims[0] if claims else {}).get("uhs") or "")
    xuid = str((claims[0] if claims else {}).get("xid") or "")
    if not token or not uhs:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError("Xbox 安全令牌响应不完整。")
    return token, uhs, xuid


def minecraft_login(xsts_token: str, uhs: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
    try:
        payload = _post_json(
            MC_LOGIN_URL,
            {"identityToken": f"XBL3.0 x={uhs};{xsts_token}"},
        )
    except _HttpFailure as exc:
        if exc.status in (400, 401, 403):
            raise MicrosoftAuthError(
                "Minecraft 登录被拒绝，请确认该账户已购买 Minecraft Java Edition。"
            ) from None
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(
            f"Minecraft 登录失败（HTTP {exc.status}）。"
        ) from None
    token = str(payload.get("access_token") or "")
    if not token:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError("Minecraft 服务没有返回访问令牌。")
    try:
        expires_in = int(payload.get("expires_in") or 86400)
    except Exception:
        expires_in = 86400
    return token, expires_in


def fetch_profile(mc_access_token: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        MC_PROFILE_URL,
        headers={
            "User-Agent": USER_AGENT,
            "Accept": "application/json",
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {mc_access_token}",
        },
        method="GET",
    )
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
            raw = response.read()
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        if exc.status == 404:
            raise MicrosoftAuthError(
                "该 Microsoft 账户没有 Minecraft Java Edition，或还没有创建游戏档案。"
            ) from None
        if exc.status == 401:
            raise MicrosoftAuthError("Minecraft 登录已失效，请重新登录。") from None
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(
            f"获取 Minecraft 档案失败（HTTP {exc.status}）。"
        ) from None
    except urllib.error.URLError as exc:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(f"无法连接 Minecraft 服务：{exc.reason}") from None
    payload = _decode(raw)
    if not payload.get("id") or not payload.get("name"):
        raise MicrosoftAuthError("Minecraft 档案数据不完整。")
    return payload


def _complete_chain(account: Account) -> Account:
    user_token, uhs, xuid = _xbox_user_token(
        account.access_token, legacy=is_legacy_client_id(account.client_id)
    )
    xsts_token, xsts_uhs, xsts_xuid = _xsts_token(user_token)
    mc_token, expires_in = minecraft_login(xsts_token, xsts_uhs or uhs)
    profile = fetch_profile(mc_token)
    account.mc_access_token = mc_token
    account.mc_expires_at = time.time() + max(0, expires_in - 120)
    account.uuid = str(profile.get("id") or "")
    account.name = str(profile.get("name") or "")
    account.xuid = xsts_xuid or xuid
    if not account.uuid or not account.name:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError("无法读取 Minecraft 账户名称。")
    return account


def login_with_device_code(
    client_id: str,
    *,
    on_code: Callable[[DeviceCode], None] | None = None,
    on_status: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
    cancel_event=None,
) -> Account:
    client_id = normalize_client_id(client_id)
    device = request_device_code(client_id)
    if on_code:
        on_code(device)
    token = poll_device_code(
        client_id,
        device.device_code,
        interval=device.interval,
        expires_in=device.expires_in,
        cookie=device.cookie,
        cancel_event=cancel_event,
        on_status=on_status,
    )
    account = Account(
        kind="msa",
        access_token=token.access_token,
        refresh_token=token.refresh_token,
        client_id=client_id,
        expires_at=time.time() + token.expires_in,
    )
    if on_status:
        on_status("正在验证 Xbox 与 Minecraft 账户…")
    return _complete_chain(account)


def ensure_minecraft_token(account: Account, client_id: str) -> Account:
    """确保正版账户拥有可用的 Minecraft 访问令牌。"""
    if not account.is_msa:
        return account
    if (
        account.mc_access_token
        and account.mc_expires_at > time.time() + 60
        and account.name
        and account.uuid
    ):
        return account
    # 账户里记录的是登录时实际使用的应用；全局设置只作为兜底，
    # 这样换过客户端 ID 之后，老账户仍然能用原来的应用刷新令牌。
    preferred = str(account.client_id or client_id or "").strip()
    if not preferred:
        raise MicrosoftAuthError(
            "缺少客户端 ID，无法刷新正版登录状态。请到设置中填写后重试。"
        )
    client_id = normalize_client_id(preferred)
    if not account.client_id:
        account.client_id = client_id
    token = refresh_microsoft_token(client_id, account.refresh_token)
    account.access_token = token.access_token
    account.refresh_token = token.refresh_token or account.refresh_token
    account.expires_at = time.time() + token.expires_in
    return _complete_chain(account)

# FILE: darkitten/migration.py
################################################################################
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import shutil
import threading
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Callable

from .modrinth import (
    ModrinthError,
    download_mod_file,
    fetch_mod_versions,
    lookup_version_by_hash,
    version_supports,
)
from .paths import version_game_dir
from .versions import ResolvedVersion, resolve_version

ProgressCallback = Callable[[int, str], None]
LogCallback = Callable[[str], None]

CATEGORY_DIRS: dict[str, str] = {
    "saves": "saves",
    "config": "config",
    "resourcepacks": "resourcepacks",
    "shaderpacks": "shaderpacks",
}

CATEGORY_NAMES: dict[str, str] = {
    "saves": "存档",
    "config": "配置",
    "resourcepacks": "资源包",
    "shaderpacks": "光影",
    "mods": "模组",
    "options": "选项与服务器列表",
}

OPTION_FILES = ("options.txt", "optionsof.txt", "servers.dat")

DEFAULT_CATEGORIES = (
    "saves",
    "config",
    "resourcepacks",
    "shaderpacks",
    "mods",
    "options",
)


class MigrationError(Exception):
    pass


class MigrationCancelled(Exception):
    pass


@dataclass
class ModCandidate:
    path: Path
    filename: str
    disabled: bool
    size: int = 0
    sha1: str = ""

    @property
    def base_name(self) -> str:
        return self.filename[: -len(".disabled")] if self.disabled else self.filename

    @property
    def target_name(self) -> str:
        return self.base_name + (".disabled" if self.disabled else "")


@dataclass
class MigrationPlan:
    game_dir: Path
    source_id: str
    target_id: str
    source_mc: str
    target_mc: str
    source_loader: str
    target_loader: str
    source_dir: Path
    target_dir: Path
    categories: list[str]
    mods: list[ModCandidate] = field(default_factory=list)
    file_counts: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    total_files: int = 0
    total_bytes: int = 0
    conflicts: int = 0
    same_dir: bool = False


@dataclass
class MigrationReport:
    source_id: str
    target_id: str
    copied_files: int = 0
    skipped_files: int = 0
    matched_mods: int = 0
    copied_mods: int = 0
    skipped_mods: int = 0
    copied_bytes: int = 0
    warnings: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def summary(self) -> str:
        parts = [f"迁移 {self.copied_files} 个文件"]
        if self.matched_mods:
            parts.append(f"匹配 {self.matched_mods} 个 Mod")
        if self.copied_mods:
            parts.append(f"迁移 {self.copied_mods} 个 Mod")
        if self.skipped_files or self.skipped_mods:
            parts.append(f"跳过 {self.skipped_files + self.skipped_mods} 项")
        if self.warnings:
            parts.append(f"{len(self.warnings)} 条提醒")
        return "，".join(parts)


def _check_cancel(cancel_event: threading.Event | None) -> None:
    if cancel_event is not None and cancel_event.is_set():
        raise MigrationCancelled()


def _mc_version(resolved: ResolvedVersion) -> str:
    return str(resolved.chain[0] if resolved.chain else resolved.id)


def _iter_files(root: Path) -> list[Path]:
    if not root.is_dir():
        return []
    result: list[Path] = []
    for path in root.rglob("*"):
        try:
            if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
                continue
        except OSError:
            continue
        result.append(path)
    return result


def _mod_candidates(source_dir: Path) -> list[ModCandidate]:
    mods_dir = source_dir / "mods"
    if not mods_dir.is_dir():
        return []
    result: list[ModCandidate] = []
    for path in sorted(mods_dir.iterdir(), key=lambda item: item.name.lower()):
        try:
            if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
                continue
        except OSError:
            continue
        name = path.name
        disabled = name.lower().endswith(".jar.disabled")
        if not disabled and not name.lower().endswith(".jar"):
            continue
        try:
            size = path.stat().st_size
        except OSError:
            size = 0
        result.append(
            ModCandidate(
                path=path,
                filename=name,
                disabled=disabled,
                size=size,
            )
        )
    return result


def collect_migration_plan(
    game_dir: Path,
    source_id: str,
    target_id: str = "",
    categories: list[str] | tuple[str, ...] | None = None,
    isolated: bool = True,
) -> MigrationPlan:
    game_dir = Path(game_dir)
    selected = [
        key
        for key in (categories or DEFAULT_CATEGORIES)
        if key in CATEGORY_DIRS or key in ("mods", "options")
    ]
    try:
        source_resolved = resolve_version(game_dir, source_id)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise MigrationError(f"无法读取源版本 {source_id}：{exc}") from exc

    target_resolved: ResolvedVersion | None = None
    if target_id:
        try:
            target_resolved = resolve_version(game_dir, target_id)
        except Exception as exc:
            raise MigrationError(f"无法读取目标版本 {target_id}：{exc}") from exc

    source_dir = version_game_dir(game_dir, source_id, isolated)
    target_dir = (
        version_game_dir(game_dir, target_id, isolated)
        if target_id
        else source_dir
    )
    same_dir = bool(target_id) and source_dir.resolve() == target_dir.resolve()

    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    total_bytes = 0
    total_files = 0
    conflicts = 0

    for key in selected:
        if key in CATEGORY_DIRS:
            files = _iter_files(source_dir / CATEGORY_DIRS[key])
            counts[key] = len(files)
            for path in files:
                try:
                    total_bytes += path.stat().st_size
                except OSError:
                    pass
                if target_id and not same_dir:
                    rel = path.relative_to(source_dir / CATEGORY_DIRS[key])
                    if (target_dir / CATEGORY_DIRS[key] / rel).exists():
                        conflicts += 1
            total_files += len(files)
        elif key == "options":
            files = [
                source_dir / name
                for name in OPTION_FILES
                if (source_dir / name).is_file()
            ]
            counts[key] = len(files)
            for path in files:
                try:
                    total_bytes += path.stat().st_size
                except OSError:
                    pass
                if target_id and not same_dir and (target_dir / path.name).exists():
                    conflicts += 1
            total_files += len(files)

    mods = _mod_candidates(source_dir) if "mods" in selected else []
    counts["mods"] = len(mods)
    total_files += len(mods)
    total_bytes += sum(mod.size for mod in mods)
    if target_id and not same_dir:
        target_mods = target_dir / "mods"
        conflicts += sum(1 for mod in mods if (target_mods / mod.target_name).exists())

    return MigrationPlan(
        game_dir=game_dir,
        source_id=source_id,
        target_id=target_id,
        source_mc=_mc_version(source_resolved),
        target_mc=_mc_version(target_resolved) if target_resolved else "",
        source_loader=source_resolved.loader,
        target_loader=target_resolved.loader if target_resolved else "",
        source_dir=source_dir,
        target_dir=target_dir,
        categories=selected,
        mods=mods,
        file_counts=counts,
        total_files=total_files,
        total_bytes=total_bytes,
        conflicts=conflicts,
        same_dir=same_dir,
    )


def _sha1_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha1()
    with path.open("rb") as fp:
        while True:
            chunk = fp.read(1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _copy_file(source: Path, target: Path) -> int:
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(source, target)
    try:
        return target.stat().st_size
    except OSError:
        return 0


def _copy_mod(mod: ModCandidate, target: Path) -> int:
    if target.exists():
        return 0
    return _copy_file(mod.path, target)


def _find_compatible_mod(
    mod: ModCandidate,
    loader: str,
    mc_version: str,
    log: LogCallback,
) -> dict | None:
    if not loader or not mc_version:
        return None
    try:
        if not mod.sha1:
            mod.sha1 = _sha1_file(mod.path)
        cached = lookup_version_by_hash(mod.sha1)
    except Exception as exc:
        log(f"{mod.base_name}: 查询 Modrinth 失败（{exc}）")
        return None
    if isinstance(cached, dict) and version_supports(cached, loader, mc_version):
        return cached
    project_id = ""
    if isinstance(cached, dict):
        project_id = str(cached.get("project_id") or "")
        if not project_id:
            project_id = str(cached.get("projectId") or "")
    if not project_id:
        return None
    try:
        versions = fetch_mod_versions(project_id, loader, mc_version)
    except ModrinthError as exc:
        log(f"{mod.base_name}: 获取目标版本失败（{exc}）")
        return None
    if not versions:
        return None
    preferred = [version for version in versions if version_supports(version, loader, mc_version)]
    return preferred[0] if preferred else None


def run_migration(
    plan: MigrationPlan,
    *,
    match_mods: bool = True,
    copy_unmatched: bool = True,
    overwrite: bool = False,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    log_cb: LogCallback | None = None,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
    threads: int = 8,
) -> MigrationReport:
    progress = progress_cb or (lambda p, m: None)
    log = log_cb or (lambda m: None)
    report = MigrationReport(source_id=plan.source_id, target_id=plan.target_id)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- 复制目录
    tasks: list[tuple[Path, Path, str]] = []
    if not plan.same_dir:
        for key in plan.categories:
            if key in CATEGORY_DIRS:
                root = plan.source_dir / CATEGORY_DIRS[key]
                for source in _iter_files(root):
                    rel = source.relative_to(root)
                    tasks.append(
                        (source, plan.target_dir / CATEGORY_DIRS[key] / rel, key)
                    )
            elif key == "options":
                for name in OPTION_FILES:
                    source = plan.source_dir / name
                    if source.is_file():
                        tasks.append((source, plan.target_dir / name, key))

    log(
        f"迁移计划：{plan.source_id} → {plan.target_id or '（安装中）'}"
        f" · {plan.total_files} 个文件 · {plan.total_bytes / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB"
    )
    if plan.same_dir:
        log("源版本与目标版本共用同一个游戏目录，跳过内容复制，只处理 Mod 匹配。")
    if plan.total_files == 0:
        log("没有找到可迁移的内容。")

    total_tasks = max(1, len(tasks))
    for index, (source, target, category) in enumerate(tasks):
        _check_cancel(cancel_event)
        progress(
            int(index * 60 / total_tasks),
            f"正在迁移{CATEGORY_NAMES.get(category, category)} "
            f"{index + 1}/{len(tasks)}",
        )
        try:
            if target.exists() and not overwrite:
                report.skipped_files += 1
                continue
            report.copied_bytes += _copy_file(source, target)
            report.copied_files += 1
        except Exception as exc:
            report.warnings.append(f"{source.name}: 复制失败（{exc}）")
            log(f"复制失败：{source}（{exc}）")

    progress(60, "内容复制完成，正在处理 Mod…")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- 迁移 Mod
    target_mods = plan.target_dir / "mods"
    mod_total = max(1, len(plan.mods))
    loader_key = str(plan.target_loader or "").strip().lower()
    for index, mod in enumerate(plan.mods):
        _check_cancel(cancel_event)
        percent = 60 + int(index * 36 / mod_total)
        progress(percent, f"正在处理 Mod {index + 1}/{len(plan.mods)} · {mod.base_name}")
        target = target_mods / mod.target_name
        base_target = target_mods / mod.base_name
        if target.exists() and not overwrite:
            report.skipped_mods += 1
            continue
        if mod.disabled and base_target.exists() and not target.exists():
            # 目标里已有同名启用文件，不再额外放一个禁用副本。
            report.skipped_mods += 1
            log(f"{mod.base_name}: 目标已有启用版本，跳过禁用副本")
            continue

        matched: dict | None = None
        if match_mods:
            matched = _find_compatible_mod(mod, loader_key, plan.target_mc, log)

        if matched is not None:
            try:
                log(f"{mod.base_name}: 匹配到 Modrinth 目标版本")
                downloaded = download_mod_file(
                    matched,
                    target_mods,
                    progress_cb=lambda p, m, i=index: progress(
                        60 + int((i + p / 100.0) * 36 / mod_total), m
                    ),
                    cancel_event=cancel_event,
                    threads=threads,
                )
                final = target
                if mod.disabled:
                    final = target_mods / (downloaded.name + ".disabled")
                if downloaded != final:
                    if final.exists() and not overwrite:
                        report.skipped_mods += 1
                    else:
                        downloaded.replace(final)
                report.matched_mods += 1
                report.copied_mods += 1
                continue
            except MigrationCancelled:
                raise
            except Exception as exc:
                message = f"{mod.base_name}: 下载匹配版本失败（{exc}）"
                report.warnings.append(message)
                log(message)

        if copy_unmatched:
            try:
                size = _copy_mod(mod, target)
                report.copied_mods += 1
                report.copied_bytes += size
                reason = (
                    "未匹配到目标加载器/MC 版本"
                    if match_mods
                    else "未开启 Mod 匹配"
                )
                message = f"{mod.base_name}: {reason}，已保留原文件（可能不兼容）"
                report.warnings.append(message)
                log(message)
            except Exception as exc:
                report.warnings.append(f"{mod.base_name}: 复制失败（{exc}）")
                log(f"Mod 复制失败：{mod.base_name}（{exc}）")
        else:
            report.skipped_mods += 1
            message = f"{mod.base_name}: 未匹配到目标版本，已跳过"
            report.warnings.append(message)
            log(message)

    progress(100, "迁移完成")
    log(report.summary())
    return report

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import threading
import zipfile
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Callable
from urllib.parse import urljoin

from .config import APP_DIR, DEFAULT_UPDATE_URL
from .downloader import DownloadCancelled, download_to_file
from .pet import is_newer
from .updater import fetch_manifest, sha256_file
from .zip_extract import ExtractJob, extract_zip_entries

AGENT_NAME = "Darkitten Mod Agent"
AGENT_ID = "DarkittenModAgent"
AGENT_EXE = "DarkittenModAgent.exe"
AGENT_MANIFEST_NAME = "mod_agent_release.json"
AGENT_STATE_FILE = "state.json"
MAX_AGENT_ARCHIVE_BYTES = 256 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_AGENT_UNPACKED_BYTES = 512 * 1024 * 1024

ProgressCallback = Callable[[int, str], None]


class ModAgentError(Exception):
    pass


@dataclass
class ModAgentRelease:
    version: str
    name: str = AGENT_NAME
    download_url: str = ""
    sha256: str = ""
    size: int = 0
    released: str = ""
    notes: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)


def mod_agent_root() -> Path:
    return Path(APP_DIR) / "mod_agent"


def mod_agent_app_dir(root: Path | None = None) -> Path:
    return (Path(root) if root is not None else mod_agent_root()) / AGENT_ID


def mod_agent_exe_path(root: Path | None = None) -> Path:
    return mod_agent_app_dir(root) / AGENT_EXE


def mod_agent_state_path(root: Path | None = None) -> Path:
    return (Path(root) if root is not None else mod_agent_root()) / AGENT_STATE_FILE


def is_installed(root: Path | None = None) -> bool:
    return mod_agent_exe_path(root).is_file()


def _packed_version(app_dir: Path) -> str:
    """读取工坊包内自带的 version.json。

    state.json 只在启动器安装/更新时刷新；程序内更新或手动解压覆盖后，
    以包内版本文件为准，避免把已经更新的工坊识别成旧版本。
    """
    for path in (app_dir / "version.json", app_dir / "_internal" / "version.json"):
        try:
            data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            continue
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            value = str(data.get("version") or "").strip().lstrip("vV")
            if value:
                return value
    return ""


def _updated_version(app_dir: Path) -> str:
    """旧版本没有 version.json 时，从更新包反推当前实际版本。

    工坊在程序内更新后会把更新包留在 data/updates 里。用包里 exe 的
    原始大小和已安装 exe 对比，大小一致的才是真正装进去的那一版；
    还在等待应用的版本（存在 staging-<version> 目录）直接跳过。
    """
    try:
        size = (app_dir / AGENT_EXE).stat().st_size
    except OSError:
        return ""
    updates = app_dir / "data" / "updates"
    matches: list[tuple[float, str]] = []
    try:
        candidates = list(updates.glob(f"{AGENT_ID}-*.zip"))
    except OSError:
        return ""
    for path in candidates:
        version = path.stem[len(AGENT_ID) + 1 :]
        if not version or (updates / f"staging-{version}").exists():
            continue
        try:
            with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
                packed_size = archive.getinfo(AGENT_EXE).file_size
            mtime = path.stat().st_mtime
        except (OSError, KeyError, zipfile.BadZipFile):
            continue
        if packed_size == size:
            matches.append((mtime, version))
    if not matches:
        return ""
    return max(matches)[1]


def installed_info(root: Path | None = None) -> dict:
    try:
        data = json.loads(mod_agent_state_path(root).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        data = {}
    info = data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}
    app_dir = mod_agent_app_dir(root)
    packed = _packed_version(app_dir) or _updated_version(app_dir)
    if packed:
        info["version"] = packed
    return info


def installed_version(root: Path | None = None) -> str:
    return str(installed_info(root).get("version") or "")


def manifest_url(update_url: str = DEFAULT_UPDATE_URL) -> str:
    base = str(update_url or "").strip() or DEFAULT_UPDATE_URL
    if base.rsplit("/", 1)[-1].lower().endswith(".json"):
        return urljoin(base, AGENT_MANIFEST_NAME)
    return base.rstrip("/") + "/" + AGENT_MANIFEST_NAME


def _normalize_notes(value) -> list[str]:
    if isinstance(value, str):
        raw = str(value).splitlines()
    elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        raw = [str(item) for item in value]
    else:
        return []
    notes: list[str] = []
    for line in raw:
        text = str(line).strip().lstrip("-*•").strip()
        if text:
            notes.append(text)
    return notes[:20]


def parse_mod_agent_release(
    manifest: dict, base_url: str = DEFAULT_UPDATE_URL
) -> ModAgentRelease | None:
    data = manifest if isinstance(manifest, dict) else None
    if not data:
        return None
    version = str(data.get("version") or "").strip().lstrip("vV")
    if not version:
        return None
    download_url = str(data.get("download_url") or data.get("url") or "").strip()
    if download_url:
        download_url = urljoin(base_url, download_url)
    digest = str(data.get("sha256") or "").strip().lower()
    try:
        size = int(data.get("size") or 0)
    except Exception:
        size = 0
    return ModAgentRelease(
        version=version,
        name=str(data.get("name") or AGENT_NAME),
        download_url=download_url,
        sha256=digest,
        size=max(0, size),
        released=str(data.get("released") or ""),
        notes=_normalize_notes(data.get("notes")),
    )


def fetch_mod_agent_release(url: str = DEFAULT_UPDATE_URL) -> ModAgentRelease | None:
    target = manifest_url(url)
    return parse_mod_agent_release(fetch_manifest(target), target)


def archive_path(
    release: ModAgentRelease, root: Path | None = None
) -> Path:
    folder = (Path(root) if root is not None else mod_agent_root()) / "downloads"
    return folder / f"{AGENT_ID}-{release.version}.zip"


def _emit(progress: ProgressCallback | None, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
    if progress is not None:
        progress(max(0, min(100, int(percent))), str(message))


def download_mod_agent(
    release: ModAgentRelease,
    root: Path | None = None,
    *,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
    threads: int = 4,
) -> Path:
    if not release.download_url:
        raise ModAgentError("发布清单里没有模组工坊下载地址")
    if not release.sha256:
        raise ModAgentError("发布清单里没有模组工坊 SHA-256，已停止下载以保护安全")
    cancel_event = cancel_event or threading.Event()
    dest = archive_path(release, root)
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    if dest.exists():
        try:
            if sha256_file(dest, cancel_event).lower() == release.sha256.lower():
                _emit(progress_cb, 100, "模组工坊安装包已下载")
                return dest
        except DownloadCancelled:
            raise
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            dest.unlink()
        except OSError:
            pass

    def on_bytes(done: int, total: int) -> None:
        total = int(total or release.size or 0)
        if total:
            percent = max(1, min(99, int(done * 100 / total)))
            _emit(
                progress_cb,
                percent,
                f"{done / 1024 / 1024:.1f}/{total / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB",
            )
        else:
            _emit(progress_cb, 50, f"已下载 {done / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB")

    _emit(progress_cb, 1, f"正在下载模组工坊 {release.version}…")
    try:
        download_to_file(
            release.download_url,
            dest,
            size=release.size,
            cancel_event=cancel_event,
            progress_cb=on_bytes,
            connections=max(2, min(6, int(threads))),
        )
    except DownloadCancelled:
        raise
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ModAgentError(f"模组工坊下载失败：{exc}") from exc

    if dest.stat().st_size > MAX_AGENT_ARCHIVE_BYTES:
        try:
            dest.unlink()
        except OSError:
            pass
        raise ModAgentError("模组工坊安装包体积异常，已删除")
    digest = sha256_file(dest, cancel_event).lower()
    if digest != release.sha256.lower():
        try:
            dest.unlink()
        except OSError:
            pass
        raise ModAgentError("模组工坊安装包 SHA-256 校验失败，已删除损坏文件")
    _emit(progress_cb, 100, "模组工坊安装包下载完成")
    return dest


def _plan_jobs(
    archive: Path, staging: Path, cancel_event: threading.Event | None
) -> tuple[list[ExtractJob], int]:
    jobs: list[ExtractJob] = []
    total = 0
    root = staging.resolve()
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as zf:
            for info in zf.infolist():
                if cancel_event is not None and cancel_event.is_set():
                    raise DownloadCancelled()
                name = info.filename.replace("\\", "/")
                if not name or name.endswith("/"):
                    continue
                parts = [part for part in name.split("/") if part]
                if parts and parts[0].lower() == AGENT_ID.lower():
                    parts = parts[1:]
                if not parts:
                    continue
                relative = Path(*parts)
                if relative.is_absolute() or ".." in relative.parts:
                    raise ModAgentError("模组工坊安装包包含不安全的路径")
                destination = (staging / relative).resolve()
                if destination != root and root not in destination.parents:
                    raise ModAgentError("模组工坊安装包包含不安全的路径")
                total += max(0, int(info.file_size))
                if total > MAX_AGENT_UNPACKED_BYTES:
                    raise ModAgentError("模组工坊安装包解压后体积异常，已停止")
                jobs.append(
                    ExtractJob(
                        info=info,
                        destination=destination,
                        label=relative.name,
                        check_exists=False,
                    )
                )
    except (ModAgentError, DownloadCancelled):
        raise
    except zipfile.BadZipFile as exc:
        raise ModAgentError("模组工坊安装包不是有效的 ZIP 文件") from exc
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ModAgentError(f"读取模组工坊安装包失败：{exc}") from exc
    if not jobs:
        raise ModAgentError("模组工坊安装包是空的")
    return jobs, total


def _exe_locked(exe: Path) -> bool:
    """目标目录里的模组工坊正在运行时，Windows 会锁住 exe，无法替换。"""
    if not exe.is_file():
        return False
    try:
        with exe.open("r+b"):
            pass
    except OSError:
        return True
    return False


def install_mod_agent(
    archive: Path,
    version: str,
    root: Path | None = None,
    *,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
) -> Path:
    archive = Path(archive)
    if not archive.is_file():
        raise ModAgentError("模组工坊安装包不存在，请重新下载")
    base = Path(root) if root is not None else mod_agent_root()
    target = base / AGENT_ID
    staging = base / f".staging-{AGENT_ID}"
    backup = base / f".backup-{AGENT_ID}"
    if target.exists() and _exe_locked(target / AGENT_EXE):
        raise ModAgentError("模组工坊正在运行，请先关闭再更新")
    base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for leftover in (staging, backup):
        if leftover.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(leftover, ignore_errors=True)

    jobs, total = _plan_jobs(archive, staging, cancel_event)

    def on_extract(done_bytes: int, _done_files: int, label: str) -> None:
        percent = max(1, min(99, int(done_bytes * 100 / total))) if total else 50
        _emit(progress_cb, percent, f"正在解压 {label}…")

    _emit(progress_cb, 1, "正在安装模组工坊…")
    try:
        extract_zip_entries(
            archive,
            jobs,
            threads=4,
            overwrite=True,
            cancel_event=cancel_event,
            progress_cb=on_extract,
        )
    except DownloadCancelled:
        shutil.rmtree(staging, ignore_errors=True)
        raise
    except Exception as exc:
        shutil.rmtree(staging, ignore_errors=True)
        raise ModAgentError(f"解压模组工坊失败：{exc}") from exc

    if not (staging / AGENT_EXE).is_file():
        shutil.rmtree(staging, ignore_errors=True)
        raise ModAgentError("模组工坊安装包里没有找到 DarkittenModAgent.exe")

    moved_old = False
    if target.exists():
        old_data = target / "data"
        if old_data.is_dir():
            new_data = staging / "data"
            if new_data.exists():
                shutil.rmtree(new_data, ignore_errors=True)
            shutil.move(str(old_data), str(new_data))
        try:
            target.rename(backup)
            moved_old = True
        except Exception as exc:
            shutil.rmtree(staging, ignore_errors=True)
            raise ModAgentError(f"无法替换旧版模组工坊，可能仍有文件被占用：{exc}") from exc

    try:
        staging.rename(target)
    except Exception as exc:
        if moved_old and backup.exists() and not target.exists():
            try:
                backup.rename(target)
            except Exception:
                pass
        shutil.rmtree(staging, ignore_errors=True)
        raise ModAgentError(f"安装模组工坊失败：{exc}") from exc

    if moved_old:
        shutil.rmtree(backup, ignore_errors=True)

    state = {
        "version": str(version or ""),
        "installed_at": datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        "archive": archive.name,
        "size": archive.stat().st_size,
    }
    try:
        (base / AGENT_STATE_FILE).write_text(
            json.dumps(state, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
    except OSError:
        pass
    _emit(progress_cb, 100, "模组工坊安装完成")
    return target


def launch_mod_agent(root: Path | None = None) -> subprocess.Popen:
    exe = mod_agent_exe_path(root)
    if not exe.is_file():
        raise ModAgentError("模组工坊还没有安装")
    flags = 0
    if os.name == "nt":
        flags = getattr(subprocess, "DETACHED_PROCESS", 0) | getattr(
            subprocess, "CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP", 0
        )
    try:
        return subprocess.Popen(
            [str(exe)],
            cwd=str(exe.parent),
            creationflags=flags,
            close_fds=True,
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ModAgentError(f"无法启动模组工坊：{exc}") from exc


def open_mod_agent_folder(root: Path | None = None) -> None:
    folder = mod_agent_app_dir(root)
    if not folder.is_dir():
        raise ModAgentError("模组工坊还没有安装")
    if os.name == "nt":
        os.startfile(str(folder))
        return
    subprocess.Popen(["xdg-open", str(folder)])
