from __future__ import annotations

import re
import zipfile
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from .mods import jar_identity, list_mods, read_jar_declarations

PLATFORM_IDS = {
    "minecraft",
    "java",
    "fabricloader",
    "fabric-loader",
    "quilt_loader",
    "quilt-loader",
    "forge",
    "neoforge",
    "javafml",
    "lowcodefml",
    "mixinextras",
}

LOADER_FAMILIES = {
    "fabric": {"fabric"},
    "quilt": {"fabric", "quilt"},
    "forge": {"forge"},
    "neoforge": {"neoforge"},
}


@dataclass
class ModDependency:
    modid: str
    version_range: str = ""
    mandatory: bool = True
    side: str = ""
    reason: str = ""


@dataclass
class ModConflict:
    modid: str
    version_range: str = ""


@dataclass
class ModDescriptor:
    path: Path
    name: str
    modids: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    version: str = ""
    loader: str = ""
    loaders: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    dependencies: list[ModDependency] = field(default_factory=list)
    dependencies_by_loader: dict[str, list[ModDependency]] = field(
        default_factory=dict
    )
    conflicts: list[ModConflict] = field(default_factory=list)
    conflicts_by_loader: dict[str, list[ModConflict]] = field(
        default_factory=dict
    )
    nested_provides: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    valid: bool = True
    error: str = ""


@dataclass
class ModIssue:
    severity: str
    title: str
    message: str
    filename: str = ""
    related: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def badge(self) -> str:
        return {"error": "错误", "warning": "警告", "info": "提示"}.get(
            self.severity, "提示"
        )


def _clean(value: Any) -> str:
    text = str(value or "").strip()
    if text.startswith("${") or text.startswith("%"):
        return ""
    return text


def _dep_from_fabric(value: Any, modid: str) -> ModDependency:
    version_range = ""
    if isinstance(value, str):
        version_range = value
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        version_range = " || ".join(str(item) for item in value if item)
    elif isinstance(value, dict):
        version_range = _clean(value.get("version") or value.get("versions"))
    return ModDependency(modid=modid, version_range=version_range)


def _fabric_conflict(value: Any, modid: str) -> ModConflict:
    version_range = ""
    if isinstance(value, str):
        version_range = value
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        version_range = " || ".join(str(item) for item in value if item)
    elif isinstance(value, dict):
        version_range = _clean(value.get("version") or value.get("versions"))
    return ModConflict(modid=modid, version_range=version_range.strip())


def _parse_fabric(
    data: dict,
) -> tuple[list[str], list[ModDependency], list[ModConflict]]:
    modids = [_clean(data.get("id"))] if _clean(data.get("id")) else []
    provides = data.get("provides")
    if isinstance(provides, list):
        modids.extend(_clean(item) for item in provides if _clean(item))
    deps: list[ModDependency] = []
    depends = data.get("depends")
    if isinstance(depends, dict):
        for modid, value in depends.items():
            if _clean(modid).lower() in PLATFORM_IDS:
                continue
            deps.append(_dep_from_fabric(value, _clean(modid)))
    elif isinstance(depends, list):
        # Quilt 的 depends 是对象数组，而不是 Fabric 的字典。
        for item in depends:
            if not isinstance(item, dict):
                continue
            modid = _clean(item.get("id"))
            if not modid or modid.lower() in PLATFORM_IDS:
                continue
            deps.append(_dep_from_fabric(item, modid))
    conflicts: list[ModConflict] = []
    for key in ("breaks", "conflicts"):
        raw = data.get(key)
        if isinstance(raw, dict):
            for modid, value in raw.items():
                modid = _clean(modid)
                if not modid or modid.lower() in PLATFORM_IDS:
                    continue
                conflicts.append(_fabric_conflict(value, modid))
        elif isinstance(raw, list):
            for item in raw:
                if isinstance(item, dict):
                    modid = _clean(item.get("id") or item.get("modid"))
                    if not modid or modid.lower() in PLATFORM_IDS:
                        continue
                    conflicts.append(_fabric_conflict(item, modid))
                elif _clean(item):
                    conflicts.append(ModConflict(modid=_clean(item)))
    return modids, deps, conflicts


def _parse_forge(
    data: dict,
) -> tuple[list[str], list[ModDependency], list[ModConflict]]:
    modids: list[str] = []
    for mod in data.get("mods") or []:
        if isinstance(mod, dict) and _clean(mod.get("modId")):
            modids.append(_clean(mod.get("modId")))
    deps: list[ModDependency] = []
    conflicts: list[ModConflict] = []
    raw_deps = data.get("dependencies")
    if isinstance(raw_deps, dict):
        for _owner, items in raw_deps.items():
            if not isinstance(items, list):
                continue
            for item in items:
                if not isinstance(item, dict):
                    continue
                modid = _clean(item.get("modId"))
                if not modid or modid.lower() in PLATFORM_IDS:
                    continue
                dep_type = _clean(item.get("type")).lower()
                if dep_type == "incompatible":
                    conflicts.append(
                        ModConflict(
                            modid=modid,
                            version_range=_clean(
                                item.get("versionRange")
                                or item.get("version")
                            ),
                        )
                    )
                    continue
                if dep_type == "optional":
                    mandatory = False
                elif dep_type == "discouraged":
                    mandatory = False
                elif dep_type == "required":
                    mandatory = True
                else:
                    mandatory = item.get("mandatory", True)
                    if isinstance(mandatory, str):
                        mandatory = mandatory.strip().lower() != "false"
                deps.append(
                    ModDependency(
                        modid=modid,
                        version_range=_clean(
                            item.get("versionRange") or item.get("version")
                        ),
                        mandatory=bool(mandatory),
                        side=_clean(item.get("side")).upper(),
                        reason=_clean(item.get("ordering")),
                    )
                )
    return modids, deps, conflicts


def describe_mod(path: Path) -> ModDescriptor:
    path = Path(path)
    result = ModDescriptor(path=path, name=path.name)
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as zf:
            decl = read_jar_declarations(zf, with_nested_provides=True)
            if not decl.has_metadata:
                return result
            name, version, _description, _icon = jar_identity(decl)
            result.name = name or path.name
            result.version = version
            result.loaders = list(decl.loaders)
            if len(decl.loaders) > 1:
                result.loader = "多加载器"
            elif decl.loaders:
                result.loader = decl.loaders[0]

            groups = (
                ("fabric", decl.fabric),
                ("quilt", decl.quilt),
                ("neoforge", decl.neoforge),
                ("forge", decl.forge),
            )
            for key, entries in groups:
                for data in entries:
                    if key in ("fabric", "quilt"):
                        modids, deps, conflicts = _parse_fabric(data)
                    else:
                        modids, deps, conflicts = _parse_forge(data)
                    result.modids.extend(modids)
                    result.dependencies_by_loader.setdefault(key, []).extend(
                        deps
                    )
                    result.conflicts_by_loader.setdefault(key, []).extend(
                        conflicts
                    )

            result.modids = list(dict.fromkeys(result.modids))
            result.nested_provides = dict(decl.nested_provides)
            seen_deps: set[tuple[str, str, bool]] = set()
            for key, _entries in groups:
                for dep in result.dependencies_by_loader.get(key, []):
                    marker = (dep.modid.lower(), dep.version_range, dep.mandatory)
                    if marker in seen_deps:
                        continue
                    seen_deps.add(marker)
                    result.dependencies.append(dep)
            seen_conflicts: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
            for key, _entries in groups:
                for conflict in result.conflicts_by_loader.get(key, []):
                    marker = (conflict.modid.lower(), conflict.version_range)
                    if marker in seen_conflicts:
                        continue
                    seen_conflicts.add(marker)
                    result.conflicts.append(conflict)
    except (zipfile.BadZipFile, OSError, ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:
        result.valid = False
        result.error = str(exc)
    return result


def _numeric_core(value: str) -> str:
    text = str(value or "").strip().lstrip("vV=")
    match = re.match(r"(\d+(?:\.\d+)*)", text)
    return match.group(1) if match else text


def _version_parts(value: str) -> tuple[int, ...]:
    parts = re.findall(r"\d+", _numeric_core(value))
    return tuple(int(item) for item in parts[:4]) if parts else ()


def _compare_versions(left: str, right: str) -> int:
    a = _version_parts(left)
    b = _version_parts(right)
    length = max(len(a), len(b))
    a = a + (0,) * (length - len(a))
    b = b + (0,) * (length - len(b))
    return (a > b) - (a < b)


def _version_tokens(value: str) -> list[str]:
    text = str(value or "").strip().lower().lstrip("vV=")
    return [item for item in re.split(r"[.\-_+]", text) if item]


def _wildcard_match(version: str, pattern: str) -> bool | None:
    """匹配 0.8.x / 1.20.* 这类通配版本；不是通配模式时返回 None。"""
    parts = _version_tokens(pattern)
    if not any(item in ("x", "*") for item in parts):
        return None
    if not parts:
        return None
    version_parts = _version_tokens(version)
    if len(version_parts) < len(parts):
        version_parts += ["0"] * (len(parts) - len(version_parts))
    for expected, actual in zip(parts, version_parts):
        if expected in ("x", "*"):
            return True
        expected_num = re.match(r"\d+", expected)
        actual_num = re.match(r"\d+", actual)
        if expected_num and actual_num:
            if int(expected_num.group()) != int(actual_num.group()):
                return False
            continue
        if expected != actual:
            return False
    return len(version_parts) >= len(parts)


def _match_interval(version: str, chunk: str) -> bool:
    match = re.match(
        r"^([\[(])\s*([^,\])]*)\s*(?:,\s*([^,\])]*)\s*)?([\])])$",
        chunk,
    )
    if not match:
        return False
    left_bracket, low, high, right_bracket = match.groups()
    if high is None:
        # Maven 的 [1.2.3] 表示精确版本。
        if left_bracket != "[" or right_bracket != "]":
            return False
        return _compare_versions(version, low) == 0
    if low:
        cmp = _compare_versions(version, low)
        if cmp < 0 or (cmp == 0 and left_bracket == "("):
            return False
    if high:
        cmp = _compare_versions(version, high)
        if cmp > 0 or (cmp == 0 and right_bracket == ")"):
            return False
    return True


def _range_groups(text: str):
    """把「>=1.20 || [1.21,1.22)」拆成若干组，组内空格表示 AND。"""
    for raw in re.split(r"\s*\|\|\s*", text):
        raw = raw.strip()
        if not raw:
            continue
        if raw.startswith(("[", "(")):
            yield [raw]
            continue
        # 先合并「>= 1.20」这类运算符与值之间的空格，再按空格拆分条件。
        raw = re.sub(r"(>=|<=|>|<|=|~|\^|!=)\s+", r"\1", raw)
        tokens = [token for token in re.split(r"[\s,]+", raw) if token]
        if tokens:
            yield tokens


def _match_token(version: str, token: str) -> bool:
    token = token.strip()
    if not token or token == "*":
        return True
    if token.startswith(("[", "(")):
        return _match_interval(version, token)
    if token.startswith(("[", "(", "]")):
        return False

    wildcard = _wildcard_match(version, token)
    if wildcard is not None:
        return wildcard

    operator = ""
    for prefix in ("!=", ">=", "<=", ">", "<", "=", "~", "^"):
        if token.startswith(prefix):
            operator = prefix
            token = token[len(prefix) :].strip()
            break
    if not token:
        return True
    if token.endswith("+"):
        return _compare_versions(version, token[:-1]) >= 0

    cmp = _compare_versions(version, token)
    if operator in ("!=",):
        return cmp != 0
    if operator == ">=":
        return cmp >= 0
    if operator == ">":
        return cmp > 0
    if operator == "<=":
        return cmp <= 0
    if operator == "<":
        return cmp < 0
    if operator == "=":
        return cmp == 0 or _numeric_core(version) == _numeric_core(token)
    if operator == "~":
        target = _version_parts(token)
        actual = _version_parts(version)
        width = min(2, len(target))
        return cmp >= 0 and actual[:width] == target[:width]
    if operator == "^":
        target = _version_parts(token)
        actual = _version_parts(version)
        if not target or not actual or cmp < 0:
            return False
        if target[0] > 0:
            return actual[0] == target[0]
        if len(target) > 1 and target[1] > 0:
            return actual[:2] == target[:2]
        return actual[:3] == target[:3]
    actual_core = _numeric_core(version)
    token_core = _numeric_core(token)
    if actual_core == token_core:
        return True
    # 1.2 可以匹配 1.2.3，但不能把 1.20 当成 1.2 的前缀。
    return actual_core.startswith(token_core + ".")


def version_in_range(version: str, version_range: str) -> bool:
    """支持 Maven 区间、通配符和空格 AND；无法解析时放行，避免误报。"""
    text = str(version_range or "").strip()
    if not text or text in ("*", "any"):
        return True
    version = str(version or "").strip()
    if not version:
        return True
    for group in _range_groups(text):
        if all(_match_token(version, token) for token in group):
            return True
    return False


def _dependency_side_applies(side: str) -> bool:
    return str(side or "").upper() not in ("SERVER",)


def _metadata_keys(target_loader: str, available: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    wanted = str(target_loader or "").strip().lower()
    if wanted == "neoforge":
        return ["neoforge"] if "neoforge" in available else ["forge"]
    if wanted == "forge":
        return ["forge"]
    if wanted == "quilt":
        return ["quilt", "fabric"]
    if wanted == "fabric":
        return ["fabric"]
    return ["fabric", "quilt", "neoforge", "forge"]


def _owner_dependencies(
    owner: ModDescriptor, target_loader: str
) -> list[ModDependency]:
    if not owner.dependencies_by_loader:
        return owner.dependencies
    deps: list[ModDependency] = []
    for key in _metadata_keys(target_loader, owner.dependencies_by_loader):
        deps.extend(owner.dependencies_by_loader.get(key, []))
    return deps


def _owner_conflicts(
    owner: ModDescriptor, target_loader: str
) -> list[ModConflict]:
    if not owner.conflicts_by_loader:
        return owner.conflicts
    conflicts: list[ModConflict] = []
    for key in _metadata_keys(target_loader, owner.conflicts_by_loader):
        conflicts.extend(owner.conflicts_by_loader.get(key, []))
    return conflicts


def scan_mod_issues(
    mods_dir: Path,
    *,
    target_loader: str = "",
) -> tuple[list[ModIssue], list[ModDescriptor]]:
    mods_dir = Path(mods_dir)
    mods = list_mods(mods_dir)
    descriptors: list[ModDescriptor] = []
    for mod in mods:
        if not mod.enabled:
            continue
        descriptors.append(describe_mod(mod.path))

    issues: list[ModIssue] = []
    provided: dict[str, tuple[ModDescriptor, str]] = {}
    duplicates: dict[str, list[ModDescriptor]] = {}
    fabric_only: list[ModDescriptor] = []
    forge_only: list[ModDescriptor] = []

    for desc in descriptors:
        if not desc.valid:
            issues.append(
                ModIssue(
                    "warning",
                    "无法读取 Mod 元数据",
                    f"{desc.path.name} 不是有效的 JAR，或元数据已损坏：{desc.error}",
                    desc.path.name,
                )
            )
            continue
        families: set[str] = set()
        for loader in desc.loaders:
            if loader in ("Fabric", "Quilt"):
                families.add("fabric")
            elif loader in ("Forge", "NeoForge"):
                families.add("forge")
        if families == {"fabric"}:
            fabric_only.append(desc)
        elif families == {"forge"}:
            forge_only.append(desc)
        if not desc.modids:
            issues.append(
                ModIssue(
                    "warning",
                    "缺少 Mod ID",
                    "这个文件没有声明 modId，加载器可能无法识别它。",
                    desc.path.name,
                )
            )
        for modid in desc.modids:
            key = modid.lower()
            if key in provided:
                duplicates.setdefault(key, [provided[key][0]]).append(desc)
            else:
                provided[key] = (desc, desc.version)

    for desc in descriptors:
        if not desc.valid:
            continue
        for modid, version in desc.nested_provides.items():
            key = modid.lower()
            if key in provided:
                continue
            provided[key] = (desc, version)

    for modid, group in duplicates.items():
        names = "、".join(sorted({item.name for item in group}))
        issues.append(
            ModIssue(
                "error",
                "Mod ID 重复",
                f"modId「{modid}」被多个文件同时提供：{names}。"
                "游戏可能只加载其中一个，建议只保留一个版本。",
                group[-1].path.name,
                [item.path.name for item in group],
            )
        )

    if fabric_only and forge_only:
        counts: dict[str, int] = {}
        for desc in fabric_only + forge_only:
            label = desc.loaders[0]
            counts[label] = counts.get(label, 0) + 1
        summary = "、".join(
            f"{loader} {count} 个" for loader, count in counts.items()
        )
        issues.append(
            ModIssue(
                "error",
                "加载器混装",
                f"同一个 mods 文件夹里同时存在 {summary}。"
                "Fabric/Quilt 与 Forge/NeoForge 的 Mod 不能混用。",
            )
        )
    if target_loader:
        wanted = target_loader.strip().lower()
        compatible = LOADER_FAMILIES.get(wanted)
        mismatched: dict[str, list[ModDescriptor]] = {}
        if not compatible:
            # OptiFine / LiteLoader 等不是 Mod 加载器，不能把普通 Mod
            # 全部判成“加载器不匹配”。
            compatible = set()
        for desc in descriptors:
            if not compatible or not desc.valid or not desc.loaders:
                continue
            supported = {loader.lower() for loader in desc.loaders}
            if supported & compatible:
                continue
            mismatched.setdefault(desc.loaders[0], []).append(desc)
        for loader, items in mismatched.items():
            names = "、".join(item.name for item in items[:4])
            issues.append(
                ModIssue(
                    "error",
                    "加载器不匹配",
                    f"当前版本使用 {target_loader}，但这些 Mod 是 {loader} 的：{names}。",
                    items[0].path.name,
                    [item.path.name for item in items],
                )
            )

    for owner in descriptors:
        if not owner.valid:
            continue
        seen_deps: set[tuple[str, str, bool]] = set()
        for dep in _owner_dependencies(owner, target_loader):
            marker = (dep.modid.lower(), dep.version_range, dep.mandatory)
            if marker in seen_deps:
                continue
            seen_deps.add(marker)
            if not _dependency_side_applies(dep.side):
                continue
            key = dep.modid.lower()
            if key in PLATFORM_IDS:
                continue
            entry = provided.get(key)
            if entry is None:
                if dep.mandatory:
                    issues.append(
                        ModIssue(
                            "error",
                            "缺少必需前置",
                            f"{owner.name} 需要前置「{dep.modid}」"
                            f"{'（' + dep.version_range + '）' if dep.version_range else ''}，"
                            "但 mods 文件夹里没有找到。",
                            owner.path.name,
                        )
                    )
                continue
            provider, provider_version = entry
            if (
                dep.version_range
                and provider_version
                and not version_in_range(provider_version, dep.version_range)
            ):
                issues.append(
                    ModIssue(
                        "warning",
                        "前置版本不匹配",
                        f"{owner.name} 要求 {dep.modid} {dep.version_range}，"
                        f"当前安装的是 {provider_version}。",
                        owner.path.name,
                        [provider.path.name],
                    )
                )

        seen_conflicts: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
        for conflict in _owner_conflicts(owner, target_loader):
            key = str(conflict.modid or "").strip().lower()
            marker = (key, conflict.version_range)
            if not key or key in PLATFORM_IDS or marker in seen_conflicts:
                continue
            seen_conflicts.add(marker)
            entry = provided.get(key)
            if entry is None or entry[0] is owner:
                continue
            provider, provider_version = entry
            # 只在已安装版本落入声明的不兼容区间时提示，否则 Sodium
            # 对旧版 Iris / fabric-api 的 breaks 会被误报成当前冲突。
            if not version_in_range(provider_version, conflict.version_range):
                continue
            range_text = (
                f" {conflict.version_range}" if conflict.version_range else ""
            )
            current = f"（当前 {provider_version}）" if provider_version else ""
            issues.append(
                ModIssue(
                    "warning",
                    "声明了冲突",
                    f"{owner.name} 声明与「{conflict.modid}」{range_text} 冲突"
                    f"{current}，两个 Mod 目前同时启用。",
                    owner.path.name,
                    [provider.path.name],
                )
            )

    order = {"error": 0, "warning": 1, "info": 2}
    issues.sort(key=lambda item: (order.get(item.severity, 3), item.title))
    return issues, descriptors

# FILE: darkitten/mod_repair.py

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import re
import shutil
import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from .fsops import recycle_path
from .mod_conflicts import (
    LOADER_FAMILIES,
    PLATFORM_IDS,
    ModDescriptor,
    _owner_conflicts,
    _owner_dependencies,
    version_in_range,
)

BACKUP_DIR_NAME = ".dkl-mod-backups"
MANIFEST_NAME = "repair.json"
ACTIVE_STATES = ("pending", "launched", "verified", "failed", "partial")


class RepairError(RuntimeError):
    pass


@dataclass
class RepairAction:
    path: Path
    reason: str


@dataclass
class RepairPlan:
    mods_dir: Path
    actions: list[RepairAction] = field(default_factory=list)
    skipped: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def files(self) -> list[str]:
        return [item.path.name for item in self.actions]


@dataclass
class RepairFile:
    name: str
    backup_name: str
    size: int
    sha1: str
    reason: str


@dataclass
class RepairBackup:
    directory: Path
    mods_dir: Path
    created_at: str
    state: str = "pending"
    files: list[RepairFile] = field(default_factory=list)
    launched_at: str = ""
    finished_at: str = ""
    exit_code: int | None = None
    runtime_seconds: float | None = None
    note: str = ""

    @property
    def manifest_path(self) -> Path:
        return self.directory / MANIFEST_NAME


def _now() -> str:
    return datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds")


def _backup_root(mods_dir: Path) -> Path:
    return Path(mods_dir).parent / BACKUP_DIR_NAME


def _sha1(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha1()
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _write_manifest(backup: RepairBackup) -> None:
    data = {
        "version": 1,
        "mods_dir": str(backup.mods_dir),
        "created_at": backup.created_at,
        "state": backup.state,
        "launched_at": backup.launched_at,
        "finished_at": backup.finished_at,
        "exit_code": backup.exit_code,
        "runtime_seconds": backup.runtime_seconds,
        "note": backup.note,
        "files": [
            {
                "name": item.name,
                "backup_name": item.backup_name,
                "size": item.size,
                "sha1": item.sha1,
                "reason": item.reason,
            }
            for item in backup.files
        ],
    }
    backup.directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temp = backup.manifest_path.with_suffix(".tmp")
    temp.write_text(
        json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
    )
    temp.replace(backup.manifest_path)


def load_repair(backup_dir: Path) -> RepairBackup | None:
    backup_dir = Path(backup_dir)
    manifest = backup_dir / MANIFEST_NAME
    try:
        data = json.loads(manifest.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        files = [
            RepairFile(
                name=str(item.get("name") or ""),
                backup_name=str(item.get("backup_name") or ""),
                size=int(item.get("size") or 0),
                sha1=str(item.get("sha1") or ""),
                reason=str(item.get("reason") or ""),
            )
            for item in data.get("files") or []
            if isinstance(item, dict)
        ]
        return RepairBackup(
            directory=backup_dir,
            mods_dir=Path(str(data.get("mods_dir") or "")),
            created_at=str(data.get("created_at") or ""),
            state=str(data.get("state") or "pending"),
            files=files,
            launched_at=str(data.get("launched_at") or ""),
            finished_at=str(data.get("finished_at") or ""),
            exit_code=(
                int(data["exit_code"])
                if data.get("exit_code") is not None
                else None
            ),
            runtime_seconds=(
                float(data["runtime_seconds"])
                if data.get("runtime_seconds") is not None
                else None
            ),
            note=str(data.get("note") or ""),
        )
    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        return None


def latest_repair(mods_dir: Path) -> RepairBackup | None:
    mods_dir = Path(mods_dir)
    root = _backup_root(mods_dir)
    if not root.is_dir():
        return None
    target = mods_dir.resolve()
    found: list[RepairBackup] = []
    for child in root.iterdir():
        if not child.is_dir():
            continue
        backup = load_repair(child)
        if backup is None or backup.state not in ACTIVE_STATES:
            continue
        try:
            if backup.mods_dir.resolve() != target:
                continue
        except OSError:
            continue
        found.append(backup)
    if not found:
        return None
    found.sort(key=lambda item: item.created_at, reverse=True)
    return found[0]


def _version_key(desc: ModDescriptor, path: Path) -> tuple:
    parts = tuple(
        int(item) for item in re.findall(r"\d+", desc.version)[:4]
    )
    try:
        mtime = path.stat().st_mtime
    except OSError:
        mtime = 0.0
    return (parts, len(desc.modids), mtime)


def _loader_compatible(desc: ModDescriptor, compatible: set[str]) -> bool:
    supported = {item.lower() for item in desc.loaders}
    return bool(supported & compatible)


def _add_action(
    actions: dict[Path, RepairAction], path: Path, reason: str
) -> None:
    existing = actions.get(path)
    if existing is None:
        actions[path] = RepairAction(path=path, reason=reason)
    elif reason not in existing.reason:
        existing.reason = f"{existing.reason}；{reason}"


def build_repair_plan(
    mods_dir: Path,
    descriptors: list[ModDescriptor],
    target_loader: str = "",
) -> RepairPlan:
    """根据检查结果生成“移出文件”的修复计划，不执行任何写操作。"""
    mods_dir = Path(mods_dir)
    plan = RepairPlan(mods_dir=mods_dir)
    actions: dict[Path, RepairAction] = {}
    valid: list[ModDescriptor] = []

    for desc in descriptors:
        if not desc.path.exists():
            continue
        if not desc.valid:
            _add_action(actions, desc.path, "无法读取 Mod 元数据")
            continue
        valid.append(desc)

    wanted = target_loader.strip().lower()
    compatible = LOADER_FAMILIES.get(wanted)
    if compatible:
        for desc in valid:
            if desc.loaders and not _loader_compatible(desc, compatible):
                _add_action(
                    actions,
                    desc.path,
                    f"加载器不匹配：当前 {target_loader}，文件是 {desc.loader or '未知'}",
                )
    else:
        if not wanted:
            families = {
                "fabric"
                for desc in valid
                if any(item in ("Fabric", "Quilt") for item in desc.loaders)
            }
            if families and any(
                item in ("Forge", "NeoForge")
                for desc in valid
                for item in desc.loaders
            ):
                plan.skipped.append(
                    "同时存在 Fabric 与 Forge 系 Mod，但当前版本没有识别到加载器，"
                    "无法判断该保留哪一边；请先在加载器页面完成配置。"
                )

    remaining = [item for item in valid if item.path not in actions]

    # 重复 modId：保留版本号最高（同版本则文件更新）的一个。
    provider_files: dict[str, list[ModDescriptor]] = {}
    for desc in remaining:
        for modid in desc.modids:
            provider_files.setdefault(modid.lower(), []).append(desc)
    keepers: dict[str, ModDescriptor] = {}
    duplicates = {
        modid: group
        for modid, group in provider_files.items()
        if len(group) > 1
    }
    for modid, group in duplicates.items():
        keeper = max(group, key=lambda item: _version_key(item, item.path))
        keepers[modid] = keeper
        for desc in group:
            if desc is keeper:
                continue
            _add_action(
                actions,
                desc.path,
                f"重复提供 modId「{modid}」，保留 {keeper.path.name}",
            )

    # 如果某个文件被判定移出，却是另一组重复 ID 的保留项，就不动它，
    # 避免修好一个冲突又拆掉另一个。
    marked = set(actions)
    protected: set[Path] = set()
    for desc in remaining:
        if desc.path not in marked:
            continue
        if any(
            keepers.get(modid.lower()) is desc for modid in desc.modids
        ):
            protected.add(desc.path)
    for path in protected:
        actions.pop(path, None)
        plan.skipped.append(
            f"{path.name} 同时参与多组重复 modId，自动处理可能破坏另一组，"
            "已跳过；请在列表里手动选择保留版本。"
        )

    remaining = [item for item in valid if item.path not in actions]

    # 重建“谁提供了什么”，并记录哪些文件被别的 Mod 强制依赖。
    provided: dict[str, tuple[ModDescriptor, str]] = {}
    for desc in remaining:
        for modid in desc.modids:
            provided.setdefault(modid.lower(), (desc, desc.version))
    for desc in remaining:
        for modid, version in desc.nested_provides.items():
            provided.setdefault(modid.lower(), (desc, version))
    required_by: dict[str, set[Path]] = {}
    for desc in remaining:
        for dep in _owner_dependencies(desc, target_loader):
            if not dep.mandatory:
                continue
            key = dep.modid.lower()
            if key in PLATFORM_IDS:
                continue
            required_by.setdefault(key, set()).add(desc.path)

    def needed(desc: ModDescriptor) -> bool:
        keys = [item.lower() for item in desc.modids]
        keys.extend(item.lower() for item in desc.nested_provides)
        return any(
            required_by.get(key, set()) - {desc.path} for key in keys
        )

    seen_pairs: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
    for owner in remaining:
        for conflict in _owner_conflicts(owner, target_loader):
            key = str(conflict.modid or "").strip().lower()
            if not key or key in PLATFORM_IDS:
                continue
            entry = provided.get(key)
            if entry is None or entry[0] is owner:
                continue
            provider, provider_version = entry
            if not version_in_range(provider_version, conflict.version_range):
                continue
            pair = (owner.path.name.lower(), provider.path.name.lower())
            if pair in seen_pairs or (pair[1], pair[0]) in seen_pairs:
                continue
            seen_pairs.add(pair)
            range_text = (
                f" {conflict.version_range}" if conflict.version_range else ""
            )
            if needed(provider) and needed(owner):
                plan.skipped.append(
                    f"{owner.name} 与 {provider.name} 互相被其他 Mod 依赖，"
                    f"冲突「{conflict.modid}」{range_text} 需要手动取舍。"
                )
                continue
            target = owner if needed(provider) else provider
            other = provider if target is owner else owner
            _add_action(
                actions,
                target.path,
                f"解决冲突：{owner.name} 声明与「{conflict.modid}」"
                f"{range_text} 不兼容，移出 {target.path.name}（保留 {other.name}）",
            )

    # 缺前置 / 前置版本不符无法靠“移出文件”解决，明确告诉用户。
    for desc in remaining:
        for dep in _owner_dependencies(desc, target_loader):
            if not dep.mandatory or dep.modid.lower() in PLATFORM_IDS:
                continue
            entry = provided.get(dep.modid.lower())
            if entry is None:
                plan.skipped.append(
                    f"{desc.name} 缺少前置「{dep.modid}」，需要下载安装，"
                    "不能通过移出文件解决。"
                )
                continue
            provider, provider_version = entry
            if (
                dep.version_range
                and provider_version
                and not version_in_range(provider_version, dep.version_range)
            ):
                plan.skipped.append(
                    f"{desc.name} 要求 {dep.modid} {dep.version_range}，"
                    f"当前是 {provider_version}；请更新前置而不是移出文件。"
                )

    plan.actions = list(actions.values())
    plan.actions.sort(key=lambda item: item.path.name.lower())
    return plan


def apply_repair(mods_dir: Path, actions: list[RepairAction]) -> RepairBackup:
    mods_dir = Path(mods_dir)
    actions = [item for item in actions if item.path.exists()]
    if not actions:
        raise RepairError("没有可以自动修复的文件")

    root = _backup_root(mods_dir)
    stamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
    backup_dir = root / f"{stamp}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}"
    backup = RepairBackup(
        directory=backup_dir,
        mods_dir=mods_dir,
        created_at=_now(),
    )
    moved: list[tuple[Path, Path]] = []
    try:
        backup_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
        used_names: set[str] = set()
        for action in actions:
            source = action.path
            try:
                source.resolve().relative_to(mods_dir.resolve())
            except (OSError, ValueError):
                continue
            name = source.name
            backup_name = name
            counter = 1
            while backup_name.lower() in used_names:
                backup_name = f"{source.stem}-{counter}{source.suffix}"
                counter += 1
            used_names.add(backup_name.lower())
            size = source.stat().st_size
            sha1 = _sha1(source)
            destination = backup_dir / backup_name
            shutil.move(str(source), str(destination))
            moved.append((source, destination))
            backup.files.append(
                RepairFile(
                    name=name,
                    backup_name=backup_name,
                    size=size,
                    sha1=sha1,
                    reason=action.reason,
                )
            )
        if not backup.files:
            raise RepairError("没有文件被移入备份")
        backup.state = "pending"
        _write_manifest(backup)
        return backup
    except Exception:
        for source, destination in reversed(moved):
            try:
                if destination.exists() and not source.exists():
                    shutil.move(str(destination), str(source))
            except OSError:
                pass
        try:
            if backup_dir.exists():
                shutil.rmtree(backup_dir)
        except OSError:
            pass
        raise


def restore_repair(
    backup: RepairBackup,
) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    """把备份文件移回 mods 目录；遇到同名文件绝不覆盖。"""
    restored: list[str] = []
    conflicts: list[str] = []
    backup_root = backup.directory.resolve()
    mods_root = backup.mods_dir.resolve()
    for item in backup.files:
        source = backup.directory / item.backup_name
        target = backup.mods_dir / item.name
        try:
            if source.resolve().parent != backup_root:
                continue
            if target.resolve().parent != mods_root:
                continue
        except OSError:
            continue
        if not source.exists():
            continue
        if target.exists():
            conflicts.append(item.name)
            continue
        try:
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.move(str(source), str(target))
            restored.append(item.name)
        except OSError:
            conflicts.append(item.name)
    if conflicts:
        backup.state = "partial"
        backup.note = "以下文件因同名而未还原：" + "、".join(conflicts)
    else:
        backup.state = "restored"
        backup.note = ""
    try:
        _write_manifest(backup)
    except OSError:
        pass
    return restored, conflicts


def mark_repair_launched(mods_dir: Path) -> None:
    backup = latest_repair(mods_dir)
    if backup is None or backup.state == "verified":
        return
    backup.state = "launched"
    backup.launched_at = _now()
    try:
        _write_manifest(backup)
    except OSError:
        pass


def mark_repair_finished(
    mods_dir: Path, exit_code: int, runtime_seconds: float
) -> None:
    backup = latest_repair(mods_dir)
    if backup is None or backup.state not in ("pending", "launched", "failed"):
        return
    backup.finished_at = _now()
    backup.exit_code = int(exit_code)
    backup.runtime_seconds = round(float(runtime_seconds), 1)
    if exit_code != 0:
        backup.state = "failed"
        backup.note = "上次启动异常退出，建议还原备份后排查。"
    elif runtime_seconds >= 20:
        backup.state = "verified"
        backup.note = "游戏已正常运行，备份可以删除了。"
    else:
        backup.state = "launched"
        backup.note = "这次运行时间较短，请再启动一次确认。"
    try:
        _write_manifest(backup)
    except OSError:
        pass


def delete_repair_backup(
    backup: RepairBackup, recycle=recycle_path
) -> None:
    if backup.state != "verified":
        raise RepairError("请先启动一次游戏，确认没有问题后再删除备份")
    if not backup.directory.exists():
        return
    recycle(backup.directory)

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import shutil
import threading
import time
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable

from . import curseforge as cf
from . import modrinth
from .mods import ModInfo, forget_mod_meta, load_mod_meta, remember_downloaded_mod

ProgressCallback = Callable[[int, str], None]


class ModUpdateError(Exception):
    pass


@dataclass
class ModUpdate:
    mod: ModInfo
    version: dict[str, Any]
    source: str
    version_label: str
    file_name: str
    size: int = 0
    sha1: str = ""
    page_url: str = ""
    dependencies: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    content_type: str = "mod"

    @property
    def source_label(self) -> str:
        return "CurseForge" if self.source == "curseforge" else "Modrinth"

    @property
    def size_text(self) -> str:
        if self.size >= 1024 * 1024:
            return f"{self.size / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB"
        if self.size >= 1024:
            return f"{self.size / 1024:.0f} KB"
        return f"{self.size} B" if self.size else "大小未知"


def file_sha1(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha1()
    try:
        with Path(path).open("rb") as fp:
            while True:
                chunk = fp.read(1024 * 1024)
                if not chunk:
                    break
                digest.update(chunk)
    except OSError:
        return ""
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _hash_of_file(version: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    file = modrinth.primary_file(version) or {}
    hashes = file.get("hashes") if isinstance(file.get("hashes"), dict) else {}
    return {
        "filename": Path(str(file.get("filename") or "")).name,
        "size": int(file.get("size") or 0),
        "sha1": str(hashes.get("sha1") or "").lower(),
    }


def _source_for(mod: ModInfo, meta: dict) -> str:
    source = str(meta.get("source") or mod.source or "").strip().lower()
    if source in ("modrinth", "curseforge"):
        return source
    url = str(meta.get("project_url") or mod.project_url or "").lower()
    if "curseforge.com" in url:
        return "curseforge"
    if "modrinth.com" in url:
        return "modrinth"
    return ""


def _version_id(meta: dict, mod: ModInfo) -> str:
    return str(
        meta.get("file_id")
        or meta.get("version_id")
        or mod.file_id
        or mod.version_id
        or ""
    )


def _installed_sha1(mod: ModInfo, meta: dict) -> str:
    return str(meta.get("sha1") or mod.sha1 or "") or file_sha1(mod.path)


def _resolved_loader(mod: ModInfo, loader: str) -> str:
    return str(loader or mod.loader or "").strip()


def check_mod_update(
    mod: ModInfo,
    game_version: str = "",
    loader: str = "",
    content_type: str = "mod",
) -> ModUpdate | None:
    """检查单个 Mod/插件是否有适配当前游戏版本与平台的新文件。"""
    kind = str(content_type or "mod").strip().lower()
    if kind not in ("mod", "plugin"):
        kind = "mod"
    meta = load_mod_meta(mod.path.parent, mod.path.name)
    source = _source_for(mod, meta)
    project_id = str(meta.get("project_id") or mod.project_id or "").strip()
    installed_sha1 = _installed_sha1(mod, meta)
    current_id = _version_id(meta, mod)
    target_loader = _resolved_loader(mod, loader)

    if not source and installed_sha1:
        looked_up = modrinth.lookup_version_by_hash(installed_sha1)
        if looked_up:
            source = "modrinth"
            project_id = str(looked_up.get("project_id") or "")
            current_id = current_id or str(looked_up.get("id") or "")

    if not project_id:
        return None

    if source == "curseforge":
        versions = cf.fetch_mod_versions(
            project_id,
            target_loader,
            game_version,
            content_type=kind,
        )
        if not versions:
            return None
        latest = versions[0]
        latest_file = _hash_of_file(latest)
        latest_id = str(latest.get("id") or "")
        if current_id and latest_id and current_id == latest_id:
            return None
        if installed_sha1 and latest_file["sha1"]:
            if installed_sha1.lower() == latest_file["sha1"]:
                return None
        if (
            not current_id
            and latest_file["filename"] == mod.filename
            and latest_file["size"] == mod.size
        ):
            return None
        return ModUpdate(
            mod=mod,
            version=latest,
            source="curseforge",
            version_label=str(latest.get("version_number") or latest_id or "新版本"),
            file_name=latest_file["filename"],
            size=latest_file["size"],
            sha1=latest_file["sha1"],
            page_url=str(latest.get("page_url") or mod.project_url),
            dependencies=modrinth.required_dependencies(latest),
            content_type=kind,
        )

    if kind == "plugin":
        # 插件项目在 Modrinth 使用 paper/spigot/bukkit 加载器，按平台展开。
        versions = modrinth.fetch_server_addon_versions(
            project_id,
            target_loader or "paper",
            game_version,
        )
    else:
        versions = modrinth.fetch_mod_versions(
            project_id,
            target_loader,
            game_version,
            content_type="mod",
        )
    if not versions:
        return None
    latest = versions[0]
    latest_file = _hash_of_file(latest)
    latest_id = str(latest.get("id") or "")
    if current_id and latest_id and current_id == latest_id:
        return None
    if installed_sha1 and latest_file["sha1"]:
        if installed_sha1.lower() == latest_file["sha1"]:
            return None
    if (
        not current_id
        and latest_file["filename"] == mod.filename
        and latest_file["size"] == mod.size
    ):
        return None
    slug = str(meta.get("slug") or "")
    page_url = str(latest.get("page_url") or "")
    if not page_url and latest_id:
        category = "plugin" if kind == "plugin" else "mod"
        page_url = (
            f"https://modrinth.com/{category}/{slug or project_id}"
            f"/version/{latest_id}"
        )
    return ModUpdate(
        mod=mod,
        version=latest,
        source="modrinth",
        version_label=str(
            latest.get("version_number")
            or latest.get("name")
            or latest_id
            or "新版本"
        ),
        file_name=latest_file["filename"],
        size=latest_file["size"],
        sha1=latest_file["sha1"],
        page_url=page_url or mod.project_url,
        dependencies=modrinth.required_dependencies(latest),
        content_type=kind,
    )


def check_mod_updates(
    mods: list[ModInfo],
    game_version: str = "",
    loader: str = "",
    *,
    content_type: str = "mod",
    max_workers: int = 4,
    progress_cb: Callable[[int, int, str], None] | None = None,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[ModUpdate], list[str]]:
    """并发检查一组 Mod/插件；单个失败不会影响其他结果。"""
    cancel = cancel_event or threading.Event()
    updates: list[ModUpdate] = []
    errors: list[str] = []
    total = len(mods)
    if not total:
        return updates, errors
    done = 0
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max(1, min(8, int(max_workers)))) as pool:
        futures = {
            pool.submit(
                check_mod_update, mod, game_version, loader, content_type
            ): mod
            for mod in mods
        }
        for future in as_completed(futures):
            if cancel.is_set():
                break
            mod = futures[future]
            done += 1
            try:
                update = future.result()
            except Exception as exc:
                errors.append(f"{mod.name}：{exc}")
            else:
                if update is not None:
                    updates.append(update)
            if progress_cb:
                progress_cb(done, total, mod.name)
    updates.sort(key=lambda item: item.mod.name.lower())
    return updates, errors


def _backup_file(path: Path, backup_root: Path) -> Path:
    backup_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target = backup_root / path.name
    index = 2
    while target.exists():
        target = backup_root / f"{path.stem}-{index}{path.suffix}"
        index += 1
    shutil.move(str(path), str(target))
    return target


def apply_mod_update(
    update: ModUpdate,
    mods_dir: Path,
    *,
    threads: int = 8,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
) -> Path:
    """下载新版本并替换旧文件；旧文件保存在 .dkl-meta/backups 中。"""
    mods_dir = Path(mods_dir)
    mods_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    progress = progress_cb or (lambda p, m: None)
    cancel = cancel_event or threading.Event()
    stamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
    temp_dir = mods_dir / ".dkl-updates" / f"{stamp}-{time.time_ns() % 1000000}"
    temp_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    downloaded: Path | None = None
    old_path = Path(update.mod.path)
    target_path: Path | None = None
    backup_old: Path | None = None
    backup_target: Path | None = None
    try:
        downloader = (
            cf.download_mod_file
            if update.source == "curseforge"
            else modrinth.download_mod_file
        )
        downloaded = downloader(
            update.version,
            temp_dir,
            progress_cb=progress,
            cancel_event=cancel,
            threads=threads,
        )
        if not downloaded.is_file() or downloaded.stat().st_size <= 0:
            raise ModUpdateError("新版本下载失败，没有拿到有效文件")
        expected_sha1 = str(update.sha1 or "").lower()
        if expected_sha1 and file_sha1(downloaded).lower() != expected_sha1:
            raise ModUpdateError("新版本文件校验失败，已保留旧文件")
        if cancel.is_set():
            raise ModUpdateError("更新已取消")

        suffix = ".disabled" if not update.mod.enabled else ""
        target_path = mods_dir / (downloaded.name + suffix)
        backup_root = mods_dir / ".dkl-meta" / "backups" / "mods" / stamp
        if old_path.exists():
            backup_old = _backup_file(old_path, backup_root)
        if target_path.exists() and target_path != old_path:
            backup_target = _backup_file(target_path, backup_root)
        if target_path.exists():
            # 旧文件与目标同名且已被备份时，理论上不会走到这里；兜底清理空壳。
            target_path.unlink()

        shutil.move(str(downloaded), str(target_path))
        meta = load_mod_meta(mods_dir, update.mod.filename)
        meta.update(
            {
                "title": update.mod.name,
                "project_id": str(
                    meta.get("project_id")
                    or update.mod.project_id
                    or update.version.get("project_id")
                    or ""
                ),
                "source": update.source,
                "source_label": update.source_label,
                "version_id": str(update.version.get("id") or ""),
                "file_id": str(update.version.get("id") or ""),
                "file_name": downloaded.name,
                "sha1": update.sha1,
                "content_type": str(update.content_type or "mod"),
                "project_url": str(
                    update.page_url or meta.get("project_url") or update.mod.project_url
                ),
            }
        )
        if target_path.name != update.mod.filename:
            forget_mod_meta(mods_dir, update.mod.filename)
        remember_downloaded_mod(mods_dir, target_path, meta)
        progress(100, f"{update.mod.name} 已更新")
        return target_path
    except Exception:
        if target_path is not None and target_path.exists() and backup_old is not None:
            try:
                target_path.unlink()
            except OSError:
                pass
        if backup_old is not None and backup_old.exists() and not old_path.exists():
            try:
                shutil.move(str(backup_old), str(old_path))
            except OSError:
                pass
        if (
            backup_target is not None
            and backup_target.exists()
            and target_path is not None
            and not target_path.exists()
        ):
            try:
                shutil.move(str(backup_target), str(target_path))
            except OSError:
                pass
        raise
    finally:
        try:
            shutil.rmtree(temp_dir, ignore_errors=True)
        except Exception:
            pass


def apply_mod_updates(
    updates: list[ModUpdate],
    mods_dir: Path,
    *,
    threads: int = 8,
    progress_cb: Callable[[int, str], None] | None = None,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[Path], list[str]]:
    """按顺序更新多个 Mod，返回成功文件与错误信息。"""
    cancel = cancel_event or threading.Event()
    done_paths: list[Path] = []
    errors: list[str] = []
    total = len(updates)
    for index, update in enumerate(updates):
        if cancel.is_set():
            errors.append("更新已取消")
            break
        def on_progress(percent: int, message: str, i=index) -> None:
            if progress_cb:
                overall = int((i + max(0, min(100, percent)) / 100) / max(1, total) * 100)
                progress_cb(
                    overall,
                    f"[{i + 1}/{total}] {message}",
                )

        try:
            path = apply_mod_update(
                update,
                mods_dir,
                threads=threads,
                progress_cb=on_progress,
                cancel_event=cancel,
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            errors.append(f"{update.mod.name}：{exc}")
        else:
            done_paths.append(path)
        if progress_cb:
            progress_cb(
                int((index + 1) * 100 / max(1, total)),
                f"已处理 {index + 1}/{total} 个 Mod",
            )
    return done_paths, errors

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import threading
import urllib.parse
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable

from .downloader import DownloadCancelled, download_to_file, http_open as _http_open

MODRINTH_API = "https://api.modrinth.com/v2"
ProgressCallback = Callable[[int, str], None]

LOADER_KEYS = {"Fabric": "fabric", "Forge": "forge", "NeoForge": "neoforge"}
PROJECT_TYPES = {"mod", "modpack", "resourcepack", "shader"}


class ModrinthError(Exception):
    pass


def _get_json(url: str, timeout: int = 30) -> Any:
    try:
        with _http_open(url, timeout=timeout) as resp:
            raw = resp.read()
        return json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ModrinthError(f"无法连接 Modrinth：{exc}") from exc


def _loader_key(loader: str) -> str:
    if not loader:
        return ""
    if loader in LOADER_KEYS:
        return LOADER_KEYS[loader]
    return loader.strip().lower()


def search_mods(
    query: str,
    *,
    loader: str = "",
    game_version: str = "",
    limit: int = 20,
    offset: int = 0,
    project_type: str = "mod",
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    kind = str(project_type or "mod").strip().lower()
    if kind not in PROJECT_TYPES:
        kind = "mod"
    facets: list[list[str]] = [[f"project_type:{kind}"]]
    # 只有 Mod 受加载器约束；材质、光影和整合包不按加载器过滤。
    key = _loader_key(loader) if kind == "mod" else ""
    if key:
        facets.append([f"categories:{key}"])
    if game_version:
        facets.append([f"versions:{game_version}"])
    params = {
        "query": query.strip(),
        "limit": max(1, min(50, int(limit))),
        "offset": max(0, int(offset)),
        "index": "relevance" if query.strip() else "downloads",
        "facets": json.dumps(facets, separators=(",", ":")),
    }
    url = f"{MODRINTH_API}/search?" + urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
    data = _get_json(url)
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise ModrinthError("Modrinth 返回了无法识别的数据")
    return data


def search_server_addons(
    query: str,
    *,
    server_type: str,
    game_version: str = "",
    limit: int = 20,
    offset: int = 0,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """搜索服务端插件（Paper/Spigot）或服务端 Mod。"""
    server = str(server_type or "").lower()
    if server in ("paper", "spigot"):
        facets: list[list[str]] = [
            ["project_type:plugin"],
            ["categories:paper", "categories:spigot", "categories:bukkit"],
        ]
    elif server in ("fabric", "forge", "neoforge"):
        facets = [
            ["project_type:mod"],
            [f"categories:{server}"],
            ["server_side:required", "server_side:optional"],
        ]
    else:
        raise ModrinthError("未知的服务端类型")
    if game_version:
        facets.append([f"versions:{game_version}"])
    params = {
        "query": query.strip(),
        "limit": max(1, min(50, int(limit))),
        "offset": max(0, int(offset)),
        "index": "relevance" if query.strip() else "downloads",
        "facets": json.dumps(facets, separators=(",", ":")),
    }
    url = f"{MODRINTH_API}/search?" + urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
    data = _get_json(url)
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise ModrinthError("Modrinth 返回了无法识别的数据")
    return data


def fetch_server_addon_versions(
    project_id: str,
    server_type: str,
    game_version: str = "",
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    server = str(server_type or "").lower()
    if server in ("paper", "spigot"):
        loaders = ["paper", "spigot", "bukkit"]
    elif server in ("fabric", "forge", "neoforge"):
        loaders = [server]
    else:
        raise ModrinthError("未知的服务端类型")
    params: dict[str, str] = {"loaders": json.dumps(loaders)}
    if game_version:
        params["game_versions"] = json.dumps([game_version])
    url = f"{MODRINTH_API}/project/{project_id}/version?" + urllib.parse.urlencode(
        params
    )
    data = _get_json(url)
    if not isinstance(data, list):
        raise ModrinthError("Modrinth 版本列表格式不正确")
    result = []
    for entry in data:
        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
            continue
        files = entry.get("files") or []
        if not isinstance(files, list) or not files:
            continue
        if not any(isinstance(f, dict) and f.get("url") for f in files):
            continue
        result.append(entry)
    return result


def fetch_projects(project_ids: list[str]) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    """批量读取项目摘要，用于前置 Mod 按钮显示名称和图标。"""
    ids = list(dict.fromkeys(str(item).strip() for item in project_ids if str(item).strip()))
    if not ids:
        return {}
    params = {"ids": json.dumps(ids, separators=(",", ":"))}
    url = f"{MODRINTH_API}/projects?" + urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
    data = _get_json(url)
    if not isinstance(data, list):
        raise ModrinthError("Modrinth 返回的项目列表无法识别")
    result: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for item in data:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        for key in (item.get("id"), item.get("slug")):
            if key:
                result[str(key)] = item
    return result


def fetch_project(project_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """读取 Modrinth 项目详情（图标、画廊、统计、链接和正文）。"""
    project_id = (project_id or "").strip()
    if not project_id:
        raise ModrinthError("缺少 Mod 项目 ID")
    url = f"{MODRINTH_API}/project/{urllib.parse.quote(project_id, safe='')}"
    data = _get_json(url)
    if not isinstance(data, dict) or not data.get("id"):
        raise ModrinthError("Modrinth 返回的项目详情无法识别")
    gallery = []
    for item in data.get("gallery") or []:
        if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("url"):
            gallery.append(item)
        elif isinstance(item, str) and item:
            gallery.append({"url": item})
    gallery.sort(key=lambda item: 0 if item.get("featured") else 1)
    data["gallery"] = gallery
    return data


def fetch_mod_versions(
    project_id: str,
    loader: str = "",
    game_version: str = "",
    content_type: str = "mod",
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    params: dict[str, str] = {}
    # 材质与光影的版本文件不声明 Fabric/Forge 加载器，不能按加载器过滤。
    key = _loader_key(loader) if str(content_type or "mod") == "mod" else ""
    if key:
        params["loaders"] = json.dumps([key])
    if game_version:
        params["game_versions"] = json.dumps([game_version])
    url = f"{MODRINTH_API}/project/{project_id}/version"
    if params:
        url += "?" + urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
    data = _get_json(url)
    if not isinstance(data, list):
        raise ModrinthError("Modrinth 版本列表格式不正确")
    result = []
    for entry in data:
        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
            continue
        files = entry.get("files") or []
        if not isinstance(files, list) or not files:
            continue
        if not any(isinstance(f, dict) and f.get("url") for f in files):
            continue
        result.append(entry)
    return result


def lookup_version_by_hash(sha1: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """按文件 SHA-1 反查 Modrinth 版本；未收录时返回 None。"""
    digest = str(sha1 or "").strip().lower()
    if not digest:
        return None
    url = f"{MODRINTH_API}/version_file/{digest}?algorithm=sha1"
    try:
        data = _get_json(url)
    except ModrinthError:
        return None
    return data if isinstance(data, dict) and data.get("id") else None


def version_supports(
    version: dict[str, Any], loader: str = "", game_version: str = ""
) -> bool:
    """判断 Modrinth 版本是否支持目标加载器与 MC 版本。"""
    if not isinstance(version, dict):
        return False
    key = _loader_key(loader)
    loaders = {str(item).lower() for item in version.get("loaders") or []}
    games = {str(item) for item in version.get("game_versions") or []}
    if key and key not in loaders:
        return False
    if game_version and game_version not in games:
        return False
    return True


def primary_file(version: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    files = [f for f in version.get("files") or [] if isinstance(f, dict)]
    for item in files:
        if item.get("primary") and item.get("url"):
            return item
    for item in files:
        if item.get("url"):
            return item
    return None


def required_dependencies(version: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    return [
        dep
        for dep in version.get("dependencies") or []
        if isinstance(dep, dict) and dep.get("dependency_type") == "required"
    ]


def download_mod_file(
    version: dict[str, Any],
    mods_dir: Path,
    *,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
    threads: int = 8,
) -> Path:
    progress = progress_cb or (lambda p, m: None)
    file = primary_file(version)
    if not file:
        raise ModrinthError("这个版本没有可下载的文件")
    filename = Path(str(file.get("filename") or "")).name
    if not filename:
        filename = f"{version.get('id', 'mod')}.jar"
    mods_dir = Path(mods_dir)
    mods_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest = mods_dir / filename
    hashes = file.get("hashes") or {}
    sha1 = str(hashes.get("sha1") or "")
    size = int(file.get("size") or 0)

    if dest.exists():
        if size and dest.stat().st_size == size:
            progress(100, f"{filename} 已存在")
            return dest
        if not size:
            progress(100, f"{filename} 已存在")
            return dest

    progress(1, f"正在下载 {filename}")

    def on_bytes(done: int, total: int) -> None:
        if total:
            percent = max(1, min(99, int(done * 100 / total)))
            progress(
                percent,
                f"{filename} · {done / 1024 / 1024:.1f}/{total / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB",
            )
        else:
            progress(50, f"正在下载 {filename}")

    try:
        download_to_file(
            str(file["url"]),
            dest,
            sha1=sha1,
            size=size,
            cancel_event=cancel_event,
            progress_cb=on_bytes,
            connections=min(8, max(2, int(threads))),
        )
    except DownloadCancelled:
        raise
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ModrinthError(str(exc)) from exc
    progress(100, "下载完成")
    return dest

    "fabric-loader": ("fabric", "Fabric"),
    "forge": ("forge", "Forge"),
    "neoforge": ("neoforge", "NeoForge"),
    "quilt-loader": ("quilt", "Quilt"),
}

class ModrinthPackError(Exception):
    pass


@dataclass
class ModrinthFile:
    path: str
    sha1: str
    size: int
    urls: list[str]
    client: str = "required"

@dataclass
class ModrinthPackInfo:
    path: Path
    manifest: dict[str, Any]
    files: list[ModrinthFile]
    overrides: list[ModrinthOverride]
    counts: dict[str, int]
    total_files: int
    total_bytes: int
    archive_bytes: int

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return str(self.manifest.get("name") or self.path.stem or "Modrinth 整合包")

    @property
    def description(self) -> str:
        return str(self.manifest.get("summary") or "")

    @property
    def version_id(self) -> str:
        return str(self.manifest.get("versionId") or "")

    @property
    def created_at(self) -> str:
        return ""

    @property
    def created_with(self) -> str:
        return "Modrinth"

    @property
    def minecraft_version(self) -> str:
        dependencies = self.manifest.get("dependencies") or {}
        return str(dependencies.get("minecraft") or "")

    @property
    def loader_key(self) -> str:
        dependencies = self.manifest.get("dependencies") or {}
        for key in _LOADER_KEYS:
            if dependencies.get(key):
                return key
        return ""

    @property
    def loader(self) -> str:
        key = self.loader_key
        return _LOADER_KEYS.get(key, ("", ""))[1]

    @property
    def loader_version(self) -> str:
        key = self.loader_key
        if not key:
            return ""
        dependencies = self.manifest.get("dependencies") or {}
        return str(dependencies.get(key) or "")

    @property
    def loader_kind(self) -> str:
        return _LOADER_KEYS.get(self.loader_key, ("", ""))[0]


@dataclass
