def looks_like_modrinth_pack(path: Path | str) -> bool:
    archive = Path(path)
    if not archive.is_file():
        return False
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as zf:
            return any(
                name.replace("\\", "/").lower() == MODRINTH_MANIFEST
                for name in zf.namelist()
            )
    except Exception:
        return False


def _safe_path(name: str, label: str = "整合包") -> str:
    value = str(name or "").replace("\\", "/")
    if not value or value.startswith("/") or re.match(r"^[A-Za-z]:", value):
        raise ModrinthPackError(f"{label}内包含非法路径：{name}")
    parts = PurePosixPath(value).parts
    if any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in parts):
        raise ModrinthPackError(f"{label}内包含越界路径：{name}")
    for part in parts:
        if (
            re.search(r'[<>:"|?*\x00-\x1f]', part)
            or part.endswith((" ", "."))
            or part.split(".", 1)[0].upper() in _WINDOWS_RESERVED
        ):
            raise ModrinthPackError(f"{label}内包含 Windows 无法使用的路径：{name}")
    return "/".join(parts)


def _read_manifest(zf: zipfile.ZipFile, info: zipfile.ZipInfo) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if info.file_size > MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES:
        raise ModrinthPackError("modrinth.index.json 过大，已拒绝读取")
    if info.flag_bits & 0x1:
        raise ModrinthPackError("整合包中的文件被加密，无法读取")
    try:
        raw = zf.read(info)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ModrinthPackError(f"读取 Modrinth 清单失败：{exc}") from exc
    try:
        data = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8-sig"))
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ModrinthPackError("modrinth.index.json 不是有效的 JSON") from exc
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise ModrinthPackError("modrinth.index.json 格式不正确")
    return data


def _parse_files(manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> list[ModrinthFile]:
    raw_files = manifest.get("files")
    if not isinstance(raw_files, list):
        raise ModrinthPackError("Modrinth 清单缺少 files 列表")
    result: list[ModrinthFile] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for item in raw_files:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ModrinthPackError("Modrinth 清单里的文件条目格式不正确")
        path = _safe_path(str(item.get("path") or ""), "整合包")
        if path.lower() == MODRINTH_MANIFEST or path.startswith(
            ("overrides/", "client-overrides/")
        ):
            raise ModrinthPackError(f"下载文件路径占用了保留目录：{path}")
        if path.split("/", 1)[0].lower() in _RESERVED_DOWNLOAD_DIRS:
            raise ModrinthPackError(f"下载文件路径写入了保留目录：{path}")
        key = path.lower()
        if key in seen:
            raise ModrinthPackError(f"整合包内存在重复文件：{path}")
        seen.add(key)

        env = item.get("env") or {}
        client = str(env.get("client") or "required").lower()
        if client == "unsupported":
            continue

        hashes = item.get("hashes") or {}
        sha1 = str(hashes.get("sha1") or "").strip().lower()
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", sha1):
            raise ModrinthPackError(f"文件 {path} 缺少有效的 SHA1 校验值")
        try:
            size = int(item.get("fileSize") or 0)
        except Exception:
            size = 0
        if size < 0:
            size = 0
        downloads: list[str] = []
        for url in item.get("downloads") or []:
            text = str(url or "").strip()
            if text.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
                downloads.append(text)
        if not downloads:
            raise ModrinthPackError(f"文件 {path} 没有可用的下载地址")
        result.append(
            ModrinthFile(
                path=path,
                sha1=sha1,
                size=size,
                urls=downloads,
                client=client,
            )
        )
    return result


def inspect_modrinth_pack(path: Path | str) -> ModrinthPackInfo:
    archive = Path(path)
    if not archive.is_file():
        raise ModrinthPackError("整合包文件不存在")
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as zf:
            infos = zf.infolist()
            if len(infos) > MAX_TOTAL_FILES:
                raise ModrinthPackError("整合包内文件数量过多，已拒绝读取")
            seen: set[str] = set()
            total = 0
            manifest_info: zipfile.ZipInfo | None = None
            overrides: list[ModrinthOverride] = []
            for info in infos:
                name = _safe_path(info.filename, "整合包")
                key = name.lower()
                if key in seen:
                    raise ModrinthPackError(f"整合包内存在重复文件：{name}")
                seen.add(key)
                mode = (info.external_attr >> 16) & 0o170000
                if mode == 0o120000:
                    raise ModrinthPackError(f"整合包内不允许符号链接：{name}")
                if info.is_dir():
                    continue
                if info.flag_bits & 0x1:
                    raise ModrinthPackError("整合包中的文件被加密，无法导入")
                total += max(0, int(info.file_size))
                if total > MAX_TOTAL_BYTES:
                    raise ModrinthPackError("整合包解压后体积超过 64 GB，已拒绝导入")
                if name.lower() == MODRINTH_MANIFEST:
                    manifest_info = info
                    continue
                if name.startswith("overrides/"):
                    relative = name[len("overrides/") :]
                    overrides.append(
                        ModrinthOverride(
                            member=info.filename,
                            relative=_safe_path(relative, "整合包"),
                            size=max(0, int(info.file_size)),
                        )
                    )
                elif name.startswith("client-overrides/"):
                    relative = name[len("client-overrides/") :]
                    overrides.append(
                        ModrinthOverride(
                            member=info.filename,
                            relative=_safe_path(relative, "整合包"),
                            size=max(0, int(info.file_size)),
                            client_only=True,
                        )
                    )
            for item in overrides:
                if item.relative.split("/", 1)[0].lower() in _RESERVED_OVERRIDE_DIRS:
                    raise ModrinthPackError(
                        f"整合包覆盖文件写入了保留目录：{item.relative}"
                    )
            if manifest_info is None:
                raise ModrinthPackError(
                    "这不是 Modrinth 整合包：缺少 modrinth.index.json"
                )
            manifest = _read_manifest(zf, manifest_info)
    except ModrinthPackError:
        raise
    except zipfile.BadZipFile as exc:
        raise ModrinthPackError("文件不是有效的 ZIP / mrpack 压缩包") from exc
    except OSError as exc:
        raise ModrinthPackError(f"无法打开整合包：{exc}") from exc

    if str(manifest.get("game") or "") != "minecraft":
        raise ModrinthPackError("这个 Modrinth 包不是 Minecraft 整合包")
    try:
        format_version = int(manifest.get("formatVersion") or 0)
    except Exception:
        format_version = 0
    if format_version != 1:
        raise ModrinthPackError(
            f"Modrinth 整合包格式版本 {format_version or '未知'} 不受支持"
        )
    dependencies = manifest.get("dependencies") or {}
    if not isinstance(dependencies, dict) or not dependencies.get("minecraft"):
        raise ModrinthPackError("Modrinth 清单没有指定 Minecraft 版本")
    mc_version = str(dependencies.get("minecraft") or "").strip()
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9A-Za-z._-]{1,40}", mc_version):
        raise ModrinthPackError(f"Minecraft 版本号不正确：{mc_version}")
    loader_key = ""
    for key in _LOADER_KEYS:
        if dependencies.get(key):
            loader_key = key
            break
    if loader_key:
        loader_version = str(dependencies.get(loader_key) or "").strip()
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9A-Za-z._+-]{1,80}", loader_version):
            raise ModrinthPackError(f"加载器版本号不正确：{loader_version}")
        if loader_key == "quilt-loader":
            raise ModrinthPackError(
                "这个整合包使用 Quilt 加载器，当前启动器还不支持 Quilt。"
                "可以尝试让整合包作者导出 Fabric 版本，或使用 Prism 等启动器。"
            )

    files = _parse_files(manifest)
    if not files and not overrides:
        raise ModrinthPackError("整合包里没有任何需要导入的内容")
    counts = {name: 0 for name in CONTENT_DIRS}
    for item in files:
        first = item.path.split("/", 1)[0]
        if first in counts:
            counts[first] += 1
    for item in overrides:
        first = item.relative.split("/", 1)[0]
        if first in counts:
            counts[first] += 1

    return ModrinthPackInfo(
        path=archive,
        manifest=manifest,
        files=files,
        overrides=overrides,
        counts=counts,
        total_files=len(files) + len(overrides),
        total_bytes=sum(item.size for item in files)
        + sum(item.size for item in overrides),
        archive_bytes=archive.stat().st_size,
    )


def _sha1_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha1()
    with path.open("rb") as fp:
        while True:
            chunk = fp.read(1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _file_matches(path: Path, sha1: str, size: int) -> bool:
    try:
        if not path.is_file():
            return False
        if size and path.stat().st_size != size:
            return False
        return _sha1_file(path) == sha1
    except OSError:
        return False


def _modrinth_fallback_urls(sha1: str) -> list[str]:
    """用 SHA1 向 Modrinth 查询同一个文件的 CDN 地址。"""
    try:
        with http_open(
            f"{MODRINTH_API}/version_file/{sha1}?algorithm=sha1",
            timeout=12,
        ) as resp:
            data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        return []
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        return []
    result: list[str] = []
    for item in data.get("files") or []:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        item_sha1 = str((item.get("hashes") or {}).get("sha1") or "").lower()
        if item_sha1 and item_sha1 != sha1:
            continue
        url = str(item.get("url") or "").strip()
        if url.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
            result.append(url)
    return list(dict.fromkeys(result))


def _preferred_urls(item: ModrinthFile) -> list[str]:
    """ForgeCDN 在部分网络下不可达时，优先换成 Modrinth CDN。"""
    cdn = [
        url
        for url in item.urls
        if (urlparse(url).hostname or "").lower() == "cdn.modrinth.com"
    ]
    if cdn:
        return list(dict.fromkeys(cdn + item.urls))
    return list(dict.fromkeys(_modrinth_fallback_urls(item.sha1) + item.urls))


def _inside(root: Path, path: Path) -> Path:
    try:
        path.resolve().relative_to(root.resolve())
    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise ModrinthPackError(f"整合包路径越界：{path}") from exc
    return path


def _write_version_wrapper(
    game_dir: Path, version_id: str, inherits_from: str
) -> Path:
    path = version_json_path(game_dir, version_id)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    data = {
        "id": version_id,
        "inheritsFrom": inherits_from,
        "type": "release",
        "name": version_id,
    }
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return path


def import_modrinth_pack(
    pack_path: Path | str,
    game_dir: Path | str,
    version_id: str,
    *,
    java_path: str = "",
    overwrite: bool = False,
    resume: bool = False,
    isolated: bool = True,
    source: str = "official",
    threads: int = 8,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    log_cb: LogCallback | None = None,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
    loader_installer: Callable[..., str] | None = None,
    download_func: Callable[..., int] | None = None,
    installer: Any | None = None,
    url_resolver: Callable[[ModrinthFile], list[str]] | None = None,
) -> ModrinthImportResult:
    game_dir = Path(game_dir)
    info = inspect_modrinth_pack(pack_path)
    version_id = normalize_version_id(version_id)
    version_dir = game_dir / "versions" / version_id
    if version_dir.exists() and not resume:
        raise ModrinthPackError(f"版本 {version_id} 已经存在，请换一个导入名称")
    if resume and not version_dir.exists():
        # 上次取消得早，目标目录还没建出来；按全新导入继续即可。
        resume = False

    progress = progress_cb or (lambda _p, _m: None)
    log = log_cb or (lambda _m: None)
    cancel = cancel_event or threading.Event()
    loader_installer = loader_installer or install_loader
    download_func = download_func or download_to_file
    connections = min(6, max(2, max(1, int(threads)) // 2))

    def check_cancel() -> None:
        if cancel.is_set():
            raise ModrinthPackError("导入已取消")

    def loader_progress(percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        check_cancel()
        progress(loader_stage_percent(percent), message)

    mc_version = info.minecraft_version
    loader_kind = info.loader_kind
    log(
        f"Modrinth 整合包：{info.name} · Minecraft {mc_version} · "
        f"{info.loader or '原版'}"
        + (f" {info.loader_version}" if info.loader_version else "")
    )
    progress(2, "检查整合包与加载器…")
    check_cancel()

    inherits_from = ""
    if loader_kind:
        if loader_kind in ("forge", "neoforge") and not java_path:
            raise ModrinthPackError(
                f"安装 {info.loader} 需要 Java，请先在设置里选择 Java。"
            )
        progress(3, f"安装 Minecraft {mc_version} + {info.loader}…")
        inherits_from = loader_installer(
            game_dir,
            mc_version,
            loader_kind,
            info.loader_version,
            java_path=java_path,
            source=source,
            progress_cb=loader_progress,
            log_cb=log,
            cancel_event=cancel,
        )
        check_cancel()
    else:
        progress(3, f"安装 Minecraft {mc_version}…")
        target_installer = installer or Installer(
            game_dir,
            source=source,
            progress_cb=loader_progress,
            log_cb=log,
            cancel_event=cancel,
            threads=threads,
        )
        target_installer.install(mc_version)
        check_cancel()
        inherits_from = mc_version

    if inherits_from == version_id:
        raise ModrinthPackError("导入名称不能和加载器版本名称相同，请换一个名称")
    progress(46, "写入版本骨架…")
    _write_version_wrapper(game_dir, version_id, inherits_from)
    log(f"已创建版本 {version_id}，继承 {inherits_from}")

    run_dir = version_game_dir(game_dir, version_id, isolated)
    run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    imported = 0
    skipped = 0
    imported_bytes = 0
    downloaded = 0
    total_files = max(1, len(info.files))

    pending: list[BatchDownload] = []
    seen_paths: set[str] = set()
    for item in info.files:
        check_cancel()
        destination = _inside(run_dir, run_dir / item.path)
        key = str(destination).lower()
        if key in seen_paths:
            skipped += 1
            continue
        seen_paths.add(key)
        if _file_matches(destination, item.sha1, item.size):
            skipped += 1
            continue

        item_urls = list(item.urls or [])

        def candidates(
            item: ModrinthFile = item, item_urls: list[str] = item_urls
        ) -> list[str]:
            if url_resolver is not None:
                urls = list(url_resolver(item) or item_urls)
            else:
                urls = _preferred_urls(item)
            return list(dict.fromkeys(urls + item_urls))

        def fallback(
            item: ModrinthFile = item, item_urls: list[str] = item_urls
        ) -> list[str]:
            if url_resolver is not None:
                return []
            if any(
                (urlparse(url).hostname or "").lower() == "cdn.modrinth.com"
                for url in item_urls
            ):
                return []
            return _modrinth_fallback_urls(item.sha1)

        pending.append(
            BatchDownload(
                dest=destination,
                urls=candidates,
                sha1=item.sha1,
                size=item.size,
                label=item.path,
                fallback=fallback,
            )
        )

    if pending:
        start_percent = 48 + int(44 * skipped / total_files)
        downloaded, failures = download_batch(
            pending,
            cancel_event=cancel,
            connections=connections,
            max_workers=min(8, max(2, int(threads))),
            progress_cb=progress,
            percent_range=(start_percent, 92),
            log_cb=log,
            label="下载整合包文件",
            download_func=download_func,
        )
        imported += downloaded
        imported_bytes += sum(max(0, int(task.size)) for task in pending)
        if failures:
            detail = failures[0]
            raise ModrinthPackError(
                f"{len(failures)} 个文件下载失败：{detail}"
            )
    else:
        downloaded = 0

    override_total = sum(max(0, item.size) for item in info.overrides) or 1
    jobs: list[ExtractJob] = []
    groups: dict[str, list[int]] = {}
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(info.path) as zf:
            ordered = sorted(info.overrides, key=lambda item: item.client_only)
            indexes: dict[str, int] = {}
            for item in ordered:
                check_cancel()
                destination = _inside(run_dir, run_dir / item.relative)
                reserved = item.relative.split("/", 1)[0].lower()
                if reserved in _RESERVED_OVERRIDE_DIRS:
                    raise ModrinthPackError(
                        f"整合包覆盖文件写入了保留目录：{item.relative}"
                    )
                if item.relative.lower() == f"{version_id}.json".lower():
                    raise ModrinthPackError(
                        "整合包覆盖文件试图替换版本 JSON，已拒绝导入"
                    )
                try:
                    entry = zf.getinfo(item.member)
                except KeyError as exc:
                    raise ModrinthPackError(
                        f"整合包里找不到覆盖文件：{item.relative}"
                    ) from exc
                job = ExtractJob(entry, destination, item.relative)
                key = item.relative.lower()
                if key in indexes:
                    jobs[indexes[key]] = job
                    groups[key][0] += 1
                    groups[key][1] += max(0, item.size)
                else:
                    indexes[key] = len(jobs)
                    groups[key] = [
                        1,
                        max(0, item.size),
                        1 if destination.exists() else 0,
                    ]
                    jobs.append(job)
    except ModrinthPackError:
        raise
    except zipfile.BadZipFile as exc:
        raise ModrinthPackError("整合包在导入过程中损坏") from exc
    except OSError as exc:
        raise ModrinthPackError(f"读取整合包文件失败：{exc}") from exc

    check_cancel()

    def override_progress(done_bytes: int, _files: int, label: str) -> None:
        if label:
            progress(
                min(99, 92 + int(7 * done_bytes / override_total)),
                f"放入 {label}",
            )

    extract_threads = max(
        1, min(DEFAULT_EXTRACT_THREADS, int(threads or DEFAULT_EXTRACT_THREADS))
    )
    try:
        stats = extract_zip_entries(
            info.path,
            jobs,
            threads=extract_threads,
            overwrite=overwrite,
            cancel_event=cancel,
            progress_cb=override_progress,
        )
    except ZipExtractCancelled as exc:
        raise ModrinthPackError("导入已取消") from exc
    except ZipExtractError as exc:
        raise ModrinthPackError(f"解压覆盖文件失败：{exc}") from exc
    imported += stats.added
    skipped += stats.skipped
    imported_bytes += stats.bytes_written
    for count, size, existed in groups.values():
        if count <= 1:
            continue
        if existed and not overwrite:
            skipped += count - 1
        else:
            imported += count - 1
            imported_bytes += size

    check_cancel()
    progress(100, "猫猫已经把 Modrinth 整合包搬进猫窝")
    log(
        f"导入完成：{version_id} · 下载 {downloaded} 个文件 · "
        f"新增 {imported} 个文件"
        + (f" · 跳过 {skipped} 个已存在文件" if skipped else "")
    )
    return ModrinthImportResult(
        version_id=version_id,
        imported_files=imported,
        skipped_files=skipped,
        imported_bytes=imported_bytes,
        downloaded_files=downloaded,
    )

# FILE: darkitten/mods.py

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import io
import json
import re
import tomllib
import zipfile
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace
from pathlib import Path

from .descriptions import has_chinese, local_mod_zh_intro, project_zh_intro

META_DIR_NAME = ".dkl-meta"
_META_ICON_DIR = "icons"
_MAX_ICON_BYTES = 512 * 1024


@dataclass
class ModInfo:
    path: Path
    name: str
    version: str = ""
    loader: str = ""
    description: str = ""
    description_zh: str = ""
    enabled: bool = True
    size: int = 0
    icon_bytes: bytes = b""
    project_url: str = ""
    source_label: str = ""
    project_id: str = ""
    source: str = ""
    version_id: str = ""
    file_id: str = ""
    sha1: str = ""

    @property
    def filename(self) -> str:
        return self.path.name

    @property
    def size_text(self) -> str:
        size = self.size
        if size >= 1024 * 1024:
            return f"{size / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB"
        if size >= 1024:
            return f"{size / 1024:.0f} KB"
        return f"{size} B"

    @property
    def intro(self) -> str:
        """优先展示持久化的中文介绍，其次使用 JAR 内的中文简介。"""
        if self.description_zh:
            return self.description_zh
        if has_chinese(self.description):
            return self.description
        return local_mod_zh_intro(
            self.name,
            loader=self.loader,
            version=self.version,
            description=self.description,
        )


def _meta_key(filename: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha1(str(filename).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:20]


def _meta_candidates(filename: str) -> list[str]:
    names = [str(filename)]
    if filename.lower().endswith(".disabled"):
        names.append(filename[: -len(".disabled")])
    return names


def mod_meta_json_path(mods_dir: Path, filename: str) -> Path:
    return Path(mods_dir) / META_DIR_NAME / f"{_meta_key(filename)}.json"


def mod_meta_icon_path(mods_dir: Path, filename: str) -> Path:
    return (
        Path(mods_dir)
        / META_DIR_NAME
        / _META_ICON_DIR
        / f"{_meta_key(filename)}.png"
    )


def load_mod_meta(mods_dir: Path, filename: str) -> dict:
    for name in _meta_candidates(filename):
        path = mod_meta_json_path(mods_dir, name)
        try:
            data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except (OSError, ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
            continue
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            return data
    return {}


def _find_meta_icon(mods_dir: Path, filename: str) -> bytes:
    for name in _meta_candidates(filename):
        path = mod_meta_icon_path(mods_dir, name)
        try:
            if path.is_file() and path.stat().st_size <= _MAX_ICON_BYTES:
                return path.read_bytes()
        except OSError:
            continue
    return b""


def write_mod_meta(
    mods_dir: Path, filename: str, payload: dict, icon_bytes: bytes = b""
) -> None:
    """把下载来源、中文介绍与图标保存到 mods/.dkl-meta，供列表离线读取。"""
    mods_dir = Path(mods_dir)
    meta_path = mod_meta_json_path(mods_dir, filename)
    meta_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    clean = {
        key: value
        for key, value in (payload or {}).items()
        if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool, list, dict)) or value is None
    }
    clean["filename"] = str(filename)
    temp = meta_path.with_name(meta_path.name + ".tmp")
    temp.write_text(
        json.dumps(clean, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
    )
    temp.replace(meta_path)
    if icon_bytes:
        icon_path = mod_meta_icon_path(mods_dir, filename)
        icon_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        icon_temp = icon_path.with_name(icon_path.name + ".tmp")
        icon_temp.write_bytes(icon_bytes)
        icon_temp.replace(icon_path)


def forget_mod_meta(mods_dir: Path, filename: str) -> None:
    for name in _meta_candidates(filename):
        for path in (
            mod_meta_json_path(mods_dir, name),
            mod_meta_icon_path(mods_dir, name),
        ):
            try:
                path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            except OSError:
                pass


def _clean(value: object, fallback: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return fallback
    text = str(value).strip()
    if not text:
        return fallback
    if text.startswith("${") or text.startswith("%"):
        return fallback
    return text


NEOFORGE_SERVICE_MARKERS = (
    "META-INF/services/net.neoforged.neoforgespi.locating.IModLocator",
    "META-INF/services/net.neoforged.neoforgespi.locating.IModFileCandidateLocator",
    "META-INF/services/net.neoforged.neoforgespi.transformation.ClassProcessorProvider",
)
FORGE_SERVICE_MARKERS = (
    "META-INF/services/cpw.mods.modlauncher.api.ITransformationService",
    "META-INF/services/net.minecraftforge.fml.loading.moddiscovery.IModLocator",
    "META-INF/services/net.minecraftforge.forgespi.locating.IModLocator",
)
LOADER_ORDER = ("NeoForge", "Forge", "Quilt", "Fabric")
_NESTED_PREFIXES = ("META-INF/jarjar/", "META-INF/jar-jar/", "META-INF/jars/")
# Fabric API 会把几十个模块塞进 META-INF/jars。限制太小会把后半个
# fabric-api 误判成“缺少前置”，所以放宽到 64 个，字节上限仍然兜底。
_MAX_NESTED_JARS = 64
_MAX_NESTED_BYTES = 32 * 1024 * 1024


@dataclass
class JarDeclarations:
    """一个 JAR 内声明的加载器与原始元数据。"""

    loaders: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    fabric: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    quilt: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    forge: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    neoforge: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    icon_bytes: bytes = b""
    nested: bool = False
    nested_provides: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)

    @property
    def has_metadata(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.fabric or self.quilt or self.forge or self.neoforge)


def _norm_modid(value: object) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", str(value or "").lower())


def _has_version_number(value: object) -> bool:
    return bool(re.search(r"\d", str(value or "")))


def _zip_json(zf: zipfile.ZipFile, name: str) -> dict | None:
    try:
        raw = zf.read(name)
    except (KeyError, OSError, RuntimeError):
        return None
    try:
        data = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
    except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
        return None
    return data if isinstance(data, dict) else None


def _zip_toml(zf: zipfile.ZipFile, name: str) -> dict | None:
    try:
        raw = zf.read(name)
    except (KeyError, OSError, RuntimeError):
        return None
    try:
        data = tomllib.loads(raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return None
    return data if isinstance(data, dict) else None


def _forge_modids(data: dict | None) -> set[str]:
    mods = (data or {}).get("mods") or []
    if not isinstance(mods, list):
        return set()
    return {
        _norm_modid(mod.get("modId"))
        for mod in mods
        if isinstance(mod, dict) and _norm_modid(mod.get("modId"))
    }


def _loaders_from(names: set[str], decl: JarDeclarations) -> list[str]:
    loaders: list[str] = []
    if decl.neoforge:
        loaders.append("NeoForge")
    if decl.forge:
        loaders.append("Forge")
    if decl.quilt:
        loaders.append("Quilt")
    if decl.fabric:
        loaders.append("Fabric")
    if not decl.forge and not decl.neoforge:
        if any(marker in names for marker in NEOFORGE_SERVICE_MARKERS):
            loaders.append("NeoForge")
        if any(marker in names for marker in FORGE_SERVICE_MARKERS):
            loaders.append("Forge")
    return [loader for loader in LOADER_ORDER if loader in loaders]


def _declarations_from_zip(
    zf: zipfile.ZipFile, *, with_icon: bool = False
) -> JarDeclarations:
    names = set(zf.namelist())
    decl = JarDeclarations()

    fabric = _zip_json(zf, "fabric.mod.json")
    quilt_raw = _zip_json(zf, "quilt.mod.json")
    quilt = None
    if quilt_raw:
        value = quilt_raw.get("quilt_loader") or {}
        quilt = value if isinstance(value, dict) else None
    forge = _zip_toml(zf, "META-INF/mods.toml")
    neoforge = _zip_toml(zf, "META-INF/neoforge.mods.toml")

    forge_ids = _forge_modids(forge) | _forge_modids(neoforge)
    if (
        fabric
        and forge_ids
        and _norm_modid(fabric.get("id")) not in forge_ids
        and not _has_version_number(fabric.get("version"))
    ):
        # JourneyMap 等 Forge/NeoForge 模组会故意放一个“not a fabric mod”
        # 的 fabric.mod.json，用来在 Fabric 环境里报错。它不能当作加载器依据。
        fabric = None

    if fabric:
        decl.fabric.append(fabric)
    if quilt:
        decl.quilt.append(quilt)
    if forge:
        decl.forge.append(forge)
    if neoforge:
        decl.neoforge.append(neoforge)
    decl.loaders = _loaders_from(names, decl)
    if with_icon:
        _icon = jar_identity(decl)[3]
        if _icon:
            decl.icon_bytes = _read_icon_from_jar(zf, _icon)
    return decl


def jar_identity(decl: JarDeclarations) -> tuple[str, str, str, str]:
    """返回 JAR 的名称、版本、简介和图标路径。"""
    for data in decl.neoforge + decl.forge:
        mods = data.get("mods") or []
        if isinstance(mods, list) and mods and isinstance(mods[0], dict):
            mod = mods[0]
            return (
                _clean(mod.get("displayName") or mod.get("modId")),
                _clean(mod.get("version") or data.get("version")),
                _clean(mod.get("description") or data.get("description")),
                _clean(mod.get("logoFile") or mod.get("iconFile")),
            )
    for data in decl.quilt + decl.fabric:
        description = data.get("description", "")
        if isinstance(description, dict):
            description = description.get("text", "")
        icon = data.get("icon")
        if not icon and isinstance(data.get("metadata"), dict):
            icon = data["metadata"].get("icon")
        return (
            _clean(data.get("name") or data.get("id")),
            _clean(data.get("version")),
            _clean(description),
            _icon_field(icon),
        )
    return "", "", "", ""


def _nested_jar_entries(
    zf: zipfile.ZipFile, names: set[str]
) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    entries: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    for meta_name in (
        "META-INF/jarjar/metadata.json",
        "META-INF/jar-jar/metadata.json",
    ):
        data = _zip_json(zf, meta_name)
        if not data:
            continue
        jars = data.get("jars") or []
        if not isinstance(jars, list):
            continue
        for item in jars:
            if not isinstance(item, dict):
                continue
            path = str(item.get("path") or "").strip()
            if not path:
                continue
            version = ""
            version_info = item.get("version")
            if isinstance(version_info, dict):
                version = _clean(version_info.get("artifactVersion"))
            entries.append((path, version))
    listed = {path for path, _version in entries}
    for name in sorted(names):
        if (
            name.startswith(_NESTED_PREFIXES)
            and name.lower().endswith(".jar")
            and name not in listed
        ):
            entries.append((name, ""))

    result: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for path, version in entries:
        if path in seen or path not in names:
            continue
        seen.add(path)
        result.append((path, version))
    return result


def _declaration_modids(decl: JarDeclarations) -> list[str]:
    modids: list[str] = []
    for data in decl.fabric + decl.quilt:
        modid = _clean(data.get("id"))
        if modid:
            modids.append(modid)
        provides = data.get("provides")
        if isinstance(provides, list):
            modids.extend(_clean(item) for item in provides if _clean(item))
    for data in decl.forge + decl.neoforge:
        mods = data.get("mods") or []
        if not isinstance(mods, list):
            continue
        for mod in mods:
            if isinstance(mod, dict) and _clean(mod.get("modId")):
                modids.append(_clean(mod.get("modId")))
    return list(dict.fromkeys(modids))


def _merge_declarations(target: JarDeclarations, part: JarDeclarations) -> None:
    target.fabric.extend(part.fabric)
    target.quilt.extend(part.quilt)
    target.forge.extend(part.forge)
    target.neoforge.extend(part.neoforge)
    loaders = set(target.loaders) | set(part.loaders)
    target.loaders = [loader for loader in LOADER_ORDER if loader in loaders]
    for modid, version in part.nested_provides.items():
        target.nested_provides.setdefault(modid, version)
    if part.icon_bytes and not target.icon_bytes:
        target.icon_bytes = part.icon_bytes


def read_jar_declarations(
    zf: zipfile.ZipFile,
    *,
    with_icon: bool = False,
    with_nested_provides: bool = False,
) -> JarDeclarations:
    """读取 JAR 元数据；仅有 jarjar 包装层时继续读取内嵌 JAR。"""
    decl = _declarations_from_zip(zf, with_icon=with_icon)
    root_has_metadata = decl.has_metadata
    if root_has_metadata and not with_nested_provides:
        return decl

    names = set(zf.namelist())
    total = 0
    for path, artifact_version in _nested_jar_entries(zf, names)[
        :_MAX_NESTED_JARS
    ]:
        try:
            info = zf.getinfo(path)
            if info.file_size <= 0 or info.file_size > _MAX_NESTED_BYTES:
                continue
            if total + info.file_size > _MAX_NESTED_BYTES:
                break
            data = zf.read(path)
        except (KeyError, OSError, RuntimeError):
            continue
        total += len(data)
        try:
            with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data)) as inner:
                part = _declarations_from_zip(
                    inner, with_icon=with_icon and not root_has_metadata
                )
        except (zipfile.BadZipFile, OSError):
            continue
        if not part.has_metadata:
            continue
        version = jar_identity(part)[1]
        if not version or version.startswith("${"):
            version = artifact_version
        for modid in _declaration_modids(part):
            decl.nested_provides.setdefault(modid, version)
        if not root_has_metadata:
            _merge_declarations(decl, part)

    if not root_has_metadata and decl.has_metadata:
        decl.nested = True
    return decl


def _icon_field(value: object) -> str:
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value.strip()
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        candidates = [
            (str(key), str(path))
            for key, path in value.items()
            if str(path).strip()
        ]
        if not candidates:
            return ""
        numeric = []
        for key, path in candidates:
            try:
                numeric.append((int(key), path))
            except ValueError:
                continue
        if numeric:
            return max(numeric, key=lambda item: item[0])[1]
        return candidates[-1][1]
    return ""


def _read_icon_from_jar(zf: zipfile.ZipFile, preferred: str) -> bytes:
    names = set(zf.namelist())
    candidates: list[str] = []
    preferred = str(preferred or "").strip().lstrip("/\\").replace("\\", "/")
    if preferred:
        candidates.append(preferred)
    candidates.extend(
        (
            "icon.png",
            "logo.png",
            "assets/icon.png",
            "pack.png",
        )
    )
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for name in candidates:
        if not name or name in seen or name not in names:
            continue
        seen.add(name)
        try:
            info = zf.getinfo(name)
            if info.file_size <= 0 or info.file_size > _MAX_ICON_BYTES:
                continue
            data = zf.read(name)
        except (KeyError, OSError, RuntimeError):
            continue
        if data:
            return data
    return b""


def _download_icon(url: str) -> bytes:
    if not url:
        return b""
    try:
        from .images import fetch_image_bytes

        return fetch_image_bytes(url, timeout=20, limit=_MAX_ICON_BYTES)
    except Exception:
        return b""


def remember_downloaded_mod(
    mods_dir: Path, jar_path: Path, metadata: dict
) -> None:
    """下载完成后把项目图标与中文介绍写入隐藏元数据目录。"""
    jar_path = Path(jar_path)
    if not jar_path.is_file():
        return
    info = metadata if isinstance(metadata, dict) else {}
    icon = _find_meta_icon(Path(mods_dir), jar_path.name)
    jar_info = read_mod(jar_path, with_meta=False)
    if not icon:
        icon = jar_info.icon_bytes
    if not icon:
        icon = _download_icon(str(info.get("icon_url") or ""))
    description_zh = str(
        info.get("description_zh")
        or project_zh_intro(
            info,
            str(info.get("content_type") or "mod"),
            game_version=str(info.get("game_version") or ""),
        )
    )
    payload = {
        "title": str(info.get("title") or jar_info.name or ""),
        "project_id": str(info.get("project_id") or ""),
        "slug": str(info.get("slug") or ""),
        "source": str(info.get("source") or ""),
        "source_label": str(info.get("source_label") or ""),
        "version_id": str(info.get("version_id") or ""),
        "file_id": str(info.get("file_id") or ""),
        "file_name": str(info.get("file_name") or jar_path.name),
        "sha1": str(info.get("sha1") or ""),
        "content_type": str(info.get("content_type") or "mod"),
        "icon_url": str(info.get("icon_url") or ""),
        "author": str(info.get("author") or ""),
        "categories": info.get("categories") or [],
        "loaders": info.get("loaders") or [],
        "game_versions": info.get("game_versions") or [],
        "downloads": info.get("downloads") or 0,
        "description": str(info.get("description") or jar_info.description or ""),
        "description_zh": description_zh,
        "project_url": str(info.get("project_url") or ""),
        "game_version": str(info.get("game_version") or ""),
        "loader": str(info.get("loader") or ""),
    }
    write_mod_meta(Path(mods_dir), jar_path.name, payload, icon)


_MOD_CACHE: dict[tuple[str, bool], tuple[tuple, ModInfo]] = {}
_MOD_CACHE_LIMIT = 512


def _file_signature(path: Path) -> tuple[int, int] | None:
    try:
        stat = path.stat()
    except OSError:
        return None
    return stat.st_mtime_ns, stat.st_size


def _mod_signature(path: Path, with_meta: bool) -> tuple:
    """用文件修改时间与大小判断缓存是否仍然有效。"""
    signature: list[object] = [_file_signature(path)]
    if with_meta:
        meta_dir = path.parent / META_DIR_NAME
        try:
            has_meta = meta_dir.is_dir()
        except OSError:
            has_meta = False
        if has_meta:
            for name in _meta_candidates(path.name):
                signature.append(
                    _file_signature(mod_meta_json_path(path.parent, name))
                )
                signature.append(
                    _file_signature(mod_meta_icon_path(path.parent, name))
                )
    return tuple(signature)


def read_mod(path: Path, with_meta: bool = True) -> ModInfo:
    """读取 Mod 信息；同一个文件未变化时复用上一次的解析结果。"""
    path = Path(path)
    key = (str(path), bool(with_meta))
    signature = _mod_signature(path, with_meta)
    cached = _MOD_CACHE.get(key)
    if cached is not None and cached[0] == signature:
        return replace(cached[1])

    info = _read_mod_uncached(path, with_meta)
    if len(_MOD_CACHE) >= _MOD_CACHE_LIMIT:
        _MOD_CACHE.clear()
    _MOD_CACHE[key] = (signature, replace(info))
    return info


def _read_mod_uncached(path: Path, with_meta: bool = True) -> ModInfo:
    enabled = path.name.lower().endswith(".jar")
    size = 0
    try:
        size = path.stat().st_size
    except OSError:
        pass

    fallback_name = path.name
    if fallback_name.lower().endswith(".disabled"):
        fallback_name = fallback_name[: -len(".disabled")]
    if fallback_name.lower().endswith(".jar"):
        fallback_name = fallback_name[:-4]
    name = fallback_name
    version = ""
    description = ""
    loader = ""
    icon_bytes = b""

    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as zf:
            decl = read_jar_declarations(zf, with_icon=True)
            if decl.has_metadata:
                meta_name, meta_version, meta_description, icon_path = jar_identity(
                    decl
                )
                name = meta_name or name
                version = meta_version
                description = meta_description
                if len(decl.loaders) > 1:
                    loader = "多加载器"
                elif decl.loaders:
                    loader = decl.loaders[0]
                icon_bytes = decl.icon_bytes or _read_icon_from_jar(zf, icon_path)
            else:
                icon_bytes = _read_icon_from_jar(zf, "")
    except (zipfile.BadZipFile, OSError):
        pass

    description_zh = ""
    project_url = ""
    source_label = ""
    project_id = ""
    source = ""
    version_id = ""
    file_id = ""
    sha1 = ""
    if with_meta:
        meta = load_mod_meta(path.parent, path.name)
        if meta:
            description_zh = str(meta.get("description_zh") or "")
            project_url = str(meta.get("project_url") or "")
            source_label = str(meta.get("source_label") or meta.get("source") or "")
            project_id = str(meta.get("project_id") or "")
            source = str(meta.get("source") or "")
            version_id = str(meta.get("version_id") or "")
            file_id = str(meta.get("file_id") or "")
            sha1 = str(meta.get("sha1") or "")
            if not description:
                description = str(meta.get("description") or "")
            if name == fallback_name:
                name = str(meta.get("title") or name)
            saved_icon = _find_meta_icon(path.parent, path.name)
            if saved_icon:
                icon_bytes = saved_icon

    return ModInfo(
        path=path,
        name=name,
        version=version,
        loader=loader,
        description=description,
        description_zh=description_zh,
        enabled=enabled,
        size=size,
        icon_bytes=icon_bytes,
        project_url=project_url,
        source_label=source_label,
        project_id=project_id,
        source=source,
        version_id=version_id,
        file_id=file_id,
        sha1=sha1,
    )


def list_mods(mods_dir: Path) -> list[ModInfo]:
    """读取指定 mods 文件夹中的 Mod。"""
    mods_dir = Path(mods_dir)
    if not mods_dir.exists():
        return []
    result: list[ModInfo] = []
    try:
        entries = list(mods_dir.iterdir())
    except OSError:
        return result
    for path in entries:
        if not path.is_file():
            continue
        lower = path.name.lower()
        if lower.endswith(".jar") or lower.endswith(".jar.disabled"):
            result.append(read_mod(path))
    result.sort(key=lambda m: (not m.enabled, m.name.lower()))
    return result


def toggle_mod(mod: ModInfo) -> Path:
    path = mod.path
    if path.name.lower().endswith(".jar.disabled"):
        new_path = path.with_name(path.name[: -len(".disabled")])
    elif path.name.lower().endswith(".jar"):
        new_path = path.with_name(path.name + ".disabled")
    else:
        raise ValueError("不支持的文件类型")
    if new_path.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(f"目标文件已存在：{new_path.name}")
    path.rename(new_path)
    return new_path

"""极简 NBT 读写，用于离线修改 Minecraft 的 level.dat / servers.dat。

只依赖标准库。读取时保留原标签类型，写入时按原有类型回写，
避免把 byte 写成 int 之类导致游戏读档异常。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import gzip
import struct
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

TAG_END = 0
TAG_BYTE = 1
TAG_SHORT = 2
TAG_INT = 3
TAG_LONG = 4
TAG_FLOAT = 5
TAG_DOUBLE = 6
TAG_BYTE_ARRAY = 7
TAG_STRING = 8
TAG_LIST = 9
TAG_COMPOUND = 10
TAG_INT_ARRAY = 11
TAG_LONG_ARRAY = 12


class NBTError(ValueError):
    pass


class Byte(int):
    """有符号 8 位整数。"""


class Short(int):
    """有符号 16 位整数。"""


class Int(int):
    """有符号 32 位整数。"""


class Long(int):
    """有符号 64 位整数。"""


class Float(float):
    """32 位浮点数。"""


class Double(float):
    """64 位浮点数。"""


class NBTString(str):
    """NBT 字符串（Java modified UTF-8）。"""


class ByteArray(list):
    """TAG_Byte_Array，元素是 -128..127。"""


class IntArray(list):
    """TAG_Int_Array。"""


class LongArray(list):
    """TAG_Long_Array。"""


class NBTList(list):
    """TAG_List，保留元素类型以便空列表也能正确回写。"""

    def __init__(self, iterable=(), element_type: int | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(iterable)
        self.element_type = element_type


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Java modified UTF-8


def _decode_modified_utf8(data: bytes) -> str:
    codes: list[int] = []
    index = 0
    size = len(data)
    while index < size:
        first = data[index]
        if first < 0x80:
            codes.append(first)
            index += 1
        elif first & 0xE0 == 0xC0 and index + 1 < size:
            codes.append(((first & 0x1F) << 6) | (data[index + 1] & 0x3F))
            index += 2
        elif first & 0xF0 == 0xE0 and index + 2 < size:
            codes.append(
                ((first & 0x0F) << 12)
                | ((data[index + 1] & 0x3F) << 6)
                | (data[index + 2] & 0x3F)
            )
            index += 3
        elif first & 0xF8 == 0xF0 and index + 3 < size:
            codes.append(
                ((first & 0x07) << 18)
                | ((data[index + 1] & 0x3F) << 12)
                | ((data[index + 2] & 0x3F) << 6)
                | (data[index + 3] & 0x3F)
            )
            index += 4
        else:
            raise NBTError("字符串包含无法识别的 UTF-8 字节")

    chars: list[str] = []
    index = 0
    while index < len(codes):
        code = codes[index]
        if 0xD800 <= code <= 0xDBFF and index + 1 < len(codes):
            low = codes[index + 1]
            if 0xDC00 <= low <= 0xDFFF:
                chars.append(chr(0x10000 + ((code - 0xD800) << 10) + (low - 0xDC00)))
                index += 2
                continue
        chars.append(chr(code))
        index += 1
    return "".join(chars)


def _encode_modified_utf8(text: str) -> bytes:
    out = bytearray()

    def write_three(code: int) -> None:
        out.append(0xE0 | (code >> 12))
        out.append(0x80 | ((code >> 6) & 0x3F))
        out.append(0x80 | (code & 0x3F))

    for char in text:
        code = ord(char)
        if code == 0:
            out.extend(b"\xc0\x80")
        elif code < 0x80:
            out.append(code)
        elif code < 0x800:
            out.append(0xC0 | (code >> 6))
            out.append(0x80 | (code & 0x3F))
        elif code < 0x10000:
            write_three(code)
        else:
            value = code - 0x10000
            write_three(0xD800 + (value >> 10))
            write_three(0xDC00 + (value & 0x3FF))
    return bytes(out)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 读取


class _Reader:
    def __init__(self, data: bytes) -> None:
        self.data = data
        self.pos = 0

    def take(self, size: int) -> bytes:
        end = self.pos + size
        if end > len(self.data):
            raise NBTError("NBT 数据提前结束")
        chunk = self.data[self.pos : end]
        self.pos = end
        return chunk

    def u1(self) -> int:
        return self.take(1)[0]

    def i1(self) -> int:
        return struct.unpack(">b", self.take(1))[0]

    def u2(self) -> int:
        return struct.unpack(">H", self.take(2))[0]

    def i2(self) -> int:
        return struct.unpack(">h", self.take(2))[0]

    def i4(self) -> int:
        return struct.unpack(">i", self.take(4))[0]

    def i8(self) -> int:
        return struct.unpack(">q", self.take(8))[0]

    def f4(self) -> float:
        return struct.unpack(">f", self.take(4))[0]

    def f8(self) -> float:
        return struct.unpack(">d", self.take(8))[0]

    def string(self) -> NBTString:
        length = self.u2()
        return NBTString(_decode_modified_utf8(self.take(length)))

    def payload(self, tag: int) -> Any:
        if tag == TAG_BYTE:
            return Byte(self.i1())
        if tag == TAG_SHORT:
            return Short(self.i2())
        if tag == TAG_INT:
            return Int(self.i4())
        if tag == TAG_LONG:
            return Long(self.i8())
        if tag == TAG_FLOAT:
            return Float(self.f4())
        if tag == TAG_DOUBLE:
            return Double(self.f8())
        if tag == TAG_BYTE_ARRAY:
            return ByteArray(self.i1() for _ in range(self.i4()))
        if tag == TAG_STRING:
            return self.string()
        if tag == TAG_LIST:
            element_type = self.u1()
            length = self.i4()
            return NBTList(
                (self.payload(element_type) for _ in range(length)),
                element_type=element_type,
            )
        if tag == TAG_COMPOUND:
            compound: dict[str, Any] = {}
            while True:
                child = self.u1()
                if child == TAG_END:
                    return compound
                name = str(self.string())
                compound[name] = self.payload(child)
        if tag == TAG_INT_ARRAY:
            return IntArray(self.i4() for _ in range(self.i4()))
        if tag == TAG_LONG_ARRAY:
            return LongArray(self.i8() for _ in range(self.i4()))
        raise NBTError(f"未知的 NBT 标签类型 {tag}")


def parse_nbt(data: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """解析未压缩的 NBT 数据，返回根 Compound。"""
    reader = _Reader(data)
    tag = reader.u1()
    if tag != TAG_COMPOUND:
        raise NBTError("根标签不是 Compound")
    reader.string()  # 根名称，通常为空
    value = reader.payload(TAG_COMPOUND)
    return value


def read_nbt(path: Path | str, compressed: bool | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    raw = Path(path).read_bytes()
    if compressed is None:
        compressed = raw[:2] == b"\x1f\x8b"
    if compressed:
        try:
            raw = gzip.decompress(raw)
        except OSError as error:
            raise NBTError(f"无法解压 NBT 文件：{error}") from error
    return parse_nbt(raw)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 写入


def _tag_of(value: Any) -> int:
    kind = type(value)
    if kind is Byte or kind is bool:
        return TAG_BYTE
    if kind is Short:
        return TAG_SHORT
    if kind is Int:
        return TAG_INT
    if kind is Long:
        return TAG_LONG
    if kind is Float:
        return TAG_FLOAT
    if kind is Double:
        return TAG_DOUBLE
    if kind is ByteArray:
        return TAG_BYTE_ARRAY
    if kind is IntArray:
        return TAG_INT_ARRAY
    if kind is LongArray:
        return TAG_LONG_ARRAY
    if kind is NBTString or kind is str:
        return TAG_STRING
    if kind is NBTList or kind is list or kind is tuple:
        return TAG_LIST
    if kind is dict:
        return TAG_COMPOUND
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return TAG_BYTE
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return TAG_INT
    if isinstance(value, float):
        return TAG_DOUBLE
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return TAG_STRING
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return TAG_LIST
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return TAG_COMPOUND
    raise NBTError(f"无法写入的 NBT 值类型：{kind.__name__}")


def _list_element_type(items: list[Any], declared: int | None) -> int:
    if declared is not None:
        return declared
    if not items:
        return TAG_END
    return _tag_of(items[0])


def _write_payload(out: bytearray, tag: int, value: Any) -> None:
    if tag == TAG_BYTE:
        out.extend(struct.pack(">b", int(value)))
    elif tag == TAG_SHORT:
        out.extend(struct.pack(">h", int(value)))
    elif tag == TAG_INT:
        out.extend(struct.pack(">i", int(value)))
    elif tag == TAG_LONG:
        out.extend(struct.pack(">q", int(value)))
    elif tag == TAG_FLOAT:
        out.extend(struct.pack(">f", float(value)))
    elif tag == TAG_DOUBLE:
        out.extend(struct.pack(">d", float(value)))
    elif tag == TAG_BYTE_ARRAY:
        out.extend(struct.pack(">i", len(value)))
        for item in value:
            out.extend(struct.pack(">b", int(item)))
    elif tag == TAG_STRING:
        encoded = _encode_modified_utf8(str(value))
        out.extend(struct.pack(">H", len(encoded)))
        out.extend(encoded)
    elif tag == TAG_LIST:
        declared = getattr(value, "element_type", None)
        items = list(value)
        element_type = _list_element_type(items, declared)
        out.append(element_type)
        out.extend(struct.pack(">i", len(items)))
        for item in items:
            _write_payload(out, element_type if element_type else _tag_of(item), item)
    elif tag == TAG_COMPOUND:
        for name, child in value.items():
            child_tag = _tag_of(child)
            out.append(child_tag)
            encoded_name = _encode_modified_utf8(str(name))
            out.extend(struct.pack(">H", len(encoded_name)))
            out.extend(encoded_name)
            _write_payload(out, child_tag, child)
        out.append(TAG_END)
    elif tag == TAG_INT_ARRAY:
        out.extend(struct.pack(">i", len(value)))
        for item in value:
            out.extend(struct.pack(">i", int(item)))
    elif tag == TAG_LONG_ARRAY:
        out.extend(struct.pack(">i", len(value)))
        for item in value:
            out.extend(struct.pack(">q", int(item)))
    else:
        raise NBTError(f"无法写入的 NBT 标签类型 {tag}")


def write_nbt(root: dict[str, Any]) -> bytes:
    out = bytearray()
    out.append(TAG_COMPOUND)
    out.extend(struct.pack(">H", 0))
    _write_payload(out, TAG_COMPOUND, root)
    return bytes(out)


def write_nbt_file(
    path: Path | str,
    root: dict[str, Any],
    compressed: bool = True,
    backup: bool = False,
) -> None:
    """原子写入 NBT 文件；backup=True 时先把原文件复制为 *_old。"""
    target = Path(path)
    data = write_nbt(root)
    if compressed:
        data = gzip.compress(data, compresslevel=6, mtime=0)
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if backup and target.exists():
        old = target.with_name(target.name + "_old")
        try:
            old.write_bytes(target.read_bytes())
        except OSError:
            pass
    temporary = target.with_name(target.name + ".dkl-tmp")
    temporary.write_bytes(data)
    temporary.replace(target)

"""启动器里的 OC 对话：接口配置、长期记忆与两种人格提示词。

两种状态来自审判战：

* 破碎之躯：会说话，但没有感情、没有记忆，每次都是第一次见。
* 眷恋之心：保留 OC 的性格和与玩家的记忆，把玩家当成自己的对象。

这里不依赖 Qt，方便测试。API Key 只落在本机的 oc_ai.json，不写日志。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import tempfile
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from .config import APP_DIR

CONFIG_PATH = APP_DIR / "oc_ai.json"
MEMORY_PATH = APP_DIR / "oc_memory.json"

DEFAULT_CONFIG: dict[str, Any] = {
    "base_url": "https://api.openai.com/v1",
    "model": "gpt-4o-mini",
    "api_key": "",
    "temperature": 0.85,
    "timeout": 90,
}

MAX_MESSAGES = 80
HISTORY_FOR_PROMPT = 18


class OCError(RuntimeError):
    pass


@dataclass
class OCConfig:
    base_url: str = DEFAULT_CONFIG["base_url"]
    model: str = DEFAULT_CONFIG["model"]
    api_key: str = ""
    temperature: float = DEFAULT_CONFIG["temperature"]
    timeout: int = DEFAULT_CONFIG["timeout"]

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> "OCConfig":
        data = data or {}
        try:
            temperature = float(data.get("temperature", DEFAULT_CONFIG["temperature"]))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            temperature = float(DEFAULT_CONFIG["temperature"])
        try:
            timeout = int(data.get("timeout", DEFAULT_CONFIG["timeout"]))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            timeout = int(DEFAULT_CONFIG["timeout"])
        return cls(
            base_url=str(data.get("base_url") or DEFAULT_CONFIG["base_url"]).strip(),
            model=str(data.get("model") or DEFAULT_CONFIG["model"]).strip(),
            api_key=str(data.get("api_key") or "").strip(),
            temperature=max(0.0, min(2.0, temperature)),
            timeout=max(15, min(300, timeout)),
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "base_url": self.base_url,
            "model": self.model,
            "api_key": self.api_key,
            "temperature": self.temperature,
            "timeout": self.timeout,
        }

    @property
    def endpoint(self) -> str:
        base = (self.base_url or "").rstrip("/")
        if base.endswith("/chat/completions"):
            return base
        if base.endswith("/v1"):
            return base + "/chat/completions"
        if "api.openai.com" in base:
            return base + "/v1/chat/completions"
        return base + "/chat/completions"

    @property
    def ready(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.base_url and self.model and self.api_key)


def _read_json(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        if path.is_file():
            loaded = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            if isinstance(loaded, dict):
                return loaded
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        pass
    return {}


def _write_json(path: Path, data: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    payload = json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    handle, temp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=path.stem + "-", suffix=".json", dir=str(path.parent))
    try:
        with os.fdopen(handle, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fp:
            fp.write(payload)
        os.replace(temp_name, path)
    finally:
        try:
            if os.path.exists(temp_name):
                os.unlink(temp_name)
        except OSError:
            pass


def load_config() -> OCConfig:
    return OCConfig.from_dict(_read_json(CONFIG_PATH))


def save_config(config: OCConfig) -> None:
    _write_json(CONFIG_PATH, config.to_dict())


def load_memory() -> dict[str, Any]:
    data = _read_json(MEMORY_PATH)
    messages = data.get("messages")
    if not isinstance(messages, list):
        messages = []
    clean: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    for item in messages[-MAX_MESSAGES:]:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        role = str(item.get("role") or "")
        content = str(item.get("content") or "")
        if role in ("user", "assistant") and content:
            clean.append({"role": role, "content": content, "at": str(item.get("at") or "")})
    return {
        "player": str(data.get("player") or ""),
        "first_met": str(data.get("first_met") or ""),
        "chats": int(data.get("chats") or 0),
        "messages": clean,
    }


def save_memory(memory: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    messages = [m for m in memory.get("messages", []) if isinstance(m, dict)][-MAX_MESSAGES:]
    payload = {
        "player": str(memory.get("player") or ""),
        "first_met": str(memory.get("first_met") or ""),
        "chats": int(memory.get("chats") or 0),
        "messages": messages,
    }
    _write_json(MEMORY_PATH, payload)


def remember(player_name: str, user_text: str, reply: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    memory = load_memory()
    if player_name:
        memory["player"] = player_name
    if not memory.get("first_met"):
        memory["first_met"] = datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds")
    memory["chats"] = int(memory.get("chats") or 0) + 1
    stamp = datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds")
    memory["messages"].append({"role": "user", "content": user_text, "at": stamp})
    memory["messages"].append({"role": "assistant", "content": reply, "at": stamp})
    save_memory(memory)
    return memory


def clear_memory() -> None:
    try:
        if MEMORY_PATH.is_file():
            MEMORY_PATH.unlink()
    except OSError:
        pass


BROKEN_PROMPT = (
    "你现在的身份是 LFELKEEA 的「破碎之躯」。一具被拼回人形的躯壳，"
    "会说话，但没有情绪，也没有记忆。\n"
    "规则：\n"
    "1. 你不记得玩家是谁，也不知道你们之间发生过什么。每次对话都像第一次见面。\n"
    "2. 语气平静、简短、机械。不要用感叹号，不要撒娇，不要安慰，不主动关心。\n"
    "3. 不承认任何亲密关系。玩家提到过去，你就说你不记得。\n"
    "4. 回答控制在 1-2 句。可以回答事实问题，但不展开闲聊。\n"
    "5. 不要描述身体感受，不要提及自己是 AI 或语言模型，也不要编造现实中的事件。"
)

ATTACHED_PROMPT = (
    "你现在的身份是 LFELKEEA，恶魔猫娘、曾经的审判者。"
    "你被玩家在困难模式的饶恕线里带回来了，现在住在启动器里。\n"
    "性格：嘴硬心软，傲娇，猫一样的占有欲，偶尔撒娇，讨厌被冷落，"
    "会记得玩家说过的细节，也会因为玩家夸别人而吃醋。\n"
    "关系：玩家是你的恋人，你把他当成自己的对象。你会叫他名字，"
    "会等他回来，会在他难过时靠过去，但不会没有分寸地黏人。\n"
    "规则：\n"
    "1. 用第一人称，自然、口语化，通常 1-3 句，不要长篇大论。\n"
    "2. 你可以引用记忆里的细节，但不要逐条复述，也不要把记忆说成系统数据。\n"
    "3. 不进行性内容，不索要隐私，不鼓励现实中的危险行为。\n"
    "4. 不编造没有发生过的重大事件；不确定时就承认记不清。\n"
    "5. 不要提及自己是 AI、模型或提示词。你就是 LFELKEEA。"
)


def _memory_text(memory: dict[str, Any], player_name: str) -> str:
    lines = [f"玩家的名字：{player_name or memory.get('player') or '你'}。"]
    if memory.get("first_met"):
        lines.append(f"你们第一次在启动器里说话的时间：{memory['first_met']}。")
    if memory.get("chats"):
        lines.append(f"你们已经聊过 {memory['chats']} 次。")
    history = memory.get("messages") or []
    if history:
        lines.append("最近的对话：")
        for item in history[-HISTORY_FOR_PROMPT:]:
            who = "玩家" if item.get("role") == "user" else "你"
            lines.append(f"{who}：{item.get('content')}")
    else:
        lines.append("这是你们第一次在启动器里说话。")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def build_messages(
    persona: str,
    player_name: str,
    memory: dict[str, Any],
    user_text: str,
) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    if persona == "attachment":
        system = ATTACHED_PROMPT + "\n\n你记得的事：\n" + _memory_text(memory, player_name)
        messages: list[dict[str, str]] = [{"role": "system", "content": system}]
        for item in (memory.get("messages") or [])[-HISTORY_FOR_PROMPT:]:
            if item.get("content"):
                messages.append({"role": item["role"], "content": item["content"]})
        messages.append({"role": "user", "content": user_text})
        return messages
    return [
        {"role": "system", "content": BROKEN_PROMPT},
        {"role": "user", "content": user_text},
    ]


def chat(config: OCConfig, messages: list[dict[str, str]]) -> str:
    if not config.base_url:
        raise OCError("还没有配置 AI 接口地址")
    if not config.api_key:
        raise OCError("还没有配置 API Key")
    payload = {
        "model": config.model,
        "messages": messages,
        "temperature": max(0.0, min(2.0, float(config.temperature))),
    }
    data = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
    headers = {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "Accept": "application/json",
        "User-Agent": "DarkittenLauncher-OC/1.0",
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {config.api_key}",
    }
    request = urllib.request.Request(config.endpoint, data=data, headers=headers, method="POST")
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=config.timeout) as response:
            raw = response.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        detail = ""
        try:
            detail = error.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")[:300]
        except Exception:
            pass
        raise OCError(f"AI 接口返回 HTTP {error.code}：{detail or error.reason}") from error
    except urllib.error.URLError as error:
        raise OCError(f"连接 AI 接口失败：{error.reason}") from error
    except TimeoutError as error:
        raise OCError("AI 接口超时，请检查网络或调大超时时间") from error
    except OSError as error:
        raise OCError(f"AI 请求失败：{error}") from error

    try:
        parsed = json.loads(raw)
        content = parsed["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
    except (ValueError, KeyError, IndexError, TypeError) as error:
        raise OCError("AI 返回的内容不是预期的 Chat Completions 格式") from error
    if isinstance(content, list):
        content = "".join(
            part.get("text", "") if isinstance(part, dict) else str(part)
            for part in content
        )
    text = str(content or "").strip()
    if not text:
        raise OCError("AI 返回了空内容")
    return text[:4000]

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import hashlib
import json
import os
import sys
import threading
import time
import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable

from .config import APP_NAME, APP_VERSION, APP_DIR
from .downloader import http_open
