AUTHLIB_VERSION = "1.2.8"
AUTHLIB_SHA256 = "9c7f4343e6c82034958ffb48c14a2cb0c85928be7283103ce17da00c6d5a7b10"
AUTHLIB_DIR = APP_DIR / "runtime"
AUTHLIB_JAR = AUTHLIB_DIR / f"authlib-injector-{AUTHLIB_VERSION}.jar"
AUTHLIB_URLS = (
    f"https://authlib-injector.yushi.moe/artifact/56/authlib-injector-{AUTHLIB_VERSION}.jar",
    f"https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com/mirrors/authlib-injector/artifact/56/authlib-injector-{AUTHLIB_VERSION}.jar",
    f"https://github.com/yushijinhun/authlib-injector/releases/download/v{AUTHLIB_VERSION}/authlib-injector-{AUTHLIB_VERSION}.jar",
    f"https://ghfast.top/https://github.com/yushijinhun/authlib-injector/releases/download/v{AUTHLIB_VERSION}/authlib-injector-{AUTHLIB_VERSION}.jar",
)

# 这组密钥只用于本机 127.0.0.1 皮肤服务的 textures 属性签名，
# 不会用于联网身份验证，也不代表任何 Mojang / Microsoft 凭据。
_PUBLIC_KEY_PEM = """-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----
MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEA2IwWFmDr31AX97HIvmDW
Oir0pxVtoMUvjcKpynNUb9ccH7mFVw2vvUo9HqumpThewe9ERg8cnWnL7j/m7ozV
Y1rsulYLKFGHI0Nujgvg2/oawkc2g7LwExxkHyE/mvCT1xspAhX2NSLTnYKrd0vM
zlhXyCAIDjiiqHtewiVA5EuVH1ZhJ3llDZ6uu/PfwHrK0eD6HHnlULjyWPvY3OAR
p6KDD86fhU1Ebvmshndk3QzAZVnMwm3x5CZKYt+e6e+9/ucwoTZ5CsMRqPCWtdP5
PHY2QzZ+xVe8LSzBBZS2wtoajWgETkM2NVcFmjBtk6aEWYITkr46VNOxux4VuVIZ
VQIDAQAB
-----END PUBLIC KEY-----
"""
_RSA_N = int(
    ""
)
_RSA_E = 65537
_RSA_D = int(
    ""
)
_RSA_KEY_BYTES = (_RSA_N.bit_length() + 7) // 8
_SHA1_DIGEST_INFO = bytes.fromhex("3021300906052b0e03021a05000414")


class OfflineSkinError(Exception):
    pass


def _sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    try:
        return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    except OSError:
        return ""


def ensure_authlib_jar(
    status_cb: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
) -> Path:
    if AUTHLIB_JAR.is_file() and _sha256_file(AUTHLIB_JAR) == AUTHLIB_SHA256:
        return AUTHLIB_JAR
    AUTHLIB_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    errors: list[str] = []
    for index, url in enumerate(AUTHLIB_URLS, start=1):
        if status_cb is not None:
            status_cb(f"正在准备离线皮肤组件（{index}/{len(AUTHLIB_URLS)}）…")
        try:
            with http_open(url, timeout=45) as response:
                data = response.read(8 * 1024 * 1024)
            if not data.startswith(b"PK\x03\x04"):
                raise OfflineSkinError("下载到的文件不是有效的 JAR。")
            if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != AUTHLIB_SHA256:
                raise OfflineSkinError("组件校验失败，已拒绝使用。")
            tmp = AUTHLIB_JAR.with_name(AUTHLIB_JAR.name + ".tmp")
            tmp.write_bytes(data)
            os.replace(tmp, AUTHLIB_JAR)
            if status_cb is not None:
                status_cb("离线皮肤组件已就绪。")
            return AUTHLIB_JAR
        except Exception as exc:
            errors.append(f"{url}：{exc}")
            try:
                AUTHLIB_JAR.with_name(AUTHLIB_JAR.name + ".tmp").unlink(
                    missing_ok=True
                )
            except OSError:
                pass
    detail = errors[-1] if errors else "未知错误"
    raise OfflineSkinError(f"无法下载离线皮肤组件：{detail}")


def sign_texture_value(value: str) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha1(value.encode("utf-8")).digest()
    payload = _SHA1_DIGEST_INFO + digest
    padding = b"\xff" * (_RSA_KEY_BYTES - len(payload) - 3)
    encoded = b"\x00\x01" + padding + b"\x00" + payload
    signature = pow(int.from_bytes(encoded, "big"), _RSA_D, _RSA_N)
    return base64.b64encode(
        signature.to_bytes(_RSA_KEY_BYTES, "big")
    ).decode("ascii")


def _compact_uuid(value: str) -> str:
    return str(value or "").replace("-", "").lower()


class OfflineSkinServer:
    """在 127.0.0.1 上模拟 Yggdrasil，供 authlib-injector 读取皮肤。"""

    def __init__(
        self,
        player_name: str,
        player_uuid: str,
        skin_data: bytes,
        variant: str = "classic",
    ) -> None:
        if not skin_data:
            raise OfflineSkinError("离线皮肤数据为空。")
        self.player_name = str(player_name or "").strip()
        self.player_uuid_dashed = str(player_uuid or "").strip()
        self.player_uuid = _compact_uuid(self.player_uuid_dashed)
        self.texture_hash = hashlib.sha256(skin_data).hexdigest()
        self.skin_data = skin_data
        self.variant = "slim" if str(variant).lower() == "slim" else "classic"
        self.access_token = uuid.uuid4().hex
        self.client_token = uuid.uuid4().hex
        self._httpd: ThreadingHTTPServer | None = None
        self._thread: threading.Thread | None = None

    @property
    def url(self) -> str:
        if self._httpd is None:
            return ""
        host, port = self._httpd.server_address[:2]
        return f"http://{host}:{port}"

    def start(self) -> None:
        if self._httpd is not None:
            return
        server = self

        class Handler(_SkinRequestHandler):
            pass

        class Server(ThreadingHTTPServer):
            daemon_threads = True
            allow_reuse_address = True
            runtime = server

            def handle_error(self, request, client_address) -> None:
                # authlib-injector 读取完元数据后会主动断开短连接，
                # 这是正常行为，不需要把 ConnectionResetError 打到日志里。
                error = sys.exc_info()[1]
                if isinstance(
                    error,
                    (ConnectionResetError, ConnectionAbortedError, BrokenPipeError),
                ):
                    return
                super().handle_error(request, client_address)

        try:
            self._httpd = Server(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
        except OSError as exc:
            raise OfflineSkinError(f"无法启动本地皮肤服务：{exc}") from exc
        self._thread = threading.Thread(
            target=self._httpd.serve_forever,
            kwargs={"poll_interval": 0.15},
            daemon=True,
            name="dkl-offline-skin",
        )
        self._thread.start()

    def stop(self) -> None:
        httpd = self._httpd
        self._httpd = None
        if httpd is not None:
            try:
                httpd.shutdown()
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                httpd.server_close()
            except Exception:
                pass
        thread = self._thread
        self._thread = None
        if thread is not None and thread.is_alive():
            thread.join(timeout=1.0)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def metadata(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "meta": {
                "serverName": f"{APP_NAME} 离线皮肤",
                "implementationName": APP_NAME,
                "implementationVersion": APP_VERSION,
                "feature.non_email_login": True,
            },
            "skinDomains": ["127.0.0.1", "localhost"],
            "signaturePublickey": _PUBLIC_KEY_PEM,
        }

    def texture_payload(self) -> str:
        textures: dict[str, Any] = {
            "SKIN": {"url": f"{self.url}/textures/{self.texture_hash}"}
        }
        if self.variant == "slim":
            textures["SKIN"]["metadata"] = {"model": "slim"}
        payload = {
            "timestamp": int(time.time() * 1000),
            "profileId": self.player_uuid,
            "profileName": self.player_name,
            "textures": textures,
        }
        raw = json.dumps(
            payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")
        ).encode("utf-8")
        return base64.b64encode(raw).decode("ascii")

    def profile(self, *, complete: bool = True) -> dict[str, Any]:
        response: dict[str, Any] = {
            "id": self.player_uuid,
            "name": self.player_name,
        }
        if complete:
            value = self.texture_payload()
            response["properties"] = [
                {
                    "name": "textures",
                    "value": value,
                    "signature": sign_texture_value(value),
                }
            ]
        return response


class _SkinRequestHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    server_version = f"DarkittenSkin/{APP_VERSION}"
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"

    @property
    def runtime(self) -> OfflineSkinServer:
        return self.server.runtime  # type: ignore[attr-defined]

    def log_message(self, format: str, *args: Any) -> None:
        return

    def _send(
        self,
        status: int,
        body: bytes = b"",
        content_type: str = "application/json; charset=utf-8",
        cache: str = "no-store",
    ) -> None:
        self.send_response(status)
        if body:
            self.send_header("Content-Type", content_type)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.send_header("Cache-Control", cache)
        self.end_headers()
        if body:
            try:
                self.wfile.write(body)
            except OSError:
                pass

    def _json(self, payload: Any, status: int = 200) -> None:
        body = json.dumps(
            payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")
        ).encode("utf-8")
        self._send(status, body)

    def _no_content(self) -> None:
        self._send(204)

    def _read_json(self) -> Any:
        try:
            length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
        except ValueError:
            length = 0
        if length <= 0:
            return None
        try:
            return json.loads(self.rfile.read(min(length, 1024 * 1024)))
        except Exception:
            return None

    def do_GET(self) -> None:
        runtime = self.runtime
        parsed = urlsplit(self.path)
        path = parsed.path.rstrip("/") or "/"

        if path == "/":
            self._json(runtime.metadata())
            return
        if path == "/status":
            self._json(
                {
                    "user.count": 1,
                    "token.count": 1,
                    "pendingAuthentication.count": 0,
                }
            )
            return
        if path == "/sessionserver/session/minecraft/hasJoined":
            names = parse_qs(parsed.query).get("username") or []
            if names and names[0] == runtime.player_name:
                self._json(runtime.profile(complete=True))
            else:
                self._no_content()
            return
        prefix = "/sessionserver/session/minecraft/profile/"
        if path.startswith(prefix):
            requested = _compact_uuid(path[len(prefix) :])
            if requested and requested == runtime.player_uuid:
                self._json(runtime.profile(complete=True))
            else:
                self._no_content()
            return
        prefix = "/textures/"
        if path.startswith(prefix):
            requested = path[len(prefix) :].lower()
            if requested == runtime.texture_hash:
                self._send(
                    200,
                    runtime.skin_data,
                    "image/png",
                    "public, max-age=2592000",
                )
            else:
                self._no_content()
            return
        if path == "/authserver/validate":
            self._no_content()
            return
        self._no_content()

    def do_POST(self) -> None:
        runtime = self.runtime
        parsed = urlsplit(self.path)
        path = parsed.path.rstrip("/") or "/"

        if path == "/api/profiles/minecraft":
            names = self._read_json()
            if not isinstance(names, list):
                names = []
            if runtime.player_name in [str(name) for name in names]:
                self._json(
                    [
                        {
                            "id": runtime.player_uuid,
                            "name": runtime.player_name,
                        }
                    ]
                )
            else:
                self._json([])
            return
        if path in (
            "/authserver/authenticate",
            "/authserver/refresh",
        ):
            profile = {
                "id": runtime.player_uuid,
                "name": runtime.player_name,
            }
            self._json(
                {
                    "accessToken": runtime.access_token,
                    "clientToken": runtime.client_token,
                    "availableProfiles": [profile],
                    "selectedProfile": profile,
                }
            )
            return
        if path == "/sessionserver/session/minecraft/join":
            self._no_content()
            return
        if path == "/authserver/validate":
            self._no_content()
            return
        self._no_content()


@dataclass
class OfflineSkinRuntime:
    server: OfflineSkinServer
    jar: Path
    jvm_args: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    note: str = ""
    _closed: bool = False

    def close(self) -> None:
        if self._closed:
            return
        self._closed = True
        self.server.stop()


def active_skin_path(cfg) -> Path | None:
    candidates: list[Path] = []
    configured = str(getattr(cfg, "skin_path", "") or "").strip()
    if configured:
        candidates.append(Path(configured))
    local = local_skin_path()
    if local not in candidates:
        candidates.append(local)
    for path in candidates:
        try:
            if path.is_file():
                return path
        except OSError:
            continue
    return None


def prepare_offline_runtime(
    cfg,
    player_name: str,
    player_uuid: str,
    status_cb: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
) -> OfflineSkinRuntime | None:
    path = active_skin_path(cfg)
    if path is None:
        return None
    try:
        skin = load_skin_file(path)
    except SkinError:
        return None
    if status_cb is not None:
        status_cb("正在准备离线皮肤…")
    jar = ensure_authlib_jar(status_cb)
    variant = "classic" if skin.legacy else str(
        getattr(cfg, "skin_variant", "classic") or "classic"
    )
    server = OfflineSkinServer(
        player_name, player_uuid, skin.data, variant=variant
    )
    try:
        server.start()
    except Exception:
        server.stop()
        raise
    args = [
        f"-javaagent:{jar}={server.url}",
        "-Dauthlibinjector.side=client",
    ]
    return OfflineSkinRuntime(
        server=server,
        jar=jar,
        jvm_args=args,
        note=(
            f"已启用离线皮肤：{player_name} · "
            f"{variant_text(variant)}（本地服务 {server.url}）"
        ),
    )

# 硬件探测与推荐


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class GpuInfo:
    name: str
    vram_mb: int = 0
    kind: str = "other"

    @property
    def label(self) -> str:
        memory = f" · {self.vram_mb // 1024} GB" if self.vram_mb >= 1024 else ""
        return f"{self.name}{memory}"


_TOTAL_RAM: int | None = None
_GPU_CACHE: list[GpuInfo] | None = None
_SYSTEM_CACHE: dict[str, Any] = {}


class _MemoryStatusEx(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("dwLength", ctypes.c_ulong),
        ("dwMemoryLoad", ctypes.c_ulong),
        ("ullTotalPhys", ctypes.c_ulonglong),
        ("ullAvailPhys", ctypes.c_ulonglong),
        ("ullTotalPageFile", ctypes.c_ulonglong),
        ("ullAvailPageFile", ctypes.c_ulonglong),
        ("ullTotalVirtual", ctypes.c_ulonglong),
        ("ullAvailVirtual", ctypes.c_ulonglong),
        ("ullAvailExtendedVirtual", ctypes.c_ulonglong),
    ]


def system_memory_mb() -> int:
    """读取物理内存；失败时退回 8 GB，保证推荐值永远可用。"""
    global _TOTAL_RAM
    if _TOTAL_RAM is not None:
        return _TOTAL_RAM
    total = 0
    try:
        status = _MemoryStatusEx()
        status.dwLength = ctypes.sizeof(_MemoryStatusEx)
        if ctypes.windll.kernel32.GlobalMemoryStatusEx(ctypes.byref(status)):
            total = int(status.ullTotalPhys // (1024 * 1024))
    except Exception:
        total = 0
    if not total:
        try:
            total = int(os.sysconf("SC_PHYS_PAGES") * os.sysconf("SC_PAGE_SIZE") // (1024 * 1024))
        except Exception:
            total = 0
    _TOTAL_RAM = total if total > 0 else 8192
    return _TOTAL_RAM


def _gpu_kind(name: str) -> str:
    low = name.lower()
    if "nvidia" in low or "geforce" in low or "rtx" in low or "gtx" in low:
        return "nvidia"
    if "amd" in low or "radeon" in low or "rx " in low:
        return "amd"
    if "intel" in low or "arc" in low or "iris xe" in low or "uhd" in low:
        return "intel"
    return "other"


def detect_gpus(refresh: bool = False) -> list[GpuInfo]:
    """通过 PowerShell 读取显卡名称与显存；结果在进程内缓存。"""
    global _GPU_CACHE
    if _GPU_CACHE is not None and not refresh:
        return _GPU_CACHE
    if sys.platform != "win32":
        _GPU_CACHE = []
        return _GPU_CACHE
    command = (
        "Get-CimInstance Win32_VideoController | "
        "Select-Object Name,AdapterRAM | ConvertTo-Json -Compress"
    )
    flags = getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0)
    try:
        completed = subprocess.run(
            ["powershell", "-NoProfile", "-Command", command],
            capture_output=True,
            timeout=12,
            creationflags=flags,
            check=False,
        )
        raw = completed.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore").strip()
        if not raw:
            raw = completed.stdout.decode("gbk", errors="ignore").strip()
        data = json.loads(raw) if raw else []
    except Exception:
        data = []
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        data = [data]
    gpus: list[GpuInfo] = []
    if isinstance(data, list):
        for item in data:
            if not isinstance(item, dict):
                continue
            name = str(item.get("Name") or "").strip()
            if not name:
                continue
            try:
                vram = max(0, int(item.get("AdapterRAM") or 0) // (1024 * 1024))
            except Exception:
                vram = 0
            gpus.append(GpuInfo(name=name, vram_mb=vram, kind=_gpu_kind(name)))
    _GPU_CACHE = gpus
    return gpus


def recommend_memory_mb(
    total_ram_mb: int, mod_count: int = 0, loader: str = ""
) -> int:
    total = max(2048, int(total_ram_mb or 8192))
    if total <= 4096:
        budget = max(1536, int(total * 0.55))
    elif total <= 8192:
        budget = int(total * 0.50)
    elif total <= 16384:
        budget = int(total * 0.45)
    else:
        budget = int(total * 0.40)
    base = 3072 if loader else 2048
    mods_bonus = min(4096, (max(0, int(mod_count)) // 20) * 512) if loader else 0
    target = max(base + mods_bonus, base)
    target = min(target, budget, 16384)
    target = int(round(target / 512.0) * 512)
    return max(1024, min(target, total - 1024))


def recommended_jvm_args() -> str:
    """Aikar 风格的 G1 参数，适合现代 Minecraft 服务端/客户端。"""
    return (
        "-XX:+UseG1GC -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 "
        "-XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+DisableExplicitGC "
        "-XX:+AlwaysPreTouch -XX:G1NewSizePercent=30 "
        "-XX:G1MaxNewSizePercent=40 -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=8M "
        "-XX:G1ReservePercent=20 -XX:G1HeapWastePercent=5 "
        "-XX:G1MixedGCCountTarget=4 -XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=15 "
        "-XX:G1MixedGCLiveThresholdPercent=90 "
        "-XX:G1RSetUpdatingPauseTimePercent=5 -XX:SurvivorRatio=32 "
        "-XX:+PerfDisableSharedMem -XX:MaxTenuringThreshold=1"
    )


def suggest_graphics_profile(gpus: Iterable[GpuInfo], total_ram_mb: int = 0) -> str:
    items = list(gpus or [])
    names = " ".join(item.name.lower() for item in items)
    if not items:
        return "balanced"
    if any(keyword in names for keyword in ("rtx", "rx 6", "rx 7", "rx 9")):
        return "quality"
    if any(
        keyword in names
        for keyword in ("gtx 16", "gtx 10", "rx 5", "arc a", "rtx")
    ):
        return "quality"
    if any(item.kind in ("nvidia", "amd") for item in items):
        return "balanced"
    if "intel" in names:
        return "performance"
    if total_ram_mb and total_ram_mb <= 8192:
        return "performance"
    return "balanced"

    "fabric": _FABRIC_MODS,

    "neoforge": _FORGE_MODS,
    "forge": _FORGE_MODS,
    "": (),
}


def catalog_for(loader: str) -> tuple[OptimizationMod, ...]:
    from .game_context import loader_key

    return CATALOG.get(loader_key(loader), ())


def is_optifine_installed(mods_dir: Path) -> bool:
    for path in all_mod_files(mods_dir):
        if "optifine" in normalize_token(path.name):
            return True
    return False


def _present_mods(
    mods_dir: Path,
    catalog: Iterable[OptimizationMod],
) -> tuple[list[OptimizationMod], list[Path]]:
    files = all_mod_files(mods_dir)
    keys = installed_meta_keys(mods_dir)
    present: list[OptimizationMod] = []
    for mod in catalog:
        hit = any(key in keys for key in (mod.slug.lower(),))
        if not hit:
            tokens = mod.tokens or (mod.slug,)
            hit = any(filename_matches(path.name, *tokens) for path in files)
        if hit:
            present.append(mod)
    return present, files


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 优化计划与执行


@dataclass
class OptimizationPlan:
    context: LoaderContext
    total_ram_mb: int
    gpus: list[GpuInfo]
    mod_count: int
    optifine: bool
    present: list[OptimizationMod]
    missing: list[OptimizationMod]
    warnings: list[str]
    current_memory_mb: int
    recommended_memory_mb: int
    current_jvm_args: str
    recommended_jvm_args: str

    @property
    def loader_label(self) -> str:
        return self.context.loader_label

    @property
    def mc_version(self) -> str:
        return self.context.mc_version

    @property
    def game_dir(self) -> Path:
        return self.context.game_dir

    @property
    def mods_dir(self) -> Path:
        return self.context.mods_dir

    @property
    def has_loader(self) -> bool:
        return self.context.has_loader


@dataclass
class InstalledOptimization:
    kind: str
    slug: str
    title: str
    filename: str
    sha1: str = ""
    version_id: str = ""
    project_id: str = ""


@dataclass
class OptimizationResult:
    memory_mb: int = 0
    jvm_args: str = ""
    installed: list[InstalledOptimization] = field(default_factory=list)
    errors: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    cancelled: bool = False


def build_optimization_plan(
    version_id: str,
    config,
    versions: Iterable,
    *,
    total_ram_mb: int | None = None,
    gpus: list[GpuInfo] | None = None,
) -> OptimizationPlan:
    context = resolve_context(version_id, versions, config)
    mods = enabled_mod_files(context.mods_dir)
    optifine = is_optifine_installed(context.mods_dir)
    catalog = catalog_for(context.loader)
    present, _files = _present_mods(context.mods_dir, catalog)

    warnings: list[str] = []
    if not context.has_loader:
        warnings.append("原版客户端没有可安装的优化 Mod，只会调整内存与 JVM 参数。")
    elif not catalog:
        warnings.append(f"{context.loader_label} 暂未提供自动优化 Mod。")

    missing: list[OptimizationMod] = []
    for mod in catalog:
        if mod in present:
            continue
        if mod.is_renderer and optifine:
            warnings.append("检测到 OptiFine，已跳过 Sodium/Embeddium 渲染优化，避免冲突。")
            continue
        missing.append(mod)

    if optifine:
        warnings.append("OptiFine 与部分优化 Mod 可能冲突；启动器不会卸载或改动 OptiFine。")
    if context.loader_key == "forge" and missing:
        warnings.append("Forge 的优化 Mod 适配版本较少，安装时会自动跳过不兼容项。")

    total = int(total_ram_mb or system_memory_mb())
    gpu_list = list(gpus if gpus is not None else detect_gpus())
    current_memory = int(config.memory_for(version_id))
    return OptimizationPlan(
        context=context,
        total_ram_mb=total,
        gpus=gpu_list,
        mod_count=len(mods),
        optifine=optifine,
        present=present,
        missing=missing,
        warnings=_dedupe(warnings),
        current_memory_mb=current_memory,
        recommended_memory_mb=recommend_memory_mb(
            total, len(mods), context.loader
        ),
        current_jvm_args=str(config.jvm_args_for(version_id) or ""),
        recommended_jvm_args=recommended_jvm_args(),
    )


def _dedupe(items: Iterable[str]) -> list[str]:
    return list(dict.fromkeys(item for item in items if item))


def _state_dir(game_dir: Path) -> Path:
    return Path(game_dir) / STATE_DIR_NAME


def _state_path(game_dir: Path) -> Path:
    return _state_dir(game_dir) / STATE_FILE_NAME


def load_state(game_dir: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        data = json.loads(_state_path(game_dir).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        return {}
    return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}


def _save_state(game_dir: Path, state: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    directory = _state_dir(game_dir)
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target = directory / STATE_FILE_NAME
    temp = target.with_name(target.name + ".tmp")
    temp.write_text(
        json.dumps(state, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
    )
    temp.replace(target)


def _ensure_state(game_dir: Path, version_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    state = load_state(game_dir)
    if state.get("active"):
        return state
    return {
        "version": 1,
        "active": True,
        "version_id": version_id,
        "created_at": time.time(),
        "installed": [],
    }


def _snapshot_settings(
    state: dict[str, Any], config, version_id: str
) -> None:
    if isinstance(state.get("settings"), dict):
        return
    memory_exists = version_id in config.version_memory
    jvm_exists = version_id in config.version_jvm_args
    state["settings"] = {
        "memory": {
            "existed": memory_exists,
            "value": int(config.version_memory.get(version_id, config.memory_mb)),
        },
        "jvm_args": {
            "existed": jvm_exists,
            "value": str(config.version_jvm_args.get(version_id, config.jvm_args)),
        },
    }


def metadata_for(
    project: dict[str, Any],
    version: dict[str, Any],
    path: Path,
    context: LoaderContext,
    content_type: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    file = modrinth.primary_file(version) or {}
    hashes = file.get("hashes") if isinstance(file.get("hashes"), dict) else {}
    slug = str(project.get("slug") or project.get("id") or "")
    kind = "shader" if content_type == "shader" else "resourcepack" if content_type == "resourcepack" else "mod"
    page_kind = "shader" if kind == "shader" else "resourcepack" if kind == "resourcepack" else "mod"
    return {
        "title": str(project.get("title") or path.stem),
        "project_id": str(project.get("id") or ""),
        "slug": slug,
        "source": "modrinth",
        "source_label": "Modrinth",
        "version_id": str(version.get("id") or ""),
        "file_id": str(version.get("id") or ""),
        "file_name": path.name,
        "sha1": str(hashes.get("sha1") or ""),
        "content_type": kind,
        "icon_url": str(project.get("icon_url") or ""),
        "author": "",
        "categories": project.get("categories") or [],
        "loaders": version.get("loaders") or [],
        "game_versions": version.get("game_versions") or [],
        "downloads": project.get("downloads") or 0,
        "description": str(project.get("description") or ""),
        "project_url": f"https://modrinth.com/{page_kind}/{slug}",
        "game_version": context.mc_version,
        "loader": context.loader,
    }


class _ModInstaller:
    """串行安装 Mod 与其前置依赖，重复项目只下载一次。"""

    def __init__(
        self,
        context: LoaderContext,
        *,
        threads: int = 8,
        cancel_event=None,
        progress_cb: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.context = context
        self.threads = max(1, min(16, int(threads or 8)))
        self.cancel = cancel_event
        self.progress = progress_cb or (lambda p, m: None)
        self.known = installed_meta_keys(context.mods_dir)
        self.claimed: set[str] = set()
        self.installed: list[InstalledOptimization] = []
        self.errors: list[str] = []
        self._count = 0
        self._limit = 28

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _cancelled(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.cancel is not None and self.cancel.is_set())

    def _error(self, message: str) -> None:
        if message and message not in self.errors:
            self.errors.append(message)

    def _mark(self, project: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        for key in (project.get("id"), project.get("slug")):
            value = str(key or "").strip().lower()
            if value:
                self.claimed.add(value)
                self.known.add(value)

    def _project_known(self, project: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
        values = [
            str(project.get("id") or "").lower(),
            str(project.get("slug") or "").lower(),
        ]
        if any(value and value in self.known for value in values):
            return True
        tokens = [value for value in values if value]
        for path in all_mod_files(self.context.mods_dir):
            if filename_matches(path.name, *tokens):
                self.known.add(path.name.lower())
                return True
        return False

    def _pick_versions(
        self,
        project: dict[str, Any],
        content_type: str,
        preferred_version_id: str = "",
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        project_id = str(project.get("id") or "")
        if content_type in ("shader", "resourcepack"):
            versions = modrinth.fetch_mod_versions(
                project_id, "", self.context.mc_version, content_type
            )
            if not versions:
                versions = modrinth.fetch_mod_versions(
                    project_id, "", "", content_type
                )
        else:
            versions = []
            for key in loader_candidates(self.context.loader):
                loader_name = LOADER_NAMES.get(key, key)
                found = modrinth.fetch_mod_versions(
                    project_id,
                    loader_name,
                    self.context.mc_version,
                    "mod",
                )
                if found:
                    versions = found
                    break
        if preferred_version_id:
            exact = [
                item
                for item in versions
                if str(item.get("id") or "") == str(preferred_version_id)
            ]
            if exact:
                return exact + [item for item in versions if item not in exact]
        return versions

    def install_project(
        self,
        ident: str,
        *,
        title: str = "",
        content_type: str = "mod",
        preferred_version_id: str = "",
        depth: int = 0,
    ) -> Path | None:
        if self._cancelled():
            return None
        ident = str(ident or "").strip()
        if not ident or ident.lower() in self.claimed:
            return None
        if self._count >= self._limit:
            self._error("依赖数量超过上限，已停止继续安装前置 Mod")
            return None
        try:
            project = modrinth.fetch_project(ident)
        except Exception as exc:
            self._error(f"{title or ident} 查询失败：{exc}")
            return None
        slug = str(project.get("slug") or ident)
        name = str(title or project.get("title") or slug)
        self._mark(project)
        if content_type == "mod" and self._project_known(project):
            self.progress(100, f"{name} 已安装")
            return None

        try:
            versions = self._pick_versions(
                project, content_type, preferred_version_id
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            self._error(f"{name} 版本列表读取失败：{exc}")
            return None
        if not versions:
            self._error(
                f"{name} 没有适配 {self.context.loader_label} "
                f"{self.context.mc_version} 的文件，已跳过"
            )
            return None
        version = versions[0]
        version_id = str(version.get("id") or "")

        if content_type == "mod":
            target_dir = self.context.mods_dir
        elif content_type == "shader":
            target_dir = self.context.shaderpacks_dir
        else:
            target_dir = self.context.resourcepacks_dir
        target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            path = modrinth.download_mod_file(
                version,
                target_dir,
                progress_cb=self.progress,
                cancel_event=self.cancel,
                threads=self.threads,
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            if self._cancelled():
                return None
            self._error(f"{name} 下载失败：{exc}")
            return None

        self._count += 1
        metadata = metadata_for(project, version, path, self.context, content_type)
        sha1 = str(metadata.get("sha1") or "")
        expected = str(sha1 or "").lower()
        if expected and file_sha1(path).lower() != expected:
            self._error(f"{name} 文件校验失败，已保留下载文件")
        if content_type == "mod":
            try:
                from .mods import remember_downloaded_mod

                remember_downloaded_mod(target_dir, path, metadata)
            except Exception:
                pass
        self.installed.append(
            InstalledOptimization(
                kind=content_type,
                slug=slug,
                title=name,
                filename=path.name,
                sha1=sha1 or file_sha1(path),
                version_id=version_id,
                project_id=str(project.get("id") or ""),
            )
        )
        self.progress(100, f"{name} 安装完成")

        if content_type == "mod" and depth < 2:
            for dep in modrinth.required_dependencies(version):
                if self._cancelled():
                    break
                dep_id = str(dep.get("project_id") or "").strip()
                if not dep_id:
                    continue
                try:
                    self.install_project(
                        dep_id,
                        content_type="mod",
                        preferred_version_id=str(dep.get("version_id") or ""),
                        depth=depth + 1,
                    )
                except Exception as exc:
                    self._error(f"{name} 的前置 Mod 安装失败：{exc}")
        return path


def apply_optimization(
    plan: OptimizationPlan,
    config,
    *,
    install_mods: bool = True,
    apply_memory: bool = True,
    apply_jvm: bool = True,
    threads: int = 8,
    progress_cb: OptimizeProgress | None = None,
    cancel_event=None,
) -> OptimizationResult:
    progress = progress_cb or (lambda p, m: None)
    context = plan.context
    state = _ensure_state(context.game_dir, context.version_id)
    result = OptimizationResult()

    if apply_memory or apply_jvm:
        _snapshot_settings(state, config, context.version_id)
    if apply_memory:
        config.version_memory[context.version_id] = int(plan.recommended_memory_mb)
        result.memory_mb = int(plan.recommended_memory_mb)
    if apply_jvm:
        config.version_jvm_args[context.version_id] = plan.recommended_jvm_args
        result.jvm_args = plan.recommended_jvm_args
    if apply_memory or apply_jvm:
        config.save()

    if install_mods and plan.has_loader and plan.missing:
        installer = _ModInstaller(
            context,
            threads=threads,
            cancel_event=cancel_event,
            progress_cb=None,
        )
        total = len(plan.missing)
        for index, mod in enumerate(plan.missing):
            if cancel_event is not None and cancel_event.is_set():
                result.cancelled = True
                break

            def on_file_progress(
                percent: int, message: str, i: int = index
            ) -> None:
                overall = int((i + max(0, min(100, int(percent))) / 100) / total * 100)
                progress(
                    overall,
                    f"[{i + 1}/{total}] {message}",
                )

            installer.progress = on_file_progress
            progress(int(index / total * 100), f"正在准备 {mod.title}…")
            installer.install_project(mod.slug, title=mod.title, content_type="mod")
        result.installed = list(installer.installed)
        result.errors = list(installer.errors)
        if installer.installed:
            state.setdefault("installed", []).extend(
                {
                    "kind": item.kind,
                    "slug": item.slug,
                    "title": item.title,
                    "filename": item.filename,
                    "sha1": item.sha1,
                    "version_id": item.version_id,
                    "project_id": item.project_id,
                }
                for item in installer.installed
            )
            state["installed"] = _dedupe_installed(state["installed"])
    elif install_mods and not plan.has_loader:
        progress(100, "原版客户端无需安装优化 Mod")
    else:
        progress(100, "优化 Mod 已经齐全")

    if not apply_memory and not apply_jvm and not result.installed:
        progress(100, "没有需要应用的优化")
        return result
    state["updated_at"] = time.time()
    _save_state(context.game_dir, state)
    progress(100, "性能优化完成" if not result.cancelled else "性能优化已取消")
    return result


def _dedupe_installed(items: Iterable[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    result: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    seen: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
    for item in reversed(list(items)):
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        key = (str(item.get("kind") or ""), str(item.get("filename") or ""))
        if not key[1] or key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        result.append(item)
    result.reverse()
    return result

# 画面一键升级


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class GraphicsProfile:
    key: str
    title: str
    subtitle: str
    options: dict[str, str]
    color: str = "green"


GRAPHICS_PROFILES: tuple[GraphicsProfile, ...] = (
    GraphicsProfile(
        key="performance",
        title="流畅",
        subtitle="优先帧率，适合核显与老显卡",
        options={
            "graphics": "fast",
            "renderDistance": "6",
            "simulationDistance": "5",
            "maxFps": "120",

def graphics_profile(key: str) -> GraphicsProfile:
    for profile in GRAPHICS_PROFILES:
        if profile.key == key:
            return profile
    return GRAPHICS_PROFILES[1]


def read_options(path: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    values: dict[str, str] = {}
    try:
        text = Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
    except OSError:
        return values
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if ":" not in line:
            continue
        key, value = line.split(":", 1)
        key = key.strip()
        if key:
            values[key] = value.strip()
    return values


def write_options(path: Path, updates: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    try:
        lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").splitlines()
    except OSError:
        lines = []
    pending = dict(updates)
    output: list[str] = []
    for line in lines:
        if ":" in line:
            key = line.split(":", 1)[0].strip()
            if key in pending:
                output.append(f"{key}:{pending.pop(key)}")
                continue
        output.append(line)
    for key, value in pending.items():
        output.append(f"{key}:{value}")
    path.write_text("\n".join(output) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


@dataclass
class GraphicsPlan:
    context: LoaderContext
    profile: GraphicsProfile
    current_options: dict[str, str]
    recommended_profile: str
    gpus: list[GpuInfo]
    optifine: bool
    iris_installed: bool
    shader_installed: bool
    can_install_iris: bool
    warnings: list[str]

    @property
    def loader_label(self) -> str:
        return self.context.loader_label

    @property
    def mc_version(self) -> str:
        return self.context.mc_version

    @property
    def game_dir(self) -> Path:
        return self.context.game_dir

    @property
    def shaderpacks_dir(self) -> Path:
        return self.context.shaderpacks_dir


@dataclass
class GraphicsResult:
    profile: str = ""
    options_written: bool = False
    installed: list[InstalledOptimization] = field(default_factory=list)
    errors: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    shader_file: str = ""
    iris_ready: bool = False
    cancelled: bool = False


def _has_file(directory: Path, *tokens: str) -> bool:
    try:
        files = [
            path
            for path in Path(directory).iterdir()
            if path.is_file()
        ]
    except OSError:
        return False
    return any(filename_matches(path.name, *tokens) for path in files)


def build_graphics_plan(
    version_id: str,
    config,
    versions: Iterable,
    profile_key: str = "",
    *,
    gpus: list[GpuInfo] | None = None,
) -> GraphicsPlan:
    context = resolve_context(version_id, versions, config)
    gpu_list = list(gpus if gpus is not None else detect_gpus())
    recommended = suggest_graphics_profile(gpu_list, system_memory_mb())
    profile = graphics_profile(profile_key or recommended)
    optifine = is_optifine_installed(context.mods_dir)
    iris = _has_file(context.mods_dir, "iris")
    shader = _has_file(context.shaderpacks_dir, "complementary", "reimagined")
    can_iris = context.loader_key in ("fabric", "quilt", "neoforge") and not optifine
    warnings: list[str] = []
    if not context.has_loader:
        warnings.append("原版客户端只能调整画面参数；光影需要 Iris，而 Iris 需要 Fabric/Quilt/NeoForge。")
    elif context.loader_key == "forge":
        warnings.append("Forge 暂不自动安装 Iris。画面参数仍会生效，光影请手动使用 OptiFine 或改用 NeoForge。")
    if optifine:
        warnings.append("检测到 OptiFine，已保留它作为光影加载方案，不安装 Iris。")
    if not gpu_list:
        warnings.append("没有读取到显卡信息，已按均衡档推荐。")
    return GraphicsPlan(
        context=context,
        profile=profile,
        current_options=read_options(context.options_path),
        recommended_profile=recommended,
        gpus=gpu_list,
        optifine=optifine,
        iris_installed=iris,
        shader_installed=shader,
        can_install_iris=can_iris,
        warnings=_dedupe(warnings),
    )


def _backup_options(state: dict[str, Any], context: LoaderContext) -> None:
    if "options_backup" in state:
        return
    directory = _state_dir(context.game_dir)
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    existed = context.options_path.is_file()
    state["options_existed"] = existed
    if existed:
        backup = directory / OPTIONS_BACKUP_NAME
        shutil.copy2(context.options_path, backup)
        state["options_backup"] = str(backup)


def _backup_iris(state: dict[str, Any], path: Path) -> None:
    if "iris_backup" in state:
        return
    directory = _state_dir(path.parent.parent)
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    existed = path.is_file()
    state["iris_existed"] = existed
    if existed:
        backup = directory / IRIS_BACKUP_NAME
        shutil.copy2(path, backup)
        state["iris_backup"] = str(backup)


def _write_iris_selection(game_dir: Path, shader_file: str) -> None:
    path = Path(game_dir) / "config" / "iris.properties"
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    try:
        lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").splitlines()
    except OSError:
        lines = []
    updates = {
        "shaderPack": shader_file,
        "enableShaders": "true",
    }
    output: list[str] = []
    pending = dict(updates)
    for line in lines:
        if "=" in line:
            key = line.split("=", 1)[0].strip()
            if key in pending:
                output.append(f"{key}={pending.pop(key)}")
                continue
        output.append(line)
    for key, value in pending.items():
        output.append(f"{key}={value}")
    path.write_text("\n".join(output) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def apply_graphics(
    plan: GraphicsPlan,
    config,
    *,
    apply_options: bool = True,
    install_iris: bool = True,
    install_shader: bool = True,
    threads: int = 8,
    progress_cb: OptimizeProgress | None = None,
    cancel_event=None,
) -> GraphicsResult:
    progress = progress_cb or (lambda p, m: None)
    context = plan.context
    state = _ensure_state(context.game_dir, context.version_id)
    result = GraphicsResult(profile=plan.profile.key)

    if apply_options:
        progress(5, "正在备份并写入画面参数…")
        _backup_options(state, context)
        write_options(context.options_path, plan.profile.options)
        result.options_written = True
        progress(20, f"已应用「{plan.profile.title}」画面参数")

    installer = _ModInstaller(
        context,
        threads=threads,
        cancel_event=cancel_event,
        progress_cb=None,
    )
    iris_ready = plan.iris_installed
    if install_iris and plan.can_install_iris and not iris_ready:
        if cancel_event is not None and cancel_event.is_set():
            result.cancelled = True
        else:
            def iris_progress(percent: int, message: str) -> None:
                progress(20 + int(max(0, min(100, percent)) * 0.45), message)

            installer.progress = iris_progress
            progress(22, "正在安装 Iris 光影加载器…")
            installer.install_project(IRIS_SLUG, title="Iris Shaders", content_type="mod")
            iris_ready = bool(installer.installed) or _has_file(context.mods_dir, "iris")
    result.iris_ready = iris_ready

    shader_file = ""
    if install_shader and iris_ready:
        if cancel_event is not None and cancel_event.is_set():
            result.cancelled = True
        else:
            def shader_progress(percent: int, message: str) -> None:
                progress(68 + int(max(0, min(100, percent)) * 0.28), message)

            installer.progress = shader_progress
            progress(70, f"正在安装光影 {SHADER_TITLE}…")
            path = installer.install_project(
                SHADER_SLUG,
                title=SHADER_TITLE,
                content_type="shader",
            )
            if path is not None:
                shader_file = path.name
            else:
                existing = [
                    item
                    for item in _list_files(context.shaderpacks_dir)
                    if "complementary" in normalize_token(item.name)
                ]
                if existing:
                    shader_file = existing[0].name
            if shader_file:
                iris_path = context.game_dir / "config" / "iris.properties"
                _backup_iris(state, iris_path)
                _write_iris_selection(context.game_dir, shader_file)
                result.shader_file = shader_file

    result.installed = list(installer.installed)
    result.errors = list(installer.errors)
    if installer.installed:
        state.setdefault("installed", []).extend(
            {
                "kind": item.kind,
                "slug": item.slug,
                "title": item.title,
                "filename": item.filename,
                "sha1": item.sha1,
                "version_id": item.version_id,
                "project_id": item.project_id,
            }
            for item in installer.installed
        )
        state["installed"] = _dedupe_installed(state["installed"])
    state["graphics_profile"] = plan.profile.key
    state["updated_at"] = time.time()
    _save_state(context.game_dir, state)
    progress(100, "画面升级完成" if not result.cancelled else "画面升级已取消")
    return result


def _list_files(directory: Path) -> list[Path]:
    try:
        return [path for path in Path(directory).iterdir() if path.is_file()]
    except OSError:
        return []

# 回滚


@dataclass
class RestoreResult:
    settings_restored: bool = False
    options_restored: bool = False
    iris_restored: bool = False
    moved_files: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    kept_files: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    errors: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)


def restore_optimization(version_id: str, config) -> RestoreResult:
    game_dir = Path(config.version_game_path(version_id))
    state = load_state(game_dir)
    if not state.get("active"):
        raise OptimizeError("这个版本没有可恢复的优化记录。")
    result = RestoreResult()

    settings = state.get("settings")
    if isinstance(settings, dict):
        memory = settings.get("memory") if isinstance(settings.get("memory"), dict) else {}
        jvm = settings.get("jvm_args") if isinstance(settings.get("jvm_args"), dict) else {}
        if memory:
            if memory.get("existed"):
                try:
                    config.version_memory[version_id] = int(memory.get("value") or 0)
                except Exception:
                    pass
            else:
                config.version_memory.pop(version_id, None)
        if jvm:
            if jvm.get("existed"):
                config.version_jvm_args[version_id] = str(jvm.get("value") or "")
            else:
                config.version_jvm_args.pop(version_id, None)
        config.save()
        result.settings_restored = True

    options_backup = str(state.get("options_backup") or "")
    options_path = game_dir / "options.txt"
    if options_backup and Path(options_backup).is_file():
        try:
            shutil.copy2(options_backup, options_path)
            result.options_restored = True
        except OSError as exc:
            result.errors.append(f"恢复 options.txt 失败：{exc}")
    elif state.get("options_existed") is False and options_path.is_file():
        target_dir = _state_dir(game_dir) / "restored"
        target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            shutil.move(str(options_path), str(target_dir / "options-after-optimize.txt"))
            result.options_restored = True
        except OSError as exc:
            result.errors.append(f"移走生成的 options.txt 失败：{exc}")

    iris_backup = str(state.get("iris_backup") or "")
    iris_path = game_dir / "config" / "iris.properties"
    if iris_backup and Path(iris_backup).is_file():
        try:
            iris_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(iris_backup, iris_path)
            result.iris_restored = True
        except OSError as exc:
            result.errors.append(f"恢复 iris.properties 失败：{exc}")
    elif state.get("iris_existed") is False and iris_path.is_file():
        target_dir = _state_dir(game_dir) / "restored"
        target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            shutil.move(
                str(iris_path), str(target_dir / "iris-after-optimize.properties")
            )
            result.iris_restored = True
        except OSError as exc:
            result.errors.append(f"移走生成的 iris.properties 失败：{exc}")

    stamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
    for item in state.get("installed") or []:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        kind = str(item.get("kind") or "mod")
        directory = (
            game_dir / "shaderpacks"
            if kind == "shader"
            else game_dir / "resourcepacks"
            if kind == "resourcepack"
            else game_dir / "mods"
        )
        filename = Path(str(item.get("filename") or "")).name
        if not filename:
            continue
        target = directory / filename
        if not target.is_file():
            continue
        expected = str(item.get("sha1") or "").lower()
        if expected and file_sha1(target).lower() != expected:
            result.kept_files.append(filename)
            continue
        backup_dir = _state_dir(game_dir) / "restored" / stamp / directory.name
        backup_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            shutil.move(str(target), str(backup_dir / filename))
            result.moved_files.append(filename)
        except OSError as exc:
            result.errors.append(f"移走 {filename} 失败：{exc}")

    state["active"] = False
    state["restored_at"] = time.time()
    _save_state(game_dir, state)
    return result


def state_summary(version_id: str, config) -> dict[str, Any]:
    game_dir = Path(config.version_game_path(version_id))
    state = load_state(game_dir)
    if not state.get("active"):
        return {}
    return state

def human_size(value: int) -> str:
    size = float(max(0, int(value)))
    for unit in ("B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"):
        if size < 1024 or unit == "TB":
            if unit == "B":
                return f"{int(size)} B"
            return f"{size:.1f} {unit}"
        size /= 1024
    return f"{size:.1f} TB"


def loader_stage_percent(percent: int) -> int:
    """加载器安装阶段占整合包总进度的 3%–45%。"""
    return 3 + int(max(0, min(100, int(percent))) * 0.42)


def normalize_version_id(value: str) -> str:
    text = str(value or "").strip()
    text = re.sub(r'[<>:"/\\|?*\x00-\x1f]', "-", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip(" .")
    if not text or text in (".", ".."):
        text = "DKL-Pack"
    return text[:64].rstrip(" .") or "DKL-Pack"


def unique_version_id(game_dir: Path | str, base: str) -> str:
    versions = Path(game_dir) / "versions"
    candidate = normalize_version_id(base)
    if not (versions / candidate).exists() and not version_json_path(
        Path(game_dir), candidate
    ).exists():
        return candidate
    index = 2
    while True:
        suffix = f"-{index}"
        trimmed = candidate[: 64 - len(suffix)].rstrip(" .") or "DKL-Pack"
        value = trimmed + suffix
        if not (versions / value).exists() and not version_json_path(
            Path(game_dir), value
        ).exists():
            return value
        index += 1
        if index > 9999:
            raise PackError("无法生成不重复的版本名称")


def _loader_version(version_id: str, loader: str) -> str:
    text = str(version_id)
    lowered = text.lower()
    if loader == "NeoForge":
        for marker in ("-neoforge-", "-forge-"):
            if marker in lowered:
                return text[lowered.index(marker) + len(marker):]
    if loader == "Forge" and "-forge-" in lowered:
        return text[lowered.index("-forge-") + len("-forge-"):]
    if loader in ("Fabric", "Quilt"):
        match = re.search(r"(?:fabric|quilt)-loader-([^/]+)", text, re.I)
        if match:
            value = match.group(1)
            return re.sub(r"-\d+\.\d+(?:\.\d+)?$", "", value) or value
    return ""


def _skip_name(name: str) -> bool:
    lowered = name.lower()
    return (
        lowered in _SKIP_NAMES
        or lowered.endswith(_SKIP_SUFFIXES)
        or lowered.startswith("~")
    )


def _iter_tree(root: Path, relative: str) -> list[tuple[Path, str]]:
    base = root / relative
    if not base.is_dir():
        return []
    files: list[tuple[Path, str]] = []
    for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(base):
        dirnames[:] = sorted(
            name for name in dirnames if not (Path(dirpath) / name).is_symlink()
        )
        for filename in sorted(filenames):
            if _skip_name(filename):
                continue
            path = Path(dirpath) / filename
            try:
                if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
                    continue
                resolved = path.resolve()
                resolved.relative_to(base.resolve())
            except (OSError, ValueError):
                continue
            files.append((path, path.relative_to(root).as_posix()))
    return files


def _read_json_member(zf: zipfile.ZipFile, name: str, label: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        info = zf.getinfo(name)
    except KeyError as exc:
        raise PackError(f"整合包缺少 {label}") from exc
    if info.file_size > MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES:
        raise PackError(f"{label} 过大，已拒绝读取")
    if info.flag_bits & 0x1:
        raise PackError("整合包中的文件被加密，无法读取")
    try:
        raw = zf.read(info)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise PackError(f"读取 {label} 失败：{exc}") from exc
    try:
        data = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8-sig"))
    except Exception as exc:
        raise PackError(f"{label} 不是有效的 JSON") from exc
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise PackError(f"{label} 格式不正确")
    return data


def _safe_archive_name(name: str) -> str:
    value = str(name or "").replace("\\", "/")
    if not value or value.startswith("/") or re.match(r"^[A-Za-z]:", value):
        raise PackError(f"整合包内包含非法路径：{name}")
    parts = PurePosixPath(value).parts
    if any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in parts):
        raise PackError(f"整合包内包含越界路径：{name}")
    return "/".join(parts)


def _allowed_content_name(name: str) -> bool:
    parts = PurePosixPath(name).parts
    return bool(parts) and parts[0] in CONTENT_DIRS and len(parts) >= 2


def _validate_archive(zf: zipfile.ZipFile) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if zf.infolist() and len(zf.infolist()) > MAX_TOTAL_FILES + 16:
        raise PackError("整合包内文件数量过多，已拒绝读取")
    seen: set[str] = set()
    total = 0
    counts = {name: 0 for name in CONTENT_DIRS}
    for info in zf.infolist():
        name = _safe_archive_name(info.filename)
        if name in seen:
            raise PackError(f"整合包内存在重复文件：{name}")
        seen.add(name)
        mode = (info.external_attr >> 16) & 0o170000
        if mode == 0o120000:
            raise PackError(f"整合包内不允许符号链接：{name}")
        if info.is_dir():
            continue
        if info.flag_bits & 0x1:
            raise PackError("整合包中的文件被加密，无法导入")
        total += max(0, int(info.file_size))
        if total > MAX_TOTAL_BYTES:
            raise PackError("整合包解压后体积超过 64 GB，已拒绝导入")
        if _allowed_content_name(name):
            counts[name.split("/", 1)[0]] += 1
    if "manifest.json" not in seen:
        raise PackError("这不是 DKL 整合包：缺少 manifest.json")
    if "version/version.json" not in seen:
        raise PackError("整合包缺少版本信息 version/version.json")
    return {"counts": counts, "total": total}


def inspect_pack(path: Path | str) -> PackInfo:
    pack_path = Path(path)
    if not pack_path.is_file():
        raise PackError("整合包文件不存在")
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(pack_path) as zf:
            validation = _validate_archive(zf)
            manifest = _read_json_member(zf, "manifest.json", "manifest.json")
            version_json = _read_json_member(
                zf, "version/version.json", "version/version.json"
            )
    except PackError:
        raise
    except zipfile.BadZipFile as exc:
        raise PackError("文件不是有效的 DKL 整合包（ZIP 结构损坏）") from exc
    except OSError as exc:
        raise PackError(f"无法打开整合包：{exc}") from exc

    if str(manifest.get("format") or "") != PACK_FORMAT:
        raise PackError(
            "这不是 Darkitten Launcher 整合包。请选择由 DKL 导出的 .dklpack 文件。"
        )
    try:
        format_version = int(manifest.get("format_version") or 0)
    except Exception:
        format_version = 0
    if format_version <= 0 or format_version > PACK_FORMAT_VERSION:
        raise PackError(
            f"整合包格式版本 {format_version or '未知'} 不受支持，请更新启动器。"
        )

    version_id = str(manifest.get("version_id") or "").strip()
    if not version_id:
        raise PackError("整合包没有记录原版本名称")
    if "id" not in version_json:
        version_json["id"] = version_id
    return PackInfo(
        path=pack_path,
        manifest=manifest,
        version_json=version_json,
        counts=validation["counts"],
        total_files=int(manifest.get("total_files") or 0)
        or sum(validation["counts"].values()) + 1,
        total_bytes=int(manifest.get("total_bytes") or 0) or validation["total"],
        archive_bytes=pack_path.stat().st_size,
    )


def export_pack(
    game_dir: Path | str,
    version_id: str,
    output_path: Path | str,
    *,
    name: str = "",
    description: str = "",
    options: PackOptions | None = None,
    isolated: bool = True,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    log_cb: LogCallback | None = None,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
) -> Path:
    game_dir = Path(game_dir)
    output_path = Path(output_path)
    if output_path.suffix.lower() != PACK_EXTENSION:
        output_path = output_path.with_suffix(PACK_EXTENSION)
    progress = progress_cb or (lambda _p, _m: None)
    log = log_cb or (lambda _m: None)
    cancel = cancel_event or threading.Event()
    options = options or PackOptions()

    json_path = version_json_path(game_dir, version_id)
    if not json_path.is_file():
        raise PackError(f"找不到版本 {version_id} 的 JSON 文件")
    try:
        version_json = json.loads(json_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    except Exception as exc:
        raise PackError(f"版本 JSON 无法读取：{exc}") from exc
    if not isinstance(version_json, dict):
        raise PackError("版本 JSON 格式不正确")

    try:
        resolved = resolve_version(game_dir, version_id)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise PackError(f"版本无法解析：{exc}") from exc

    run_dir = version_game_dir(game_dir, version_id, isolated)
    enabled = options.enabled_dirs()
    collected: list[tuple[str, list[tuple[Path, str]]]] = []
    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    total_bytes = 0
    for content in enabled:
        files = _iter_tree(run_dir, content)
        collected.append((content, files))
        counts[content] = len(files)
        total_bytes += sum(path.stat().st_size for path, _arc in files)
        if files:
            log(f"{content}：{len(files)} 个文件")

    json_bytes = json.dumps(version_json, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2).encode("utf-8")
    total_files = sum(counts.values()) + 1
    total_bytes += len(json_bytes)

    manifest = {
        "format": PACK_FORMAT,
        "format_version": PACK_FORMAT_VERSION,
        "name": str(name or f"{version_id} 的猫猫整合包").strip()[:80],
        "description": str(description or "").strip()[:500],
        "version_id": version_id,
        "minecraft_version": resolved.jar_id,
        "loader": resolved.loader,
        "loader_version": _loader_version(version_id, resolved.loader),
        "created_at": datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        "created_with": f"{APP_NAME} {APP_VERSION}",
        "contents": enabled,
        "counts": counts,
        "total_files": total_files,
        "total_bytes": total_bytes,
    }

    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temp_path = output_path.with_name(
        f".{output_path.name}.{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}.part"
    )
    done = 1
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(
            temp_path, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=6
        ) as zf:
            progress(1, "写入整合包清单…")
            zf.writestr(
                "manifest.json",
                json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
            )
            zf.writestr(
                "version/version.json",
                json_bytes,
                compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,
            )
            for content, files in collected:
                for path, arcname in files:
                    if cancel.is_set():
                        raise PackError("打包已取消")
                    progress(
                        min(99, int(2 + 97 * done / max(1, total_files))),
                        f"打包 {arcname}",
                    )
                    compress = (
                        zipfile.ZIP_STORED
                        if path.suffix.lower() in _STORE_SUFFIXES
                        else zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
                    )
                    zf.write(path, arcname, compress_type=compress)
                    done += 1
        if cancel.is_set():
            raise PackError("打包已取消")
        os.replace(temp_path, output_path)
    except Exception:
        try:
            temp_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        except Exception:
            pass
        raise
    progress(100, f"整合包已保存（{human_size(output_path.stat().st_size)}）")
    log(
        f"整合包已保存：{output_path} · {total_files} 个文件 · "
        f"{human_size(total_bytes)}"
    )
    return output_path


def _write_version_json(
    game_dir: Path, version_id: str, version_json: dict[str, Any]
) -> Path:
    path = version_json_path(game_dir, version_id)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    data = dict(version_json)
    data["id"] = version_id
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
    )
    return path


def import_pack(
    pack_path: Path | str,
    game_dir: Path | str,
    version_id: str,
    *,
    overwrite: bool = False,
    resume: bool = False,
    isolated: bool = True,
    source: str = "official",
    threads: int = 8,
    installer: Any | None = None,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    log_cb: LogCallback | None = None,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
) -> PackImportResult:
    game_dir = Path(game_dir)
    info = inspect_pack(pack_path)
    version_id = normalize_version_id(version_id)
    version_dir = game_dir / "versions" / version_id
    if version_dir.exists() and not resume:
        raise PackError(f"版本 {version_id} 已经存在，请换一个导入名称")
    if resume and not version_dir.exists():
        # 上次取消得早，目录还没建出来；按全新导入继续即可。
        resume = False
    progress = progress_cb or (lambda _p, _m: None)
    log = log_cb or (lambda _m: None)
    cancel = cancel_event or threading.Event()

    progress(2, "解包版本信息…")
    fresh_version_dir = not version_dir.exists()
    _write_version_json(game_dir, version_id, info.version_json)
    log(f"已写入版本骨架：{version_id}")

    run_dir = version_game_dir(game_dir, version_id, isolated)
    run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    jobs: list[ExtractJob] = []
    seen_destinations: dict[str, int] = {}
    total = 1
    with zipfile.ZipFile(Path(pack_path)) as zf:
        for entry in zf.infolist():
            if entry.is_dir():
                continue
            name = entry.filename.replace("\\", "/")
            if not _allowed_content_name(name):
                continue
            safe_name = _safe_archive_name(entry.filename)
            destination = run_dir / safe_name
            try:
                destination.resolve().relative_to(run_dir.resolve())
            except ValueError as exc:
                raise PackError(f"整合包路径越界：{safe_name}") from exc
            job = ExtractJob(
                entry,
                destination,
                safe_name,
                check_exists=not (
                    fresh_version_dir
                    and isolated
                    and version_dir in destination.parents
                ),
            )
            key = str(destination).lower()
            if key in seen_destinations:
                jobs[seen_destinations[key]] = job
            else:
                seen_destinations[key] = len(jobs)
                jobs.append(job)
        total = max(
            1, sum(max(0, int(entry.info.file_size)) for entry in jobs)
        )

    def content_progress(done_bytes: int, _files: int, label: str) -> None:
        if cancel.is_set():
            return
        progress(
            min(66, 5 + int(60 * done_bytes / total)),
            f"放入 {label}" if label else "放入整合包内容…",
        )

    try:
        stats = extract_zip_entries(
            pack_path,
            jobs,
            threads=max(
                1,
                min(DEFAULT_EXTRACT_THREADS, int(threads or DEFAULT_EXTRACT_THREADS)),
            ),
            overwrite=overwrite,
            cancel_event=cancel,
            progress_cb=content_progress,
        )
    except ZipExtractCancelled as exc:
        raise PackError("导入已取消") from exc
    except ZipExtractError as exc:
        raise PackError(f"解压失败：{exc}") from exc
    if cancel.is_set():
        raise PackError("导入已取消")
    imported = stats.added
    skipped = stats.skipped
    imported_bytes = stats.bytes_written
    log(
        f"整合包内容已放入版本文件夹：新增 {imported} 个文件"
        + (f"，跳过 {skipped} 个已存在文件" if skipped else "")
    )

    def mapped_progress(percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        if cancel.is_set():
            raise PackError("导入已取消")
        progress(67 + int(max(0, min(100, percent)) * 0.32), message)

    if installer is None:
        installer = Installer(
            game_dir,
            source=source,
            progress_cb=mapped_progress,
            log_cb=log,
            cancel_event=cancel,
            threads=threads,
        )
    progress(67, "补齐原版、依赖库与资源文件…")
    installer.install(version_id)
    if cancel.is_set():
        raise PackError("导入已取消")

    progress(100, "猫猫已经把整合包搬进猫窝")
    log(
        f"导入完成：{version_id} · 新增 {imported} 个文件"
        + (f" · 跳过 {skipped} 个已存在文件" if skipped else "")
    )
    return PackImportResult(
        version_id=version_id,
        imported_files=imported,
        skipped_files=skipped,
        imported_bytes=imported_bytes,
    )

# FILE: darkitten/paths.py

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path


def version_game_dir(
    game_dir: Path | str, version_id: str, isolated: bool = True
) -> Path:
    """返回某个游戏版本实际使用的游戏目录。

    开启版本隔离后，每个版本以 versions/<版本名> 作为游戏工作目录，
    这样 mods、saves、config 等都会随版本分开存放。
    """
    root = Path(game_dir)
    if isolated and version_id:
        return root / "versions" / version_id
    return root

# FILE: darkitten/pet.py
