def property_spec(key: str) -> PropertySpec:
    known = SERVER_PROPERTY_SPECS.get(key)
    if known is not None:
        return known
    return PropertySpec(
        key=key,
        label=key,
        help="Minecraft 或插件写入的自定义配置项；请结合对应插件文档修改。",
        category="其他",
    )


def _unescape_properties(text: str) -> str:
    result: list[str] = []
    index = 0
    while index < len(text):
        char = text[index]
        if char != "\\" or index + 1 >= len(text):
            result.append(char)
            index += 1
            continue
        index += 1
        code = text[index]
        if code == "u" and index + 4 < len(text):
            try:
                result.append(chr(int(text[index + 1 : index + 5], 16)))
                index += 5
                continue
            except ValueError:
                result.append("\\u")
                index += 1
                continue
        result.append(
            {"t": "\t", "n": "\n", "r": "\r", "f": "\f"}.get(code, code)
        )
        index += 1
    return "".join(result)


def _split_property(line: str) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
    escaped = False
    split_at = -1
    for index, char in enumerate(line):
        if escaped:
            escaped = False
            continue
        if char == "\\":
            escaped = True
            continue
        if char in "=:":
            split_at = index
            break
        if char.isspace():
            split_at = index
            break
    if split_at < 0:
        return None
    key = line[:split_at].strip()
    value = line[split_at + 1 :] if line[split_at : split_at + 1] in "=:" else line[split_at:]
    return _unescape_properties(key), _unescape_properties(value.strip())


def read_server_properties(path: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    if not Path(path).is_file():
        return {}
    try:
        text = Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig", errors="replace")
    except OSError:
        return {}
    values: dict[str, str] = {}
    pending = ""
    for physical in text.splitlines():
        line = physical.lstrip() if pending else physical
        if line.endswith("\\") and not line.endswith("\\\\"):
            pending += line[:-1]
            continue
        line = pending + line
        pending = ""
        raw = line.strip()
        if not raw or raw.startswith(("#", "!")):
            continue
        parsed = _split_property(line.strip())
        if parsed is None:
            continue
        key, value = parsed
        if key:
            values[key] = value
    if pending:
        parsed = _split_property(pending.strip())
        if parsed is not None and parsed[0]:
            values[parsed[0]] = parsed[1]
    return values


def property_rows(
    values: dict[str, str], include_all: bool = False
) -> list[tuple[PropertySpec, str]]:
    """按中文分类返回属性行，未知键放在“其他”。

    文件里没有的常用项会用默认值补齐，方便直接开启；
    include_all 为 True 时补齐全部已知项。
    """
    rows: list[tuple[PropertySpec, str]] = []
    for key, value in values.items():
        rows.append((property_spec(key), value))
    present = set(values)
    keys = (
        list(SERVER_PROPERTY_SPECS)
        if include_all
        else list(COMMON_PROPERTY_KEYS)
    )
    for key in keys:
        spec = SERVER_PROPERTY_SPECS.get(key)
        if spec is not None and key not in present:
            rows.append((spec, spec.default))
    order = {category: index for index, category in enumerate(CATEGORY_ORDER)}
    rows.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            order.get(item[0].category, 99),
            list(SERVER_PROPERTY_SPECS).index(item[0].key)
            if item[0].key in SERVER_PROPERTY_SPECS
            else 100000,
            item[0].key.lower(),
        )
    )
    return rows


def normalise_bool(value: str) -> bool:
    return str(value or "").strip().lower() in {"true", "1", "yes", "on"}


def validate_property(spec: PropertySpec, value: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    raw = str(value or "").strip()
    if spec.kind == "bool":
        lowered = raw.lower()
        if lowered in {"true", "false"}:
            return lowered, ""
        if lowered in {"1", "0", "yes", "no", "on", "off"}:
            return "true" if lowered in {"1", "yes", "on"} else "false", ""
        return raw, f"{spec.label}只能填写 true 或 false。"
    if spec.kind == "int":
        try:
            number = int(raw)
        except ValueError:
            return raw, f"{spec.label}需要填写整数。"
        if spec.minimum is not None and number < spec.minimum:
            return raw, f"{spec.label}不能小于 {spec.minimum}。"
        if spec.maximum is not None and number > spec.maximum:
            return raw, f"{spec.label}不能大于 {spec.maximum}。"
        return str(number), ""
    if spec.kind == "choice":
        if raw not in spec.choices:
            return raw, f"{spec.label}只能从：{'、'.join(spec.choices)} 中选择。"
        return raw, ""
    if "\x00" in raw:
        return raw, f"{spec.label}包含无效字符。"
    return raw, ""


def save_server_properties(info: ServerInfo, values: dict[str, str]) -> Path:
    path = info.path / "server.properties"
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if path.is_file():
        backup = path.with_name(path.name + ".bak")
        try:
            shutil.copy2(path, backup)
        except OSError:
            pass
    try:
        info.port = max(1, min(65535, int(values.get("server-port", info.port))))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        pass
    info.online_mode = normalise_bool(values.get("online-mode", str(info.online_mode)))
    update_server_properties(info, values)
    save_server(info)
    return path


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PluginConfigFile:
    path: Path
    relative: str
    group: str
    format: str
    size: int
    modified: float

    @property
    def display_size(self) -> str:
        if self.size >= 1024 * 1024:
            return f"{self.size / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB"
        if self.size >= 1024:
            return f"{self.size / 1024:.0f} KB"
        return f"{self.size} B"


def _config_format(path: Path) -> str:
    return CONFIG_SUFFIXES.get(path.suffix.lower(), "")


def _relative_label(path: Path, base: Path) -> str:
    try:
        return path.relative_to(base).as_posix()
    except ValueError:
        return path.name


def scan_plugin_configs(info: ServerInfo) -> list[PluginConfigFile]:
    base = info.path
    if not base.is_dir():
        return []
    roots: list[tuple[Path, str]] = []
    plugins = base / "plugins"
    if plugins.is_dir():
        roots.append((plugins, "插件"))
    config = base / "config"
    if config.is_dir():
        roots.append((config, "Mod / 服务器"))
    files: dict[str, PluginConfigFile] = {}

    def add(path: Path, group: str) -> None:
        fmt = _config_format(path)
        if not fmt:
            return
        try:
            stat = path.stat()
        except OSError:
            return
        if stat.st_size > MAX_CONFIG_BYTES:
            return
        relative = _relative_label(path, base)
        files[relative.lower()] = PluginConfigFile(
            path=path,
            relative=relative,
            group=group,
            format=fmt,
            size=stat.st_size,
            modified=stat.st_mtime,
        )

    for root, group in roots:
        for current, dirs, names in os.walk(root):
            current_path = Path(current)
            try:
                depth = len(current_path.relative_to(root).parts)
            except ValueError:
                depth = 0
            if depth >= 4:
                dirs[:] = []
            dirs[:] = [
                name
                for name in dirs
                if name.lower() not in SKIP_DIRS and not name.startswith(".")
            ]
            for name in names:
                add(current_path / name, group)
                if len(files) >= 500:
                    break
            if len(files) >= 500:
                break

    for name in ROOT_SERVER_CONFIGS:
        path = base / name
        if path.is_file():
            add(path, "服务器")

    return sorted(
        files.values(),
        key=lambda item: (item.group != "服务器", item.group.lower(), item.relative.lower()),
    )


def read_config_text(path: Path) -> str:
    raw = Path(path).read_bytes()
    if raw.startswith(b"\xef\xbb\xbf"):
        raw = raw[3:]
    for encoding in ("utf-8", "gb18030"):
        try:
            return raw.decode(encoding)
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            continue
    return raw.decode("utf-8", "replace")


def write_text_atomic(path: Path, text: str) -> Path:
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    backup = path.with_name(path.name + ".bak")
    if path.is_file():
        try:
            shutil.copy2(path, backup)
        except OSError:
            pass
    temp = path.with_name(path.name + ".tmp")
    temp.write_text(str(text), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    os.replace(temp, path)
    return path


def validate_config_text(text: str, suffix: str) -> str:
    suffix = str(suffix or "").lower()
    if suffix == ".json":
        try:
            json.loads(text)
        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
            return f"JSON 第 {exc.lineno} 行第 {exc.colno} 列：{exc.msg}"
        except ValueError as exc:
            return f"JSON 格式错误：{exc}"
        return ""
    if suffix == ".toml":
        try:
            tomllib.loads(text)
        except tomllib.TOMLDecodeError as exc:
            return f"TOML 格式错误：{exc}"
        return ""
    if suffix in {".yml", ".yaml"}:
        seen: dict[str, int] = {}
        for number, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), start=1):
            if "\t" in line[: len(line) - len(line.lstrip())]:
                return f"YAML 第 {number} 行使用了 Tab 缩进，请改成空格。"
            stripped = line.strip()
            if not stripped or stripped.startswith(("#", "---", "...")):
                continue
            if line[:1] not in {" ", "-"} and ":" in line:
                key = line.split(":", 1)[0].strip()
                if key and key in seen:
                    return (
                        f"YAML 第 {number} 行的顶层键“{key}”与第 {seen[key]} 行重复，"
                        "请合并或改名。"
                    )
                if key:
                    seen[key] = number
        return ""
    if suffix == ".properties":
        for number, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), start=1):
            stripped = line.strip()
            if not stripped or stripped.startswith(("#", "!")):
                continue
            if "\\u" in stripped:
                tail = stripped.split("\\u", 1)[1][:4]
                if len(tail) < 4 or any(c not in "0123456789abcdefABCDEF" for c in tail):
                    return f"Properties 第 {number} 行有无效的 \\u 转义。"
        return ""
    return ""

def explain_config_key(key: str) -> str:
    text = str(key or "").strip().strip("\"'")
    if not text:
        return ""
    if text in SERVER_PROPERTY_SPECS:
        return SERVER_PROPERTY_SPECS[text].help
    for candidate in (text, text.lower()):
        note = _CONFIG_KEY_NOTES.get(candidate.lower())
        if note:
            return note
    words = [
        part
        for part in text.replace("-", "_").replace(".", "_").split("_")
        if part
    ]
    notes = [
        _CONFIG_KEY_NOTES.get(word.lower())
        for word in words
        if _CONFIG_KEY_NOTES.get(word.lower())
    ]
    if notes:
        return "；".join(dict.fromkeys(notes))
    return "插件自定义配置项；具体含义以该插件的官方文档或配置注释为准。"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ConfigHint:
    key: str
    value: str
    line: int
    note: str


def _yaml_top_keys(text: str) -> list[tuple[str, str, int]]:
    result: list[tuple[str, str, int]] = []
    for number, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), start=1):
        if not line or line[:1].isspace() or line.startswith(("#", "-", "---", "...")):
            continue
        if ":" not in line:
            continue
        key, value = line.split(":", 1)
        key = key.strip().strip("\"'")
        if not key:
            continue
        value = value.strip()
        if value.startswith("#"):
            value = ""
        if len(value) > 80:
            value = value[:77] + "..."
        result.append((key, value, number))
    return result


def _json_top_keys(text: str) -> list[tuple[str, str, int]]:
    try:
        data = json.loads(text)
    except Exception:
        return []
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        return []
    result: list[tuple[str, str, int]] = []
    for key, value in list(data.items())[:80]:
        if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
            preview = "配置分组" if isinstance(value, dict) else f"列表（{len(value)} 项）"
        else:
            preview = str(value)
        if len(preview) > 80:
            preview = preview[:77] + "..."
        result.append((str(key), preview, 0))
    return result


def _toml_top_keys(text: str) -> list[tuple[str, str, int]]:
    try:
        data = tomllib.loads(text)
    except Exception:
        return []
    result: list[tuple[str, str, int]] = []
    for key, value in list(data.items())[:80]:
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            preview = "配置分组"
        elif isinstance(value, list):
            preview = f"列表（{len(value)} 项）"
        else:
            preview = str(value)
        if len(preview) > 80:
            preview = preview[:77] + "..."
        result.append((str(key), preview, 0))
    return result


def _properties_top_keys(text: str) -> list[tuple[str, str, int]]:
    result: list[tuple[str, str, int]] = []
    for number, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), start=1):
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped or stripped.startswith(("#", "!")):
            continue
        parsed = _split_property(stripped)
        if parsed is None:
            continue
        key, value = parsed
        if len(value) > 80:
            value = value[:77] + "..."
        result.append((key, value, number))
    return result


def describe_config(text: str, suffix: str) -> list[ConfigHint]:
    suffix = str(suffix or "").lower()
    if suffix in {".yml", ".yaml"}:
        rows = _yaml_top_keys(text)
    elif suffix == ".json":
        rows = _json_top_keys(text)
    elif suffix == ".toml":
        rows = _toml_top_keys(text)
    else:
        rows = _properties_top_keys(text)
    hints: list[ConfigHint] = []
    for key, value, line in rows[:80]:
        hints.append(
            ConfigHint(
                key=key,
                value=value,
                line=line,
                note=explain_config_key(key),
            )
        )
    return hints


def key_at_line(text: str, line_number: int) -> str:
    lines = text.splitlines()
    if not lines:
        return ""
    index = max(0, min(len(lines) - 1, int(line_number) - 1))
    line = lines[index]
    stripped = line.strip()
    if not stripped or stripped.startswith(("#", "!", "//")):
        return ""
    if stripped.startswith(("[", "{")):
        return ""
    for separator in (":", "="):
        if separator in stripped:
            key = stripped.split(separator, 1)[0].strip().strip("\"'")
            key = key.lstrip("-").strip()
            if key and " " not in key:
                return key
    return ""


def file_modified_text(timestamp: float) -> str:
    try:
        return time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", time.localtime(float(timestamp)))
    except (OSError, ValueError, OverflowError):
        return ""


def config_summary(info: ServerInfo) -> str:
    try:
        values = read_server_properties(info.path / "server.properties")
    except Exception:
        values = {}
    port = values.get("server-port", str(info.port))
    online = "正版验证" if normalise_bool(values.get("online-mode", "")) else "离线可进"
    return f"端口 {port} · {online} · {len(scan_plugin_configs(info))} 个可编辑配置文件"

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import threading
import zipfile
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
from typing import Any, Callable, Iterator

from .packs import human_size
from .servers import (
    SERVER_NAMES,
    SERVERS_DIR,
    ServerInfo,
    _safe_folder,
)

SERVER_PACK_MARKER = "dkl-server.json"
MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_TOTAL_FILES = 300_000
MAX_TOTAL_BYTES = 128 * 1024**3
_SKIP_TOP_DIRS = {
    "logs",
    "crash-reports",
    "cache",
    "__pycache__",
    ".git",
    "updates",
}
_SKIP_NAMES = {
    "session.lock",
    ".ds_store",
    "thumbs.db",
    "desktop.ini",
}
_SKIP_SUFFIXES = (".tmp", ".part", ".download")
_WINDOWS_RESERVED = {
    "CON",
    "PRN",
    "AUX",
    "NUL",
    *(f"COM{i}" for i in range(1, 10)),
    *(f"LPT{i}" for i in range(1, 10)),
}

ProgressCallback = Callable[[int, str], None]
LogCallback = Callable[[str], None]


class ServerPackError(Exception):
    pass


class ServerPackCancelled(Exception):
    pass


@dataclass
class ServerPackInfo:
    path: Path
    is_zip: bool
    root: Path | None = None
    prefix: str = ""
    manifest: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    name: str = ""
    kind: str = ""
    mc_version: str = ""
    loader_version: str = ""
    total_files: int = 0
    total_bytes: int = 0
    archive_bytes: int = 0
    worlds: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    players: int = 0
    has_whitelist: bool = False
    has_ops: bool = False
    has_banned: bool = False
    installed: bool = True

    @property
    def type_name(self) -> str:
        return SERVER_NAMES.get(self.kind, self.kind or "服务端")

    @property
    def display_version(self) -> str:
        if self.loader_version:
            return f"{self.mc_version or '未知版本'} · {self.loader_version}"
        return self.mc_version or "未知版本"

    @property
    def size_text(self) -> str:
        return human_size(self.total_bytes)

    @property
    def world_text(self) -> str:
        return "、".join(self.worlds) if self.worlds else "未检测到世界目录"


def _now() -> str:
    return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")


def _check_cancel(cancel_event: threading.Event | None) -> None:
    if cancel_event is not None and cancel_event.is_set():
        raise ServerPackCancelled()


def _skip_relative(relative: Path) -> bool:
    parts = relative.parts
    if not parts:
        return False
    if len(parts) == 1 and parts[0].lower() in (SERVER_PACK_MARKER, "server.json"):
        return True
    if parts[0].lower() in _SKIP_TOP_DIRS:
        return True
    name = relative.name.lower()
    if name in _SKIP_NAMES:
        return True
    return name.endswith(_SKIP_SUFFIXES)


def _scan_files(root: Path) -> Iterator[tuple[Path, Path, int]]:
    """遍历服务端文件；不跟随目录链接，跳过日志、缓存与临时文件。"""
    for current, dirs, names in os.walk(root, followlinks=False):
        current_path = Path(current)
        try:
            relative_dir = current_path.relative_to(root)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if not relative_dir.parts:
            dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d.lower() not in _SKIP_TOP_DIRS]
        else:
            dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not (current_path / d).is_symlink()]
        dirs.sort()
        for name in sorted(names):
            path = current_path / name
            if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
                continue
            relative = path.relative_to(root)
            if _skip_relative(relative):
                continue
            try:
                size = path.stat().st_size
            except OSError:
                size = 0
            yield relative, path, max(0, int(size))


def _read_json(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        if not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size > MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES:
            return {}
        data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    except Exception:
        return {}
    return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}


def _read_properties(path: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    data: dict[str, str] = {}
    try:
        lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()
    except OSError:
        return data
    for line in lines:
        raw = line.strip()
        if not raw or raw.startswith(("#", "!")) or "=" not in raw:
            continue
        key, value = raw.split("=", 1)
        data[key.strip()] = value.strip()
    return data


def _json_list_length(path: Path) -> int:
    try:
        data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    except Exception:
        return 0
    return len(data) if isinstance(data, list) else 0


def _eula_accepted(root: Path) -> bool:
    try:
        text = (root / "eula.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    except OSError:
        return False
    return any(
        line.strip().lower() == "eula=true" for line in text.splitlines()
    )


def _world_names(root: Path) -> list[str]:
    props = _read_properties(root / "server.properties")
    level = props.get("level-name", "").strip()
    names: list[str] = []
    if level and (root / level / "level.dat").is_file():
        names.append(level)
    try:
        for item in root.iterdir():
            if not item.is_dir():
                continue
            if (item / "level.dat").is_file() and item.name not in names:
                names.append(item.name)
    except OSError:
        pass
    return names


def _player_count(root: Path, worlds: list[str]) -> int:
    count = 0
    for world in worlds:
        folder = root / world / "playerdata"
        if not folder.is_dir():
            continue
        try:
            count += sum(1 for item in folder.iterdir() if item.suffix.lower() == ".dat")
        except OSError:
            pass
    if count:
        return count
    try:
        data = json.loads((root / "usercache.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    except Exception:
        return 0
    return len(data) if isinstance(data, list) else 0


def _infer_launch(root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    result: dict[str, Any] = {
        "kind": "",
        "mc_version": "",
        "loader_version": "",
        "launch_kind": "",
        "launch_target": "",
        "launch_classpath": [],
    }
    for pattern, kind in (
        ("libraries/net/minecraftforge/forge/*/win_args.txt", "forge"),
        ("libraries/net/neoforged/neoforge/*/win_args.txt", "neoforge"),
    ):
        hits = sorted(root.glob(pattern))
        if not hits:
            continue
        target = hits[0]
        result["kind"] = kind
        result["launch_kind"] = "args"
        result["launch_target"] = target.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        if kind == "forge":
            folder = target.parent.name
            if "-" in folder:
                minecraft, loader = folder.split("-", 1)
                result["mc_version"] = minecraft
                result["loader_version"] = loader
        break
    if not result["kind"] and (root / "fabric-server-launch.jar").is_file():
        result["kind"] = "fabric"
        result["launch_kind"] = "jar"
        result["launch_target"] = "fabric-server-launch.jar"
        loader_hits = sorted(root.glob("libraries/net/fabricmc/fabric-loader/*"))
        if loader_hits:
            result["loader_version"] = loader_hits[0].name
    if not result["kind"] and (root / "server.jar").is_file():
        result["kind"] = "paper"
        result["launch_kind"] = "jar"
        result["launch_target"] = "server.jar"

    if not result["mc_version"]:
        result["mc_version"] = _jar_minecraft_version(root / "server.jar")
    if not result["mc_version"]:
        for folder in sorted(root.glob("libraries/net/minecraft/server/*")):
            name = folder.name
            if not name:
                continue
            result["mc_version"] = name.split("-", 1)[0]
            break
    return result


def _jar_minecraft_version(jar: Path) -> str:
    if not jar.is_file():
        return ""
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(jar) as archive:
            try:
                data = json.loads(archive.read("version.json").decode("utf-8-sig"))
            except (KeyError, ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
                return ""
    except (OSError, zipfile.BadZipFile):
        return ""
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        return ""
    for key in ("id", "name", "release_target"):
        value = str(data.get(key) or "").strip()
        if value and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9A-Za-z._-]{1,40}", value):
            return value
    return ""


def _pack_manifest(
    info: ServerInfo,
    root_name: str,
    files: int,
    total_bytes: int,
    worlds: list[str],
    players: int,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    whitelist = _json_list_length(info.path / "whitelist.json")
    ops = _json_list_length(info.path / "ops.json")
    banned_players = _json_list_length(info.path / "banned-players.json")
    banned_ips = _json_list_length(info.path / "banned-ips.json")
    return {
        "format": "dkl-server",
        "format_version": 1,
        "name": info.name,
        "kind": info.kind,
        "type_name": info.type_name,
        "mc_version": info.mc_version,
        "loader_version": info.loader_version,
        "paper_build": info.paper_build,
        "memory_mb": info.memory_mb,
        "port": info.port,
        "online_mode": info.online_mode,
        "eula": info.eula or _eula_accepted(info.path),
        "created_at": info.created_at,
        "exported_at": _now(),
        "source_folder": info.folder,
        "root": root_name,
        "files": files,
        "bytes": total_bytes,
        "worlds": worlds,
        "players": players,
        "permissions": {
            "whitelist": whitelist,
            "ops": ops,
            "banned_players": banned_players,
            "banned_ips": banned_ips,
            "online_mode": info.online_mode,
        },
    }


def _server_json_for_export(info: ServerInfo, root_name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    data = asdict(info)
    data["folder"] = root_name
    data["java_path"] = ""
    data["name"] = info.name
    return data


def _ensure_outside(source: Path, target: Path) -> None:
    try:
        target.resolve().relative_to(source.resolve())
    except ValueError:
        return
    raise ServerPackError("不能把服务端包保存到服务端自己的文件夹里")


def _write_metadata(
    folder: Path,
    info: ServerInfo,
    root_name: str,
    files: int,
    total_bytes: int,
    worlds: list[str],
    players: int,
) -> None:
    manifest = _pack_manifest(info, root_name, files, total_bytes, worlds, players)
    (folder / SERVER_PACK_MARKER).write_text(
        json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    (folder / "server.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(
            _server_json_for_export(info, root_name), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2
        )
        + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def export_server(
    info: ServerInfo,
    target: Path | str,
    *,
    as_zip: bool = True,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    log_cb: LogCallback | None = None,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
) -> Path:
    """打包服务端代码、世界、玩家数据和权限设置；日志与缓存不会写入。"""
    root = Path(info.path)
    if not root.is_dir():
        raise ServerPackError("服务端文件夹不存在")
    destination = Path(target)
    if as_zip and destination.suffix.lower() != ".zip":
        destination = destination.with_suffix(".zip")
    _ensure_outside(root, destination)

    progress = progress_cb or (lambda _p, _m: None)
    log = log_cb or (lambda _m: None)
    progress(2, "扫描服务端文件…")
    files = list(_scan_files(root))
    if not files:
        raise ServerPackError("服务端文件夹里没有可打包的文件")
    total_bytes = sum(item[2] for item in files)
    worlds = _world_names(root)
    players = _player_count(root, worlds)
    root_name = _safe_folder(info.name or info.folder) or info.folder
    log(
        f"打包 {info.name}：{len(files)} 个文件 · {human_size(total_bytes)} · "
        f"世界 {len(worlds)} 个 · 玩家数据 {players} 份"
    )

    if as_zip:
        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        temp = destination.with_name(destination.name + ".part")
        try:
            with zipfile.ZipFile(
                temp, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=6
            ) as archive:
                manifest = _pack_manifest(
                    info, root_name, len(files), total_bytes, worlds, players
                )
                archive.writestr(
                    f"{root_name}/{SERVER_PACK_MARKER}",
                    json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
                )
                archive.writestr(
                    f"{root_name}/server.json",
                    json.dumps(
                        _server_json_for_export(info, root_name),
                        ensure_ascii=False,
                        indent=2,
                    )
                    + "\n",
                )
                done = 0
                for relative, path, size in files:
                    _check_cancel(cancel_event)
                    archive.write(path, f"{root_name}/{relative.as_posix()}")
                    done += size
                    percent = 5 + int(90 * done / max(1, total_bytes))
                    progress(percent, f"打包 {relative.as_posix()}")
            if destination.exists():
                destination.unlink()
            os.replace(temp, destination)
        except ServerPackCancelled:
            try:
                temp.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            except OSError:
                pass
            raise
        except Exception:
            try:
                temp.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            except OSError:
                pass
            raise
        size = destination.stat().st_size
        progress(100, "ZIP 打包完成")
        log(f"ZIP 已保存：{destination} · {human_size(size)}")
        return destination

    if destination.exists():
        try:
            if any(destination.iterdir()):
                raise ServerPackError("目标文件夹不为空，请换一个位置")
        except OSError as exc:
            raise ServerPackError(f"无法读取目标文件夹：{exc}") from exc
    temp = destination.parent / f".{destination.name}.dkl-export"
    if temp.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(temp, ignore_errors=True)
    temp.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    try:
        done = 0
        for relative, path, size in files:
            _check_cancel(cancel_event)
            dest = temp / relative
            dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(path, dest)
            done += size
            percent = 5 + int(90 * done / max(1, total_bytes))
            progress(percent, f"复制 {relative.as_posix()}")
        _write_metadata(temp, info, root_name, len(files), total_bytes, worlds, players)
        if destination.exists():
            destination.rmdir()
        os.replace(temp, destination)
    except ServerPackCancelled:
        shutil.rmtree(temp, ignore_errors=True)
        raise
    except Exception:
        shutil.rmtree(temp, ignore_errors=True)
        raise
    progress(100, "文件夹打包完成")
    log(f"服务端文件夹已保存：{destination}")
    return destination


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 识别 / 导入


def _detect_zip_prefix(names: list[str]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    def collect(marker: str, limit: int) -> list[tuple[str, ...]]:
        found: list[tuple[str, ...]] = []
        for name in names:
            normalized = str(name or "").replace("\\", "/")
            if not normalized or normalized.endswith("/"):
                continue
            parts = PurePosixPath(normalized).parts
            if not parts or len(parts) > limit:
                continue
            if parts[-1].lower() != marker:
                continue
            prefix = tuple(parts[:-1])
            if any(part.lower() == "__macosx" for part in prefix):
                continue
            if prefix not in found:
                found.append(prefix)
        return found

    for marker, limit in (
        (SERVER_PACK_MARKER, 3),
        ("server.json", 3),
        ("server.properties", 3),
        ("eula.txt", 3),
    ):
        found = collect(marker, limit)
        if not found:
            continue
        shortest = min(len(item) for item in found)
        roots = [item for item in found if len(item) == shortest]
        if len(roots) > 1:
            raise ServerPackError(
                "压缩包里包含多个服务端，请解压后单独拖入其中一个文件夹"
            )
        return roots[0]
    raise ServerPackError("这个压缩包不像 Minecraft 服务端包")


def _zip_manifest(zf: zipfile.ZipFile, prefix: tuple[str, ...]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    member = "/".join((*prefix, SERVER_PACK_MARKER))
    try:
        info = zf.getinfo(member)
    except KeyError:
        return {}
    if info.file_size > MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES:
        raise ServerPackError("服务端清单过大，已拒绝读取")
    if info.flag_bits & 0x1:
        raise ServerPackError("服务端包中的文件被加密，无法导入")
    try:
        data = json.loads(zf.read(info).decode("utf-8-sig"))
    except Exception:
        return {}
    return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}


def _zip_server_json(zf: zipfile.ZipFile, prefix: tuple[str, ...]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    member = "/".join((*prefix, "server.json"))
    try:
        info = zf.getinfo(member)
        if info.file_size > MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES:
            return {}
        data = json.loads(zf.read(info).decode("utf-8-sig"))
    except Exception:
        return {}
    return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}


def _zip_relative(name: str, prefix: tuple[str, ...]) -> str | None:
    normalized = str(name or "").replace("\\", "/")
    parts = PurePosixPath(normalized).parts
    if len(parts) < len(prefix) or tuple(parts[: len(prefix)]) != prefix:
        return None
    return "/".join(parts[len(prefix) :])


def _zip_stats(
    zf: zipfile.ZipFile, prefix: tuple[str, ...]
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    files = 0
    total = 0
    worlds: list[str] = []
    players = 0
    has_whitelist = False
    has_ops = False
    has_banned = False
    installed = False
    for item in zf.infolist():
        if item.is_dir():
            continue
        relative = _zip_relative(item.filename, prefix)
        if not relative:
            continue
        rel = Path(relative)
        if _skip_relative(rel):
            continue
        size = max(0, int(item.file_size))
        total += size
        files += 1
        if files > MAX_TOTAL_FILES:
            raise ServerPackError("服务端包内文件数量过多，已拒绝读取")
        if total > MAX_TOTAL_BYTES:
            raise ServerPackError("服务端包解压后体积超过 128 GB，已拒绝读取")
        lower = relative.lower()
        if lower in ("whitelist.json",):
            has_whitelist = True
        elif lower in ("ops.json",):
            has_ops = True
        elif lower.startswith("banned-"):
            has_banned = True
        elif lower in ("server.jar", "fabric-server-launch.jar"):
            installed = True
        elif lower.endswith("/win_args.txt") or lower.endswith("/unix_args.txt"):
            installed = True
        parts = rel.parts
        if len(parts) == 2 and parts[1].lower() == "level.dat":
            if parts[0] not in worlds:
                worlds.append(parts[0])
        if (
            len(parts) >= 3
            and parts[-2].lower() == "playerdata"
            and parts[-1].lower().endswith(".dat")
        ):
            players += 1
    return {
        "files": files,
        "bytes": total,
        "worlds": worlds,
        "players": players,
        "has_whitelist": has_whitelist,
        "has_ops": has_ops,
        "has_banned": has_banned,
        "installed": installed,
    }


def _find_folder_root(path: Path) -> Path:
    def marker(folder: Path) -> bool:
        return (
            any(
                (folder / name).exists()
                for name in (
                    SERVER_PACK_MARKER,
                    "server.json",
                    "server.properties",
                    "eula.txt",
                )
            )
            or (folder / "server.jar").is_file()
            or (folder / "fabric-server-launch.jar").is_file()
        )

    if marker(path) or (path / "world").joinpath("level.dat").is_file():
        return path
    try:
        candidates = [
            item
            for item in path.iterdir()
            if item.is_dir() and marker(item)
        ]
    except OSError:
        candidates = []
    if len(candidates) == 1:
        return candidates[0]
    if len(candidates) > 1:
        raise ServerPackError(
            "这个文件夹里包含多个服务端，请单独拖入其中一个服务端文件夹"
        )
    raise ServerPackError("这个文件夹不像 Minecraft 服务端文件夹")


def _folder_stats(root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    files = 0
    total = 0
    for _relative, _path, size in _scan_files(root):
        files += 1
        total += size
    if files > MAX_TOTAL_FILES or total > MAX_TOTAL_BYTES:
        raise ServerPackError("服务端文件夹过大，无法打包或导入")
    worlds = _world_names(root)
    return {
        "files": files,
        "bytes": total,
        "worlds": worlds,
        "players": _player_count(root, worlds),
        "has_whitelist": (root / "whitelist.json").is_file(),
        "has_ops": (root / "ops.json").is_file(),
        "has_banned": any(root.glob("banned-*.json")),
        "installed": (
            (root / "server.jar").is_file()
            or (root / "fabric-server-launch.jar").is_file()
            or bool(list(root.glob("libraries/**/win_args.txt")))
            or bool(list(root.glob("libraries/**/unix_args.txt")))
        ),
    }


def _fill_from_source(
    result: ServerPackInfo,
    manifest: dict[str, Any],
    server_data: dict[str, Any],
    stats: dict[str, Any],
    fallback_name: str,
) -> None:
    result.manifest = manifest
    result.name = str(
        manifest.get("name")
        or server_data.get("name")
        or fallback_name
        or "Minecraft 服务端"
    ).strip()
    result.kind = str(manifest.get("kind") or server_data.get("kind") or "").strip()
    result.mc_version = str(
        manifest.get("mc_version") or server_data.get("mc_version") or ""
    ).strip()
    result.loader_version = str(
        manifest.get("loader_version") or server_data.get("loader_version") or ""
    ).strip()
    result.total_files = int(stats.get("files") or manifest.get("files") or 0)
    result.total_bytes = int(stats.get("bytes") or manifest.get("bytes") or 0)
    result.worlds = list(
        stats.get("worlds") or manifest.get("worlds") or []
    )
    result.players = int(stats.get("players") or manifest.get("players") or 0)
    result.has_whitelist = bool(
        stats.get("has_whitelist")
        or (manifest.get("permissions") or {}).get("whitelist")
    )
    result.has_ops = bool(
        stats.get("has_ops") or (manifest.get("permissions") or {}).get("ops")
    )
    result.has_banned = bool(
        stats.get("has_banned")
        or (manifest.get("permissions") or {}).get("banned_players")
        or (manifest.get("permissions") or {}).get("banned_ips")
    )
    if "installed" in manifest:
        result.installed = bool(manifest.get("installed"))
    elif stats.get("installed"):
        result.installed = True
    elif server_data:
        result.installed = bool(server_data.get("installed"))
    else:
        result.installed = False
    if not result.kind:
        result.kind = "paper"
    if result.kind not in SERVER_NAMES:
        result.kind = "paper"


def inspect_server_pack(path: Path | str) -> ServerPackInfo:
    source = Path(path)
    if source.is_dir():
        root = _find_folder_root(source)
        manifest = _read_json(root / SERVER_PACK_MARKER)
        server_data = _read_json(root / "server.json")
        stats = _folder_stats(root)
        inferred = _infer_launch(root)
        merged = {**inferred, **server_data}
        result = ServerPackInfo(
            path=source,
            is_zip=False,
            root=root,
            archive_bytes=0,
        )
        _fill_from_source(
            result, manifest, merged, stats, root.name
        )
        if not result.mc_version:
            result.mc_version = str(inferred.get("mc_version") or "")
        if not result.kind:
            result.kind = str(inferred.get("kind") or "paper")
        if not result.loader_version:
            result.loader_version = str(inferred.get("loader_version") or "")
        return result

    if not source.is_file():
        raise ServerPackError("找不到服务端包")
    if source.suffix.lower() != ".zip":
        raise ServerPackError("只支持 ZIP 服务端包或服务端文件夹")
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(source) as zf:
            infos = zf.infolist()
            if len(infos) > MAX_TOTAL_FILES:
                raise ServerPackError("服务端包内文件数量过多，已拒绝读取")
            names = [item.filename for item in infos]
            prefix = _detect_zip_prefix(names)
            manifest = _zip_manifest(zf, prefix)
            server_data = _zip_server_json(zf, prefix)
            stats = _zip_stats(zf, prefix)
    except ServerPackError:
        raise
    except zipfile.BadZipFile as exc:
        raise ServerPackError("文件不是有效的 ZIP 压缩包") from exc
    except OSError as exc:
        raise ServerPackError(f"无法读取服务端包：{exc}") from exc

    fallback = str(prefix[-1] if prefix else source.stem)
    result = ServerPackInfo(
        path=source,
        is_zip=True,
        prefix="/".join(prefix),
        archive_bytes=source.stat().st_size,
    )
    _fill_from_source(result, manifest, server_data, stats, fallback)
    return result


def looks_like_server_pack(path: Path | str) -> bool:
    """只做轻量识别，供拖拽路由使用；完整检查交给 inspect_server_pack。"""
    source = Path(path)
    try:
        if source.is_dir():
            _find_folder_root(source)
            return True
        if not source.is_file() or source.suffix.lower() != ".zip":
            return False
        with zipfile.ZipFile(source) as zf:
            names = [item.filename for item in zf.infolist()]
        _detect_zip_prefix(names)
    except ServerPackError as exc:
        return "多个服务端" in str(exc)
    except Exception:
        return False
    return True


def _unique_folder(dest_root: Path, base: str) -> str:
    folder = _safe_folder(base) or "server"
    candidate = folder
    index = 2
    while (dest_root / candidate).exists():
        candidate = f"{folder[:44]}-{index}"
        index += 1
    return candidate


def suggest_server_folder(path: Path | str, servers_dir: Path | None = None) -> str:
    dest_root = Path(servers_dir or SERVERS_DIR)
    try:
        info = inspect_server_pack(path)
        base = info.name or "server"
    except Exception:
        base = Path(path).stem or "server"
    return _unique_folder(dest_root, base)


def _safe_member(name: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    value = str(name or "").replace("\\", "/")
    if not value or value.startswith("/") or re.match(r"^[A-Za-z]:", value):
        raise ServerPackError(f"服务端包内包含非法路径：{name}")
    parts = PurePosixPath(value).parts
    if any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in parts):
        raise ServerPackError(f"服务端包内包含越界路径：{name}")
    for part in parts:
        if (
            re.search(r'[<>:"|?*\x00-\x1f]', part)
            or part.endswith((" ", "."))
            or part.split(".", 1)[0].upper() in _WINDOWS_RESERVED
        ):
            raise ServerPackError(f"服务端包内包含 Windows 无法使用的路径：{name}")
    return parts


def _copy_folder(
    root: Path,
    staging: Path,
    files: list[tuple[Path, Path, int]],
    total_bytes: int,
    progress: ProgressCallback,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None,
) -> None:
    done = 0
    staging.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for relative, path, size in files:
        _check_cancel(cancel_event)
        destination = staging / relative
        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(path, destination)
        done += size
        progress(
            5 + int(85 * done / max(1, total_bytes)),
            f"导入 {relative.as_posix()}",
        )


def _extract_zip(
    zf: zipfile.ZipFile,
    prefix: tuple[str, ...],
    staging: Path,
    total_bytes: int,
    progress: ProgressCallback,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None,
) -> None:
    done = 0
    staging.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for item in zf.infolist():
        if item.is_dir():
            continue
        if item.flag_bits & 0x1:
            raise ServerPackError("服务端包中的文件被加密，无法导入")
        mode = (item.external_attr >> 16) & 0o170000
        if mode == 0o120000:
            raise ServerPackError("服务端包里不允许符号链接")
        relative = _zip_relative(item.filename, prefix)
        if not relative:
            continue
        parts = _safe_member(relative)
        rel = Path(*parts)
        if _skip_relative(rel):
            continue
        _check_cancel(cancel_event)
        destination = staging / rel
        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with zf.open(item) as source, destination.open("wb") as target:
            shutil.copyfileobj(source, target, 1024 * 1024)
        done += max(0, int(item.file_size))
        progress(
            5 + int(85 * done / max(1, total_bytes)),
            f"解压 {relative}",
        )


def _launch_exists(folder: Path, data: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    kind = str(data.get("launch_kind") or "")
    target = str(data.get("launch_target") or "")
    if kind == "args":
        return bool(target) and (folder / target).is_file()
    if kind == "classpath":
        return bool(target) and bool(data.get("launch_classpath"))
    if kind == "jar":
        return bool(target) and (folder / target).is_file()
    return (folder / "server.jar").is_file() or (
        folder / "fabric-server-launch.jar"
    ).is_file()


def _write_import_server_json(
    folder: Path,
    info: ServerPackInfo,
    display_name: str,
    folder_name: str,
) -> None:
    data = _read_json(folder / "server.json")
    for key in (
        "kind",
        "mc_version",
        "loader_version",
        "paper_build",
        "memory_mb",
        "port",
        "online_mode",
        "launch_kind",
        "launch_target",
        "launch_classpath",
    ):
        value = info.manifest.get(key)
        if value not in (None, "") and data.get(key) in (None, "", []):
            data[key] = value
    if not data.get("kind"):
        data["kind"] = info.kind or "paper"
    if not data.get("mc_version"):
        data["mc_version"] = info.mc_version
    if not data.get("loader_version"):
        data["loader_version"] = info.loader_version
    inferred = _infer_launch(folder)
    for key, value in inferred.items():
        if value and not data.get(key):
            data[key] = value
    data["folder"] = folder_name
    data["name"] = display_name
    data["java_path"] = ""

    props = _read_properties(folder / "server.properties")
    try:
        data["port"] = int(props.get("server-port") or data.get("port") or 25565)
    except Exception:
        data["port"] = 25565
    online = str(props.get("online-mode", "")).strip().lower()
    if online in ("true", "false"):
        data["online_mode"] = online == "true"
    elif "online_mode" not in data:
        data["online_mode"] = False
    try:
        data["memory_mb"] = max(512, min(65536, int(data.get("memory_mb") or 4096)))
    except Exception:
        data["memory_mb"] = 4096
    data["eula"] = _eula_accepted(folder)
    data["installed"] = _launch_exists(folder, data)
    if not data.get("created_at"):
        data["created_at"] = _now()
    known = set(ServerInfo.__dataclass_fields__)
    clean = {key: value for key, value in data.items() if key in known}
    (folder / "server.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(clean, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def import_server_pack(
    source: Path | str,
    *,
    name: str = "",
    servers_dir: Path | str | None = None,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    log_cb: LogCallback | None = None,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
) -> str:
    """把 ZIP 或文件夹导入为新的服务端，保留世界、玩家与权限数据。"""
    info = inspect_server_pack(source)
    dest_root = Path(servers_dir or SERVERS_DIR)
    dest_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    display_name = str(name or info.name or "Minecraft 服务端").strip()
    folder_name = _unique_folder(dest_root, display_name)
    target = dest_root / folder_name
    progress = progress_cb or (lambda _p, _m: None)
    log = log_cb or (lambda _m: None)
    stamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
    staging = dest_root / f".import-{stamp}-{os.getpid()}"
    if staging.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(staging, ignore_errors=True)

    progress(1, "检查服务端包…")
    try:
        if info.is_zip:
            with zipfile.ZipFile(info.path) as zf:
                prefix = tuple(info.prefix.split("/")) if info.prefix else ()
                _extract_zip(
                    zf,
                    prefix,
                    staging,
                    info.total_bytes,
                    progress,
                    cancel_event,
                )
        else:
            root = info.root or Path(info.path)
            if root.resolve() == dest_root.resolve():
                raise ServerPackError("不能把 servers 目录本身当作服务端导入")
            files = list(_scan_files(root))
            _copy_folder(
                root,
                staging,
                files,
                info.total_bytes,
                progress,
                cancel_event,
            )
        _check_cancel(cancel_event)
        progress(94, "写入服务端设置…")
        _write_import_server_json(staging, info, display_name, folder_name)
        _check_cancel(cancel_event)
        if target.exists():
            raise ServerPackError(f"服务端 {folder_name} 已经存在")
        os.replace(staging, target)
    except ServerPackCancelled:
        shutil.rmtree(staging, ignore_errors=True)
        raise
    except Exception:
        shutil.rmtree(staging, ignore_errors=True)
        raise

    progress(100, "导入完成")
    log(
        f"服务端已导入：{display_name} · {info.type_name} {info.mc_version} · "
        f"世界 {len(info.worlds)} 个 · 玩家 {info.players} 份"
    )
    return folder_name

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 数据模型与目录


@dataclass
class ServerInfo:
    folder: str
    name: str
    kind: str
    mc_version: str
    loader_version: str = ""
    java_path: str = ""
    memory_mb: int = 4096
    port: int = 25565
    online_mode: bool = False
    seed: str = ""
    eula: bool = False
    installed: bool = False
    install_error: str = ""
    launch_kind: str = ""
    launch_target: str = ""
    launch_classpath: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    paper_build: int = 0
    created_at: str = ""
    installed_at: str = ""
    last_started: str = ""

    @property
    def type_name(self) -> str:
        return SERVER_NAMES.get(self.kind, self.kind or "未知")

    @property
    def is_plugin_server(self) -> bool:
        return self.kind in PLUGIN_SERVERS

    @property
    def addon_dir_name(self) -> str:
        return "plugins" if self.is_plugin_server else "mods"

    @property
    def addon_label(self) -> str:
        return "插件" if self.is_plugin_server else "Mod"

    @property
    def path(self) -> Path:
        return SERVERS_DIR / self.folder

    @property
    def display_version(self) -> str:
        if self.kind == "paper" and self.paper_build:
            return f"{self.mc_version} · #{self.paper_build}"
        if self.loader_version:
            return f"{self.mc_version} · {self.loader_version}"
        return self.mc_version


def _now() -> str:
    return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")


def _safe_folder(name: str) -> str:
    text = re.sub(r'[<>:"/\\|?*\x00-\x1f]', "", str(name or "")).strip()
    text = text.rstrip(". ")
    reserved = {
        "CON",
        "PRN",
        "AUX",
        "NUL",
        *(f"COM{i}" for i in range(1, 10)),
        *(f"LPT{i}" for i in range(1, 10)),
    }
    if not text or text.upper() in reserved:
        text = "server"
    return text[:48]


def new_server_folder(name: str, kind: str, mc_version: str) -> str:
    SERVERS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    base = _safe_folder(name) or _safe_folder(f"{kind}-{mc_version}")
    folder = base
    index = 2
    while (SERVERS_DIR / folder).exists():
        folder = f"{base}-{index}"
        index += 1
    return folder


def server_json_path(info: ServerInfo) -> Path:
    return info.path / "server.json"


def save_server(info: ServerInfo) -> None:
    path = server_json_path(info)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    data = asdict(info)
    data["kind"] = info.kind
    tmp = path.with_name(path.name + ".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    os.replace(tmp, path)


def load_server(folder: str) -> ServerInfo | None:
    folder = str(folder or "")
    if not folder or Path(folder).name != folder:
        return None
    path = SERVERS_DIR / folder / "server.json"
    if not path.exists():
        return None
    try:
        data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        return None
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        return None
    data["folder"] = folder
    known = set(ServerInfo.__dataclass_fields__)
    clean = {k: v for k, v in data.items() if k in known}
    try:
        info = ServerInfo(**clean)
    except Exception:
        return None
    if info.kind not in SERVER_NAMES:
        return None
    try:
        info.memory_mb = max(512, min(65536, int(info.memory_mb or 4096)))
    except Exception:
        info.memory_mb = 4096
    try:
        info.port = max(1, min(65535, int(info.port or 25565)))
    except Exception:
        info.port = 25565
    if not isinstance(info.launch_classpath, list):
        info.launch_classpath = []
    info.launch_classpath = [str(item) for item in info.launch_classpath if item]
    info.eula = bool(info.eula) or eula_path(info).exists()
    return info


def scan_servers() -> list[ServerInfo]:
    if not SERVERS_DIR.exists():
        return []
    result: list[ServerInfo] = []
    try:
        folders = [p for p in SERVERS_DIR.iterdir() if p.is_dir()]
    except OSError:
        return []
    for folder in folders:
        info = load_server(folder.name)
        if info is not None:
            result.append(info)
    result.sort(key=lambda item: (item.installed, item.created_at), reverse=True)
    return result


def eula_path(info: ServerInfo) -> Path:
    return info.path / "eula.txt"


def write_eula(info: ServerInfo) -> None:
    info.path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    eula_path(info).write_text("eula=true\n", encoding="utf-8")
    info.eula = True


def addons_dir(info: ServerInfo) -> Path:
    return info.path / info.addon_dir_name


def _properties_escape(value: str) -> str:
    text = str(value or "")
    text = text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\n", "\\n").replace("\r", "\\r")
    text = text.replace("=", "\\=").replace(":", "\\:")
    out: list[str] = []
    for ch in text:
        code = ord(ch)
        if code < 32 or code > 126:
            if code <= 0xFFFF:
                out.append(f"\\u{code:04x}")
            else:
                out.append("?")
        else:
            out.append(ch)
    return "".join(out)


def update_server_properties(
    info: ServerInfo, updates: dict[str, Any] | None = None
) -> None:
    path = info.path / "server.properties"
    info.path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    values = {k: str(v) for k, v in DEFAULT_PROPERTIES.items()}
    values.update(
        {
            "server-port": str(info.port),
            "online-mode": "true" if info.online_mode else "false",
        }
    )
    seed = str(getattr(info, "seed", "") or "").strip()
    if seed:
        values["level-seed"] = seed
    for key, value in (updates or {}).items():
        values[str(key)] = str(value)

    lines: list[str] = []
    if path.exists():
        try:
            lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()
        except OSError:
            lines = []
    existing: dict[str, int] = {}
    for index, line in enumerate(lines):
        raw = line.strip()
        if not raw or raw.startswith("#") or raw.startswith("!") or "=" not in raw:
            continue
        key = raw.split("=", 1)[0].strip()
        existing[key] = index
    for key, value in values.items():
        encoded = f"{key}={_properties_escape(value)}"
        if key in existing:
            lines[existing[key]] = encoded
        else:
            lines.append(encoded)
    if not lines:
        lines = ["#Minecraft server properties"]
    path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def check_port(port: int, host: str = "") -> bool:
    sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    try:
        sock.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
        sock.bind((host, int(port)))
        return True
    except OSError:
        return False
    finally:
        try:
            sock.close()
        except OSError:
            pass


def required_java_major(mc_version: str) -> int:
    pieces = [int(x) for x in re.findall(r"\d+", str(mc_version))[:3]]
    if len(pieces) < 2:
        return 21
    major, minor = pieces[0], pieces[1]
    patch = pieces[2] if len(pieces) > 2 else 0
    # 2026 年起 Mojang 改用年份版本号（26.x），Paper 与官方服务端最低要求 Java 25。
    if major >= 26:
        return 25
    if major > 1 or (major == 1 and minor >= 21):
        return 21
    if (major, minor, patch) >= (1, 20, 5):
        return 21
    if (major, minor) >= (1, 18):
        return 17
    if (major, minor) == (1, 17):
        return 16
    return 8


def send_to_recycle_bin(path: Path) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    """优先移动到 Windows 回收站，失败时移入启动器内 .trash 目录。"""
    target = Path(path)
    if not target.exists():
        return False, "文件夹不存在"
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        try:
            import ctypes
            from ctypes import wintypes

            class _SHFileOpStructW(ctypes.Structure):
                _fields_ = [
                    ("hwnd", wintypes.HWND),
                    ("wFunc", wintypes.UINT),
                    ("pFrom", ctypes.c_wchar_p),
                    ("pTo", ctypes.c_wchar_p),
                    ("fFlags", wintypes.USHORT),
                    ("fAnyOperationsAborted", wintypes.BOOL),
                    ("hNameMappings", ctypes.c_void_p),
                    ("lpszProgressTitle", ctypes.c_wchar_p),
                ]

            buffer = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(str(target.resolve()) + "\0")
            op = _SHFileOpStructW()
            op.hwnd = None
            op.wFunc = 3  # FO_DELETE
            op.pFrom = ctypes.cast(buffer, ctypes.c_wchar_p)
            op.pTo = None
            op.fFlags = 0x0040 | 0x0010 | 0x0004 | 0x0400  # ALLOWUNDO | NOCONFIRM | SILENT | NOERRORUI
            op.fAnyOperationsAborted = False
            op.hNameMappings = None
            op.lpszProgressTitle = None
            shell = ctypes.windll.shell32
            shell.SHFileOperationW.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(_SHFileOpStructW)]
            shell.SHFileOperationW.restype = ctypes.c_int
            code = shell.SHFileOperationW(ctypes.byref(op))
            if code == 0 and not op.fAnyOperationsAborted:
                return True, "已移动到回收站"
        except Exception:
            pass
    try:
        trash = APP_DIR / ".trash" / "servers"
        trash.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        stamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
        destination = trash / f"{stamp}-{target.name}"
        index = 2
        while destination.exists():
            destination = trash / f"{stamp}-{target.name}-{index}"
            index += 1
        shutil.move(str(target), str(destination))
        return True, f"已移入启动器回收目录：{destination}"
    except Exception as exc:
        return False, str(exc)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 基础工具


def _get_json(url: str, timeout: int = 45) -> Any:
    with _http_open(
        url,
        timeout=timeout,
        headers={"Accept": "application/json"},
    ) as resp:
        raw = resp.read()
    return json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))


def _sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as fp:
        while True:
            chunk = fp.read(1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _find_git() -> str:
    found = shutil.which("git")
    if found:
        return found
    candidates = [
        Path("C:/Program Files/Git/cmd/git.exe"),
        Path("C:/Program Files/Git/bin/git.exe"),
        Path("C:/Program Files (x86)/Git/cmd/git.exe"),
        Path(os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA", "")) / "Programs/Git/cmd/git.exe",
    ]
    for item in candidates:
        try:
            if item.exists():
                return str(item)
        except OSError:
            continue
    raise ServerError("没有找到 Git。Spigot 的 BuildTools 需要 Git，请先安装 Git 后重试。")


def _run_process(
    cmd: list[str],
    cwd: Path,
    *,
    log_cb: LogCallback,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None,
    process_cb: ProcessCallback | None,
    env: dict[str, str] | None = None,
) -> int:
    log_cb("运行：" + subprocess.list2cmdline(cmd))
    startupinfo = None
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        startupinfo = subprocess.STARTUPINFO()
        startupinfo.dwFlags |= subprocess.STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW
        startupinfo.wShowWindow = subprocess.SW_HIDE
    try:
        proc = subprocess.Popen(
            cmd,
            cwd=str(cwd),
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            text=True,
            encoding="utf-8",
            errors="replace",
            bufsize=1,
            creationflags=CREATE_NO_WINDOW,
            startupinfo=startupinfo,
            env=env,
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ServerError(f"无法启动安装进程：{exc}") from exc

    if process_cb:
        process_cb(proc)
    cancelled = False
    try:
        assert proc.stdout is not None
        for line in proc.stdout:
            if cancel_event is not None and cancel_event.is_set():
                cancelled = True
                try:
                    proc.terminate()
                except Exception:
                    pass
                break
            text = line.rstrip("\r\n")
            if text:
                log_cb(text)
        try:
            code = proc.wait(timeout=20)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            try:
                proc.terminate()
            except Exception:
                pass
            code = proc.wait(timeout=10)
    finally:
        if process_cb:
            process_cb(None)

    if cancelled or (cancel_event is not None and cancel_event.is_set()):
        raise InstallCancelled()
    return int(code)
