from __future__ import annotations

import json
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from PySide6.QtCore import QRect, Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QColor, QImage, QPainter

from .config import APP_DIR
from .installer import _http_open
from .microsoft_auth import USER_AGENT, fetch_profile

SKIN_API_URL = "https://api.minecraftservices.com/minecraft/profile/skins"
SKIN_DIR = APP_DIR / "skins"
LOCAL_SKIN_NAME = "local-skin.png"
PNG_SIGNATURE = b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
VALID_VARIANTS = ("classic", "slim")


class SkinError(Exception):
    pass


@dataclass
class SkinFile:
    image: QImage
    data: bytes
    legacy: bool = False
    source: str = ""


@dataclass
class CurrentSkin:
    image: QImage
    variant: str = "classic"
    url: str = ""
    skin_id: str = ""
    alias: str = ""


def _friendly_size(width: int, height: int) -> str:
    return f"{width}×{height}"


def validate_skin_bytes(data: bytes, *, source: str = "") -> SkinFile:
    if not data:
        raise SkinError("皮肤文件是空的，请选择有效的 PNG 图片。")
    if not data.startswith(PNG_SIGNATURE):
        raise SkinError("这不是 PNG 图片。Minecraft 皮肤必须使用 PNG 格式。")
    if len(data) > 4 * 1024 * 1024:
        raise SkinError("皮肤文件过大，请选择 64×64 或 64×32 的 PNG 图片。")
    image = QImage.fromData(data, "PNG")
    if image.isNull():
        raise SkinError("无法读取这张 PNG 图片，文件可能已损坏。")
    width, height = image.width(), image.height()
    if (width, height) not in ((64, 64), (64, 32)):
        raise SkinError(
            f"皮肤尺寸为 {_friendly_size(width, height)}，"
            "Minecraft 仅支持 64×64（现代）或 64×32（旧版）皮肤。"
        )
    image = image.convertToFormat(QImage.Format_ARGB32)
    return SkinFile(
        image=image,
        data=data,
        legacy=height == 32,
        source=source,
    )


def load_skin_file(path: str | Path) -> SkinFile:
    file_path = Path(path)
    try:
        data = file_path.read_bytes()
    except OSError as exc:
        raise SkinError(f"无法读取皮肤文件：{exc}") from exc
    return validate_skin_bytes(data, source=str(file_path))


def save_local_skin(skin: SkinFile) -> Path:
    SKIN_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest = SKIN_DIR / LOCAL_SKIN_NAME
    try:
        dest.write_bytes(skin.data)
    except OSError as exc:
        raise SkinError(f"无法保存皮肤预览副本：{exc}") from exc
    return dest


def local_skin_path() -> Path:
    return SKIN_DIR / LOCAL_SKIN_NAME


def active_skin(profile: dict[str, Any] | None) -> CurrentSkin | None:
    if not isinstance(profile, dict):
        return None
    skins = profile.get("skins")
    if not isinstance(skins, list):
        return None
    chosen: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    for entry in skins:
        if isinstance(entry, dict) and entry.get("url"):
            if str(entry.get("state") or "").upper() == "ACTIVE":
                chosen = entry
                break
    if chosen is None:
        chosen = next(
            (entry for entry in skins if isinstance(entry, dict) and entry.get("url")),
            None,
        )
    if chosen is None:
        return None
    return CurrentSkin(
        image=QImage(),
        variant=str(chosen.get("variant") or "classic").lower(),
        url=str(chosen.get("url") or ""),
        skin_id=str(chosen.get("id") or ""),
        alias=str(chosen.get("alias") or ""),
    )


def download_skin_image(url: str, timeout: int = 30) -> QImage:
    if not url:
        raise SkinError("没有可下载的皮肤地址。")
    try:
        with _http_open(
            url,
            timeout=timeout,
            headers={"Accept": "image/png,image/*;q=0.8"},
        ) as response:
            raw = response.read()
    except Exception as exc:
        raise SkinError(f"下载皮肤纹理失败：{exc}") from exc
    skin = validate_skin_bytes(raw, source=url)
    return skin.image


def fetch_account_skin(
    account, client_id: str
) -> tuple[CurrentSkin | None, Any]:
    """刷新正版令牌并读取当前皮肤，返回 (皮肤, 更新后的账户)。"""
    from .microsoft_auth import ensure_minecraft_token

    account = ensure_minecraft_token(account, client_id)
    profile = fetch_profile(account.mc_access_token)
    skin = active_skin(profile)
    if skin is not None:
        skin.image = download_skin_image(skin.url)
        if skin.variant not in VALID_VARIANTS:
            skin.variant = "classic"
    return skin, account


def _api_message(raw: bytes, status: int) -> str:
    try:
        payload = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        payload = {}
    if isinstance(payload, dict):
        for key in ("errorMessage", "error_message", "message", "error", "details"):
            value = payload.get(key)
            if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
                return value.strip()[:240]
    if status == 401:
        return "Minecraft 登录已失效，请重新登录正版账户。"
    if status == 403:
        return "该账户没有修改皮肤的权限。"
    if status == 429:
        return "皮肤服务请求过于频繁，请稍后再试。"
    return f"皮肤服务返回了错误（HTTP {status}）。"


def _skin_request(
    method: str, access_token: str, data: bytes | None = None, content_type: str = ""
) -> None:
    if not access_token:
        raise SkinError("Minecraft 登录令牌为空，请重新登录正版账户。")
    headers = {
        "User-Agent": USER_AGENT,
        "Accept": "application/json",
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}",
    }
    if content_type:
        headers["Content-Type"] = content_type
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        SKIN_API_URL, data=data, headers=headers, method=method
    )
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=45) as response:
            response.read()
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        raw = exc.read()
        raise SkinError(_api_message(raw, exc.code)) from None
    except urllib.error.URLError as exc:
        raise SkinError(f"无法连接 Minecraft 皮肤服务：{exc.reason}") from None
    except OSError as exc:
        raise SkinError(f"皮肤请求失败：{exc}") from None


def change_skin(access_token: str, png_data: bytes, variant: str = "classic") -> None:
    variant = (variant or "classic").lower()
    if variant not in VALID_VARIANTS:
        variant = "classic"
    if not png_data:
        raise SkinError("没有可上传的皮肤文件。")
    boundary = "----DarkittenSkin" + uuid.uuid4().hex
    chunks: list[bytes] = [
        f"--{boundary}\r\n".encode("ascii"),
        b'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="variant"\r\n\r\n',
        variant.encode("ascii"),
        b"\r\n",
        f"--{boundary}\r\n".encode("ascii"),
        b'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="skin.png"\r\n',
        b"Content-Type: image/png\r\n\r\n",
        png_data,
        b"\r\n",
        f"--{boundary}--\r\n".encode("ascii"),
    ]
    _skin_request(
        "POST",
        access_token,
        b"".join(chunks),
        f"multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}",
    )


def reset_skin(access_token: str) -> None:
    _skin_request("DELETE", access_token)


def variant_text(variant: str) -> str:
    return "Slim（Alex 细手臂）" if str(variant).lower() == "slim" else "Classic（Steve 标准手臂）"


def _fill(painter: QPainter, x: int, y: int, w: int, h: int, color: str) -> None:
    painter.fillRect(QRect(x, y, w, h), QColor(color))


def bundled_skin_path() -> Path:
    return APP_DIR / "assets" / "dkl_skin.png"


def default_skin() -> QImage:
    """优先使用内置的官方 Steve 皮肤，缺失时回退到程序绘制的 Steve 占位皮肤。"""
    bundled = bundled_skin_path()
    if bundled.is_file():
        image = QImage(str(bundled), "PNG")
        if not image.isNull() and (image.width(), image.height()) in ((64, 64), (64, 32)):
            return image.convertToFormat(QImage.Format_ARGB32)

    image = QImage(64, 64, QImage.Format_ARGB32)
    image.fill(Qt.transparent)
    painter = QPainter(image)
    painter.setPen(Qt.NoPen)

    skin = "#C99C6E"
    skin_dark = "#B5875C"
    hair = "#3B2B20"
    shirt = "#2E8E9C"
    shirt_dark = "#257680"
    pants = "#3C4F9E"
    pants_dark = "#314181"
    shoe = "#57534E"
    eye = "#2F4F73"
    mouth = "#8A5A45"

    # 头部
    _fill(painter, 8, 0, 8, 8, hair)
    _fill(painter, 16, 0, 8, 8, skin_dark)
    _fill(painter, 0, 8, 8, 8, hair)
    _fill(painter, 8, 8, 8, 8, skin)
    _fill(painter, 16, 8, 8, 8, hair)
    _fill(painter, 24, 8, 8, 8, hair)
    _fill(painter, 8, 8, 8, 2, hair)
    _fill(painter, 8, 10, 1, 3, hair)
    _fill(painter, 15, 10, 1, 3, hair)
    _fill(painter, 9, 12, 2, 1, "#F2F2F2")
    _fill(painter, 13, 12, 2, 1, "#F2F2F2")
    _fill(painter, 10, 12, 1, 1, eye)
    _fill(painter, 13, 12, 1, 1, eye)
    _fill(painter, 11, 13, 2, 1, skin_dark)
    _fill(painter, 11, 14, 2, 1, mouth)

    # 身体
    for rect in ((20, 16, 8, 4), (28, 16, 8, 4), (16, 20, 4, 12),
                 (20, 20, 8, 12), (24, 20, 4, 12), (32, 20, 8, 12)):
        _fill(painter, *rect, shirt)
    _fill(painter, 20, 28, 8, 4, shirt_dark)

    # 右臂 / 左臂
    for ox, oy in ((40, 16), (32, 48)):
        for rect in ((ox + 4, oy, 4, 4), (ox + 8, oy, 4, 4),
                     (ox, oy + 4, 4, 12), (ox + 4, oy + 4, 4, 12),
                     (ox + 8, oy + 4, 4, 12), (ox + 12, oy + 4, 4, 12)):
            _fill(painter, *rect, skin)
        _fill(painter, ox + 4, oy, 4, 4, shirt)
        _fill(painter, ox, oy + 4, 16, 4, shirt)

    # 右腿 / 左腿
    for ox, oy in ((0, 16), (16, 48)):
        for rect in ((ox + 4, oy, 4, 4), (ox + 8, oy, 4, 4),
                     (ox, oy + 4, 4, 12), (ox + 4, oy + 4, 4, 12),
                     (ox + 8, oy + 4, 4, 12), (ox + 12, oy + 4, 4, 12)):
            _fill(painter, *rect, pants)
        _fill(painter, ox, oy + 13, 16, 3, shoe)
        _fill(painter, ox + 12, oy + 4, 4, 12, pants_dark)

    painter.end()
    return image

# FILE: darkitten/snapshots.py

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import shutil
import time
import zipfile
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
from typing import Callable

SNAPSHOT_FORMAT = 1
SNAPSHOT_DIR_NAME = ".dkl-backups"
SNAPSHOT_OPTION_FILES = (
    "options.txt",
    "optionsof.txt",
    "optionsshaders.txt",
    "servers.dat",
    "servers.dat_old",
)
SNAPSHOT_DIRS = ("saves", "config", "defaultconfigs")
SKIP_NAMES = {"session.lock"}
MAX_ENTRY_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024

LogCallback = Callable[[str], None]


class SnapshotError(Exception):
    pass


@dataclass
class SnapshotInfo:
    path: Path
    created_at: float
    version_id: str
    files: int
    bytes: int
    note: str = ""
    skipped: int = 0

    @property
    def created_text(self) -> str:
        return time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", time.localtime(self.created_at))

    @property
    def size_text(self) -> str:
        size = float(self.bytes)
        if size >= 1024 * 1024 * 1024:
            return f"{size / 1024 / 1024 / 1024:.2f} GB"
        if size >= 1024 * 1024:
            return f"{size / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB"
        if size >= 1024:
            return f"{size / 1024:.0f} KB"
        return f"{int(size)} B"


def snapshot_dir(game_path: Path) -> Path:
    return Path(game_path) / SNAPSHOT_DIR_NAME / "snapshots"


def _iter_sources(game_path: Path):
    game_path = Path(game_path)
    for name in SNAPSHOT_OPTION_FILES:
        path = game_path / name
        if path.is_file():
            yield path
    for name in SNAPSHOT_DIRS:
        root = game_path / name
        if not root.is_dir():
            continue
        for path in root.rglob("*"):
            if path.is_file():
                yield path


def _relative(path: Path, game_path: Path) -> str:
    return path.relative_to(game_path).as_posix()


def _read_meta(archive: zipfile.ZipFile) -> dict:
    try:
        raw = archive.read("snapshot.json")
        data = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
        return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}
    except (KeyError, OSError, ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
        return {}


def create_snapshot(
    game_path: Path,
    version_id: str = "",
    note: str = "",
    log: LogCallback | None = None,
) -> SnapshotInfo:
    """把当前版本的世界、配置和选项文件打包成 ZIP 快照。"""
    game_path = Path(game_path)
    if not game_path.is_dir():
        raise SnapshotError(f"游戏目录不存在：{game_path}")

    files = list(_iter_sources(game_path))
    if not files:
        raise SnapshotError("没有找到可备份的世界或配置文件")

    root = snapshot_dir(game_path)
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
    safe_version = "".join(
        char if char.isalnum() or char in "-_." else "_" for char in version_id
    )[:48]
    base = f"{stamp}-{safe_version}" if safe_version else stamp
    path = root / f"{base}.zip"
    index = 1
    while path.exists():
        path = root / f"{base}-{index}.zip"
        index += 1

    created_at = time.time()
    total_bytes = 0
    written = 0
    skipped: list[str] = []
    temp = path.with_name(path.name + ".tmp")
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(
            temp, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=6
        ) as archive:
            for file_path in files:
                name = _relative(file_path, game_path)
                if file_path.name in SKIP_NAMES:
                    continue
                try:
                    archive.write(file_path, name)
                    total_bytes += file_path.stat().st_size
                    written += 1
                except OSError:
                    skipped.append(name)
                    if log:
                        log(f"跳过被占用的文件：{name}")
            meta = {
                "format": SNAPSHOT_FORMAT,
                "version_id": version_id,
                "created_at": created_at,
                "game_path": str(game_path),
                "files": written,
                "bytes": total_bytes,
                "note": note,
                "skipped": skipped[:50],
            }
            archive.writestr(
                "snapshot.json",
                json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2).encode("utf-8"),
            )
        temp.replace(path)
    except Exception:
        try:
            temp.unlink()
        except OSError:
            pass
        raise

    if log:
        log(f"快照已创建：{path.name}（{written} 个文件，{total_bytes} 字节）")
    return SnapshotInfo(
        path=path,
        created_at=created_at,
        version_id=version_id,
        files=written,
        bytes=total_bytes,
        note=note,
        skipped=len(skipped),
    )


def read_snapshot_info(path: Path) -> SnapshotInfo:
    path = Path(path)
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
            meta = _read_meta(archive)
    except (OSError, zipfile.BadZipFile):
        meta = {}
    try:
        stat = path.stat()
        fallback_time = stat.st_mtime
        fallback_size = stat.st_size
    except OSError:
        fallback_time = 0.0
        fallback_size = 0
    return SnapshotInfo(
        path=path,
        created_at=float(meta.get("created_at") or fallback_time),
        version_id=str(meta.get("version_id") or ""),
        files=int(meta.get("files") or 0),
        bytes=int(meta.get("bytes") or fallback_size),
        note=str(meta.get("note") or ""),
        skipped=len(meta.get("skipped") or []),
    )


def list_snapshots(game_path: Path) -> list[SnapshotInfo]:
    root = snapshot_dir(game_path)
    if not root.is_dir():
        return []
    result = [read_snapshot_info(path) for path in root.glob("*.zip")]
    result.sort(key=lambda item: item.created_at, reverse=True)
    return result


def _safe_members(archive: zipfile.ZipFile) -> list[zipfile.ZipInfo]:
    safe: list[zipfile.ZipInfo] = []
    for info in archive.infolist():
        name = info.filename
        if not name or name.endswith("/") or name == "snapshot.json":
            continue
        pure = PurePosixPath(name)
        if pure.is_absolute() or ".." in pure.parts or ":" in pure.parts[0]:
            raise SnapshotError(f"快照包含不安全路径：{name}")
        if info.file_size > MAX_ENTRY_BYTES:
            raise SnapshotError(f"快照文件过大，已中止：{name}")
        safe.append(info)
    return safe


def restore_snapshot(
    archive_path: Path,
    game_path: Path,
    log: LogCallback | None = None,
) -> int:
    """恢复快照；覆盖同名文件，但不会删除快照之外的新文件。"""
    archive_path = Path(archive_path)
    game_path = Path(game_path)
    if not archive_path.is_file():
        raise SnapshotError("快照文件不存在")
    if not game_path.is_dir():
        raise SnapshotError(f"游戏目录不存在：{game_path}")

    restored = 0
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
        members = _safe_members(archive)
        for info in members:
            target = game_path / PurePosixPath(info.filename)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            try:
                with archive.open(info) as source, target.open("wb") as dest:
                    shutil.copyfileobj(source, dest)
                restored += 1
            except OSError as exc:
                raise SnapshotError(f"恢复 {info.filename} 失败：{exc}") from exc
    if log:
        log(f"已从 {archive_path.name} 恢复 {restored} 个文件")
    return restored

# FILE: darkitten/social.py

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import json
import re
import secrets
import time
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path

from .config import APP_DIR

SOCIAL_PATH = APP_DIR / "social.json"
INVITE_PREFIX = "DKLF1:"
ID_RE = re.compile(r"^DKL-[A-Z0-9]{4,16}$")
ROOM_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.:\-]{3,80}$")


class SocialError(Exception):
    pass


def new_profile_id() -> str:
    return "DKL-" + secrets.token_hex(4).upper()


@dataclass
class SocialProfile:
    id: str = ""
    name: str = ""
    created_at: float = 0.0
    room_code: str = ""
    room_version: str = ""

    def ensure(self, fallback_name: str = "Steve") -> "SocialProfile":
        if not ID_RE.fullmatch(self.id or ""):
            self.id = new_profile_id()
        self.name = str(self.name or fallback_name or "Steve").strip()[:24]
        if not self.created_at:
            self.created_at = time.time()
        return self


@dataclass
class Friend:
    id: str
    name: str
    room_code: str = ""
    room_version: str = ""
    note: str = ""
    added_at: float = 0.0
    last_room_at: float = 0.0

    def ensure(self) -> "Friend":
        self.id = str(self.id or "").strip().upper()
        if not ID_RE.fullmatch(self.id):
            raise SocialError("好友 ID 格式不正确，应以 DKL- 开头。")
        self.name = str(self.name or "未命名好友").strip()[:24]
        self.room_code = str(self.room_code or "").strip()[:80]
        self.room_version = str(self.room_version or "").strip()[:64]
        self.note = str(self.note or "").strip()[:120]
        if not self.added_at:
            self.added_at = time.time()
        return self


@dataclass
class Invite:
    id: str
    name: str
    room_code: str = ""
    room_version: str = ""
    note: str = ""
    kind: str = "friend"
    mod_manifest: str = ""


def encode_invite(
    profile: SocialProfile,
    room_code: str = "",
    room_version: str = "",
    note: str = "",
    kind: str = "friend",
    mod_manifest: str = "",
) -> str:
    payload = {
        "v": 1,
        "kind": kind,
        "id": profile.id,
        "name": profile.name,
        "room": str(room_code or profile.room_code or "").strip(),
        "mc": str(room_version or profile.room_version or "").strip(),
        "note": str(note or "").strip()[:120],
        "ts": int(time.time()),
    }
    manifest = str(mod_manifest or "").strip()
    if manifest:
        payload["mods"] = manifest
    raw = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
    token = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(raw).decode("ascii").rstrip("=")
    return INVITE_PREFIX + token


def parse_invite(text: str) -> Invite:
    raw = str(text or "").strip()
    if not raw:
        raise SocialError("请先粘贴好友发来的 DKL 邀请卡。")
    if not raw.startswith(INVITE_PREFIX):
        raise SocialError(
            "邀请卡格式不正确。请让好友在“个人资料与好友”里复制 DKL 邀请卡。"
        )
    token = raw[len(INVITE_PREFIX) :].strip()
    try:
        padding = "=" * (-len(token) % 4)
        data = json.loads(
            base64.urlsafe_b64decode(token + padding).decode("utf-8")
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        raise SocialError("邀请卡已损坏，无法解析。") from exc
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise SocialError("邀请卡内容无法识别。")
    invite = Invite(
        id=str(data.get("id") or "").strip().upper(),
        name=str(data.get("name") or "").strip()[:24],
        room_code=str(data.get("room") or "").strip()[:80],
        room_version=str(data.get("mc") or "").strip()[:64],
        note=str(data.get("note") or "").strip()[:120],
        kind=str(data.get("kind") or "friend"),
        mod_manifest=str(data.get("mods") or "").strip(),
    )
    if not ID_RE.fullmatch(invite.id):
        raise SocialError("邀请卡里的 DKL ID 无效。")
    if not invite.name:
        invite.name = "未命名好友"
    return invite


@dataclass
class SocialStore:
    path: Path = field(default_factory=lambda: SOCIAL_PATH)
    profile: SocialProfile = field(default_factory=SocialProfile)
    friends: list[Friend] = field(default_factory=list)

    def load(self) -> "SocialStore":
        try:
            if self.path.is_file():
                data = json.loads(self.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            else:
                data = {}
        except Exception:
            data = {}
        if isinstance(data.get("profile"), dict):
            allowed = {
                key: data["profile"].get(key)
                for key in ("id", "name", "created_at", "room_code", "room_version")
            }
            self.profile = SocialProfile(**allowed)
        self.friends = []
        for item in data.get("friends") or []:
            if not isinstance(item, dict):
                continue
            allowed = {
                key: item.get(key)
                for key in (
                    "id",
                    "name",
                    "room_code",
                    "room_version",
                    "note",
                    "added_at",
                    "last_room_at",
                )
            }
            try:
                self.friends.append(Friend(**allowed).ensure())
            except (SocialError, TypeError):
                continue
        self.friends.sort(
            key=lambda friend: (friend.last_room_at, friend.added_at), reverse=True
        )
        return self

    def ensure_profile(self, fallback_name: str = "Steve") -> SocialProfile:
        before = asdict(self.profile)
        self.profile.ensure(fallback_name)
        if asdict(self.profile) != before:
            self.save()
        return self.profile

    def rename_profile(self, name: str) -> SocialProfile:
        clean = str(name or "").strip()
        if not 1 <= len(clean) <= 24:
            raise SocialError("昵称需要 1-24 个字符。")
        self.profile.name = clean
        self.save()
        return self.profile

    def set_room(self, room_code: str, room_version: str = "") -> None:
        self.profile.room_code = str(room_code or "").strip()[:80]
        self.profile.room_version = str(room_version or "").strip()[:64]
        self.save()

    def add_invite(self, invite: Invite) -> Friend:
        if invite.id == self.profile.id:
            raise SocialError("这是你自己的邀请卡，换一张好友的吧。")
        friend = Friend(
            id=invite.id,
            name=invite.name,
            room_code=invite.room_code,
            room_version=invite.room_version,
            note=invite.note,
        ).ensure()
        existing = self.find(friend.id)
        if existing is not None:
            existing.name = friend.name or existing.name
            existing.note = friend.note or existing.note
            if friend.room_code:
                existing.room_code = friend.room_code
                existing.room_version = friend.room_version
                existing.last_room_at = time.time()
            friend = existing
        else:
            if friend.room_code:
                friend.last_room_at = time.time()
            self.friends.insert(0, friend)
        self.save()
        return friend

    def add_friend(
        self, name: str, friend_id: str, room_code: str = "", room_version: str = ""
    ) -> Friend:
        friend = Friend(
            id=str(friend_id or "").strip().upper(),
            name=str(name or "").strip(),
            room_code=room_code,
            room_version=room_version,
        ).ensure()
        if friend.id == self.profile.id:
            raise SocialError("不能把自己添加为好友。")
        existing = self.find(friend.id)
        if existing is not None:
            existing.name = friend.name
            if friend.room_code:
                existing.room_code = friend.room_code
                existing.room_version = friend.room_version
                existing.last_room_at = time.time()
            self.save()
            return existing
        if friend.room_code:
            friend.last_room_at = time.time()
        self.friends.insert(0, friend)
        self.save()
        return friend

    def find(self, friend_id: str) -> Friend | None:
        key = str(friend_id or "").strip().upper()
        return next((friend for friend in self.friends if friend.id == key), None)

    def update_room(
        self, friend_id: str, room_code: str, room_version: str = ""
    ) -> Friend | None:
        friend = self.find(friend_id)
        if friend is None:
            return None
        friend.room_code = str(room_code or "").strip()[:80]
        friend.room_version = str(room_version or "").strip()[:64]
        friend.last_room_at = time.time() if friend.room_code else 0.0
        self.save()
        return friend

    def remove_friend(self, friend_id: str) -> bool:
        friend = self.find(friend_id)
        if friend is None:
            return False
        self.friends.remove(friend)
        self.save()
        return True

    def save(self) -> None:
        data = {
            "version": 1,
            "profile": asdict(self.profile),
            "friends": [asdict(friend) for friend in self.friends],
        }
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        tmp = self.path.with_name(self.path.name + ".tmp")
        tmp.write_text(
            json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
        )
        tmp.replace(self.path)


def load_store(path: Path | None = None) -> SocialStore:
    return SocialStore(path=Path(path or SOCIAL_PATH)).load()

# FILE: darkitten/sources.py

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import threading
import time
import urllib.request
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from .config import APP_DIR

OFFICIAL = "official"
BMCLAPI = "bmclapi"
SOURCES = (OFFICIAL, BMCLAPI)

MANIFEST_URLS = {
    OFFICIAL: "https://piston-meta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json",
    BMCLAPI: "https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json",
}
SOURCE_LABELS = {
    OFFICIAL: "Mojang 官方",
    BMCLAPI: "BMCLAPI 镜像",
}

STATE_PATH = APP_DIR / "cache" / "source_health.json"
HEALTH_TTL = 10 * 60
PROBE_TIMEOUT = 2.5
FAILURE_THRESHOLD = 2
FAILURE_COOLDOWN = 5 * 60
USER_AGENT = "DarkittenLauncher/1.9"

_lock = threading.RLock()


def source_for_url(url: str) -> str:
    """把下载地址归类到官方源或镜像源，无法归类时返回空字符串。"""
    try:
        host = urlsplit(str(url)).netloc.lower()
    except Exception:
        return ""
    if not host:
        return ""
    if "bmclapi" in host or host.endswith("bangbang93.com"):
        return BMCLAPI
    if (
        host.endswith("mojang.com")
        or host.endswith("minecraft.net")
        or host.endswith("minecraftservices.com")
    ):
        return OFFICIAL
    return ""


def _default_state() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {"updated": 0.0, "sources": {}}


def _read_state() -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        data = json.loads(Path(STATE_PATH).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
        return _default_state()
    if not isinstance(data, dict) or not isinstance(data.get("sources"), dict):
        return _default_state()
    return data


def _write_state(state: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    path = Path(STATE_PATH)
    try:
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        temp = path.with_name(path.name + ".tmp")
        temp.write_text(json.dumps(state, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
        temp.replace(path)
    except OSError:
        pass


def _entry(state: dict[str, Any], source: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    entry = state.setdefault("sources", {}).setdefault(source, {})
    return entry if isinstance(entry, dict) else {}


def _fresh(entry: dict[str, Any], now: float) -> bool:
    if not entry:
        return False
    blocked_until = float(entry.get("blocked_until") or 0)
    if blocked_until > now:
        return True
    if entry.get("ok") is False:
        # 上次探测或下载失败，允许下次重新探测，避免永久拉黑。
        return False
    checked = float(entry.get("checked_at") or 0)
    return now - checked < HEALTH_TTL


def _probe_latency(source: str, timeout: float) -> float:
    url = MANIFEST_URLS.get(source)
    if not url:
        raise ValueError(f"未知下载源：{source}")
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        url,
        headers={"User-Agent": USER_AGENT, "Range": "bytes=0-0"},
    )
    started = time.perf_counter()
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=timeout) as response:
        response.read(1)
    return (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000


def _probe_one(source: str, timeout: float) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        latency = _probe_latency(source, timeout)
        return {
            "ok": True,
            "latency_ms": round(latency),
            "checked_at": time.time(),
            "failures": 0,
            "blocked_until": 0.0,
            "last_error": "",
        }
    except Exception as exc:
        return {
            "ok": False,
            "latency_ms": None,
            "checked_at": time.time(),
            "failures": FAILURE_THRESHOLD,
            "blocked_until": time.time() + FAILURE_COOLDOWN,
            "last_error": str(exc)[:200],
        }


def refresh_sources(
    sources: tuple[str, ...] = SOURCES,
    *,
    force: bool = False,
    allow_probe: bool = True,
    timeout: float = PROBE_TIMEOUT,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """检查下载源可用性；结果缓存 10 分钟，失败源熔断 5 分钟。"""
    with _lock:
        state = _read_state()
    now = time.time()
    pending = [
        source
        for source in sources
        if force or not _fresh(_entry(state, source), now)
    ]
    if not pending:
        return state

    if allow_probe:
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max(1, len(pending))) as pool:
            results = list(
                pool.map(lambda item: (item, _probe_one(item, timeout)), pending)
            )
        with _lock:
            state = _read_state()
            for source, entry in results:
                state.setdefault("sources", {})[source] = entry
            state["updated"] = time.time()
            _write_state(state)
        return state

    # 不允许联网时只把缺失项标记为未知，排序仍可继续。
    with _lock:
        state = _read_state()
        for source in pending:
            _entry(state, source)
        return state


def order_sources(
    preferred: str = "auto",
    *,
    allow_probe: bool = False,
    force_probe: bool = False,
) -> list[str]:
    """返回按优先级排列的下载源。

    auto 会使用测速结果，延迟更低且未被熔断的源排在前面；
    official / bmclapi 固定尊重用户选择，另一条线路排在后面兜底。
    """
    if preferred in (OFFICIAL, BMCLAPI):
        other = BMCLAPI if preferred == OFFICIAL else OFFICIAL
        return [preferred, other]

    state = refresh_sources(force=force_probe, allow_probe=allow_probe)
    now = time.time()
    entries = {source: _entry(state, source) for source in SOURCES}

    def usable(source: str) -> bool:
        entry = entries[source]
        if float(entry.get("blocked_until") or 0) > now:
            return False
        return entry.get("ok") is not False

    available = [source for source in SOURCES if usable(source)]
    if not available:
        available = list(SOURCES)

    def rank(source: str) -> tuple[int, float]:
        entry = entries[source]
        latency = entry.get("latency_ms")
        if entry.get("ok") is False or latency is None:
            return (1, float("inf"))
        return (0, float(latency))

    available.sort(key=lambda source: (rank(source), SOURCES.index(source)))
    # 未被探测过的源也放入兜底，避免因为缓存缺失只能走一条线路。
    for source in SOURCES:
        if source not in available:
            available.append(source)
    return available


def is_source_usable(source: str) -> bool:
    """读取缓存中的熔断状态，供逐文件选择镜像时快速判断。"""
    state = _read_state()
    entry = _entry(state, source)
    now = time.time()
    if float(entry.get("blocked_until") or 0) > now:
        return False
    return entry.get("ok") is not False


def report_success(url: str) -> None:
    """下载成功后清除对应源的失败计数。"""
    source = source_for_url(url)
    if not source:
        return
    with _lock:
        state = _read_state()
        entry = _entry(state, source)
        if (
            entry.get("failures")
            or entry.get("ok") is not True
            or entry.get("blocked_until")
        ):
            entry.update(
                {
                    "ok": True,
                    "failures": 0,
                    "blocked_until": 0.0,
                    "checked_at": time.time(),
                    "last_error": "",
                }
            )
            _write_state(state)


def report_failure(url: str, error: object = "") -> None:
    """记录一次下载失败；连续失败会暂时熔断该源。"""
    source = source_for_url(url)
    if not source:
        return
    message = str(error or "")
    # 校验失败、取消、磁盘空间不足不是线路问题，不能误熔断。
    ignored = ("SHA1", "校验", "取消", "cancel", "空间", "No space")
    if any(token.lower() in message.lower() for token in ignored):
        return
    now = time.time()
    with _lock:
        state = _read_state()
        entry = _entry(state, source)
        failures = int(entry.get("failures") or 0) + 1
        entry["failures"] = failures
        entry["checked_at"] = now
        entry["last_error"] = message[:200]
        if failures >= FAILURE_THRESHOLD:
            entry["ok"] = False
            entry["latency_ms"] = None
            entry["blocked_until"] = now + FAILURE_COOLDOWN
        _write_state(state)


def reset_health() -> None:
    """清空测速与熔断记录（设置页/诊断用）。"""
    with _lock:
        _write_state(_default_state())


def health_summary() -> str:
    """给日志/诊断使用的一行摘要。"""
    state = _read_state()
    now = time.time()
    parts: list[str] = []
    for source in SOURCES:
        entry = _entry(state, source)
        label = SOURCE_LABELS[source]
        if float(entry.get("blocked_until") or 0) > now:
            parts.append(f"{label}=熔断")
        elif entry.get("ok") is True:
            latency = entry.get("latency_ms")
            parts.append(f"{label}={latency}ms" if latency else f"{label}=可用")
        elif entry.get("ok") is False:
            parts.append(f"{label}=不可用")
        else:
            parts.append(f"{label}=未测速")
    return " · ".join(parts)

)


def _apply_client_id(dialog, edit: QLineEdit, error: QLabel) -> str | None:
    """校验登录窗口里的客户端 ID，并把它保存为默认值。"""
    try:
        client_id = normalize_client_id(edit.text())
    except MicrosoftAuthError as exc:
        error.setText(str(exc))
        error.setVisible(True)
        edit.setFocus()
        return None
    edit.setText(client_id)
    dialog.client_id = client_id
    dialog.main.config.microsoft_client_id = client_id
    dialog.main.config.save()
    return client_id

    title.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 600;")
    layout.addWidget(title)
    text = QLabel(LEGACY_WARNING)
    text.setObjectName("Tiny")
    text.setWordWrap(True)
    layout.addWidget(text)
    check = QCheckBox("我已了解并自行承担使用该应用 ID 的风险")
    layout.addWidget(check)
    box.setVisible(False)
    return box, check

        self.steps_box = QFrame()
        self.steps_box.setObjectName("SoftCard")
        self.steps_box.setAttribute(Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
        self.steps_layout = QVBoxLayout(self.steps_box)
        self.steps_layout.setContentsMargins(13, 11, 13, 11)
        self.steps_layout.setSpacing(4)
        for text in (
            "1. 点击“打开浏览器登录”，启动器会自动打开 Microsoft 登录页。",
            "2. 在浏览器中输入密码并同意授权；密码不会经过启动器。",
            "3. 页面显示“登录完成”后回到启动器，账户会自动完成验证。",
        ):
            label = QLabel(text)
            label.setObjectName("Tiny")
            label.setWordWrap(True)
            self.steps_layout.addWidget(label)
        self.body.addWidget(self.steps_box)

        self.code_box = QFrame()
        self.code_box.setObjectName("SoftCard")
        self.code_box.setAttribute(Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
        code_layout = QVBoxLayout(self.code_box)
        code_layout.setContentsMargins(14, 12, 14, 12)
        code_layout.setSpacing(7)
        code_title = QLabel("在 Microsoft 页面输入此验证码")
        code_title.setObjectName("Tiny")
        code_title.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
        code_layout.addWidget(code_title)

        self.code_label = QLabel("------")
        self.code_label.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
        self.code_label.setStyleSheet(
            "font-size: 30px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 6px;"
        )
        code_layout.addWidget(self.code_label)

        code_actions = QHBoxLayout()
        code_actions.setSpacing(8)
        code_actions.addStretch(1)
        self.copy_btn = QPushButton("复制验证码")
        self.copy_btn.setObjectName("Secondary")
        self.copy_btn.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.copy_btn.clicked.connect(self._copy_code)
        self.open_btn = QPushButton("打开登录页")
        self.open_btn.setObjectName("Primary")
        self.open_btn.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.open_btn.clicked.connect(self._open_page)
        code_actions.addWidget(self.copy_btn)
        code_actions.addWidget(self.open_btn)
        code_actions.addStretch(1)
        code_layout.addLayout(code_actions)
        self.code_box.setVisible(False)
        self.body.addWidget(self.code_box)

        self.status = QLabel("")
        self.status.setObjectName("Tiny")
        self.status.setWordWrap(True)
        self.body.addWidget(self.status)

        self.reopen_btn = QPushButton("重新打开登录页")
        self.reopen_btn.setObjectName("Secondary")
        self.reopen_btn.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.reopen_btn.clicked.connect(self._open_page)
        self.reopen_btn.setVisible(False)
        self.body.addWidget(self.reopen_btn, 0, Qt.AlignLeft)

        self.error = QLabel("")
        self.error.setWordWrap(True)
        self.error.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['red']}; font-size: 11px;")
        self.error.setVisible(False)
        self.body.addWidget(self.error)

        self.cancel_btn = self.add_button("取消", "Secondary", self.reject)
        self.start_btn = self.add_button(
            "打开浏览器登录", "Primary", self._start
        )
        self.start_btn.setMinimumWidth(132)
        self._client_id_changed()

    @property
    def account(self):
        return self._account

    def _client_id_changed(self, *_args) -> None:
        if self._worker is not None:
            return
        legacy = is_legacy_client_id(self.client_edit.text())
        self.legacy_box.setVisible(legacy)
        self.email_box.setVisible(not legacy)
        self.steps_box.setVisible(not legacy)
        self.intro.setText(
            "16 位旧版应用 ID 将使用 Microsoft 验证码登录。"
            "登录在 Microsoft 官方页面完成，启动器不会接触你的密码。"
            if legacy
            else "启动器会打开系统浏览器，并把邮箱预填到 Microsoft 官方登录页。"
            "密码只在浏览器中输入，授权完成后会自动返回启动器。"
        )
        self.start_btn.setText(
            "使用验证码登录" if legacy else "打开浏览器登录"
        )
        self.start_btn.setEnabled(
            not legacy or self.risk_check.isChecked()
        )
        self.adjustSize()

    def _start(self) -> None:
        if self._worker is not None:
            return
        client_id = _apply_client_id(self, self.client_edit, self.error)
        if client_id is None:
            return
        if is_legacy_client_id(client_id):
            self.legacy_box.setVisible(True)
            if not self.risk_check.isChecked():
                self.error.setText(
                    "请先勾选风险确认，再继续使用 16 位应用 ID 登录。"
                )
                self.error.setVisible(True)
                return
            self.error.setVisible(False)
            self.status.setText("正在向 Microsoft 请求验证码…")
            self._device = None
            self.code_box.setVisible(False)
            self.reopen_btn.setVisible(False)
            self.client_edit.setEnabled(False)
            self.email_box.setEnabled(False)
            self.start_btn.setEnabled(False)
            self.start_btn.setText("等待验证码登录…")
            self.cancel_btn.setText("取消登录")
            worker = DeviceLoginWorker(client_id, self)
            self._worker = worker
            worker.code_ready.connect(self._code_ready)
            worker.status.connect(self._set_status)
            worker.finished.connect(self._finished)
            worker.start()
            return

        email = self.email_edit.text().strip()
        if email and ("@" not in email or any(ch.isspace() for ch in email)):
            self.error.setText("请输入完整的 Microsoft 邮箱地址，或留空。")
            self.error.setVisible(True)
            self.email_edit.setFocus()
            return
        self.error.setVisible(False)
        self.status.setText("正在启动本地登录服务并打开浏览器…")
        self._url = ""
        self._device = None
        self.code_box.setVisible(False)
        self.reopen_btn.setVisible(False)
        self.client_edit.setEnabled(False)
        self.email_edit.setEnabled(False)
        self.start_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.start_btn.setText("等待浏览器登录…")
        self.cancel_btn.setText("取消登录")
        self.main.config.microsoft_email = email
        self.main.config.save()
        worker = BrowserLoginWorker(client_id, email, self)
        self._worker = worker
        worker.url_ready.connect(self._url_ready)
        worker.status.connect(self._set_status)
        worker.finished.connect(self._finished)
        worker.start()

    def _url_ready(self, url: str) -> None:
        if self._closed:
            return
        self._url = url
        self.reopen_btn.setVisible(True)
        self.adjustSize()

    def _code_ready(self, device: DeviceCode) -> None:
        if self._closed:
            return
        self._device = device
        self.code_label.setText(device.user_code)
        self.code_box.setVisible(True)
        self._copy_code()
        self.status.setText(
            "验证码已复制到剪贴板。请在浏览器中输入验证码并登录。"
        )
        self._open_page()
        self.adjustSize()

    def _set_status(self, text: str) -> None:
        if not self._closed:
            self.status.setText(text)

    def _copy_code(self) -> None:
        if self._device:
            QApplication.clipboard().setText(self._device.user_code)
            self.status.setText("验证码已复制到剪贴板。")

    def _open_page(self) -> None:
        if self._device:
            url = (
                self._device.verification_uri_complete
                or self._device.verification_uri
                or "https://www.microsoft.com/link"
            )
            QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(url))
        elif self._url:
            QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(self._url))

    def _finished(self, account, error: str) -> None:
        self._worker = None
        if self._closed:
            return
        if account is not None:
            self._account = account
            self.accept()
            return
        self.error.setText(error or "Microsoft 登录失败，请重试。")
        self.error.setVisible(True)
        self.status.setText("")
        self._url = ""
        self._device = None
        self.code_box.setVisible(False)
        self.reopen_btn.setVisible(False)
        self.client_edit.setEnabled(True)
        self.email_box.setEnabled(True)
        legacy = is_legacy_client_id(self.client_edit.text())
        self.legacy_box.setVisible(legacy)
        self.email_box.setVisible(not legacy)
        self.steps_box.setVisible(not legacy)
        self.start_btn.setEnabled(
            not legacy or self.risk_check.isChecked()
        )
        self.start_btn.setText(
            "使用验证码登录" if legacy else "重新尝试"
        )
        self.cancel_btn.setText("关闭")
        self.adjustSize()

    def reject(self) -> None:
        self._closed = True
        if self._worker is not None:
            self._worker.cancel()
            self._worker = None
        super().reject()

    def _start(self) -> None:
        if self._worker is not None:
            return
        client_id = _apply_client_id(self, self.client_edit, self.error)
        if client_id is None:
            return
        if is_legacy_client_id(client_id):
            self.legacy_box.setVisible(True)
            if not self.risk_check.isChecked():
                self.error.setText(
                    "请先勾选风险确认，再继续使用 16 位应用 ID 登录。"
                )
                self.error.setVisible(True)
                return
        self.error.setVisible(False)
        self.code_box.setVisible(False)
        self.status.setText("正在向 Microsoft 请求验证码…")
        self.client_edit.setEnabled(False)
        self.login_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.cancel_btn.setText("取消登录")
        worker = DeviceLoginWorker(client_id, self)
        self._worker = worker
        worker.code_ready.connect(self._code_ready)
        worker.status.connect(self._set_status)
        worker.finished.connect(self._finished)
        worker.start()

    def _code_ready(self, device: DeviceCode) -> None:
        if self._closed:
            return
        self._device = device
        self.code_label.setText(device.user_code)
        self.code_box.setVisible(True)
        self._copy_code()
        self.status.setText(
            "验证码已复制到剪贴板。请在浏览器中输入验证码并登录。"
        )
        self._open_page()
        self.adjustSize()

    def _set_status(self, text: str) -> None:
        if not self._closed:
            self.status.setText(text)

    def _copy_code(self) -> None:
        if self._device:
            QApplication.clipboard().setText(self._device.user_code)
            self.status.setText("验证码已复制到剪贴板。")

    def _open_page(self) -> None:
        if not self._device:
            return
        url = (
            self._device.verification_uri_complete
            or self._device.verification_uri
            or "https://microsoft.com/devicelogin"
        )
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(url))

    def _finished(self, account, error: str) -> None:
        self._worker = None
        if self._closed:
            return
        self.client_edit.setEnabled(True)
        legacy = is_legacy_client_id(self.client_edit.text())
        self.legacy_box.setVisible(legacy)
        self.login_btn.setEnabled(
            not legacy or self.risk_check.isChecked()

        self.login_btn.setText("重新登录")
        self.cancel_btn.setText("关闭")
        if account is not None:
            self._account = account
            self.accept()
            return
        self.error.setText(error or "Microsoft 登录失败，请重试。")
        self.error.setVisible(True)
        self.status.setText("")
        self.code_box.setVisible(False)
        self.adjustSize()

    def reject(self) -> None:
        self._closed = True
        if self._worker is not None:
            self._worker.cancel()
            self._worker = None
        super().reject()

def _center_on_screen(widget: QWidget) -> None:
    screen = QApplication.primaryScreen()
    if not screen:
        return
    area = screen.availableGeometry()
    widget.move(
        area.x() + (area.width() - widget.width()) // 2,
        area.y() + (area.height() - widget.height()) // 2,
    )


def _draw_paw(
    p: QPainter, center: QPointF, size: float, color: QColor, rotation: float = 0.0
) -> None:
    p.save()
    p.translate(center)
    p.rotate(rotation)
    p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
    p.setBrush(color)
    p.drawEllipse(QPointF(0, size * 0.22), size * 1.05, size * 0.86)
    for dx, dy in ((-1.10, -1.00), (-0.38, -1.48), (0.38, -1.48), (1.10, -1.00)):
        p.drawEllipse(
            QPointF(dx * size, dy * size), size * 0.42, size * 0.52
        )
    p.restore()


def _draw_cat_ears(p: QPainter, rect: QRectF, color: QColor) -> None:
    """在圆角卡片顶部画一对猫耳。"""
    left = QPolygonF(
        [
            QPointF(rect.left() + rect.width() * 0.16, rect.top() + 10),
            QPointF(rect.left() + rect.width() * 0.24, rect.top() - 30),
            QPointF(rect.left() + rect.width() * 0.36, rect.top() + 6),
        ]
    )
    right = QPolygonF(
        [
            QPointF(rect.left() + rect.width() * 0.64, rect.top() + 6),
            QPointF(rect.left() + rect.width() * 0.76, rect.top() - 30),
            QPointF(rect.left() + rect.width() * 0.84, rect.top() + 10),
        ]
    )
    p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
    p.setBrush(color)
    p.drawPolygon(left)
    p.drawPolygon(right)
    inner = QColor("#E23A5E")
    inner.setAlpha(90)
    p.setBrush(inner)
    p.drawPolygon(
        QPolygonF(
            [
                QPointF(rect.left() + rect.width() * 0.205, rect.top() - 2),
                QPointF(rect.left() + rect.width() * 0.247, rect.top() - 19),
                QPointF(rect.left() + rect.width() * 0.30, rect.top() + 0),
            ]
        )
    )
    p.drawPolygon(
        QPolygonF(
            [
                QPointF(rect.left() + rect.width() * 0.70, rect.top() + 0),
                QPointF(rect.left() + rect.width() * 0.753, rect.top() - 19),
                QPointF(rect.left() + rect.width() * 0.795, rect.top() - 2),
            ]
        )
    )


class SplashScreen(QWidget):
    """启动器开场：恶魔小猫贴纸、猫耳卡片和磨爪子进度。"""

    finished = Signal()

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__(
            None,
            Qt.FramelessWindowHint
            | Qt.WindowStaysOnTopHint
            | Qt.SplashScreen
            | Qt.WindowDoesNotAcceptFocus,
        )
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WA_TranslucentBackground, True)
        # 不抢焦点，也不接收键盘输入：启动阶段按键不会影响窗口生命周期。
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WA_ShowWithoutActivating, True)
        self.setFocusPolicy(Qt.NoFocus)
        self.setFixedSize(560, 340)
        self.setWindowTitle(APP_NAME)
        self.setWindowIcon(icons.app_icon())
        self._pixmap: QPixmap = icons.chibi_pixmap(460)
        self._progress = 0.0
        self._elapsed = 0
        self._done = False
        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.setInterval(16)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self._tick)
        self._fade: QPropertyAnimation | None = None
        _center_on_screen(self)

    def start(self) -> None:
        self.setWindowOpacity(0.0)
        self.show()
        self.raise_()
        self._fade = QPropertyAnimation(self, b"windowOpacity", self)
        self._fade.setDuration(260)
        self._fade.setStartValue(0.0)
        self._fade.setEndValue(1.0)
        self._fade.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.OutCubic)
        self._fade.start()
        self._timer.start()

    def _tick(self) -> None:
        if self._done:
            return
        self._elapsed += 16
        self._progress = min(1.0, self._elapsed / 1900.0)
        self.update()
        if self._progress >= 1.0 and not self._done:
            self._finish()

    def _finish(self) -> None:
        if self._done:
            return
        self._done = True
        self._timer.stop()
        if self._fade:
            self._fade.stop()
        self._fade = QPropertyAnimation(self, b"windowOpacity", self)
        self._fade.setDuration(300)
        self._fade.setStartValue(self.windowOpacity())
        self._fade.setEndValue(0.0)
        self._fade.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.InCubic)
        self._fade.finished.connect(self.finished.emit)
        self._fade.start()

    def mousePressEvent(self, event) -> None:
        self._finish()
        super().mousePressEvent(event)

    def keyPressEvent(self, event) -> None:
        # 启动画面不响应键盘，按键一律吞掉。
        event.accept()

    def keyReleaseEvent(self, event) -> None:
        event.accept()

    def closeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        if not self._done:
            self._done = True
            self._timer.stop()
            self.finished.emit()
        super().closeEvent(event)

    def paintEvent(self, event) -> None:
        p = QPainter(self)
        p.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing)
        p.setRenderHint(QPainter.SmoothPixmapTransform)

        card = QRectF(18, 32, self.width() - 36, self.height() - 48)
        _draw_cat_ears(p, card, QColor("#1C1019"))

        shadow = QColor(0, 0, 0, 120)
        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
        p.setBrush(shadow)
        p.drawRoundedRect(card.translated(0, 8), 24, 24)

        gradient = QLinearGradient(card.topLeft(), card.bottomRight())
        gradient.setColorAt(0, QColor("#24101C"))
        gradient.setColorAt(0.55, QColor("#160D15"))
        gradient.setColorAt(1, QColor("#2A0C1A"))
        p.setBrush(gradient)
        p.drawRoundedRect(card, 24, 24)
        p.setBrush(Qt.NoBrush)
        p.setPen(QPen(QColor(226, 58, 94, 75), 1))
        p.drawRoundedRect(card, 24, 24)

        glow = QRadialGradient(card.center(), card.height() * 0.75)
        glow.setColorAt(0, QColor(226, 58, 94, 46))
        glow.setColorAt(1, QColor(226, 58, 94, 0))
        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
        p.setBrush(glow)
        p.drawEllipse(card.center(), card.height() * 0.75, card.height() * 0.75)

        # 左侧圆形肖像
        radius = 58.0
        center = QPointF(card.left() + 88, card.top() + 112)
        disc = QRectF(
            center.x() - radius, center.y() - radius, radius * 2, radius * 2
        )
        p.setBrush(QColor("#FFF4F7"))
        p.drawEllipse(disc)
        clip = QPainterPath()
        clip.addEllipse(disc.adjusted(5, 5, -5, -5))
        p.save()
        p.setClipPath(clip)
        if self._pixmap.isNull():
            p.fillRect(disc, QColor("#3D1226"))
        else:
            p.drawPixmap(disc.adjusted(5, 5, -5, -5).toRect(), self._pixmap)
        p.restore()
        p.setBrush(Qt.NoBrush)
        p.setPen(QPen(QColor("#E23A5E"), 2))
        p.drawEllipse(disc)

        text_left = card.left() + 170
        p.setPen(QColor("#F8E9EF"))
        title_font = QFont("Microsoft YaHei UI", 21)
        title_font.setBold(True)
        p.setFont(title_font)
        p.drawText(
            QRectF(text_left, card.top() + 42, card.width() - 220, 36),
            Qt.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignVCenter,
            APP_NAME,
        )

        p.setPen(QColor("#E23A5E"))
        tag_font = QFont("Microsoft YaHei UI", 8)
        tag_font.setBold(True)
        tag_font.setLetterSpacing(QFont.AbsoluteSpacing, 2.0)
        p.setFont(tag_font)
        p.drawText(
            QRectF(text_left + 1, card.top() + 77, card.width() - 220, 20),
            Qt.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignVCenter,
            f"{APP_SHORT_NAME} · {APP_TAGLINE}",
        )

        p.setPen(QColor(240, 220, 229, 210))
        note_font = QFont("Microsoft YaHei UI", 10)
        p.setFont(note_font)
        index = min(len(SPLASH_NOTES) - 1, int(self._progress * len(SPLASH_NOTES)))
        p.drawText(
            QRectF(text_left, card.top() + 112, card.width() - 220, 24),
            Qt.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignVCenter,
            SPLASH_NOTES[index],
        )

        # 爪印进度
        base_y = card.bottom() - 66
        total = 5
        filled = self._progress * total
        for i in range(total):
            x = text_left + 16 + i * 38
            active = i < int(filled)
            pulse = 1.0
            if active and i == int(filled) - 1:
                pulse = 1.0 + 0.16 * math.sin(self._elapsed / 90.0)
            color = QColor("#E23A5E") if active else QColor(255, 255, 255, 30)
            _draw_paw(p, QPointF(x, base_y), 7.2 * pulse, color)

        track = QRectF(text_left, card.bottom() - 40, card.width() - 250, 4)
        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
        p.setBrush(QColor(255, 255, 255, 22))
        p.drawRoundedRect(track, 2, 2)
        p.setBrush(QColor("#E23A5E"))
        p.drawRoundedRect(
            QRectF(track.left(), track.top(), track.width() * self._progress, 4), 2, 2
        )

        p.setPen(QColor(255, 255, 255, 70))
        foot_font = QFont("Microsoft YaHei UI", 8)
        p.setFont(foot_font)
        p.drawText(
            QRectF(card.left() + 32, card.bottom() - 28, card.width() - 64, 18),
            Qt.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignVCenter,
            f"v{APP_VERSION} · 点击任意处跳过",
        )
        p.end()


class GameLoadingOverlay(QWidget):
    """启动游戏时覆盖主窗口的加载动画。"""

    cancel_requested = Signal()

    def __init__(self, parent: QWidget) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, False)
        self.setVisible(False)
        self._pixmap = icons.chibi_pixmap(420)
        self._angle = 0.0
        self._elapsed = 0
        self._status = "正在准备启动…"
        self._version = ""
        self._closing = False
        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.setInterval(16)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self._tick)

        self.cancel_btn = QPushButton("收回猫爪（取消启动）", self)
        self.cancel_btn.setObjectName("Secondary")
        self.cancel_btn.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.cancel_btn.setFixedSize(184, 34)
        self.cancel_btn.clicked.connect(self._request_cancel)
        self.cancel_btn.hide()

    def show_loading(self, version: str, status: str = "") -> None:
        self._version = version
        self._status = status or "正在准备启动…"
        self._elapsed = 0
        self._closing = False
        self.cancel_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.cancel_btn.setText("收回猫爪（取消启动）")
        self.cancel_btn.show()
        self.setGeometry(self.parentWidget().rect())
        self.raise_()
        self.show()
        self._timer.start()

    def set_status(self, text: str) -> None:
        if text:
            self._status = text
            self.update()

    def finish(self, message: str = "世界已加载，去玩吧喵。", delay_ms: int = 650) -> None:
        if not self.isVisible():
            return
        self._closing = True
        self._status = message
        self.cancel_btn.hide()
        self.update()
        QTimer.singleShot(max(0, delay_ms), self._hide_now)

    def abort(self) -> None:
        self._closing = True
        self._timer.stop()
        self.hide()
        self.cancel_btn.hide()

    def _hide_now(self) -> None:
        self._timer.stop()
        self.hide()
        self.cancel_btn.hide()

    def _request_cancel(self) -> None:
        if not self._closing:
            self.cancel_btn.setEnabled(False)
            self.cancel_btn.setText("正在收回猫爪…")
            self.cancel_requested.emit()

    def _tick(self) -> None:
        self._elapsed += 16
        self._angle = (self._angle + 2.2) % 360.0
        self.update()

    def resizeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        self.cancel_btn.move(
            (self.width() - self.cancel_btn.width()) // 2,
            int(self.height() * 0.5) + 176,
        )
        super().resizeEvent(event)

    def paintEvent(self, event) -> None:
        p = QPainter(self)
        p.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing)
        p.setRenderHint(QPainter.SmoothPixmapTransform)
        w, h = self.width(), self.height()

        p.fillRect(self.rect(), QColor(12, 7, 11, 214))
        glow = QRadialGradient(w / 2, h / 2 - 40, max(w, h) * 0.42)
        glow.setColorAt(0, QColor(226, 58, 94, 64))
        glow.setColorAt(1, QColor(226, 58, 94, 0))
        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
        p.setBrush(glow)
        p.drawEllipse(QPointF(w / 2, h / 2 - 40), max(w, h) * 0.42, max(w, h) * 0.42)

        cx, cy = w / 2, h / 2 - 54
        radius = 62.0
        disc = QRectF(cx - radius, cy - radius, radius * 2, radius * 2)
        p.setBrush(QColor(0, 0, 0, 80))
        p.drawEllipse(disc.translated(0, 7))
        p.setBrush(QColor("#FFF4F7"))
        p.drawEllipse(disc)
        clip = QPainterPath()
        clip.addEllipse(disc.adjusted(5, 5, -5, -5))
        p.save()
        p.setClipPath(clip)
        if self._pixmap.isNull():
            p.fillRect(disc, QColor("#3D1226"))
        else:
            p.drawPixmap(disc.adjusted(5, 5, -5, -5).toRect(), self._pixmap)
        p.restore()
        p.setBrush(Qt.NoBrush)
        p.setPen(QPen(QColor("#E23A5E"), 2))
        p.drawEllipse(disc)

        # 环绕的爪印
        for i in range(6):
            angle = math.radians(self._angle + i * 60)
            px = cx + math.cos(angle) * (radius + 26)
            py = cy + math.sin(angle) * (radius + 26)
            alpha = 90 + int(120 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(angle)))
            _draw_paw(
                p,
                QPointF(px, py),
                5.5,
                QColor(255, 190, 208, alpha),
                math.degrees(angle) + 90,
            )

        # 旋转弧线
        arc = QRectF(cx - radius - 11, cy - radius - 11, (radius + 11) * 2, (radius + 11) * 2)
        pen = QPen(QColor("#E23A5E"), 2.5)
        pen.setCapStyle(Qt.RoundCap)
        p.setPen(pen)
        p.setBrush(Qt.NoBrush)
        start = int(-self._angle * 16)
        p.drawArc(arc, start, 70 * 16)

        p.setPen(QColor("#F8E9EF"))
        title_font = QFont("Microsoft YaHei UI", 17)
        title_font.setBold(True)
        p.setFont(title_font)
        p.drawText(
            QRectF(0, cy + radius + 32, w, 32),
            Qt.AlignCenter,
            "正在把猫猫送进世界…",
        )

        p.setPen(QColor(236, 210, 220, 210))
        status_font = QFont("Microsoft YaHei UI", 10)
        p.setFont(status_font)
        p.drawText(
            QRectF(w * 0.1, cy + radius + 68, w * 0.8, 26),
            Qt.AlignCenter,
            self._status,
        )

        if self._version:
            badge_w, badge_h = 210.0, 26.0
            badge = QRectF(
                cx - badge_w / 2, cy + radius + 104, badge_w, badge_h
            )
            p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
            p.setBrush(QColor(255, 255, 255, 26))
            p.drawRoundedRect(badge, 13, 13)
            p.setPen(QColor(255, 220, 230, 210))
            small = QFont("Microsoft YaHei UI", 9)
            p.setFont(small)
            p.drawText(badge, Qt.AlignCenter, self._version)

        if not self._closing:
            p.setPen(QColor(255, 255, 255, 55))
            foot = QFont("Microsoft YaHei UI", 8)
            p.setFont(foot)
            p.drawText(
                QRectF(0, h - 38, w, 20),
                Qt.AlignCenter,
                "如果猫猫卡住了，可以随时收回猫爪",
            )
        p.end()

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Iterable

from PySide6.QtCore import QEvent, Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QLabel,
    QLineEdit,
    QListWidget,
    QListWidgetItem,
)

from .dialogs import StyledDialog
from .widgets import colors


class CommandPalette(StyledDialog):
    """Ctrl+K 快捷命令面板。"""

    def __init__(
        self,
        parent,
        commands: Iterable[dict],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent, "快捷命令", "search", width=540)
        self.commands = [dict(item) for item in commands]
        self.chosen = ""

        self.input = QLineEdit()
        self.input.setPlaceholderText("输入命令，例如：下载 / 设置 / 快照 / 诊断")
        self.input.setClearButtonEnabled(True)
        self.input.textChanged.connect(self._apply_filter)
        self.input.returnPressed.connect(self._activate_current)
        self.input.installEventFilter(self)
        self.body.addWidget(self.input)

        self.list = QListWidget()
        self.list.setMinimumHeight(300)
        self.list.setFocusPolicy(Qt.NoFocus)
        self.list.setStyleSheet(
            "QListWidget {"
            " background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; }"
            "QListWidget::item {"
            " padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 8px; }"
            f"QListWidget::item:selected {{ background: {colors()['accent_soft']};"
            f" color: {colors()['text']}; }}"
        )
        self.list.itemClicked.connect(lambda _item: self._activate_current())
        self.body.addWidget(self.list)

        hint = QLabel("↑ ↓ 选择 · Enter 执行 · Esc 关闭")
        hint.setObjectName("Tiny")
        self.body.addWidget(hint)

        self._reload()
        self.add_button("关闭", "Secondary", self.reject)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _reload(self) -> None:
        self.list.clear()
        for command in self.commands:
            item = QListWidgetItem(
                f"{command.get('title', '')}   ·   {command.get('subtitle', '')}"
            )
            item.setData(Qt.UserRole, str(command.get("id") or ""))
            item.setToolTip(str(command.get("keywords") or ""))
            self.list.addItem(item)
        for row in range(self.list.count()):
            self.list.item(row).setHidden(False)
        if self.list.count():
            self.list.setCurrentRow(0)
        self._empty_hint()

    def _empty_hint(self) -> None:
        visible = any(
            not self.list.item(row).isHidden() for row in range(self.list.count())
        )
        if not visible and self.list.count():
            self.list.setCurrentRow(-1)

    def _matches(self, item: QListWidgetItem, query: str) -> bool:
        text = f"{item.text()} {item.toolTip()}".casefold()
        return all(word in text for word in query.split())

    def _apply_filter(self, text: str) -> None:
        query = str(text or "").strip().casefold()
        first_visible = -1
        for row in range(self.list.count()):
            item = self.list.item(row)
            visible = not query or self._matches(item, query)
            item.setHidden(not visible)
            if visible and first_visible < 0:
                first_visible = row
        if first_visible >= 0:
            self.list.setCurrentRow(first_visible)
        else:
            self.list.setCurrentRow(-1)
        self._empty_hint()

    def _move(self, delta: int) -> None:
        count = self.list.count()
        if not count:
            return
        current = self.list.currentRow()
        visible = [
            row for row in range(count) if not self.list.item(row).isHidden()
        ]
        if not visible:
            return
        if current not in visible:
            self.list.setCurrentRow(visible[0])
            return
        index = visible.index(current)
        self.list.setCurrentRow(visible[(index + delta) % len(visible)])

    def _activate_current(self) -> None:
        item = self.list.currentItem()
        if item is None or item.isHidden():
            visible = [
                self.list.item(row)
                for row in range(self.list.count())
                if not self.list.item(row).isHidden()
            ]
            if not visible:
                return
            item = visible[0]
        self.chosen = str(item.data(Qt.UserRole) or "")
        if self.chosen:
            self.accept()

    def eventFilter(self, obj, event) -> bool:
        if obj is self.input and event.type() == QEvent.KeyPress:
            key = event.key()
            if key == Qt.Key_Down:
                self._move(1)
                return True
            if key == Qt.Key_Up:
                self._move(-1)
                return True
            if key == Qt.Key_Escape:
                self.reject()
                return True
        return super().eventFilter(obj, event)

    def showEvent(self, event) -> None:
        super().showEvent(event)
        self.input.setFocus(Qt.OtherFocusReason)

class StyledDialog(QDialog):
    def __init__(
        self,
        parent: QWidget | None,
        title: str,
        icon_name: str = "bolt",
        icon_color: str | None = None,
        width: int = 440,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setWindowFlags(Qt.Dialog | Qt.FramelessWindowHint)
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WA_TranslucentBackground)
        self.setModal(True)
        self._width = width

        outer = QVBoxLayout(self)
        outer.setContentsMargins(24, 24, 24, 24)
        outer.setSpacing(0)

        self.card = QFrame()
        self.card.setObjectName("DialogCard")
        self.card.setAttribute(Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
        shadow = QGraphicsDropShadowEffect(self.card)
        shadow.setBlurRadius(38)
        shadow.setOffset(0, 10)
        shadow.setColor(QColor(10, 20, 40, 80))
        self.card.setGraphicsEffect(shadow)
        outer.addWidget(self.card)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self.card)
        layout.setContentsMargins(24, 20, 24, 20)
        layout.setSpacing(14)

        header = QHBoxLayout()
        header.setSpacing(10)
        icon_badge = QLabel()
        icon_badge.setFixedSize(36, 36)
        icon_badge.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)

        self.title_label.setObjectName("DialogTitle")
        close_btn = icon_button("close", "关闭", size=28, icon_size=15)
        close_btn.clicked.connect(self.reject)
        header.addWidget(icon_badge)
        header.addWidget(self.title_label, 1)
        header.addWidget(close_btn, 0, Qt.AlignTop)
        layout.addLayout(header)

        self.body = QVBoxLayout()
        self.body.setSpacing(10)
        layout.addLayout(self.body, 1)

        self.footer = QHBoxLayout()
        self.footer.setSpacing(8)
        self.footer.addStretch(1)
        layout.addLayout(self.footer)

        self.setFixedWidth(width)
        self.adjustSize()

    def add_button(
        self, text: str, style: str = "Secondary", callback=None
    ) -> QPushButton:
        button = QPushButton(text)
        button.setObjectName(style)
        button.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        button.setMinimumWidth(78)
        if callback:
            button.clicked.connect(callback)
        self.footer.addWidget(button)
        return button

    def showEvent(self, event) -> None:
        super().showEvent(event)
        parent = self.parentWidget()
        if parent:
            geo = parent.window().frameGeometry()
            self.adjustSize()
            x = geo.x() + (geo.width() - self.width()) // 2
            y = geo.y() + (geo.height() - self.height()) // 2
            self.move(x, y)


class ConfirmDialog(StyledDialog):
    def __init__(
        self,
        parent: QWidget | None,
        title: str,
        message: str,
        primary_text: str = "确定",
        secondary_text: str = "取消",
        icon_name: str = "warning",
        icon_color: str | None = None,
        details: str = "",
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent, title, icon_name, icon_color, width=460)
        text = QLabel(message)

        self.add_button(secondary_text, "Secondary", self.reject)

class TextInputDialog(StyledDialog):
    def __init__(
        self,
        parent: QWidget | None,
        title: str,
        message: str,
        value: str,
        button_text: str = "保存",
        max_length: int = 16,
        placeholder: str = "3-16 位字母、数字或下划线",
        player_name: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent, title, "user", width=440)
        self._result = value
        self._player_name = player_name

        text = QLabel(message)
        text.setObjectName("DialogText")
        text.setWordWrap(True)
        self.body.addWidget(text)

        self.edit = QLineEdit(value)
        self.edit.setMaxLength(max(1, int(max_length)))
        self.edit.setPlaceholderText(placeholder)
        self.edit.returnPressed.connect(self._save)
        self.body.addWidget(self.edit)

        self.error = QLabel("")
        self.error.setStyleSheet(f"color: {theme.colors()['red']}; font-size: 11px;")
        self.error.setVisible(False)
        self.body.addWidget(self.error)

        self.add_button("取消", "Secondary", self.reject)
        self.add_button(button_text, "Primary", self._save)
        self.edit.setFocus()

    def _save(self) -> None:
        value = self.edit.text().strip()
        if not value:
            self.error.setText("名称不能为空。")
            self.error.setVisible(True)
            return
        if self._player_name and not valid_player_name(value):
            self.error.setText("名称需为 3-16 位字母、数字或下划线。")
            self.error.setVisible(True)
            return
        self._result = value
        self.accept()

    def value(self) -> str:
        return self._result
