from __future__ import annotations

import time
from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path

from PySide6.QtCore import QObject, Qt, QTimer, Signal
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QFrame,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QProgressBar,
    QPushButton,
    QScrollArea,
    QSizePolicy,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from ..workers import ModDownloadWorker
from . import icons
from .dialogs import StyledDialog
from .widgets import badge, colors, repolish, transparent_children

TASK_RUNNING = "running"
TASK_SUCCESS = "success"
TASK_ERROR = "error"
TASK_CANCELLED = "cancelled"


IMPORT_TYPES = {"modpack", "version-import", "local-import"}
INSTALL_TYPES = {"version-install", "loader-install", "server-install"}


@dataclass
class DownloadTask:
    id: int
    title: str
    content_type: str
    source: str
    target: Path
    pack_mode: bool = False
    progress: int = 0
    message: str = "准备下载…"
    status: str = TASK_RUNNING
    filename: str = ""
    error: str = ""
    metadata: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    worker: QObject | None = None
    cancel_cb: Callable[[], None] | None = None
    created_at: float = field(default_factory=time.time)
    finished_at: float = 0.0

    @property
    def running(self) -> bool:
        return self.status == TASK_RUNNING

    @property
    def action_text(self) -> str:
        if self.content_type in IMPORT_TYPES:
            return "导入中"
        if self.content_type in INSTALL_TYPES:
            return "安装中"
        return "下载中"

    @property
    def status_text(self) -> str:
        return {
            TASK_RUNNING: self.action_text,
            TASK_SUCCESS: "已完成",
            TASK_ERROR: "失败",
            TASK_CANCELLED: "已取消",
        }.get(self.status, self.status)

    @property
    def display_name(self) -> str:
        return self.filename or self.title


class _TaskRelay(QObject):
    """把工作线程信号排队回主线程，避免下载过程中直接操作界面数据。"""

    def __init__(
        self,
        center: "DownloadCenter",
        task_id: int,
        finished_adapter: Callable[..., tuple[bool, str, str]] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(center)
        self.center = center
        self.task_id = task_id
        self.finished_adapter = finished_adapter

    def on_progress(self, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        self.center._on_progress(self.task_id, percent, message)

    def on_finished(self, *args) -> None:
        try:
            if self.finished_adapter is not None:
                success, message, filename = self.finished_adapter(*args)
            else:
                success = bool(args[0]) if args else False
                message = str(args[1]) if len(args) > 1 else ""
                filename = str(args[2]) if len(args) > 2 else ""
        except Exception as exc:
            success, message, filename = False, str(exc), ""
        self.center._on_finished(self.task_id, success, message, filename)


class DownloadCenter(QObject):
    """启动器级下载任务中心：窗口关闭后任务继续，由顶栏接管显示。"""

    task_progress = Signal(int, int, str)
    task_finished = Signal(object)
    tasks_changed = Signal()

    def __init__(self, main) -> None:
        super().__init__(main)
        self.main = main
        self._tasks: dict[int, DownloadTask] = {}
        self._order: list[int] = []
        self._relays: dict[int, _TaskRelay] = {}
        self._next_id = 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 任务生命周期

    def start_mod_download(
        self,
        version: dict,
        target_dir: Path,
        *,
        threads: int,
        title: str,
        content_type: str,
        source: str,
        metadata: dict | None = None,
        pack_mode: bool = False,
    ) -> DownloadTask:
        task_id = self._next_id
        self._next_id += 1
        target = Path(target_dir)
        task = DownloadTask(
            id=task_id,
            title=str(title or "下载内容"),
            content_type=str(content_type or "mod"),
            source=str(source or "modrinth"),
            target=target,
            pack_mode=bool(pack_mode),
            metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
        )
        worker = ModDownloadWorker(
            version,
            target,
            threads=threads,
            parent=self,
            source=source,
            metadata=task.metadata if task.content_type == "mod" else None,
        )
        task.worker = worker
        self._tasks[task_id] = task
        self._order.append(task_id)
        relay = _TaskRelay(self, task_id)
        self._relays[task_id] = relay
        worker.progress.connect(relay.on_progress)
        worker.finished.connect(relay.on_finished)
        self.tasks_changed.emit()
        worker.start()
        return task

    def start_worker(
        self,
        worker: QObject,
        *,
        title: str,
        content_type: str,
        target: Path,
        source: str = "",
        pack_mode: bool = False,
        metadata: dict | None = None,
        finished_adapter: Callable[..., tuple[bool, str, str]] | None = None,
        cancel_cb: Callable[[], None] | None = None,
        forward_log: bool = True,
    ) -> DownloadTask:
        """接管任意带 progress/finished/cancel 的工作线程。

        finished_adapter 负责把不同 worker 的 finished 参数归一成
        (success, message, filename)。worker 会改由下载中心持有，
        因此发起它的对话框关闭后任务仍会继续。
        """
        task_id = self._next_id
        self._next_id += 1
        target_path = Path(target)
        task = DownloadTask(
            id=task_id,
            title=str(title or "后台任务"),
            content_type=str(content_type or "download"),
            source=str(source or ""),
            target=target_path,
            pack_mode=bool(pack_mode),
            metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
            worker=worker,
            cancel_cb=cancel_cb,
        )
        worker.setParent(self)
        self._tasks[task_id] = task
        self._order.append(task_id)
        relay = _TaskRelay(self, task_id, finished_adapter)
        self._relays[task_id] = relay
        progress = getattr(worker, "progress", None)
        if progress is not None:
            progress.connect(relay.on_progress)
        finished = getattr(worker, "finished", None)
        if finished is not None:
            finished.connect(relay.on_finished)
        log_line = getattr(worker, "log_line", None)
        if forward_log and log_line is not None:
            log_line.connect(self.main.log)
        self.tasks_changed.emit()
        worker.start()
        return task

    def task(self, task_id: int) -> DownloadTask | None:
        return self._tasks.get(int(task_id))

    def active_tasks(self) -> list[DownloadTask]:
        return [
            self._tasks[task_id]
            for task_id in self._order
            if self._tasks[task_id].running
        ]

    def latest_task(self) -> DownloadTask | None:
        for task_id in reversed(self._order):
            task = self._tasks.get(task_id)
            if task is not None:
                return task
        return None

    def recent_tasks(self, limit: int = 12) -> list[DownloadTask]:
        result: list[DownloadTask] = []
        for task_id in reversed(self._order):
            task = self._tasks.get(task_id)
            if task is not None:
                result.append(task)
            if len(result) >= max(1, int(limit)):
                break
        return result

    def has_running(self) -> bool:
        return any(task.running for task in self._tasks.values())

    def cancel(self, task_id: int) -> None:
        task = self._tasks.get(int(task_id))
        if task is None or not task.running:
            return
        task.message = "正在取消，请稍候…"
        cancel = task.cancel_cb
        if cancel is None and task.worker is not None:
            cancel = getattr(task.worker, "cancel", None)
        if callable(cancel):
            cancel()
        self.tasks_changed.emit()

    def clear_finished(self) -> None:
        for task_id in list(self._order):
            task = self._tasks.get(task_id)
            if task is None or task.running:
                continue
            self._tasks.pop(task_id, None)
            self._order.remove(task_id)
            relay = self._relays.pop(task_id, None)
            if relay is not None:
                relay.deleteLater()
        self.tasks_changed.emit()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 信号转发

    def _on_progress(self, task_id: int, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        task = self._tasks.get(task_id)
        if task is None or not task.running:
            return
        task.progress = max(0, min(100, int(percent)))
        task.message = str(message or "")
        self.task_progress.emit(task.id, task.progress, task.message)
        self.tasks_changed.emit()

    def _on_finished(
        self, task_id: int, success: bool, message: str, filename: str
    ) -> None:
        task = self._tasks.get(task_id)
        if task is None:
            return
        task.worker = None
        task.filename = str(filename or "")
        task.finished_at = time.time()
        if success:
            task.status = TASK_SUCCESS
            task.progress = 100
            if task.content_type in IMPORT_TYPES:
                task.message = "导入完成"
            elif task.content_type in INSTALL_TYPES:
                task.message = "安装完成"
            else:
                task.message = "下载完成"
        elif "取消" in str(message):
            task.status = TASK_CANCELLED
            task.message = "任务已取消"
        else:
            task.status = TASK_ERROR
            task.error = str(message or "任务失败")
            task.message = task.error
        self.task_finished.emit(task)
        self.tasks_changed.emit()


class _ChipLabel(QLabel):
    def __init__(self, text: str = "", parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(text, parent)
        self._full_text = str(text or "")
        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Ignored, QSizePolicy.Preferred)

    def setText(self, text: str) -> None:
        self._full_text = str(text or "")
        self._refresh()

    def resizeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        self._refresh()

    def _refresh(self) -> None:
        width = self.contentsRect().width()
        if width <= 0:
            QLabel.setText(self, self._full_text)
            return
        QLabel.setText(
            self,
            self.fontMetrics().elidedText(self._full_text, Qt.ElideRight, width),
        )

        self.progress.setRange(0, 100)
        self.progress.setTextVisible(False)
        self.progress.setFixedHeight(5)

        target = _ChipLabel(str(task.target))
        target.setObjectName("Tiny")
        target.setToolTip(str(task.target))
        info.addWidget(target)
        layout.addLayout(info, 1)

        actions = QVBoxLayout()
        actions.setSpacing(4)
        self.cancel_btn = QPushButton("取消")
        self.cancel_btn.setObjectName("Ghost")
        self.cancel_btn.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.cancel_btn.clicked.connect(lambda _=False: self.cancel_requested.emit(self.task.id))
        self.folder_btn = QPushButton("打开文件夹")
        self.folder_btn.setObjectName("Ghost")
        self.folder_btn.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.folder_btn.clicked.connect(
            lambda _=False: self.folder_requested.emit(str(self.task.target))
        )
        self.import_btn = QPushButton("导入")
        self.import_btn.setObjectName("Primary")
        self.import_btn.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.import_btn.clicked.connect(lambda _=False: self.import_requested.emit(self.task))
        actions.addWidget(self.cancel_btn)
        actions.addWidget(self.import_btn)
        actions.addWidget(self.folder_btn)
        layout.addLayout(actions)
        transparent_children(self)
        self.cancel_btn.setAttribute(Qt.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, False)
        self.folder_btn.setAttribute(Qt.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, False)
        self.import_btn.setAttribute(Qt.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, False)
        self.update_task(task)

    def update_task(self, task: DownloadTask) -> None:
        self.task = task
        self.title_label.setText(task.title)
        self.title_label.setToolTip(task.display_name)
        self.message_label.setText(task.message or task.display_name)
        self.progress.setValue(task.progress)
        self.percent_label.setText(f"{task.progress}%")
        color = {
            TASK_RUNNING: "blue",
            TASK_SUCCESS: "green",
            TASK_ERROR: "red",
            TASK_CANCELLED: "gray",
        }.get(task.status, "gray")
        self.status_badge.setText(task.status_text)
        self.status_badge.setProperty("badge", color)
        repolish(self.status_badge)
        running = task.running
        self.cancel_btn.setVisible(running)
        self.cancel_btn.setEnabled(running)
        self.import_btn.setVisible(
            task.status == TASK_SUCCESS and task.pack_mode and bool(task.filename)
        )
        self.folder_btn.setVisible(not running and task.status == TASK_SUCCESS)
        if task.status == TASK_SUCCESS:
            self.icon_box.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("check", colors()["green"], 18))
            self.icon_box.setStyleSheet(
                f"background: {colors()['green_soft']}; border-radius: 9px;"
            )
        elif task.status in (TASK_ERROR, TASK_CANCELLED):
            self.icon_box.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("warning", colors()["orange"], 18))
            self.icon_box.setStyleSheet(
                f"background: {colors()['orange_soft']}; border-radius: 9px;"
            )
        elif task.worker is not None:
            self.icon_box.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("download", colors()["accent"], 18))

    def _on_closed(self, _result: int = 0) -> None:
        try:
            self.center.tasks_changed.disconnect(self.refresh)
            self.center.task_progress.disconnect(self._on_progress)
        except (RuntimeError, TypeError):
            pass

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        tasks = self.center.recent_tasks(12)
        active = self.center.active_tasks()
        self.summary.setText(
            f"{len(active)} 个任务正在进行，关闭此窗口不会中断。"
            if active
            else "下载、导入和安装任务会在启动器顶栏显示进度，关闭原窗口不会取消任务。"
        )
        if not tasks:
            self._clear_rows()
            self.empty.setVisible(True)
            self.scroll.setVisible(False)
            self.clear_btn.setEnabled(False)
            return
        self.empty.setVisible(False)
        self.scroll.setVisible(True)
        self.clear_btn.setEnabled(any(not item.running for item in tasks))
        existing = set()
        for index, task in enumerate(tasks):
            existing.add(task.id)
            row = self._rows.get(task.id)
            if row is None:
                row = DownloadTaskRow(task, self.holder)
                row.cancel_requested.connect(self.center.cancel)
                row.import_requested.connect(self._import_pack)
                row.folder_requested.connect(self.main.open_path)
                self._rows[task.id] = row
            else:
                row.update_task(task)
            if self.list_layout.indexOf(row) != index:
                self.list_layout.removeWidget(row)
                self.list_layout.insertWidget(index, row)
        for task_id, row in list(self._rows.items()):
            if task_id not in existing:
                row.setParent(None)
                row.deleteLater()
                self._rows.pop(task_id, None)
        self.list_layout.activate()

    def _clear_rows(self) -> None:
        for row in self._rows.values():
            row.setParent(None)
            row.deleteLater()
        self._rows.clear()

    def _on_progress(self, task_id: int, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        row = self._rows.get(int(task_id))
        task = self.center.task(task_id)
        if row is not None and task is not None:
            row.update_task(task)

    def _import_pack(self, task: DownloadTask) -> None:
        path = task.target / task.filename
        if not path.is_file():
            self.main.toast("文件没有保存成功，请重新下载", "error")
            return
        self.main.open_local_import(path)
        self.refresh()


class TopDownloadChip(QFrame):
    clicked = Signal()

    def __init__(self, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setObjectName("DownloadChip")
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
        self.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.setFixedHeight(38)
        self.setMinimumWidth(38)
        self.setMaximumWidth(196)
        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Preferred, QSizePolicy.Fixed)
        self._task: DownloadTask | None = None
        self._final_task_id = 0
        self._compact = False
        self._icon_only: bool | None = None
        self._hide_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._hide_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._hide_timer.setInterval(8000)
        self._hide_timer.timeout.connect(self._apply_idle)

        outer = QHBoxLayout(self)
        outer.setContentsMargins(7, 4, 9, 4)
        outer.setSpacing(7)
        self._outer = outer

        self.icon_box = QLabel()
        self.icon_box.setFixedSize(24, 24)
        self.icon_box.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
        self.icon_box.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("download", colors()["accent"], 14))
        self.icon_box.setStyleSheet(
            f"background: {colors()['accent_soft']}; border-radius: 7px;"
        )
        outer.addWidget(self.icon_box)

        text_box = QVBoxLayout()
        text_box.setSpacing(0)
        top = QHBoxLayout()
        top.setSpacing(4)
        self.status_label = QLabel("下载中")
        self.status_label.setStyleSheet("font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700;")
        self.percent_label = QLabel("0%")
        self.percent_label.setObjectName("Tiny")
        top.addWidget(self.status_label)
        top.addStretch(1)
        top.addWidget(self.percent_label)
        text_box.addLayout(top)
        self.message_label = _ChipLabel("")
        self.message_label.setObjectName("Tiny")
        text_box.addWidget(self.message_label)
        self.progress = QProgressBar()
        self.progress.setObjectName("ChipProgress")
        self.progress.setRange(0, 100)
        self.progress.setTextVisible(False)
        self.progress.setFixedHeight(3)
        text_box.addWidget(self.progress)
        outer.addLayout(text_box, 1)
        transparent_children(self)
        self._apply_idle()

    def resizeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        compact = self.width() < 104
        self.message_label.setVisible(not compact)
        self.percent_label.setVisible(self.width() >= 72)
        self.status_label.setVisible(self.width() >= 84)
        self.progress.setVisible(not compact)
        self._sync_icon_margins(compact)

    def _sync_icon_margins(self, icon_only: bool) -> None:
        """只显示图标时取消右侧留白，否则图标会偏左约 6px。"""
        if icon_only == self._icon_only:
            return
        self._icon_only = icon_only
        if icon_only:
            self._outer.setContentsMargins(12, 4, 12, 4)
            self._outer.setSpacing(0)
        else:
            self._outer.setContentsMargins(7, 4, 9, 4)
            self._outer.setSpacing(7)

    def set_compact(self, compact: bool) -> None:
        """窄窗口固定为图标大小，任务运行时也不再横向撑开顶栏。"""
        compact = bool(compact)
        if compact == self._compact:
            return
        self._compact = compact
        if compact:
            self.setMinimumWidth(48)
            self.setMaximumWidth(48)
        else:
            self.setMaximumWidth(196)
            active = self._task is not None and self._task.running
            self.setMinimumWidth(120 if active else 48)
        self.updateGeometry()

    def sync(self, center: DownloadCenter) -> None:
        active = center.active_tasks()
        if active:
            task = active[-1]
            self._hide_timer.stop()
            self._final_task_id = 0
            self._apply(task, running_count=len(active))
            return
        latest = center.latest_task()
        if latest is None:
            self._apply_idle()
            return
        self._apply(latest, running_count=0, final=True)
        if self._final_task_id != latest.id:
            self._final_task_id = latest.id
            self._hide_timer.start()

    def _apply_idle(self) -> None:
        self._task = None
        self._hide_timer.stop()
        self.setProperty("state", "idle")
        repolish(self)
        self.setMinimumWidth(48)
        self.setMaximumWidth(48)
        self.status_label.setText("下载中心")
        self.percent_label.setText("")
        self.message_label.setText("没有进行中的任务")
        self.progress.setValue(0)
        self.icon_box.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("download", colors()["accent"], 14))
        self.icon_box.setStyleSheet(
            f"background: {colors()['accent_soft']}; border-radius: 7px;"
        )
        self.setToolTip("下载中心\n没有进行中的任务\n点击查看下载与导入记录")
        self.show()
        self.updateGeometry()

    def _apply(
        self, task: DownloadTask, running_count: int, final: bool = False
    ) -> None:
        self._task = task
        if self._compact:
            self.setMinimumWidth(48)
            self.setMaximumWidth(48)
        elif final:
            self.setMinimumWidth(48)
            self.setMaximumWidth(196)
        else:
            self.setMinimumWidth(120)
            self.setMaximumWidth(196)
        self.setProperty("state", task.status)
        repolish(self)
        self.status_label.setText(
            f"{task.action_text} · {running_count} 项"
            if running_count > 1
            else (task.action_text if task.running else task.status_text)
        )
        self.percent_label.setText(f"{task.progress}%")
        self.message_label.setText(task.message or task.display_name)
        self.progress.setValue(task.progress)
        self.setToolTip(
            f"{task.title}\n{task.message}\n目标：{task.target}\n点击查看下载任务"
        )
        if task.status == TASK_SUCCESS:
            self.icon_box.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("check", colors()["green"], 14))
            self.icon_box.setStyleSheet(
                f"background: {colors()['green_soft']}; border-radius: 7px;"
            )
        elif task.status in (TASK_ERROR, TASK_CANCELLED):
            self.icon_box.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("warning", colors()["orange"], 14))
            self.icon_box.setStyleSheet(
                f"background: {colors()['orange_soft']}; border-radius: 7px;"
            )
        else:
            self.icon_box.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("download", colors()["accent"], 14))
            self.icon_box.setStyleSheet(
                f"background: {colors()['accent_soft']}; border-radius: 7px;"
            )
        self.show()
        self.updateGeometry()

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, event) -> None:
        if event.button() == Qt.LeftButton:
            self.clicked.emit()
        super().mouseReleaseEvent(event)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 状态与主题

    def _set_status(self, label: QLabel, text: str, kind: str = "muted") -> None:
        c = colors()
        label.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {c[STATUS_COLORS.get(kind, 'muted')]};"
            "font-size: 11px; background: transparent;"
        )
        label.setText(text)
        if label is self.host_status:
            self._host_status_kind = kind
        elif label is self.guest_status:
            self._guest_status_kind = kind

    def _set_badge(self, label: QLabel, text: str, kind: str) -> None:
        label.setText(text)
        label.setProperty("badge", kind)
        repolish(label)

    def refresh_theme(self) -> None:
        self._set_status(
            self.host_status, self.host_status.text(), self._host_status_kind
        )
        self._set_status(
            self.guest_status, self.guest_status.text(), self._guest_status_kind
        )
        self.create_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("bolt", "#FFFFFF", 16))
        self.join_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("play", "#FFFFFF", 16))
        self.copy_code_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("copy", "#FFFFFF", 14))
        self.copy_address_btn.setIcon(
            icons.icon("copy", colors()["text2"], 13)
        )
        for label in self.findChildren(QLabel):
            if label.property("badge"):
                repolish(label)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 版本

    def _sync_versions(self) -> None:
        versions = list(self.main.game_version_summaries())
        current = (
            self.version_combo.currentData() if self.version_combo.count() else ""
        )
        preferred = str(current or self.main.selected_version or "")
        self.version_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self.version_combo.clear()
        for summary in versions:
            kind = summary.loader or summary.type_name or ""
            label = f"{summary.id} · {kind}" if kind else summary.id
            if summary.error:
                label += "（文件异常）"
            self.version_combo.addItem(label, summary.id)
        if versions:
            index = self.version_combo.findData(preferred)
            if index < 0:
                index = 0
            self.version_combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
        else:
            self.version_combo.addItem("未安装游戏版本", "")
        self.version_combo.blockSignals(False)
        self._sync_host_versions()
        self._sync_controls()

    def _sync_host_versions(self) -> None:
        if not hasattr(self, "host_version_combo"):
            return
        versions = list(self.main.game_version_summaries())
        current = (
            self.host_version_combo.currentData()
            if self.host_version_combo.count()
            else ""
        )
        preferred = str(current or self.main.selected_version or "")
        self.host_version_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self.host_version_combo.clear()
        for summary in versions:
            kind = summary.loader or summary.type_name or ""
            display = self.main.config.version_name(summary.id) or summary.id
            label = f"{display} · {kind}" if kind else display
            self.host_version_combo.addItem(label, summary.id)
            if display != summary.id:
                index = self.host_version_combo.count() - 1
                self.host_version_combo.setItemData(
                    index, f"内部版本：{summary.id}", Qt.ToolTipRole
                )
        if versions:
            index = self.host_version_combo.findData(preferred)
            if index < 0:
                index = 0
            self.host_version_combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
        else:
            self.host_version_combo.addItem("未安装游戏版本", "")
        self.host_version_combo.blockSignals(False)
        self._sync_host_saves()

    def _sync_host_saves(self) -> None:
        if not hasattr(self, "host_save_combo"):
            return
        version_id = str(self.host_version_combo.currentData() or "")
        current = self._host_world_id or self.host_save_combo.currentData()
        worlds = []
        if version_id:
            try:
                worlds = scan_worlds(
                    Path(self.main.config.version_game_path(version_id))
                )
            except OSError:
                worlds = []
        self.host_save_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self.host_save_combo.clear()
        if not worlds:
            self.host_save_combo.addItem(
                "这个版本还没有存档" if version_id else "请先安装游戏版本", ""
            )
            self._host_world_id = ""
        else:
            for world in worlds:
                label = (
                    f"{world.name} · {world.mode_text} · "
                    f"{world.last_played_text}"
                )
                self.host_save_combo.addItem(label, world.folder.name)
            index = self.host_save_combo.findData(current)
            self.host_save_combo.setCurrentIndex(index if index >= 0 else 0)
            self._host_world_id = str(
                self.host_save_combo.currentData() or ""
            )
        self.host_save_combo.blockSignals(False)
        self._sync_controls()

    def _sync_selection(self, version_id: str) -> None:
        if not version_id:
            return
        index = self.version_combo.findData(version_id)
        if index >= 0 and index != self.version_combo.currentIndex():
            self.version_combo.blockSignals(True)
            self.version_combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
            self.version_combo.blockSignals(False)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 房主流程

    def _lan_auth_check(self, version_id: str) -> bool:
        """官方局域网默认只允许正版，启动前提醒安装联机模组。"""
        room_page = getattr(self.main, "room_page", None)
        check = getattr(room_page, "ensure_lan_auth_mod", None)
        if callable(check):
            return bool(check(version_id))
        return True

    def install_lan_mod(self) -> None:
        version_id = str(self.host_version_combo.currentData() or "")
        room_page = getattr(self.main, "room_page", None)
        install = getattr(room_page, "_install_lan_mod", None)
        if callable(install):
            install(version_id)
            return
        self.toast("请在“联机”页打开模组下载后选择 mcwifipnp。", "info")

    def show_lan_mod_help(self) -> None:
        room_page = getattr(self.main, "room_page", None)
        help_fn = getattr(room_page, "_show_lan_mod_help", None)
        if callable(help_fn):
            help_fn()
            return
        self.toast(
            "安装 LAN World Plug-n-Play 后，开放局域网时关闭“正版验证”。",
            "info",
        )

    def host_quick_start(self) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            return
        if self._host_session is not None or self._host_worker is not None:
            self.toast("P2P 房间已经开启，请先关闭当前房间。", "info")
            return
        if self._auto_host_flow:
            self.toast("正在等待游戏局域网端口，请稍候。", "info")
            return
        if self.main.launch_active:
            self.toast("游戏正在启动，请稍候。", "info")
            return
        if self.main.install_active:
            self.toast("正在安装游戏文件，请稍候。", "info")
            return
        version_id = str(self.host_version_combo.currentData() or "")
        world_id = str(self.host_save_combo.currentData() or "")
        if not version_id or not world_id:
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status, "请先选择游戏版本和存档。", "error"
            )
            return
        if not self._lan_auth_check(version_id):
            return

        existing = self.main.find_game_session(version_id)
        if existing is not None:
            # 这个版本已经在运行，直接等它在游戏里开放局域网。
            self._host_session_key = existing.key
            self._host_world_id = world_id
            self._auto_host_flow = True
            self._set_badge(self.host_badge, "等待端口", "blue")
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status,
                "这个版本已经在运行。请在游戏里按 Esc → 对局域网开放，"
                "启动器检测到端口后会自动创建 P2P 房间。",
                "busy",
            )
            self._lan_timer.start()
            self._sync_controls()
            return

        self._host_world_id = world_id
        self._auto_host_flow = True
        self._set_badge(self.host_badge, "启动中", "blue")
        self._set_status(
            self.host_status,
            f"正在启动 {version_id} 并进入存档…",
            "busy",
        )
        if version_id != self.main.selected_version:
            self.main.home_page.select_version(version_id)
        self._host_session_key = self.main.launch_selected(
            quick_world=world_id
        )
        if not self._host_session_key:
            self._auto_host_flow = False
            self._set_badge(self.host_badge, "未开启", "gray")
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status,
                "启动没有完成，请查看启动器提示。",
                "error",
            )
            self._sync_controls()
            return
        self._lan_timer.start()
        self._sync_controls()

    def _poll_host_lan(self) -> None:
        if self._closing:
            self._lan_timer.stop()
            return
        if self._host_session is not None or self._host_worker is not None:
            self._lan_timer.stop()
            return
        key = self._host_session_key
        if key:
            process = self.main.session_process(key)
            if process is None:
                if not self.main.launch_active:
                    # 自己启动的游戏已经退出，停止等待。
                    self._host_session_key = ""
                    self._lan_timer.stop()
                    if self._auto_host_flow:
                        self._auto_host_flow = False
                        self._set_badge(self.host_badge, "未开启", "gray")
                        self._set_status(
                            self.host_status,
                            "启动的游戏已经退出，一键联机已停止。",
                            "muted",
                        )
                        self._sync_controls()
                return
        else:
            if not self.main.game_running:
                return
            version_id = str(self.host_version_combo.currentData() or "")
            session = (
                self.main.find_game_session(version_id)
                if version_id
                else None
            )
            process = session.process if session else self.main.game_process
        pid = int(getattr(process, "pid", 0) or 0) if process else 0
        if not pid:
            return
        ports = detect_game_lan_ports(pid)
        if not ports:
            return
        port = preferred_lan_port(ports)
        self.port_spin.setValue(port)
        self._lan_timer.stop()
        self._set_badge(self.host_badge, "建房中", "blue")
        self._set_status(
            self.host_status,
            f"已检测到局域网端口 {port}，正在创建 P2P 房间…",
            "busy",
        )
        self.create_room(auto=True)

    def detect_port(self) -> None:
        process = None
        if self._host_session_key:
            process = self.main.session_process(self._host_session_key)
        version_id = str(self.host_version_combo.currentData() or "")
        if process is None and version_id:
            session = self.main.find_game_session(version_id)
            process = session.process if session else None
        process = process or self.main.game_process
        pid = process.pid if process and process.pid else 0
        if not pid:
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status,
                "游戏还没有运行。请先启动游戏，并在单人游戏里“对局域网开放”。",
                "warning",
            )
            return
        ports = detect_game_lan_ports(pid)
        if not ports:
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status,
                "没有检测到游戏监听端口。请先在游戏里对局域网开放，再点一次检测。",
                "warning",
            )
            return
        port = preferred_lan_port(ports)
        self.port_spin.setValue(port)
        others = [str(item) for item in ports if item != port]
        text = f"已检测到游戏端口 {port}，可以创建 P2P 房间。"
        if others:
            text += f"（其他监听端口：{', '.join(others[:4])}）"
        self._set_status(self.host_status, text, "success")

    def create_room(self, checked: bool = False, auto: bool = False) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            return
        if self._host_session is not None:
            self.toast("P2P 房间已经开启，请先关闭当前房间。", "info")
            return
        if not auto:
            # 手动点“创建房间”时不再继续自动等待端口。
            self._lan_timer.stop()
            self._auto_host_flow = False
            if not self._host_session_key:
                version_id = str(self.host_version_combo.currentData() or "")
                session = (
                    self.main.find_game_session(version_id)
                    if version_id
                    else None
                )
                if session is not None:
                    self._host_session_key = session.key
        port = int(self.port_spin.value())
        config = self.main.config
        config.easytier_last_port = port
        config.easytier_direct_only = self.direct_switch.isChecked()
        config.easytier_hide_address = self.hide_switch.isChecked()
        config.save()

        self._busy = True
        self.progress.setRange(0, 100)
        self.progress.setValue(0)
        self.progress.setVisible(True)
        self.log_box.clear()
        self.log_box.setVisible(True)
        self._set_status(self.host_status, "正在准备 EasyTier 联机组件…", "busy")
        self._set_badge(self.host_badge, "准备中", "blue")
        self.result_box.setVisible(False)
        self._sync_controls()

        worker = EasyTierHostWorker(
            port,
            self.main.display_name(),
            machine_id=str(config.easytier_machine_id or ""),
            node_ids=list(config.easytier_node_ids or []),
            direct_only=config.easytier_direct_only,
            hide_address=config.easytier_hide_address,
            parent=self,
        )
        self._host_worker = worker
        self._host_log_worker = worker
        worker.progress.connect(
            lambda value, message, w=worker: self._host_progress(w, value, message)
        )
        worker.log_line.connect(
            lambda line, w=worker: self._host_log(w, line)
        )
        worker.ready.connect(
            lambda session, error, w=worker: self._host_ready(w, session, error)
        )
        worker.failed.connect(
            lambda error, w=worker: self._host_failed(w, error)
        )
        worker.cancelled.connect(
            lambda w=worker: self._host_cancelled(w)
        )
        worker.start()

    def _host_progress(
        self, worker: EasyTierHostWorker, value: int, message: str
    ) -> None:
        if self._host_worker is not worker:
            return
        self.progress.setValue(int(value))
        self._set_status(self.host_status, message, "busy")

    def _host_log(self, worker: EasyTierHostWorker, line: str) -> None:
        if self._host_log_worker is not worker:
            return
        self._append_log(line)

    @staticmethod
    def _dispose_session(session, wait: bool = False) -> None:
        if session is None:
            return
        if wait:
            try:
                session.stop()
            except Exception:
                pass
            return
        threading.Thread(target=session.stop, daemon=True).start()

    def _host_ready(
        self, worker: EasyTierHostWorker, session, error: str
    ) -> None:
        if self._host_worker is not worker:
            # 用户已经关闭房间或退出启动器，迟到的会话要立即回收，
            # 否则 EasyTier 进程和房间服务会一直留在后台。
            self._dispose_session(session)
            return
        self._host_worker = None
        self._busy = False
        self._auto_host_flow = False
        if error or session is None:
            self._host_session_key = ""
            self.progress.setVisible(False)
            self._set_badge(self.host_badge, "未开启", "gray")
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status, error or "创建 P2P 房间失败。", "error"
            )
            self.toast(error or "创建 P2P 房间失败", "error")
            self._sync_controls()
            return

        self._host_session = session
        self.progress.setValue(100)
        self.progress.setVisible(False)
        self._set_badge(self.host_badge, "房间开启", "green")
        self._set_status(
            self.host_status,
            "P2P 房间已开启。把房间号发给朋友，保持游戏和启动器运行。",
            "success",
        )
        self.room_code_label.setText(session.code.code)
        self.code_detail.setText(
            f"房间服务端口 {session.service_port} · "
            f"游戏端口 {self.port_spin.value()} · "
            f"公共节点 {max(0, session.connected_nodes)} 个"
        )
        self.player_line.setText("房间玩家：你自己")
        self.result_box.setVisible(True)
        self._host_timer.start()
        self._sync_controls()
        self.toast("P2P 房间已创建", "success")

    def _host_failed(self, worker: EasyTierHostWorker, error: str) -> None:
        if self._host_worker is not worker:
            return
        self._host_worker = None
        self._busy = False
        self._auto_host_flow = False
        self._host_session_key = ""
        self.progress.setVisible(False)
        self._set_badge(self.host_badge, "未开启", "gray")
        self._set_status(self.host_status, error or "创建 P2P 房间失败。", "error")
        self.toast(error or "创建 P2P 房间失败", "error")
        self._sync_controls()

    def _host_cancelled(self, worker: EasyTierHostWorker) -> None:
        if self._host_worker is not worker:
            return
        self._host_worker = None
        self._busy = False
        self._auto_host_flow = False
        self._host_session_key = ""
        self.progress.setVisible(False)
        self._set_badge(self.host_badge, "未开启", "gray")
        self._set_status(self.host_status, "已取消创建房间。", "muted")
        self._sync_controls()

    def _host_tick(self) -> None:
        session = self._host_session
        if session is None:
            self._host_timer.stop()
            return
        key = self._host_session_key
        if (
            key
            and self.main.session_process(key) is None
            and not self.main.launch_active
        ):
            self._append_log("游戏已退出，正在关闭 P2P 房间。")
            self.close_room(message="游戏已退出，P2P 房间已关闭。")
            return
        if session.lost:
            self._host_timer.stop()
            message = session.error or "EasyTier 网络已断开。"
            self._host_session = None
            self._dispose_session(session)
            self._busy = False
            self.progress.setVisible(False)
            self._set_badge(self.host_badge, "未开启", "gray")
            self._set_status(self.host_status, message, "error")
            self.result_box.setVisible(False)
            self.toast(message, "error")
            self._sync_controls()
            return
        players = list(session.players or [])
        names = "、".join(
            (profile.name or "玩家")
            + ("（房主）" if profile.kind == "HOST" else "")
            for profile in players[:6]
        )
        if len(players) > 6:
            names += f" 等 {len(players)} 人"
        self.player_line.setText(
            f"房间玩家：{names or '你自己'} · "
            f"直连 {session.direct_peers} · 中继 {session.relayed_peers} · "
            f"公共节点 {max(0, session.connected_nodes)}"
        )
        self.code_detail.setText(
            f"房间服务端口 {session.service_port} · "
            f"游戏端口 {self.port_spin.value()} · "
            f"公共节点 {max(0, session.connected_nodes)} 个"
        )

    def close_room(self, checked: bool = False, message: str = "") -> None:
        worker = self._host_worker
        if worker is not None:
            worker.cancel()
            self._host_worker = None
        session = self._host_session
        self._host_session = None
        self._host_log_worker = None
        self._dispose_session(session)
        self._host_timer.stop()
        self._lan_timer.stop()
        self._auto_host_flow = False
        self._host_session_key = ""
        self._busy = False
        self.progress.setVisible(False)
        self.result_box.setVisible(False)
        self.log_box.setVisible(False)
        self._set_badge(self.host_badge, "未开启", "gray")
        self._set_status(
            self.host_status, message or "P2P 房间已关闭。", "muted"
        )
        self._sync_controls()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 加入流程

    def _parse_code(self) -> RoomCode | None:
        text = self.code_edit.text().strip()
        if not text:
            return None
        try:
            return parse_room_code(text)
        except ValueError:
            return None

    def _update_code_hint(self) -> None:
        text = self.code_edit.text().strip()
        if not text:
            self.code_hint.setText(
                "也可以直接粘贴一整段聊天消息，会自动找出房间号。"
            )
            return
        try:
            code = parse_room_code(text)
        except ValueError:
            self.code_hint.setText("继续输入完整的 U/XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX 房间号…")
            return
        self.code_hint.setText(f"将加入房间 {code.code}")
        if text != code.code:
            # 粘贴整段聊天消息时，把输入框整理成标准房间号。
            self.code_edit.blockSignals(True)
            self.code_edit.setText(code.code)
            self.code_edit.blockSignals(False)

    def _paste_code(self) -> None:
        text = QApplication.clipboard().text().strip()
        if not text:
            self.toast("剪贴板为空", "info")
            return
        self.code_edit.setText(text)
        self._update_code_hint()

    def join_room(self) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            return
        if self._guest_session is not None:
            self.toast("已经连接到 P2P 房间。", "info")
            return
        code = self._parse_code()
        if code is None:
            self._set_status(
                self.guest_status,
                "请先输入有效的 P2P 房间号（U/ 开头）。",
                "error",
            )
            return
        version_id = str(self.version_combo.currentData() or "")
        if not version_id:
            self.toast("请先安装一个游戏版本", "info")
            return
        if self.main.game_running:
            self._set_status(
                self.guest_status,
                "游戏已经在运行。请先退出游戏，再加入 P2P 房间。",
                "warning",
            )
            return
        if self.main.install_active:
            self.toast("正在安装游戏文件，请稍候", "info")
            return

        config = self.main.config
        self._pending_version = version_id
        self._busy = True
        self.progress.setRange(0, 100)
        self.progress.setValue(0)
        self.progress.setVisible(True)
        self.log_box.clear()
        self.log_box.setVisible(True)
        self._set_status(self.guest_status, "正在准备 EasyTier 联机组件…", "busy")
        self._set_badge(self.guest_badge, "连接中", "blue")
        self._sync_controls()

        worker = EasyTierJoinWorker(
            code,
            self.main.display_name(),
            machine_id=str(config.easytier_machine_id or ""),
            node_ids=list(config.easytier_node_ids or []),
            allow_relay=not bool(config.easytier_direct_only),
            hide_address=bool(config.easytier_hide_address),
            search_timeout=120.0,
            parent=self,
        )
        self._join_worker = worker
        self._join_log_worker = worker
        worker.progress.connect(
            lambda value, message, w=worker: self._join_progress(w, value, message)
        )
        worker.log_line.connect(
            lambda line, w=worker: self._join_log(w, line)
        )
        worker.ready.connect(
            lambda session, error, w=worker: self._join_ready(w, session, error)
        )
        worker.failed.connect(
            lambda error, w=worker: self._join_failed(w, error)
        )
        worker.cancelled.connect(
            lambda w=worker: self._join_cancelled(w)
        )
        worker.start()

    def _join_progress(
        self, worker: EasyTierJoinWorker, value: int, message: str
    ) -> None:
        if self._join_worker is not worker:
            return
        self.progress.setValue(int(value))
        self._set_status(self.guest_status, message, "busy")

    def _join_log(self, worker: EasyTierJoinWorker, line: str) -> None:
        if self._join_log_worker is not worker:
            return
        self._append_log(line)

    def _join_ready(
        self, worker: EasyTierJoinWorker, session, error: str
    ) -> None:
        if self._join_worker is not worker:
            self._dispose_session(session)
            return
        self._join_worker = None
        self._busy = False
        if error or session is None:
            self.progress.setVisible(False)
            self._set_badge(self.guest_badge, "空闲", "gray")
            self._set_status(
                self.guest_status, error or "加入 P2P 房间失败。", "error"
            )
            self.toast(error or "加入 P2P 房间失败", "error")
            self._sync_controls()
            return

        self._guest_session = session
        self.progress.setValue(100)
        self.progress.setVisible(False)
        self._set_badge(self.guest_badge, "已连接", "green")
        self._set_status(
            self.guest_status,
            f"已连接房主，正在启动游戏并连接 {session.address}…",
            "success",
        )
        self._guest_timer.start()
        self._sync_controls()

        version_id = self._pending_version or str(
            self.version_combo.currentData() or ""
        )
        if version_id != self.main.selected_version:
            self.main.home_page.select_version(version_id)
        self.main.launch_selected(connect_address=session.address)
        if not self.main.game_running and not self.main.launch_active:
            self._set_status(
                self.guest_status,
                "组网成功，但游戏启动没有完成。请查看启动器提示，"
                f"或手动连接 {session.address}。",
                "warning",
            )

    def _join_failed(self, worker: EasyTierJoinWorker, error: str) -> None:
        if self._join_worker is not worker:
            return
        self._join_worker = None
        self._busy = False
        self.progress.setVisible(False)
        self._set_badge(self.guest_badge, "未开启", "gray")
        self._set_status(
            self.guest_status, error or "加入 P2P 房间失败。", "error"
        )
        self.toast(error or "加入 P2P 房间失败", "error")
        self._sync_controls()

    def _join_cancelled(self, worker: EasyTierJoinWorker) -> None:
        if self._join_worker is not worker:
            return
        self._join_worker = None
        self._busy = False
        self.progress.setVisible(False)
        self._set_badge(self.guest_badge, "未开启", "gray")
        self._set_status(self.guest_status, "已取消加入房间。", "muted")
        self._sync_controls()

    def _join_tick(self) -> None:
        session = self._guest_session
        if session is None:
            self._guest_timer.stop()
            return
        if session.lost:
            self._guest_timer.stop()
            message = session.error or "与房主的连接已断开。"
            self._guest_session = None
            self._dispose_session(session)
            self.progress.setVisible(False)
            self._set_badge(self.guest_badge, "未开启", "gray")
            self._set_status(self.guest_status, message, "error")
            self.toast(message, "error")
            self._sync_controls()
            return
        players = list(session.players or [])
        names = "、".join(profile.name or "玩家" for profile in players[:6])
        latency = (
            f" · 延迟 {session.host_latency_ms:.0f} ms"
            if session.host_latency_ms is not None
            else ""
        )
        self._set_status(
            self.guest_status,
            f"已连接 {session.address}{latency}"
            + (f" · 房间玩家：{names}" if names else ""),
            "success",
        )

    def _copy_room_code(self) -> None:
        session = self._host_session
        if session is None:
            self.toast("当前没有可复制的房间号", "info")
            return
        QApplication.clipboard().setText(session.code.code)
        self.toast("房间号已复制", "success")

    def close_guest(self, checked: bool = False) -> None:
        worker = self._join_worker
        if worker is not None:
            worker.cancel()
            self._join_worker = None
        session = self._guest_session
        self._guest_session = None
        self._join_log_worker = None
        self._dispose_session(session)
        self._guest_timer.stop()
        self._busy = False
        self.progress.setVisible(False)
        self._set_badge(self.guest_badge, "空闲", "gray")
        self._set_status(
            self.guest_status, "已断开 P2P 连接。", "muted"
        )
        self._sync_controls()

    def _copy_address(self) -> None:
        session = self._guest_session
        if session is None:
            self.toast("加入房间后才能复制连接地址", "info")
            return
        QApplication.clipboard().setText(session.address)
        self.toast("连接地址已复制", "success")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 其他

    def _append_log(self, line: str) -> None:
        text = re.sub(r"\x1b\[[0-9;]*[A-Za-z]", "", str(line or "")).strip()
        if not text:
            return
        if not self.log_box.isVisible():
            self.log_box.setVisible(True)
        self.log_box.appendPlainText(text)
        bar = self.log_box.verticalScrollBar()
        bar.setValue(bar.maximum())

    def _on_game_state(self, running: bool) -> None:
        self.detect_btn.setEnabled(running)
        if not running and self._host_session is not None:
            self._append_log("游戏已退出，正在关闭 P2P 房间。")
            self.close_room(message="游戏已退出，P2P 房间已关闭。")
        self._sync_controls()

    def _sync_controls(self) -> None:
        if not hasattr(self, "create_btn"):
            return
        room_active = (
            self._host_session is not None or self._host_worker is not None
        )
        guest_active = (
            self._guest_session is not None or self._join_worker is not None
        )
        self.create_btn.setEnabled(not self._busy and not room_active)
        self.close_btn.setVisible(room_active)
        self.direct_switch.setEnabled(not room_active and not self._busy)
        self.hide_switch.setEnabled(not room_active and not self._busy)
        self.port_spin.setEnabled(not room_active and not self._busy)
        self.detect_btn.setEnabled(
            not room_active and not self._busy and self.main.game_running
        )
        if hasattr(self, "host_quick_btn"):
            auto_host = self._auto_host_flow
            quick_ready = bool(
                self.host_version_combo.currentData()
                and self.host_save_combo.currentData()
            )
            self.host_quick_btn.setEnabled(
                quick_ready
                and not self._busy
                and not room_active
                and not auto_host
                and not self.main.launch_active
            )
            self.host_quick_btn.setText(
                "正在等待游戏端口…" if auto_host else "启动存档并创建房间"
            )
            pick_enabled = (
                not room_active and not self._busy and not auto_host
            )
            self.host_version_combo.setEnabled(pick_enabled)
            self.host_save_combo.setEnabled(pick_enabled)
        if hasattr(self, "lan_mod_btn"):
            self.lan_mod_btn.setEnabled(not self._busy)
            self.lan_help_btn.setEnabled(not self._busy)
        has_version = bool(self.version_combo.currentData())
        self.join_btn.setEnabled(has_version and not self._busy and not guest_active)
        self.join_btn.setText(
            "已连接房主" if self._guest_session is not None else "组网并启动游戏"
        )
        self.code_edit.setEnabled(not guest_active and not self._busy)
        self.copy_address_btn.setEnabled(self._guest_session is not None)
        self.leave_btn.setVisible(guest_active)

    def on_show(self) -> None:
        self._sync_versions()
        self._sync_host_saves()

    def toast(self, text: str, kind: str = "info") -> None:
        self.main.toast(text, kind)

    def shutdown(self) -> None:
        self._closing = True
        self._host_timer.stop()
        self._guest_timer.stop()
        self._lan_timer.stop()
        self._auto_host_flow = False
        self._host_session_key = ""
        host_worker = self._host_worker
        if host_worker is not None:
            host_worker.cancel()
            self._host_worker = None
        self._host_log_worker = None
        join_worker = self._join_worker
        if join_worker is not None:
            join_worker.cancel()
            self._join_worker = None
        self._join_log_worker = None
        host_session = self._host_session
        self._host_session = None
        # 退出时同步收尾，避免启动器进程结束后还留下 easytier-core。
        self._dispose_session(host_session, wait=True)
        guest_session = self._guest_session
        self._guest_session = None
        self._dispose_session(guest_session, wait=True)

            texts = QVBoxLayout()
            texts.setSpacing(1)
            title = QLabel("开发者模式已解锁")
            title.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px;")
            note = QLabel(
                "反馈表在下载站内，只有从启动器开发者入口才能进入。"
                "反馈不会再经过第三方反馈服务。"
            )
            note.setObjectName("Tiny")
            note.setWordWrap(True)
            texts.addWidget(title)
            texts.addWidget(note)
            banner_layout.addLayout(texts, 1)
            self.body.addWidget(banner)

        self.tabs = SegmentedControl()
        self.tabs.add_item("写反馈", "compose")
        if developer_mode():
            self.tabs.add_item("反馈表", "table")
            self.tabs.changed.connect(self._switch_tab)
        else:
            self.tabs.setVisible(False)
        self.body.addWidget(self.tabs)

        self.stack = QStackedWidget()
        self.stack.setMinimumHeight(440)
        self.compose_page = self._build_compose()
        self.table_page = self._build_table()
        self.stack.addWidget(self.compose_page)
        self.stack.addWidget(self.table_page)
        self.body.addWidget(self.stack, 1)

        self.add_button("打开网站反馈", "Ghost", self._open_site)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def set_kind(self, kind: str) -> None:
        kind = kind if kind in KIND_LABELS else "bug"
        self._kind = kind
        index = self.type_combo.findData(kind)
        if index >= 0:
            self.type_combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
        if kind == "suggestion":
            self.title_label.setText("给猫猫提个改进建议")
            self.form_title.setText("提一个改进建议")
            self.form_hint.setText(
                "希望启动器多做什么、少做什么，或者哪里用起来不顺手？"
                "具体的使用场景比一句“优化一下”更有帮助。"
            )
            self.title_edit.setPlaceholderText("例如：希望下载中心支持按完成时间排序")
            self.submit_btn.setText("在下载站提建议")
        else:
            self.title_label.setText("猫猫收到一只虫子")
            self.form_title.setText("报告一个 Bug")
            self.form_hint.setText(
                "描述发生了什么、你期待什么，以及能否稳定复现。"
                "带版本号和报错信息的反馈最有用。"
            )
            self.title_edit.setPlaceholderText("例如：安装 1.21.1 后启动时报错")
            self.submit_btn.setText("在下载站提交")

    def _switch_tab(self, value: str) -> None:
        self.stack.setCurrentIndex(1 if value == "table" else 0)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _set_status(self, text: str, kind: str = "") -> None:
        self.status_label.setText(text)
        color = colors()["muted"]
        if kind == "ok":
            color = colors()["green"]
        elif kind == "err":
            color = colors()["red"]
        elif kind == "busy":
            color = colors()["accent"]
        self.status_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {color}; font-size: 11px;")

    def _copy_compose(self) -> None:
        payload = self._payload()
        if not payload.get("title") and not payload.get("description"):
            self._set_status("先写一点内容再复制。", "err")
            return
        QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText(feedback_payload_text(payload))
        self._set_status("反馈内容已复制到剪贴板。", "ok")

    def _payload(self) -> dict:
        return build_feedback_payload(
            kind=str(self.type_combo.currentData() or "other"),
            title=self.title_edit.text(),
            description=self.desc_edit.toPlainText(),
            version=self.version_edit.text() or APP_VERSION,
            contact=self.contact_edit.text(),
        )

    def _submit(self) -> None:
        payload = self._payload()
        if len(payload["title"]) < 2:
            self._set_status("标题至少需要 2 个字。", "err")
            self.title_edit.setFocus()
            return
        if len(payload["description"]) < 10:
            self._set_status("描述至少需要 10 个字，写清楚操作步骤会更容易定位。", "err")
            self.desc_edit.setFocus()
            return
        self._fallback_payload = payload
        QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText(feedback_payload_text(payload))
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(build_site_feedback_url(payload)))
        self._set_status(
            "已打开下载站反馈表单，内容已自动填好。在网页里确认提交后会转到 GitHub Issue。"
            "完整内容也复制到了剪贴板。",
            "ok",
        )
        self.fallback_box.setVisible(True)
        try:
            self.main.toast("已打开下载站反馈表单", "success")
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _open_github_fallback(self) -> None:
        payload = self._fallback_payload or self._payload()
        if not payload.get("title") and not payload.get("description"):
            self._set_status("先写一点内容再提交。", "err")
            return
        QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText(feedback_payload_text(payload))
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(build_github_issue_url(payload)))
        self._set_status(
            "已打开 GitHub 新建 Issue 页面，完整内容也复制到了剪贴板。",
            "ok",
        )

    def _open_email_fallback(self) -> None:
        payload = self._fallback_payload or self._payload()
        QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText(feedback_payload_text(payload))
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(build_mailto_url(payload)))
        self._set_status("已打开邮件草稿，完整内容也复制到了剪贴板。", "ok")

    def _open_site(self) -> None:
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(FEEDBACK_SITE))

    def _open_table(self) -> None:
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(feedback_table_url(self.main.config)))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def reject(self) -> None:
        super().reject()

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path

from PySide6.QtCore import QPointF, QRectF, QSize, Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import (
    QColor,
    QIcon,
    QImage,
    QPainter,
    QPainterPath,
    QPen,
    QPixmap,
    QPolygonF,
)

ASSETS_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "assets"


def _new_painter(size: int) -> tuple[QPixmap, QPainter, int]:
    scale = 2
    pixmap = QPixmap(size * scale, size * scale)
    pixmap.setDevicePixelRatio(scale)
    pixmap.fill(Qt.transparent)
    painter = QPainter(pixmap)
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing, True)
    return pixmap, painter, size


def _line(painter: QPainter, points: list[tuple[float, float] | QPointF]) -> None:
    def _point(value: tuple[float, float] | QPointF) -> QPointF:
        return value if isinstance(value, QPointF) else QPointF(*value)

    path = QPainterPath(_point(points[0]))
    for point in points[1:]:
        path.lineTo(_point(point))
    painter.drawPath(path)


@lru_cache(maxsize=512)
def pixmap(name: str, color: str = "#59637A", size: int = 18) -> QPixmap:
    pm, p, s = _new_painter(size)
    c = QColor(color)
    pen = QPen(c, max(1.5, size / 11.0))
    pen.setCapStyle(Qt.RoundCap)
    pen.setJoinStyle(Qt.RoundJoin)
    p.setPen(pen)
    p.setBrush(Qt.NoBrush)
    u = size / 18.0

    def pt(x: float, y: float) -> QPointF:
        return QPointF(x * u, y * u)

    if name == "play":
        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
        p.setBrush(c)
        p.drawPolygon(QPolygonF([pt(5.2, 3.2), pt(5.2, 14.8), pt(14.8, 9.0)]))
    elif name == "download":
        # 与其他图标一样按 size/18 缩放，否则 14px 时箭头会偏向右下并被裁切。
        _line(p, [pt(9, 2.6), pt(9, 11.4)])
        _line(p, [pt(4.8, 7.4), pt(9, 11.7), pt(13.2, 7.4)])
        _line(p, [pt(3.2, 14.6), pt(14.8, 14.6)])
    elif name == "cube":
        p.drawPolygon(
            QPolygonF([pt(9, 2.1), pt(15.3, 5.7), pt(9, 9.3), pt(2.7, 5.7)])
        )
        _line(p, [(2.7, 5.7), (2.7, 12.3), (9, 16.0), (15.3, 12.3), (15.3, 5.7)])
        _line(p, [(9, 9.3), (9, 16.0)])
    elif name == "settings":
        center = pt(9, 9)
        p.save()
        p.translate(center)
        for i in range(8):
            p.save()
            p.rotate(i * 45)
            p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(-1.15 * u, -8.2 * u, 2.3 * u, 3.1 * u), 0.8, 0.8)
            p.restore()
        p.restore()
        p.drawEllipse(center, 5.2 * u, 5.2 * u)
        p.drawEllipse(center, 1.8 * u, 1.8 * u)
    elif name == "folder":
        path = QPainterPath(pt(2.2, 5.0))
        path.lineTo(6.8 * u, 5.0 * u)
        path.lineTo(8.2 * u, 6.8 * u)
        path.lineTo(15.8 * u, 6.8 * u)
        path.lineTo(15.8 * u, 13.9 * u)
        path.lineTo(2.2 * u, 13.9 * u)
        path.closeSubpath()
        p.drawPath(path)
        _line(p, [(2.2, 8.4), (15.8, 8.4)])
    elif name == "refresh":
        p.drawArc(QRectF(2.6 * u, 2.6 * u, 12.8 * u, 12.8 * u), 35 * 16, 285 * 16)
        p.setBrush(c)
        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
        p.drawPolygon(QPolygonF([pt(14.6, 2.2), pt(15.4, 6.4), pt(11.5, 4.5)]))
    elif name == "log":
        p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(3.0 * u, 2.2 * u, 12.0 * u, 13.6 * u), 1.4, 1.4)
        _line(p, [(5.8, 6.0), (12.2, 6.0)])
        _line(p, [(5.8, 9.0), (12.2, 9.0)])
        _line(p, [(5.8, 12.0), (10.2, 12.0)])
    elif name == "message":
        path = QPainterPath()
        path.addRoundedRect(QRectF(2.4 * u, 3.1 * u, 13.2 * u, 9.6 * u), 2.2 * u, 2.2 * u)
        p.drawPath(path)
        p.drawPolygon(QPolygonF([pt(6.4, 12.4), pt(6.4, 15.8), pt(10.2, 12.7)]))
        p.setBrush(c)
        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
        for x in (6.0, 9.0, 12.0):
            p.drawEllipse(pt(x, 7.9), 0.85 * u, 0.85 * u)
    elif name == "plus":
        _line(p, [(9, 3.2), (9, 14.8)])
        _line(p, [(3.2, 9), (14.8, 9)])
    elif name == "edit":
        _line(p, [(3.6, 14.4), (4.5, 10.6), (12.4, 2.7), (15.3, 5.6), (7.4, 13.5), (3.6, 14.4)])
        _line(p, [(10.8, 4.3), (13.7, 7.2)])
    elif name == "close":
        _line(p, [(4.2, 4.2), (13.8, 13.8)])
        _line(p, [(13.8, 4.2), (4.2, 13.8)])
    elif name == "minimize":
        _line(p, [(4.2, 10.2), (13.8, 10.2)])
    elif name == "maximize":
        p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(4.2 * u, 4.2 * u, 9.6 * u, 9.6 * u), 1.0, 1.0)
    elif name == "restore":
        p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(3.2 * u, 5.6 * u, 8.2 * u, 8.2 * u), 1.0, 1.0)
        _line(p, [(6.2, 3.2), (14.8, 3.2), (14.8, 11.6)])
    elif name == "check":
        _line(p, [(3.6, 9.4), (7.3, 13.0), (14.6, 4.8)])
    elif name == "warning":
        path = QPainterPath(pt(9, 2.2))
        path.lineTo(16.4 * u, 15.2 * u)
        path.lineTo(1.6 * u, 15.2 * u)
        path.closeSubpath()
        p.drawPath(path)
        _line(p, [(9, 6.6), (9, 10.3)])
        p.setBrush(c)
        p.drawEllipse(pt(9, 12.7), 0.9 * u, 0.9 * u)
    elif name == "search":
        p.drawEllipse(QRectF(3.0 * u, 3.0 * u, 9.2 * u, 9.2 * u))
        _line(p, [(11.4, 11.4), (15.4, 15.4)])
    elif name == "sun":
        p.drawEllipse(QRectF(5.8 * u, 5.8 * u, 6.4 * u, 6.4 * u))
        for angle in range(0, 360, 45):
            rad = math.radians(angle)
            x1 = 9 + math.cos(rad) * 6.6
            y1 = 9 + math.sin(rad) * 6.6
            x2 = 9 + math.cos(rad) * 8.1
            y2 = 9 + math.sin(rad) * 8.1
            _line(p, [(x1, y1), (x2, y2)])
    elif name == "moon":
        path = QPainterPath()
        path.addEllipse(QRectF(3.4 * u, 3.0 * u, 11.4 * u, 11.4 * u))
        cut = QPainterPath()
        cut.addEllipse(QRectF(7.6 * u, 1.6 * u, 10.0 * u, 10.0 * u))
        p.drawPath(path.subtracted(cut))
    elif name == "user":
        p.drawEllipse(QRectF(6.2 * u, 2.8 * u, 5.6 * u, 5.6 * u))
        path = QPainterPath(pt(3.4, 15.4))
        path.cubicTo(3.8 * u, 11.0 * u, 14.2 * u, 11.0 * u, 14.6 * u, 15.4 * u)
        p.drawPath(path)
    elif name == "chevron-down":
        _line(p, [(4.4, 6.8), (9, 11.4), (13.6, 6.8)])
    elif name == "chevron-right":
        _line(p, [(6.8, 4.4), (11.4, 9), (6.8, 13.6)])
    elif name == "chevron-left":
        _line(p, [(11.2, 4.4), (6.6, 9), (11.2, 13.6)])
    elif name == "external":
        p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(3.0 * u, 6.0 * u, 9.0 * u, 9.0 * u), 1.4, 1.4)
        _line(p, [(9.4, 3.0), (15.0, 3.0), (15.0, 8.6)])
        _line(p, [(15.0, 3.0), (8.2, 9.8)])
    elif name == "globe":
        p.drawEllipse(QRectF(2.4 * u, 2.4 * u, 13.2 * u, 13.2 * u))
        p.drawEllipse(QRectF(6.2 * u, 2.6 * u, 5.6 * u, 12.8 * u))
        _line(p, [(2.8, 6.6), (15.2, 6.6)])
        _line(p, [(2.8, 11.4), (15.2, 11.4)])
    elif name == "image":
        p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(2.6 * u, 3.2 * u, 12.8 * u, 11.6 * u), 1.6, 1.6)
        p.drawEllipse(QPointF(6.5 * u, 6.6 * u), 1.15 * u, 1.15 * u)
        _line(p, [(3.6, 13.0), (7.8, 8.9), (10.2, 11.2), (12.2, 9.2), (14.6, 12.9)])
    elif name == "shirt":
        path = QPainterPath(pt(6.2, 3.2))
        path.lineTo(11.8 * u, 3.2 * u)
        path.lineTo(15.4 * u, 6.1 * u)
        path.lineTo(13.0 * u, 8.8 * u)
        path.lineTo(12.0 * u, 7.9 * u)
        path.lineTo(12.0 * u, 15.2 * u)
        path.lineTo(6.0 * u, 15.2 * u)
        path.lineTo(6.0 * u, 7.9 * u)

def icon(name: str, color: str = "#59637A", size: int = 18) -> QIcon:
    return QIcon(pixmap(name, color, size))


def logo_pixmap(size: int = 40) -> QPixmap:
    """内部品牌图标：与桌面图标一致的低像素恶魔小猫。"""
    return app_icon_pixmap(size)


@lru_cache(maxsize=64)
def chibi_face_pixmap(size: int) -> QPixmap:
    """Q 版 OC 的正面头像，正方形裁切，适合圆形徽章。"""
    image = QImage(str(ASSETS_DIR / "chibi_face.png"))
    if image.isNull():
        return app_icon_pixmap(size)
    side = min(image.width(), image.height())
    left = (image.width() - side) // 2
    top = (image.height() - side) // 2
    square = image.copy(left, top, side, side)
    return QPixmap.fromImage(
        square.scaled(
            QSize(size, size),
            Qt.IgnoreAspectRatio,
            Qt.SmoothTransformation,
        )
    )


@lru_cache(maxsize=32)
def chibi_pixmap(height: int) -> QPixmap:
    """Q 版 OC 头像立绘，保持宽高比缩放到指定高度。"""
    image = QImage(str(ASSETS_DIR / "chibi_oc.png"))
    if image.isNull():
        return app_icon_pixmap(height)
    return QPixmap.fromImage(
        image.scaledToHeight(max(1, height), Qt.SmoothTransformation)
    )


def skin_face_pixmap(size: int) -> QPixmap:
    """把玩家当前皮肤的脸部（含帽子层）渲染成小头像。"""
    image = active_skin_image()
    if image.isNull():
        return logo_pixmap(size)
    face = QImage(8, 8, QImage.Format_ARGB32)
    face.fill(Qt.transparent)
    painter = QPainter(face)
    painter.drawImage(0, 0, image.copy(8, 8, 8, 8))
    painter.drawImage(0, 0, image.copy(40, 8, 8, 8))
    painter.end()
    scaled = face.scaled(
        QSize(size, size), Qt.IgnoreAspectRatio, Qt.FastTransformation
    ).convertToFormat(QImage.Format_ARGB32)
    return QPixmap.fromImage(scaled)


_SKIN_IMAGE_CACHE: dict[str, tuple[float, QImage]] = {}


def active_skin_image() -> QImage:
    """读取启动器当前使用的皮肤：优先 config.skin_path，其次本地预览副本。"""
    try:
        from ..config import Config

        configured = str(Config.load().skin_path or "").strip()
    except Exception:
        configured = ""
    candidates: list[Path] = []
    if configured:
        candidates.append(Path(configured))
    try:
        from ..skins import local_skin_path

        local = local_skin_path()
        if local not in candidates:
            candidates.append(local)
    except Exception:
        pass

    for path in candidates:
        try:
            if not path.is_file():
                continue
            mtime = path.stat().st_mtime
            cached = _SKIN_IMAGE_CACHE.get(str(path))
            if cached and cached[0] == mtime:
                return cached[1]
            from ..skins import load_skin_file

            image = load_skin_file(path).image
            if not image.isNull():
                _SKIN_IMAGE_CACHE[str(path)] = (mtime, image)
                return image
        except Exception:
            continue
    try:
        from ..skins import default_skin

        return default_skin()
    except Exception:
        return QImage()

_APP_ICON_BASE: QImage | None = None


def _app_icon_base() -> QImage:
    global _APP_ICON_BASE
    if _APP_ICON_BASE is not None:
        return _APP_ICON_BASE

    band_colors: list[QColor | None] = [None] * 32
    for lo, hi, value in _APP_ICON_BANDS:
        for y in range(lo, hi + 1):
            band_colors[y] = QColor(value)

    image = QImage(32, 32, QImage.Format_ARGB32)
    image.fill(Qt.transparent)
    for y, row in enumerate(_APP_ICON_ROWS):
        for x, ch in enumerate(row):
            if ch == " ":
                continue
            if ch == ".":
                color = band_colors[y]
            else:
                color = QColor(_APP_ICON_PALETTE[ch])
            if color is not None:
                image.setPixelColor(x, y, color)
    _APP_ICON_BASE = image
    return image


def app_icon_image(size: int) -> QImage:
    """低像素恶魔小猫：玫瑰渐变底，奶白侧影，头朝左，尾巴卷在右侧。"""
    base = _app_icon_base()
    if size == base.width():
        return base.copy()
    return base.scaled(size, size, Qt.IgnoreAspectRatio, Qt.FastTransformation)


@lru_cache(maxsize=64)
def app_icon_pixmap(size: int) -> QPixmap:
    return QPixmap.fromImage(app_icon_image(size))


def app_icon() -> QIcon:
    icon = QIcon()
    ico = ASSETS_DIR / "dkl.ico"
    if ico.is_file():
        icon.addFile(str(ico))
        return icon
    for size in (16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128, 256):
        icon.addPixmap(app_icon_pixmap(size))
    return icon

class _Task(QObject):
    done = Signal(object)
    failed = Signal(str)
    progress = Signal(int, str)

    def __init__(self, fn, parent: QObject | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.fn = fn

    def start(self) -> None:
        threading.Thread(target=self._run, daemon=True).start()

    def _run(self) -> None:
        try:
            result = self.fn(self.progress.emit)
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - 直接显示给用户
            self.failed.emit(f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
        else:
            self.done.emit(result)
