    @staticmethod
    def _status_separator() -> QLabel:
        label = QLabel("|")
        label.setObjectName("Tiny")
        return label

    def _restore_geometry(self) -> None:
        screen = QApplication.primaryScreen()
        available = screen.availableGeometry() if screen else None
        width = max(980, int(self.config.window_width or 1180))
        height = max(640, int(self.config.window_height or 760))
        if available:
            width = min(width, available.width() - 40)
            height = min(height, available.height() - 40)
        self.resize(width, height)
        if available:
            self.move(
                available.x() + (available.width() - width) // 2,
                available.y() + (available.height() - height) // 2,
            )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 主题 / 窗口

    def apply_theme(self, theme_name: str) -> None:
        theme.set_current(theme_name)
        app = QApplication.instance()
        if app:
            app.setStyleSheet(theme.stylesheet(theme_name))
        refresh_themed_icons()
        self._update_nav(self.current_page)
        self._update_window_icons()
        if hasattr(self, "home_page"):
            self.home_page.refresh_versions()
        if hasattr(self, "download_page"):
            self.download_page.refresh_theme()
        if hasattr(self, "loader_page"):
            self.loader_page.refresh_theme()
        if hasattr(self, "mods_page"):
            self.mods_page.refresh_mods()
        if hasattr(self, "skin_page"):
            self.skin_page.refresh_theme()
        if hasattr(self, "room_page"):
            self.room_page.refresh_theme()
        if hasattr(self, "server_page"):
            self.server_page.refresh_theme()
        if hasattr(self, "assistant_page"):
            self.assistant_page.refresh_theme()
        if hasattr(self, "account_chip"):
            self.account_chip.avatar.refresh()
        if hasattr(self, "download_chip"):
            self.download_chip.sync(self.download_center)
        for widget in QApplication.allWidgets():
            widget.update()
        self._apply_dwm()

    def _update_nav(self, current: str) -> None:
        self.current_page = current
        for key, button in self.nav_buttons.items():
            button.set_active(key == current)

    def _update_window_icons(self) -> None:
        c = colors()["text2"]
        self.min_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("minimize", c, 14))
        self.max_btn.setIcon(
            icons.icon("restore" if self.isMaximized() else "maximize", c, 13)
        )
        self.close_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("close", c, 14))

    def _apply_dwm(self) -> None:
        if sys.platform != "win32":
            return
        try:
            hwnd = int(self.winId())
            dwm = ctypes.windll.dwmapi
            dwm.DwmSetWindowAttribute.argtypes = [
                wintypes.HWND,
                wintypes.DWORD,
                ctypes.c_void_p,
                wintypes.DWORD,
            ]
            dark = ctypes.c_int(1 if self.config.theme == "dark" else 0)
            dwm.DwmSetWindowAttribute(
                hwnd, 20, ctypes.byref(dark), ctypes.sizeof(dark)
            )
            corner = ctypes.c_int(2)
            dwm.DwmSetWindowAttribute(
                hwnd, 33, ctypes.byref(corner), ctypes.sizeof(corner)
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

    def toggle_maximize(self) -> None:
        if self.isMaximized():
            self.showNormal()
        else:
            self.showMaximized()
        QTimer.singleShot(0, self._update_window_icons)

    def changeEvent(self, event: QEvent) -> None:
        super().changeEvent(event)
        if event.type() == QEvent.WindowStateChange and hasattr(self, "max_btn"):
            self._update_window_icons()

    def _apply_titlebar_mode(self) -> None:
        """窄窗口收缩品牌、账户与下载胶囊，保证导航标签不被裁切或重叠。"""
        width = self.width()
        show_brand = width >= 1180
        full_account = width >= 1400
        tight_nav = width < 1400
        compact_download = width < 1500
        if hasattr(self, "brand_name"):
            self.brand_name.setVisible(show_brand)
            self.brand_tag.setVisible(show_brand)
        if hasattr(self, "account_chip"):
            self.account_chip.set_compact(not full_account)
        if hasattr(self, "download_chip"):
            self.download_chip.set_compact(compact_download)
        if hasattr(self, "nav_buttons"):
            for button in self.nav_buttons.values():
                button.set_tight(tight_nav)

    def resizeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        self._apply_titlebar_mode()
        if hasattr(self, "loading_overlay") and self.loading_overlay.isVisible():
            self.loading_overlay.setGeometry(self.rect())
        if hasattr(self, "drop_hint") and self.drop_hint.isVisible():
            self._position_drop_hint()
        if hasattr(self, "toast_widget") and self.toast_widget.isVisible():
            parent = self.toast_widget.parentWidget()
            if parent:
                self.toast_widget.move(
                    (parent.width() - self.toast_widget.width()) // 2,
                    parent.height() - self.toast_widget.height() - 58,
                )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 拖拽导入

    @staticmethod
    def _archive_paths(mime) -> list[Path]:
        return local_transfer_paths(mime)

    @staticmethod
    def _is_addon_drop_target(widget) -> bool:
        """服务端插件列表自己处理拖入时，把事件让给它。"""
        node = widget
        while isinstance(node, QWidget):
            if node.property("dklAddonDrop"):
                return True
            node = node.parentWidget()
        return False

    def _position_drop_hint(self) -> None:
        self.drop_hint.move(
            (self.width() - self.drop_hint.width()) // 2,
            max(80, int(self.height() * 0.38)),
        )

    def _show_drop_hint(self) -> None:
        if not hasattr(self, "drop_hint"):
            return
        self._position_drop_hint()
        self.drop_hint.show()
        self.drop_hint.raise_()

    def _hide_drop_hint(self) -> None:
        if hasattr(self, "drop_hint"):
            self.drop_hint.hide()

    def eventFilter(self, obj, event) -> bool:
        try:
            etype = event.type()
        except (RuntimeError, AttributeError):
            return False
        if etype in (
            QEvent.DragEnter,
            QEvent.DragMove,
            QEvent.DragLeave,
            QEvent.Drop,
        ):
            if (
                isinstance(obj, QWidget)
                and isValid(obj)
                and obj.window() is self
                and isValid(self)
                and QApplication.activeModalWidget() is None
            ):
                if self._is_addon_drop_target(obj):
                    # 服务端插件列表有独立拖放区，交给控件自己处理。
                    self._hide_drop_hint()
                    return False
                if etype == QEvent.DragLeave:
                    self._hide_drop_hint()
                    return False
                try:
                    paths = self._archive_paths(event.mimeData())
                except RuntimeError:
                    return False
                if paths:
                    if etype == QEvent.Drop:
                        self._hide_drop_hint()
                        event.setDropAction(Qt.CopyAction)
                        event.accept()
                        self._handle_dropped_archives(paths)
                    else:
                        event.setDropAction(Qt.CopyAction)
                        event.accept()
                        self._show_drop_hint()
                    return True
        return False

    def _handle_dropped_archives(self, paths: list[Path]) -> None:
        if not paths:
            return
        if self.install_active or self.launch_active:
            self.toast("有任务正在进行，稍等一下喵", "info")
            return
        self.open_local_import(paths)

    def nativeEvent(self, eventType, message):
        if sys.platform == "win32" and eventType == b"windows_generic_MSG":
            try:
                msg = wintypes.MSG.from_address(int(message))
                if msg.message == 0x0084 and not self.isMaximized():
                    hwnd = msg.hwnd
                    rect = wintypes.RECT()
                    ctypes.windll.user32.GetWindowRect(hwnd, ctypes.byref(rect))
                    border = max(5, int(6 * self.devicePixelRatioF()))
                    x = ctypes.c_short(msg.lParam & 0xFFFF).value
                    y = ctypes.c_short((msg.lParam >> 16) & 0xFFFF).value
                    left = x < rect.left + border
                    right = x >= rect.right - border
                    top = y < rect.top + border
                    bottom = y >= rect.bottom - border
                    if top and left:
                        return True, 13
                    if top and right:
                        return True, 14
                    if bottom and left:
                        return True, 16
                    if bottom and right:
                        return True, 17
                    if left:
                        return True, 10
                    if right:
                        return True, 11
                    if top:
                        return True, 12
                    if bottom:
                        return True, 15
            except Exception:
                pass
        return super().nativeEvent(eventType, message)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 启动器更新

    def _should_auto_check_updates(self) -> bool:
        if not self.config.update_auto_check:
            return False
        if "--no-update-check" in sys.argv or "--screenshot" in sys.argv:
            return False
        if os.environ.get("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "").lower() == "offscreen":
            return False
        return bool(str(self.config.update_url or "").strip())

    def check_for_updates(self, manual: bool = False) -> None:
        if self._update_busy:
            if manual:
                self.toast("正在检查更新，稍等一下喵", "info")
            return
        url = str(self.config.update_url or DEFAULT_UPDATE_URL).strip()
        if not url:
            if manual:
                self.toast("请先在设置里填写更新源地址", "error")
            return
        self._update_busy = True
        self.update_state_text = "正在检查更新…"
        self.update_state_kind = "busy"
        self.refresh_update_state()
        if manual:
            self.set_status("正在检查启动器更新…", "busy")
        worker = UpdateCheckWorker(APP_VERSION, url, self)
        self._update_check_worker = worker
        worker.ready.connect(
            lambda release, error: self._update_check_ready(
                release, error, manual
            )
        )
        worker.start()

    def _update_check_ready(self, release, error: str, manual: bool) -> None:
        self._update_busy = False
        self._update_check_worker = None
        self.config.update_last_check = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
        self.config.save()
        if error:
            self.update_state_text = "检查更新失败"
            self.update_state_kind = "error"
            self.refresh_update_state()
            self.log(f"检查更新失败：{error}")
            if manual:
                self.set_status("检查更新失败", "error")
                NoticeDialog(
                    self,
                    "检查更新失败",
                    "暂时无法读取更新清单。下载站可能没有启动，或者更新源地址不可用。"
                    f"\n\n{error}\n更新源：{self.config.update_url}",
                    icon_name="warning",
                ).exec()
            return

        if release is None:
            self.last_update_release = None
            self.update_state_text = f"v{APP_VERSION} 已是最新版本"
            self.update_state_kind = "success"
            self.refresh_update_state()
            self.set_status(f"已是最新版本 v{APP_VERSION}", "success")
            self.log(f"检查更新：当前 v{APP_VERSION} 已是最新版本")
            if manual:
                self.toast("已经是最新版本啦喵", "success")
            return

        self.last_update_release = release
        self.update_state_text = f"发现新版本 v{release.version}"
        self.update_state_kind = "accent"
        self.refresh_update_state()
        self.set_status(f"发现新版本 v{release.version}", "success")
        self.log(
            f"检查更新：发现 v{release.version}（当前 v{APP_VERSION}）"
        )
        if not manual:
            skipped = str(self.config.update_skipped_version or "").strip()
            if release.version == skipped and not release.mandatory:
                self.log(f"已跳过 v{release.version}，等待用户手动检查")
                return
        self.open_update_dialog(release)

    def refresh_update_state(self) -> None:
        if hasattr(self, "settings_page"):
            self.settings_page.refresh_update_state()

    def open_update_dialog(self, release) -> None:
        if self._update_dialog is not None:
            try:
                self._update_dialog.raise_()
                self._update_dialog.activateWindow()
            except Exception:
                pass
            return
        dialog = UpdateDialog(self, release)
        self._update_dialog = dialog
        try:
            dialog.exec()
        finally:
            self._update_dialog = None
            self.refresh_update_state()
            self.raise_()
            self.activateWindow()

    def apply_update(self, payload: str, version: str = "") -> bool:
        if self.install_active or self.launch_active:
            self.toast("还有任务正在进行，完成或取消后再更新", "info")
            return False
        if self.game_running:
            self.toast("游戏还在运行，先关掉游戏再更新", "info")
            return False
        if hasattr(self, "server_page"):
            running = self.server_page.running_server_names()
            if running:
                self.toast("服务端还在运行，先停止服务端再更新", "info")
                return False
        try:
            schedule_apply(
                Path(payload),
                APP_DIR,
                python_exe=restart_executable(),
                restart=True,
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            self.toast(f"无法安排更新：{exc}", "error")
            return False
        self.config.update_skipped_version = ""
        self.config.save()
        self.log(
            f"准备更新到 v{version or '新版本'}，启动器即将退出并自动替换代码"
        )
        self.update_state_text = f"正在更新到 v{version}"
        self.update_state_kind = "busy"
        self.set_status("正在应用更新，启动器即将重启…", "busy")
        self.refresh_update_state()
        # 更新器要等当前进程退出才会替换代码，这里不能再走“关闭到托盘”。
        self._force_quit = True
        QTimer.singleShot(250, self.close)
        return True

    def open_update_site(self) -> None:
        url = ""
        release = self.last_update_release
        if release is not None and getattr(release, "page_url", ""):
            url = str(release.page_url)
        else:
            url = self._site_url_from_update_url(
                str(self.config.update_url or DEFAULT_UPDATE_URL)
            )
        if not url:
            self.toast("这个更新源没有提供下载站地址", "info")
            return
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(url))

    @staticmethod
    def _site_url_from_update_url(update_url: str) -> str:
        """更新源未提供 page_url 时，从清单地址推导站点根地址。

        不能只取 scheme + netloc：GitHub Pages 项目站部署在
        /darkitten-launcher/ 子路径下，丢掉路径会打开用户站根目录（404）。
        """
        parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(str(update_url or "").strip())
        if parsed.scheme not in ("http", "https") or not parsed.netloc:
            return ""
        path = parsed.path or "/"
        if not path.endswith("/"):
            path = path.rsplit("/", 1)[0] + "/"
        return urllib.parse.urlunsplit(
            (parsed.scheme, parsed.netloc, path, "", "")
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 后台运行 / 系统托盘

    def background_active(self) -> bool:
        return self._tray is not None

    def _setup_tray(self) -> None:
        if self._tray is not None:
            return
        if not bool(getattr(self.config, "background_enabled", True)):
            return
        app = QApplication.instance()
        if app is None or not QSystemTrayIcon.isSystemTrayAvailable():
            return
        tray = QSystemTrayIcon(icons.app_icon(), self)
        tray.setToolTip(f"{APP_NAME} v{APP_VERSION}")
        menu = QMenu(self)
        menu.addAction("显示主界面", self.show_from_tray)
        menu.addAction("下载中心", self._show_downloads_from_tray)
        menu.addSeparator()
        menu.addAction("退出启动器", self.quit_from_tray)
        tray.setContextMenu(menu)
        tray.activated.connect(self._on_tray_activated)
        tray.messageClicked.connect(self.show_from_tray)
        self.download_center.task_finished.connect(self._on_tray_task_finished)
        tray.show()
        self._tray = tray
        self._tray_menu = menu
        # 隐藏到托盘后最后一个窗口关闭不能再触发退出。
        app.setQuitOnLastWindowClosed(False)

    def _teardown_tray(self) -> None:
        tray = self._tray
        menu = self._tray_menu
        self._tray = None
        self._tray_menu = None
        if tray is not None:
            try:
                self.download_center.task_finished.disconnect(
                    self._on_tray_task_finished
                )
            except (RuntimeError, TypeError):
                pass
            tray.hide()
            tray.setContextMenu(None)
            tray.deleteLater()
        if menu is not None:
            menu.deleteLater()
        app = QApplication.instance()
        if app is not None:
            app.setQuitOnLastWindowClosed(True)

    def apply_background_setting(self) -> None:
        if bool(getattr(self.config, "background_enabled", True)):
            self._setup_tray()
        else:
            self._teardown_tray()

    def _on_tray_activated(self, reason: QSystemTrayIcon.ActivationReason) -> None:
        if reason in (QSystemTrayIcon.Trigger, QSystemTrayIcon.DoubleClick):
            self.show_from_tray()

    def show_from_tray(self) -> None:
        if self.isMinimized():
            self.showNormal()
        else:
            self.show()
        self.raise_()
        self.activateWindow()

    def _show_downloads_from_tray(self) -> None:
        self.show_from_tray()
        self.open_download_tasks()

    def quit_from_tray(self) -> None:
        self._force_quit = True
        self.close()

    def _show_close_choice(self) -> None:
        dialog = CloseChoiceDialog(self)
        self._close_choice_dialog = dialog
        dialog.setAttribute(Qt.WA_DeleteOnClose, True)
        dialog.finished.connect(
            lambda _result, current=dialog: self._on_close_choice(current)
        )
        dialog.open()

    def _on_close_choice(self, dialog: CloseChoiceDialog) -> None:
        if self._close_choice_dialog is dialog:
            self._close_choice_dialog = None
        choice = str(getattr(dialog, "choice", ""))
        if choice == CloseChoiceDialog.BACKGROUND:
            self.hide()
            self._show_tray_hint()
        elif choice == CloseChoiceDialog.EXIT:
            self._force_quit = True
            self.close()

    def _quit_application(self) -> None:
        if self._quit_requested:
            return
        self._quit_requested = True
        app = QApplication.instance()
        if app is not None:
            app.quit()

    def _on_tray_task_finished(self, task) -> None:
        if self._tray is None:
            return
        if self.isVisible() and not self.isMinimized():
            return
        success = str(getattr(task, "status", "")) == "success"
        title = "下载完成" if success else "下载结束"
        message = str(getattr(task, "message", "") or getattr(task, "title", ""))
        icon = (
            QSystemTrayIcon.Information
            if success
            else QSystemTrayIcon.Warning
        )
        self._tray.showMessage(title, message, icon, 4000)

    def _show_tray_hint(self) -> None:
        if self._tray is None:
            return
        self._tray.setToolTip(f"{APP_NAME} v{APP_VERSION} · 正在后台运行")
        if bool(getattr(self.config, "tray_hint_shown", False)):
            return
        self.config.tray_hint_shown = True
        self.config.save()
        self._tray.showMessage(
            APP_NAME,
            "启动器已最小化到系统托盘，下载和服务端会继续运行。右键托盘图标可以退出。",
            QSystemTrayIcon.Information,
            4200,
        )

    def closeEvent(self, event: QCloseEvent) -> None:
        if self._force_quit:
            # 托盘菜单或更新器发起的退出，继续走下面的安全确认流程。
            if self._close_choice_dialog is not None:
                dialog = self._close_choice_dialog
                self._close_choice_dialog = None
                dialog.reject()
        elif self.background_active() and bool(
            getattr(self.config, "background_enabled", True)
        ):
            if os.environ.get("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "").lower() == "offscreen":
                # 无界面 QA 沿用直接隐藏，不弹出需要人工选择的对话框。
                self.hide()
                event.ignore()
                self._show_tray_hint()
                return
            if self._close_choice_dialog is not None:
                self._close_choice_dialog.raise_()
                self._close_choice_dialog.activateWindow()
                event.ignore()
                return
            self._show_close_choice()
            event.ignore()
            return
        if hasattr(self, "loading_overlay"):
            self.loading_overlay.abort()
        if self.install_active and self.install_worker:
            dialog = ConfirmDialog(
                self,
                "安装仍在进行",
                "现在退出会中断下载，已经下载完成的文件会保留。确定要退出吗？",
                primary_text="退出",
                secondary_text="继续安装",
                icon_name="warning",
            )
            if not dialog.exec():
                self._force_quit = False
                event.ignore()
                return
            self.install_worker.cancel()
        if self.download_center.has_running():
            dialog = ConfirmDialog(
                self,
                "下载仍在进行",
                "现在退出会中断正在下载的文件，已经完成的部分会保留。确定要退出吗？",
                primary_text="退出",
                secondary_text="继续下载",
                icon_name="download",
                icon_color=colors()["orange"],
            )
            if not dialog.exec():
                self._force_quit = False
                event.ignore()
                return
            for task in self.download_center.active_tasks():
                self.download_center.cancel(task.id)
        if hasattr(self, "server_page"):
            running = self.server_page.running_server_names()
            if running:
                dialog = ConfirmDialog(
                    self,
                    "服务端仍在运行",
                    "以下服务端仍在运行，退出启动器会先尝试安全关闭它们：",
                    primary_text="停止并退出",
                    secondary_text="取消",
                    icon_name="server",
                    icon_color=colors()["red"],
                    details="、".join(running),
                )
                if not dialog.exec():
                    self._force_quit = False
                    event.ignore()
                    return
            self.server_page.shutdown()
        if hasattr(self, "room_page"):
            self.room_page.shutdown()
        if not self.isMaximized():
            self.config.window_width = self.width()
            self.config.window_height = self.height()
        self.config.save()
        for session in self.game_sessions.values():
            if session.log_file is not None:
                try:
                    session.log_file.close()
                except Exception:
                    pass
                session.log_file = None
        if self._force_quit:
            self._teardown_tray()
            # 窗口可能本来就隐藏着，不能依赖“最后一个窗口关闭”来结束进程。
            QTimer.singleShot(0, self._quit_application)
        event.accept()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 导航 / 日志

    def switch_page(self, name: str) -> None:
        index = PAGE_INDEX.get(name, 0)
        self.stack.setCurrentIndex(index)
        self._update_nav(name)
        page = self.stack.widget(index)
        if hasattr(page, "on_show"):
            page.on_show()

    def log(self, text: str) -> None:
        if not text:
            return
        self.log_panel.append(text)

    def toggle_log(self) -> None:
        if self.log_panel.isVisible() and self.log_panel.maximumHeight() > 0:
            self.log_panel.close_panel()
            self.log_btn.setText("运行日志")
        else:
            self.log_panel.open_panel()
            self.log_btn.setText("收起日志")

    def toast(self, text: str, kind: str = "info") -> None:
        if hasattr(self, "toast_widget"):
            self.toast_widget.show_message(text, kind)

    def set_status(self, text: str, kind: str = "idle") -> None:
        # 导入期间底栏由导入任务独占，避免更新检查等后台状态覆盖导入文案，
        # 却留下仍可点击的“取消导入”按钮。
        if self._active_import_task() is not None:
            return
        self._set_status_now(text, kind)

    def _set_status_now(self, text: str, kind: str = "idle") -> None:
        palette = {
            "idle": colors()["muted"],
            "busy": colors()["accent"],
            "success": colors()["green"],
            "error": colors()["red"],
        }
        color = palette.get(kind, palette["idle"])
        self.status_dot.setStyleSheet(f"color: {color}; font-size: 9px;")
        self.status_text.setText(text)
        if self._tray is not None:
            self._tray.setToolTip(f"{APP_NAME} v{APP_VERSION}\n{text}")

    def open_path(self, path: Path | str) -> None:
        try:
            p = Path(path)
            if p.suffix == "":
                p.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl.fromLocalFile(str(p)))
        except Exception as exc:
            self.toast(f"无法打开路径：{exc}", "error")

    def open_game_dir(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.config.game_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.toast(f"无法创建游戏目录：{exc}", "error")
            return
        self.open_path(self.config.game_path)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 版本 / Java

    def refresh_versions(self) -> None:
        self.versions = scan_versions(self.config.game_path)
        self._repair_loader_bindings()
        games = list_game_versions(self.versions)
        ids = {v.id for v in games}
        if self.selected_version not in ids:
            if self.config.last_version in ids:
                self.selected_version = self.config.last_version
            elif games:
                self.selected_version = games[0].id
            else:
                self.selected_version = ""
        self.versions_changed.emit()
        self.selection_changed.emit(self.selected_version)
        self._update_status_version()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 加载器 / 游戏版本绑定

    def loader_profiles(self):
        return list_loader_profiles(self.versions)

    def game_version_summaries(self):
        return list_game_versions(self.versions)

    def loader_profile_for(self, version_id: str):
        """返回游戏版本当前绑定的纯加载器配置；无效时返回 None。"""
        summary = next((v for v in self.versions if v.id == version_id), None)
        if not summary or summary.is_loader_profile or summary.loader:
            return None
        profile_id = self.config.loader_for(version_id)
        if not profile_id:
            return None
        profile = next(
            (
                v
                for v in self.versions
                if v.id == profile_id and v.is_loader_profile
            ),
            None,
        )
        if not profile or profile.base_id != summary.base_id:
            return None
        return profile

    def compatible_loader_profiles(self, version_id: str):
        summary = next((v for v in self.versions if v.id == version_id), None)
        if not summary or summary.is_loader_profile or summary.loader:
            return []
        return [
            profile
            for profile in self.loader_profiles()
            if profile.base_id == summary.base_id
        ]

    def compatible_game_versions(self, loader_id: str):
        profile = next(
            (v for v in self.versions if v.id == loader_id),
            None,
        )
        if not profile or not profile.is_loader_profile:
            return []
        return [
            game
            for game in self.game_version_summaries()
            if not game.loader and game.base_id == profile.base_id
        ]

    def bind_loader(self, version_id: str, loader_id: str) -> None:
        self.config.bind_loader(version_id, loader_id)
        self.config.save()
        self.versions_changed.emit()
        self.selection_changed.emit(self.selected_version)
        self._update_status_version()

    def launch_profile(self, version_id: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
        """返回（启动配置 ID，游戏实例 ID）。"""
        summary = next((v for v in self.versions if v.id == version_id), None)
        if not summary:
            return version_id, version_id
        if summary.is_loader_profile:
            return summary.id, summary.base_id or summary.id
        profile = self.loader_profile_for(version_id)
        if profile:
            return profile.id, version_id
        return version_id, version_id

    def _launch_mode_note(self, profile_id: str, instance_id: str) -> str:
        summary = next(
            (v for v in self.versions if v.id == instance_id), None
        )
        if profile_id and profile_id != instance_id:
            return f" · 加载器 {profile_id}"
        if summary and summary.loader:
            return f" · {summary.loader}"
        return " · 原版"

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 多游戏会话

    def game_session(self, key: str) -> GameSession | None:
        return self.game_sessions.get(str(key or ""))

    def session_process(self, key: str) -> GameProcess | None:
        session = self.game_session(key)
        return session.process if session else None

    def find_game_session(self, version_id: str) -> GameSession | None:
        """按显示版本、启动配置或实例 ID 查找正在运行的游戏。"""
        target = str(version_id or "")
        if not target:
            return None
        for session in self.game_sessions.values():
            if target in (
                session.version,
                session.profile_id,
                session.instance_id,
            ):
                return session
        return None

    def _latest_session(self) -> GameSession | None:
        latest: GameSession | None = None
        for session in self.game_sessions.values():
            # 尚未拿到 PID 时 started_at 都是 0，按插入顺序让后启动的优先。
            if latest is None or session.started_at >= latest.started_at:
                latest = session
        return latest

    def _sync_game_state(self) -> None:
        self.game_running = bool(self.game_sessions)
        latest = self._latest_session()
        if latest is not None:
            self.game_process = latest.process
            self._running_version = latest.version
            self._running_profile_id = latest.profile_id
            self._game_started_at = latest.started_at
        else:
            self.game_process = None
            self._running_version = ""
            self._running_profile_id = ""
            self._game_started_at = 0.0
        self._launch_closing = any(
            item.closing for item in self.game_sessions.values()
        )

    def _repair_loader_bindings(self) -> None:
        profiles = {
            item.id: item
            for item in self.versions
            if item.is_loader_profile
        }
        games = [
            item
            for item in self.versions
            if not item.is_loader_profile
        ]
        game_ids = {item.id for item in games}
        valid: dict[str, str] = {}
        changed = False
        for game in games:
            if game.loader:
                continue
            profile = profiles.get(self.config.loader_for(game.id))
            if profile and profile.base_id == game.base_id:
                valid[game.id] = profile.id

        # 旧版本里用户是直接选中加载器版本启动的。升级后把这类选择迁移到
        # 它继承的原版游戏版本上，避免打开首页时选中项凭空消失。
        last = next(
            (item for item in self.versions if item.id == self.config.last_version),
            None,
        )
        if last and last.is_loader_profile and last.base_id in game_ids:
            valid[last.base_id] = last.id
            self.config.last_version = last.base_id
            changed = True

        # 只有一个加载器候选时，升级后首次运行给它的基础版本补上绑定；
        # 其他同基础版本仍保持原版，等用户在加载器页面明确勾选。
        # 迁移完成后不再自动绑定，避免用户手动选择原版后被改回去。
        if not self.config.loaders_migrated:
            for game in games:
                if game.loader or game.id in valid:
                    continue
                candidates = [
                    item
                    for item in profiles.values()
                    if item.base_id == game.base_id
                ]
                if len(candidates) == 1 and game.id == candidates[0].base_id:
                    valid[game.id] = candidates[0].id

        # 旧绑定指向已删除或已不兼容的版本时一并清理。
        self.config.version_loaders = {
            key: value
            for key, value in self.config.version_loaders.items()
            if key in game_ids
        }
        if self.config.version_loaders != valid:
            self.config.version_loaders = valid
            changed = True
        if not self.config.loaders_migrated:
            self.config.loaders_migrated = True
            changed = True
        if changed:
            self.config.save()

    def _update_status_version(self) -> None:
        if hasattr(self, "mc_label"):
            version_id = self.selected_version
            display = self.config.version_name(version_id) if version_id else ""
            text = f"MC: {display or version_id}" if version_id else "MC: —"
            self.mc_label.setText(text)
            self.mc_label.setToolTip(version_id)
        self._update_java_label()

    def ensure_java_detected(self, force: bool = False) -> None:
        if self._java_busy:
            return
        if self.java_installs and not force:
            return
        self._java_busy = True
        worker = JavaDetectWorker(self.config.java_path)
        self._java_worker = worker
        worker.ready.connect(self._java_ready)
        worker.start()

    def _java_ready(self, installs) -> None:
        self._java_busy = False
        self.java_installs = list(installs or [])
        self.java_installs_changed.emit(self.java_installs)
        self._update_java_label()

    def _update_java_label(self) -> None:
        if not hasattr(self, "java_label"):
            return
        required = 0
        profile_id, _instance_id = self.launch_profile(self.selected_version)
        summary = next(
            (v for v in self.versions if v.id == profile_id), None
        )
        if summary:
            required = summary.java_major
        chosen = pick_java(self.java_installs, required, self.config.java_path)
        if chosen:
            self.java_label.setText(f"Java {chosen.major or '?'}")
            self.java_label.setToolTip(chosen.path)
        else:
            self.java_label.setText("Java 未检测")
            self.java_label.setToolTip("")

    def current_account(self) -> Account:
        return Account.from_config(self.config.account)

    def apply_littleskin_account(self, account) -> None:
        """把 LittleSkin 角色设为当前游戏账户，并同步皮肤账户里的令牌。"""
        from ..littleskin import load_account, save_account

        profile = load_account(self.config)
        for field in ("username", "name", "uuid", "access_token", "client_token"):
            value = str(getattr(account, field, "") or "")
            if value:
                setattr(profile, field, value)
        for field in ("variant", "skin_url"):
            value = str(getattr(account, field, "") or "")
            if value:
                setattr(profile, field, value)
        last_sync = float(getattr(account, "last_sync", 0) or 0)
        if last_sync:
            profile.last_sync = last_sync
        profiles = getattr(account, "profiles", None)
        if isinstance(profiles, list) and profiles:
            profile.profiles = profiles
        save_account(self.config, profile)

        self.config.account = Account.from_littleskin(profile).to_config()
        self.config.player_name = profile.name
        self.config.save()
        self.account_changed.emit()

    def display_name(self) -> str:
        account = self.current_account()
        return account.name if account.is_online else self.config.player_name

    def _update_account(self) -> None:
        account = self.current_account()
        dev_mode = bool(self.config.developer_unlocked)
        set_developer_mode(dev_mode)
        if hasattr(self, "account_chip"):
            self.account_chip.set_account(
                account.display_name if account.is_online else self.config.player_name,
                "正版" if account.is_msa else ("LittleSkin" if account.is_littleskin else "离线"),
                account.is_online,
            )
            self.account_chip.set_developer(dev_mode)
            self.account_chip.avatar.refresh()
        if hasattr(self, "feedback_btn"):
            self.feedback_btn.setToolTip(
                "开发者反馈表 · 提交反馈 / 查看反馈"
                if dev_mode
                else "Bug 反馈 / 改进建议"
            )
        if hasattr(self, "home_page"):
            self.home_page._refresh_status()
        if hasattr(self, "settings_page"):
            self.settings_page.refresh_account()
            if hasattr(self.settings_page, "refresh_developer_state"):
                self.settings_page.refresh_developer_state()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 安装

    def begin_install(
        self,
        version_id: str,
        version_url: str = "",
        verify: bool = False,
        success_callback=None,
    ) -> None:
        if self.install_active:
            self.toast("已有安装任务正在进行", "info")
            return
        if self.launch_active:
            self.toast("游戏正在启动，请稍候", "info")
            return
        if not version_id:
            self.toast("请先选择一个版本", "error")
            return

        worker = InstallWorker(
            self.config.game_path,
            version_id,
            version_url=version_url,
            source=self.config.download_source,
            verify=verify,
            threads=self.config.download_threads,
        )
        self.install_worker = worker
        self.install_active = True
        self._install_cancelling = False
        self._install_version = version_id
        self._install_success_callback = success_callback
        worker.progress.connect(self.install_progress.emit)
        worker.progress.connect(self._on_install_progress)
        worker.log_line.connect(self._on_task_log)
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_install_finished)
        self._install_last_percent = 0
        self._install_last_message = ""
        self.install_started.emit(version_id)
        if self._active_import_task() is None:
            self.set_status(f"正在安装 {version_id}…", "busy")
            self.progress_bar.setValue(0)
            self.progress_bar.setVisible(True)
            self.speed_label.setText("")
            self.speed_label.setVisible(True)
            self._update_action_button()
        else:
            self._sync_import_status()
        self.speed_timer.start()
        self.log(f"开始安装 {version_id}（{self.config.download_source}）")
        self._install_task = self.download_center.start_worker(
            worker,
            title=f"安装游戏版本 · {version_id}",
            content_type="version-install",
            target=self.config.version_game_path(version_id),
            source=self.config.download_source,
            metadata={"version_id": version_id},
            cancel_cb=self.cancel_install,
            forward_log=False,
        )

    def _on_install_progress(self, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        self._install_last_percent = int(percent)
        self._install_last_message = str(message)
        if self._active_import_task() is not None:
            # 导入优先占用底栏，安装进度只记录，等导入结束后再恢复显示。
            return
        self.progress_bar.setValue(percent)
        self.set_status(f"{self._install_version} · {message}", "busy")

    def _on_task_log(self, line: str) -> None:
        self.log(line)
        self.task_log.emit(line)

    def _tick_speed(self) -> None:
        worker = self.install_worker
        if worker and worker.installer:
            self.speed_label.setText(worker.installer.speed_text)

    def _on_install_finished(self, success: bool, message: str) -> None:
        version_id = self._install_version
        was_cancelling = self._install_cancelling
        cancelled = (not success) and (
            was_cancelling or "取消" in str(message)
        )
        import_active = self._active_import_task() is not None
        self.install_active = False
        self._install_cancelling = False
        if import_active:
            # 导入仍在进行，底栏继续显示导入任务，不让安装结果覆盖。
            self._sync_import_status()
        else:
            self.speed_timer.stop()
            self.speed_label.setText("")
            self.speed_label.setVisible(False)
            self.progress_bar.setVisible(False)
            self.progress_bar.setValue(100 if success else 0)
        if success:
            if not import_active:
                self.set_status(f"{version_id} 安装完成", "success")
            self.log(f"{version_id} 安装完成")
            self.toast(f"{version_id} 已准备就绪", "success")
        elif cancelled:
            if not import_active:
                self.set_status(f"已取消安装 {version_id}", "idle")
            self.log(f"已取消安装 {version_id}")
            self.toast("安装已取消，临时下载文件已清理", "info")
        else:
            if not import_active:
                self.set_status(f"安装失败：{message}", "error")
            self.log(f"安装失败：{message}")
            self.toast(f"安装失败：{message}", "error")

        self.refresh_versions()
        self._update_action_button()
        self.install_finished.emit(success, message, version_id)
        callback = self._install_success_callback
        self._install_success_callback = None
        if success and callback:
            QTimer.singleShot(150, callback)

    def cancel_install(self) -> None:
        if not self.install_active or not self.install_worker:
            return
        if self._install_cancelling:
            return
        self._install_cancelling = True
        self.install_worker.cancel()
        self.set_status("正在取消安装…", "busy")
        self.log("正在取消安装…")
        self.action_cancel_btn.setText("正在取消…")
        self.action_cancel_btn.setEnabled(False)

    def _active_import_task(self):
        if not hasattr(self, "download_center"):
            return None
        for task in reversed(self.download_center.active_tasks()):
            if task.content_type in IMPORT_TYPES:
                return task
        return None

    def _on_task_progress(self, task_id: int, _percent: int, _message: str) -> None:
        task = self.download_center.task(task_id)
        if task is not None and task.content_type in IMPORT_TYPES:
            self._sync_import_status()

    def _sync_import_status(self) -> None:
        task = self._active_import_task()
        if task is not None:
            self._import_status_active = True
            label = task.target.name or task.title
            prefix = {
                "modpack": "导入整合包",
                "version-import": "导入版本",
                "local-import": "导入内容",
            }.get(task.content_type, "导入")
            message = str(task.message or "").strip()
            if not message or message == "准备下载…":
                message = "准备导入…"
            self._set_status_now(f"{prefix} {label} · {message}", "busy")
            self.progress_bar.setValue(task.progress)
            self.progress_bar.setVisible(True)
            self.speed_label.setText("")
            self.speed_label.setVisible(False)
            pending = message.startswith("正在取消")
            self.action_cancel_btn.setText("正在取消…" if pending else "取消导入")
            self.action_cancel_btn.setEnabled(not pending)
            self.action_cancel_btn.setVisible(True)
            return
        if not self._import_status_active:
            return
        self._import_status_active = False
        self.progress_bar.setVisible(False)
        self.speed_label.setText("")
        self.speed_label.setVisible(False)
        self.action_cancel_btn.setVisible(False)
        if self.install_active:
            self._restore_install_status()
        else:
            self.speed_timer.stop()

    def _restore_install_status(self) -> None:
        if not self.install_active:
            return
        if self._install_last_message:
            self.set_status(
                f"{self._install_version} · {self._install_last_message}", "busy"
            )
        else:
            self.set_status(f"正在安装 {self._install_version}…", "busy")
        self.progress_bar.setValue(self._install_last_percent)
        self.progress_bar.setVisible(True)
        self.speed_label.setVisible(True)
        self.speed_timer.start()
        self._update_action_button()

    def _update_action_button(self) -> None:
        if not hasattr(self, "action_cancel_btn"):
            return
        self.action_cancel_btn.setEnabled(True)
        import_task = self._active_import_task()
        if import_task is not None:
            pending = str(import_task.message or "").startswith("正在取消")
            self.action_cancel_btn.setText("正在取消…" if pending else "取消导入")
            self.action_cancel_btn.setEnabled(not pending)
            self.action_cancel_btn.setVisible(True)
            return
        if self.install_active:
            self.action_cancel_btn.setText(
                "正在取消…" if self._install_cancelling else "取消安装"
            )
            self.action_cancel_btn.setEnabled(not self._install_cancelling)
            self.action_cancel_btn.setVisible(True)
        elif self.launch_active:
            self.action_cancel_btn.setText(
                "正在取消…" if self._launch_cancel_requested else "取消启动"
            )
            self.action_cancel_btn.setEnabled(not self._launch_cancel_requested)
            self.action_cancel_btn.setVisible(True)
        elif self.game_sessions:
            closing = any(
                item.closing for item in self.game_sessions.values()
            )
            if closing:
                text = "正在关闭…"
            elif len(self.game_sessions) > 1:
                text = f"关闭全部游戏（{len(self.game_sessions)}）"
            else:
                text = "关闭游戏"
            self.action_cancel_btn.setText(text)
            self.action_cancel_btn.setEnabled(not closing)
            self.action_cancel_btn.setVisible(True)
        else:
            self.action_cancel_btn.setVisible(False)

    def cancel_current_action(self) -> None:
        import_task = self._active_import_task()
        if import_task is not None:
            self.download_center.cancel(import_task.id)
            self.action_cancel_btn.setText("正在取消…")
            self.action_cancel_btn.setEnabled(False)
            return
        if self.install_active:
            self.cancel_install()
        elif self.launch_active:
            self.cancel_launch()
        elif self.game_sessions:
            self.close_game()

    def complete_selected(self) -> None:
        if not self.selected_version:
            self.toast("请先选择一个版本", "info")
            return
        profile_id, _instance_id = self.launch_profile(self.selected_version)
        try:
            resolved = resolve_version(self.config.game_path, profile_id)
            missing = check_installation(self.config.game_path, resolved, check_assets=False)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.toast(f"无法读取版本：{exc}", "error")
            return
        if not missing:
            self.toast("当前版本文件已完整", "success")
            return
        self.begin_install(profile_id, verify=True)
        self.log_panel.open_panel()
        self.log_btn.setText("收起日志")

            return

        self.refresh_versions()

    def open_mod_info(self, info) -> None:
        """从已安装列表打开内容介绍；有项目 ID 就复用下载页的详情视图。"""
        from .mod_dialog import ModBrowserDialog

        project_id = str(getattr(info, "project_id", "") or "")
        if not project_id:
            from .dialogs import NoticeDialog

            name = str(getattr(info, "name", "") or "Mod 介绍")
            intro = str(getattr(info, "intro", "") or "").strip()
            description = str(getattr(info, "description", "") or "").strip()
            parts = [intro]
            if description and description != intro:
                parts.append("原版简介：\n" + description)
            if not any(parts):
                parts.append("这个文件没有保存介绍信息。")
            NoticeDialog(self, name, "\n\n".join(parts), icon_name="cube").exec()
            return
        hit = {
            "project_id": project_id,
            "title": str(getattr(info, "name", "") or ""),
            "slug": "",
            "description": str(getattr(info, "description", "") or ""),
            "project_url": str(getattr(info, "project_url", "") or ""),
            "source": str(getattr(info, "source", "") or "modrinth"),
            "source_label": str(getattr(info, "source_label", "") or ""),
            "content_type": "mod",
            "categories": [],
            "downloads": 0,
            "icon_url": "",
        }
        ModBrowserDialog(self, hit).exec()
        self._refresh_download_chip()

    def open_mod_learn(self) -> None:

        LearnDialog(self).exec()

    def _refresh_download_chip(self) -> None:
        if hasattr(self, "download_chip"):
            self.download_chip.sync(self.download_center)

    def _on_download_task_finished(self, task) -> None:
        filename = str(getattr(task, "filename", "") or task.title)
        content_type = str(getattr(task, "content_type", ""))
        status = str(getattr(task, "status", ""))
        import_types = ("modpack", "version-import", "local-import")
        if content_type == "version-install":
            # 安装流程自己的 _on_install_finished 已经负责提示、刷新和回调，
            # 这里只让任务留在下载中心，避免重复弹出提示。
            return
        if content_type == "loader-install":
            if bool(getattr(task, "metadata", {}).get("ui_handled")):
                return
            meta = getattr(task, "metadata", {}) or {}
            version_id = str(
                getattr(task, "filename", "")
                or meta.get("loader_version", "")
            )
            base_id = str(meta.get("base_id", ""))
            if status == "success":
                self.refresh_versions()
                profile = next(
                    (v for v in self.versions if v.id == version_id), None
                )
                if profile and profile.is_loader_profile and base_id:
                    self.config.bind_loader(base_id, version_id)
                    self.config.last_version = base_id
                    self.config.save()
                    self.select_version(base_id)
                self.set_status(f"加载器安装完成：{version_id}", "success")
                self.toast(f"{version_id} 加载器已安装", "success")
            elif status == "cancelled":
                self.set_status("加载器安装已取消", "idle")
                self.toast("加载器安装已取消", "info")
            else:
                message = str(
                    getattr(task, "error", "") or getattr(task, "message", "")
                )
                self.set_status(f"加载器安装失败：{message}", "error")
                self.toast(f"加载器安装失败：{message}", "error")
            return
        if content_type == "server-install":
            if bool(getattr(task, "metadata", {}).get("ui_handled")):
                return
            meta = getattr(task, "metadata", {}) or {}
            name = str(meta.get("name", "") or "服务端")
            folder = str(meta.get("folder", ""))
            if status == "success":
                if hasattr(self, "server_page"):
                    self.server_page.refresh_servers(folder)
                self.set_status(f"服务端安装完成：{name}", "success")
                self.toast(f"{name} 服务端已就绪", "success")
            elif status == "cancelled":
                self.set_status("服务端安装已取消", "idle")
                self.toast("服务端安装已取消", "info")
            else:
                message = str(
                    getattr(task, "error", "") or getattr(task, "message", "")
                )
                self.set_status(f"服务端安装失败：{message}", "error")
                self.toast(f"服务端安装失败：{message}", "error")
            return
        if status == "success":
            if content_type in ("mod", "local-import") and hasattr(self, "mods_page"):
                self.mods_page.refresh_mods()
            if content_type in ("modpack", "version-import"):
                self.refresh_versions()
                if getattr(task, "filename", ""):
                    self.select_version(str(task.filename))
            if content_type == "pack-fetch":
                self.set_status("压缩包下载完成", "success")
                self.toast("压缩包下载完成，可在下载任务中点击导入", "success")
            elif content_type == "modpack":
                self.set_status(f"整合包导入完成：{filename}", "success")
                self.log(f"整合包导入完成：{filename}")
                self.toast(f"整合包导入完成：{filename}", "success")
            elif content_type == "version-import":
                self.set_status(f"版本导入完成：{filename}", "success")
                self.log(f"版本导入完成：{filename}")
                self.toast(f"版本导入完成：{filename}", "success")
            elif content_type == "local-import":
                self.set_status("本地内容导入完成", "success")
                self.toast("本地内容已经放进对应文件夹", "success")
            elif content_type == "mod":
                self.set_status(f"下载完成：{filename}", "success")
                self.toast(f"已下载 {filename}", "success")
            else:
                self.set_status(f"任务完成：{filename}", "success")
                self.toast(f"已完成 {filename}", "success")
        elif status == "cancelled":
            self.set_status("任务已取消", "idle")
            self.toast("任务已取消，临时文件已清理", "info")
        else:
            message = str(getattr(task, "error", "") or getattr(task, "message", ""))
            label = "导入" if content_type in import_types else "下载"
            self.set_status(f"{label}失败：{message}", "error")
            self.toast(f"{label}失败：{message}", "error")

    def open_download_tasks(self) -> None:
        if self._download_tasks_dialog is not None:
            self._download_tasks_dialog.refresh()
            self._download_tasks_dialog.raise_()
            self._download_tasks_dialog.activateWindow()
            return
        dialog = DownloadTasksDialog(self)
        self._download_tasks_dialog = dialog
        dialog.finished.connect(self._on_download_tasks_closed)
        dialog.show()

    def _on_download_tasks_closed(self, _result: int = 0) -> None:
        dialog = self._download_tasks_dialog
        self._download_tasks_dialog = None
        if dialog is not None:
            dialog.deleteLater()

            return
        from .migration_dialog import MigrationDialog

        self.ensure_java_detected()

    # OC：右键菜单、审判战与对话

    def open_oc_menu(self, global_pos=None) -> None:
        from .. import judgement

        state = judgement.load_state()
        reward = judgement.active_persona(state)
        menu = QMenu(self)
        title = menu.addAction("LFELKEEA")
        title.setEnabled(False)
        if reward:
            status = menu.addAction(judgement.REWARDS[reward]["name"])
            status.setEnabled(False)
        menu.addSeparator()
        battle = menu.addAction("进入审判战")
        battle.triggered.connect(self.open_judgement_dialog)
        chat = menu.addAction("和她说话")
        chat.setEnabled(judgement.has_any(state))
        chat.triggered.connect(self.open_oc_chat)
        if not judgement.has_any(state):
            chat.setToolTip("先在困难模式的审判战里带回一件信物")
        menu.addSeparator()
        config = menu.addAction("AI 接口设置")
        config.triggered.connect(self.open_oc_config)
        menu.exec(global_pos if global_pos is not None else QCursor.pos())

    def open_judgement_dialog(self) -> None:
        from .oc_dialog import JudgementDialog

        dialog = getattr(self, "_judgement_dialog", None)
        if dialog is not None:
            try:
                if dialog.isVisible():
                    dialog.raise_()
                    dialog.activateWindow()
                    return
            except RuntimeError:
                pass
        dialog = JudgementDialog(self, self)
        dialog.setAttribute(Qt.WA_DeleteOnClose, False)
        self._judgement_dialog = dialog
        dialog.show()
        dialog.raise_()

    def open_oc_chat(self) -> None:
        from .. import judgement
        from .oc_dialog import OCChatDialog

        state = judgement.load_state()
        if not judgement.has_any(state):
            notice = NoticeDialog(
                self,
                "她还没有醒来",
                "在困难模式的审判战里通关屠杀线或饶恕线，带回一件信物之后，"
                "她才会在启动器里和你说话。",
                "去审判战",
                "heart",
                secondary_text="以后再说",
            )
            if notice.exec() and notice.action_clicked:
                self.open_judgement_dialog()
            return
        OCChatDialog(self, self).exec()

    def open_oc_config(self) -> None:
        from .oc_dialog import OCConfigDialog

        OCConfigDialog(self).exec()
