    def show_command_palette(self) -> None:
        if QApplication.activeModalWidget() is not None:
            return
        dialog = CommandPalette(self, self._palette_commands())
        if dialog.exec() and dialog.chosen:
            self._run_palette_command(dialog.chosen)

    def _run_palette_command(self, command_id: str) -> None:
        pages = {
            "page-home": "home",
            "page-download": "download",
            "page-loaders": "loaders",
            "page-mods": "mods",
            "page-skin": "skin",
            "page-room": "room",
            "page-server": "server",
            "page-assistant": "assistant",
            "page-settings": "settings",
        }
        if command_id in pages:
            self.switch_page(pages[command_id])
            return
        if command_id == "launch":
            self.launch_selected()
        elif command_id == "launch-safe":
            self.launch_safe_mode()
        elif command_id == "close-game":
            self.close_game()
        elif command_id == "mod-download":
            self.open_mod_download()
        elif command_id == "game-optimize":
            self.open_optimize_dialog()
        elif command_id == "import-local":
            self.open_local_import()
        elif command_id == "download-center":
            self.open_download_tasks()
        elif command_id == "snapshot":
            self.switch_page("settings")
            self.settings_page._create_snapshot()
        elif command_id == "diagnostics-bundle":
            self.switch_page("settings")
            self.settings_page._create_diagnostics()
        elif command_id == "diagnostics-copy":
            self.switch_page("settings")
            self.settings_page._copy_diagnostics()
        elif command_id == "check-update":
            self.check_for_updates(manual=True)
        elif command_id == "toggle-theme":
            self.toggle_theme()
        elif command_id == "open-game-dir":
            self.open_game_folder()
        elif command_id == "toggle-log":
            self.toggle_log()
        elif command_id == "feedback-bug":
            self.open_feedback_dialog("bug")
        elif command_id == "feedback-suggestion":
            self.open_feedback_dialog("suggestion")
        elif command_id == "feedback-inbox":
            self.open_feedback_inbox()

    def toggle_theme(self) -> None:
        target = "light" if self.config.theme == "dark" else "dark"
        self.config.theme = target
        self.config.save()
        self.apply_theme(target)
        if hasattr(self, "settings_page") and hasattr(
            self.settings_page, "theme_seg"
        ):
            self.settings_page.theme_seg.set_value(target)

    def open_game_folder(self) -> None:
        path = self.config.game_path
        try:
            path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        except OSError as exc:
            self.toast(f"无法打开游戏目录：{exc}", "error")
            return
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl.fromLocalFile(str(path)))

    @staticmethod
    def _utc_now_text() -> str:
        return datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

    def _check_feedback_reminder(self) -> None:
        if self._feedback_checked or not developer_mode():
            return
        self._feedback_checked = True
        worker = FeedbackListWorker(parent=self)
        self._feedback_reminder_worker = worker
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_feedback_reminder)
        worker.start()

    def _on_feedback_reminder(
        self, items, _account, _source: str, _warning: str
    ) -> None:
        self._feedback_reminder_worker = None
        if not isinstance(items, list):
            return
        last_seen = str(self.config.feedback_last_seen or "").strip()
        if not last_seen:
            self.config.feedback_last_seen = self._utc_now_text()
            self.config.save()
            return
        unread = [
            item
            for item in items
            if str(item.get("status") or "open") == "open"
            and str(item.get("created_at") or "") > last_seen
        ]
        if not unread:
            return
        if hasattr(self, "feedback_dot"):
            self.feedback_dot.show()
            self.feedback_dot.raise_()
        self.feedback_btn.setToolTip(
            f"开发者反馈表 · {len(unread)} 条新反馈 / 建议"
        )

    def _mark_feedback_seen(self) -> None:
        self.config.feedback_last_seen = self._utc_now_text()
        self.config.save()
        if hasattr(self, "feedback_dot"):
            self.feedback_dot.hide()
        if hasattr(self, "feedback_btn"):
            self.feedback_btn.setToolTip("开发者反馈表 · 提交反馈 / 查看反馈")

    def open_feedback_dialog(self, kind: str = "bug") -> None:
        """打开 Bug 反馈 / 改进建议；开发者会额外看到反馈表入口。"""
        dialog = FeedbackDialog(self, kind=kind)
        dialog.exec()
        self._update_account()

    def open_feedback_inbox(self) -> None:
        """开发者快捷入口：在下载站打开反馈表。"""
        if not developer_mode():
            return
        self._mark_feedback_seen()
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(feedback_table_url(self.config)))
        self.toast("已在浏览器打开开发者反馈表", "info")

    def offer_shortcut_once(self) -> None:
        """第一次启动时询问是否创建桌面快捷方式，之后不再打扰。"""
        if bool(self.config.shortcut_offered):
            return
        from ..shortcut import shortcut_exists

        if shortcut_exists():
            self.config.shortcut_offered = True
            self.config.save()
            if hasattr(self, "settings_page"):
                self.settings_page.refresh_shortcut_state()
            return
        dialog = ConfirmDialog(
            self,
            "创建桌面快捷方式",
            "要把 Darkitten Launcher 放到桌面吗？以后双击桌面上的猫猫图标就能启动，"
            "不用每次翻文件夹。",
            primary_text="创建快捷方式",
            secondary_text="暂不创建",
            icon_name="desktop",
            icon_color=colors()["accent"],
            details="之后也可以在“设置 → 启动器设置”里重新创建，快捷方式只保存在本机。",
        )
        create = dialog.exec()
        self.config.shortcut_offered = True
        self.config.save()
        if create:
            self.create_desktop_shortcut()

    def create_desktop_shortcut(self) -> bool:
        from ..shortcut import ShortcutError
        from ..shortcut import create_desktop_shortcut as build_shortcut

        try:
            path = build_shortcut()
        except ShortcutError as exc:
            self.toast(f"创建快捷方式失败：{exc}", "error")
            return False
        self.toast(f"桌面快捷方式已创建：{path.name}", "success")
        if hasattr(self, "settings_page"):
            self.settings_page.refresh_shortcut_state()
        return True

    def join_friend_room(self, room_code: str, room_version: str = "") -> None:
        if not room_code:
            self.toast("好友还没有分享房间号", "info")
            return
        if self.game_running:
            self.toast("游戏已经在运行，先把当前游戏关掉", "info")
            return
        if self.launch_active or self.install_active:
            self.toast("有任务正在进行，请稍候", "info")
            return
        self.switch_page("room")
        QTimer.singleShot(
            0, lambda: self.room_page.join_friend_room(room_code, room_version)
        )

    def export_version(self, version_id: str = "") -> None:
        version_id = version_id or self.selected_version
        if not version_id:
            self.toast("先选一个版本，猫猫才有东西可打包", "info")
            return
        if self.install_active and self._install_version == version_id:
            self.toast("这个版本还在安装，等装完再打包", "info")
            return
        from .pack_dialog import PackExportDialog

        PackExportDialog(self, version_id).exec()

    def open_pack_import(self, path: str | Path | None = None) -> None:
        if self.install_active or self.launch_active:
            self.toast("有任务正在进行，稍等一下喵", "info")
            return
        from .pack_dialog import PackImportDialog

        dialog = PackImportDialog(self, initial_path=path)
        dialog.exec()
        if dialog.imported_version:
            self.select_version(dialog.imported_version)

    def open_local_import(
        self,
        path: str | Path | list[str | Path] | None = None,
        *,
        initial_paths: list[str | Path] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """统一识别本地文件，再转到版本、整合包、服务端或内容导入。"""
        if self.install_active or self.launch_active:
            self.toast("有任务正在进行，稍等一下喵", "info")
            return
        from ..local_import import LocalImportError, detect_local_import
        from .local_import_dialog import LocalImportDialog

        raw: list[str | Path] = []
        if isinstance(path, (list, tuple)):
            raw.extend(path)
        elif path is not None:
            raw.append(path)
        if initial_paths:
            raw.extend(initial_paths)
        sources = [Path(item) for item in raw if str(item or "").strip()]
        if not sources:
            dialog = LocalImportDialog(self)
            dialog.exec()
            return
        try:
            infos = [detect_local_import(item) for item in sources]
        except LocalImportError as exc:
            self.toast(str(exc), "error")
            return

        if len(infos) == 1:
            info = infos[0]
            if info.kind == "server":
                self.open_server_import(info.path)
                return
            if info.kind == "modpack":
                self.open_pack_import(info.path)
                return
            if info.kind == "version_zip":
                self.open_version_import(info.path)
                return
        elif any(info.kind != "content" for info in infos):
            self.toast("一次可以导入多个 Mod / 材质 / 光影，但版本包和服务端要单独导入", "info")
            return

        dialog = LocalImportDialog(self, initial_paths=sources)
        dialog.exec()
        if dialog.imported_version:
            self.select_version(dialog.imported_version)

    def open_version_import(self, path: str | Path | None = None) -> None:
        if self.install_active or self.launch_active:
            self.toast("有任务正在进行，稍等一下喵", "info")
            return
        from ..curseforge_pack import (
            inspect_curseforge_pack,
            looks_like_curseforge_pack,
        )
        from ..modrinth_pack import inspect_modrinth_pack, looks_like_modrinth_pack
        from ..packs import inspect_pack
        from ..version_zip import inspect_version_zip
        from .version_zip_dialog import VersionZipDialog

        if path:
            source = Path(path)
            if not source.is_file():
                self.toast(f"找不到文件：{source.name}", "error")
                return
            suffix = source.suffix.lower()
            if suffix not in (".zip", ".dklpack", ".mrpack"):
                self.toast(
                    "只认识 .zip、.dklpack 和 .mrpack 三种压缩包",
                    "error",
                )
                return
            try:
                inspect_pack(source)
            except Exception:
                pass
            else:
                self.open_pack_import(source)
                return
            if looks_like_modrinth_pack(source):
                try:
                    inspect_modrinth_pack(source)
                except Exception as exc:
                    self.toast(f"这个 Modrinth 整合包不能导入：{exc}", "error")
                    return
                self.open_pack_import(source)
                return
            if looks_like_curseforge_pack(source):
                try:
                    inspect_curseforge_pack(source)
                except Exception as exc:
                    self.toast(f"这个 CurseForge 整合包不能导入：{exc}", "error")
                    return
                self.open_pack_import(source)
                return
            try:
                inspect_version_zip(source)
            except Exception as exc:
                self.toast(f"这个压缩包不能当版本用：{exc}", "error")
                return

        dialog = VersionZipDialog(self, initial_path=path)
        dialog.exec()
        if dialog.imported_version:
            self.select_version(dialog.imported_version)

    def open_server_import(self, path: str | Path | None = None) -> None:
        self.switch_page("server")
        self.server_page.open_import_dialog(path)

    def select_version(self, version_id: str) -> None:
        if not version_id:
            return
        if hasattr(self, "home_page"):
            self.home_page.select_version(version_id)
        self.selected_version = version_id
        self._update_status_version()

    def launch_version(self, version_id: str) -> None:
        """工坊通过联动桥请求启动某个版本。"""
        if not version_id:
            return
        self.select_version(version_id)
        self.show_from_tray()
        self.switch_page("home")
        QTimer.singleShot(250, self.launch_selected)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 删除版本

    def delete_version(self, version_id: str) -> None:
        if not version_id:
            return
        if self.install_active and self._install_version == version_id:
            self.toast("该版本正在安装，请先取消安装", "info")
            return
        if self.game_running and (
            self._running_version == version_id
            or self._running_profile_id == version_id
        ):
            self.toast("该版本正在运行，请先关闭游戏", "error")
            return
        if self._delete_worker is not None:
            self.toast("已有删除任务正在进行", "info")
            return

        summary = next((v for v in self.versions if v.id == version_id), None)
        is_profile = bool(summary and summary.is_loader_profile)

        dependents = dependent_versions(self.config.game_path, version_id)
        if dependents:
            NoticeDialog(
                self,
                "无法删除此版本",
                "以下已安装版本依赖它，直接删除会导致这些版本无法启动。"
                "请先删除依赖它的版本。",
                button_text="知道了",
                icon_name="warning",
                secondary_text="",
            ).exec()
            self.toast(
                "存在依赖版本：" + "、".join(dependents[:4]), "error"
            )
            return

        version_dir = version_json_path(
            self.config.game_path, version_id
        ).parent
        if not version_dir.exists():
            self.toast("版本目录不存在，已刷新列表", "info")
            self.refresh_versions()
            return

        if is_profile:
            bound_games = sorted(
                gid
                for gid, pid in self.config.version_loaders.items()
                if pid == version_id
            )
            note = f"目录：{version_dir}\n"
            if bound_games:
                note += (
                    "以下游戏版本会切回原版启动："
                    + "、".join(bound_games)
                    + "。存档、Mod、材质和光影不会被删除。"
                )
            else:
                note += "当前没有游戏版本使用这个加载器。"
            dialog = ConfirmDialog(
                self,
                "删除加载器配置",
                f"确定删除加载器 {version_id} 吗？配置文件会移入系统回收站。",
                primary_text="移入回收站",
                secondary_text="取消",
                icon_name="trash",
                icon_color=colors()["red"],
                details=note,
            )
        elif self.config.version_isolation:
            note = (
                f"目录：{version_dir}\n"
                "版本隔离已开启，此目录内的 mods、saves 和 config 也会一并移入回收站。"
            )
            dialog = ConfirmDialog(
                self,
                "删除游戏版本",
                f"确定删除版本 {version_id} 吗？文件会移入系统回收站，可在回收站恢复。",
                primary_text="移入回收站",
                secondary_text="取消",
                icon_name="trash",
                icon_color=colors()["red"],
                details=note,
            )
        else:
            note = (
                f"目录：{version_dir}\n"
                "版本隔离已关闭，只会删除版本文件，公共 mods 和存档不受影响。"
            )
            dialog = ConfirmDialog(
                self,
                "删除游戏版本",
                f"确定删除版本 {version_id} 吗？文件会移入系统回收站，可在回收站恢复。",
                primary_text="移入回收站",
                secondary_text="取消",
                icon_name="trash",
                icon_color=colors()["red"],
                details=note,
            )
        if not dialog.exec():
            return

        self.set_status(f"正在删除 {version_id}…", "busy")
        worker = DeleteWorker(version_dir, self)
        self._delete_worker = worker
        worker.finished.connect(
            lambda ok, message, vid=version_id: self._on_version_deleted(
                vid, ok, message
            )
        )
        worker.start()

    def _on_version_deleted(
        self, version_id: str, success: bool, message: str
    ) -> None:
        self._delete_worker = None
        if not success:
            self.set_status(f"删除失败：{message}", "error")
            self.toast(f"删除失败：{message}", "error")
            return
        changed = False
        if self.config.last_version == version_id:
            self.config.last_version = ""
            changed = True
        if self.config.version_loaders.pop(version_id, None) is not None:
            changed = True
        for game_id in list(self.config.version_loaders):
            if self.config.version_loaders[game_id] == version_id:
                del self.config.version_loaders[game_id]
                changed = True
        if changed:
            self.config.save()
        self.refresh_versions()
        self.set_status(f"已删除版本 {version_id}", "success")
        self.toast(f"{version_id} 已移入回收站", "success")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 启动

    def _restore_safe_mode_on_startup(self) -> None:
        try:
            handled = restore_pending(self.config.game_path)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log(f"安全模式恢复检查失败：{exc}")
            return
        if handled:
            self.log(f"已恢复上次安全模式临时禁用的 Mod（{len(handled)} 个目录）")

    def launch_safe_mode(self) -> None:
        """临时禁用当前版本的 Mod 后启动，游戏结束时自动恢复。"""
        if self.game_running:
            self.toast("游戏已经在运行了", "info")
            return
        if self.launch_active:
            self.toast("游戏正在启动，请稍候", "info")
            return
        if self.install_active:
            self.toast("文件仍在安装中，请稍候", "info")
            return
        if not self.selected_version:
            self.toast("请先安装一个游戏版本", "info")
            return
        mods_dir = self.config.mods_path(self.selected_version)
        try:
            moved = enable_safe_mode(mods_dir)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.toast(f"无法进入安全模式：{exc}", "error")
            return
        self._safe_mode_mods_dir = mods_dir
        if hasattr(self, "mods_page"):
            self.mods_page.refresh_mods()
        if moved:
            self.log(
                f"安全模式：临时禁用 {len(moved)} 个 Mod，游戏退出后自动恢复"
            )
            self.toast(f"安全模式 · 已临时禁用 {len(moved)} 个 Mod", "info")
        else:
            self.log("安全模式：当前版本没有可禁用的 Mod")
            self.toast("安全模式 · 当前版本没有可禁用的 Mod", "info")
        self.launch_selected()

    def _restore_safe_mode_mods(self) -> None:
        mods_dir = self._safe_mode_mods_dir
        if not mods_dir:
            return
        self._safe_mode_mods_dir = None
        try:
            count = restore_safe_mode(mods_dir)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log(f"安全模式恢复失败：{exc}")
            return
        if count:
            self.log(f"安全模式结束，已恢复 {count} 个 Mod")
            self.toast(f"已恢复 {count} 个被安全模式禁用的 Mod", "info")
        if hasattr(self, "mods_page"):
            self.mods_page.refresh_mods()

    def launch_selected(
        self,
        checked: bool = False,
        auto_retry: bool = True,
        connect_address: str = "",
        quick_world: str = "",
    ) -> str:
        """启动一个游戏实例，返回会话键；未启动时返回空字符串。

        允许多个实例同时运行，但同一时刻只处理一次启动流程，
        避免两条启动线程同时写入配置。
        """
        if self.launch_active:
            self.toast("游戏正在启动，请稍候", "info")
            return ""
        if self.install_active:
            self.toast("文件仍在安装中，请稍候", "info")
            return ""
        if not self.selected_version:
            self.toast("请先安装一个游戏版本", "info")
            return ""

        self.launch_active = True
        self._launch_cancel_requested = False
        self._launch_connect_address = connect_address
        self._launch_quick_world = quick_world
        self._launch_auto_retry = auto_retry
        self._launch_version = self.selected_version
        profile_id, instance_id = self.launch_profile(self.selected_version)
        self._launch_profile_id = profile_id
        self._launch_instance_id = instance_id
        self._session_seq += 1
        self._launch_session_key = f"game-{self._session_seq}"
        worker = LaunchWorker(
            self.config.game_path,
            profile_id,
            self.config,
            self.java_installs,
            self.current_account(),
            server_address=connect_address,
            quick_world=quick_world,
            parent=self,
            instance_id=instance_id,
        )
        self.launch_worker = worker
        worker.status.connect(self._on_launch_status)
        worker.ready.connect(self._on_launch_ready)
        worker.missing.connect(self._on_launch_missing)
        worker.failed.connect(self._on_launch_failed)
        worker.cancelled.connect(self._on_launch_cancelled)
        self.home_page.set_launching(True)
        self._update_action_button()
        self.set_status("正在准备启动…", "busy")
        self.log(
            f"准备启动 {self.selected_version}"
            f"{self._launch_mode_note(profile_id, instance_id)}"
            + (f" · 联机 {connect_address}" if connect_address else "")
            + (f" · 存档 {quick_world}" if quick_world else "")
        )
        self.loading_overlay.show_loading(self.selected_version)
        worker.start()
        return self._launch_session_key

    def _on_launch_status(self, message: str) -> None:
        if self.launch_active:
            self.set_status(message, "busy")
            if hasattr(self, "loading_overlay"):
                self.loading_overlay.set_status(message)

    def _on_launch_ready(self, plan, account) -> None:
        if self.sender() is not self.launch_worker or not self.launch_active:
            return
        if self._launch_cancel_requested:
            self.launch_active = False
            self.launch_worker = None
            self._launch_cancel_requested = False
            close_plan = getattr(plan, "close", None)
            if callable(close_plan):
                close_plan()
            self.home_page.set_launching(False)
            self._update_action_button()
            self.loading_overlay.abort()
            self._restore_safe_mode_mods()
            self.set_status("已取消启动", "idle")
            self.log("已取消启动")
            self.toast("已取消启动", "info")
            return
        self.launch_active = False
        self.launch_worker = None
        self.loading_overlay.set_status("正在注入猫猫能量…")
        if account.is_littleskin:
            # 启动前刷新过的令牌与角色资料要同时写回游戏账户和皮肤账户。
            self.apply_littleskin_account(account)
        elif account.is_online:
            self.config.account = account.to_config()
            self.config.save()
            self.account_changed.emit()

        for warning in plan.warnings:
            self.log(warning)

        version = self._launch_version or self.selected_version
        profile_id = self._launch_profile_id or version
        instance_id = self._launch_instance_id or version
        key = self._launch_session_key or f"game-{self._session_seq}"
        self.config.last_version = version
        self.config.save()
        log_file, log_path = self._open_game_log(key)
        process = GameProcess(plan, self)
        self.game_sessions[key] = GameSession(
            key=key,
            version=version,
            profile_id=profile_id,
            instance_id=instance_id,
            process=process,
            log_file=log_file,
            log_path=log_path,
        )
        self._sync_game_state()
        self.home_page.set_game_running(True, len(self.game_sessions))
        self.set_status("正在启动游戏…", "busy")
        self._update_action_button()
        self.log(
            f"启动 {version}"
            f"{self._launch_mode_note(profile_id, instance_id)}"
            + f" · Java {plan.java.version or plan.java.major}"
            f" · 内存 {self.config.memory_mb} MB"
            + (f" · 联机 {self._launch_connect_address}" if self._launch_connect_address else "")
            + (f" · 存档 {self._launch_quick_world}" if self._launch_quick_world else "")
        )
        try:
            from ..config import append_log

            append_log("命令：" + redacted_command_line(plan.command))
        except Exception:
            pass

        process.started_ok.connect(
            lambda pid, k=key: self._game_started(k, pid)
        )
        process.output.connect(lambda line, k=key: self._game_output(k, line))
        process.game_finished.connect(
            lambda code, k=key: self._game_finished(k, code)
        )
        process.start()

    def _on_launch_missing(self, missing) -> None:
        self.launch_active = False
        self.launch_worker = None
        self.home_page.set_launching(False)
        self._update_action_button()
        self.loading_overlay.abort()
        self._restore_safe_mode_mods()
        exc = MissingFilesError(list(missing or []))
        self._handle_missing_files(
            exc,
            self._launch_auto_retry,
            self._launch_connect_address,
        )

    def _on_launch_failed(self, message: str) -> None:
        self.launch_active = False
        self.launch_worker = None
        self.home_page.set_launching(False)
        self._update_action_button()
        self.loading_overlay.abort()
        self._restore_safe_mode_mods()
        self._handle_launch_error(message)

    def _on_launch_cancelled(self) -> None:
        if self.sender() is not self.launch_worker or not self.launch_active:
            return
        self.launch_active = False
        self.launch_worker = None
        self._launch_cancel_requested = False
        self.home_page.set_launching(False)
        self._update_action_button()
        self.loading_overlay.abort()
        self._restore_safe_mode_mods()
        self.set_status("已取消启动", "idle")
        self.log("已取消启动")
        self.toast("已取消启动", "info")

    def cancel_launch(self) -> None:
        if not self.launch_active or not self.launch_worker:
            return
        if self._launch_cancel_requested:
            return
        self._launch_cancel_requested = True
        self.launch_worker.cancel()
        self.set_status("正在取消启动…", "busy")
        self.log("正在取消启动…")
        self.action_cancel_btn.setText("正在取消…")
        self.action_cancel_btn.setEnabled(False)

    def close_game(self) -> None:
        if self.launch_active:
            self.cancel_launch()
            return
        sessions = list(self.game_sessions.values())
        if not sessions:
            self.toast("游戏没有在运行", "info")
            return
        if any(item.closing for item in sessions):
            return
        multiple = len(sessions) > 1
        details = "\n".join(
            f"· {item.version}"
            + (f"（PID {item.pid}）" if item.pid else "（正在启动）")
            for item in sessions
        )
        dialog = ConfirmDialog(
            self,
            "关闭全部游戏" if multiple else "关闭游戏",
            "将请求游戏窗口正常关闭；如果游戏没有响应，会在等待后强制结束进程。",
            primary_text="全部关闭" if multiple else "关闭游戏",
            secondary_text="取消",
            icon_name="stop",
            icon_color=colors()["red"],
            details=f"正在运行 {len(sessions)} 个游戏：\n{details}",
        )
        if not dialog.exec():
            return
        self.home_page.set_game_closing()
        self.set_status(
            f"正在关闭 {len(sessions)} 个游戏…" if multiple else "正在关闭游戏…",
            "busy",
        )
        for session in sessions:
            session.closing = True
            if session.process is not None:
                session.process.stop(graceful=True)
        self._sync_game_state()
        self._update_action_button()

    def _handle_missing_files(
        self,
        exc: MissingFilesError,
        auto_retry: bool,
        connect_address: str = "",
    ) -> None:
        missing = exc.missing
        detail = "、".join(missing[:5])
        if len(missing) > 5:
            detail += f" 等 {len(missing)} 项"
        install_id = self._launch_profile_id or self.selected_version
        if self.config.auto_complete and auto_retry:
            self.toast("正在自动补全缺失文件，完成后启动", "info")
            self.begin_install(
                install_id,
                success_callback=lambda: self.launch_selected(
                    auto_retry=False, connect_address=connect_address
                ),
            )
            self.toggle_log_if_closed()
            return

        dialog = ConfirmDialog(
            self,
            "游戏文件不完整",
            "启动前需要补全以下文件，补全完成后可以继续启动。",
            primary_text="自动补全",
            secondary_text="取消",
            icon_name="download",
            icon_color=colors()["accent"],
            details=detail,
        )
        if dialog.exec():
            self.begin_install(
                self._launch_profile_id or self.selected_version,
                success_callback=lambda: self.launch_selected(
                    auto_retry=False, connect_address=connect_address
                ),
            )
            self.toggle_log_if_closed()

    def toggle_log_if_closed(self) -> None:
        if not (self.log_panel.isVisible() and self.log_panel.maximumHeight() > 0):
            self.log_panel.open_panel()
            self.log_btn.setText("收起日志")

    def _handle_launch_error(self, message: str) -> None:
        self.set_status(message, "error")
        self.toast(message, "error")
        if "Java" in message:
            dialog = NoticeDialog(
                self,
                "无法启动游戏",
                message,
                button_text="打开设置",
                icon_name="warning",
                secondary_text="取消",
            )
            if dialog.exec() and dialog.action_clicked:
                self.switch_page("settings")
        else:
            NoticeDialog(
                self, "无法启动游戏", message, button_text="知道了", icon_name="warning"
            ).exec()

    def _open_game_log(self, key: str = ""):
        """为本次游戏单独打开一份日志，返回（文件对象，路径）。"""
        try:
            LOG_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            stamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
            suffix = f"-{key}" if key else ""
            path = LOG_DIR / f"game-{stamp}{suffix}.log"
            handle = path.open("w", encoding="utf-8")
            self._current_game_log = str(path)
            return handle, str(path)
        except Exception:
            return None, ""

    def _game_started(self, key: str, pid: int) -> None:
        session = self.game_session(key)
        if session is None:
            return
        session.pid = pid
        session.started_at = time.monotonic()
        try:
            mark_repair_launched(self.config.mods_path(session.instance_id))
        except Exception:
            pass
        if hasattr(self, "mods_page"):
            self.mods_page.refresh_mods()
        self._sync_game_state()
        self.set_status(
            f"游戏运行中 · {session.version} · PID {pid}", "success"
        )
        self.toast(f"{session.version} 已启动", "success")
        self.game_state_changed.emit(True)
        self.home_page.set_game_running(True, len(self.game_sessions))
        self._update_action_button()
        self.loading_overlay.finish("世界已加载，去玩吧喵。", 700)
        self.log(f"游戏进程已启动（{session.version} · PID {pid}）")

    def _game_output(self, key: str, line: str) -> None:
        session = self.game_session(key)
        prefix = f"[{session.version}] " if session and len(self.game_sessions) > 1 else ""
        self.log_panel.append(prefix + line)
        if session is not None and session.log_file is not None:
            try:
                session.log_file.write(line + "\n")
                session.log_file.flush()
            except Exception:
                pass

    def _game_finished(self, key: str, code: int) -> None:
        session = self.game_sessions.pop(key, None)
        if session is None:
            return
        was_closing = session.closing
        runtime = 0.0
        if session.started_at > 0:
            runtime = max(0.0, time.monotonic() - session.started_at)
            try:
                mark_repair_finished(
                    self.config.mods_path(session.instance_id), code, runtime
                )
            except Exception:
                pass
        self._restore_safe_mode_mods()
        if session.log_file is not None:
            try:
                session.log_file.close()
            except Exception:
                pass
            session.log_file = None
        self._sync_game_state()
        if any(item.closing for item in self.game_sessions.values()):
            self.home_page.set_game_closing()
        else:
            self.home_page.set_game_running(
                self.game_running, len(self.game_sessions)
            )
        self.game_state_changed.emit(self.game_running)
        self._update_action_button()
        others = len(self.game_sessions)
        if was_closing:
            self.set_status(
                f"{session.version} 已关闭"
                + (f"，还有 {others} 个游戏在运行" if others else ""),
                "success",
            )
            self.log(f"{session.version} 已按请求关闭")
            self.toast(f"{session.version} 已关闭", "info")
        else:
            self.set_status(
                f"{session.version} 已退出（代码 {code}）"
                if code
                else f"{session.version} 已正常退出",
                "success" if code == 0 else "error",
            )
            self.log(
                f"{session.version} 游戏进程结束，退出代码 {code}"
                + (f"，仍有 {others} 个游戏在运行" if others else "")
            )
            if code == 0:
                self.toast(f"{session.version} 已退出", "info")
            else:
                self.toast(
                    f"{session.version} 异常退出（代码 {code}），请查看日志",
                    "error",
                )
                self.toggle_log_if_closed()
        if hasattr(self, "mods_page"):
            self.mods_page.refresh_mods()

        self.log.setPlaceholderText("迁移日志会显示在这里")
        self.log.setVisible(False)
        self.body.addWidget(self.log)

        note = QLabel(
            "Mod 会先通过 Modrinth 的 SHA-1 记录匹配目标加载器/MC 版本，"
            "匹配失败时按下方选项保留原文件或跳过。"
        )
        note.setObjectName("Tiny")
        note.setWordWrap(True)
        self.body.addWidget(note)

        self.close_btn = self.add_button("关闭", "Secondary", self.reject)
        self.start_btn = self.add_button("开始迁移", "Primary", self._start_or_finish)
        self.start_btn.setMinimumWidth(110)

        self._populate_sources(source_id)
        self._mode_changed(self.mode_tabs.current())
        self.mode_tabs.changed.connect(self._mode_changed)
        self.source_combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(lambda _: self._source_changed())
        self.target_combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(lambda _: self._refresh_preview())
        self.loader_tabs.changed.connect(lambda _: self._reload_loader_versions())
        self.loader_version_combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(
            lambda _: self._update_info()
        )
        for box in self.category_boxes.values():
            box.toggled.connect(lambda _: self._refresh_preview())
        main.java_installs_changed.connect(lambda _: self._update_info())
        main.ensure_java_detected()
        self._refresh_preview()
        self._update_action()
        self.adjustSize()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

        self.loader_info.setObjectName("Tiny")
        self.loader_info.setWordWrap(True)
        loader.addWidget(self.loader_info)

        self.empty_label = QLabel("")

    def _build_categories(self) -> QWidget:
        card = Card()
        layout = QVBoxLayout(card)
        layout.setContentsMargins(14, 12, 14, 12)
        layout.setSpacing(7)
        title = QLabel("要迁移的内容")

        grid = QGridLayout()

        grid.setVerticalSpacing(4)

        for index, key in enumerate(CATEGORY_ORDER):
            box = QCheckBox(CATEGORY_HINTS[key])
            box.setChecked(key in DEFAULT_CATEGORIES)

        layout.addLayout(grid)
        tip = QLabel("“选项”包含 options.txt、optionsof.txt 和 servers.dat。")
        tip.setObjectName("Tiny")

    def _build_options(self) -> QWidget:
        card = Card()
        layout = QVBoxLayout(card)
        layout.setContentsMargins(14, 11, 14, 11)
        layout.setSpacing(5)
        self.match_mods_box = QCheckBox("通过 Modrinth 匹配目标加载器/MC 版本的 Mod")
        self.match_mods_box.setChecked(True)
        self.copy_unmatched_box = QCheckBox("匹配失败时保留原 Mod 文件（可能不兼容）")
        self.copy_unmatched_box.setChecked(True)
        self.overwrite_box = QCheckBox("覆盖目标版本中的同名文件")
        self.overwrite_box.setChecked(False)
        layout.addWidget(self.match_mods_box)
        layout.addWidget(self.copy_unmatched_box)
        layout.addWidget(self.overwrite_box)
        self.match_mods_box.toggled.connect(self._update_option_state)
        return card

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _populate_sources(self, preferred: str) -> None:
        self.source_combo.blockSignals(True)
        for summary in self.main.versions:
            if summary.error:
                continue
            label = summary.id
            if summary.loader:
                label += f" · {summary.loader}"
            elif summary.type_name:
                label += f" · {summary.type_name}"
            self.source_combo.addItem(label, summary.id)
        if not self.source_combo.count():
            self.source_combo.addItem("没有可迁移的版本", "")
        index = self.source_combo.findData(preferred)
        if index < 0:
            index = self.source_combo.findData(self.main.selected_version)
        if index < 0:
            index = 0
        self.source_combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
        self.source_combo.blockSignals(False)
        self._populate_targets()
        if not self.main.versions:
            self.empty_label.setText(
                "还没有安装版本。先到“下载”页面安装游戏，再回来迁移。"
            )
            self.empty_label.setVisible(True)
            self.start_btn.setEnabled(False)

    def _populate_targets(self) -> None:
        source = self.source_combo.currentData()
        self.target_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self.target_combo.clear()
        candidates = [
            v for v in self.main.versions if not v.error and v.id != source
        ]
        for summary in candidates:
            label = summary.id
            if summary.loader:
                label += f" · {summary.loader}"
            elif summary.type_name:
                label += f" · {summary.type_name}"
            if summary.id == self.main.selected_version:
                label += "  ·  当前选中"
            self.target_combo.addItem(label, summary.id)
        if not candidates:
            self.target_combo.addItem("没有其他已安装版本", "")
        self.target_combo.blockSignals(False)
        self.existing_hint.setText(
            "目标版本必须已经安装。若想安装新的加载器版本，请切换到“升级加载器”。"
        )
        if not candidates:
            self.existing_hint.setText(
                "至少需要两个已安装版本才能迁移到已有版本；"
                "也可以切换到“升级加载器”，为同一个 MC 版本安装新的加载器。"
            )

    def _source_changed(self) -> None:
        self._populate_targets()
        self._refresh_preview()
        self._reload_loader_versions()
        self._update_info()

    def _mode_changed(self, mode: str) -> None:
        loader_mode = mode == "loader"
        self.existing_box.setVisible(not loader_mode)
        self.loader_box.setVisible(loader_mode)
        self.start_btn.setText("安装并迁移" if loader_mode else "开始迁移")
        if loader_mode:
            self._reload_loader_versions()
        self._refresh_preview()
        self._update_info()
        self._update_action()
        self.adjustSize()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _source_mc(self) -> str:
        source_id = str(self.source_combo.currentData() or "")
        if not source_id:
            return ""
        try:
            resolved = resolve_version(self.main.config.game_path, source_id)
            return str(resolved.chain[0] if resolved.chain else resolved.id)
        except Exception:
            return source_id

    def _source_summary(self):
        return self._summaries.get(str(self.source_combo.currentData() or ""))

    def _chosen_java(self):
        summary = self._source_summary()
        required = max(8, summary.java_major if summary else 8)
        java = pick_java(
            self.main.java_installs, required, self.main.config.java_path
        )
        if java and java.major and java.major < required:
            return None, required, java
        return java, required, None

    def _reload_loader_versions(self) -> None:
        if self._busy or self.mode_tabs.current() != "loader":
            return
        kind = self.loader_tabs.current()
        mc_version = self._source_mc()
        self._loader_error = ""
        self.loader_version_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self.loader_version_combo.clear()
        self.loader_version_combo.blockSignals(False)
        if not mc_version:
            self._loader_error = "请先选择源版本。"
            self.loader_version_combo.addItem("请先选择源版本", "")
            self._update_action()
            return
        self.loader_version_combo.addItem("正在获取版本列表…", "")
        worker = LoaderVersionsWorker(kind, mc_version, self)
        self._versions_worker = worker
        worker.ready.connect(
            lambda data, error, w=worker: self._loader_versions_ready(
                w, data, error
            )
        )
        worker.start()
        self._update_action()

    def _loader_versions_ready(self, worker, data, error: str) -> None:
        if worker is not self._versions_worker:
            return
        self.loader_version_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self.loader_version_combo.clear()
        if error:
            self._loader_error = (
                f"获取 {LOADER_NAMES.get(worker.kind, '')} 版本失败：{error}"
            )
            self.loader_version_combo.addItem("获取失败", "")
            self.loader_version_combo.blockSignals(False)
            self._update_info()
            return
        if not data:
            self._loader_error = (
                f"{LOADER_NAMES.get(worker.kind, '')} 目前没有适配 "
                f"{worker.mc_version} 的版本。"
            )
            self.loader_version_combo.addItem("没有可用版本", "")
            self.loader_version_combo.blockSignals(False)
            self._update_info()
            return
        self._loader_error = ""
        first_stable = next(
            (i for i, item in enumerate(data) if item.get("stable")), -1
        )
        for index, item in enumerate(data):
            version = str(item.get("version") or "")
            suffix = ""
            if index == first_stable:
                suffix = "  ·  推荐"
            elif first_stable < 0 and index == 0:
                suffix = "  ·  最新"
            self.loader_version_combo.addItem(version + suffix, version)
        self.loader_version_combo.setCurrentIndex(
            first_stable if first_stable >= 0 else 0
        )
        self.loader_version_combo.blockSignals(False)
        self._update_info()

    def _update_info(self) -> None:
        if self.mode_tabs.current() != "loader":
            self._update_action()
            return
        if self._loader_error:
            self.loader_info.setText(self._loader_error)
            self._update_action()
            return
        kind = self.loader_tabs.current()
        version = str(self.loader_version_combo.currentData() or "")
        mc_version = self._source_mc()
        parts = []
        if version and mc_version:
            parts.append(
                f"将在 MC {mc_version} 上安装 "
                f"{LOADER_NAMES.get(kind, kind)} {version}，安装完成后自动迁移。"
            )
        if kind in ("forge", "neoforge"):
            java, required, fallback = self._chosen_java()
            if java:
                parts.append(
                    f"将使用 Java {java.major or '?'}（{java.path}）运行安装器。"
                )
            elif fallback:
                parts.append(
                    f"需要 Java {required}+，当前只有 Java "
                    f"{fallback.major or '?'}，请先在设置中指定 Java。"
                )
            else:
                parts.append(
                    f"未检测到 Java，安装 {LOADER_NAMES[kind]} 需要 Java {required}+。"
                )
        self.loader_info.setText("\n".join(parts))
        self._update_action()

    def _selected_categories(self) -> list[str]:
        return [
            key for key in CATEGORY_ORDER
            if key in self.category_boxes and self.category_boxes[key].isChecked()
        ]

    def _refresh_preview(self) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            return
        source_id = str(self.source_combo.currentData() or "")
        if not source_id:
            self.preview.setText("没有可迁移的源版本。")
            self._update_action()
            return
        categories = self._selected_categories()
        if not categories:
            self.preview.setText("还没有勾选任何内容。")
            self._plan = None
            self._update_action()
            return
        loader_mode = self.mode_tabs.current() == "loader"
        target_id = "" if loader_mode else str(self.target_combo.currentData() or "")
        try:
            plan = collect_migration_plan(
                self.main.config.game_path,
                source_id,
                target_id,
                categories,
                isolated=bool(self.main.config.version_isolation),
            )
        except MigrationError as exc:
            self.preview.setText(str(exc))
            self._plan = None
            self._update_action()
            return
        except Exception as exc:
            self.preview.setText(f"无法读取迁移内容：{exc}")
            self._plan = None
            self._update_action()
            return
        self._plan = plan
        counts = "、".join(
            f"{CATEGORY_NAMES.get(key, key)} {count}"
            for key, count in plan.file_counts.items()
            if count
        )
        lines = [
            f"源：{plan.source_id}（MC {plan.source_mc}"
            + (f" · {plan.source_loader}" if plan.source_loader else "")
            + "）"
        ]
        if target_id:
            lines.append(
                f"目标：{plan.target_id}（MC {plan.target_mc}"
                + (f" · {plan.target_loader}" if plan.target_loader else "")
                + "）"
            )
        elif loader_mode:
            lines.append("目标：安装新加载器后创建的版本")
        lines.append(
            f"共 {plan.total_files} 个文件 · "
            f"{plan.total_bytes / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB"
            + (f" · {counts}" if counts else " · 没有找到内容")
        )
        if plan.same_dir:
            lines.append("源与目标共用同一个游戏目录，只会重新匹配 Mod，不复制其他内容。")
        elif plan.conflicts:
            lines.append(
                f"目标已有 {plan.conflicts} 个同名文件，默认跳过；"
                "需要替换时勾选“覆盖同名文件”。"
            )
        self.preview.setText("\n".join(lines))
        self._update_action()

    def _update_option_state(self) -> None:
        self.copy_unmatched_box.setEnabled(
            self.match_mods_box.isChecked() and not self._busy
        )

    def _update_action(self) -> None:
        if self._busy or self._finished_ok:
            return
        enabled = bool(self.source_combo.currentData())
        enabled = enabled and bool(self._selected_categories())
        if self.mode_tabs.current() == "loader":
            enabled = enabled and bool(self.loader_version_combo.currentData())
            if self.loader_tabs.current() in ("forge", "neoforge"):
                java, _required, _fallback = self._chosen_java()
                enabled = enabled and java is not None
        else:
            enabled = enabled and bool(self.target_combo.currentData())
        self.start_btn.setEnabled(enabled)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _start_or_finish(self) -> None:
        if self._finished_ok:
            self.accept()
            return
        if self._busy:
            self._cancel()
            return
        if not self._selected_categories():
            self.main.toast("至少勾选一类要迁移的内容", "info")
            return
        source_id = str(self.source_combo.currentData() or "")
        if not source_id:
            self.main.toast("请选择源版本", "info")
            return

        loader_mode = self.mode_tabs.current() == "loader"
        loader_kind = ""
        loader_version = ""
        java_path = ""
        target_id = ""
        if loader_mode:
            loader_kind = self.loader_tabs.current()
            loader_version = str(self.loader_version_combo.currentData() or "")
            if not loader_version:
                self.main.toast("请选择加载器版本", "info")
                return
            if loader_kind in ("forge", "neoforge"):
                java, _required, _fallback = self._chosen_java()
                if not java:
                    self.main.toast("未找到满足要求的 Java，请先在设置中指定", "error")
                    return
                java_path = java.path
        else:
            target_id = str(self.target_combo.currentData() or "")
            if not target_id:
                self.main.toast("请选择目标版本", "info")
                return

        self._busy = True
        self._finished_ok = False
        self._set_busy(True)
        self.progress.setValue(0)
        self.progress_text.setText("准备迁移…")
        self.progress_box.setVisible(True)
        self.log.clear()
        self.log.setVisible(True)
        self.start_btn.setText("取消迁移")
        self.close_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.adjustSize()

        worker = MigrationWorker(
            self.main.config.game_path,
            source_id,
            target_id,
            self._selected_categories(),
            match_mods=self.match_mods_box.isChecked(),
            copy_unmatched=self.copy_unmatched_box.isEnabled()
            and self.copy_unmatched_box.isChecked(),
            overwrite=self.overwrite_box.isChecked(),
            isolated=bool(self.main.config.version_isolation),
            loader_kind=loader_kind,
            loader_version=loader_version,
            java_path=java_path,
            source=self.main.config.download_source,
            threads=self.main.config.download_threads,
            parent=self,
        )
        self._worker = worker
        worker.progress.connect(self._on_progress)
        worker.log_line.connect(self._append_log)
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_finished)
        worker.start()

    def _cancel(self) -> None:
        if self._worker:
            self.progress_text.setText("正在取消…")
            self.start_btn.setEnabled(False)
            self._worker.cancel()

    def _set_busy(self, busy: bool) -> None:
        self.mode_tabs.setEnabled(not busy)
        self.source_combo.setEnabled(not busy and self.source_combo.count() > 0)
        self.target_combo.setEnabled(not busy)
        self.loader_tabs.setEnabled(not busy)
        self.loader_version_combo.setEnabled(not busy)
        for box in self.category_boxes.values():
            box.setEnabled(not busy)
        self.match_mods_box.setEnabled(not busy)
        self.copy_unmatched_box.setEnabled(
            not busy and self.match_mods_box.isChecked()
        )
        self.overwrite_box.setEnabled(not busy)
        self.close_btn.setEnabled(not busy)
        self.start_btn.setText("取消迁移" if busy else "开始迁移")
        if not busy and not self._finished_ok:
            self._update_action()

    def _on_progress(self, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        self.progress.setValue(max(0, min(100, percent)))
        self.progress_text.setText(message)

    def _append_log(self, line: str) -> None:
        self.log.appendPlainText(line)
        bar = self.log.verticalScrollBar()
        bar.setValue(bar.maximum())

    def _on_finished(self, success: bool, message: str, version_id: str) -> None:
        self._busy = False
        self._worker = None
        self._set_busy(False)
        self.close_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.start_btn.setEnabled(True)
        if success:
            self._finished_ok = True
            self._finished_target = version_id
            self.progress.setValue(100)
            self.progress_text.setText("迁移完成")
            self.start_btn.setText("完成")
            if version_id:
                self.main.config.last_version = version_id
                self.main.config.save()
                self.main.refresh_versions()
                self.main.select_version(version_id)
            self.main.set_status("版本迁移完成", "success")
            self.main.toast(message or "迁移完成", "success")
            self._append_log("迁移完成：" + message)
            self._set_busy(False)
            self.start_btn.setText("完成")
            self.start_btn.setEnabled(True)
        else:
            self.progress_text.setText(message)
            self.start_btn.setText("安装并迁移" if self.mode_tabs.current() == "loader" else "开始迁移")
            self.main.toast(f"迁移失败：{message}", "error")
            self._append_log("迁移失败：" + message)
            self._update_action()

    def reject(self) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            self._cancel()
            return
        super().reject()

        self.status_label.setWordWrap(True)
        self.body.addWidget(self.status_label)

        self.folder_btn = self.add_button("打开文件夹", "Ghost", self._open_folder)
        self.launch_btn = self.add_button("启动模组工坊", "Secondary", self._launch)
        self.action_btn = self.add_button("检查中…", "Primary", self._primary)
        self.action_btn.setEnabled(False)

        self.main.download_center.task_progress.connect(self._on_task_progress)
        self.main.download_center.task_finished.connect(self._on_task_finished)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _load_manifest(self) -> None:
        url = str(self.main.config.update_url or DEFAULT_UPDATE_URL)
        self._manifest_worker = ModAgentManifestWorker(url, self.main)
        self._manifest_worker.ready.connect(self._on_manifest)
        self._manifest_worker.start()

    def _on_manifest(self, release, error: str) -> None:
        self._manifest_worker = None
        if error:
            self.status_label.setText(f"读取模组工坊清单失败：{error}")
            if self._release is None and self._task_id is None:
                self.action_btn.setText("重新检查")
                self.action_btn.setEnabled(True)
            return
        if release is None:
            self.status_label.setText("发布清单里还没有模组工坊信息。")
            if self._release is None and self._task_id is None:
                self.action_btn.setText("重新检查")
                self.action_btn.setEnabled(True)
            return
        self._release = release
        self._refresh_state()

    def _restore_task(self) -> None:
        for task in self.main.download_center.active_tasks():
            if str(task.content_type) != "mod-agent":
                continue
            self._task_id = task.id
            self.progress.show()
            self.progress.setValue(task.progress)
            self.status_label.setText(task.message)
            self.action_btn.setText("取消下载")
            self.action_btn.setEnabled(True)
            return

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _refresh_state(self) -> None:
        installed = mod_agent.is_installed()
        local_version = mod_agent.installed_version()
        release = self._release
        root = mod_agent.mod_agent_root()

        if installed:
            local_text = f"v{local_version}" if local_version else "已安装"
            self.version_badge.setText(local_text)
            self.version_badge.setProperty("badge", "green")
            repolish(self.version_badge)
            self.path_value.setText(str(mod_agent.mod_agent_app_dir()))
            self.folder_btn.setEnabled(True)
            self.launch_btn.setEnabled(True)
        else:
            self.version_badge.setText("未安装")
            self.version_badge.setProperty("badge", "gray")
            repolish(self.version_badge)
            self.path_value.setText(str(mod_agent.mod_agent_app_dir(root)))
            self.folder_btn.setEnabled(False)
            self.launch_btn.setEnabled(False)

        if release is not None:
            self.size_value.setText(
                format_size(release.size) if release.size else "未知"
            )
            self.release_value.setText(release.released or release.version)
            if release.notes:
                self.notes_label.setText(
                    "\n".join(f"· {item}" for item in release.notes[:4])
                )
                self.notes_label.show()
            if self._task_id is None:
                if not installed:
                    self.action_btn.setText("下载模组工坊")
                elif release.version and mod_agent.is_newer(release.version, local_version):
                    self.action_btn.setText(f"更新到 v{release.version}")
                else:
                    self.action_btn.setText("重新下载")
                self.action_btn.setEnabled(True)
            if installed and not self.status_label.text():
                self.status_label.setText(
                    "模组工坊已安装。API Key 只保存在它自己的设置页，启动器不读取。"
                )
        else:
            self.size_value.setText("—")
            self.release_value.setText("—")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _primary(self) -> None:
        if self._task_id is not None:
            self.main.download_center.cancel(self._task_id)
            self.action_btn.setEnabled(False)
            self.action_btn.setText("正在取消…")
            return
        if self._release is None:
            self.action_btn.setEnabled(False)
            self.action_btn.setText("检查中…")
            self._load_manifest()
            return
        self._start_download(self._release)

    def _start_download(self, release: mod_agent.ModAgentRelease) -> None:
        worker = ModAgentDownloadWorker(
            release,
            threads=int(self.main.config.download_threads or 4),
            parent=self.main,
        )
        task = self.main.download_center.start_worker(
            worker,
            title=f"模组工坊 {release.version}",
            content_type="mod-agent",
            target=mod_agent.mod_agent_root(),
            source="github-pages",
            metadata={"mod_agent_version": release.version},
        )
        self._task_id = task.id
        self.progress.setValue(1)
        self.progress.show()
        self.status_label.setText("正在下载模组工坊…")
        self.action_btn.setText("取消下载")
        self.action_btn.setEnabled(True)

    def _on_task_progress(self, task_id: int, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        if task_id != self._task_id:
            return
        self.progress.show()
        self.progress.setValue(max(0, min(100, int(percent))))
        self.status_label.setText(message)

    def _on_task_finished(self, task) -> None:
        if task.id != self._task_id:
            return
        self._task_id = None
        self.progress.hide()
        if task.status == TASK_SUCCESS:
            version = self._release.version if self._release else ""
            self.status_label.setText(task.message or "模组工坊已安装")
            self.main.toast(f"模组工坊 {version} 安装完成", "success")
        else:
            self.status_label.setText(task.message or "模组工坊下载失败")
            self.main.toast(task.message or "模组工坊下载失败", "error")
        self._refresh_state()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _open_folder(self) -> None:
        try:
            mod_agent.open_mod_agent_folder()
        except Exception as exc:
            self.main.toast(str(exc), "error")

    def _launch(self) -> None:
        try:
            mod_agent.launch_mod_agent()
        except Exception as exc:
            self.main.toast(str(exc), "error")
        else:
            self.main.toast("模组工坊已启动", "success")

def forum_search_url(query: str = "") -> str:
    text = (query or "").strip()
    if not text:
        return FORUM_HOME
    return (
        "https://klpbbs.com/search.php?mod=forum&srchtxt="
        + urllib.parse.quote(text)
    )


def _human_number(value) -> str:
    try:
        number = int(value)
    except Exception:
        return "0"
    if number >= 1_000_000:
        return f"{number / 1_000_000:.1f}M"
    if number >= 1_000:
        return f"{number / 1_000:.1f}K"
    return str(number)


def _short(text: str, length: int) -> str:
    text = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
    return text if len(text) <= length else text[: length - 1] + "…"


def _plain_excerpt(body: str, limit: int = 360) -> str:
    text = str(body or "")
    if not text:
        return ""
    text = re.sub(r"!\[[^\]]*\]\([^)]*\)", "", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]*\)", r"\1", text)
    text = re.sub(r"```.*?```", " ", text, flags=re.S)
    text = re.sub(r"`([^`]*)`", r"\1", text)
    text = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"[#>*_~|]+", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"^\s*[-+]\s+", "", text, flags=re.M)
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    return _short(text, limit)


def _cover_pixmap(image: QImage, size: int, radius: int = 9) -> QPixmap:
    canvas = QImage(size, size, QImage.Format_ARGB32)
    canvas.fill(Qt.transparent)
    painter = QPainter(canvas)
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing, True)
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.SmoothPixmapTransform, True)
    path = QPainterPath()
    path.addRoundedRect(0.5, 0.5, size - 1, size - 1, radius, radius)
    painter.setClipPath(path)
    if not image.isNull():
        scaled = image.scaled(
            size,
            size,
            Qt.KeepAspectRatioByExpanding,
            Qt.SmoothTransformation,
        )
        x = (size - scaled.width()) // 2
        y = (size - scaled.height()) // 2
        painter.drawImage(x, y, scaled)
    painter.end()
    return QPixmap.fromImage(canvas)


def _cache_image(url: str, image: QImage) -> None:
    if not url or image.isNull():
        return
    _IMAGE_CACHE[url] = image
    while len(_IMAGE_CACHE) > _MAX_CACHE:
        _IMAGE_CACHE.pop(next(iter(_IMAGE_CACHE)))


class _ElidedLabel(QLabel):
    """按可用宽度省略文本，避免固定宽度列表里出现硬裁切。"""

    def __init__(self, text: str = "", parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._full_text = ""
        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Ignored, QSizePolicy.Preferred)
        self.setText(text)

    def setText(self, text: str) -> None:
        self._full_text = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
        if self._full_text:
            self.setToolTip(self._full_text)
        else:
            self.setToolTip("")
        self._refresh()

    def full_text(self) -> str:
        return self._full_text

    def resizeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        self._refresh()

    def _refresh(self) -> None:
        width = self.contentsRect().width()
        if width <= 0:
            return
        elided = self.fontMetrics().elidedText(
            self._full_text, Qt.ElideRight, width
        )
        if QLabel.text(self) != elided:
            QLabel.setText(self, elided)


class GalleryPreview(QLabel):
    clicked = Signal()

    def __init__(self, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setFixedHeight(150)
        self.setMinimumWidth(220)
        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Fixed)
        self.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self._image = QImage()
        self._message = "该项目暂未提供预览图"
        self._hover = False

    def set_image(self, image: QImage) -> None:
        self._image = image
        self.update()

    def set_message(self, message: str) -> None:
        self._image = QImage()
        self._message = message
        self.update()

    def enterEvent(self, event) -> None:
        self._hover = True
        self.update()
        super().enterEvent(event)

    def leaveEvent(self, event) -> None:
        self._hover = False
        self.update()
        super().leaveEvent(event)

    def paintEvent(self, event) -> None:
        painter = QPainter(self)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing, True)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.SmoothPixmapTransform, True)
        rect = QRectF(0.5, 0.5, self.width() - 1, self.height() - 1)
        path = QPainterPath()
        path.addRoundedRect(rect, 9, 9)
        painter.setClipPath(path)
        painter.fillRect(rect, QColor("#101722"))
        if self._image.isNull():
            painter.setPen(QColor("#93A4BD"))
            painter.drawText(rect, Qt.AlignCenter, self._message)
        else:
            scaled = self._image.scaled(
                self.width(),
                self.height(),
                Qt.KeepAspectRatio,
                Qt.SmoothTransformation,
            )
            x = (self.width() - scaled.width()) // 2
            y = (self.height() - scaled.height()) // 2
            painter.drawImage(x, y, scaled)
            if self._hover:
                painter.fillRect(rect, QColor(255, 255, 255, 10))
        painter.end()

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, event) -> None:
        if event.button() == Qt.LeftButton:
            self.clicked.emit()
        super().mouseReleaseEvent(event)

        self.body.setSpacing(8)
        self._initial = dict(initial or {})
        self._search_worker: ModSearchWorker | None = None
        self._project_worker: ModProjectWorker | None = None
        self._versions_worker: ModVersionsWorker | None = None
        self._download_task: DownloadTask | None = None
        self._download_bound = False
        self._image_workers: dict[str, ImageFetchWorker] = {}
        self._image_waiters: dict[str, list] = {}
        self._hits: list[dict] = []
        self._rows: list[ModResultRow] = []
        self._page = 0
        self._page_size = PAGE_SIZE
        self._total = 0
        self._polling = False
        self._source = "modrinth"
        self._content_type = "mod"
        self._pack_download_dir: Path | None = None
        self._selected_project = ""
        self._project: dict | None = None
        self._hit: dict | None = None
        self._target_version_id = ""
        self._target_mode = "installed"
        self._custom_target_dir: Path | None = None
        self._gallery: list[dict] = []
        self._gallery_index = 0
        self._gallery_url = ""
        self._gallery_caption = ""
        self._dep_projects_worker: ModProjectsWorker | None = None
        self._dep_projects: dict[str, dict] = {}
        self._dep_projects_pending: set[str] = set()
        self._nav_stack: list[tuple[str, dict, str]] = []
        self._pending_project_id = ""
        self._pending_version_id = ""

        self._build_context()
        self._build_search()
        self._build_split()
        self._build_footer()
        self._apply_adaptive_height()

        self._reload_bases()
        self.mc_combo.activated.connect(lambda _: self._on_context_changed())
        self.mc_combo.lineEdit().editingFinished.connect(self._on_context_changed)
        self.loader_tabs.changed.connect(lambda _: self._on_context_changed())
        self._apply_content_mode()
        if self._initial:
            self.title_label.setText("内容详情")
            QTimer.singleShot(0, self._open_initial_project)
        else:
            QTimer.singleShot(0, lambda: self._search(0))

    def _open_initial_project(self) -> None:
        hit = dict(self._initial)
        if str(hit.get("source") or "") == "curseforge":
            self._source = "curseforge"
            self.source_tabs.set_value("curseforge")
        project_id = str(hit.get("project_id") or hit.get("id") or "")
        if not project_id:
            return
        self._select_project(project_id, hit)

    def keyPressEvent(self, event) -> None:
        # 在搜索框里按回车只触发搜索，不要被对话框当成“确定”直接关掉。
        if event.key() in (Qt.Key_Return, Qt.Key_Enter) and isinstance(
            self.focusWidget(), (QLineEdit, QComboBox)
        ):
            event.accept()
            return
        super().keyPressEvent(event)

    def _downloading(self) -> bool:
        return self._download_task is not None and self._download_task.running

    def reject(self) -> None:
        task = self._download_task
        self._detach_download_ui()
        if task is not None and task.running:
            self.main.toast(
                "下载已转到顶栏，可以继续操作启动器；点击顶栏进度可查看任务",
                "info",
            )
        super().reject()

    def _detach_download_ui(self) -> None:
        if self._download_bound:
            try:
                self.main.download_center.task_progress.disconnect(
                    self._on_download_progress
                )
                self.main.download_center.task_finished.disconnect(
                    self._on_download_finished
                )
            except (RuntimeError, TypeError):
                pass
            self._download_bound = False
        self._download_task = None

    def _source_name(self) -> str:
        return "CurseForge" if self._source == "curseforge" else "Modrinth"

    def _content_label(self) -> str:
        return CONTENT_LABELS.get(self._content_type, "Mod")

    def _update_search_placeholder(self) -> None:
        label = self._content_label()
        source = self._source_name()
        if self._content_type == "modpack":
            self.search.setPlaceholderText(
                f"搜索 {source} 整合包名称或关键词，留空则浏览热门整合包…"
            )
        else:
            self.search.setPlaceholderText(
                f"搜索 {source} {label}名称、作者或关键词，留空则浏览热门{label}…"
            )

    def _set_content_type(self, content_type: str) -> None:
        kind = str(content_type or "mod").lower()
        if kind not in CONTENT_LABELS:
            kind = "mod"
        self.type_tabs.set_value(kind)
        if kind == self._content_type:
            return
        self._content_type = kind
        self.title_label.setText(f"下载 {CONTENT_LABELS[kind]}")
        self._apply_content_mode()
        self._reset_results()
        self._search(0)

    def _apply_content_mode(self) -> None:
        is_mod = self._content_type == "mod"
        self._loader_label.setVisible(is_mod)
        self.loader_tabs.setVisible(is_mod)
        self.loader_btn.setVisible(is_mod)
        self._update_search_placeholder()
        if self._content_type == "modpack":
            self._folder_btn.setText("打开整合包缓存")
        else:
            self._folder_btn.setText(
                f"打开 {CONTENT_FOLDERS.get(self._content_type, 'mods')} 文件夹"
            )
        if not self._downloading():
            self.download_btn.setText(self._download_button_text())
        self._sync_download_button()
        self._update_context()

    def _reset_results(self) -> None:
        self._page = 0
        self._selected_project = ""
        self._project = None
        self._hit = None
        self._hits = []
        self._total = 0
        self._nav_stack.clear()
        self._dep_projects.clear()
        self._dep_projects_pending.clear()
        self.dep_bar.clear()
        self._render_results(loading=True)
        self._clear_detail()

    def _set_source(self, source: str) -> None:
        source = "curseforge" if source == "curseforge" else "modrinth"
        self.source_tabs.set_value(source)
        if source == self._source:
            return
        self._source = source
        self._update_search_placeholder()
        if source == "curseforge":
            self.source_note.setText(
                "CurseForge 数据与文件镜像由 MCIM 提供；"
                "若作者关闭第三方下载，会在详情里给出 CurseForge 页面。"
            )
            self.source_note.setVisible(True)
        else:
            self.source_note.setVisible(False)
            self.source_note.setText("")
        self._reset_results()
        self._search(0)
