class ChatWorker(QThread):
    ok = Signal(str)
    fail = Signal(str)

    def __init__(
        self,
        config: oc.OCConfig,
        messages: list[dict[str, str]],
        parent: QObject | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._config = config
        self._messages = messages

    def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            text = oc.chat(self._config, self._messages)
        except oc.OCError as error:
            self.fail.emit(str(error))
        except Exception as error:  # 网络栈的异常类型很杂，界面只需要一句话
            self.fail.emit(f"请求失败：{error}")
        else:
            self.ok.emit(text)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 本地战果回调


class ResultServer(QObject):
    """只监听 127.0.0.1，只接受 /result，并且必须带对 token。"""

    result = Signal(dict)

    def __init__(self, parent: QObject | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._server = QTcpServer(self)
        self._server.newConnection.connect(self._accept)
        self._token = secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
        self._buffers: dict[QTcpSocket, bytearray] = {}
        self._done = False

    @property
    def token(self) -> str:
        return self._token

    @property
    def port(self) -> int:
        return self._server.serverPort()

    def start(self) -> bool:
        return self._server.listen(QHostAddress(QHostAddress.LocalHost), 0)

    def stop(self) -> None:
        self._done = True
        if self._server.isListening():
            self._server.close()
        for socket in list(self._buffers):
            try:
                socket.abort()
                socket.deleteLater()
            except RuntimeError:
                pass
        self._buffers.clear()

    def _accept(self) -> None:
        while self._server.hasPendingConnections():
            socket = self._server.nextPendingConnection()
            if socket is None:
                continue
            self._buffers[socket] = bytearray()
            socket.readyRead.connect(lambda s=socket: self._read(s))
            socket.disconnected.connect(lambda s=socket: self._drop(s))

    def _drop(self, socket: QTcpSocket) -> None:
        self._buffers.pop(socket, None)
        try:
            socket.deleteLater()
        except RuntimeError:
            pass

    def _read(self, socket: QTcpSocket) -> None:
        if self._done:
            return
        try:
            chunk = bytes(socket.readAll())
        except RuntimeError:
            return
        buffer = self._buffers.get(socket)
        if buffer is None:
            return
        buffer.extend(chunk)
        if len(buffer) > 16384:
            self._respond(socket, 413, "Payload Too Large")
            return
        if b"\r\n\r\n" not in buffer:
            return

        head = bytes(buffer).split(b"\r\n\r\n", 1)[0]
        request_line = head.split(b"\r\n", 1)[0].decode("latin-1", "replace")
        parts = request_line.split(" ")
        if len(parts) < 2:
            self._respond(socket, 400, "Bad Request")
            return
        target = parts[1]
        parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(target)
        if parsed.path != "/result":
            self._respond(socket, 404, "Not Found")
            return
        query = urllib.parse.parse_qs(parsed.query)
        token = (query.get("token") or [""])[0]
        if not token or not secrets.compare_digest(token, self._token):
            self._respond(socket, 403, "Forbidden")
            return

        payload = {
            key: (query.get(key) or [""])[0]
            for key in ("route", "diff", "turns", "damage", "hits")
        }
        self._respond(socket, 204, "No Content")
        self._done = True
        self.result.emit(payload)

    def _respond(self, socket: QTcpSocket, code: int, reason: str) -> None:
        head = (
            f"HTTP/1.1 {code} {reason}\r\n"
            "Content-Length: 0\r\n"
            "Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *\r\n"
            "Connection: close\r\n\r\n"
        ).encode("latin-1")
        try:
            socket.write(head)
            socket.flush()
            socket.disconnectFromHost()
        except RuntimeError:
            pass


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 小工具


def _set_badge(label: QLabel, text: str, kind: str) -> None:
    label.setText(text)
    label.setProperty("badge", kind)
    repolish(label)


def _browser_candidates() -> list[str]:
    found: list[str] = []
    override = os.environ.get("DARKITTEN_BROWSER", "").strip()
    if override:
        found.append(override)
    for name in ("msedge", "chrome", "google-chrome", "chromium"):
        path = shutil.which(name)
        if path:
            found.append(path)
    roots = [
        os.environ.get("ProgramFiles", ""),
        os.environ.get("ProgramFiles(x86)", ""),
        os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA", ""),
    ]
    for root in roots:
        if not root:
            continue
        found.append(str(Path(root) / "Microsoft" / "Edge" / "Application" / "msedge.exe"))
        found.append(str(Path(root) / "Google" / "Chrome" / "Application" / "chrome.exe"))
    unique: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for item in found:
        key = os.path.normcase(item)
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        if os.path.isfile(item):
            unique.append(item)
    return unique


def _launch_browser(url: str) -> bool:
    try:
        PROFILE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    except OSError:
        pass
    flags = 0
    if os.name == "nt":
        flags = getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0)
    for exe in _browser_candidates():
        try:
            subprocess.Popen(
                [
                    exe,
                    f"--app={url}",
                    "--window-size=1280,1000",
                    f"--user-data-dir={PROFILE_DIR}",
                    "--no-first-run",
                    "--no-default-browser-check",
                ],
                close_fds=True,
                creationflags=flags,
            )
            return True
        except OSError:
            continue
    return QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(url))


def _player_name(main) -> str:
    try:
        account = main.current_account()
        return str(account.name or "")
    except Exception:
        return ""

class OCConfigDialog(StyledDialog):
    def __init__(self, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent, "AI 接口设置", "settings", width=520)
        self._saved = False
        self.config = oc.load_config()

        intro = QLabel(
            "需要一个兼容 OpenAI Chat Completions 的接口。Key 只会写进本机的 "
            "oc_ai.json，不会上传，也不会写进日志。"
        )
        intro.setObjectName("Tiny")
        intro.setWordWrap(True)
        self.body.addWidget(intro)

        self.base_edit = QLineEdit(self.config.base_url)
        self.base_edit.setPlaceholderText("https://api.openai.com/v1")
        self.model_edit = QLineEdit(self.config.model)
        self.model_edit.setPlaceholderText("gpt-4o-mini")
        self.key_edit = QLineEdit(self.config.api_key)
        self.key_edit.setEchoMode(QLineEdit.Password)
        self.key_edit.setPlaceholderText("sk-...")

        self._field("接口地址", self.base_edit, "填到 /v1 为止，也可以直接填完整的 /chat/completions。")

        key_row = QHBoxLayout()
        key_row.setSpacing(8)
        key_row.addWidget(self.key_edit, 1)
        self.show_key = QPushButton("显示")
        self.show_key.setObjectName("Ghost")
        self.show_key.setCheckable(True)
        self.show_key.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.show_key.toggled.connect(self._toggle_key)
        key_row.addWidget(self.show_key)
        self._field("API Key", key_row, "只保存在本机；换电脑或重装前记得备份。")

        self._field("模型", self.model_edit, "例如 gpt-4o-mini、deepseek-chat、moonshot-v1-8k。")

        self.error = QLabel("")
        self.error.setStyleSheet(f"color: {theme.colors()['red']}; font-size: 11px;")
        self.error.setVisible(False)
        self.body.addWidget(self.error)

        self.add_button("取消", "Secondary", self.reject)
        self.add_button("保存", "Primary", self._save)
        self.adjustSize()

    def _field(self, title: str, widget, hint: str) -> None:
        label = QLabel(title)
        label.setObjectName("Tiny")
        self.body.addWidget(label)
        if isinstance(widget, QHBoxLayout):
            self.body.addLayout(widget)
        else:
            self.body.addWidget(widget)
        note = QLabel(hint)
        note.setObjectName("Tiny")
        note.setWordWrap(True)
        self.body.addWidget(note)

    def _toggle_key(self, shown: bool) -> None:
        self.key_edit.setEchoMode(QLineEdit.Normal if shown else QLineEdit.Password)
        self.show_key.setText("隐藏" if shown else "显示")

    def _save(self) -> None:
        base_url = self.base_edit.text().strip().rstrip("/")
        model = self.model_edit.text().strip()
        api_key = self.key_edit.text().strip()
        problem = ""
        if not base_url.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
            problem = "接口地址需要以 http:// 或 https:// 开头。"
        elif not model:
            problem = "模型名称不能为空。"
        elif not api_key:
            problem = "API Key 不能为空。"
        if problem:
            self.error.setText(problem)
            self.error.setVisible(True)
            return
        config = oc.OCConfig(
            base_url=base_url,
            model=model,
            api_key=api_key,
            temperature=self.config.temperature,
            timeout=self.config.timeout,
        )
        try:
            oc.save_config(config)
        except OSError as error:
            self.error.setText(f"保存失败：{error}")
            self.error.setVisible(True)
            return
        self.config = config
        self._saved = True
        self.accept()

    @property
    def saved(self) -> bool:
        return self._saved

# 对话


class OCChatDialog(StyledDialog):
    def __init__(self, main, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        state = judgement.load_state()
        persona = judgement.active_persona(state)
        super().__init__(parent, "LFELKEEA", "message", width=560)
        self.main = main
        self._state = state
        self.persona = persona
        self._both = judgement.unlocked(state, judgement.REWARD_SHATTERED) and judgement.unlocked(
            state, judgement.REWARD_ATTACHMENT
        )
        self._worker: ChatWorker | None = None
        self._pending: QWidget | None = None
        self._pending_text = ""
        self._busy = False
        self._build()
        self._refresh_header()
        self._greet()
        self.adjustSize()

    # -- 界面 ----------------------------------------------------------
    def _build(self) -> None:
        tools = QHBoxLayout()
        tools.setSpacing(6)
        self.persona_badge = badge("", "red")
        tools.addWidget(self.persona_badge)
        self.memory_label = QLabel("")
        self.memory_label.setObjectName("Tiny")
        tools.addWidget(self.memory_label)
        tools.addStretch(1)

        self.switch_btn = QPushButton("切换")
        self.switch_btn.setObjectName("Ghost")
        self.switch_btn.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.switch_btn.clicked.connect(self._switch_persona)
        self.switch_btn.setVisible(self._both)
        tools.addWidget(self.switch_btn)

        settings_btn = QPushButton("接口设置")
        settings_btn.setObjectName("Ghost")
        settings_btn.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        settings_btn.clicked.connect(self._open_config)
        tools.addWidget(settings_btn)

        self.clear_btn = QPushButton("清空记忆")
        self.clear_btn.setObjectName("Ghost")
        self.clear_btn.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.clear_btn.clicked.connect(self._clear_memory)
        self.clear_btn.setVisible(self.persona == judgement.REWARD_ATTACHMENT)
        tools.addWidget(self.clear_btn)
        self.body.addLayout(tools)

        self.scroll = QScrollArea()
        self.scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
        self.scroll.setFrameShape(QFrame.NoFrame)
        self.scroll.setMinimumHeight(360)
        self.scroll.setMaximumHeight(420)
        self.chat_host = QWidget()
        self.chat_layout = QVBoxLayout(self.chat_host)
        self.chat_layout.setContentsMargins(2, 2, 2, 2)
        self.chat_layout.setSpacing(8)
        self.chat_layout.addStretch(1)
        self.scroll.setWidget(self.chat_host)
        self.body.addWidget(self.scroll, 1)

        input_row = QHBoxLayout()
        input_row.setSpacing(8)
        self.input = QLineEdit()
        self.input.setPlaceholderText("和她说点什么…")
        self.input.returnPressed.connect(self._send)
        input_row.addWidget(self.input, 1)
        self.send_btn = QPushButton("发送")
        self.send_btn.setObjectName("Primary")
        self.send_btn.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.send_btn.setMinimumWidth(72)
        self.send_btn.clicked.connect(self._send)
        input_row.addWidget(self.send_btn)
        self.body.addLayout(input_row)

        self.status = QLabel("")
        self.status.setObjectName("Tiny")
        self.status.setWordWrap(True)
        self.body.addWidget(self.status)

        self.add_button("关闭", "Secondary", self.reject)

    def _refresh_header(self) -> None:
        attached = self.persona == judgement.REWARD_ATTACHMENT
        label = "眷恋之心" if attached else "破碎之躯"
        _set_badge(self.persona_badge, label, "red" if attached else "gray")
        self.title_label.setText(f"LFELKEEA · {label}")
        self.switch_btn.setText("切换人格")
        self.switch_btn.setToolTip(
            "切换为破碎之躯" if attached else "切换为眷恋之心"
        )
        self.clear_btn.setVisible(attached)
        self._refresh_memory()

    def _refresh_memory(self) -> None:
        if self.persona == judgement.REWARD_ATTACHMENT:
            memory = oc.load_memory()
            count = len(memory.get("messages") or [])
            chats = int(memory.get("chats") or 0)
            self.memory_label.setText(
                f"记得 {count // 2} 轮对话 · 聊过 {chats} 次" if count else "还没有留下记忆"
            )
        else:
            self.memory_label.setText("无感情 · 无记忆")

    def _greet(self) -> None:
        if self.persona == judgement.REWARD_ATTACHMENT:
            memory = oc.load_memory()
            if memory.get("chats"):
                self._add_bubble("你回来了。……我可没有一直盯着门口，只是刚好醒着。")
            else:
                self._add_bubble(
                    "……你终于来了。我是 LFELKEEA。\n别误会，我只是刚好在这里。"
                )
        else:
            self._add_bubble("有事就说。")

    def _add_bubble(self, text: str, mine: bool = False, pending: bool = False) -> QWidget:
        row = QWidget()
        line = QHBoxLayout(row)
        line.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        line.setSpacing(0)
        label = QLabel(text)
        label.setWordWrap(True)
        label.setTextInteractionFlags(Qt.TextSelectableByMouse)
        metrics = QFontMetrics(label.font())
        longest = max(
            (metrics.horizontalAdvance(part) for part in text.split("\n")),
            default=0,
        )
        label.setFixedWidth(min(390, max(170, longest + 34)))
        colors = theme.colors()
        if mine:
            label.setStyleSheet(
                f"background: {colors['accent']}; color: #FFFFFF;"
                " border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 12px;"
            )
            line.addStretch(1)
            line.addWidget(label)
        elif pending:
            label.setStyleSheet(
                f"background: {colors['card2']}; color: {colors['muted']};"
                f" border: 1px dashed {colors['border_strong']};"
                " border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 12px;"
            )
            line.addWidget(label)
            line.addStretch(1)
        else:
            label.setStyleSheet(
                f"background: {colors['accent_soft']}; color: {colors['text']};"
                f" border: 1px solid {colors['accent_border']};"
                " border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 12px;"
            )
            line.addWidget(label)
            line.addStretch(1)
        # 插在 stretch 之前，保证气泡从上往下排。
        self.chat_layout.insertWidget(self.chat_layout.count() - 1, row)
        QTimer.singleShot(0, self._scroll_bottom)
        return row

    def _add_notice(self, text: str) -> None:
        label = QLabel(text)
        label.setObjectName("Tiny")
        label.setWordWrap(True)
        label.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
        self.chat_layout.insertWidget(self.chat_layout.count() - 1, label)
        QTimer.singleShot(0, self._scroll_bottom)

    def _scroll_bottom(self) -> None:
        bar = self.scroll.verticalScrollBar()
        bar.setValue(bar.maximum())

    # -- 发送 ----------------------------------------------------------
    def _send(self) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            return
        text = self.input.text().strip()
        if not text:
            return
        config = oc.load_config()
        if not config.ready:
            self._add_notice("还没有配置 AI 接口。点右上角「接口设置」填入 API Key。")
            self._open_config()
            return
        self.input.clear()
        self._pending_text = text
        self._add_bubble(text, mine=True)
        self._pending = self._add_bubble("……", pending=True)
        memory = oc.load_memory()
        messages = oc.build_messages(
            self.persona,
            _player_name(self.main),
            memory,
            text,
        )
        self._set_busy(True)
        self._worker = ChatWorker(config, messages, self)
        self._worker.ok.connect(self._on_reply)
        self._worker.fail.connect(self._on_fail)
        self._worker.finished.connect(self._worker.deleteLater)
        self._worker.start()

    def _set_busy(self, busy: bool) -> None:
        self._busy = busy
        self.send_btn.setEnabled(not busy)
        self.input.setEnabled(not busy)
        self.status.setText("她正在输入…" if busy else "")
        if not busy:
            self.input.setFocus()

    def _drop_pending(self) -> None:
        if self._pending is not None:
            self._pending.setParent(None)
            self._pending.deleteLater()
            self._pending = None

    def _on_reply(self, text: str) -> None:
        self._worker = None
        self._drop_pending()
        self._add_bubble(text)
        if self.persona == judgement.REWARD_ATTACHMENT:
            try:
                oc.remember(_player_name(self.main), self._pending_text, text)
            except OSError:
                pass
        self._refresh_memory()
        self._set_busy(False)

    def _on_fail(self, message: str) -> None:
        self._worker = None
        self._drop_pending()
        self._add_notice(f"没有收到回复：{message}")
        self._set_busy(False)

    # -- 工具 ----------------------------------------------------------
    def _open_config(self) -> None:
        dialog = OCConfigDialog(self)
        if dialog.exec() and dialog.saved:
            self.status.setText("接口已保存。")
        self.input.setFocus()

    def _clear_memory(self) -> None:
        confirm = ConfirmDialog(
            self,
            "清空记忆",
            "她会忘记你们之前聊过的一切。这个操作不能撤销。",
            "清空",
            "取消",
            "warning",
        )
        if not confirm.exec():
            return
        oc.clear_memory()
        self._refresh_memory()
        self._add_notice("记忆已清空。")

    def _switch_persona(self) -> None:
        if not self._both:
            return
        target = (
            judgement.REWARD_SHATTERED
            if self.persona == judgement.REWARD_ATTACHMENT
            else judgement.REWARD_ATTACHMENT
        )
        try:
            judgement.set_active(target)
        except ValueError:
            return
        self.persona = target
        self._refresh_header()
        if target == judgement.REWARD_ATTACHMENT:
            self._add_notice("她抬起眼，像是终于认出了你。")
        else:
            self._add_notice("她的眼神重新变得空白。")

    def reject(self) -> None:
        # QThread 不能在运行中被销毁；等这一句说完再允许关闭。
        if self._worker is not None and self._worker.isRunning():
            self.status.setText("等她说完这一句再关闭。")
            return
        super().reject()

    def closeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        if self._worker is not None and self._worker.isRunning():
            event.ignore()
            self.status.setText("等她说完这一句再关闭。")
            return
        super().closeEvent(event)

        else:
            self.add_button("知道了", "Secondary", self.reject)

        self.accept()

        story_title.setObjectName("H2")
        story_layout.addWidget(story_title)
        self.story_label = QLabel("")
        self.story_label.setObjectName("DialogText")
        self.story_label.setWordWrap(True)
        story_layout.addWidget(self.story_label)
        self.body.addWidget(self.story_box)

        self.status = QLabel("")
        self.status.setObjectName("Tiny")
        self.status.setWordWrap(True)
        self.body.addWidget(self.status)

        self.config_btn = self.add_button("AI 接口设置", "Ghost", self._open_config)
        self.chat_btn = self.add_button("和她说话", "Secondary", self._open_chat)
        self.stop_btn = self.add_button("停止等待", "Ghost", self._stop_session)
        self.start_btn = self.add_button("开始审判", "Primary", self._start)

    def _refresh(self) -> None:
        state = judgement.load_state()
        rewards = state.get("rewards") or {}
        for reward, status in self.reward_badges.items():
            if reward in rewards:
                _set_badge(status, "已解锁", "green" if reward == judgement.REWARD_SHATTERED else "red")
            else:
                _set_badge(status, "未解锁", "gray")
        active = judgement.active_persona(state)
        if len(rewards) >= 2:
            _set_badge(self.state_badge, "两件信物", "purple")
        elif rewards:
            _set_badge(self.state_badge, judgement.REWARDS[active]["name"], "red" if active == judgement.REWARD_ATTACHMENT else "gray")
        else:
            _set_badge(self.state_badge, "尚未解锁", "gray")

        lines: list[str] = []
        for reward in (judgement.REWARD_SHATTERED, judgement.REWARD_ATTACHMENT):
            if reward not in rewards:
                continue
            if lines:
                lines.append("")
            lines.append(f"【{judgement.REWARDS[reward]['name']}】")
            lines.extend(judgement.reward_story(reward))
        self.story_label.setText("\n".join(lines) if lines else judgement.LOCKED_HINT)
        self.story_box.setVisible(True)

        has_any = judgement.has_any(state)
        self.chat_btn.setEnabled(has_any)
        self.chat_btn.setToolTip("" if has_any else "先在困难模式的审判战里带回一件信物")
        self.stop_btn.setVisible(self._playing)
        self.start_btn.setEnabled(not self._playing and judgement.html_ready())
        if self._playing:
            self.start_btn.setText("审判进行中…")
            self.status.setText(
                "审判战已在独立窗口打开。打完会自己把战果送回来，不用关闭这个窗口。"
            )
        elif not judgement.html_ready():
            self.start_btn.setText("缺少游戏文件")
            self.status.setText("没有找到 assets/judgement/judgement-lfelkeea.html，请重新安装启动器。")
        else:
            self.start_btn.setText("开始审判" if not has_any else "再打一次")
            self.status.setText(
                "困难模式的屠杀线给「破碎之躯」，饶恕线需要看完所有互动并饶恕十次，给「眷恋之心」。"
            )

    # -- 开战 ----------------------------------------------------------
    def _start(self) -> None:
        if self._playing:
            return
        if not judgement.html_ready():
            NoticeDialog(
                self,
                "缺少审判战文件",
                "assets/judgement/judgement-lfelkeea.html 不存在或不完整，请重新安装启动器。",
                "知道了",
                "warning",
            ).exec()
            return

        server = ResultServer(self)
        if not server.start():
            NoticeDialog(
                self,
                "无法接收战果",
                "本机端口被占用，启动器没法接收这场战斗的结果。请稍后再试。",
                "知道了",
                "warning",
            ).exec()
            server.deleteLater()
            return
        server.result.connect(self._on_result)
        self._server = server

        callback = f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.port}/result"
        url = QUrl.fromLocalFile(str(judgement.HTML_PATH))
        url.setQuery(
            urllib.parse.urlencode({"cb": callback, "token": server.token})
        )
        if not _launch_browser(url.toString()):
            server.stop()
            server.deleteLater()
            self._server = None
            NoticeDialog(
                self,
                "打不开审判战",
                "没有找到 Microsoft Edge 或 Google Chrome。安装其中一个后再试，"
                "或者把默认浏览器设为它们。",
                "知道了",
                "warning",
            ).exec()
            return

        self._playing = True
        self._deadline.start()
        self._refresh()

    def _on_result(self, payload: dict) -> None:
        self._deadline.stop()
        if self._server is not None:
            self._server.stop()
            self._server.deleteLater()
            self._server = None
        self._playing = False

        route = str(payload.get("route") or "")
        difficulty = "hard" if str(payload.get("diff") or "") == "hard" else "normal"
        try:
            applied = judgement.apply_result(
                route,
                difficulty,
                payload.get("turns"),
                payload.get("damage"),
                payload.get("hits"),
            )
        except ValueError as error:
            self._refresh()
            NoticeDialog(self, "战果无法识别", str(error), "知道了", "warning").exec()
            return

        self._refresh()
        result = JudgementResultDialog(self, applied)
        result.exec()
        if result.chat_requested:
            self._open_chat()

    def _on_timeout(self) -> None:
        if not self._playing:
            return
        self._stop_session()
        self.status.setText("等了很久也没有收到战果，先停止等待了。可以重新开始。")

    def _stop_session(self) -> None:
        self._deadline.stop()
        if self._server is not None:
            self._server.stop()
            self._server.deleteLater()
            self._server = None
        self._playing = False
        self._refresh()

    # -- 其他入口 ------------------------------------------------------
    def _open_chat(self) -> None:
        self.main.open_oc_chat()

    def _open_config(self) -> None:
        self.main.open_oc_config()

    def reject(self) -> None:
        if self._playing:
            confirm = ConfirmDialog(
                self,
                "审判战还在进行",
                "现在关闭会停止接收战果，游戏窗口仍然会开着。确定要离开吗？",
                "停止等待并关闭",
                "继续等待",
                "warning",
            )
            if not confirm.exec():
                return
            self._stop_session()
        super().reject()

    def closeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        if self._playing:
            event.ignore()
            self.reject()
            return
        self._deadline.stop()
        if self._server is not None:
            self._server.stop()
            self._server.deleteLater()
            self._server = None
        super().closeEvent(event)

def _human_mb(value: int) -> str:
    value = max(0, int(value or 0))
    if value >= 1024:
        return f"{value / 1024:.1f} GB"
    return f"{value} MB"


def _gpu_text(gpus) -> str:
    names = [item.name for item in gpus if getattr(item, "name", "")]
    if not names:
        return "没有读取到显卡信息"
    return " / ".join(dict.fromkeys(names))


def _options_text(options: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    if not options:
        return "还没有 options.txt，会新建一份"
    graphics = {
        "fast": "流畅",
        "fancy": "精美",
        "fabulous": "极佳",
    }.get(str(options.get("graphics") or ""), str(options.get("graphics") or "默认"))
    particles = {
        "minimal": "最少",
        "decreased": "减少",
        "all": "全部",
    }.get(str(options.get("particles") or ""), str(options.get("particles") or "默认"))
    fps = str(options.get("maxFps") or "0")
    fps_text = "无限制" if fps in ("0", "") else fps
    return (
        f"当前：画质 {graphics} · 渲染距离 {options.get('renderDistance', '默认')} "
        f"· 粒子 {particles} · 帧率上限 {fps_text}"
    )


def _section() -> tuple[QFrame, QVBoxLayout]:
    box = QFrame()
    box.setObjectName("SoftCard")
    box.setAttribute(Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
    layout = QVBoxLayout(box)
    layout.setContentsMargins(15, 13, 15, 13)
    layout.setSpacing(8)
    return box, layout

    def _show_error(self, message: str) -> None:
        self.state_badge.setText("不可用")
        self.state_badge.setProperty("badge", "red")
        repolish(self.state_badge)
        self.state_note.setText(message)
        self.hardware_box.setVisible(False)
        self.performance_box.setVisible(False)
        self.graphics_box.setVisible(False)
        self.warn_box.setVisible(False)
        self.optimize_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.graphics_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.restore_btn.setVisible(False)

    def _reload_plans(self, initial: bool = False) -> None:
        profile_key = ""
        if self._graphics_plan is not None:
            profile_key = self._graphics_plan.profile.key
        try:
            opt_plan = build_optimization_plan(
                self.version_id, self.main.config, self.main.versions
            )
            gpus = opt_plan.gpus
            graphics_plan = build_graphics_plan(
                self.version_id,
                self.main.config,
                self.main.versions,
                profile_key,
                gpus=gpus,
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            self._show_error(str(exc))
            return
        self._opt_plan = opt_plan
        self._graphics_plan = graphics_plan
        self.profile_tabs.set_value(graphics_plan.profile.key)
        self._update_hardware(opt_plan)
        self._update_performance(opt_plan)
        self._update_graphics(graphics_plan)
        self._update_warnings(opt_plan, graphics_plan)
        self._update_state()
        if initial:
            self._sync_defaults(opt_plan, graphics_plan)
        self.adjustSize()

    def _sync_defaults(self, opt_plan, graphics_plan) -> None:
        self.install_mods_box.setChecked(
            bool(opt_plan.has_loader and opt_plan.missing)
        )
        self.memory_box.setChecked(True)
        self.jvm_box.setChecked(True)
        self.options_box.setChecked(True)
        self.iris_box.setChecked(
            bool(graphics_plan.can_install_iris and not graphics_plan.iris_installed)
        )
        self.shader_box.setChecked(
            bool(
                not graphics_plan.shader_installed
                and (graphics_plan.iris_installed or graphics_plan.can_install_iris)
            )
        )

    def _update_hardware(self, plan) -> None:
        self.hardware_label.setText(
            f"系统内存 {_human_mb(plan.total_ram_mb)} · 显卡 {_gpu_text(plan.gpus)}\n"
            f"加载器 {plan.loader_label} · Minecraft {plan.mc_version} · "
            f"已装 Mod {plan.mod_count} 个"
        )

    def _update_performance(self, plan) -> None:
        self.memory_label.setText(
            f"推荐内存 {_human_mb(plan.recommended_memory_mb)} "
            f"（当前 {_human_mb(plan.current_memory_mb)}）"
        )
        jvm_text = plan.recommended_jvm_args
        self.jvm_label.setText(
            "推荐 JVM 参数：G1 GC + 并行引用处理"
            if plan.current_jvm_args.strip() != jvm_text
            else "当前版本已经使用推荐的 JVM 参数"
        )
        self.jvm_label.setToolTip(jvm_text)

        present = "、".join(item.title for item in plan.present)
        missing = "、".join(item.title for item in plan.missing)
        if not plan.has_loader:
            self.mods_label.setText("原版客户端没有可安装的优化 Mod，只会调整启动参数。")
        elif missing:
            text = f"将安装：{missing}"
            if present:
                text += f"\n已装：{present}"
            self.mods_label.setText(text)
        elif present:
            self.mods_label.setText(f"优化 Mod 已齐全：{present}")
        else:
            self.mods_label.setText("这个加载器暂时没有可自动安装的优化 Mod。")
        available = bool(plan.has_loader and plan.missing)
        self.install_mods_box.setEnabled(available)
        if not available:
            self.install_mods_box.setChecked(False)
        if not plan.has_loader:
            self.install_mods_box.setText("原版客户端无需优化 Mod")
        elif plan.missing:
            self.install_mods_box.setText(
                f"安装 {len(plan.missing)} 个缺失的优化 Mod"
            )
        else:
            self.install_mods_box.setText("优化 Mod 已齐全")

    def _update_graphics(self, plan) -> None:
        profile = plan.profile
        profile_note = next(
            (item.subtitle for item in GRAPHICS_PROFILES if item.key == profile.key),
            "",
        )
        recommend = graphics_profile(plan.recommended_profile)
        self.graphics_recommend.setText(f"按显卡推荐：{recommend.title}")
        self.graphics_detail.setText(
            f"{profile.title} · {profile_note}\n{_options_text(plan.current_options)}"
        )
        iris_installed = plan.iris_installed
        self.iris_box.setEnabled(bool(plan.can_install_iris and not iris_installed))
        if iris_installed:
            self.iris_box.setText("Iris 已安装")
        elif plan.can_install_iris:
            self.iris_box.setText("安装 Iris 光影加载器")
        else:
            self.iris_box.setText("当前加载器不支持自动安装 Iris")
        shader_possible = bool(iris_installed or plan.can_install_iris)
        self.shader_box.setEnabled(shader_possible and not plan.shader_installed)
        if plan.shader_installed:
            self.shader_box.setText("Complementary Reimagined 已安装")
        else:
            self.shader_box.setText(
                "安装 Complementary Reimagined 光影并设为默认"
            )
        if plan.shader_installed:
            self.shader_box.setChecked(False)
        if not self.iris_box.isEnabled():
            self.iris_box.setChecked(False)
        self.options_box.setEnabled(True)

    def _update_warnings(self, opt_plan, graphics_plan) -> None:
        warnings = list(dict.fromkeys([*opt_plan.warnings, *graphics_plan.warnings]))
        self.warn_label.setText("\n".join(f"· {item}" for item in warnings))
        self.warn_box.setVisible(bool(warnings))

    def _update_state(self) -> None:
        state = state_summary(self.version_id, self.main.config)
        active = bool(state)
        if active:
            installed = state.get("installed") or []
            self.state_badge.setText("已应用优化")
            self.state_badge.setProperty("badge", "green")
            self.state_note.setText(
                f"记录到 {len(installed)} 个由启动器安装的文件；"
                "撤销时会把它们移到优化备份目录，不会直接删除。"
            )
        else:
            self.state_badge.setText("尚未优化")
            self.state_badge.setProperty("badge", "gray")
            self.state_note.setText(
                "优化只影响当前版本，随时可以撤销并恢复原设置。"
            )
        repolish(self.state_badge)
        self.restore_btn.setVisible(active)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_profile_changed(self, key: str) -> None:
        if self._worker is not None:
            return
        try:
            self._graphics_plan = build_graphics_plan(
                self.version_id,
                self.main.config,
                self.main.versions,
                key,
                gpus=self._opt_plan.gpus if self._opt_plan else None,
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            self.main.toast(str(exc), "error")
            return
        self._update_graphics(self._graphics_plan)

    def _start_optimize(self) -> None:
        if self._worker is not None:
            self._worker.cancel()
            self._set_progress(-1, "正在取消性能优化…")
            return
        if self._opt_plan is None:
            return
        choices = (
            self.install_mods_box.isChecked(),
            self.memory_box.isChecked(),
            self.jvm_box.isChecked(),
        )
        if not any(choices):
            self.main.toast("至少勾选一项性能优化内容", "info")
            return
        worker = OptimizeWorker(
            self._opt_plan,
            self.main.config,
            install_mods=choices[0],
            apply_memory=choices[1],
            apply_jvm=choices[2],
            threads=self.main.config.download_threads,
            parent=self,
        )
        self._worker = worker
        self._worker_kind = "performance"
        worker.progress.connect(self._on_progress)
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_optimize_finished)
        self._set_busy(True)
        self._set_progress(0, "准备性能优化…")
        worker.start()

    def _start_graphics(self) -> None:
        if self._worker is not None:
            self._worker.cancel()
            self._set_progress(-1, "正在取消画面升级…")
            return
        if self._graphics_plan is None:
            return
        choices = (
            self.options_box.isChecked(),
            self.iris_box.isChecked(),
            self.shader_box.isChecked(),
        )
        if not any(choices):
            self.main.toast("至少勾选一项画面升级内容", "info")
            return
        worker = GraphicsWorker(
            self._graphics_plan,
            self.main.config,
            apply_options=choices[0],
            install_iris=choices[1],
            install_shader=choices[2],
            threads=self.main.config.download_threads,
            parent=self,
        )
        self._worker = worker
        self._worker_kind = "graphics"
        worker.progress.connect(self._on_progress)
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_graphics_finished)
        self._set_busy(True)
        self._set_progress(0, "准备画面升级…")
        worker.start()

    def _set_busy(self, busy: bool) -> None:
        for box in (
            self.install_mods_box,
            self.memory_box,
            self.jvm_box,
            self.options_box,
            self.iris_box,
            self.shader_box,
        ):
            box.setEnabled(not busy and self._box_available(box))
        self.profile_tabs.setEnabled(not busy)
        self.restore_btn.setEnabled(not busy)
        self.close_btn.setEnabled(not busy)
        self.optimize_btn.setEnabled(not busy or self._worker_kind == "performance")
        self.graphics_btn.setEnabled(not busy or self._worker_kind == "graphics")
        if busy:
            self.optimize_btn.setText(
                "取消优化"
                if self._worker_kind == "performance"
                else "一键性能优化"
            )
            self.graphics_btn.setText(
                "取消升级"
                if self._worker_kind == "graphics"
                else "应用画面方案"
            )
        else:
            self.optimize_btn.setText("一键性能优化")
            self.graphics_btn.setText("应用画面方案")
        if not busy and self._opt_plan is not None:
            self.install_mods_box.setEnabled(
                bool(self._opt_plan.has_loader and self._opt_plan.missing)
            )

    def _box_available(self, box) -> bool:
        if box is self.install_mods_box:
            return bool(self._opt_plan and self._opt_plan.has_loader and self._opt_plan.missing)
        if box is self.iris_box:
            return bool(
                self._graphics_plan
                and self._graphics_plan.can_install_iris
                and not self._graphics_plan.iris_installed
            )
        if box is self.shader_box:
            return bool(
                self._graphics_plan
                and (self._graphics_plan.iris_installed or self._graphics_plan.can_install_iris)
                and not self._graphics_plan.shader_installed
            )
        return True

    def _set_progress(self, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        self.progress_box.setVisible(True)
        if percent >= 0:
            self.progress.setValue(max(0, min(100, percent)))
        self.progress_text.setText(message)

    def _on_progress(self, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        self._set_progress(percent, message)

    def _on_optimize_finished(self, success: bool, message: str, result) -> None:
        self._worker = None
        self._worker_kind = ""
        if self._closing:
            self._closing = False
            super().reject()
            return
        if not success or result is None:
            self._finish_failure(message)
            return
        parts = []
        if getattr(result, "memory_mb", 0):
            parts.append(f"内存 {_human_mb(result.memory_mb)}")
        if getattr(result, "jvm_args", ""):
            parts.append("JVM 参数")
        installed = getattr(result, "installed", []) or []
        if installed:
            parts.append(f"{len(installed)} 个优化 Mod")
        errors = getattr(result, "errors", []) or []
        if getattr(result, "cancelled", False):
            parts.append("已取消")
        text = "性能优化完成" + (f"：{'、'.join(parts)}" if parts else "")
        if errors:
            text += "\n" + "\n".join(f"· {item}" for item in errors)
        self._finish_success(text, errors)
        self.main.toast(message, "success" if not errors else "warning")

    def _on_graphics_finished(self, success: bool, message: str, result) -> None:
        self._worker = None
        self._worker_kind = ""
        if self._closing:
            self._closing = False
            super().reject()
            return
        if not success or result is None:
            self._finish_failure(message)
            return
        parts = []
        if getattr(result, "options_written", False):
            parts.append("画面参数")
        installed = getattr(result, "installed", []) or []
        if installed:
            parts.append(f"{len(installed)} 个文件")
        if getattr(result, "shader_file", ""):
            parts.append(f"光影 {result.shader_file}")
        if getattr(result, "cancelled", False):
            parts.append("已取消")
        errors = getattr(result, "errors", []) or []
        text = "画面升级完成" + (f"：{'、'.join(parts)}" if parts else "")
        if errors:
            text += "\n" + "\n".join(f"· {item}" for item in errors)
        self._finish_success(text, errors)
        self.main.toast(message, "success" if not errors else "warning")

    def _finish_failure(self, message: str) -> None:
        self._set_busy(False)
        self.progress.setValue(0)
        self._set_progress(0, f"操作失败：{message}")
        self.main.toast(message or "优化失败", "error")

    def _finish_success(self, text: str, errors: list[str]) -> None:
        self._set_busy(False)
        self.progress.setValue(100)
        self.result_label.setText(text)
        self.result_label.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {colors()['orange']};" if errors else f"color: {colors()['green']};"
        )
        self.result_label.setVisible(True)
        self._reload_plans()
        self.main.mods_page.refresh_mods()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _restore(self) -> None:
        if self._worker is not None:
            return
        state = state_summary(self.version_id, self.main.config)
        if not state:
            return
        installed = state.get("installed") or []
        confirm = ConfirmDialog(
            self,
            "撤销当前版本的优化？",
            "会恢复优化前保存的内存、JVM 参数、options.txt 和 Iris 配置，"
            "并把启动器安装的优化 Mod 移到优化备份目录。",
            "撤销优化",
            "继续保留",
            "warning",
            details=(
                f"将处理 {len(installed)} 个由启动器安装的文件。"
                "手动改过内容的文件会保留原位，不会覆盖或删除。"
            ),
        )
        if confirm.exec() != ConfirmDialog.Accepted:
            return
        try:
            result = restore_optimization(self.version_id, self.main.config)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.main.toast(str(exc), "error")
            return
        bits = []
        if result.settings_restored:
            bits.append("启动参数")
        if result.options_restored:
            bits.append("画面设置")
        if result.iris_restored:
            bits.append("Iris 配置")
        if result.moved_files:
            bits.append(f"{len(result.moved_files)} 个文件已移到备份目录")
        if result.kept_files:
            bits.append(f"{len(result.kept_files)} 个文件因内容变化被保留")
        text = "已撤销优化" + (f"：{'、'.join(bits)}" if bits else "")
        if result.errors:
            text += "\n" + "\n".join(f"· {item}" for item in result.errors)
        self.result_label.setText(text)
        self.result_label.setVisible(True)
        self._set_progress(0, "优化已撤销")
        self._reload_plans()
        self.main.mods_page.refresh_mods()
        self.main.toast("已撤销优化", "success" if not result.errors else "warning")

    def _open_folder(self) -> None:
        self.main.open_path(self.main.config.version_game_path(self.version_id))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def reject(self) -> None:
        if self._worker is not None:
            self._worker.cancel()
            self._closing = True
            self._set_progress(-1, "正在取消并清理任务，请稍候…")
            return
        super().reject()

    def closeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        if self._worker is not None:
            event.ignore()
            self.reject()
            return
        super().closeEvent(event)

def _count_files(root: Path) -> int:
    if not root.is_dir():
        return 0
    count = 0
    try:
        for path in root.rglob("*"):
            if path.is_file():
                count += 1
    except OSError:
        pass
    return count

    """把当前版本连同 mods / config 打包成 .dklpack。"""

        run_dir = version_game_dir(

        )

    @staticmethod
    def _field_label(text: str) -> QLabel:
        label = QLabel(text)
        label.setObjectName("SegLabel")
        return label

    def _options(self) -> PackOptions:
        values = {key: box.isChecked() for key, box in self.option_boxes.items()}
        return PackOptions(**values)

    def _start_export(self) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            return
        if not self.name_edit.text().strip():
            self._show_error("给纸箱写个名字吧，空名字会被猫猫叼走。")
            return
        default_name = normalize_version_id(self.name_edit.text()) or self.version_id
        path, _ = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
            self,
            "保存 DKL 整合包",
            str(self.main.config.game_path / f"{default_name}{PACK_EXTENSION}"),
            f"Darkitten 整合包 (*{PACK_EXTENSION})",
        )
        if not path:
            return
        output = Path(path)
        if output.suffix.lower() != PACK_EXTENSION:
            output = output.with_suffix(PACK_EXTENSION)
        self._begin_busy()
        worker = PackExportWorker(
            self.main.config.game_path,
            self.version_id,
            output,
            name=self.name_edit.text().strip(),
            description=self.desc_edit.text().strip(),
            options=self._options(),
            isolated=self.main.config.version_isolation,
            parent=self,
        )
        self._worker = worker
        worker.progress.connect(self._on_progress)
        worker.log_line.connect(self.main.log)
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_finished)
        worker.start()

    def _begin_busy(self) -> None:
        self._busy = True
        self._hide_error()
        self.name_edit.setEnabled(False)
        self.desc_edit.setEnabled(False)
        for box in self.option_boxes.values():
            box.setEnabled(False)
        self.progress.setValue(0)
        self.progress_box.setVisible(True)
        self.progress_text.setText("正在折纸箱…")
        self.pack_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.cancel_btn.setText("取消打包")

    def _on_progress(self, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        self.progress.setValue(percent)
        self.progress_text.setText(message)

    def _on_finished(self, success: bool, message: str, path: str) -> None:
        self._busy = False
        self._worker = None
        self.progress.setValue(100 if success else 0)
        if success:
            self._result_path = path
            self.progress_text.setText(message)
            self.pack_btn.setText("完成")
            self.pack_btn.setEnabled(True)
            try:
                self.pack_btn.clicked.disconnect()
            except (RuntimeError, TypeError):
                pass
            self.pack_btn.clicked.connect(self.accept)
            self.cancel_btn.setVisible(False)
            self.main.log(message)
            self.main.toast("整合包已经装进纸箱，喵。", "success")
            return
        self.progress_box.setVisible(False)
        self.name_edit.setEnabled(True)
        self.desc_edit.setEnabled(True)
        for box in self.option_boxes.values():
            box.setEnabled(True)
        self.pack_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.pack_btn.setText("重新打包")
        self.cancel_btn.setText("取消")
        self._show_error(message or "打包失败")
        self.main.log(f"打包失败：{message}")

    def _show_error(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.error.setText(text)
        self.error.setVisible(True)

    def _hide_error(self) -> None:
        self.error.clear()
        self.error.setVisible(False)

    def _on_cancel(self) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            if not self._worker:
                return
            self._worker.cancel()
            self.progress_text.setText("正在把纸箱收回来…")
            self.cancel_btn.setEnabled(False)
            return
        self.reject()

    def reject(self) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            dialog = ConfirmDialog(
                self,
                "停止打包",
                "纸箱还没封好，现在离开会取消打包。确定吗？",
                primary_text="停止打包",
                secondary_text="继续",
                icon_name="warning",
                icon_color=colors()["orange"],
            )
            if not dialog.exec():
                return
            if self._worker:
                self._worker.cancel()
            self._busy = False
        super().reject()

    def result_path(self) -> str:
        return self._result_path

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _choose_file(self) -> None:
        path, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self,
            "选择整合包",
            str(self.main.config.game_path),
            "整合包 (*.dklpack *.mrpack *.zip);;所有文件 (*)",
        )
        if path:
            self._load_pack(Path(path))

    def _load_pack(self, path: Path) -> None:
        self._info = None
        self._kind = ""
        dkl_error: Exception | None = None
        info: PackInfo | ModrinthPackInfo | CurseForgePackInfo
        try:
            info = inspect_pack(path)
        except Exception as exc:
            dkl_error = exc
        else:
            self._kind = "dkl"

        if not self._kind:
            if looks_like_modrinth_pack(path):
                try:
                    info = inspect_modrinth_pack(path)
                except Exception as exc:
                    self._show_error(f"Modrinth 整合包无法导入：{exc}")
                    self.preview.setVisible(False)
                    self.import_options.setVisible(False)
                    self.import_btn.setEnabled(False)
                    return
                self._kind = "modrinth"
            elif looks_like_curseforge_pack(path):
                try:
                    info = inspect_curseforge_pack(path)
                except Exception as exc:
                    self._show_error(f"CurseForge 整合包无法导入：{exc}")
                    self.preview.setVisible(False)
                    self.import_options.setVisible(False)
                    self.import_btn.setEnabled(False)
                    return
                self._kind = "curseforge"
            else:
                self._show_error(str(dkl_error or "无法识别这个整合包"))
                self.preview.setVisible(False)
                self.import_options.setVisible(False)
                self.import_btn.setEnabled(False)
                return

        self._info = info
        self._attempted_version_id = ""
        self.path_edit.setText(str(path))
        self.progress_box.setVisible(False)
        self._hide_error()
        self.preview.setVisible(True)
        self.import_options.setVisible(True)
        self.preview_name.setText(info.name)
        loader_text = info.loader or "原版"
        if info.loader and info.loader_version:
            loader_text += f" {info.loader_version}"
        self.preview_loader.setText(loader_text)
        self.preview_mc.setText(f"Minecraft {info.minecraft_version or '未知'}")
        self.preview_loader.setVisible(bool(info.loader))
        if self._kind == "modrinth":
            self.preview_meta.setText(
                f"来自 Modrinth · {info.total_files} 个文件 · "
                f"下载约 {human_size(info.total_bytes)} · "
                f"压缩包 {human_size(info.archive_bytes)}"
            )
        elif self._kind == "curseforge":
            self.preview_meta.setText(
                f"来自 CurseForge · 在线下载 {len(info.files)} 个文件 · "
                f"覆盖文件 {human_size(info.total_bytes)} · "
                f"压缩包 {human_size(info.archive_bytes)}"
            )
        else:
            created = (
                info.created_at[:19].replace("T", " ")
                if info.created_at
                else "未知"
            )
            self.preview_meta.setText(
                f"来自 {info.created_with or 'DKL'} · {created} · "
                f"{info.total_files} 个文件 · 解压后 {human_size(info.total_bytes)} · "
                f"压缩包 {human_size(info.archive_bytes)}"
            )
        parts = []
        for key in ("mods", "config", "defaultconfigs", "resourcepacks", "shaderpacks", "saves"):
            count = int(info.counts.get(key) or 0)
            if count:
                parts.append(f"{CONTENT_LABELS.get(key, key)} {count}")
        self.preview_contents.setText("纸箱里装着：" + ("、".join(parts) or "只有版本信息"))
        self.preview_contents.setVisible(bool(parts))
        self.preview_desc.setText(info.description)
        self.preview_desc.setVisible(bool(info.description))

        default_id = unique_version_id(self.main.config.game_path, info.name)
        self.name_edit.setText(default_id)
        hint = "默认使用整合包名称；如果已存在同名版本会自动加序号。"
        if self._kind in ("modrinth", "curseforge"):
            hint += (
                f" 导入时会安装 Minecraft {info.minecraft_version}"
                + (
                    f" + {info.loader} {info.loader_version}"
                    if info.loader
                    else ""
                )
                + "，并下载清单里的文件。"
            )
        if not self.main.config.version_isolation:
            hint += "  版本隔离关闭，mods 会写入共享目录。"
        self.name_hint.setText(hint)
        self.import_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.import_btn.setText("导入猫窝")

    @staticmethod
    def _fetch_result(path: str, error: str) -> tuple[bool, str, str]:
        if error:
            return False, str(error), ""
        target = Path(path)
        return True, "压缩包下载完成", target.name

    def _bind_download_center(self) -> None:
        if self._download_bound:
            return
        center = self.main.download_center
        center.task_progress.connect(self._on_task_progress)
        center.task_finished.connect(self._on_task_finished)
        self._download_bound = True

    def _detach_download_center(self, _result: int = 0) -> None:
        if not self._download_bound:
            return
        center = self.main.download_center
        try:
            center.task_progress.disconnect(self._on_task_progress)
            center.task_finished.disconnect(self._on_task_finished)
        except (RuntimeError, TypeError):
            pass
        self._download_bound = False

    def _on_task_progress(self, task_id: int, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        if self._task is None or int(task_id) != self._task.id:
            return
        self.progress.setValue(percent)
        self.progress_text.setText(message)

    def _on_task_finished(self, task: DownloadTask) -> None:
        if self._task is None or task.id != self._task.id:
            return
        self._task = None
        self._mode = "idle"
        self.cancel_btn.setText("取消")
        if task.status == TASK_SUCCESS:
            self.progress.setValue(100)
            self.progress_text.setText(task.message)
            if task.content_type == "pack-fetch":
                self._set_controls_enabled(True)
                self.progress_box.setVisible(False)
                path = task.target / task.filename
                if path.is_file():
                    self._load_pack(path)
                else:
                    self._show_error("下载完成但找不到压缩包，请重试。")
                return
            self.imported_version = task.filename
            self.accept()
            return
        self._set_controls_enabled(True)
        self.progress_box.setVisible(False)
        self.import_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.import_btn.setText("重新导入")
        cancelled = task.status == TASK_CANCELLED
        message = task.error or task.message or (
            "导入已取消" if cancelled else "导入失败"
        )
        target = normalize_version_id(self.name_edit.text())
        target_dir = self.main.config.game_path / "versions" / target
        if target and target_dir.exists():
            self._attempted_version_id = target
            message = (
                f"{message}\n已保留这个版本里已经下载/解压的内容，"
                "再次点击“重新导入”会接着补全；已完成的文件不会重复处理。"
            )
        if cancelled:
            message = (
                "导入已取消。\n已保留已经下载/解压的内容，再次点击"
                "“重新导入”会接着补全；已完成的文件不会重复处理。"
                if target_dir.exists()
                else "导入已取消。可以再次点击“重新导入”重新开始。"
            )
        self._show_error(message)
        self.main.log(
            f"整合包任务{'已取消' if cancelled else '失败'}：{message}"
        )

    def _download_url(self) -> None:
        if self._mode != "idle":
            return
        url = self.url_edit.text().strip()
        if not url:
            self._show_error("链接是空的，猫猫找不到纸箱。")
            return
        self._hide_error()
        self._begin_busy("fetch")
        worker = PackFetchWorker(
            url,
            threads=self.main.config.download_threads,
            inspect_result=False,
            parent=None,
        )
        self._bind_download_center()
        self._task = self.main.download_center.start_worker(
            worker,
            title="下载整合包",
            content_type="pack-fetch",
            source="url",
            target=APP_DIR / "cache" / "packs",
            pack_mode=True,
            finished_adapter=self._fetch_result,
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _start_import(self) -> None:
        if self._mode != "idle" or not self._info:
            return
        target = normalize_version_id(self.name_edit.text())
        if not target:
            self._show_error("导入名称不能为空。")
            return
        version_dir = self.main.config.game_path / "versions" / target
        resume = bool(
            self._attempted_version_id
            and self._attempted_version_id == target
            and version_dir.exists()
        )
        if version_dir.exists() and not resume:
            suggestion = unique_version_id(self.main.config.game_path, target)
            self.name_edit.setText(suggestion)
            self._show_error(
                f"版本 {target} 已经存在。可以改用 {suggestion}，或先删除旧版本。"
            )
            return
        self._hide_error()
        # 记住本次尝试的目标，取消或失败后用同一个名字可以直接续传，
        # 不会被“目录已存在”挡在门外。
        self._attempted_version_id = target
        self._begin_busy("import")
        if self._kind == "modrinth":
            worker: (
                PackImportWorker
                | ModrinthPackImportWorker
                | CurseForgePackImportWorker
            ) = (
                ModrinthPackImportWorker(
                    self._info.path,
                    self.main.config.game_path,
                    target,
                    java_path=self.main.config.java_path,
                    overwrite=self.overwrite.isChecked(),
                    resume=resume,
                    isolated=self.main.config.version_isolation,
                    source=self.main.config.download_source,
                    threads=self.main.config.download_threads,
                    parent=self,
                )
            )
        elif self._kind == "curseforge":
            worker = CurseForgePackImportWorker(
                self._info.path,
                self.main.config.game_path,
                target,
                java_path=self.main.config.java_path,
                overwrite=self.overwrite.isChecked(),
                resume=resume,
                isolated=self.main.config.version_isolation,
                source=self.main.config.download_source,
                threads=self.main.config.download_threads,
                parent=self,
            )
        else:
            worker = PackImportWorker(
                self._info.path,
                self.main.config.game_path,
                target,
                overwrite=self.overwrite.isChecked(),
                resume=resume,
                isolated=self.main.config.version_isolation,
                source=self.main.config.download_source,
                threads=self.main.config.download_threads,
                parent=self,
            )
        self._bind_download_center()
        self._task = self.main.download_center.start_worker(
            worker,
            title=f"导入整合包 · {target}",
            content_type="modpack",
            source=self.main.config.download_source,
            target=version_dir,
        )

    def _begin_busy(self, mode: str) -> None:
        self._mode = mode
        self._hide_error()
        self._set_controls_enabled(False)
        self.progress.setValue(0)
        self.progress_box.setVisible(True)
        self.progress_text.setText(
            "正在下载纸箱…" if mode == "fetch" else "正在给猫窝腾位置…"
        )
        self.cancel_btn.setText("取消下载" if mode == "fetch" else "取消导入")
        self.cancel_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.import_btn.setEnabled(False)

    def _set_controls_enabled(self, enabled: bool) -> None:
        self.choose_btn.setEnabled(enabled)
        self.download_btn.setEnabled(enabled)
        self.url_edit.setEnabled(enabled)
        self.name_edit.setEnabled(enabled)
        self.overwrite.setEnabled(enabled)
        self.import_btn.setEnabled(enabled and self._info is not None)

    def _on_cancel(self) -> None:
        if self._mode != "idle" and self._task is not None:
            self.cancel_btn.setEnabled(False)
            self.progress_text.setText("正在收回猫爪…")
            self.main.download_center.cancel(self._task.id)
            return
        self.reject()

    def _show_error(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.error.setText(text)
        self.error.setVisible(True)

    def _clear_error(self) -> None:
        self.error.clear()
        self.error.setVisible(False)

    def _hide_error(self) -> None:
        self._clear_error()

    def reject(self) -> None:
        if self._mode != "idle" and self._task is not None:
            self._detach_download_center()
            self.main.toast(
                "任务已转到顶栏继续，可以继续操作启动器；点击顶栏进度查看任务",
                "info",
            )
        super().reject()

# 后台任务


class AIWorker(QObject):
    finished = Signal(str)
    failed = Signal(str)

    def __init__(self, request: str, config: ga.AIConfig, version: str, context: str, parent=None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.request = request
        self.config = config
        self.version = version
        self.context = context

    def start(self) -> None:
        threading.Thread(target=self._run, daemon=True).start()

    def _run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.finished.emit(
                ga.ai_generate_commands(self.request, self.config, self.version, self.context)
            )
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - 交给界面展示
            self.failed.emit(str(error))


class MCModWorker(QObject):
    finished = Signal(object)
    failed = Signal(str)

    def __init__(
        self, query: str, filter_id: int = 0, page: int = 1, parent=None
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.query = query
        self.filter_id = filter_id
        self.page = page

    def start(self) -> None:
        threading.Thread(target=self._run, daemon=True).start()

    def _run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.finished.emit(
                ga.search_mcmod_page(
                    self.query, filter_id=self.filter_id, page=self.page
                )
            )
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
            self.failed.emit(str(error))


class VersionRegistryWorker(QObject):
    """后台读取 Chunkbase 的版本列表，避免卡住界面。"""

    done = Signal(object, str, str)

    def __init__(self, force: bool = False, parent=None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.force = force

    def start(self) -> None:
        threading.Thread(target=self._run, daemon=True).start()

    def _run(self) -> None:
        try:
            groups, source = registry.load_groups(force=self.force)
            self.done.emit(groups, source, "")
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
            self.done.emit(None, "", str(error))
