    def _snapshot_target(self, notify: bool = False) -> tuple[str, Path] | None:
        version = str(
            getattr(self.main, "selected_version", "")
            or self.main.config.last_version
            or ""
        )
        if not version:
            if notify:
                self.main.toast("请先选择一个游戏版本", "info")
            return None
        game_path = Path(self.main.config.version_game_path(version))
        if not game_path.is_dir():
            if notify:
                self.main.toast(f"版本目录不存在：{version}", "error")
            return None
        return version, game_path

    def _refresh_snapshot_hint(self) -> None:
        if not hasattr(self, "snapshot_hint"):
            return
        target = self._snapshot_target()
        if target is None:
            self.snapshot_hint.setText("选择游戏版本后即可创建快照。")
            return
        version, game_path = target
        snapshots = list_snapshots(game_path)
        if not snapshots:
            self.snapshot_hint.setText(
                f"{version} · 还没有快照。安装新 Mod 或改配置前建议先备份一次。"
            )
            return
        latest = snapshots[0]
        self.snapshot_hint.setText(
            f"{version} · 共 {len(snapshots)} 个快照 · 最近 {latest.created_text}"
            f" · {latest.size_text}"
        )

    def _create_snapshot(self) -> None:
        if self._snapshot_create_worker is not None:
            self.main.toast("快照正在创建，请稍候", "info")
            return
        target = self._snapshot_target(notify=True)
        if target is None:
            return
        version, game_path = target
        worker = SnapshotCreateWorker(game_path, version, parent=self)
        self._snapshot_create_worker = worker
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_snapshot_created)
        self.snapshot_create_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.snapshot_create_btn.setText("正在打包…")
        self.main.set_status("正在创建世界与配置快照…", "busy")
        self.main.log(f"开始创建 {version} 的世界与配置快照")
        worker.start()

    def _on_snapshot_created(self, success: bool, message: str, info) -> None:
        self._snapshot_create_worker = None
        self.snapshot_create_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.snapshot_create_btn.setText("创建快照")
        if not success:
            self.main.set_status(f"快照创建失败：{message}", "error")
            self.main.toast(f"快照创建失败：{message}", "error")
            return
        self.main.set_status("世界与配置快照已创建", "success")
        self.main.toast(f"快照已保存 · {info.size_text}", "success")
        self.main.log(
            f"快照已创建：{info.path.name}（{info.files} 个文件，"
            f"{info.size_text}）"
        )
        self._refresh_snapshot_hint()

    def _open_snapshot_dialog(self) -> None:
        target = self._snapshot_target(notify=True)
        if target is None:
            return
        version, game_path = target
        dialog = SnapshotDialog(self, game_path, version)
        dialog.restore_requested.connect(
            lambda path: self._restore_snapshot(Path(path), game_path, version)
        )
        dialog.exec()

    def _restore_snapshot(
        self, archive_path: Path, game_path: Path, version: str
    ) -> None:
        if self._snapshot_restore_worker is not None:
            self.main.toast("正在恢复快照，请稍候", "info")
            return
        worker = SnapshotRestoreWorker(archive_path, game_path, parent=self)
        self._snapshot_restore_worker = worker
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_snapshot_restored)
        self.snapshot_create_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.snapshot_manage_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.main.set_status("正在恢复世界与配置…", "busy")
        self.main.log(f"开始恢复 {version} 的快照：{archive_path.name}")
        worker.start()

    def _on_snapshot_restored(self, success: bool, message: str, count: int) -> None:
        self._snapshot_restore_worker = None
        self.snapshot_create_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.snapshot_manage_btn.setEnabled(True)
        if not success:
            self.main.set_status(f"快照恢复失败：{message}", "error")
            self.main.toast(f"快照恢复失败：{message}", "error")
            return
        self.main.set_status(f"已恢复 {count} 个文件", "success")
        self.main.toast(f"快照已恢复 · {count} 个文件", "success")
        self.main.log(f"快照恢复完成，共 {count} 个文件")
        self._refresh_snapshot_hint()

    def _open_snapshot_folder(self) -> None:
        target = self._snapshot_target(notify=True)
        if target is None:
            return
        _version, game_path = target
        folder = snapshot_dir(game_path)
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl.fromLocalFile(str(folder)))

    def _diagnostics_context(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
        version = str(
            getattr(self.main, "selected_version", "")
            or self.main.config.last_version
            or ""
        )
        loader = self.main.config.loader_for(version) if version else ""
        return version, loader

    def _start_diagnostics(self, bundle: bool) -> None:
        if self._diagnostics_worker is not None:
            self.main.toast("诊断任务正在进行，请稍候", "info")
            return
        version, loader = self._diagnostics_context()
        worker = DiagnosticsWorker(
            self.main.config,
            self.main.java_installs,
            version,
            loader,
            bundle=bundle,
            parent=self,
        )
        self._diagnostics_worker = worker
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_diagnostics_finished)
        self.diagnostics_copy_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.diagnostics_bundle_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.diagnostics_bundle_btn.setText("正在收集…" if bundle else "生成诊断包")
        self.main.set_status("正在收集诊断信息…", "busy")
        worker.start()

    def _copy_diagnostics(self) -> None:
        self._start_diagnostics(bundle=False)

    def _create_diagnostics(self) -> None:
        self._start_diagnostics(bundle=True)

    def _on_diagnostics_finished(
        self, success: bool, message: str, payload
    ) -> None:
        self._diagnostics_worker = None
        self.diagnostics_copy_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.diagnostics_bundle_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.diagnostics_bundle_btn.setText("生成诊断包")
        if not success or not isinstance(payload, dict):
            self.main.set_status(f"诊断信息生成失败：{message}", "error")
            self.main.toast(f"诊断信息生成失败：{message}", "error")
            return
        summary = str(payload.get("summary") or "")
        path = payload.get("path")
        if path is None:
            QApplication.clipboard().setText(summary)
            self.main.set_status("诊断信息已复制", "success")
            self.main.toast("诊断信息已复制到剪贴板", "success")
            self.main.log("诊断信息已复制到剪贴板")
            return
        self.main.set_status("诊断包已生成", "success")
        self.main.log(f"诊断包已生成：{path}")
        self.main.toast("诊断包已生成", "success")
        self.diagnostics_hint.setText(
            f"最近诊断包：{path}\n"
            "诊断包已隐藏访问令牌、刷新令牌和樱花 Token；"
            "不包含账户密码、世界存档、皮肤文件与 Mod 本体。"
        )

    def _open_diagnostics_folder(self) -> None:
        folder = APP_DIR / "diagnostics"
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl.fromLocalFile(str(folder)))

    def _confirm_safe_mode(self) -> None:
        if self.main.game_running or self.main.launch_active:
            self.main.toast("游戏正在运行或启动中", "info")
            return
        target = self._snapshot_target(notify=True)
        if target is None:
            return
        version, _game_path = target
        dialog = ConfirmDialog(
            self,
            "安全模式启动",
            "将临时禁用当前版本的全部 Mod 后启动游戏，"
            "用来判断闪退是否由 Mod 引起。游戏退出或启动失败后会自动恢复。",
            primary_text="安全模式启动",
            secondary_text="取消",
            icon_name="warning",
            icon_color=colors()["orange"],
            details=f"版本：{version}\nMod 目录：{self.main.config.mods_path(version)}",
        )
        if dialog.exec():
            self.main.launch_safe_mode()

    def refresh_developer_state(self) -> None:
        if not hasattr(self, "developer_badge"):
            return
        unlocked = bool(getattr(self.main.config, "developer_unlocked", False))
        self.developer_badge.setText("已解锁" if unlocked else "未解锁")
        self.developer_badge.setProperty("badge", "green" if unlocked else "gray")
        repolish(self.developer_badge)
        self.developer_unlock_row.setVisible(not unlocked)
        self.developer_actions.setVisible(unlocked)
        if unlocked:
            self.developer_hint.setText(
                "开发者模式已开启。网站反馈表只能从启动器这里的入口打开；"
                "反馈内容由下载站读取 GitHub Issues 展示。"
            )
            self.developer_status.setText("")
        else:
            self.developer_hint.setText(
                "开发者模式会显示 DEV 标记、解锁开发者台词，并允许从启动器打开网站反馈表。"
                "输入开发者口令后开启，口令只在本机校验，不会上传。"
            )

    def _unlock_developer(self) -> None:
        key = self.developer_key_edit.text().strip()
        if not key:
            self.developer_status.setText("先输入开发者口令。")
            self.developer_status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['red']}; font-size: 11px;")
            return
        if not verify_developer_key(key):
            self.developer_status.setText("口令不正确，开发者模式没有开启。")
            self.developer_status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['red']}; font-size: 11px;")
            self.developer_key_edit.selectAll()
            self.developer_key_edit.setFocus()
            return
        unlock_developer(self.main.config, key)
        self.main.config.save()
        self.developer_key_edit.clear()
        self.refresh_developer_state()
        self.developer_status.setText("开发者模式已解锁。")
        self.developer_status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['green']}; font-size: 11px;")
        if hasattr(self.main, "_update_account"):
            self.main._update_account()
        try:
            self.main.toast("开发者模式已解锁", "success")
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _lock_developer(self) -> None:
        lock_developer(self.main.config)
        self.main.config.save()
        self.refresh_developer_state()
        self.developer_status.setText("已退出开发者模式。")
        self.developer_status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['muted']}; font-size: 11px;")
        if hasattr(self.main, "_update_account"):
            self.main._update_account()
        try:
            self.main.toast("已退出开发者模式", "info")
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _open_feedback_table(self) -> None:
        if not bool(getattr(self.main.config, "developer_unlocked", False)):
            return
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(feedback_table_url(self.main.config)))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def refresh_account(self) -> None:
        account = self.main.current_account()
        current_client_id = str(
            self.main.config.microsoft_client_id or ""
        ).strip()
        stored_client_id = (
            str(getattr(account, "client_id", "") or "").strip()
            if account.is_msa
            else ""
        )
        self.client_edit.setText(current_client_id)
        self.email_edit.setText(self.main.config.microsoft_email)
        if stored_client_id and stored_client_id != current_client_id:
            self.client_note.setText(
                f"当前账户登录时使用的是 {stored_client_id}，"
                "刷新令牌会继续用它；重新登录才会换成上方 ID。"
            )
            self.client_note.setVisible(True)
        else:
            self.client_note.setVisible(False)
        self._update_legacy_note()
        if account.is_msa:
            self.account_badge.setText("微软正版")
            self.account_badge.setProperty("badge", "green")
            self.account_name.setText(account.name or "正版账户")
            uid = account.uuid or ""
            self.account_uuid.setText(
                f"UUID {uid[:8]}…{uid[-4:]}" if uid else "已登录 Microsoft 账户"
            )
            self.login_btn.setText("重新登录")
            self.verify_btn.setVisible(False)
            self.logout_btn.setVisible(True)
        elif account.is_littleskin:
            self.account_badge.setText("LittleSkin")
            self.account_badge.setProperty("badge", "blue")
            self.account_name.setText(account.name or "LittleSkin 角色")
            uid = account.uuid or ""
            self.account_uuid.setText(
                f"LittleSkin 角色 · UUID {uid[:8]}…{uid[-4:]}"
                if uid
                else "已登录 LittleSkin，启动时使用该角色"
            )
            self.login_btn.setText("Microsoft 登录")
            self.verify_btn.setVisible(False)
            self.logout_btn.setVisible(True)
        else:
            self.account_badge.setText("离线模式")
            self.account_badge.setProperty("badge", "gray")
            self.account_name.setText(f"离线账户 · {self.main.config.player_name}")
            self.account_uuid.setText(
                "未登录游戏账户，启动时使用上面的离线名称。"
            )
            self.login_btn.setText("邮箱登录")
            self.verify_btn.setVisible(True)
            self.logout_btn.setVisible(False)
        self.littleskin_btn.setText(
            "切换 LittleSkin" if account.is_littleskin else "LittleSkin 登录"
        )
        repolish(self.account_badge)

    def _update_legacy_note(self) -> None:
        legacy = is_legacy_client_id(self.client_edit.text())
        self.legacy_note.setVisible(legacy)
        self.login_btn.setToolTip(
            "当前是 16 位旧版应用 ID，将使用验证码登录"
            if legacy
            else "打开系统浏览器，用 Microsoft 邮箱登录，授权完成后自动返回"
        )

    def _save_client_id(self) -> None:
        value = self.client_edit.text().strip()
        self._update_legacy_note()
        if value == self.main.config.microsoft_client_id:
            return
        self.main.config.microsoft_client_id = value
        self.main.config.save()

    def _save_email(self) -> None:
        value = self.email_edit.text().strip()
        if value == self.main.config.microsoft_email:
            return
        self.main.config.microsoft_email = value
        self.main.config.save()

    def _open_azure_portal(self) -> None:
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(
            QUrl(
                "https://portal.azure.com/#view/"
                "Microsoft_AAD_RegisteredApps/ApplicationsListBlade"
            )
        )

    def _login_microsoft(self) -> None:
        self._save_client_id()
        self._save_email()
        client_id = self.main.config.microsoft_client_id
        if is_legacy_client_id(client_id):
            # 16 位应用 ID 走不了浏览器回调，直接使用验证码流程。
            dialog = MicrosoftLoginDialog(self.main, client_id)
        else:
            dialog = BrowserLoginDialog(
                self.main,
                client_id,
                self.main.config.microsoft_email,
            )
        accepted = dialog.exec()
        # 登录窗口里可能改过客户端 ID，回到设置页时同步显示。
        self.client_edit.setText(self.main.config.microsoft_client_id)
        self._update_legacy_note()
        if accepted and dialog.account is not None:
            self._apply_account(dialog.account)

    def _login_device_code(self) -> None:
        self._save_client_id()
        dialog = MicrosoftLoginDialog(
            self.main, self.main.config.microsoft_client_id
        )
        accepted = dialog.exec()
        self.client_edit.setText(self.main.config.microsoft_client_id)
        self._update_legacy_note()
        if accepted and dialog.account is not None:
            self._apply_account(dialog.account)

    def _apply_account(self, account) -> None:
        self.main.config.account = account.to_config()
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.account_changed.emit()
        self.main.toast(f"已登录 Microsoft 账户：{account.name}", "success")

    def _login_littleskin(self) -> None:
        dialog = LittleSkinLoginDialog(self.main)
        if not dialog.exec() or dialog.account is None:
            return
        account = dialog.account
        self.main.apply_littleskin_account(account)
        self.main.toast(
            f"已登录 LittleSkin：{account.name}，该角色将用于启动游戏",
            "success",
        )

    def _logout_account(self) -> None:
        account = self.main.current_account()
        if account.is_littleskin:
            name = account.name or "LittleSkin 角色"
            dialog = ConfirmDialog(
                self.main,
                "退出 LittleSkin 账户",
                f"将退出 LittleSkin 角色「{name}」，并改回离线账户启动游戏。",
                primary_text="退出登录",
                secondary_text="取消",
                icon_name="warning",
                details="皮肤库中已经同步的皮肤会保留，不会删除本地图片。",
            )
            if not dialog.exec():
                return
            clear_littleskin_account(self.main.config)
            self.main.config.account = {}
            self.main.config.save()
            self.main.account_changed.emit()
            self.main.toast("已退出 LittleSkin 账户", "info")
            return
        if not account.is_msa:
            return
        dialog = ConfirmDialog(
            self.main,
            "退出正版账户",
            "退出后将以离线账户启动游戏，正版服务器将无法进入。确定退出吗？",
            primary_text="退出登录",
            secondary_text="取消",
            icon_name="warning",
        )
        if not dialog.exec():
            return
        self.main.config.account = {}
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.account_changed.emit()
        self.main.toast("已退出正版账户", "info")

    def _save_background(self, checked: bool) -> None:
        checked = bool(checked)
        if checked == bool(getattr(self.main.config, "background_enabled", True)):
            return
        self.main.config.background_enabled = checked
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.apply_background_setting()
        if checked and not self.main.background_active():
            self.main.toast("系统托盘不可用，关闭窗口仍会退出", "info")
            return
        self.main.toast(
            "关闭窗口后将留在后台运行" if checked else "关闭窗口将直接退出",
            "success" if checked else "info",
        )

    def _save_isolation(self, checked: bool) -> None:
        checked = bool(checked)
        if checked == bool(self.main.config.version_isolation):
            return
        self.main.config.version_isolation = checked
        self.main.config.save()
        if hasattr(self.main, "mods_page"):
            self.main.mods_page.on_show()
        self.main.toast(
            "版本隔离已开启，新的 Mod 会进入版本目录"
            if checked
            else "版本隔离已关闭，将使用游戏目录下的公共 mods",
            "success",
        )

    def _browse_game_dir(self) -> None:
        folder = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(
            self, "选择 .minecraft 文件夹", str(self.main.config.game_path)
        )
        if not folder:
            return
        self.main.config.game_dir = folder
        self.main.config.save()
        self.game_dir.setText(folder)
        self.main.refresh_versions()
        self.main.toast("游戏目录已更新", "success")

    def _save_name(self) -> None:
        name = self.name_edit.text().strip()
        if name == self.main.config.player_name:
            return
        if not valid_player_name(name):
            self.main.toast("名称需为 3-16 位字母、数字或下划线", "error")
            self.name_edit.setText(self.main.config.player_name)
            return
        self.main.config.player_name = name
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.account_changed.emit()
        self.main.toast("玩家名称已更新", "success")

    def _on_memory(self, value: int) -> None:
        value = int(round(value / 512) * 512)
        self.memory_value.setText(f"{value} MB · {value / 1024:.1f} GB")
        if value != self.main.config.memory_mb:
            self.main.config.memory_mb = value
            if hasattr(self, "_save_timer"):
                self._save_timer.start(350)

    def _populate_java(self, installs: list[JavaInfo]) -> None:
        self.java_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self.java_combo.clear()
        self.java_combo.addItem("自动选择（推荐）", "")
        paths: set[str] = set()
        for info in installs:
            self.java_combo.addItem(info.display, info.path)
            paths.add(info.path.lower())
        config_path = self.main.config.java_path
        if config_path and config_path.lower() not in paths:
            self.java_combo.addItem(
                f"手动指定 · {config_path}", config_path
            )
        if config_path:
            index = self.java_combo.findData(config_path)
            if index >= 0:
                self.java_combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
        self.java_combo.blockSignals(False)

        if installs:
            self.java_hint.setText(
                f"已检测到 {len(installs)} 个 Java。"
                "启动时会自动选择满足版本要求的最低版本。"
            )
        else:
            self.java_hint.setText(
                "未检测到 Java。请安装 Java 运行环境，或手动选择 java.exe。"
            )
        self._update_java_requirement()

    def _update_java_requirement(self) -> None:
        profile_id, _instance_id = self.main.launch_profile(
            self.main.selected_version
        )
        summary = next(
            (v for v in self.main.versions if v.id == profile_id),
            None,
        )
        if summary and summary.java_major and self.main.java_installs:
            self.java_hint.setText(
                f"当前版本 {self.main.selected_version or summary.id} 需要 Java "
                f"{summary.java_major}+，"
                f"已检测到 {len(self.main.java_installs)} 个 Java。"
            )

    def _on_java_changed(self, _index: int) -> None:
        path = self.java_combo.currentData() or ""
        if path == self.main.config.java_path:
            return
        self.main.config.java_path = path
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.toast("Java 设置已保存", "success")

    def _browse_java(self) -> None:
        path, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self, "选择 java.exe", "", "Java 可执行文件 (java.exe);;所有文件 (*)"
        )
        if not path:
            return
        info = probe_java(path)
        if info is None:
            self.main.toast("无法运行该 Java，请确认路径是否正确", "error")
            return
        self.main.config.java_path = path
        self.main.config.save()
        self._populate_java(self.main.java_installs)
        self.main.toast(f"已选择 Java {info.version}", "success")

    def _rescan_java(self) -> None:
        self.java_hint.setText("正在检测 Java…")
        self.main.ensure_java_detected(force=True)

    def _save_jvm_args(self) -> None:
        text = self.jvm_edit.text().strip()
        if text != self.main.config.jvm_args:
            self.main.config.jvm_args = text
            self.main.config.save()
            self.main.toast("JVM 参数已保存", "success")

    def _save_source(self, _index: int) -> None:
        source = self.source_combo.currentData() or "official"
        if source == self.main.config.download_source:
            return
        self.main.config.download_source = source
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.toast("下载源已更新，下次安装生效", "success")

    def _save_threads(self, _index: int) -> None:
        value = int(self.thread_combo.currentData() or 8)
        value = max(1, min(16, value))
        if value == self.main.config.download_threads:
            return
        self.main.config.download_threads = value
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.toast(f"下载线程已设为 {value}，下次下载生效", "success")

    def refresh_shortcut_state(self) -> None:
        from ...shortcut import shortcut_exists

        exists = shortcut_exists()
        self.shortcut_btn.setText(
            "重新创建快捷方式" if exists else "创建桌面快捷方式"
        )
        self.shortcut_btn.setToolTip(
            "覆盖桌面上已有的同名快捷方式"
            if exists
            else "在桌面创建 Darkitten Launcher 快捷方式"
        )

    def _create_shortcut(self) -> None:
        self.main.create_desktop_shortcut()

    def _cleanup_partials(self) -> None:
        if self._cleanup_worker is not None:
            return
        if self.main.install_active:
            self.main.toast("有安装任务正在进行，请先完成或取消安装", "info")
            return
        root = self.main.config.game_path
        dialog = ConfirmDialog(
            self,
            "清理下载残留",
            "将扫描游戏目录，删除未完成的 .part 分片临时文件。"
            "已下载完成的文件不会受影响。",
            primary_text="开始清理",
            secondary_text="取消",
            icon_name="trash",
            icon_color=colors()["orange"],
            details=f"扫描目录：{root}",
        )
        if not dialog.exec():
            return
        self.cleanup_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.cleanup_btn.setText("正在清理…")
        self.main.set_status("正在清理下载残留…", "busy")
        worker = CleanupWorker(root, self)
        self._cleanup_worker = worker
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_cleanup_finished)
        worker.start()

    def _on_cleanup_finished(self, removed: int, freed: int) -> None:
        self._cleanup_worker = None
        self.cleanup_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.cleanup_btn.setText("清理下载残留")
        if removed:
            size = (
                f"{freed / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB"
                if freed >= 1024 * 1024
                else f"{max(0, freed) / 1024:.0f} KB"
            )
            self.main.set_status(f"已清理 {removed} 个下载残留", "success")
            self.main.toast(f"已清理 {removed} 个临时文件（{size}）", "success")
        else:
            self.main.set_status("没有发现下载残留", "idle")
            self.main.toast("没有发现未完成的下载文件", "info")

    def _save_theme(self, theme_value: str) -> None:
        if theme_value == self.main.config.theme:
            return
        self.main.config.theme = theme_value
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.apply_theme(theme_value)

    def _save_auto(self, checked: bool) -> None:
        if bool(self.main.config.auto_complete) == bool(checked):
            return
        self.main.config.auto_complete = bool(checked)
        self.main.config.save()

    def refresh_update_state(self) -> None:
        if not hasattr(self, "update_status"):
            return
        palette = {
            "idle": colors()["muted"],
            "busy": colors()["accent"],
            "accent": colors()["accent"],
            "success": colors()["green"],
            "error": colors()["red"],
        }
        color = palette.get(self.main.update_state_kind, colors()["muted"])
        self.update_status.setText(self.main.update_state_text)
        self.update_status.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {color}; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;"
        )
        last = str(self.main.config.update_last_check or "").strip()
        self.update_status.setToolTip(
            f"上次检查：{last}" if last else "还没有检查过更新"
        )
        busy = bool(getattr(self.main, "_update_busy", False))
        self.update_btn.setEnabled(not busy)
        self.update_btn.setText("正在检查…" if busy else "检查更新")
        self.update_auto_switch.setChecked(
            bool(self.main.config.update_auto_check)
        )
        self.update_url_edit.setText(DEFAULT_UPDATE_URL)

    def _check_updates(self) -> None:
        self.main.check_for_updates(manual=True)

    def _open_update_site(self) -> None:
        self.main.open_update_site()

    def _save_update_auto(self, checked: bool) -> None:
        if bool(self.main.config.update_auto_check) == bool(checked):
            return
        self.main.config.update_auto_check = bool(checked)
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.toast(
            "启动时会自动检查更新" if checked else "已关闭启动时自动检查更新",
            "success",
        )

    def on_show(self) -> None:
        self.refresh_account()
        self.isolation_switch.setChecked(bool(self.main.config.version_isolation))
        if hasattr(self, "background_switch"):
            self.background_switch.setChecked(
                bool(getattr(self.main.config, "background_enabled", True))
            )
        source_index = self.source_combo.findData(self.main.config.download_source)
        self.source_combo.setCurrentIndex(max(0, source_index))
        thread_index = self.thread_combo.findData(self.main.config.download_threads)
        if thread_index >= 0:
            self.thread_combo.setCurrentIndex(thread_index)
        self._populate_java(self.main.java_installs)
        self.refresh_shortcut_state()
        self.refresh_update_state()
        self._refresh_snapshot_hint()
        self.refresh_developer_state()
        self.main.ensure_java_detected()

def _rounded_face(image: QImage, size: int = 48) -> QPixmap:
    if image.isNull():
        image = default_skin()
    face = image.copy(8, 8, 8, 8)
    scaled = face.scaled(
        size, size, Qt.IgnoreAspectRatio, Qt.FastTransformation
    )
    canvas = QImage(size, size, QImage.Format_ARGB32)
    canvas.fill(Qt.transparent)
    painter = QPainter(canvas)
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing, True)
    path = QPainterPath()
    path.addRoundedRect(0.5, 0.5, size - 1, size - 1, 11, 11)
    painter.setClipPath(path)
    painter.drawImage(0, 0, scaled)
    painter.end()
    return QPixmap.fromImage(canvas)


class LibrarySkinCard(QFrame):
    """皮肤库中的一个皮肤卡片。"""

    use_requested = Signal(str)
    delete_requested = Signal(str)
    rename_requested = Signal(str)

    def __init__(
        self,
        entry: LibrarySkin,
        image: QImage,
        active: bool,
        parent: QWidget | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.entry = entry
        self.setObjectName("SoftCard")
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
        self.setMinimumHeight(132)
        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Fixed)
        tip = [
            f"名称：{entry.name}",
            f"尺寸：{'64×32 旧版' if entry.legacy else '64×64'}",
            f"模型：{'Slim' if entry.variant == 'slim' else 'Classic'}",
        ]
        if entry.source:
            tip.append(f"来源：{entry.source}")
        self.setToolTip("\n".join(tip))

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(9, 9, 9, 9)
        layout.setSpacing(6)

        top = QHBoxLayout()
        top.setSpacing(9)
        thumb = QLabel()
        thumb.setFixedSize(68, 68)
        thumb.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
        thumb.setStyleSheet(
            f"background: {colors()['card']}; border: 1px solid {colors()['border']};"
            " border-radius: 9px;"
        )
        if not image.isNull():
            thumb.setPixmap(
                QPixmap.fromImage(image).scaled(
                    64,
                    64,
                    Qt.KeepAspectRatio,
                    Qt.FastTransformation,
                )
            )
        top.addWidget(thumb)

        info = QVBoxLayout()
        info.setSpacing(3)
        name = QLabel(entry.name)
        name.setWordWrap(True)
        name.setMaximumHeight(36)
        name.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px;")
        info.addWidget(name)

        badges = QHBoxLayout()
        badges.setSpacing(4)
        badges.addWidget(
            badge("Slim" if entry.variant == "slim" else "Classic",
                  "purple" if entry.variant == "slim" else "gray")
        )
        if entry.legacy:
            badges.addWidget(badge("64×32", "orange"))
        if active:
            badges.addWidget(badge("使用中", "green"))
        badges.addStretch(1)
        info.addLayout(badges)

        added = ""
        if entry.added:
            try:
                added = datetime.fromtimestamp(entry.added).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
            except (OSError, ValueError, OverflowError):
                added = ""
        meta = QLabel(added or "本地皮肤")
        meta.setObjectName("Tiny")
        info.addWidget(meta)
        info.addStretch(1)
        top.addLayout(info, 1)
        layout.addLayout(top)

        actions = QHBoxLayout()
        actions.setSpacing(4)
        use_btn = QPushButton("使用中" if active else "使用")
        use_btn.setObjectName("Soft" if not active else "Ghost")
        use_btn.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        use_btn.setEnabled(not active)
        use_btn.clicked.connect(lambda: self.use_requested.emit(self.entry.id))
        rename_btn = icon_button(
            "edit", "重命名皮肤", colors()["text2"], 30, 16
        )
        rename_btn.setObjectName("SkinAction")
        rename_btn.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self.rename_requested.emit(self.entry.id)
        )
        delete_btn = icon_button(
            "trash", "从皮肤库移除", colors()["red"], 30, 16
        )
        delete_btn.setObjectName("SkinAction")
        delete_btn.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self.delete_requested.emit(self.entry.id)
        )
        actions.addWidget(use_btn)
        actions.addStretch(1)
        actions.addWidget(rename_btn)
        actions.addWidget(delete_btn)
        layout.addLayout(actions)

    def _on_preview_action(self, action: str) -> None:
        self.preview.set_action(action)

    def _fit_preview(self) -> None:
        """按窗口高度收缩预览，保证小窗口首屏能看到完整模型。"""
        if not hasattr(self, "preview") or not hasattr(self, "_preview_card"):
            return
        viewport = self.scroll.viewport()
        height = viewport.height() if viewport.height() > 200 else self.height()
        target = int(max(210, min(430, height - 350)))
        if self.preview.height() != target:
            self.preview.setFixedHeight(target)
            self._preview_card.updateGeometry()
        width = viewport.width() if viewport.width() > 300 else self.width()
        card_width = int(max(300, min(438, width * 0.47)))
        if self._preview_card.width() != card_width:
            self._preview_card.setFixedWidth(card_width)
        if (
            hasattr(self, "_community_card")
            and self._community_card.width() != card_width
        ):
            self._community_card.setFixedWidth(card_width)

    def resizeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        self._fit_preview()

        home.setIcon(icons.icon("external", colors()["text2"], 15))
        home.clicked.connect(lambda: self._open_url(FORUM_URL))
        forum_row.addWidget(skin_forum)
        forum_row.addWidget(home)
        forum_row.addStretch(1)
        layout.addLayout(forum_row)

        self._refresh_littleskin()
        return card

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _load_initial_skin(self) -> None:
        try:
            ensure_library(self.main.config)
        except Exception:
            pass
        self._refresh_library()

        candidates: list[Path] = []
        configured = self.main.config.skin_path.strip()
        if configured:
            candidates.append(Path(configured))
        local = local_skin_path()
        if local not in candidates:
            candidates.append(local)

        for path in candidates:
            if not path.is_file():
                continue
            try:
                skin = load_skin_file(path)
            except SkinError as exc:
                self._set_status(str(exc), "error")
                continue
            self._skin_file = skin
            if skin.legacy and self.variant_tabs.current() == "slim":
                self._set_variant_silently("classic")
                self.main.config.skin_variant = "classic"
                self.main.config.save()
            self._show_skin(skin.image, skin.legacy)
            self.file_edit.setText(str(path))
            self.file_edit.setToolTip(str(path))
            return

        self._show_skin(default_skin(), False)
        self.current_label.setText("使用默认皮肤预览。导入 PNG 后会自动加入皮肤库。")

    def _active_skin_path(self) -> Path | None:
        configured = str(self.main.config.skin_path or "").strip()
        if configured:
            path = Path(configured)
            if path.is_file():
                return path
        local = local_skin_path()
        if local.is_file():
            return local
        return None

    def _refresh_library(self) -> None:
        if not hasattr(self, "library_grid"):
            return
        while self.library_grid.count():
            item = self.library_grid.takeAt(0)
            widget = item.widget()
            if widget is not None:
                widget.deleteLater()
        entries = list_skins()
        active = self._active_skin_path()
        for index, entry in enumerate(entries):
            card = LibrarySkinCard(
                entry,
                load_entry_image(entry),
                path_matches(entry, active),
            )
            card.use_requested.connect(self._use_library_skin)
            card.delete_requested.connect(self._delete_library_skin)
            card.rename_requested.connect(self._rename_library_skin)
            self.library_grid.addWidget(card, index // 3, index % 3)
        self.library_empty.setVisible(not entries)
        self.library_count.setText(f"{len(entries)} 款")

    def _show_skin(self, image: QImage, legacy: bool) -> None:
        self.preview.set_skin(image, legacy)
        self.preview.set_variant(self.main.config.skin_variant)
        self.size_badge.setText("64×32 · 旧版" if legacy else "64×64")
        self.size_badge.setProperty("badge", "orange" if legacy else "blue")
        self._update_model_badge()
        self.face_label.setPixmap(_rounded_face(image, 48))
        repolish(self.size_badge)

    def _update_model_badge(self) -> None:
        variant = self.variant_tabs.current()
        self.model_badge.setText("Slim" if variant == "slim" else "Classic")
        self.model_badge.setProperty("badge", "purple" if variant == "slim" else "gray")
        repolish(self.model_badge)

    def _set_variant_silently(self, value: str) -> None:
        """程序化切换模型时不写入皮肤库，避免误改其他皮肤条目。"""
        self._syncing_variant = True
        try:
            self.variant_tabs.set_value(value)
        finally:
            self._syncing_variant = False

    def _activate_entry(
        self,
        entry: LibrarySkin,
        skin: SkinFile,
        *,
        original: str = "",
        announce: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        self._skin_file = skin
        legacy_note = ""
        if skin.legacy:
            value = "classic"
            legacy_note = " 旧版 64×32 皮肤只支持 Classic 模型。"
        elif entry.variant == "slim":
            value = "slim"
        else:
            value = self.variant_tabs.current()
        if self.variant_tabs.current() != value:
            self._set_variant_silently(value)
        self.main.config.skin_variant = value
        self.main.config.skin_path = str(entry.path)
        self.main.config.save()

        preview_note = ""
        try:
            sync_preview_copy(entry)
        except SkinLibraryError as exc:
            preview_note = f" 预览副本同步失败：{exc}"

        self._show_skin(skin.image, skin.legacy)
        self.file_edit.setText(original or str(entry.path))
        tooltip = f"皮肤库：{entry.path}"
        if entry.source:
            tooltip += f"\n原始文件：{entry.source}"
        self.file_edit.setToolTip(tooltip)

        account = self.main.current_account()
        if account.is_msa:
            self.current_label.setText(
                f"已选择皮肤库中的「{entry.name}」。"
                "点击“上传并使用”同步到正版账户。"
                + legacy_note
            )
            status = f"已切换到皮肤：{entry.name}{legacy_note}"
        elif account.is_littleskin:
            self.current_label.setText(
                f"已选择皮肤库中的「{entry.name}」，当前仅用于本地预览。"
                "LittleSkin 游戏内皮肤由 LittleSkin 衣柜决定。"
                + legacy_note
            )
            status = f"已选择 LittleSkin 预览皮肤：{entry.name}{legacy_note}"
        else:
            self.current_label.setText(
                f"离线皮肤「{entry.name}」已启用。"
                "启动游戏时会通过本地皮肤服务加载，不需要正版账户。"
                + legacy_note
            )
            status = f"离线皮肤已启用：{entry.name}{legacy_note}"
        self._set_status(status + preview_note, "success" if not preview_note else "info")
        self._refresh_library()
        self._update_buttons()
        self.main.account_changed.emit()
        if announce:
            self.main.toast(status, "success")

    def _apply_local_file(self, path: str | Path, *, original: str = "") -> None:
        source = original or str(path)
        try:
            skin = load_skin_file(path)
            entry = add_skin(
                skin,
                name=Path(source).stem,
                variant=self.variant_tabs.current(),
                source=source,
            )
        except (SkinError, SkinLibraryError) as exc:
            self._set_status(str(exc), "error")
            self.main.toast(str(exc), "error")
            return
        self._activate_entry(entry, skin, original=source, announce=False)
        self._set_status(f"已加入皮肤库并切换：{entry.name}", "success")

    def _import_to_library(self, path: str | Path) -> None:
        try:
            entry = import_path(
                path,
                variant=self.variant_tabs.current(),
            )
        except (SkinError, SkinLibraryError) as exc:
            self._set_status(f"{Path(path).name}：{exc}", "error")
            self.main.toast(f"无法加入皮肤库：{exc}", "error")
            return
        self._refresh_library()
        self._set_status(f"已加入皮肤库：{entry.name}", "success")
        self.main.toast(f"已加入皮肤库：{entry.name}", "success")

    def _use_library_skin(self, entry_id: str) -> None:
        entry = get_skin(entry_id)
        if entry is None:
            self._set_status("皮肤库中找不到这个皮肤，列表已刷新。", "error")
            self._refresh_library()
            return
        try:
            skin = load_skin_file(entry.path)
        except SkinError as exc:
            self._set_status(str(exc), "error")
            self.main.toast(str(exc), "error")
            self._refresh_library()
            return
        self._activate_entry(entry, skin)

    def _delete_library_skin(self, entry_id: str) -> None:
        entry = get_skin(entry_id)
        if entry is None:
            self._refresh_library()
            return
        active = path_matches(entry, self.main.config.skin_path)
        dialog = ConfirmDialog(
            self.main,
            "从皮肤库移除",
            f"将把「{entry.name}」从皮肤库中移除。",
            primary_text="移除",
            secondary_text="取消",
            icon_name="trash",
            icon_color=colors()["red"],
            details=(
                "只会删除启动器皮肤库中的副本，不会修改你导入的原始图片。"
                + (" 这是当前正在使用的皮肤，移除后会恢复默认皮肤。" if active else "")
            ),
        )
        if not dialog.exec():
            return
        if active:
            self.main.config.skin_path = ""
            self.main.config.save()
            self._skin_file = None
            self.file_edit.clear()
            self.file_edit.setToolTip("")
            self._show_skin(default_skin(), False)
            self.current_label.setText(
                "已移除当前皮肤，恢复默认预览。可以重新选择皮肤库中的其他皮肤。"
            )
            try:
                local_skin_path().unlink(missing_ok=True)
            except OSError:
                pass
            self.main.account_changed.emit()
        ok, message = delete_skin(entry.id, to_recycle_bin=True)
        self._refresh_library()
        self._update_buttons()
        if ok:
            self._set_status(message, "success")
            self.main.toast(message, "success")
        else:
            self._set_status(message, "error")
            self.main.toast(message, "error")

    def _rename_library_skin(self, entry_id: str) -> None:
        entry = get_skin(entry_id)
        if entry is None:
            self._refresh_library()
            return
        name, ok = QInputDialog.getText(
            self,
            "重命名皮肤",
            "给这套皮肤起个名字：",
            text=entry.name,
        )
        if not ok:
            return
        clean = str(name or "").strip()
        if not clean:
            self._set_status("皮肤名称不能为空。", "error")
            return
        updated = rename_skin(entry.id, clean)
        self._refresh_library()
        if updated is not None:
            self._set_status(f"已重命名：{updated.name}", "success")

    def _choose_skin(self) -> None:
        start = str(Path.home() / "Pictures")
        configured = self.main.config.skin_path.strip()
        if configured:
            parent = Path(configured).parent
            if parent.is_dir():
                start = str(parent)
        paths, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileNames(
            self,
            "导入 Minecraft 皮肤",
            start,
            "Minecraft 皮肤 (*.png)",
        )
        if not paths:
            return
        self._apply_local_file(paths[0], original=paths[0])
        for extra in paths[1:]:
            self._import_to_library(extra)
        if len(paths) > 1:
            self.main.toast(
                f"已导入 {len(paths)} 张皮肤，当前使用「{Path(paths[0]).stem}」",
                "success",
            )

    def _on_variant_changed(self, value: str) -> None:
        if self._syncing_variant:
            return
        if value == "slim" and self.preview.is_legacy():
            self._set_variant_silently("classic")
            value = "classic"
            self._set_status(
                "64×32 旧版皮肤没有独立的细手臂纹理，已保持 Classic 模型。",
                "info",
            )
        self.main.config.skin_variant = "slim" if value == "slim" else "classic"
        self.main.config.save()
        self.preview.set_variant(value)
        self._update_model_badge()
        configured = self.main.config.skin_path
        for entry in list_skins():
            if path_matches(entry, configured):
                set_variant(entry.id, value)
                self._refresh_library()
                break

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _set_status(self, text: str, kind: str = "info") -> None:
        color = {
            "error": colors()["red"],
            "success": colors()["green"],
            "busy": colors()["accent"],
            "info": colors()["muted"],
        }.get(kind, colors()["muted"])
        self.status_label.setText(text)
        self.status_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {color}; font-size: 11px;")

    def _update_buttons(self) -> None:
        account = self.main.current_account()
        online = account.is_msa
        littleskin = account.is_littleskin
        available = not self._busy
        has_file = self._skin_file is not None
        self.refresh_skin_btn.setEnabled(online and available)
        self.reset_skin_btn.setEnabled(online and available)
        self.upload_btn.setEnabled(available and (has_file or littleskin))
        self.select_btn.setEnabled(available)
        if online:
            self.upload_btn.setText("上传并使用")
            self.upload_btn.setToolTip(
                "" if has_file else "请先选择一张 64×64 或 64×32 的 PNG 皮肤"
            )
        elif littleskin:
            self.upload_btn.setText("在 LittleSkin 更换")
            self.upload_btn.setToolTip(
                "打开 LittleSkin 衣柜更换角色皮肤，游戏会自动加载"
            )
        else:
            self.upload_btn.setText("离线使用")
            self.upload_btn.setToolTip(
                "把当前皮肤设为离线玩家皮肤，启动游戏时自动生效"
                if has_file
                else "请先从皮肤库选择或导入一张皮肤"
            )

    def _set_busy(self, busy: bool, text: str = "") -> None:
        self._busy = busy
        if text:
            self._set_status(text, "busy")
        self._update_buttons()
        self._refresh_littleskin()

    def _save_account(self, account) -> None:
        self.main.config.account = account.to_config()
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.account_changed.emit()

    def _client_id(self, silent: bool = False) -> str | None:
        account = self.main.current_account()
        client_id = str(getattr(account, "client_id", "") or "").strip()
        if not client_id:
            client_id = str(self.main.config.microsoft_client_id or "").strip()
        if not client_id:
            if not silent:
                self.main.toast("请先在设置中填写客户端 ID", "error")
                self.main.switch_page("settings")
            return None
        return client_id

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _fetch_current_skin(self, silent: bool = False) -> None:
        account = self.main.current_account()
        if account.is_littleskin:
            if not silent:
                self._littleskin_sync()
            return
        if not account.is_msa:
            if not silent:
                self.main.toast("请先登录 Microsoft 正版账户", "info")
            return
        if self._busy:
            return
        client_id = self._client_id(silent=silent)
        if client_id is None:
            return
        self._auto_fetch_done.add(account.uuid or account.name)
        self._set_busy(True, "正在读取正版皮肤…")
        worker = SkinFetchWorker(account, client_id, self)
        self._fetch_worker = worker
        worker.status.connect(lambda text: self._set_status(text, "busy"))
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_skin_loaded)
        worker.start()

    def _on_skin_loaded(self, skin, account, error: str) -> None:
        self._fetch_worker = None
        self._busy = False
        self._save_account(account)
        if error:
            self._set_status(f"读取皮肤失败：{error}", "error")
            self._update_buttons()
            return
        if skin is None:
            self._current_skin = None
            self.current_label.setText("该正版账户目前使用默认皮肤（Steve/Alex）。")
            self._set_status("账户当前没有自定义皮肤。", "info")
            if self._skin_file is None:
                self._show_skin(default_skin(), False)
            self._update_buttons()
            return
        self._current_skin = skin
        if skin.image.height() == 32:
            skin.variant = "classic"
        self.main.config.skin_variant = (
            "slim" if skin.variant == "slim" else "classic"
        )
        self.main.config.save()
        self._set_variant_silently(self.main.config.skin_variant)
        if self._skin_file is None:
            self._show_skin(skin.image, skin.image.height() == 32)
        else:
            self.face_label.setPixmap(_rounded_face(skin.image, 48))
            self._update_model_badge()
        self.current_label.setText(
            f"正版当前皮肤 · {variant_text(skin.variant)}"
            + (f" · {skin.alias}" if skin.alias else "")
        )
        if not self.main.config.skin_path.strip():
            try:
                local = local_skin_path()
                if skin.image.save(str(local), "PNG"):
                    self.main.config.skin_path = str(local)
                    self.main.config.save()
            except Exception:
                pass
        self._set_status("已读取正版账户当前皮肤。", "success")
        self._update_buttons()
        self.main.account_changed.emit()

    def _use_offline_skin(self) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            return
        if self._skin_file is None:
            self.main.toast("请先从皮肤库选择或导入一张皮肤", "info")
            return
        configured = str(self.main.config.skin_path or "").strip()
        entry = next(
            (item for item in list_skins() if path_matches(item, configured)),
            None,
        )
        if entry is None:
            source = self.file_edit.text().strip()
            try:
                entry = add_skin(
                    self._skin_file,
                    name=Path(source).stem if source else "我的皮肤",
                    variant=self.variant_tabs.current(),
                    source=source,
                )
            except SkinLibraryError as exc:
                self._set_status(str(exc), "error")
                self.main.toast(str(exc), "error")
                return
        self._activate_entry(
            entry,
            self._skin_file,
            original=self.file_edit.text().strip() or str(entry.path),
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _refresh_littleskin(self) -> None:
        if not hasattr(self, "ls_title"):
            return
        account = self._littleskin
        logged = account.is_logged_in
        self.ls_login_btn.setVisible(not logged)
        self.ls_sync_btn.setVisible(logged)
        self.ls_logout_btn.setVisible(logged)
        available = not self._busy
        self.ls_login_btn.setEnabled(available)
        self.ls_sync_btn.setEnabled(available)
        self.ls_logout_btn.setEnabled(available)
        image = self._skin_file.image if self._skin_file is not None else default_skin()
        self.ls_avatar.setPixmap(_rounded_face(image, 38))
        if logged:
            self.ls_title.setText(f"LittleSkin · {account.name}")
            if account.last_sync:
                try:
                    stamp = datetime.fromtimestamp(account.last_sync).strftime(
                        "%m-%d %H:%M"
                    )
                except (OSError, ValueError, OverflowError):
                    stamp = ""
                synced = f"上次同步 {stamp}" if stamp else "已同步角色皮肤"
            else:
                synced = "尚未同步角色皮肤"
            self.ls_sub.setText(
                f"角色 UUID {account.short_uuid} · {synced}"
            )
            self.ls_title.setToolTip(
                f"LittleSkin 账号：{account.username or '已登录'}"
            )
        else:
            self.ls_title.setText("未登录 LittleSkin")
            self.ls_sub.setText("登录后自动同步角色皮肤，密码不会保存。")
            self.ls_title.setToolTip("")

    def _littleskin_login(self) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            return
        dialog = LittleSkinLoginDialog(
            self.main,
            self._littleskin.username,
            self._littleskin.client_token,
        )
        if dialog.exec() != QDialog.Accepted or dialog.account is None:
            return
        account = dialog.account
        skin = dialog.skin
        self._littleskin = account
        save_littleskin_account(self.main.config, account)
        # LittleSkin 角色同时成为当前游戏账户，不再只是皮肤来源。
        self.main.apply_littleskin_account(account)
        self._refresh_littleskin()
        if skin is None:
            message = (
                f"已登录 LittleSkin：{account.name}，"
                "这个角色还没有设置皮肤，但已经可以用于启动游戏。"
            )
            self._set_status(message, "info")
            self.main.toast(message, "info")
            return
        self._apply_littleskin_skin(account, skin)

    def _littleskin_sync(self) -> None:
        if self._busy or not self._littleskin.is_logged_in:
            return
        self._set_busy(True, "正在同步 LittleSkin 角色皮肤…")
        worker = LittleSkinSyncWorker(self._littleskin, self)
        self._littleskin_worker = worker
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_littleskin_synced)
        worker.start()

    def _on_littleskin_synced(self, account, skin, error: str) -> None:
        self._littleskin_worker = None
        self._set_busy(False)
        if error:
            message = f"同步 LittleSkin 皮肤失败：{error}"
            self._set_status(message, "error")
            self.main.toast(message, "error")
            return
        self._littleskin = account
        save_littleskin_account(self.main.config, account)
        if self.main.current_account().is_littleskin:
            self.main.apply_littleskin_account(account)
        if skin is None:
            self._refresh_littleskin()
            message = "LittleSkin 角色当前没有自定义皮肤。"
            self._set_status(message, "info")
            self.main.toast(message, "info")
            return
        self._apply_littleskin_skin(account, skin)

    def _apply_littleskin_skin(self, account, skin) -> None:
        value = "slim" if account.variant == "slim" and not skin.legacy else "classic"
        self._set_variant_silently(value)
        self.main.config.skin_variant = value
        try:
            entry = add_skin(
                skin,
                name=f"LittleSkin · {account.name}",
                variant=value,
                source=f"LittleSkin · {account.name}",
            )
        except (SkinError, SkinLibraryError) as exc:
            message = f"无法保存 LittleSkin 皮肤：{exc}"
            self._set_status(message, "error")
            self.main.toast(message, "error")
            return
        self._activate_entry(
            entry,
            skin,
            original=str(entry.path),
            announce=False,
        )
        save_littleskin_account(self.main.config, account)
        self._refresh_littleskin()
        if self.main.current_account().is_littleskin:
            note = (
                f"LittleSkin 角色「{account.name}」的皮肤已同步并设为预览。"
                "游戏内皮肤由 LittleSkin 自动提供，本地这份用于预览和皮肤库。"
            )
        elif self.main.current_account().is_msa:
            note = (
                f"LittleSkin 角色「{account.name}」的皮肤已同步并设为预览。"
                "微软正版启动仍使用 Mojang 账户皮肤，需要时可在上方上传。"
            )
        else:
            note = (
                f"LittleSkin 角色「{account.name}」的皮肤已启用。"
                "离线启动游戏时会自动加载这套皮肤。"
            )
        self.current_label.setText(note)
        self._set_status(note, "success")
        self.main.toast(f"已同步 LittleSkin 皮肤：{account.name}", "success")

    def _littleskin_logout(self) -> None:
        if not self._littleskin.is_logged_in or self._busy:
            return
        dialog = ConfirmDialog(
            self.main,
            "退出 LittleSkin 登录",
            f"将清除 LittleSkin 账号「{self._littleskin.name}」保存在本机的登录令牌。",
            primary_text="退出登录",
            secondary_text="取消",
            icon_name="user",
            details="皮肤库中已经同步的皮肤会保留，不会删除本地图片。",
        )
        if not dialog.exec():
            return
        clear_littleskin_account(self.main.config)
        self._littleskin = LittleSkinAccount()
        if self.main.current_account().is_littleskin:
            # LittleSkin 同时是游戏账户，退出后必须一并回到离线模式。
            self.main.config.account = {}
            self.main.config.save()
            self.main.account_changed.emit()
        self._refresh_littleskin()
        self._set_status("已退出 LittleSkin 登录，已同步的皮肤仍保留在皮肤库。", "info")
        self.main.toast("已退出 LittleSkin 登录", "info")

    def _upload_skin(self) -> None:
        account = self.main.current_account()
        if account.is_littleskin:
            QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(LITTLESKIN_CLOSET_URL))
            self.main.toast(
                "已打开 LittleSkin 衣柜；在网页更换皮肤后，游戏会自动同步",
                "info",
            )
            return
        if not account.is_msa:
            self._use_offline_skin()
            return
        if self._busy:
            return
        if self._skin_file is None:
            self.main.toast("请先选择一张本地 PNG 皮肤", "info")
            return
        client_id = self._client_id()
        if client_id is None:
            return
        variant = self.variant_tabs.current()
        dialog = ConfirmDialog(
            self.main,
            "上传并更换皮肤",
            f"将把当前预览的皮肤上传到 {account.name or '正版账户'}，"
            "并立即替换该账户正在使用的 Minecraft 皮肤。",
            primary_text="上传并使用",
            secondary_text="取消",
            icon_name="shirt",
            details="上传后通常几秒内生效；其他玩家和皮肤站点的缓存可能需要更长时间同步。",
        )
        if not dialog.exec():
            return

        self._set_busy(True, "正在准备上传皮肤…")
        worker = SkinUploadWorker(
            account, client_id, self._skin_file.data, variant, self
        )
        self._upload_worker = worker
        worker.status.connect(lambda text: self._set_status(text, "busy"))
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_skin_uploaded)
        worker.start()

    def _on_skin_uploaded(self, success: bool, message: str, account) -> None:
        self._upload_worker = None
        self._busy = False
        self._save_account(account)
        if success:
            if self._skin_file is not None:
                self._current_skin = CurrentSkin(
                    image=self._skin_file.image,
                    variant=self.variant_tabs.current(),
                )
                self.current_label.setText(
                    f"正版当前皮肤 · 刚刚上传 · {variant_text(self.variant_tabs.current())}"
                )
            self._set_status(message, "success")
            self.main.toast(message, "success")
        else:
            self._set_status(f"上传失败：{message}", "error")
            self.main.toast(f"皮肤上传失败：{message}", "error")
        self._update_buttons()

    def _reset_skin(self) -> None:
        account = self.main.current_account()
        if account.is_littleskin:
            self.main.toast("LittleSkin 皮肤请在 LittleSkin 衣柜中管理", "info")
            return
        if not account.is_msa:
            self.main.toast("请先登录 Microsoft 正版账户", "error")
            return
        if self._busy:
            return
        client_id = self._client_id()
        if client_id is None:
            return
        dialog = ConfirmDialog(
            self.main,
            "恢复默认皮肤",
            f"将移除 {account.name or '该账户'} 当前的自定义皮肤，恢复为默认皮肤。",
            primary_text="恢复默认",
            secondary_text="取消",
            icon_name="warning",
            details="这个操作会修改正版账户皮肤，但不会删除启动器 skins 文件夹中的本地图片。",
        )
        if not dialog.exec():
            return

        self._set_busy(True, "正在恢复默认皮肤…")
        worker = SkinResetWorker(account, client_id, self)
        self._reset_worker = worker
        worker.status.connect(lambda text: self._set_status(text, "busy"))
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_skin_reset)
        worker.start()

    def _on_skin_reset(self, success: bool, message: str, account) -> None:
        self._reset_worker = None
        self._busy = False
        self._save_account(account)
        if success:
            self._current_skin = None
            self._skin_file = None
            self.main.config.skin_path = ""
            self.main.config.save()
            self.file_edit.clear()
            self.file_edit.setToolTip("")
            self.current_label.setText("正版账户已恢复默认皮肤。")
            self._show_skin(default_skin(), False)
            self._set_status(message, "success")
            self.main.toast(message, "success")
        else:
            self._set_status(f"恢复失败：{message}", "error")
            self.main.toast(f"恢复默认皮肤失败：{message}", "error")
        self._update_buttons()
        self.main.account_changed.emit()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def refresh_account(self) -> None:
        account = self.main.current_account()
        self._littleskin = load_littleskin_account(self.main.config)
        self.main.config.skin_variant = self.variant_tabs.current()
        if account.is_msa:
            self.account_badge.setText("微软正版")
            self.account_badge.setProperty("badge", "green")
            self.mode_badge.setText("正版账户")
            self.mode_badge.setProperty("badge", "green")
            self.account_name.setText(account.name or "正版账户")
            uid = account.uuid or ""
            self.account_uuid.setText(
                f"UUID {uid[:8]}…{uid[-4:]}" if uid else "已登录 Microsoft 账户"
            )
        elif account.is_littleskin:
            self.account_badge.setText("LittleSkin")
            self.account_badge.setProperty("badge", "blue")
            self.mode_badge.setText("LittleSkin")
            self.mode_badge.setProperty("badge", "blue")
            self.account_name.setText(account.name or "LittleSkin 角色")
            uid = account.uuid or ""
            self.account_uuid.setText(
                f"角色 UUID {uid[:8]}…{uid[-4:]}"
                if uid
                else "已登录 LittleSkin，可直接启动游戏"
            )
            self.current_label.setText(
                "游戏内皮肤与披风由 LittleSkin 自动提供；"
                "皮肤库中的本地选择只用于预览。"
            )
        else:
            has_skin = self._skin_file is not None
            self.account_badge.setText("离线皮肤" if has_skin else "离线预览")
            self.account_badge.setProperty("badge", "purple" if has_skin else "gray")
            self.mode_badge.setText("离线模式")
            self.mode_badge.setProperty("badge", "purple" if has_skin else "gray")
            name = self.main.config.player_name
            self.account_name.setText(f"离线玩家 · {name}")
            uid = offline_uuid(name)
            if has_skin:
                entry = next(
                    (
                        item
                        for item in list_skins()
                        if path_matches(item, self.main.config.skin_path)
                    ),
                    None,
                )
                skin_name = entry.name if entry is not None else "本地皮肤"
                self.current_label.setText(
                    f"离线皮肤「{skin_name}」已启用。"
                    "启动游戏时由本地皮肤服务加载，不需要正版账户。"
                )
                self.account_uuid.setText(
                    f"UUID {uid[:8]}…{uid[-4:]} · 本地皮肤已启用"
                )
            else:
                self.account_uuid.setText(
                    f"UUID {uid[:8]}…{uid[-4:]} · 可在皮肤库选择皮肤"
                )
        repolish(self.account_badge)
        repolish(self.mode_badge)
        if not self._busy:
            online = account.is_msa
            if account.is_littleskin:
                self._set_status(
                    "LittleSkin 账户已连接，游戏内皮肤由 LittleSkin 提供。", "info"
                )
            elif self._current_skin is not None and online:
                self._set_status("正版账户已连接，可以上传或恢复皮肤。", "info")
            elif not online and self._skin_file is not None:
                self._set_status(
                    "离线模式已启用本地皮肤，游戏内会显示你的皮肤。", "info"
                )
            elif not online:
                self._set_status(
                    "离线模式可以使用皮肤库中的皮肤，启动后自动生效。", "info"
                )
            elif self._skin_file is not None:
                self._set_status("本地皮肤已就绪，可以上传。", "info")
            else:
                self._set_status("可以点击“读取正版皮肤”查看账户当前效果。", "info")
        self._update_buttons()
        self._refresh_littleskin()
        self.preview.update()

    def on_show(self) -> None:
        self._fit_preview()
        self._refresh_library()
        self.refresh_account()
        account = self.main.current_account()
        if not account.is_msa:
            return
        key = account.uuid or account.name
        if self._skin_file is None and key not in self._auto_fetch_done:
            self._auto_fetch_done.add(key)
            self._fetch_current_skin(silent=True)

    def refresh_theme(self) -> None:
        self.preview.update()
        if self._skin_file is not None:
            self.face_label.setPixmap(_rounded_face(self._skin_file.image, 48))
        elif self._current_skin is not None:
            self.face_label.setPixmap(_rounded_face(self._current_skin.image, 48))
        else:
            self.face_label.setPixmap(_rounded_face(default_skin(), 48))
        self._refresh_littleskin()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _open_skin_folder(self) -> None:
        try:
            SKIN_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        except OSError as exc:
            self.main.toast(f"无法创建皮肤文件夹：{exc}", "error")
            return
        self.main.open_path(SKIN_DIR)

    @staticmethod
    def _open_url(url: str) -> None:
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(url))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def dragEnterEvent(self, event) -> None:
        urls = event.mimeData().urls()
        if any(url.toLocalFile().lower().endswith(".png") for url in urls):
            event.acceptProposedAction()
            return
        super().dragEnterEvent(event)

    def dropEvent(self, event) -> None:
        paths = [
            url.toLocalFile()
            for url in event.mimeData().urls()
            if url.toLocalFile().lower().endswith(".png")
        ]
        if not paths:
            super().dropEvent(event)
            return
        self._apply_local_file(paths[0], original=paths[0])
        for extra in paths[1:]:
            self._import_to_library(extra)
        if len(paths) > 1:
            self.main.toast(
                f"已导入 {len(paths)} 张皮肤，当前使用「{Path(paths[0]).stem}」",
                "success",
            )
        event.acceptProposedAction()

class PetDialog(StyledDialog):

        self._release: pet.PetRelease | None = None
        self._manifest_worker: PetManifestWorker | None = None

        self._refresh_state()

        intro = QLabel("会眨眼、会闲聊的桌面小猫，装好后可以随时从这里召唤。")

        grid.addWidget(self.size_value, 0, 1)

        grid.addWidget(QLabel("安装位置"), 2, 0)

        self.launch_btn = self.add_button("启动桌宠", "Secondary", self._launch)
        self.action_btn = self.add_button("检查中…", "Primary", self._primary)
        self.action_btn.setEnabled(False)

        self.main.download_center.task_progress.connect(self._on_task_progress)
        self.main.download_center.task_finished.connect(self._on_task_finished)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _load_manifest(self) -> None:
        url = str(self.main.config.update_url or DEFAULT_UPDATE_URL)
        self._manifest_worker = PetManifestWorker(url, self.main)
        self._manifest_worker.ready.connect(self._on_manifest)
        self._manifest_worker.start()

    def _on_manifest(self, release, error: str) -> None:
        self._manifest_worker = None
        if error:
            self.status_label.setText(f"读取桌宠清单失败：{error}")
            if self._release is None and self._task_id is None:
                self.action_btn.setText("重新检查")
                self.action_btn.setEnabled(True)
            return
        if release is None:
            self.status_label.setText("更新清单里还没有桌宠信息。")
            if self._release is None and self._task_id is None:
                self.action_btn.setText("重新检查")
                self.action_btn.setEnabled(True)
            return
        self._release = release
        self._refresh_state()

    def _restore_task(self) -> None:
        for task in self.main.download_center.active_tasks():
            if str(task.content_type) != "pet":
                continue
            self._task_id = task.id
            self.progress.show()
            self.progress.setValue(task.progress)
            self.status_label.setText(task.message)
            self.action_btn.setText("取消下载")
            self.action_btn.setEnabled(True)
            return

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _refresh_state(self) -> None:
        installed = pet.is_installed()
        local_version = pet.installed_version()
        release = self._release
        root = pet.pet_root()

        if installed:
            local_text = f"v{local_version}" if local_version else "已安装"
            self.version_badge.setText(local_text)
            self.version_badge.setProperty("badge", "green")
            repolish(self.version_badge)
            self.path_value.setText(str(pet.pet_app_dir()))
            self.folder_btn.setEnabled(True)
            self.launch_btn.setEnabled(True)
        else:
            self.version_badge.setText("未安装")
            self.version_badge.setProperty("badge", "gray")
            repolish(self.version_badge)
            self.path_value.setText(str(pet.pet_app_dir(root)))
            self.folder_btn.setEnabled(False)
            self.launch_btn.setEnabled(False)

        if release is not None:
            self.size_value.setText(
                format_size(release.size) if release.size else "未知"
            )
            self.release_value.setText(release.released or release.version)
            if release.notes:
                self.notes_label.setText(
                    "\n".join(f"· {item}" for item in release.notes[:4])
                )
                self.notes_label.show()
            if self._task_id is None:
                if not installed:
                    self.action_btn.setText("下载桌宠")
                elif release.version and pet.is_newer(release.version, local_version):
                    self.action_btn.setText(f"更新到 v{release.version}")
                else:
                    self.action_btn.setText("重新下载")
                self.action_btn.setEnabled(True)
            if installed and not self.status_label.text():
                self.status_label.setText("桌宠已安装，可以直接启动。")
        else:
            self.size_value.setText("—")
            self.release_value.setText("—")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _primary(self) -> None:
        if self._task_id is not None:
            self.main.download_center.cancel(self._task_id)
            self.action_btn.setEnabled(False)
            self.action_btn.setText("正在取消…")
            return
        if self._release is None:
            self.action_btn.setEnabled(False)
            self.action_btn.setText("检查中…")
            self._load_manifest()
            return
        self._start_download(self._release)

    def _start_download(self, release: pet.PetRelease) -> None:
        worker = PetDownloadWorker(
            release,
            threads=int(self.main.config.download_threads or 4),
            parent=self.main,
        )
        task = self.main.download_center.start_worker(
            worker,
            title=f"桌宠 {release.version}",
            content_type="pet",
            target=pet.pet_root(),
            source="github-release",
            metadata={"pet_version": release.version},
        )
        self._task_id = task.id
        self.progress.setValue(1)
        self.progress.show()
        self.status_label.setText("正在下载桌宠…")
        self.action_btn.setText("取消下载")
        self.action_btn.setEnabled(True)

    def _on_task_progress(self, task_id: int, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        if task_id != self._task_id:
            return
        self.progress.show()
        self.progress.setValue(max(0, min(100, int(percent))))
        self.status_label.setText(message)

    def _on_task_finished(self, task) -> None:
        if task.id != self._task_id:
            return
        self._task_id = None
        self.progress.hide()
        if task.status == TASK_SUCCESS:
            version = self._release.version if self._release else ""
            self.status_label.setText(task.message or "桌宠已安装")
            self.main.toast(f"桌宠 {version} 安装完成", "success")
        else:
            self.status_label.setText(task.message or "桌宠下载失败")
            self.main.toast(task.message or "桌宠下载失败", "error")
        self._refresh_state()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _open_folder(self) -> None:
        try:
            pet.open_pet_folder()
        except Exception as exc:
            self.main.toast(str(exc), "error")

    def _launch(self) -> None:
        try:
            pet.launch_pet()
        except Exception as exc:
            self.main.toast(str(exc), "error")
        else:
            self.main.toast("桌宠已启动", "success")
