    def _open_initial_project(self) -> None:
        hit = dict(self._initial)
        project_id = str(hit.get("project_id") or hit.get("id") or "")
        if project_id:
            self._select_project(project_id, hit)

    def keyPressEvent(self, event) -> None:
        if event.key() in (Qt.Key_Return, Qt.Key_Enter) and isinstance(
            self.focusWidget(), (QLineEdit, QComboBox)
        ):
            event.accept()
            return
        super().keyPressEvent(event)

    def reject(self) -> None:
        worker = self._download_worker
        if worker is not None:
            self._download_worker = None
            try:
                worker.finished.disconnect(self._on_download_finished)
            except (RuntimeError, TypeError):
                pass
            worker.cancel()
        super().reject()

    @staticmethod
    def _meta_row(layout: QVBoxLayout, title: str) -> QLabel:
        row = QHBoxLayout()
        row.setSpacing(6)
        label = QLabel(title)
        label.setObjectName("Tiny")
        label.setFixedWidth(48)
        value = QLabel("—")
        value.setObjectName("Tiny")
        value.setWordWrap(True)
        row.addWidget(label, 0, Qt.AlignTop)
        row.addWidget(value, 1)
        layout.addLayout(row)
        return value

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _installed_versions(self) -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:
        items: list[tuple[str, str, str]] = []
        for summary in self.main.game_version_summaries():
            loader = summary.loader
            if not loader:
                profile = self.main.loader_profile_for(summary.id)
                loader = profile.loader if profile else ""
            items.append((summary.id, loader, summary.id))
        return items

    def _populate_target_versions(self) -> None:
        versions = self._installed_versions()
        current = str(self.main.selected_version or "")
        self.target_version_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self.target_version_combo.clear()
        for version_id, loader, _ in versions:
            alias = self.main.config.version_name(version_id)
            label = alias or version_id
            if loader:
                label += f" · {loader}"
            self.target_version_combo.addItem(label, version_id)
            if alias:
                index = self.target_version_combo.count() - 1
                self.target_version_combo.setItemData(
                    index, f"内部版本：{version_id}", Qt.ToolTipRole
                )
        if versions:
            index = self.target_version_combo.findData(current)
            if index < 0:
                index = 0
            self.target_version_combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
            self._target_version_id = str(
                self.target_version_combo.currentData() or ""
            )
        else:
            self.target_version_combo.addItem("还没有安装游戏版本", "")
            self._target_version_id = ""
        self.target_version_combo.blockSignals(False)

    def _destination_dir(self) -> Path:
        if self._custom_target_dir is not None:
            return Path(self._custom_target_dir)
        base = Path.home() / "Downloads" / "Darkitten"
        tag = f"{self.server.kind}-{self.server.mc_version}"
        return base / tag / self.server.addon_dir_name

    def _choose_destination(self) -> None:
        start = str(self._custom_target_dir or self._destination_dir())
        folder = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(self, "选择下载文件夹", start)
        if not folder:
            return
        self._custom_target_dir = Path(folder)
        self.dest_edit.setText(str(self._custom_target_dir))
        self._update_target_hint()
        self._set_download_button(False)

    def _set_target_mode(self, mode: str) -> None:
        mode = str(mode or "server")
        if mode not in ("server", "version", "folder"):
            mode = "server"
        if mode == "version" and self.server.is_plugin_server:
            mode = "server"
        self.target_tabs.set_value(mode)
        if self._target_mode == mode:
            return
        self._target_mode = mode
        self._sync_target_widgets()
        self._set_download_button(False)

    def _on_target_version_changed(self) -> None:
        self._target_version_id = str(
            self.target_version_combo.currentData() or ""
        )
        self._update_target_hint()
        self._set_download_button(False)

    def _sync_target_widgets(self) -> None:
        mode = self._target_mode
        self.target_version_combo.setVisible(mode == "version")
        self.dest_edit.setVisible(mode == "folder")
        self.dest_btn.setVisible(mode == "folder")
        if mode == "folder":
            self.dest_edit.setText(str(self._destination_dir()))
        self._update_target_hint()

    def _update_target_hint(self) -> None:
        if self._target_mode == "server":
            self.target_hint.setText(
                f"文件会安装到当前服务端：{addons_dir(self.server)}"
            )
        elif self._target_mode == "version":
            version_id = str(self.target_version_combo.currentData() or "")
            self.target_hint.setText(
                f"文件会放入客户端版本 {version_id} 的 mods 文件夹。"
                "搜索结果仍按当前服务端的类型与版本筛选。"
            )
        else:
            self.target_hint.setText(
                f"只下载文件，不写入服务端或游戏版本。保存到：{self._destination_dir()}"
            )

    def _target_dir(self) -> Path:
        if self._target_mode == "version":
            version_id = str(
                self.target_version_combo.currentData()
                or self.main.selected_version
                or ""
            )
            return self.main.config.mods_path(version_id)
        if self._target_mode == "folder":
            return self._destination_dir()
        return addons_dir(self.server)

    def _source_label(self) -> str:
        return "CurseForge" if self._source == "curseforge" else "Modrinth"

    def _set_source(self, source: str) -> None:
        source = str(source or "modrinth").strip().lower()
        if source not in ("modrinth", "curseforge"):
            source = "modrinth"
        if source == self._source:
            return
        if self._download_worker is not None:
            self.source_tabs.set_value(self._source)
            self.main.toast("请先等待当前下载结束，再切换来源", "info")
            return
        self._source = source
        self.source_tabs.set_value(source)
        # 丢弃旧来源的搜索结果：旧 worker 的回调会因为不再是当前 worker 而被忽略。
        self._search_worker = None
        self._polling = False
        self.search_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self._hits = []
        self._rows = []
        self._total = 0
        self._page = 0
        self._selected_project = ""
        self._project = None
        self._hit = None
        self._dep_projects = {}
        self._dep_projects_pending = set()
        self._nav_stack = []
        self._clear_detail()
        self._search(0)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _search(self, page: int = 0) -> None:
        if self._polling:
            return
        page = max(0, int(page))
        self._polling = True
        self.search_btn.setEnabled(False)
        offset = page * PAGE_SIZE
        self._update_pager()
        if page == 0:
            self._render_results(loading=True)
        worker = ServerAddonSearchWorker(
            self.search.text().strip(),
            self.server.kind,
            self.server.mc_version,
            offset,
            PAGE_SIZE,
            self,
            source=self._source,
        )
        self._search_worker = worker
        worker.ready.connect(
            lambda data, error, used, w=worker: self._search_ready(w, data, error, used)
        )
        worker.start()

    def _search_ready(self, worker, data, error: str, offset: int) -> None:
        if worker is not self._search_worker:
            return
        self._polling = False
        self.search_btn.setEnabled(True)
        if error or data is None:
            self._render_results(message=f"搜索失败：{_short(error, 70)}")
            return
        hits = [hit for hit in data.get("hits") or [] if isinstance(hit, dict)]
        self._hits = hits
        self._page = offset // PAGE_SIZE
        self._total = int(data.get("total_hits") or len(hits))
        self._render_results()
        if hits:
            first = str(hits[0].get("project_id") or hits[0].get("slug") or "")
            if first:
                self._select_project(first, hits[0])
        else:
            self._selected_project = ""
            self._project = None
            self._hit = None
            self._clear_detail("没有找到匹配的项目。")

    def _render_results(self, loading: bool = False, message: str = "") -> None:
        while self.results_layout.count() > 1:
            item = self.results_layout.takeAt(0)
            widget = item.widget()
            if widget:
                widget.setParent(None)
                widget.deleteLater()
        self._rows.clear()

        if loading:
            hint = QLabel(f"正在搜索 {self._source_label()}…")
            hint.setObjectName("Tiny")
            hint.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
            self.results_layout.insertWidget(0, hint)
        elif message:
            hint = QLabel(message)
            hint.setObjectName("Muted")
            hint.setWordWrap(True)
            hint.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
            self.results_layout.insertWidget(0, hint)
        elif not self._hits:
            hint = QLabel(f"没有找到匹配的服务端{self.server.addon_label}。")
            hint.setObjectName("Muted")
            hint.setWordWrap(True)
            hint.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
            self.results_layout.insertWidget(0, hint)
        else:
            for hit in self._hits:
                row = ModResultRow(
                    hit,
                    self.server.kind,
                    source_label=self._source_label(),
                    content_type="plugin" if self.server.is_plugin_server else "mod",
                )
                row.clicked.connect(
                    lambda project_id, h=hit: self._select_project(project_id, h)
                )
                row.set_selected(
                    str(hit.get("project_id") or hit.get("slug") or "")
                    == self._selected_project
                )
                self.results_layout.insertWidget(self.results_layout.count() - 1, row)
                self._rows.append(row)
                icon_url = str(hit.get("icon_url") or "")
                if icon_url:
                    image = _IMAGE_CACHE.get(icon_url)
                    if image is not None:
                        row.set_icon(image)
                    else:
                        self._load_image(icon_url, lambda img, r=row: r.set_icon(img))
        self._sync_results_height()
        self._update_pager()

    def _sync_results_height(self) -> None:
        self.results_layout.activate()
        self.results_holder.setMinimumHeight(self.results_layout.sizeHint().height())

    def _update_pager(self) -> None:
        pages = max(1, (self._total + PAGE_SIZE - 1) // PAGE_SIZE)
        current = min(self._page + 1, pages)
        self.page_label.setText(f"第 {current} / {pages} 页" if self._total else "第 1 页")
        self.result_count.setText(f"共 {self._total} 个" if self._total else "")
        self.prev_btn.setEnabled(not self._polling and self._page > 0)
        self.next_btn.setEnabled(
            not self._polling and (self._page + 1) * PAGE_SIZE < self._total
        )

    def _prev_page(self) -> None:
        if self._page > 0 and not self._polling:
            self._search(self._page - 1)

    def _next_page(self) -> None:
        if not self._polling and (self._page + 1) * PAGE_SIZE < self._total:
            self._search(self._page + 1)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _select_project(
        self, project_id: str, hit: dict, *, keep_nav: bool = False
    ) -> None:
        if not project_id:
            return
        if not keep_nav:
            self._nav_stack.clear()
            self._pending_project_id = ""
            self._pending_version_id = ""
        self._selected_project = project_id
        self._hit = hit
        for row in self._rows:
            row.set_selected(row.project_id == project_id)
        same = self._project is not None and str(self._project.get("id") or "") == project_id
        if not same:
            self._project = None
            worker = ModProjectWorker(project_id, self, source=self._source)
            self._project_worker = worker
            worker.ready.connect(self._project_ready)
            worker.start()

        self.detail_title.setText(str(hit.get("title") or hit.get("slug") or "项目"))
        author = str(hit.get("author") or "")
        categories = [str(item) for item in hit.get("categories") or [] if item]
        meta_parts = []
        if author:
            meta_parts.append(f"作者：{author}")
        if categories:
            meta_parts.append(f"分类：{', '.join(categories[:3])}")
        self.detail_author.setText(" · ".join(meta_parts) or self._source_label())
        self.detail_desc.setText(str(hit.get("description") or ""))
        self.downloads_badge.setText(f"{_human_number(hit.get('downloads'))} 下载")
        self.followers_badge.setText("0 关注")
        self.updated_label.setText("")
        self.version_combo.clear()
        self.version_combo.setEnabled(False)
        self.version_combo.addItem("正在获取可用文件…", "")
        self._sync_download_button()
        self.dep_label.setText("")
        self.dep_bar.set_state(
            [], show_back=bool(self._nav_stack), projects=self._dep_projects
        )
        self.progress_box.setVisible(False)
        self.body_excerpt.setText("")
        for label in (
            self.meta_categories,
            self.meta_loaders,
            self.meta_versions,
            self.meta_license,
        ):
            label.setText("—")
        self._set_detail_icon(str(hit.get("icon_url") or ""))

        versions_worker = ServerAddonVersionsWorker(
            project_id,
            self.server.kind,
            self.server.mc_version,
            self,
            source=self._source,
        )
        self._versions_worker = versions_worker
        versions_worker.ready.connect(
            lambda data, error, w=versions_worker, pid=project_id: self._versions_ready(
                w, pid, data, error
            )
        )
        versions_worker.start()

    def _project_ready(self, project_id: str, data, error: str) -> None:
        if project_id != self._selected_project or error or not isinstance(data, dict):
            return
        self._project = data
        title = str(data.get("title") or self.detail_title.text())
        self.detail_title.setText(title)
        description = str(data.get("description") or "")
        if description:
            self.detail_desc.setText(description)
        categories = [str(item) for item in data.get("categories") or [] if item]
        author = str((self._hit or {}).get("author") or "")
        meta_parts = []
        if author:
            meta_parts.append(f"作者：{author}")
        if categories:
            meta_parts.append(f"分类：{', '.join(categories[:3])}")
        if meta_parts:
            self.detail_author.setText(" · ".join(meta_parts))
        self.downloads_badge.setText(f"{_human_number(data.get('downloads'))} 下载")
        self.followers_badge.setText(f"{_human_number(data.get('followers'))} 关注")
        updated = str(data.get("updated") or "")[:10]
        self.updated_label.setText(f"更新于 {updated}" if updated else "")
        self.meta_categories.setText(" / ".join(categories[:5]) or "—")
        loaders = [str(item) for item in data.get("loaders") or [] if item]
        self.meta_loaders.setText(" / ".join(loaders[:4]) or "—")
        versions = [str(item) for item in data.get("game_versions") or [] if item]
        text = "、".join(versions[:8])
        if len(versions) > 8:
            text += f" 等 {len(versions)} 个"
        self.meta_versions.setText(text or "—")
        license_data = data.get("license")
        if isinstance(license_data, dict):
            license_text = str(license_data.get("name") or license_data.get("id") or "")
        else:
            license_text = str(license_data or "")
        self.meta_license.setText(license_text or "—")
        excerpt = _plain_excerpt(str(data.get("body") or ""), 260)
        self.body_excerpt.setText(excerpt)
        self.body_excerpt.setVisible(bool(excerpt))
        self._set_detail_icon(
            str(data.get("icon_url") or (self._hit or {}).get("icon_url") or "")
        )

    def _versions_ready(self, worker, project_id: str, data, error: str) -> None:
        if worker is not self._versions_worker or project_id != self._selected_project:
            return
        preferred = (
            self._pending_version_id
            if project_id == self._pending_project_id
            else ""
        )
        self._pending_project_id = ""
        self._pending_version_id = ""

        self.version_combo.blockSignals(True)
        try:
            self.version_combo.clear()
            if error:
                self.version_combo.addItem("获取版本失败", "")
                self.dep_label.setText(error)
                self.dep_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['red']};")
                self._sync_download_button()
                return
            if not data:
                self.version_combo.addItem("没有适配当前服务端的文件", "")
                self.dep_label.setText(
                    f"该项目没有适配 {self.server.type_name} {self.server.mc_version} 的文件，"
                    "可以尝试搜索其他项目。"
                )
                self.dep_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['orange']};")
                self._sync_download_button()
                return
            target_index = 0
            for index, version in enumerate(data):
                file = primary_file(version) or {}
                version_number = str(
                    version.get("version_number") or version.get("name") or ""
                )
                filename = str(file.get("filename") or "")
                version_type = str(version.get("version_type") or "")
                suffix = f" · {version_type}" if version_type else ""
                self.version_combo.addItem(
                    f"{_short(version_number, 34)}{suffix}", version
                )
                tip = f"{version_number}\n{filename}" if filename else version_number
                self.version_combo.setItemData(index, tip, Qt.ToolTipRole)
                if preferred and str(version.get("id") or "") == preferred:
                    target_index = index
            self.version_combo.setCurrentIndex(target_index)
            self.version_combo.setEnabled(True)
        finally:
            self.version_combo.blockSignals(False)
        self.dep_label.setStyleSheet("")
        self._on_version_changed()

    def _on_version_changed(self) -> None:
        self._update_dependencies()
        self._sync_download_button()

    def _update_dependencies(self) -> None:
        version = self.version_combo.currentData()
        if not isinstance(version, dict):
            self.dep_bar.set_state(
                [], show_back=bool(self._nav_stack), projects=self._dep_projects
            )
            return
        deps = required_dependencies(version)
        visible = [dep for dep in deps if str(dep.get("project_id") or "")]
        file = primary_file(version) or {}
        size = int(file.get("size") or 0)
        parts = []
        if size:
            parts.append(f"{size / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB")
        if visible:
            parts.append(
                f"需要 {len(visible)} 个前置 {self.server.addon_label}，"
                "点击下方按钮直接下载"
            )
        elif deps:
            parts.append(f"声明了 {len(deps)} 个必需前置，请确认已一并安装")
        else:
            parts.append("没有声明必需前置")
        self.dep_label.setText(" · ".join(parts))
        self.dep_label.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {colors()['orange']};" if deps else ""
        )
        if visible:
            self._request_dependency_projects(visible)
        self.dep_bar.set_state(
            visible,
            show_back=bool(self._nav_stack),
            projects=self._dep_projects,
        )

    def _request_dependency_projects(self, deps: list[dict]) -> None:
        ids = [
            str(dep.get("project_id") or "")
            for dep in deps
            if isinstance(dep, dict)
        ]
        ids = [
            project_id
            for project_id in dict.fromkeys(ids)
            if project_id
            and project_id not in self._dep_projects
            and project_id not in self._dep_projects_pending
        ]
        if not ids:
            return
        self._dep_projects_pending.update(ids)
        worker = ModProjectsWorker(ids, self, source=self._source)
        self._dep_projects_worker = worker
        worker.ready.connect(
            lambda data, error, w=worker: self._dep_projects_ready(w, data, error)
        )
        worker.start()

    def _dep_projects_ready(
        self, worker: ModProjectsWorker, data, error: str
    ) -> None:
        self._dep_projects_pending.difference_update(worker.project_ids)
        if worker is self._dep_projects_worker:
            self._dep_projects_worker = None
        if isinstance(data, dict) and data:
            self._dep_projects.update(data)
            self.dep_bar.update_projects(data)

    def _current_version_id(self) -> str:
        version = self.version_combo.currentData()
        if isinstance(version, dict):
            return str(version.get("id") or "")
        return ""

    @staticmethod
    def _dependency_hit(project_id: str, project: dict | None) -> dict:
        data = project if isinstance(project, dict) else {}
        return {
            "project_id": str(data.get("id") or project_id),
            "slug": str(data.get("slug") or ""),
            "title": str(data.get("title") or data.get("slug") or project_id),
            "description": str(data.get("description") or ""),
            "author": str(data.get("author") or ""),
            "downloads": data.get("downloads") or 0,
            "categories": data.get("categories") or [],
            "icon_url": str(data.get("icon_url") or ""),
        }

    def _open_dependency(self, project_id: str, version_id: str) -> None:
        project_id = str(project_id or "")
        if not project_id:
            return
        if self._download_worker is not None:
            self.main.toast(
                f"请先等待当前{self.server.addon_label}下载结束，再查看前置项目", "info"
            )
            return
        project = self._dep_projects.get(project_id) or {}
        canonical = str(project.get("id") or project_id)
        if canonical == self._selected_project:
            return
        self._nav_stack.append(
            (
                self._selected_project,
                dict(self._hit or {}),
                self._current_version_id(),
            )
        )
        self._pending_project_id = canonical
        self._pending_version_id = str(version_id or "")
        self._select_project(
            canonical, self._dependency_hit(canonical, project), keep_nav=True
        )

    def _go_back_dependency(self) -> None:
        if not self._nav_stack:
            return
        if self._download_worker is not None:
            self.main.toast("请先等待当前下载结束，再返回", "info")
            return
        project_id, hit, version_id = self._nav_stack.pop()
        if not project_id:
            self.dep_bar.set_state(
                [], show_back=False, projects=self._dep_projects
            )
            return
        self._pending_project_id = project_id
        self._pending_version_id = version_id
        self._select_project(project_id, hit, keep_nav=True)

    def _set_detail_icon(self, url: str) -> None:
        fallback = "plug" if self.server.is_plugin_server else "cube"
        if not url:
            self.detail_icon.setPixmap(icons.pixmap(fallback, colors()["accent"], 27))
            return
        image = _IMAGE_CACHE.get(url)
        if image is not None:
            self.detail_icon.setPixmap(_cover_pixmap(image, 52, 11))
            return
        self.detail_icon.setPixmap(icons.pixmap(fallback, colors()["accent"], 27))
        self._load_image(
            url,
            lambda image, expected=url: self._detail_icon_ready(expected, image),
        )

    def _detail_icon_ready(self, url: str, image) -> None:
        expected = {
            str((self._hit or {}).get("icon_url") or ""),
            str((self._project or {}).get("icon_url") or ""),
        }
        if url not in expected:
            return
        if image is not None and not getattr(image, "isNull", lambda: True)():
            self.detail_icon.setPixmap(_cover_pixmap(image, 52, 11))

    def _clear_detail(self, message: str = "") -> None:
        self.detail_title.setText(f"选择一个{self.server.addon_label}查看详情")
        self.detail_author.setText("从左侧搜索结果中选择项目。")
        self.detail_desc.setText(message)
        self.downloads_badge.setText("0 下载")
        self.followers_badge.setText("0 关注")
        self.updated_label.setText("")
        self.version_combo.clear()
        self.version_combo.setEnabled(False)
        self.version_combo.addItem("请选择一个项目", "")
        self._sync_download_button()
        self.dep_label.setText("")
        self._nav_stack.clear()
        self._pending_project_id = ""
        self._pending_version_id = ""
        self.dep_bar.clear()
        self.progress_box.setVisible(False)
        self.body_excerpt.setText("")
        for label in (
            self.meta_categories,
            self.meta_loaders,
            self.meta_versions,
            self.meta_license,
        ):
            label.setText("—")
        self.detail_icon.setPixmap(
            icons.pixmap(
                "plug" if self.server.is_plugin_server else "cube",
                colors()["accent"],
                27,
            )
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _load_image(self, url: str, callback) -> None:
        if not url:
            return
        cached = _IMAGE_CACHE.get(url)
        if cached is not None:
            try:
                callback(cached)
            except RuntimeError:
                pass
            return
        self._image_waiters.setdefault(url, []).append(callback)
        if url in self._image_workers:
            return
        worker = ImageFetchWorker(url, self)
        self._image_workers[url] = worker
        worker.ready.connect(self._image_ready)
        worker.start()

    def _image_ready(self, url: str, image) -> None:
        self._image_workers.pop(url, None)
        if image is not None and not getattr(image, "isNull", lambda: True)():
            _cache_image(url, image)
        callbacks = self._image_waiters.pop(url, [])
        for callback in callbacks:
            try:
                callback(image)
            except RuntimeError:
                continue

    def _sync_download_button(self) -> None:
        """下载中始终允许点“取消下载”，不被切换项目等刷新流程重新禁用。"""
        if self._download_worker is not None:
            self.download_btn.setEnabled(True)
        else:
            self.download_btn.setEnabled(
                isinstance(self.version_combo.currentData(), dict)
            )

    def _download_button_text(self) -> str:
        if self._target_mode == "version":
            version_id = str(self.target_version_combo.currentData() or "")
            return f"下载到 {version_id} 的 mods"
        if self._target_mode == "folder":
            return "下载到自选文件夹"
        return f"下载到 {self.server.addon_dir_name}"

    def _set_download_button(self, downloading: bool) -> None:
        if downloading:
            self.download_btn.setObjectName("Danger")
            self.download_btn.setText("取消下载")
            self.download_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("stop", colors()["red"], 15))
            self.download_btn.setEnabled(True)
        else:
            self.download_btn.setObjectName("Primary")
            self.download_btn.setText(self._download_button_text())
            self.download_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("download", "#FFFFFF", 15))
            self._sync_download_button()
        repolish(self.download_btn)

    def _download_metadata(self, version: dict) -> dict:
        """保存项目来源和中文介绍，安装后列表里也能打开详情。"""
        project = dict(self._project or {})
        hit = dict(self._hit or {})
        merged = {**hit, **{key: value for key, value in project.items() if value}}
        asset = primary_file(version) or {}
        hashes = asset.get("hashes") if isinstance(asset.get("hashes"), dict) else {}
        content_type = "plugin" if self.server.is_plugin_server else "mod"
        return {
            "title": str(merged.get("title") or merged.get("slug") or ""),
            "project_id": str(
                merged.get("project_id") or merged.get("id") or self._selected_project
            ),
            "slug": str(merged.get("slug") or ""),
            "source": self._source,
            "source_label": self._source_label(),
            "content_type": content_type,
            "description": str(merged.get("description") or ""),
            "description_zh": project_zh_intro(
                merged,
                content_type=content_type,
                loader=self.server.kind,
                game_version=self.server.mc_version,
            ),
            "project_url": str(merged.get("project_url") or ""),
            "icon_url": str(merged.get("icon_url") or ""),
            "game_version": self.server.mc_version,
            "loader": self.server.kind,
            "version_id": str(version.get("id") or ""),
            "file_id": str(version.get("id") or ""),
            "file_name": str(asset.get("filename") or ""),
            "sha1": str(hashes.get("sha1") or ""),
        }

    def _download(self) -> None:
        if self._download_worker is not None:
            self._download_worker.cancel()
            self.download_btn.setText("正在取消…")
            self.download_btn.setEnabled(False)
            return
        version = self.version_combo.currentData()
        if not isinstance(version, dict):
            return
        target = self._target_dir()
        try:
            target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        except OSError as exc:
            self.main.toast(f"无法创建下载文件夹：{exc}", "error")
            return
        self.progress.setValue(0)
        self.progress_text.setText(f"准备下载到 {target}…")
        self.progress_box.setVisible(True)
        worker = ModDownloadWorker(
            version,
            target,
            threads=self.main.config.download_threads,
            parent=self.main,
            source=self._source,
            metadata=self._download_metadata(version),
        )
        self._download_worker = worker
        worker.progress.connect(self._on_progress)
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_download_finished)
        self._set_download_button(True)
        worker.start()

    def _on_progress(self, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        self.progress.setValue(max(0, min(100, percent)))
        self.progress_text.setText(message)

    def _on_download_finished(self, success: bool, message: str, filename: str) -> None:
        self._download_worker = None
        self._set_download_button(False)
        if success:
            self.progress.setValue(100)
            mode = self._target_mode
            if mode == "server":
                self.progress_text.setText(f"已安装 {filename}")
                self.main.toast(
                    f"{filename} 已下载到 {self.server.addon_dir_name}", "success"
                )
                self.installed.emit(filename)
                page = getattr(self.main, "server_page", None)
                if page is not None:
                    page.refresh_addons()
            elif mode == "version":
                self.progress_text.setText(f"已下载 {filename}")
                self.main.toast(f"{filename} 已放入客户端版本 mods", "success")
                if hasattr(self.main, "mods_page"):
                    self.main.mods_page.refresh_mods()
            else:
                self.progress_text.setText(f"已保存 {filename}")
                self.main.toast(f"{filename} 已保存到自选文件夹", "success")
        elif "取消" in str(message):
            self.progress_text.setText("下载已取消")
            self.main.toast("已取消下载，临时文件已清理", "info")
        else:
            self.progress_text.setText(message)
            self.main.toast(f"下载失败：{message}", "error")

    def _open_folder(self) -> None:
        path = self._target_dir()
        try:
            path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        except OSError as exc:
            self.main.toast(f"无法创建文件夹：{exc}", "error")
            return
        self.main.open_path(path)

def _shorten(value: str, limit: int = 90) -> str:
    text = " ".join(str(value or "").split())
    return text if len(text) <= limit else text[: limit - 3] + "..."

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_tab_changed(self, value: str) -> None:
        self.stack.setCurrentIndex(0 if value == "properties" else 1)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # server.properties
    def _clear_property_rows(self) -> None:
        while self.property_layout.count():
            item = self.property_layout.takeAt(0)
            widget = item.widget()
            if widget is not None:
                widget.setParent(None)
                widget.deleteLater()
        self._property_bindings = []
        self._property_row_data = []

    def _load_properties(self) -> None:
        self._clear_property_rows()
        path = self.info.path / "server.properties"
        values = read_server_properties(path)
        # 文件里没写端口/正版验证时，以启动器记录为准，避免写入冲突的默认值。
        values.setdefault("server-port", str(self.info.port))
        values.setdefault(
            "online-mode", "true" if self.info.online_mode else "false"
        )
        rows = property_rows(values, include_all=self.all_switch.isChecked())
        for spec, value in rows:
            if spec.key not in SERVER_PROPERTY_SPECS:
                spec = self._detect_generic_spec(spec, value)
            row, control = self._property_row(spec, value)
            self.property_layout.addWidget(row)
            self._property_bindings.append((spec, control))
            self._property_row_data.append(
                (row, f"{spec.key} {spec.label} {spec.help}".lower(), spec.category)
            )
        self.property_layout.addStretch(1)

        categories: list[str] = []
        for spec, _ in self._property_bindings:
            if spec.category not in categories:
                categories.append(spec.category)
        categories.sort(
            key=lambda name: CATEGORY_ORDER.index(name)
            if name in CATEGORY_ORDER
            else 99
        )
        self.property_category.blockSignals(True)
        self.property_category.clear()
        self.property_category.addItem("全部分类", "")
        for category in categories:
            self.property_category.addItem(category, category)
        self.property_category.blockSignals(False)
        self._property_dirty = False
        self._set_property_status("", "")
        self._filter_properties()

    @staticmethod
    def _detect_generic_spec(spec, value: str):
        raw = str(value or "").strip()
        lowered = raw.lower()
        if lowered in {"true", "false"}:
            return replace(spec, kind="bool", default=lowered)
        if re.fullmatch(r"-?\d{1,9}", raw):
            return replace(
                spec,
                kind="int",
                default="0",
                minimum=-2147483648,
                maximum=2147483647,
            )
        return spec

    def _property_row(self, spec, value: str) -> tuple[QWidget, QWidget]:
        row = QFrame()
        row.setObjectName("SoftCard")
        row.setAttribute(Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
        layout = QHBoxLayout(row)
        layout.setContentsMargins(11, 8, 11, 8)
        layout.setSpacing(12)

        texts = QVBoxLayout()
        texts.setSpacing(2)
        title = QLabel(spec.label)
        title.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px;")
        title.setWordWrap(True)
        texts.addWidget(title)
        meta = QLabel(f"{spec.key} · {spec.category}")
        meta.setObjectName("Tiny")
        meta.setWordWrap(True)
        texts.addWidget(meta)
        help_label = QLabel(spec.help)
        help_label.setObjectName("Tiny")
        help_label.setWordWrap(True)
        texts.addWidget(help_label)
        layout.addLayout(texts, 1)

        control = self._property_control(spec, value)
        control.setToolTip(spec.help)
        layout.addWidget(control, 0, Qt.AlignVCenter)
        return row, control

    def _property_control(self, spec, value: str) -> QWidget:
        raw = str(value or "")
        if spec.kind == "bool":
            lowered = raw.strip().lower()
            if lowered in {"true", "false"}:
                switch = Switch()
                switch.setChecked(lowered == "true")
                switch.toggled.connect(self._mark_properties_dirty)
                return switch
            combo = QComboBox()
            combo.setFixedWidth(180)
            for text, data in (("开启", "true"), ("关闭", "false")):
                combo.addItem(text, data)
            combo.addItem(f"当前值：{raw or '空'}", raw)
            combo.setCurrentIndex(2)
            combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(self._mark_properties_dirty)
            return combo
        if spec.kind == "int":
            try:
                number = int(raw)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                edit = QLineEdit(raw)
                edit.setFixedWidth(300)
                edit.setPlaceholderText("需要整数")
                edit.textChanged.connect(self._mark_properties_dirty)
                return edit
            spin = QSpinBox()
            spin.setFixedWidth(180)
            spin.setRange(
                spec.minimum if spec.minimum is not None else -2147483648,
                spec.maximum if spec.maximum is not None else 2147483647,
            )
            if spec.minimum is None and spec.maximum is None:
                spin.setSingleStep(1)
            spin.setValue(number)
            spin.valueChanged.connect(self._mark_properties_dirty)
            return spin
        if spec.kind == "choice":
            combo = QComboBox()
            combo.setFixedWidth(220)
            for choice in spec.choices:
                combo.addItem(choice, choice)
            index = combo.findData(raw)
            if index < 0:
                combo.addItem(f"当前值：{raw or '空'}", raw)
                index = combo.count() - 1
            combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
            combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(self._mark_properties_dirty)
            return combo
        edit = QLineEdit(raw)
        edit.setFixedWidth(360)
        edit.setMaxLength(4096)
        edit.setClearButtonEnabled(True)
        edit.textChanged.connect(self._mark_properties_dirty)
        return edit

    @staticmethod
    def _control_value(control: QWidget) -> str:
        if isinstance(control, Switch):
            return "true" if control.isChecked() else "false"
        if isinstance(control, QSpinBox):
            return str(control.value())
        if isinstance(control, QComboBox):
            data = control.currentData()
            return str(data if data is not None else control.currentText())
        if isinstance(control, QLineEdit):
            return control.text()
        return ""

    def _mark_properties_dirty(self, *_args) -> None:
        self._property_dirty = True
        self._set_property_status("有未保存的修改。", colors()["orange"])

    def _set_property_status(self, text: str, color: str = "") -> None:
        self.property_status.setText(text)
        self.property_status.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {color or colors()['muted']}; font-size: 11px;"
        )

    def _filter_properties(self, *_args) -> None:
        query = self.property_search.text().strip().lower()
        category = str(self.property_category.currentData() or "")
        visible = 0
        for row, haystack, row_category in self._property_row_data:
            match = (not query or query in haystack) and (
                not category or category == row_category
            )
            row.setVisible(match)
            if match:
                visible += 1
        self.property_count.setText(f"显示 {visible} / {len(self._property_row_data)} 项")

    def _toggle_all_properties(self, checked: bool) -> None:
        if self._property_dirty and not self._confirm_discard(
            "server.properties 还有未保存的修改，切换显示范围会丢弃这些修改。"
        ):
            self.all_switch.blockSignals(True)
            self.all_switch.setChecked(not checked)
            self.all_switch.blockSignals(False)
            return
        self._load_properties()

    def _reload_properties(self) -> None:
        if self._property_dirty and not self._confirm_discard(
            "server.properties 还有未保存的修改，重新读取会丢弃这些修改。"
        ):
            return
        self._load_properties()
        self._toast("已重新读取 server.properties", "info")

    def _save_properties(self) -> None:
        values: dict[str, str] = {}
        errors: list[str] = []
        focus_widget: QWidget | None = None
        for spec, control in self._property_bindings:
            raw = self._control_value(control)
            normalized, error = validate_property(spec, raw)
            values[spec.key] = normalized
            if error:
                errors.append(error)
                if focus_widget is None:
                    focus_widget = control
        if errors:
            self._set_property_status(errors[0], colors()["red"])
            if focus_widget is not None:
                focus_widget.setFocus()
            return
        try:
            save_server_properties(self.info, values)
        except Exception as exc:
            self._set_property_status(f"保存失败：{exc}", colors()["red"])
            return
        self._property_dirty = False
        self._set_property_status(
            "已保存 server.properties；原文件备份为 server.properties.bak。",
            colors()["green"],
        )
        self._toast("server.properties 已保存", "success")
        self.saved.emit()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 插件 / Mod 配置
    def _scan_configs(self) -> None:
        configs = scan_plugin_configs(self.info)
        self._config_map = {item.relative: item for item in configs}
        self.config_list.blockSignals(True)
        self.config_list.clear()
        for item in configs:
            entry = QListWidgetItem(f"{item.relative}")
            entry.setData(Qt.UserRole, item.relative)
            entry.setToolTip(
                f"{item.path}\n{item.format} · {item.display_size}"
            )
            self.config_list.addItem(entry)
        self.config_list.blockSignals(False)
        self.config_count.setText(f"{len(configs)} 个文件")
        if configs:
            self.config_list.setCurrentRow(0)
        else:
            self._current_config = None
            self.config_title.setText("没有找到可编辑的配置文件")
            self.config_path_label.setText(
                "启动一次服务端或安装插件后，plugins/ 与 config/ 里的配置文件会显示在这里。"
            )
            self.config_format.setText("—")
            self.config_format.setProperty("badge", "gray")
            repolish(self.config_format)
            self.config_editor.clear()
            self.config_editor.setEnabled(False)
            self.config_save_btn.setEnabled(False)
            self._rebuild_hints([])
        self._filter_configs()

    def _filter_configs(self, *_args) -> None:
        query = self.config_search.text().strip().lower()
        visible = 0
        for index in range(self.config_list.count()):
            item = self.config_list.item(index)
            match = not query or query in item.text().lower()
            item.setHidden(not match)
            if match:
                visible += 1
        self.config_count.setText(f"{visible} / {self.config_list.count()} 个文件")

    def _current_plugin(self) -> PluginConfigFile | None:
        item = self.config_list.currentItem()
        if item is None:
            return None
        return self._config_map.get(str(item.data(Qt.UserRole) or ""))

    def _on_config_selected(self) -> None:
        selected = self._current_plugin()
        if selected is None:
            return
        previous = self._current_config
        if self._plugin_dirty and previous is not None and selected.relative != previous.relative:
            if not self._confirm_discard(
                f"{previous.relative} 还有未保存的修改，切换文件会丢弃这些修改。"
            ):
                self.config_list.blockSignals(True)
                for index in range(self.config_list.count()):
                    item = self.config_list.item(index)
                    if str(item.data(Qt.UserRole) or "") == previous.relative:
                        self.config_list.setCurrentItem(item)
                        break
                self.config_list.blockSignals(False)
                return
        self._load_config_file(selected)

    def _load_config_file(self, entry: PluginConfigFile) -> None:
        try:
            text = read_config_text(entry.path)
        except Exception as exc:
            self._set_config_status(f"读取失败：{exc}", colors()["red"])
            return
        self._current_config = entry
        self._ignore_plugin_text = True
        self.config_editor.setPlainText(text)
        self._ignore_plugin_text = False
        self.config_editor.setEnabled(True)
        self.config_save_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self._plugin_dirty = False
        self.config_title.setText(entry.relative)
        self.config_path_label.setText(str(entry.path))
        self.config_format.setText(entry.format)
        self.config_format.setProperty("badge", "blue")
        repolish(self.config_format)
        self._set_config_status(
            f"{entry.format} · {entry.display_size} · 保存时保留 .bak 备份",
            colors()["muted"],
        )
        self._rebuild_hints(describe_config(text, entry.path.suffix))
        self._update_cursor_hint()
        self.config_editor.setFocus()

    def _on_config_text_changed(self) -> None:
        if self._ignore_plugin_text or self._current_config is None:
            return
        self._plugin_dirty = True
        self._set_config_status("有未保存的修改。", colors()["orange"])

    def _set_config_status(self, text: str, color: str = "") -> None:
        self.config_status.setText(text)
        self.config_status.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {color or colors()['muted']}; font-size: 11px;"
        )

    def _clear_hints(self) -> None:
        while self.hint_layout.count():
            item = self.hint_layout.takeAt(0)
            widget = item.widget()
            if widget is not None:
                widget.setParent(None)
                widget.deleteLater()
        self.hint_layout.addStretch(1)

    def _rebuild_hints(self, hints) -> None:
        self._clear_hints()
        if not hints:
            label = QLabel("没有解析到顶层配置键；仍然可以直接编辑文本。")
            label.setObjectName("Tiny")
            label.setWordWrap(True)
            self.hint_layout.insertWidget(0, label)
            return
        muted = colors()["muted"]
        for hint in hints[:40]:
            value = _shorten(hint.value, 72)
            value_html = (
                f"<br><span style='color:{muted}; font-size:10px;'>"
                f"当前值：{html.escape(value)}</span>"
                if value
                else ""
            )
            label = QLabel(
                f"<b>{html.escape(hint.key)}</b>{value_html}"
                f"<br><span style='font-size:10px;'>{html.escape(hint.note)}</span>"
            )
            label.setTextFormat(Qt.RichText)
            label.setWordWrap(True)
            label.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 4)
            self.hint_layout.insertWidget(self.hint_layout.count() - 1, label)

    def _update_cursor_hint(self) -> None:
        if self._current_config is None:
            return
        cursor = self.config_editor.textCursor()
        key = key_at_line(self.config_editor.toPlainText(), cursor.blockNumber() + 1)
        if not key:
            self.cursor_hint.setText(
                f"第 {cursor.blockNumber() + 1} 行：把光标放到配置键所在行可查看解释。"
            )
            return
        note = explain_config_key(key)
        self.cursor_hint.setText(
            f"第 {cursor.blockNumber() + 1} 行 · {key}\n{note}"
        )

    def _reload_config(self) -> None:
        entry = self._current_config
        if entry is None:
            return
        if self._plugin_dirty and not self._confirm_discard(
            f"{entry.relative} 还有未保存的修改，重新读取会丢弃这些修改。"
        ):
            return
        self._load_config_file(entry)
        self._toast("配置文件已重新读取", "info")

    def _save_config(self) -> None:
        entry = self._current_config
        if entry is None:
            return
        text = self.config_editor.toPlainText()
        error = validate_config_text(text, entry.path.suffix)
        if error:
            self._set_config_status(error, colors()["red"])
            return
        try:
            write_text_atomic(entry.path, text)
        except Exception as exc:
            self._set_config_status(f"保存失败：{exc}", colors()["red"])
            return
        self._plugin_dirty = False
        self._set_config_status(
            f"已保存 {entry.relative}；原文件备份为 {entry.path.name}.bak。",
            colors()["green"],
        )
        self._toast(f"{entry.relative} 已保存", "success")
        self.saved.emit()

    def _open_config_folder(self) -> None:
        entry = self._current_config
        path = entry.path.parent if entry is not None else self.info.path
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl.fromLocalFile(str(path)))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _confirm_discard(self, message: str) -> bool:
        dialog = ConfirmDialog(
            self,
            "放弃未保存的修改",
            message,
            primary_text="放弃修改",
            secondary_text="继续编辑",
            icon_name="warning",
            icon_color=colors()["orange"],
        )
        return bool(dialog.exec())

    def reject(self) -> None:
        if self._property_dirty or self._plugin_dirty:
            dialog = ConfirmDialog(
                self,
                "还有未保存的修改",
                "关闭窗口会丢弃尚未保存的配置修改。",
                primary_text="放弃并关闭",
                secondary_text="继续编辑",
                icon_name="warning",
                icon_color=colors()["orange"],
            )
            if not dialog.exec():
                return
        super().reject()

        self.type_tabs.set_value("paper")
        main.java_installs_changed.connect(self._refresh_java)
        main.ensure_java_detected()
        self._refresh_java(main.java_installs)
        self._load_manifest()
        self._refresh_loader_versions()
        self._update_port_note()
        self._update_name()
        self._update_action()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _row_label(self, text: str) -> QLabel:
        label = QLabel(text)
        label.setFixedWidth(78)
        label.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px;")
        return label

    def _add_line_row(self, layout: QVBoxLayout, title: str, placeholder: str) -> QLineEdit:
        row = QHBoxLayout()
        row.setSpacing(10)
        row.addWidget(self._row_label(title))
        edit = QLineEdit()
        edit.setPlaceholderText(placeholder)
        edit.setMaxLength(48)
        row.addWidget(edit, 1)
        layout.addLayout(row)
        return edit

    def _add_combo_row(self, layout: QVBoxLayout, title: str) -> QComboBox:
        row = QHBoxLayout()
        row.setSpacing(10)
        row.addWidget(self._row_label(title))
        combo = QComboBox()
        row.addWidget(combo, 1)
        layout.addLayout(row)
        return combo

    def _add_spin_row(
        self,
        layout: QVBoxLayout,
        title: str,
        minimum: int,
        maximum: int,
        value: int,
        step: int,
    ) -> QSpinBox:
        row = QHBoxLayout()
        row.setSpacing(10)
        row.addWidget(self._row_label(title))
        spin = QSpinBox()
        spin.setRange(minimum, maximum)
        spin.setSingleStep(step)
        spin.setValue(max(minimum, min(maximum, value)))
        spin.setMinimumWidth(180)
        row.addWidget(spin)
        row.addStretch(1)
        layout.addLayout(row)
        return spin

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _current_kind(self) -> str:
        return self.type_tabs.current() or "paper"

    def _current_mc(self) -> str:
        return self.mc_combo.currentText().strip()

    def _base_of(self, version_id: str) -> str:
        try:
            chain = resolve_version(self.main.config.game_path, version_id).chain
            if chain:
                return chain[0]
        except Exception:
            pass
        return version_id

    def _default_mc(self) -> str:
        """优先使用当前选中的已安装版本，没有安装记录时用最新正式版。"""
        selected_id = str(getattr(self.main, "selected_version", "") or "")
        versions = getattr(self.main, "versions", None) or []
        for item in versions:
            if str(getattr(item, "id", "") or "") == selected_id:
                base = self._base_of(selected_id)
                if base:
                    return base
                break
        return self._mc_versions[0] if self._mc_versions else ""

    def _pick_mc_version(self) -> None:
        installed: list[str] = []
        for item in getattr(self.main, "versions", None) or []:
            version_id = str(getattr(item, "id", "") or "")
            if not version_id:
                continue
            base = self._base_of(version_id)
            if base and base not in installed:
                installed.append(base)
        dialog = VersionPickerDialog(self, self._current_mc(), installed)
        if not dialog.exec():
            return
        version = dialog.value().strip()
        if not version or version == self._current_mc():
            return
        self.mc_combo.setEditText(version)
        self._on_mc_changed()

    def _pick_world_source(self, zip_file: bool) -> None:
        start = Path.home()
        if zip_file:
            path, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
                self,
                "选择存档压缩包",
                str(start),
                "存档压缩包 (*.zip);;所有文件 (*.*)",
            )
        else:
            path = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(
                self, "选择世界文件夹（里面要有 level.dat）", str(start)
            )
        if not path:
            return
        try:
            source = inspect_world_source(path)
        except WorldImportError as error:
            NoticeDialog(
                self, "无法读取存档", str(error), icon_name="warning"
            ).exec()
            return
        self._import_source = source
        self.world_edit.setText(str(source.path))
        self.world_clear_btn.setVisible(True)
        self.seed_edit.setEnabled(False)
        self.seed_hint.setText(
            "已选择导入存档，种子只用于生成新世界，因此填写种子不再生效。"
        )
        self.seed_hint.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['muted']};")
        self._show_world_source()

    def _show_world_source(self) -> None:
        source = self._import_source
        if source is None:
            return
        detail = (
            f"将导入「{source.name}」 · {source.version_text} · "
            f"种子 {source.seed_text} · 维度：{source.dimension_text} · "
            f"{source.player_text} · {source.size_text}。"
            "所有维度、玩家数据和物品栏都会原样保留，不会重新生成世界。"
        )
        if is_newer_version(source.version_name, self._current_mc()):
            detail += (
                f" 注意：来源版本 {source.version_name} 高于目标版本 "
                f"{self._current_mc()}，Minecraft 不能降级打开世界，可能无法加载。"
            )
            self.world_hint.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['orange']};")
        else:
            self.world_hint.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['green']};")
        self.world_hint.setText(detail)

    def _clear_world_source(self) -> None:
        self._import_source = None
        self._import_retry = False
        self.install_btn.setText("创建并安装")
        self.world_edit.clear()
        self.world_clear_btn.setVisible(False)
        self.seed_edit.setEnabled(True)
        self.world_hint.setText(
            "可以导入其他游戏版本的存档，作为服务端主世界：所有维度、玩家数据和"
            "物品栏都会原样保留，跨版本升级由 Minecraft 首次打开时完成。"
        )
        self.world_hint.setStyleSheet("")
        self.seed_hint.setText(
            "只影响新生成的世界；数字种子和文字种子都可以，游戏会用相同算法生成地形。"
        )
        self.seed_hint.setStyleSheet("")

    def _on_name_edited(self, _text: str) -> None:
        self._name_auto = False

    def _update_name(self) -> None:
        if self._name_auto:
            kind = self._current_kind()
            mc = self._current_mc()
            self.name_edit.setText(f"{SERVER_NAMES[kind]} {mc}".strip())

    def _on_type_changed(self, _value: str) -> None:
        kind = self._current_kind()
        self.loader_widget.setVisible(kind in LOADER_KINDS)
        self.hint_label.setText(TYPE_HINTS.get(kind, ""))
        self._update_name()
        self._refresh_loader_versions()
        self._update_action()

    def _on_mc_changed(self) -> None:
        self._update_name()
        self._refresh_loader_versions()
        self._refresh_java()
        self._update_port_note()
        if self._import_source is not None:
            self._show_world_source()
        self._update_action()

    def _refresh_loader_versions(self) -> None:
        kind = self._current_kind()
        if kind not in LOADER_KINDS:
            self.loader_widget.setVisible(False)
            self._versions_worker = None
            return
        self.loader_widget.setVisible(True)
        self.loader_combo.clear()
        self.loader_combo.addItem("正在获取版本…", "")
        self.loader_combo.setEnabled(False)
        mc = self._current_mc()
        self._update_action()
        if not mc:
            self.loader_combo.clear()
            self.loader_combo.addItem("请先填写游戏版本", "")
            return
        worker = LoaderVersionsWorker(kind, mc, self)
        self._versions_worker = worker
        worker.ready.connect(
            lambda data, error, w=worker, k=kind, m=mc: self._loader_versions_ready(
                w, k, m, data, error
            )
        )
        worker.start()

    def _loader_versions_ready(
        self,
        worker: LoaderVersionsWorker,
        kind: str,
        mc: str,
        data,
        error: str,
    ) -> None:
        if worker is not self._versions_worker:
            return
        if kind != self._current_kind() or mc != self._current_mc():
            return
        self.loader_combo.clear()
        if error:
            self.loader_combo.addItem("获取失败", "")
            self.hint_label.setText(f"获取 {SERVER_NAMES[kind]} 版本失败：{error}")
            self._update_action()
            return
        if not data:
            self.loader_combo.addItem("没有可用版本", "")
            self.hint_label.setText(f"{SERVER_NAMES[kind]} 目前没有适配 Minecraft {mc} 的版本。")
            self._update_action()
            return
        for item in data:
            version = str(item.get("version") or "")
            if not version:
                continue
            suffix = "  ·  推荐" if item.get("stable") else ""
            self.loader_combo.addItem(version + suffix, version)
        self.loader_combo.setCurrentIndex(0)
        self.loader_combo.setEnabled(True)
        self._update_action()

    def _load_manifest(self) -> None:
        worker = ManifestWorker(self.main.config.download_source, parent=self)
        self._manifest_worker = worker
        worker.ready.connect(self._manifest_ready)
        worker.start()

    def _manifest_ready(self, data, error: str) -> None:
        if error or not isinstance(data, dict):
            return
        current = self._current_mc()
        existing = {self.mc_combo.itemText(i) for i in range(self.mc_combo.count())}
        releases = [
            str(item.get("id") or "")
            for item in data.get("versions") or []
            if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("type") == "release"
        ]
        self.mc_combo.blockSignals(True)
        for version in releases:
            if version and version not in existing:
                self.mc_combo.addItem(version)
        if current:
            index = self.mc_combo.findText(current)
            if index >= 0:
                self.mc_combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
            else:
                self.mc_combo.setEditText(current)
        self.mc_combo.blockSignals(False)

    def _refresh_java(self, installs=None) -> None:
        installs = list(installs if installs is not None else self.main.java_installs or [])
        current = self.java_combo.currentData()
        self.java_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self.java_combo.clear()
        self.java_combo.addItem("自动选择（推荐）", "")
        for info in installs:
            if not isinstance(info, JavaInfo):
                continue
            self.java_combo.addItem(info.display, info.path)
        if current:
            index = self.java_combo.findData(current)
            if index >= 0:
                self.java_combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
        self.java_combo.blockSignals(False)
        self._update_java_note()
        self._update_action()

    def _chosen_java(self) -> JavaInfo | None:
        required = required_java_major(self._current_mc())
        preferred = str(self.java_combo.currentData() or "")
        installs = list(self.main.java_installs or [])
        if preferred:
            for info in installs:
                if info.path.lower() == preferred.lower():
                    return info
            return None
        return pick_java(installs, required)

    def _update_java_note(self) -> None:
        required = required_java_major(self._current_mc())
        chosen = self._chosen_java()
        if chosen is None:
            self.java_note.setText(f"没有找到 Java，Minecraft {self._current_mc()} 至少需要 Java {required}。")
            self.java_note.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['red']};")
            return
        if chosen.major < required:
            self.java_note.setText(
                f"当前选择的 Java {chosen.major or '?'} 过低，"
                f"Minecraft {self._current_mc()} 至少需要 Java {required}。"
            )
            self.java_note.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['red']};")
        else:
            self.java_note.setText(f"需要 Java {required}+ · 当前 Java {chosen.major}")
            self.java_note.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['green']};")
        self._update_action()

    def _update_port_note(self) -> None:
        port = int(self.port_spin.value())
        if check_port(port):
            self.port_note.setText(f"端口 {port} 可用。")
            self.port_note.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['muted']};")
        else:
            self.port_note.setText(f"端口 {port} 已被占用，启动前请修改端口或关闭占用程序。")
            self.port_note.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['orange']};")

    def _update_action(self) -> None:
        if self._installing:
            self.install_btn.setEnabled(True)
            return
        kind = self._current_kind()
        mc = self._current_mc()
        chosen = self._chosen_java()
        required = required_java_major(mc)
        enabled = bool(self.name_edit.text().strip() and mc)
        enabled = enabled and chosen is not None and chosen.major >= required
        enabled = enabled and self.eula_check.isChecked()
        if kind in LOADER_KINDS:
            enabled = enabled and bool(self.loader_combo.currentData())
        self.install_btn.setEnabled(enabled)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _install(self) -> None:
        if self._installing:
            self._cancel_install()
            return
        if self._import_retry and self._pending_info is not None:
            self._start_world_import(self._pending_info)
            return
        if not self.install_btn.isEnabled():
            return
        kind = self._current_kind()
        mc = self._current_mc()
        chosen = self._chosen_java()
        if chosen is None:
            self.main.toast("没有可用的 Java", "error")
            return
        loader_version = (
            str(self.loader_combo.currentData() or "")
            if kind in LOADER_KINDS
            else ""
        )
        seed = "" if self._import_source is not None else self.seed_edit.text().strip()
        if kind in LOADER_KINDS and not loader_version:
            self.main.toast("请选择加载器版本", "error")
            return

        if self._pending_info is not None:
            info = self._pending_info
            info.name = self.name_edit.text().strip()
            info.kind = kind
            info.mc_version = mc
            info.loader_version = loader_version
            info.java_path = chosen.path
            info.memory_mb = self.memory_spin.value()
            info.port = self.port_spin.value()
            info.online_mode = self.online_switch.isChecked()
            info.seed = seed
        else:
            name = self.name_edit.text().strip()
            folder = new_server_folder(name, kind, mc)
            info = ServerInfo(
                folder=folder,
                name=name,
                kind=kind,
                mc_version=mc,
                loader_version=loader_version,
                java_path=chosen.path,
                memory_mb=self.memory_spin.value(),
                port=self.port_spin.value(),
                online_mode=self.online_switch.isChecked(),
                seed=seed,
            )
            self._pending_info = info
        save_server(info)

        self._installing = True
        self._set_form_enabled(False)
        self.progress.setValue(0)
        self.progress_text.setText("准备安装…")
        self.progress_box.setVisible(True)
        self.log.clear()
        self.log.setVisible(True)
        self.install_btn.setText("取消安装")
        self.close_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.close_btn.setText("后台运行")
        self.adjustSize()

        worker = ServerInstallWorker(
            info,
            java_path=chosen.path,
            accept_eula=True,
            source=self.main.config.download_source,
            parent=self,
        )
        self._install_worker = worker
        worker.progress.connect(self._on_progress)
        worker.log_line.connect(self._append_log)
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_finished)
        self._task = self.main.download_center.start_worker(
            worker,
            title=f"安装服务端 · {info.name}",
            content_type="server-install",
            target=info.path,
            source=self.main.config.download_source,
            metadata={
                "folder": info.folder,
                "name": info.name,
                "kind": info.kind,
            },
            forward_log=False,
        )

    def _cancel_install(self) -> None:
        if self._import_worker is not None:
            self.progress_text.setText("正在取消导入…")
            self.install_btn.setEnabled(False)
            self._import_worker.cancel()
            return
        if self._install_worker:
            self.progress_text.setText("正在取消…")
            self.install_btn.setEnabled(False)
            self._install_worker.cancel()

    def _detach_download_center(self, _result: int = 0) -> None:
        if self._task is not None and not self._task.running:
            self._task = None

    def _set_form_enabled(self, enabled: bool) -> None:
        for widget in self._form_widgets:
            widget.setEnabled(enabled)
        if enabled:
            self.seed_edit.setEnabled(self._import_source is None)
            self.loader_widget.setEnabled(self._current_kind() in LOADER_KINDS)
            self._update_java_note()
            self._update_action()

    def _on_progress(self, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        self.progress.setValue(max(0, min(100, percent)))
        self.progress_text.setText(message)

    def _append_log(self, line: str) -> None:
        self.log.appendPlainText(line)
        bar = self.log.verticalScrollBar()
        bar.setValue(bar.maximum())

    def _on_finished(self, success: bool, message: str) -> None:
        self._installing = False
        self._install_worker = None
        if self._task is not None:
            self._task.metadata["ui_handled"] = True
        if success and self._pending_info is not None and self._import_source is not None:
            self._start_world_import(self._pending_info)
            return
        self._set_form_enabled(True)
        self.close_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.close_btn.setText("关闭")
        self.install_btn.setText("创建并安装")
        if success and self._pending_info is not None:
            self._finish_success()
            return
        if "取消" in str(message):
            self.progress_text.setText("安装已取消")
            self.main.toast("服务端安装已取消", "info")
            return
        self.progress_text.setText(message)
        self.install_btn.setText("重试安装")
        self.main.toast(f"服务端安装失败：{message}", "error")

    def _finish_success(self) -> None:
        if self._pending_info is None:
            return
        self.progress.setValue(100)
        self.progress_text.setText("安装完成")
        self.server = self._pending_info
        if hasattr(self.main, "server_page"):
            self.main.server_page.refresh_servers(self.server.folder)
        self.main.toast(f"{self.server.name} 服务端已就绪", "success")
        QTimer.singleShot(500, self.accept)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _start_world_import(self, info: ServerInfo) -> None:
        if self._import_source is None:
            self._finish_success()
            return
        self._import_retry = False
        self._installing = True
        self._set_form_enabled(False)
        self.progress.setValue(0)
        self.progress_text.setText("服务端已安装，正在导入存档…")
        self.log.appendPlainText(
            f"开始导入存档：{self._import_source.path} → {info.path / 'world'}"
        )
        self.install_btn.setText("取消导入")
        self.close_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.close_btn.setText("后台运行")
        worker = WorldImportWorker(
            self._import_source,
            server_info=info,
            folder_name="world",
            parent=self,
        )
        self._import_worker = worker
        worker.progress.connect(self._on_import_progress)
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_import_finished)
        worker.start()

    def _on_import_progress(self, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        self.progress.setValue(max(0, min(100, percent)))
        self.progress_text.setText(message)
        if message:
            bar = self.log.verticalScrollBar()
            last = self.log.toPlainText().splitlines()[-1:] or [""]
            if last[0] != message:
                self.log.appendPlainText(message)
                bar.setValue(bar.maximum())

    def _on_import_finished(self, success: bool, message: str, _result) -> None:
        self._import_worker = None
        self._installing = False
        self._set_form_enabled(True)
        self.close_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.close_btn.setText("关闭")
        if success and self._pending_info is not None:
            self._import_source = None
            self.progress.setValue(100)
            self.progress_text.setText(message)
            self._finish_success()
            return
        self.server = self._pending_info
        if self._pending_info is not None and hasattr(self.main, "server_page"):
            self.main.server_page.refresh_servers(self._pending_info.folder)
        if "取消" in message:
            self.progress_text.setText("存档导入已取消，服务端已安装但没有导入世界")
            self.install_btn.setText("创建并安装")
            self.main.toast("存档导入已取消，服务端已安装", "info")
            return
        self.progress_text.setText(f"服务端已安装，但存档导入失败：{message}")
        self.install_btn.setText("重试导入存档")
        self.install_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self._import_retry = True
        self.main.toast(f"存档导入失败：{message}", "error")

    def reject(self) -> None:
        if self._installing:
            self.main.toast(
                "服务端任务已在后台继续，可以继续操作启动器；"
                "完成后会更新服务端列表",
                "info",
            )
        super().reject()
