"""服务端种子与跨版本存档导入的单元测试（不启动界面）。"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from darkitten import nbt, servers, worlds  # noqa: E402
from darkitten.world_import import (  # noqa: E402
    WorldImportCancelled,
    WorldImportError,
    import_dimensions_into_server,
    import_into_server,
    import_world,
    import_world_dimensions,
    inspect_world_source,
    is_newer_version,
    scan_local_world_options,
    world_dimension_labels,
)


def _make_world(parent: Path, name: str = "远端世界") -> Path:
    info = worlds.create_world(
        parent,
        name=name,
        seed=424242,
        game_mode=0,
        difficulty=2,
        version_id="1.20.1",
    )
    folder = info.folder
    root = nbt.read_nbt(folder / "level.dat")
    root["Data"]["Version"] = {
        "Name": nbt.NBTString("1.20.1"),
        "Id": nbt.Int(3465),
    }
    root["Data"]["DataVersion"] = nbt.Int(3465)
    nbt.write_nbt_file(folder / "level.dat", root, compressed=True, backup=False)
    (folder / "region").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (folder / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").write_bytes(b"overworld-chunks")
    (folder / "DIM-1" / "region").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (folder / "DIM-1" / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").write_bytes(b"nether-chunks")
    (folder / "DIM1" / "region").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (folder / "DIM1" / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").write_bytes(b"end-chunks")
    (folder / "dimensions" / "mypack" / "custom" / "region").mkdir(parents=True)
    (folder / "dimensions" / "mypack" / "custom" / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").write_bytes(
        b"custom-chunks"
    )
    (folder / "playerdata").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (folder / "playerdata" / "abc.dat").write_bytes(b"player-inventory")
    (folder / "stats").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (folder / "stats" / "abc.json").write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
    (folder / "advancements").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (folder / "advancements" / "abc.json").write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
    return folder


def _digest(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


class ServerSeedTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_seed_is_written_to_level_seed(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            with mock.patch.object(servers, "SERVERS_DIR", Path(tmp)):
                info = servers.ServerInfo(
                    folder="seed-server",
                    name="种子服",
                    kind="paper",
                    mc_version="1.20.1",
                    seed="123456789",
                )
                info.path.mkdir(parents=True)
                servers.update_server_properties(info)
                text = (info.path / "server.properties").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                self.assertIn("level-seed=123456789", text)

    def test_blank_seed_keeps_existing_value(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            with mock.patch.object(servers, "SERVERS_DIR", Path(tmp)):
                info = servers.ServerInfo(
                    folder="seed-server",
                    name="种子服",
                    kind="paper",
                    mc_version="1.20.1",
                    seed="123456789",
                )
                info.path.mkdir(parents=True)
                servers.update_server_properties(info)
                info.seed = ""
                servers.update_server_properties(info)
                text = (info.path / "server.properties").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                self.assertIn("level-seed=123456789", text)


class VersionCompareTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_newer_source_versions_are_detected(self) -> None:
        self.assertTrue(is_newer_version("1.21.1", "1.20.1"))
        self.assertTrue(is_newer_version("26.1", "1.21.11"))
        self.assertFalse(is_newer_version("1.20.1", "1.21.1"))
        self.assertFalse(is_newer_version("1.20.1", "1.20.1"))
        self.assertFalse(is_newer_version("", "1.20.1"))
        self.assertFalse(is_newer_version("1.20.1", ""))


class WorldImportTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_inspect_detects_dimensions_and_players(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            source = _make_world(Path(tmp) / "src")
            info = inspect_world_source(source)
            self.assertEqual(info.seed, 424242)
            self.assertEqual(info.version_name, "1.20.1")
            self.assertEqual(info.players, 1)
            self.assertIn("主世界", info.dimensions)
            self.assertIn("下界", info.dimensions)
            self.assertIn("末地", info.dimensions)
            self.assertIn("mypack:custom", info.dimensions)

    def test_folder_import_copies_everything_unchanged(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            source = _make_world(Path(tmp) / "src")
            level_digest = _digest(source / "level.dat")
            player_digest = _digest(source / "playerdata" / "abc.dat")

            result = import_world(source, Path(tmp) / "saves")

            self.assertEqual(result.folder.name, source.name)
            self.assertTrue((result.folder / "level.dat").is_file())
            self.assertEqual(_digest(result.folder / "level.dat"), level_digest)
            self.assertEqual(
                _digest(result.folder / "playerdata" / "abc.dat"), player_digest
            )
            for relative in (
                Path("region/r.0.0.mca"),
                Path("DIM-1/region/r.0.0.mca"),
                Path("DIM1/region/r.0.0.mca"),
                Path("dimensions/mypack/custom/region/r.0.0.mca"),
                Path("stats/abc.json"),
                Path("advancements/abc.json"),
            ):
                self.assertEqual(
                    _digest(result.folder / relative),
                    _digest(source / relative),
                    msg=str(relative),
                )
            loaded, _ = worlds.load_world(result.folder)
            self.assertEqual(loaded.seed, 424242)

    def test_zip_import_with_wrapper_folder(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            source = _make_world(Path(tmp) / "src")
            archive = Path(tmp) / "world.zip"
            with zipfile.ZipFile(archive, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
                for path in source.rglob("*"):
                    if path.is_file():
                        zf.write(path, Path("我的世界") / path.relative_to(source))

            info = inspect_world_source(archive)
            self.assertEqual(info.name, "远端世界")
            self.assertEqual(info.players, 1)
            self.assertIn("末地", info.dimensions)

            result = import_world(info, Path(tmp) / "saves", folder_name="导入世界")
            self.assertEqual(result.folder.name, "导入世界")
            self.assertEqual(
                (result.folder / "DIM1" / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").read_bytes(),
                b"end-chunks",
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                (result.folder / "playerdata" / "abc.dat").read_bytes(),
                b"player-inventory",
            )

    def test_existing_world_is_backed_up_not_deleted(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            saves = Path(tmp) / "saves"
            source = _make_world(Path(tmp) / "src", name="新世界")
            old = saves / source.name
            old.mkdir(parents=True)
            (old / "level.dat").write_bytes(b"old-world")

            result = import_world(source, saves)

            self.assertIsNotNone(result.backup)
            self.assertTrue(result.backup.is_dir())
            self.assertEqual((result.backup / "level.dat").read_bytes(), b"old-world")
            self.assertNotEqual((result.folder / "level.dat").read_bytes(), b"old-world")

    def test_zip_slip_is_ignored(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            source = _make_world(Path(tmp) / "src")
            archive = Path(tmp) / "slip.zip"
            with zipfile.ZipFile(archive, "w") as zf:
                zf.writestr("world/level.dat", (source / "level.dat").read_bytes())
                zf.writestr("../evil.txt", b"should-not-escape")
                zf.writestr("/absolute.txt", b"should-not-be-absolute")

            result = import_world(archive, Path(tmp) / "saves")
            self.assertFalse((Path(tmp) / "evil.txt").exists())
            self.assertFalse((result.folder / "absolute.txt").exists())
            self.assertTrue((result.folder / "level.dat").is_file())

    def test_multiple_worlds_in_one_folder_are_rejected(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            _make_world(Path(tmp) / "saves", name="世界一")
            _make_world(Path(tmp) / "saves", name="世界二")
            with self.assertRaises(WorldImportError):
                inspect_world_source(Path(tmp) / "saves")

    def test_cancel_stops_before_copying(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            source = _make_world(Path(tmp) / "src")
            event = threading.Event()
            event.set()
            with self.assertRaises(WorldImportCancelled):
                import_world(source, Path(tmp) / "saves", cancel_event=event)

    def test_cancel_restores_existing_world_name(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            saves = Path(tmp) / "saves"
            source = _make_world(Path(tmp) / "src", name="要导入的世界")
            old = saves / source.name
            old.mkdir(parents=True)
            (old / "level.dat").write_bytes(b"old-world")
            event = threading.Event()
            event.set()

            with self.assertRaises(WorldImportCancelled):
                import_world(source, saves, cancel_event=event)

            self.assertTrue(old.is_dir())
            self.assertEqual((old / "level.dat").read_bytes(), b"old-world")
            leftovers = [p.name for p in saves.iterdir() if ".bak-" in p.name]
            self.assertEqual(leftovers, [])

    def test_import_into_server_sets_level_name(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            with mock.patch.object(servers, "SERVERS_DIR", Path(tmp) / "servers"):
                info = servers.ServerInfo(
                    folder="my-server",
                    name="我的服",
                    kind="paper",
                    mc_version="1.20.1",
                )
                info.path.mkdir(parents=True)
                source = _make_world(Path(tmp) / "src")

                result = import_into_server(info, source, level_name="world")

                self.assertEqual(result.folder, info.path / "world")
                self.assertTrue((info.path / "world" / "level.dat").is_file())
                text = (info.path / "server.properties").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                self.assertIn("level-name=world", text)


class DimensionImportTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """只导入主世界、下界或末地时，不能动到其他数据。"""

    def _target(self, root: Path) -> Path:
        target = _make_world(root / "server", name="目标世界")
        return target

    def test_overworld_only_keeps_other_dimensions_and_player_data(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            source = _make_world(Path(tmp) / "src", name="来源世界")
            target = self._target(Path(tmp))
            level_digest = _digest(target / "level.dat")
            (target / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").write_bytes(b"old-overworld")
            (target / "DIM-1" / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").write_bytes(b"old-nether")
            (target / "DIM1" / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").write_bytes(b"old-end")
            (target / "playerdata" / "abc.dat").write_bytes(b"target-player")

            result = import_world_dimensions(
                source,
                target,
                dimensions=["overworld"],
                level_name=target.name,
                target_version="1.20.1",
                server_kind="fabric",
            )

            self.assertEqual(
                (target / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").read_bytes(), b"overworld-chunks"
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                (target / "DIM-1" / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").read_bytes(),
                b"old-nether",
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                (target / "DIM1" / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").read_bytes(), b"old-end"
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                (target / "playerdata" / "abc.dat").read_bytes(), b"target-player"
            )
            self.assertEqual(_digest(target / "level.dat"), level_digest)
            self.assertTrue(result.backups)
            self.assertIn("主世界", result.dimension_text)
            backup = next(p for p in result.backups if p.name.startswith("region.bak-"))
            self.assertEqual(
                (backup / "r.0.0.mca").read_bytes(), b"old-overworld"
            )

    def test_nether_only_replaces_only_nether(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            source = _make_world(Path(tmp) / "src", name="来源世界")
            target = self._target(Path(tmp))
            (target / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").write_bytes(b"old-overworld")
            (target / "DIM-1" / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").write_bytes(b"old-nether")
            (target / "DIM1" / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").write_bytes(b"old-end")
            (target / "playerdata" / "abc.dat").write_bytes(b"target-player")

            import_world_dimensions(
                source,
                target,
                dimensions=["nether"],
                level_name=target.name,
                target_version="1.20.1",
                server_kind="fabric",
            )

            self.assertEqual(
                (target / "DIM-1" / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").read_bytes(),
                b"nether-chunks",
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                (target / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").read_bytes(), b"old-overworld"
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                (target / "DIM1" / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").read_bytes(), b"old-end"
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                (target / "playerdata" / "abc.dat").read_bytes(), b"target-player"
            )

    def test_paper_split_layout_uses_sibling_world_folders(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            source = _make_world(Path(tmp) / "src", name="来源世界")
            target = self._target(Path(tmp))
            shutil.rmtree(target / "DIM-1", ignore_errors=True)
            shutil.rmtree(target / "DIM1", ignore_errors=True)
            (target / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").write_bytes(b"old-overworld")

            import_world_dimensions(
                source,
                target,
                dimensions=["nether", "end"],
                level_name=target.name,
                target_version="1.20.1",
                server_kind="paper",
            )

            nether = target.parent / f"{target.name}_nether" / "DIM-1" / "region"
            end = target.parent / f"{target.name}_the_end" / "DIM1" / "region"
            self.assertEqual(
                (nether / "r.0.0.mca").read_bytes(), b"nether-chunks"
            )
            self.assertEqual((end / "r.0.0.mca").read_bytes(), b"end-chunks")
            self.assertEqual(
                (target / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").read_bytes(), b"old-overworld"
            )

    def test_namespaced_layout_uses_dimensions_minecraft(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            source = _make_world(Path(tmp) / "src", name="来源世界")
            target = self._target(Path(tmp))
            shutil.rmtree(target / "DIM-1", ignore_errors=True)
            shutil.rmtree(target / "DIM1", ignore_errors=True)
            ns_overworld = target / "dimensions" / "minecraft" / "overworld"
            (ns_overworld / "region").mkdir(parents=True)
            (ns_overworld / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").write_bytes(b"old-ns")

            import_world_dimensions(
                source,
                target,
                dimensions=["overworld", "nether"],
                level_name=target.name,
                target_version="26.1",
                server_kind="paper",
            )

            self.assertEqual(
                (ns_overworld / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").read_bytes(),
                b"overworld-chunks",
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                (
                    target
                    / "dimensions"
                    / "minecraft"
                    / "the_nether"
                    / "region"
                    / "r.0.0.mca"
                ).read_bytes(),
                b"nether-chunks",
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                (
                    target
                    / "dimensions"
                    / "mypack"
                    / "custom"
                    / "region"
                    / "r.0.0.mca"
                ).read_bytes(),
                b"custom-chunks",
            )
            self.assertFalse((target / "DIM-1").exists())

    def test_new_world_copies_common_files_and_selected_dimension(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            source = _make_world(Path(tmp) / "src", name="来源世界")
            new_world = Path(tmp) / "saves" / "新世界"

            import_world_dimensions(
                source,
                new_world,
                dimensions=["nether"],
                level_name="新世界",
                target_version="1.20.1",
                server_kind="fabric",
            )

            self.assertTrue((new_world / "level.dat").is_file())
            self.assertEqual(
                (new_world / "playerdata" / "abc.dat").read_bytes(),
                b"player-inventory",
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                (new_world / "DIM-1" / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").read_bytes(),
                b"nether-chunks",
            )
            self.assertFalse((new_world / "region").exists())
            self.assertFalse((new_world / "DIM1").exists())

    def test_zip_source_supports_selective_import(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            source = _make_world(Path(tmp) / "src", name="来源世界")
            archive = Path(tmp) / "world.zip"
            with zipfile.ZipFile(archive, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
                for path in source.rglob("*"):
                    if path.is_file():
                        zf.write(path, Path("我的世界") / path.relative_to(source))
            new_world = Path(tmp) / "saves" / "只导末地"

            import_world_dimensions(
                archive,
                new_world,
                dimensions=["end"],
                level_name="只导末地",
                target_version="1.20.1",
                server_kind="fabric",
            )

            self.assertTrue((new_world / "level.dat").is_file())
            self.assertEqual(
                (new_world / "DIM1" / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").read_bytes(),
                b"end-chunks",
            )
            self.assertFalse((new_world / "DIM-1").exists())
            self.assertFalse((new_world / "region").exists())

    def test_missing_source_dimension_is_rejected(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            source = _make_world(Path(tmp) / "src", name="来源世界")
            shutil.rmtree(source / "DIM1")
            target = self._target(Path(tmp))

            with self.assertRaises(WorldImportError):
                import_world_dimensions(
                    source,
                    target,
                    dimensions=["end"],
                    level_name=target.name,
                    target_version="1.20.1",
                )

    def test_cancel_restores_overwritten_dimension(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            source = _make_world(Path(tmp) / "src", name="来源世界")
            target = self._target(Path(tmp))
            (target / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").write_bytes(b"old-overworld")
            event = threading.Event()
            event.set()

            with self.assertRaises(WorldImportCancelled):
                import_world_dimensions(
                    source,
                    target,
                    dimensions=["overworld"],
                    level_name=target.name,
                    target_version="1.20.1",
                    cancel_event=event,
                )

            self.assertEqual(
                (target / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").read_bytes(), b"old-overworld"
            )
            leftovers = [p.name for p in target.iterdir() if ".bak-" in p.name]
            self.assertEqual(leftovers, [])

    def test_all_three_dimensions_replaces_world_but_keeps_player_data(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            source = _make_world(Path(tmp) / "src", name="来源世界")
            target = self._target(Path(tmp))
            level_digest = _digest(target / "level.dat")
            (target / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").write_bytes(b"old-overworld")
            (target / "DIM-1" / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").write_bytes(b"old-nether")
            (target / "DIM1" / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").write_bytes(b"old-end")
            (target / "playerdata" / "abc.dat").write_bytes(b"target-player")
            (target / "dimensions" / "oldpack" / "custom" / "region").mkdir(
                parents=True
            )
            (
                target
                / "dimensions"
                / "oldpack"
                / "custom"
                / "region"
                / "r.0.0.mca"
            ).write_bytes(b"old-custom")

            result = import_world_dimensions(
                source,
                target,
                dimensions=["overworld", "nether", "end"],
                level_name=target.name,
                target_version="1.20.1",
                server_kind="fabric",
            )

            self.assertEqual(result.dimension_text, "主世界、下界、末地")
            self.assertEqual(
                (target / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").read_bytes(), b"overworld-chunks"
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                (target / "DIM-1" / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").read_bytes(),
                b"nether-chunks",
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                (target / "DIM1" / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").read_bytes(),
                b"end-chunks",
            )
            # level.dat 与玩家数据不被来源覆盖。
            self.assertEqual(_digest(target / "level.dat"), level_digest)
            self.assertEqual(
                (target / "playerdata" / "abc.dat").read_bytes(), b"target-player"
            )
            # 自定义维度随三个维度全选一起导入，旧的自定义维度先备份。
            self.assertEqual(
                (target / "dimensions" / "mypack" / "custom" / "region" / "r.0.0.mca")
                .read_bytes(),
                b"custom-chunks",
            )
            backups = [p.name for p in (target / "dimensions").iterdir()]
            self.assertTrue(any(name.startswith("oldpack.bak-") for name in backups))
            self.assertTrue(
                any(".bak-" in path.name for path in result.backups),
                result.backups,
            )

    def test_all_three_dimensions_into_paper_target_uses_split_layout(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            source = _make_world(Path(tmp) / "src", name="来源世界")
            target = self._target(Path(tmp))
            shutil.rmtree(target / "DIM-1", ignore_errors=True)
            shutil.rmtree(target / "DIM1", ignore_errors=True)
            (target / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").write_bytes(b"old-overworld")

            import_world_dimensions(
                source,
                target,
                dimensions=["overworld", "nether", "end"],
                level_name=target.name,
                target_version="1.20.1",
                server_kind="paper",
            )

            self.assertEqual(
                (target / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").read_bytes(), b"overworld-chunks"
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                (
                    target.parent
                    / f"{target.name}_nether"
                    / "DIM-1"
                    / "region"
                    / "r.0.0.mca"
                ).read_bytes(),
                b"nether-chunks",
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                (
                    target.parent
                    / f"{target.name}_the_end"
                    / "DIM1"
                    / "region"
                    / "r.0.0.mca"
                ).read_bytes(),
                b"end-chunks",
            )
            self.assertFalse((target / "DIM-1").exists())
            self.assertFalse((target / "DIM1").exists())

    def test_dimension_import_into_paper_server_sets_level_name(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            with mock.patch.object(servers, "SERVERS_DIR", Path(tmp) / "servers"):
                info = servers.ServerInfo(
                    folder="my-server",
                    name="我的服",
                    kind="paper",
                    mc_version="1.20.1",
                )
                info.path.mkdir(parents=True)
                source = _make_world(Path(tmp) / "src", name="来源世界")

                result = import_dimensions_into_server(
                    info,
                    source,
                    dimensions=["nether"],
                    level_name="world",
                )

                self.assertEqual(result.folder, info.path / "world")
                self.assertTrue((info.path / "world" / "level.dat").is_file())
                self.assertEqual(
                    (
                        info.path
                        / "world_nether"
                        / "DIM-1"
                        / "region"
                        / "r.0.0.mca"
                    ).read_bytes(),
                    b"nether-chunks",
                )
                text = (info.path / "server.properties").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                self.assertIn("level-name=world", text)


class LocalWorldScanTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def _write_version(self, root: Path, version_id: str) -> Path:
        version_dir = root / "versions" / version_id
        version_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        payload = {
            "id": version_id,
            "type": "release",
            "mainClass": "net.minecraft.client.main.Main",
        }
        (version_dir / f"{version_id}.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(payload), encoding="utf-8"
        )
        return version_dir

    def test_scan_finds_version_shared_and_server_worlds(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            root = Path(tmp) / "game"
            version_dir = self._write_version(root, "1.20.1")
            _make_world(version_dir, name="版本世界")
            _make_world(root, name="共享世界")

            servers_dir = Path(tmp) / "servers"
            server_dir = servers_dir / "s1"
            server_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
            (server_dir / "server.json").write_text(
                json.dumps(
                    {
                        "folder": "s1",
                        "name": "我的服",
                        "kind": "paper",
                        "mc_version": "1.20.1",
                    },
                    ensure_ascii=False,
                ),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            (server_dir / "server.properties").write_text(
                "level-name=world\n", encoding="utf-8"
            )
            seed = _make_world(Path(tmp) / "seed", name="服务端世界")
            shutil.move(str(seed), str(server_dir / "world"))

            with mock.patch.object(servers, "SERVERS_DIR", servers_dir):
                options = scan_local_world_options(
                    root, version_names={"1.20.1": "我的 1.20.1"}
                )
                excluded = scan_local_world_options(
                    root,
                    version_names={"1.20.1": "我的 1.20.1"},
                    exclude_server="s1",
                )

            labels = [item.label for item in options]
            self.assertTrue(any("版本世界" in label for label in labels))
            self.assertTrue(any("共享世界" in label for label in labels))
            self.assertTrue(any("我的 1.20.1" in label for label in labels))
            self.assertTrue(
                any("服务端" in label and "服务端世界" in label for label in labels)
            )
            self.assertFalse(any("服务端世界" in item.label for item in excluded))
            server_item = next(item for item in options if item.category == "server")
            self.assertEqual(server_item.path, server_dir / "world")
            self.assertEqual(
                set(server_item.dimensions), {"主世界", "下界", "末地"}
            )

    def test_paper_source_siblings_are_detected_and_imported(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            source = _make_world(Path(tmp) / "src", name="Paper世界")
            nether_sibling = source.parent / f"{source.name}_nether"
            end_sibling = source.parent / f"{source.name}_the_end"
            nether_sibling.mkdir()
            end_sibling.mkdir()
            shutil.move(str(source / "DIM-1"), str(nether_sibling / "DIM-1"))
            shutil.move(str(source / "DIM1"), str(end_sibling / "DIM1"))

            info = inspect_world_source(source)
            self.assertIn("主世界", info.dimensions)
            self.assertIn("下界", info.dimensions)
            self.assertIn("末地", info.dimensions)
            self.assertEqual(
                world_dimension_labels(source), ["主世界", "下界", "末地"]
            )

            target = Path(tmp) / "saves" / "导入"
            import_world_dimensions(
                info,
                target,
                dimensions=["nether", "end"],
                level_name="导入",
                target_version="1.20.1",
                server_kind="fabric",
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                (target / "DIM-1" / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").read_bytes(),
                b"nether-chunks",
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                (target / "DIM1" / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").read_bytes(),
                b"end-chunks",
            )

    def test_dimension_labels_detect_namespaced_layout(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            world = Path(tmp) / "world"
            for name in ("overworld", "the_nether", "the_end"):
                (world / "dimensions" / "minecraft" / name).mkdir(parents=True)
            self.assertEqual(
                world_dimension_labels(world), ["主世界", "下界", "末地"]
            )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

class NBTTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_roundtrip_all_tags(self):
        root = {
            "Data": {
                "byte": nbt.Byte(-3),
                "short": nbt.Short(300),
                "int": nbt.Int(70000),
                "long": nbt.Long(1 << 40),
                "float": nbt.Float(1.5),
                "double": nbt.Double(3.25),
                "text": nbt.NBTString("你好，猫猫🐱"),
                "list": nbt.NBTList([nbt.Int(1), nbt.Int(2)], element_type=nbt.TAG_INT),
                "empty": nbt.NBTList([], element_type=nbt.TAG_STRING),
                "nested": {"flag": nbt.Byte(1)},
                "bytes": nbt.ByteArray([-1, 2, 127]),
                "ints": nbt.IntArray([1, -2, 70000]),
                "longs": nbt.LongArray([1, -(1 << 45)]),
            }
        }
        encoded = nbt.write_nbt(root)
        decoded = nbt.parse_nbt(encoded)
        self.assertEqual(nbt.write_nbt(decoded), encoded)
        self.assertEqual(str(decoded["Data"]["text"]), "你好，猫猫🐱")
        self.assertIsInstance(decoded["Data"]["byte"], nbt.Byte)
        self.assertIsInstance(decoded["Data"]["long"], nbt.Long)
        self.assertEqual(list(decoded["Data"]["nested"].items())[0][0], "flag")
        self.assertEqual(decoded["Data"]["empty"].element_type, nbt.TAG_STRING)

    def test_gzip_file_roundtrip(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            path = Path(tmp) / "level.dat"
            nbt.write_nbt_file(path, {"Data": {"name": nbt.NBTString("存档")}}, compressed=True)
            self.assertEqual(path.read_bytes()[:2], b"\x1f\x8b")
            loaded = nbt.read_nbt(path)
            self.assertEqual(str(loaded["Data"]["name"]), "存档")

    def test_truncated_data_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(nbt.NBTError):
            nbt.parse_nbt(b"\x0a\x00\x00\x03")


class WorldTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_create_read_and_edit_legacy_world(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            info = worlds.create_world(
                tmp,
                name="猫猫世界",
                seed=123456789,
                game_mode=1,
                difficulty=3,
                cheats=True,
                version_id="1.20.1",
            )
            self.assertTrue((info.folder / "level.dat").is_file())
            self.assertEqual(info.name, "猫猫世界")
            self.assertEqual(info.seed, 123456789)
            self.assertEqual(info.seed_text, "123456789")
            self.assertEqual(info.game_mode, 1)
            self.assertEqual(info.difficulty, 3)
            self.assertTrue(info.cheats)
            self.assertFalse(info.modern)

            items = worlds.scan_worlds(tmp)
            self.assertEqual(len(items), 1)
            self.assertEqual(items[0].folder, info.folder)
            self.assertEqual(items[0].seed_text, "123456789")

            settings = worlds.load_world_settings(info.folder)
            settings.name = "改名后的世界"
            settings.seed = 42
            settings.game_mode = 0
            settings.difficulty = 0
            settings.cheats = False
            settings.day_time = 18000
            settings.raining = True
            settings.rules["keepInventory"] = True
            settings.rules["randomTickSpeed"] = 0
            settings.rules["spawnRadius"] = 32
            updated = worlds.apply_world_settings(info.folder, settings)
            self.assertEqual(updated.name, "改名后的世界")
            self.assertEqual(updated.seed, 42)
            self.assertEqual(updated.game_mode, 0)
            self.assertEqual(updated.difficulty, 0)
            self.assertFalse(updated.cheats)
            self.assertTrue(updated.rules["keepInventory"])
            self.assertEqual(updated.rules["randomTickSpeed"], 0)
            self.assertEqual(updated.rules["spawnRadius"], 32)
            self.assertTrue((info.folder / "level.dat_old").is_file())

    @unittest.skipUnless(
        (ROOT / "assets" / "world_template_modern.dat").is_file(),
        "没有现代版世界模板",
    )
    def test_create_read_and_edit_modern_world(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            info = worlds.create_world(
                tmp,
                name="现代世界",
                seed=-5236563929054714751,
                game_mode=0,
                difficulty=2,
                cheats=False,
                version_id="1.21.11",
            )
            self.assertTrue(info.modern)
            self.assertEqual(info.seed, -5236563929054714751)
            settings = worlds.load_world_settings(info.folder)
            settings.rules["keepInventory"] = True
            settings.difficulty = 1
            updated = worlds.apply_world_settings(info.folder, settings)
            self.assertTrue(updated.rules["keepInventory"])
            self.assertEqual(updated.difficulty, 1)
            data = nbt.read_nbt(info.folder / "level.dat")["Data"]
            self.assertIn("game_rules", data)
            self.assertEqual(int(data["game_rules"]["minecraft:keep_inventory"]), 1)

    def test_create_collision_folder(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            first = worlds.create_world(tmp, name="同名", seed=1, version_id="1.20.1")
            second = worlds.create_world(tmp, name="同名", seed=2, version_id="1.20.1")
            self.assertNotEqual(first.folder, second.folder)
            self.assertTrue(second.folder.name.startswith("同名"))

    def test_clean_world_name(self):
        self.assertEqual(worlds.clean_world_name(' a/b:c*? '), "a-b-c--")
        self.assertEqual(worlds.clean_world_name(""), "新的世界")

    def test_delete_rejects_non_save_folder(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            with self.assertRaises(worlds.WorldError):
                worlds.delete_world(Path(tmp))


class ServerTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_add_edit_delete_server(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            entry = worlds.ServerEntry(name="猫猫服", address="mc.example.com")
            worlds.upsert_server(tmp, entry)
            items = worlds.read_servers(tmp)
            self.assertEqual(len(items), 1)
            self.assertEqual(items[0].name, "猫猫服")
            self.assertEqual(items[0].address, "mc.example.com")
            self.assertTrue(items[0].accept_textures)

            edited = worlds.ServerEntry(
                name="猫猫服 2",
                address="127.0.0.1:25565",
                accept_textures=False,
                hidden=True,
                raw=items[0].raw,
            )
            worlds.upsert_server(tmp, edited, 0)
            items = worlds.read_servers(tmp)
            self.assertEqual(items[0].name, "猫猫服 2")
            self.assertEqual(items[0].address, "127.0.0.1:25565")
            self.assertFalse(items[0].accept_textures)
            self.assertTrue(items[0].hidden)
            self.assertTrue((Path(tmp) / "servers.dat_old").is_file())

            worlds.delete_server(tmp, 0)
            self.assertEqual(worlds.read_servers(tmp), [])

    def test_invalid_address_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(worlds.WorldError):
            worlds.validate_server("name", "")
        with self.assertRaises(worlds.WorldError):
            worlds.validate_server("name", "host with space")
        with self.assertRaises(worlds.WorldError):
            worlds.validate_server("", "host")

    def test_overview_counts(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            worlds.create_world(tmp, name="世界", seed=1, version_id="1.20.1")
            worlds.upsert_server(tmp, worlds.ServerEntry(name="服", address="mc.example.com"))
            self.assertEqual(worlds.overview(tmp), (1, 1))


class ChunkbaseRegistryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    PAGE = """
    <select id="platform">
      <optgroup label="Latest Versions">
        <option value="latest//java_99_1_lb">Java 99.1 (LB)</option>
        <option value="latest//bedrock_99_1">Bedrock 99.1</option>
      </optgroup>
      <optgroup label="Experimental">
        <option value="experimental//java_99_2">Java 99.2 (Exp.)</option>
        <option value="experimental//bedrock_99_2">Bedrock 99.2 (Exp.)</option>
      </optgroup>
      <optgroup label="Java Edition">
        <option value="java//java_99_1">Java 99.1</option>
        <option value="java//java_1_21_9">Java 1.21.9 - 1.21.11</option>
        <option value="java//java_1_20">Java 1.20 - 1.20.6</option>
        <option value="java//java_1_19">Java 1.19 - 1.19.2</option>
      </optgroup>
      <optgroup label="Java Edition - Large Biomes">
        <option value="java_lb//java_99_1_lb">Java 99.1 (LB)</option>
        <option value="java_lb//java_1_21_9_lb">Java 1.21.9 - 1.21.11 (LB)</option>
      </optgroup>
      <optgroup label="Bedrock Edition">
        <option value="bedrock//bedrock_99_1">Bedrock 99.1</option>
        <option value="bedrock//bedrock_1_21">Bedrock 1.21</option>
        <option value="bedrock//bedrock_1_20">Bedrock 1.20</option>
      </optgroup>
    </select>
    """

    def test_parse_groups_and_deduplicate(self):
        groups = registry.parse_platform_options(self.PAGE)
        names = [name for name, _items in groups]
        self.assertEqual(
            names,
            [
                registry.GROUP_JAVA,
                registry.GROUP_JAVA_EXPERIMENTAL,
                registry.GROUP_JAVA_LB,
                registry.GROUP_BEDROCK,
            ],
        )
        platforms = registry.platforms(groups)
        self.assertIn("java_99_1", platforms)
        self.assertIn("java_99_2", platforms)
        self.assertIn("bedrock_99_2", platforms)
        self.assertEqual(len(platforms), 11)
        self.assertEqual(names.count(registry.GROUP_BEDROCK), 1)

    def test_future_platform_accepted_by_normalizer(self):
        self.assertEqual(ga.normalize_chunkbase_platform("java_99_1"), "java_99_1")
        self.assertEqual(ga.normalize_chunkbase_platform("bedrock_99_1"), "bedrock_99_1")
        self.assertEqual(
            ga.normalize_chunkbase_platform("javascript:alert(1)"), "java_1_21_9"
        )
        url = ga.chunkbase_url(1, "java_99_1", "end")
        self.assertIn("platform=java_99_1", url)
        self.assertIn("dimension=end", url)

    def test_parse_rejects_empty_page(self):
        with self.assertRaises(registry.RegistryError):
            registry.parse_platform_options("<html></html>")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main(verbosity=2)

################################################################################
# FILE: website/build_plugins.py

from __future__ import annotations

"""把桌宠插件打包成可下载的 ZIP，并生成站点用的 plugins.json。

用法：
    python build_plugins.py

产物：
    public/plugins/<id>-<version>.zip
    public/plugins/docs/PLUGIN_DEV.md
    public/plugins/docs/AI_PLUGIN_PROMPT.md
    public/plugins.json
"""

import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import zipfile
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

SITE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PUBLIC = SITE / "public"
PET = SITE.parent / "desktop_pet"
SOURCE = PET / "plugins"
DOCS = PET / "docs"
DEST = PUBLIC / "plugins"
REGISTRY = PUBLIC / "plugins.json"
COMMUNITY = SITE / "community_plugins.json"

PERMISSION_LABELS = {
    "pet.say": "说话",
    "pet.action": "动作",
    "pet.model": "Live2D 模型",
    "pet.persona": "人格与台词",
    "pet.menu": "右键菜单",
    "ai.chat": "AI 对话",
    "chat.context": "聊天上下文",
    "screen.capture": "截屏",
    "timer": "定时器",
    "events": "事件",
    "settings": "设置",
    "storage": "本地存储",
}

EXCLUDED_PARTS = {"__pycache__", ".state"}
EXCLUDED_SUFFIXES = {".pyc", ".pyo", ".log"}

FEATURED = {
    "lfelkeea.quiz_helper",
    "lfelkeea.deepseek_chan",
    "lfelkeea.alive_core",
    "lfelkeea.focus_guard",
    "lfelkeea.qq_bridge",
    "lfelkeea.qq_inspiration",
    "lfelkeea.self_dev",
}


def plugin_files(folder: Path) -> list[Path]:
    return sorted(
        path
        for path in folder.rglob("*")
        if path.is_file()
        and not any(part in EXCLUDED_PARTS for part in path.relative_to(folder).parts)
        and path.suffix.lower() not in EXCLUDED_SUFFIXES
    )


def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 256), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def package(folder: Path, manifest: dict) -> dict:
    plugin_id = str(manifest["id"])
    version = str(manifest.get("version", "0.0.0"))
    target = DEST / f"{plugin_id}-{version}.zip"
    files = plugin_files(folder)
    if not files:
        raise SystemExit(f"{folder} 里没有可打包的文件")

    with zipfile.ZipFile(target, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=9) as archive:
        for path in files:
            archive.write(path, f"{folder.name}/{path.relative_to(folder).as_posix()}")

    permissions = [str(item) for item in manifest.get("permissions", [])]
    requires = []
    for item in manifest.get("requires", []) or []:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        requires.append(
            {
                "name": str(item.get("name", "")),
                "version": str(item.get("version", "")),
                "url": str(item.get("url", "")),
                "note": str(item.get("note", "")),
            }
        )
    highlights = []
    for item in manifest.get("highlights", []) or []:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        highlights.append(
            {"label": str(item.get("label", "")), "value": str(item.get("value", ""))}
        )
    return {
        "id": plugin_id,
        "name": str(manifest.get("name", plugin_id)),
        "version": version,
        "author": str(manifest.get("author", "")),
        "description": str(manifest.get("description", "")),
        "api_version": int(manifest.get("api_version", 1)),
        "permissions": permissions,
        "permission_labels": [PERMISSION_LABELS.get(item, item) for item in permissions],
        "requires": requires,
        "highlights": highlights,
        "settings": manifest.get("settings", {}),
        "bundled": folder.name.startswith("example."),
        "featured": plugin_id in FEATURED,
        "file": f"plugins/{target.name}",
        "size": target.stat().st_size,
        "sha256": sha256(target),
    }


def copy_docs() -> None:
    docs_dest = DEST / "docs"
    docs_dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for name in ("PLUGIN_DEV.md", "AI_PLUGIN_PROMPT.md"):
        source = DOCS / name
        if source.is_file():
            shutil.copy2(source, docs_dest / name)


def main() -> int:
    if not SOURCE.is_dir():
        raise SystemExit(f"找不到插件目录：{SOURCE}")
    DEST.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    released = json.loads((SITE / "pet_release.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    pet_version = str(released.get("version", "1.1.0"))

    entries: list[dict] = []
    for folder in sorted(SOURCE.iterdir()):
        manifest_path = folder / "plugin.json"
        if not folder.is_dir() or not manifest_path.is_file():
            continue
        manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if "id" not in manifest:
            raise SystemExit(f"{manifest_path} 缺少 id")
        entries.append(package(folder, manifest))

    official_ids = {item["id"] for item in entries}
    community = []
    if COMMUNITY.is_file():
        data = json.loads(COMMUNITY.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        for item in data.get("plugins", []):
            if not isinstance(item, dict):
                continue
            plugin_id = str(item.get("id", ""))
            file_name = Path(str(item.get("file", ""))).name
            target = DEST / file_name
            if not plugin_id or plugin_id in official_ids or not target.is_file():
                continue
            # 新版记录把完整条目放在 entry 里；旧记录只有最小字段，直接用自身兜底。
            base = item.get("entry")
            entry = dict(base) if isinstance(base, dict) else dict(item)
            entry["id"] = plugin_id
            entry["name"] = str(entry.get("name") or plugin_id)
            entry["version"] = str(entry.get("version") or item.get("version") or "0.0.0")
            entry["author"] = str(entry.get("author") or "")
            entry["description"] = str(entry.get("description") or "")
            entry["api_version"] = int(entry.get("api_version") or 1)
            entry["permissions"] = [str(value) for value in (entry.get("permissions") or [])]
            entry["permission_labels"] = [PERMISSION_LABELS.get(value, value) for value in entry["permissions"]]
            entry["requires"] = entry.get("requires") or []
            entry["highlights"] = entry.get("highlights") or []
            entry["settings"] = entry.get("settings") or {}
            entry["bundled"] = False
            entry["featured"] = False
            entry["community"] = True
            entry["file"] = f"plugins/{file_name}"
            entry["size"] = target.stat().st_size
            entry["sha256"] = sha256(target)
            community.append(entry)

    entries.extend(community)
    entries.sort(key=lambda item: (not item["featured"], item["bundled"], item["name"]))

    registry = {
        "updated": datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
        "api_version": 1,
        "pet_version": pet_version,
        "plugins": entries,
    }
    REGISTRY.write_text(json.dumps(registry, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    copy_docs()

    total = sum(item["size"] for item in entries)
    for item in entries:
        print(f"{item['id']:<28} {item['version']:<8} {item['size']:>8} B  {item['file']}")
    print(f"{len(entries)} plugins ({len(community)} community), {total} B total -> {REGISTRY}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse

SITE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PUBLIC = SITE / "public"
DOWNLOADS = PUBLIC / "downloads"
PET_RELEASE = SITE / "pet_release.json"
DEFAULT_SOURCE = Path(os.environ.get("DKL_SOURCE", str(SITE.parent / "launcher")))
MOD_AGENT_SOURCE = Path(os.environ.get("DMA_SOURCE", str(SITE.parent / "mod_agent")))
MOD_AGENT_ASSETS = MOD_AGENT_SOURCE / "assets"
MOD_AGENT_DIST = MOD_AGENT_SOURCE / "dist"
DELIVERY = Path(os.environ.get("DKL_DELIVERY", str(Path.home() / "Tianxi")))
DEFAULT_REPO = "darkitten-launcher"
# GitHub Git Blob API 对单次请求体积有限制，超过这个大小的发布包必须走 Release 资源。
MAX_PAGES_FILE_BYTES = 30 * 1024 * 1024

EXCLUDED_NAMES = {
    "config.json",
    "social.json",
    "assistant.json",
    "frpc.exe",
    # 本机运行时数据：OC 的 API Key、记忆与审判战进度不能进发布包。
    "judgement.json",
    "oc_ai.json",
    "oc_memory.json",
}
EXCLUDED_PARTS = {
    "__pycache__",
    ".writing",
    "cache",
    # EasyTier 联机组件由启动器首次开房时按需下载，不随包分发。
    "easytier",
    "logs",

    ".deploy",
    "downloads",
}
TEXT_SUFFIXES = {
    ".py", ".txt", ".json", ".md", ".bat", ".cmd", ".ps1", ".sh",
    ".html", ".css", ".js", ".svg", ".yml", ".yaml", ".toml", ".ini",
    ".cfg", ".properties", ".xml", ".java", ".gradle", ".kts", ".csv",
}


def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as fp:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: fp.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def read_version(source: Path) -> str:
    text = (source / "darkitten" / "config.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    match = re.search(r'APP_VERSION\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"', text)
    if not match:
        raise SystemExit("无法从 darkitten/config.py 读取 APP_VERSION")
    return match.group(1)


def source_include(relative: Path) -> bool:
    if any(part in EXCLUDED_PARTS for part in relative.parts):
        return False
    if relative.name in EXCLUDED_NAMES:
        return False
    if relative.suffix.lower() in (".pyc", ".pyo", ".log"):
        return False
    if relative.parts and relative.parts[0] == "qa" and relative.suffix.lower() == ".png":
        return False
    return True


def website_include(relative: Path) -> bool:
    if any(part in EXCLUDED_PARTS for part in relative.parts):
        return False
    if relative.parts and relative.parts[0] == "qa":
        return False
    if "downloads" in relative.parts:
        return False
    if relative.suffix.lower() in (".pyc", ".pyo", ".log"):
        return False
    return True


def write_zip(target: Path, entries: list[tuple[Path, str]]) -> None:
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(target, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=9) as archive:
        for source, arcname in entries:
            archive.write(source, arcname)


def source_files(source: Path) -> list[Path]:
    return sorted(
        path.relative_to(source)
        for path in source.rglob("*")
        if path.is_file() and source_include(path.relative_to(source))
    )


PACKAGE_EXCLUDED_PARTS = {"qa"}


def package_files(source: Path) -> list[Path]:
    """发布包只带启动器运行所需的代码与资源，不带测试、工具和网站源码。"""
    return [
        relative
        for relative in source_files(source)
        if not (relative.parts and relative.parts[0] in PACKAGE_EXCLUDED_PARTS)
    ]


def website_files() -> list[Path]:
    return sorted(
        path.relative_to(SITE)
        for path in SITE.rglob("*")
        if path.is_file() and website_include(path.relative_to(SITE))
    )


def decode_text(path: Path) -> str:
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    for encoding in ("utf-8-sig", "utf-8", "gbk"):
        try:
            return raw.decode(encoding)
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            continue
    return raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")


def text_entries(source: Path) -> list[tuple[str, Path]]:
    entries: list[tuple[str, Path]] = []
    for relative in package_files(source):
        if relative.suffix.lower() in TEXT_SUFFIXES:
            entries.append((relative.as_posix(), source / relative))
    return entries


def write_source_txt(target: Path, source: Path, version: str) -> None:
    entries = text_entries(source)
    lines = [
        f"Darkitten Launcher {version} 完整源代码",
        f"生成时间：{datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}",
        f"文本文件：{len(entries)}",
        "=" * 80,
        "目录",
        "=" * 80,
    ]
    lines.extend(f"  {name}" for name, _ in entries)
    lines.extend(["", "=" * 80, ""])
    for name, path in entries:
        lines.append("#" * 80)
        lines.append(f"# FILE: {name}")
        lines.append("#" * 80)
        lines.append(decode_text(path).rstrip())
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("")
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8-sig")


LEGACY_SHIM_UPDATER = '''from __future__ import annotations

import re
import shutil
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path


def _legacy_version(install_dir: Path) -> str:
    try:
        text = (install_dir / "stellar" / "config.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except Exception:
        return ""
    match = re.search(r'APP_VERSION\\s*=\\s*"([^"]+)"', text)
    return match.group(1) if match else ""


def apply_update_code(payload_root: Path, install_dir: Path) -> Path:
    """1.9.14 及更早版本只有 stellar 包，这里转交给新的 darkitten 实现。"""
    payload_root = Path(payload_root).resolve()
    install_dir = Path(install_dir).resolve()
    legacy_version = _legacy_version(install_dir)
    if str(payload_root) not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, str(payload_root))
    from darkitten.updater import apply_update_code as apply_new

    backup = apply_new(payload_root, install_dir)
    if legacy_version and backup.name.startswith("backup-unknown-"):
        renamed = backup.with_name(
            backup.name.replace("backup-unknown-", f"backup-{legacy_version}-", 1)
        )
        try:
            backup.rename(renamed)
            backup = renamed
        except Exception:
            pass

    legacy = install_dir / "stellar"
    if legacy.exists():
        stamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
        target = install_dir / "updates" / f"legacy-stellar-{stamp}"
        try:
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.move(str(legacy), str(target))
        except Exception:
            shutil.rmtree(legacy, ignore_errors=True)
    return backup
'''


def legacy_shim_entries(
    directory: Path, version: str, update_root: str
) -> list[tuple[Path, str]]:
    shim = directory / "stellar"
    shim.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (shim / "__init__.py").write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
    (shim / "config.py").write_text(
        f'APP_VERSION = "{version}"\n', encoding="utf-8"
    )
    (shim / "updater.py").write_text(LEGACY_SHIM_UPDATER, encoding="utf-8")
    return [
        (path, f"{update_root}/stellar/{path.relative_to(shim).as_posix()}")
        for path in sorted(shim.rglob("*"))
        if path.is_file()
    ]


def load_pet_release() -> dict | None:
    """桌宠体积超过 GitHub Pages 单文件上限，走 Release 资源，清单里只放元数据。"""
    if not PET_RELEASE.is_file():
        return None
    try:
        data = json.loads(PET_RELEASE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise SystemExit(f"pet_release.json 读取失败：{exc}") from exc
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise SystemExit("pet_release.json 必须是一个 JSON 对象")
    version = str(data.get("version") or "").strip()
    url = str(data.get("download_url") or "").strip()
    digest = str(data.get("sha256") or "").strip().lower()
    try:
        size = int(data.get("size") or 0)
    except Exception:
        size = 0
    if not version:
        raise SystemExit("pet_release.json 缺少 version")
    if not url.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
        raise SystemExit("pet_release.json 的 download_url 必须是完整地址")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", digest):
        raise SystemExit("pet_release.json 的 sha256 不是有效的 64 位十六进制")
    if size <= 0:
        raise SystemExit("pet_release.json 的 size 无效")
    return {
        "name": str(data.get("name") or "LFELKEEA 桌宠"),
        "version": version,
        "released": str(data.get("released") or ""),
        "size": size,
        "sha256": digest,
        "download_url": url,
        "notes": [str(item) for item in (data.get("notes") or []) if str(item).strip()],
    }


def load_mod_agent_release() -> dict | None:
    """模组工坊的发布包较小，直接跟随下载站发布；dist 有产物时自动同步。"""
    source = MOD_AGENT_DIST / "mod_agent_release.json"
    target = PUBLIC / "mod_agent_release.json"
    if not source.is_file():
        if not target.is_file():
            print("mod agent: 没有找到发布清单，跳过", flush=True)
            return None
        source = target
    try:
        data = json.loads(source.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise SystemExit(f"mod_agent_release.json 读取失败：{exc}") from exc
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise SystemExit("mod_agent_release.json 必须是一个 JSON 对象")
    version = str(data.get("version") or "").strip()
    url = str(data.get("download_url") or "").strip()
    digest = str(data.get("sha256") or "").strip().lower()
    try:
        size = int(data.get("size") or 0)
    except Exception:
        size = 0
    if not version:
        raise SystemExit("mod_agent_release.json 缺少 version")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", digest):
        raise SystemExit("mod_agent_release.json 的 sha256 不是有效的 64 位十六进制")
    if size <= 0:
        raise SystemExit("mod_agent_release.json 的 size 无效")
    if url.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
        package = None
    else:
        name = Path(url).name
        package = MOD_AGENT_DIST / name
        if not package.is_file():
            package = (PUBLIC / url).resolve()
        if PUBLIC.resolve() not in package.parents and MOD_AGENT_DIST.resolve() not in package.parents:
            raise SystemExit("mod_agent_release.json 的 download_url 越出网站目录")
        if not package.is_file():
            raise SystemExit(f"找不到模组工坊发布包：{url}")

    if package is not None:
        actual_sha = sha256(package)
        actual_size = package.stat().st_size
        if actual_sha != digest:
            raise SystemExit(
                f"模组工坊发布包 SHA-256 不匹配：清单 {digest}，实际 {actual_sha}"
            )
        if actual_size != size:
            raise SystemExit(
                f"模组工坊发布包大小不匹配：清单 {size}，实际 {actual_size}"
            )
        if package.parent != DOWNLOADS:
            DOWNLOADS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(package, DOWNLOADS / package.name)
        if str(data.get("download_url", "")).startswith(("http://", "https://")):
            data["download_url"] = f"downloads/{package.name}"
    elif size >= 95 * 1024 * 1024:
        raise SystemExit(
            "模组工坊发布包超过 GitHub Pages 单文件建议上限，请改走 GitHub Releases。"
        )

    icon = MOD_AGENT_ASSETS / "dma.png"
    if icon.is_file():
        (PUBLIC / "assets").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(icon, PUBLIC / "assets" / "dma.png")

    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_text(
        json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    return {
        "version": version,
        "size": size,
        "download_url": str(data.get("download_url") or ""),
    }


def sync_site_version(version: str) -> None:
    index = PUBLIC / "index.html"
    text = index.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    previous = ""
    try:
        manifest = json.loads((PUBLIC / "update.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        previous = str(manifest.get("version") or "")
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        pass
    if previous and previous != version:
        # 精确替换上一版版本号，避免误伤页面里的 Minecraft 版本号。
        text = text.replace(previous, version)
    else:
        text = re.sub(r"1\.(?:9|10)\.\d+", version, text)
    index.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")

    script = PUBLIC / "app.js"
    text = script.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    text = re.sub(r'(\|\| ")\d+\.\d+\.\d+(")', rf"\g<1>{version}\g<2>", text)
    text = re.sub(
        r'(FEEDBACK_VERSION_FALLBACK\s*=\s*")\d+\.\d+\.\d+(")',
        rf"\g<1>{version}\g<2>",
        text,
    )
    script.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")


def find_gh() -> str:
    for candidate in (shutil.which("gh"), r"C:\Program Files\GitHub CLI\gh.exe"):
        if candidate and Path(candidate).is_file():
            return candidate
    raise SystemExit("未找到 GitHub CLI（gh），请先安装并登录。")


def run_gh(gh: str, *args: str, check: bool = True) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
    result = subprocess.run(
        [gh, *args], text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", capture_output=True
    )
    if check and result.returncode != 0:
        detail = (result.stderr or result.stdout).strip()
        raise SystemExit(f"GitHub 命令失败：gh {' '.join(args)}\n{detail}")
    return result


def gh_api(
    gh: str,
    endpoint: str,
    method: str | None = None,
    payload: dict | None = None,
    check: bool = True,
) -> dict:
    args = ["api"]
    if method:
        args.extend(["-X", method])
    args.append(endpoint)
    input_text = None
    if payload is not None:
        args.extend(["--input", "-"])
        input_text = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False)
    result = subprocess.run(
        [gh, *args],
        input=input_text,
        text=True,
        encoding="utf-8",
        errors="replace",
        capture_output=True,
    )
    if check and result.returncode != 0:
        detail = (result.stderr or result.stdout).strip()
        raise SystemExit(f"GitHub API 调用失败：{endpoint}\n{detail}")
    if result.returncode != 0:
        return {}
    text = result.stdout.strip()
    if not text:
        if check:
            raise SystemExit(f"GitHub API 返回空响应：{endpoint}")
        return {}
    try:
        return json.loads(text)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        if check:
            raise SystemExit(f"GitHub API 返回无效 JSON：{endpoint}\n{text[:400]}") from exc
        return {}


def ensure_repo(gh: str, repo: str) -> str:
    if "/" in repo:
        target = repo
    else:
        probe = run_gh(gh, "repo", "view", repo, "--json", "nameWithOwner", "--jq", ".nameWithOwner", check=False)
        if probe.returncode == 0:
            return probe.stdout.strip()
        user = run_gh(gh, "api", "user", "--jq", ".login").stdout.strip()
        target = f"{user}/{repo}"

    probe = run_gh(gh, "repo", "view", target, "--json", "nameWithOwner", "--jq", ".nameWithOwner", check=False)
    if probe.returncode == 0:
        return probe.stdout.strip()

    created = run_gh(
        gh, "repo", "create", target, "--public",
        "--description", "Darkitten Launcher 下载站与完整源码",
        check=False,
    )
    if created.returncode != 0:
        detail = (created.stderr or created.stdout).strip()
        raise SystemExit(f"创建 GitHub 仓库失败：{detail}")
    return target


def repo_is_empty(gh: str, full: str) -> bool:
    return not bool(gh_api(gh, f"repos/{full}/git/refs", check=False))


def upload_tree(
    gh: str,
    full: str,
    branch: str,
    files: list[tuple[str, Path]],
    message: str,
    *,
    base_tree: bool = False,
) -> None:
    if repo_is_empty(gh, full):
        # Git Data API 在完全空的仓库上会返回 409，先用 Contents API 建立首个提交。
        gh_api(
            gh, f"repos/{full}/contents/.nojekyll", "PUT",
            {
                "message": "chore: initialize repository",
                "content": base64.b64encode(b"\n").decode("ascii"),
            },
        )

    ref = gh_api(gh, f"repos/{full}/git/ref/heads/{branch}", check=False)
    parent = str(ref.get("object", {}).get("sha") or "") or None

    entries: list[dict] = []
    for relative, path in files:
        content = base64.b64encode(path.read_bytes()).decode("ascii")
        blob: dict = {}
        for attempt in range(3):
            try:
                blob = gh_api(
                    gh, f"repos/{full}/git/blobs", "POST",
                    {"content": content, "encoding": "base64"},
                )
                break
            except SystemExit:
                if attempt == 2:
                    raise
                time.sleep(2)
        entries.append(
            {"path": relative, "mode": "100644", "type": "blob", "sha": blob["sha"]}
        )

    payload: dict = {"tree": entries}
    if base_tree and parent:
        # 增量覆盖：保留远端已有文件（例如历史下载包），只替换本次上传的路径。
        # 读不到父提交的 tree 时必须中止，否则会把整个分支覆盖成本次文件。
        parent_commit = gh_api(gh, f"repos/{full}/git/commits/{parent}", check=False)
        base_sha = str(parent_commit.get("tree", {}).get("sha") or "")
        if not base_sha:
            raise SystemExit(
                "base_tree 失败：读不到父提交的 tree，已中止上传以避免覆盖远端文件。"
            )
        payload["base_tree"] = base_sha
    tree = gh_api(gh, f"repos/{full}/git/trees", "POST", payload)
    print(f"upload {branch}: {len(entries)} files, tree {tree['sha']}", flush=True)
    # 新建 tree 后立刻提交偶尔会触发 GitHub 的复制延迟（Tree SHA does not exist），短暂等待后重试。
    commit: dict = {}
    for attempt in range(4):
        try:
            commit = gh_api(
                gh, f"repos/{full}/git/commits", "POST",
                {
                    "message": message,
                    "tree": tree["sha"],
                    "parents": [parent] if parent else [],
                },
            )
            break
        except SystemExit:
            if attempt == 3:
                raise
            time.sleep(2 * (attempt + 1))
    if parent:
        gh_api(
            gh, f"repos/{full}/git/refs/heads/{branch}", "PATCH",
            {"sha": commit["sha"], "force": False},
        )
    else:
        gh_api(
            gh, f"repos/{full}/git/refs", "POST",
            {"ref": f"refs/heads/{branch}", "sha": commit["sha"]},
        )


def deploy_github(version: str, repo: str, source: Path) -> str:
    gh = find_gh()
    auth = run_gh(gh, "auth", "status", check=False)
    if auth.returncode != 0:
        raise SystemExit("GitHub CLI 尚未登录，请先运行 gh auth login 完成授权。")

    full = ensure_repo(gh, repo)
    (PUBLIC / ".nojekyll").write_text("", encoding="utf-8")

    public_files = []
    for path in sorted(PUBLIC.rglob("*")):
        if not path.is_file():
            continue
        relative = path.relative_to(PUBLIC)
        if ".git" in relative.parts or ".sync-part" in path.name:
            continue
        if path.stat().st_size > MAX_PAGES_FILE_BYTES:
            print(
                f"skip pages upload: {relative.as_posix()} "
                f"({path.stat().st_size} bytes) 请使用 Release 资源",
                flush=True,
            )
            continue
        public_files.append((relative.as_posix(), path))
    # 增量覆盖 gh-pages：以远端现有 tree 为基底，历史版本的下载包不会被删除。
    upload_tree(
        gh, full, "gh-pages", public_files,
        f"deploy: Darkitten Launcher {version}", base_tree=True,
    )

    source_repo_files = [
        (relative.as_posix(), source / relative) for relative in source_files(source)
    ]
    source_repo_files.extend(
        (f"website/{relative.as_posix()}", SITE / relative)
        for relative in website_files()
    )
    upload_tree(gh, full, "main", source_repo_files, f"source: Darkitten Launcher {version}")

    pages_payload = {"source": {"branch": "gh-pages", "path": "/"}}
    pages = gh_api(gh, f"repos/{full}/pages", check=False)
    if not pages:
        # 仓库首次推送 gh-pages 时 GitHub 可能已经自动启用 Pages，409 视为成功。
        gh_api(gh, f"repos/{full}/pages", "POST", pages_payload, check=False)
    gh_api(gh, f"repos/{full}/pages", "PUT", pages_payload, check=False)

    info = gh_api(gh, f"repos/{full}/pages", check=False)
    owner, name = full.split("/", 1)
    return str(info.get("html_url") or f"https://{owner.lower()}.github.io/{name}/")


def build(source: Path, version: str, deploy: bool, repo: str) -> int:
    notes_map = json.loads((SITE / "release_notes.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if version not in notes_map:
        raise SystemExit(f"release_notes.json 缺少 {version} 的更新说明，请先补充。")

    sync_site_version(version)
    source_entries: list[tuple[Path, str]] = []
    root = f"DarkittenLauncher-{version}-source"
    for relative in package_files(source):
        source_entries.append((source / relative, f"{root}/{relative.as_posix()}"))

    update_entries: list[tuple[Path, str]] = []
    update_root = f"DKL-{version}"
    for name in (
        "app.py",
        "requirements.txt",
        "launch.bat",
        "启动.bat",
        "bootstrap_runtime.ps1",
    ):
        path = source / name
        if path.is_file():
            update_entries.append((path, f"{update_root}/{name}"))
    for name in ("darkitten", "assets", "tools/enchcracker"):
        folder = source / name
        if not folder.is_dir():
            continue
        for path in sorted(folder.rglob("*")):
            if not path.is_file():
                continue
            relative = path.relative_to(source)
            if any(part == "__pycache__" for part in relative.parts):
                continue
            if path.suffix.lower() in (".pyc", ".pyo", ".log"):
                continue
            update_entries.append((path, f"{update_root}/{relative.as_posix()}"))

    DOWNLOADS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    source_zip = DOWNLOADS / f"DarkittenLauncher-{version}-source.zip"
    update_zip = DOWNLOADS / f"DKL-{version}-update.zip"
    source_txt = DOWNLOADS / f"DarkittenLauncher-{version}-source.txt"
    write_zip(source_zip, source_entries)
    # 更新包额外带一份 stellar 兼容垫片：1.9.14 的旧更新器只认 stellar/config.py
    # 和 stellar.updater，用它把更新转交给 darkitten 后再清理旧包。
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="dkl-legacy-shim-") as shim_tmp:
        update_entries.extend(
            legacy_shim_entries(Path(shim_tmp), version, update_root)
        )
        write_zip(update_zip, update_entries)
    write_source_txt(source_txt, source, version)

    manifest = {
        "version": version,
        "released": date.today().isoformat(),
        "notes": notes_map[version],
        "download_url": f"downloads/{update_zip.name}",
        "page_url": "https://lfelkeea.github.io/darkitten-launcher/",
        "source_url": f"downloads/{source_zip.name}",
        "source_txt_url": f"downloads/{source_txt.name}",
        "sha256": sha256(update_zip),
        "size": update_zip.stat().st_size,
        "source_sha256": sha256(source_zip),
        "source_size": source_zip.stat().st_size,
        "source_txt_sha256": sha256(source_txt),
        "source_txt_size": source_txt.stat().st_size,
    }
    pet_meta = load_pet_release()
    if pet_meta:
        manifest["pet"] = pet_meta
    mod_agent_meta = load_mod_agent_release()
    (PUBLIC / "update.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    DELIVERY.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(source_zip, DELIVERY / source_zip.name)
    shutil.copy2(source_txt, DELIVERY / source_txt.name)

    for archive_path in (source_zip, update_zip):
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
            bad = archive.testzip()
            if bad:
                raise SystemExit(f"{archive_path.name} 校验失败：{bad}")

    print("version:", version)
    print("source zip:", len(source_entries), "entries,", source_zip.stat().st_size, "bytes")
    print("update zip:", len(update_entries), "entries,", update_zip.stat().st_size, "bytes")
    print("source txt:", len(text_entries(source)), "files,", source_txt.stat().st_size, "bytes")
    print("update sha256:", manifest["sha256"])
    print("source sha256:", manifest["source_sha256"])
    print("source txt sha256:", manifest["source_txt_sha256"])
    if pet_meta:
        print(
            "pet:",
            pet_meta["version"],
            pet_meta["size"],
            "bytes",
            pet_meta["download_url"],
        )
    if mod_agent_meta:
        print(
            "mod agent:",
            mod_agent_meta["version"],
            mod_agent_meta["size"],
            "bytes",
            mod_agent_meta["download_url"],
        )

    if deploy:
        pages_url = deploy_github(version, repo, source)
        print("pages url:", pages_url)
    return 0


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="构建并发布 Darkitten Launcher")
    parser.add_argument("--source", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_SOURCE, help="启动器源码目录")
    parser.add_argument("--version", default="", help="默认读取 darkitten/config.py")
    parser.add_argument("--deploy", action="store_true", help="构建后部署到 GitHub Pages")
    parser.add_argument("--repo", default=DEFAULT_REPO, help="GitHub 仓库名或 owner/repo")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    source = args.source.resolve()
    version = args.version or read_version(source)
    return build(source, version, args.deploy, args.repo)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

# FILE: website/deploy_agent_only.py

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))

import build_release as br

# GitHub Pages 单文件硬上限是 100MB；超过这个大小的包必须走 Release 资源。
MAX_PAGES_PACKAGE_BYTES = 100 * 1024 * 1024

gh = br.find_gh()
full = br.ensure_repo(gh, br.DEFAULT_REPO)
files = [
    ("index.html", br.PUBLIC / "index.html"),
    ("mod_agent_release.json", br.PUBLIC / "mod_agent_release.json"),
]
for rel, path in files:
    if not path.is_file():
        raise SystemExit(f"缺少 {path}")
    size = path.stat().st_size
    if size > br.MAX_PAGES_FILE_BYTES:
        raise SystemExit(f"{rel} 过大：{size}")
    print("upload", rel, size)

manifest = json.loads(
    (br.PUBLIC / "mod_agent_release.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
)
version = str(manifest.get("version") or "").strip()
if not version:
    raise SystemExit("mod_agent_release.json 缺少 version")

# 清单里的 download_url 是相对路径时，发布包随站点一起上传；
# 绝对地址（GitHub Release）则保持原样，只更新页面和清单。
url = str(manifest.get("download_url") or "").strip()
if not url.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
    package = (br.PUBLIC / url).resolve()
    if br.PUBLIC.resolve() not in package.parents:
        raise SystemExit("mod_agent_release.json 的 download_url 越出网站目录")
    if not package.is_file():
        raise SystemExit(f"缺少模组工坊发布包：{package}")
    size = package.stat().st_size
    if size > MAX_PAGES_PACKAGE_BYTES:
        raise SystemExit(
            f"发布包 {size} 字节超过 GitHub Pages 单文件上限，请改走 GitHub Releases。"
        )
    if size != int(manifest.get("size") or 0):
        raise SystemExit(
            f"发布包大小与清单不一致：清单 {manifest.get('size')}，实际 {size}"
        )
    digest = br.sha256(package)
    if digest != str(manifest.get("sha256") or "").strip().lower():
        raise SystemExit(
            f"发布包 SHA-256 与清单不一致：清单 {manifest.get('sha256')}，实际 {digest}"
        )
    files.append((package.relative_to(br.PUBLIC).as_posix(), package))
    print("upload package", url, size, digest)

br.upload_tree(
    gh,
    full,
    "gh-pages",
    files,
    f"deploy: Mod Agent {version}",
    base_tree=True,
)
print("done", full)
