## 12. 给 AI 助手的提示词

见同目录的 [`AI_PLUGIN_PROMPT.md`](AI_PLUGIN_PROMPT.md)。把那份文件连同本指南一起交给其他 AI，就可以让它按统一规范产出插件。


################################################################################
# FILE: website/public/plugins/docs/SUBMIT_PLUGIN.md
################################################################################
# 插件投稿与审核说明

这份文档写给想把自己的桌宠插件放进官方插件库的人。投稿是**人工审核制**：投稿不等于上架，审核通过后才会公开。

- 投稿入口：<https://lfelkeea.github.io/darkitten-launcher/submit-plugin.html>
- 审核队列：<https://lfelkeea.github.io/darkitten-launcher/plugin-review.html>
- 插件开发文档：[PLUGIN_DEV.md](PLUGIN_DEV.md)
- 投稿 Issue 列表：<https://github.com/LFELKEEA/darkitten-launcher/issues?q=label%3Aplugin-submission>

---

## 1. 投稿前准备

1. 按 [PLUGIN_DEV.md](PLUGIN_DEV.md) 完成插件，确认能在桌宠里正常启用。
2. 插件根目录名必须等于 `plugin.json` 里的 `id`，例如：

```text
my_plugin/
├─ plugin.json
├─ main.py
└─ README.md
```

3. 打包时只压缩这个文件夹本身，不要多套一层目录，也不要带运行数据：

```text
my_plugin-1.0.0.zip
└─ my_plugin/
   ├─ plugin.json
   └─ main.py
```

4. 不要包含以下内容：
   - `data/`、`__pycache__/`、`.git/`、`node_modules/`、日志和缓存；
   - `config.json`、`social.json`、`.env`、密钥、证书、账号密码；
   - `.exe`、`.dll`、`.bat`、`.cmd`、`.ps1`、`.sh`、`.jar` 等可执行文件或脚本；
   - 你无权分发的第三方代码、素材或闭源程序。

5. 单个 ZIP 不超过 **6 MB**，解压后总大小不超过 **30 MB**，最多 **300** 个条目，`plugin.json` 不超过 **64 KB**。

---

## 2. 投稿流程

```text
选择 ZIP
  ↓ 浏览器本地解析、检查清单和权限（不上传文件）
生成投稿 Issue
  ↓ 把 ZIP 拖进 Issue 附件
Actions 自动校验
  ↓ 打上 plugin-validated / plugin-invalid
维护者阅读代码
  ↓ 评论 /approve 或 /reject 原因
自动发布到插件库
```

### 2.1 在网站提交

打开投稿页，选择 ZIP。页面会在本地完成这些检查：

- ZIP 结构、路径穿越、绝对路径、加密、ZIP64、符号链接；
- 是否只有一个顶层插件文件夹，且文件夹名等于 `id`；
- `plugin.json` 是否存在、是否合法；
- `id`、`version`、`api_version`、`entry`、`permissions`、`settings`、`requires`、`highlights`；
- 是否使用保留前缀 `lfelkeea.` / `example.`；
- 是否包含危险文件名或可执行文件；
- 计算 SHA-256，供 GitHub Actions 再次核对。

检查通过后，页面会生成一个带 `plugin-submission` 标签的 GitHub Issue 正文，并打开新建 Issue 页面。把 ZIP 拖到正文里，等 GitHub 显示上传完成，再提交。

### 2.2 自动校验

Issue 创建或编辑后，GitHub Actions 会：

1. 下载 Issue 里的 ZIP 附件；
2. 用和网站相同的规则重新校验；
3. 对比 ZIP 的 SHA-256 和大小；
4. 在 Issue 里回复校验结果，并打标签：
   - `plugin-validated`：结构检查通过，等待人工审核；
   - `plugin-invalid`：检查失败，按评论里的提示修改后重新投稿。

自动校验**只解析 ZIP，不执行插件代码**。

### 2.3 人工审核

审核看板：<https://lfelkeea.github.io/darkitten-launcher/plugin-review.html>。看板优先读取 Actions 生成的同源队列快照，再尝试 GitHub 公开接口；即使浏览器访问不了 `api.github.com`，也能看到队列和 Issue 链接。最终状态以 Issue 标签和评论为准。

维护者会检查：

- `main.py` 和依赖模块的实际行为；
- 权限是否和代码一致，有没有多要权限；
- 是否读取、上传或记录不该碰的数据；
- 外部依赖是否说明清楚，链接是否指向官方来源；
- 名称、描述、版本号、作者信息是否准确；
- 是否覆盖官方插件、别人的插件 id，或只是空壳 / 重复投稿。

### 2.4 发布

维护者在 Issue 评论：

```text
/approve
```

Actions 会再次校验，确认不会覆盖官方 id、版本必须高于已发布版本，然后把 ZIP、`plugins.json` 和社区记录发布到插件库。发布成功后：

- Issue 打上 `plugin-published` 并关闭；
- 插件出现在[插件库](https://lfelkeea.github.io/darkitten-launcher/plugins.html)；
- 桌宠的插件市场刷新后可以看到。

退回时维护者评论：

```text
/reject 说明具体原因
```

Issue 会打上 `plugin-rejected` 并关闭。修改后可以重新走投稿流程；同一个 id 的新版本必须使用更高的 `version`。

---

## 3. 版本与 id 规则

- `id`：`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.-]{1,63}$`，只能小写字母、数字、点、下划线、短横线，长度 2–64。
- `version`：语义化版本，例如 `1.0.0`、`1.2.3-beta.1`。
- `api_version`：目前必须是 `1`。
- `entry`：插件目录内的 `.py` 文件，默认 `main.py`。
- 保留前缀：`lfelkeea.` 和 `example.`，投稿请换一个 id。
- 官方或内置插件占用的 id 不能被覆盖。
- 同一 id 的新版本必须严格高于已发布版本。

权限只接受以下值：

| 权限 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `pet.say` | 让桌宠说话 |
| `pet.action` | 触发桌宠动作 |
| `ai.chat` | 调用 AI 对话 |
| `screen.capture` | 截取屏幕 |
| `timer` | 创建定时器 |
| `events` | 订阅事件 |
| `settings` | 读写插件设置 |
| `storage` | 读写插件存储 |

---

## 4. 会被直接退回的情况

- 包含可执行文件、脚本、密钥、`config.json`、`social.json` 或 `data/`；
- 使用 `lfelkeea.` / `example.` 保留前缀；
- 覆盖官方插件或他人的插件 id；
- 权限声明和实际行为明显不符；
- 有联网上传、偷拍屏幕、读取账号凭证、下载执行远程代码等行为；
- 没有实际功能、只是空壳、重复投稿或无法正常启用；
- 描述、作者、版本信息与实际不符；
- 侵犯他人版权或违反第三方许可。

---

## 5. 没有 GitHub 账号

可以把以下内容发到 <lfel278623@outlook.com>：

- 插件 ZIP；
- `plugin.json`；
- 使用说明和权限说明；
- 你希望展示的作者名和联系方式。

同样要走审核，通过后由维护者代为发布。

---

## 6. 隐私与责任

- 网站不会保存你选择的 ZIP；文件只在浏览器里读取。
- Issue 里的附件由 GitHub 托管，公开可见，不要上传任何密钥或私人数据。
- 投稿即表示你确认自己制作了插件，或拥有分发它的权利，并同意插件在审核通过后公开下载。
- 插件运行在本机桌宠进程里，权限系统只能约束插件 API，不能约束 Python 本身。请对自己发布的代码负责，也请用户只安装信任的插件。

    <section class="section pl-install" id="install">
      <div class="pl-section-head reveal">
        <div>
          <span class="kicker">INSTALL</span>
          <h2>三步装好，<br>不用改代码。</h2>
          <p>插件只放在桌宠自己的目录里，不会写进启动器，也不会跟着启动器更新被覆盖。</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="pl-steps">
        <article class="pl-step reveal">
          <span class="pl-step-no">01</span>
          <h3>下载并解压</h3>
          <p>下载 ZIP 后解压，会得到一个以插件 id 命名的文件夹，例如 <code>lfelkeea.focus_guard</code>。整个文件夹留着，别只拿里面的 <code>main.py</code>。</p>
        </article>
        <article class="pl-step reveal">
          <span class="pl-step-no">02</span>
          <h3>放进插件目录</h3>
          <p>右键桌宠 →「插件管理」→「打开插件目录」，把整个文件夹放进去。也可以手动放到桌宠的 <code>data/plugins</code> 下。</p>
        </article>
        <article class="pl-step reveal">
          <span class="pl-step-no">03</span>
          <h3>扫描并启用</h3>
          <p>回到插件管理点「重新扫描」，找到新插件，勾选「启用」。插件会立即运行；带设置面板的插件还会出现「设置」按钮，连接、白名单等配置都在里面填。不想要时取消勾选即可停止。</p>
        </article>
      </div>
      <div class="pl-tip-grid reveal">
        <article class="pl-tip-card">
          <span class="pl-tip-tag">做题助手</span>
          <h3>切到题目窗口，右键选「识别屏幕上的题目」</h3>
          <p>默认先用 Windows OCR 读字，读不到再发截图；答完给出答案和解析，可自动填进答题框。</p>
          <details>
            <summary>识别与自动填入的详细规则</summary>
            <p><strong>做题助手会把题目窗口截下来识别。</strong>启用后把题目切到最前面，右键桌宠选「识别屏幕上的题目」（需要桌宠 1.4.6 或更新版本），或在聊天框 / 语音里说「做题」「答题」「这题怎么做」；答完会念出答案并弹出解析窗口。1.3.0 起会自动定位答题框：识别题目的同时用 Windows UI Automation 扫描页面里的输入框和左侧标签，把「可填写位置」一起交给 AI，答完按 AI 的判断逐个点进输入框、清空并粘贴对应内容，适合一行一个答案的表格页；扫描不到输入框时退回光标方式，在 3 秒倒计时（可调）里把光标点进答题框即可。1.3.1 起只会补还空着的位置，已有答案的框直接跳过；内容必须是完整句子，带省略号、「见上」「按表格填写」这类占位内容或语言不对时，会针对缺的位置单独再问一次 AI，仍拿不到就把答案留在剪贴板，不会把中文说明盲粘进英文表格。如果页面被别的窗口挡住、或者窗口被移动缩放，插件会直接放弃，不会盲敲。自动填入只在焦点已经切到别的窗口时才会执行光标方式，否则会把答案留在剪贴板。默认先用 Windows 自带 OCR 读文字，读不到再发截图；当前模型不支持图片时，到插件设置里把识别方式改成「文字」。截图只在内存里压缩，不写磁盘，题目和答案也不会进日志，本地只记录答题数量。</p>
          </details>
        </article>
        <article class="pl-tip-card">
          <span class="pl-tip-tag">专注时间</span>
          <h3>装好后立刻开始第一段计时</h3>
          <p>默认专注 50 分钟、休息 5 分钟，到点让桌宠提醒你站起来活动。每天完成多少段只记在本地。</p>
          <details>
            <summary>怎么改专注时长</summary>
            <p><strong>专注时间装好后会立刻开始第一段计时。</strong>默认专注 50 分钟、休息 5 分钟。想改时长，先退出桌宠，编辑 <code>data/config.json</code> 里 <code>plugins.settings.lfelkeea.focus_guard</code> 的 <code>focus_minutes</code> 和 <code>break_minutes</code>，保存后重新打开桌宠。每天完成多少段只记在本地，不会上传。</p>
          </details>
        </article>
        <article class="pl-tip-card pl-tip-dependency" id="snowluma">
          <span class="pl-tip-tag">QQ 桥接</span>
          <h3>先装 SnowLuma，再填连接地址</h3>
          <p>SnowLuma 是独立运行的 QQ → OneBot 桥，不包含在插件包里。装好后在插件「设置」里填 HTTP 地址和 accessToken，事件地址会自动算好。</p>
          <details>
            <summary>版本记录与部署说明</summary>
            <p><strong>QQ 桥接要先装 SnowLuma，桌宠要 1.1.1 或更高。</strong>SnowLuma 是独立运行的 QQ → OneBot 桥，不包含在插件包里，也不允许二次打包。到 <a href="https://github.com/SnowLuma/SnowLuma/releases" target="_blank" rel="noopener">官方 Releases</a> 下载 <code>win-x64</code> 完整包（自带 Node，开箱即用），按 <a href="https://snowluma.github.io/zh/docs/guide/deploy/windows" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Windows 部署说明</a>登录 QQ。装好插件后打开「设置」面板，填 SnowLuma 的 HTTP 地址和 accessToken，事件地址 <code>http://127.0.0.1:8766/onebot</code> 面板里会自动算好并可一键复制，粘回 SnowLuma 即可。白名单、人格卡、记忆、黑话和 QQ 空间也都在面板里。1.4.1 起设置窗口可以拖动、右下角可拉伸，打开时按屏幕自动收缩，十个标签页都能滚动。1.4.2 修好了记忆整理：模型输出被截断或夹带解释时会抢救可读部分，完全没返回 JSON 时保留聊天记录并说明原因，网络抖动会自动重试一次；「记忆」页多了「立即整理」，「习惯」页可以删除单个会话的统计。1.4.3 起自动启动或接管 SnowLuma 时不再弹出控制台窗口，关闭插件或桌宠后仍会结束后台进程。1.4.4 给白名单里的好友和群加了文字备注：列表显示「号码 · 备注」，新增时可直接带备注，删除条目会一并清理；备注只用于辨认，不参与白名单匹配。1.4.5 修复 DeepSeek 等推理模型下记忆整理提示“接口返回了空回复”：桌宠 1.2.1 起在 DeepSeek 模型上关闭思考模式，插件遇到空回复或非 JSON 时也会用更短的输入自动重试一次。1.4.6 新增盯人名单，被盯的 QQ 私聊或在白名单群发言时直接回复，不受 @ 和接话概率限制；QQ 空间可以自动回复最近说说下的新评论，首次开启只建立基线，已回复评论会去重；还能读取并勾选自己收藏的 QQ 表情，AI 回复后按概率补发一条。1.6.0 让 GPT-SoVITS 也能像 SnowLuma 一样自动托管：自动探测整合包目录，用自带 runtime 隐藏窗口后台启动 api_v2.py，合成前自动等服务就绪，关闭插件或桌宠时一并结束；「语音」页可以直接改安装目录、开关自动启动、手动启停服务，音色下拉会扫描 refs 里的 wav 并自动带出同名 txt 的参考文字。1.5.0 把语音包换成 TTS：可以直接用 Windows 自带语音朗读，也可以连接本机 GPT-SoVITS，用参考音频克隆音色（支持中/英/日/韩/粤语）；「语音」页能试听和手动发送，AI 回复可按概率附带语音，`[voice]` 标记和 `/voice 文字` 指令也保留。1.7.0 可以接入「活人感内核」：回复会带上她当前的状态、最近的自我认识和按话题召回的记忆，聊天也会写回内核；没装内核时完全按原逻辑工作。活人感内核把身份、记忆、状态和节律分开管理：情节只追加、按遗忘曲线变淡、被真正用过才加固，更正保留历史；主动说话有每日额度、夜间静默和话题去重，没信号就允许沉默。GPT-SoVITS 模型和音色素材需要自己部署，插件不附带；数据集素材请遵守其 CC BY-NC 等授权。插件 ZIP 里的 <code>README.md</code> 有逐项说明。</p>
          </details>
        </article>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="section pl-develop" id="develop">
      <div class="pl-section-head reveal">
        <div>
          <span class="kicker">BUILD YOUR OWN</span>
          <h2>想自己写？<br>接口很小，够用。</h2>
          <p>一个插件就是一个文件夹：<code>plugin.json</code> 声明元信息和权限，<code>main.py</code> 暴露 <code>setup(api)</code>。不需要打包，也不需要改桌宠源码。</p>
        </div>
      </div>

          <p>插件以你的 Windows 账户权限运行，能读取它被允许访问的内容，也能执行 Python 代码本身能做到的事。下载前看一眼来源和 <code>main.py</code>；来路不明的插件不要启用。站内插件都附了 SHA-256，下载后可以自行核对。</p>

# FILE: website/public/plugins.js
################################################################################
(function () {
  "use strict";

  document.documentElement.classList.add("js");

  const $ = (selector, root = document) => root.querySelector(selector);
  const $$ = (selector, root = document) => Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(selector));

  const grid = $("#pluginGrid");
  const emptyNote = $("[data-plugin-empty]");
  const filters = $$("[data-filter]");

  const ICONS = [
    ["quiz", "i-eye"],
    ["focus", "i-timer"],
    ["hello", "i-chat"],
    ["screen", "i-eye"],
    ["qq", "i-chat"]
  ];

  const SETTING_LABELS = {
    focus_minutes: "专注",
    break_minutes: "休息",
    interval_minutes: "间隔",
    message: "自定义语句",
    trigger_words: "触发词",
    recognition: "识别方式",
    detail: "解析长度",
    show_window: "解析窗口"
  };

  const VALUE_LABELS = {
    auto: "自动",
    text: "文字",
    image: "图片",
    brief: "简洁",
    standard: "标准",
    detailed: "详细"
  };

  const CATEGORY_LABELS = {
    social: "社交",
    efficiency: "效率",
    study: "学习",
    persona: "人格",
    dev: "开发",
    example: "示例"
  };

  let plugins = [];

  function escapeHtml(value) {
    return String(value == null ? "" : value)
      .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
      .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
      .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
      .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
      .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
  }

  function formatBytes(bytes) {
    const value = Number(bytes || 0);
    if (!value) return "—";
    if (value >= 1024 * 1024) return (value / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1) + " MB";
    if (value >= 1024) return (value / 1024).toFixed(1) + " KB";
    return value + " B";
  }

  function shortSha(sha) {
    const value = String(sha || "");
    if (value.length <= 28) return value;
    return value.slice(0, 18) + "…" + value.slice(-10);
  }

  function iconFor(id) {
    const key = String(id || "");
    const match = ICONS.find((item) => key.indexOf(item[0]) !== -1);
    return match ? match[1] : "i-plug";
  }

  function safeFile(file, id, version) {
    const value = String(file || "");
    if (/^plugins\/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\.zip$/.test(value)) return value;
    return "plugins/" + id + "-" + version + ".zip";
  }

  function settingChips(settings, limit) {
    if (!settings || typeof settings !== "object") return "";
    const chips = [];
    Object.keys(settings).forEach((key) => {
      if (limit && chips.length >= limit) return;
      const raw = settings[key];
      if (raw === "" || raw === null || raw === undefined) return;
      if (Array.isArray(raw) && !raw.length) return;
      if (typeof raw === "object" && !Array.isArray(raw)) return;
      if (/token|secret|password/i.test(key)) return;
      const label = SETTING_LABELS[key] || key;
      let value = raw;
      if (Array.isArray(raw)) value = raw.length + " 项";
      if (typeof raw === "boolean") value = raw ? "开" : "关";
      if (typeof value === "string" && VALUE_LABELS[value]) value = VALUE_LABELS[value];
      const unit = key.slice(-8) === "_minutes" ? " 分钟" : "";
      chips.push(
        '<span class="pl-setting">' + escapeHtml(label) +
        " <strong>" + escapeHtml(value) + "</strong>" + unit + "</span>"
      );
    });
    return chips.length ? '<div class="pl-settings">' + chips.join("") + "</div>" : "";
  }

  function highlightChips(plugin, limit) {
    let items = Array.isArray(plugin.highlights) ? plugin.highlights : [];
    if (limit) items = items.slice(0, limit);
    if (!items.length) return "";
    const chips = items.map((item) => {
      if (!item || typeof item !== "object") return "";
      let value = String(item.value || "");
      if (limit && value.length > 26) value = value.slice(0, 26) + "…";
      return (
        '<span class="pl-setting">' + escapeHtml(item.label || "说明") +
        " <strong>" + escapeHtml(value) + "</strong></span>"
      );
    }).filter(Boolean);
    return chips.length ? '<div class="pl-settings pl-highlights">' + chips.join("") + "</div>" : "";
  }

  function requiresBlock(plugin) {
    const items = Array.isArray(plugin.requires) ? plugin.requires : [];
    if (!items.length) return "";
    const rows = items.map((item) => {
      if (!item || typeof item !== "object") return "";
      const name = escapeHtml(item.name || "前置程序");
      const version = item.version ? " <strong>" + escapeHtml(item.version) + "</strong>" : "";
      const label = item.url
        ? '<a class="pl-requires-link" href="' + escapeHtml(item.url) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">' + name + version + ' <svg class="icon"><use href="#i-arrow"></use></svg></a>'
        : "<span>" + name + version + "</span>";
      const note = item.note ? '<span class="pl-requires-note">' + escapeHtml(item.note) + "</span>" : "";
      return '<div class="pl-requires-row"><span class="pl-requires-label">需要</span>' + label + note + "</div>";
    }).filter(Boolean);
    return rows.length ? '<div class="pl-requires">' + rows.join("") + "</div>" : "";
  }

  function permissionChips(plugin) {
    const perms = Array.isArray(plugin.permissions) ? plugin.permissions : [];
    const labels = Array.isArray(plugin.permission_labels) ? plugin.permission_labels : [];
    if (!perms.length) return "";
    const chips = perms.map((perm, index) => {
      const label = labels[index] || perm;
      return '<span class="pl-perm" title="' + escapeHtml(perm) + '">' + escapeHtml(label) + "</span>";
    });
    return '<div class="pl-perms"><span class="pl-perms-label">权限</span>' + chips.join("") + "</div>";
  }

  function badgeFor(plugin) {
    if (plugin.featured) return '<span class="pl-badge pl-badge-featured">推荐</span>';
    if (plugin.bundled) return '<span class="pl-badge pl-badge-bundled">内置示例</span>';
    return '<span class="pl-badge">社区</span>';
  }

  function detailBlock(plugin) {
    const sections = [];
    if (plugin.description) {
      sections.push('<p class="pl-detail-desc">' + escapeHtml(plugin.description) + "</p>");
    }
    const allHighlights = highlightChips(plugin);
    if (allHighlights) {
      sections.push('<div class="pl-detail-label">全部特性</div>' + allHighlights);
    }
    const allSettings = settingChips(plugin.settings);
    if (allSettings) {
      sections.push('<div class="pl-detail-label">默认设置</div>' + allSettings);
    }
    if (!sections.length) return "";
    return (
      '<details class="pl-more">' +
        "<summary>完整说明与全部特性</summary>" +
        '<div class="pl-more-body">' + sections.join("") + "</div>" +
      "</details>"
    );
  }

  function cardFor(plugin) {
    const id = String(plugin.id || "");
    const version = String(plugin.version || "");
    const name = String(plugin.name || id);
    const author = String(plugin.author || "—");
    const href = safeFile(plugin.file, id, version);
    const sha = String(plugin.sha256 || "");
    const apiVersion = plugin.api_version ? "v" + esc(plugin.api_version) : "—";
    const category = String(plugin.category || "");
    const categoryLabel = CATEGORY_LABELS[category] || "其他";
    const tagline = String(plugin.tagline || plugin.description || "");

    const article = document.createElement("article");
    article.className = "pl-card" + (plugin.featured ? " pl-featured" : "");
    article.dataset.featured = plugin.featured ? "true" : "false";
    article.dataset.bundled = plugin.bundled ? "true" : "false";
    article.dataset.category = category;
    article.innerHTML =
      '<div class="pl-card-top">' +
        badgeFor(plugin) +
        '<span class="pl-card-version">v' + escapeHtml(version) + "</span>" +
      "</div>" +
      '<div class="pl-card-head">' +
        '<span class="pl-glyph"><svg class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#' + iconFor(id) + '"></use></svg></span>' +
        '<div class="pl-name"><h3>' + escapeHtml(name) + "</h3>" +
        '<span class="pl-id">' + escapeHtml(id) + "</span></div>" +
      "</div>" +
      '<p class="pl-tagline">' + escapeHtml(tagline) + "</p>" +
      requiresBlock(plugin) +
      (highlightChips(plugin, 6) || settingChips(plugin.settings, 4)) +
      permissionChips(plugin) +
      detailBlock(plugin) +
      '<dl class="pl-meta">' +
        "<div><dt>分类</dt><dd>" + escapeHtml(categoryLabel) + "</dd></div>" +
        "<div><dt>包大小</dt><dd>" + escapeHtml(formatBytes(plugin.size)) + "</dd></div>" +
        "<div><dt>接口</dt><dd>API " + escapeHtml(apiVersion) + "</dd></div>" +
        '<div><dt>作者</dt><dd>' + escapeHtml(author) + "</dd></div>" +
      "</dl>" +
      '<div class="pl-card-foot">' +
        '<a class="btn btn-primary pl-download" href="' + escapeHtml(href) + '" download>' +
          '<svg class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-download"></use></svg>下载 ZIP</a>' +
        '<button class="btn btn-ghost pl-copy" type="button" data-sha="' + escapeHtml(sha) + '">' +
          '<svg class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-copy"></use></svg>复制 SHA-256</button>' +
      "</div>" +
      (sha
        ? '<div class="pl-sha"><span>SHA-256</span><code title="' + escapeHtml(sha) + '">' +
          escapeHtml(shortSha(sha)) + "</code></div>"
        : "");

    article.querySelector("[data-sha]")?.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      copyText(sha, event.currentTarget);
    });

    return article;
  }

  function esc(value) {
    return escapeHtml(value);
  }

  function render() {
    if (!grid) return;
    grid.innerHTML = "";
    if (!plugins.length) {
      grid.innerHTML = '<p class="pl-noscript">清单里还没有插件。</p>';
      return;
    }
    const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
    plugins.forEach((plugin) => fragment.appendChild(cardFor(plugin)));
    grid.appendChild(fragment);
    applyFilter("all");
  }

  function applyFilter(kind) {
    let visible = 0;
    $$(".pl-card", grid).forEach((card) => {
      const featured = card.dataset.featured === "true";
      const bundled = card.dataset.bundled === "true";
      const category = card.dataset.category || "";
      const show = kind === "all"
        ? true
        : kind === "featured"
          ? featured
          : kind === "bundled"
            ? bundled
            : kind.indexOf("cat:") === 0
              ? category === kind.slice(4)
              : true;
      card.classList.toggle("is-hidden", !show);
      if (show) visible += 1;
    });
    if (emptyNote) emptyNote.hidden = visible > 0;
  }

  function copyText(text, button) {
    if (!text) return;
    const done = () => {
      showToast("SHA-256 已复制");
      if (!button) return;
      button.classList.add("is-copied");
      window.setTimeout(() => button.classList.remove("is-copied"), 1400);
    };
    const fallback = () => {
      const area = document.createElement("textarea");
      area.className = "pl-copy-temp";
      area.value = text;
      document.body.appendChild(area);
      area.select();
      try {
        document.execCommand("copy");
        done();
      } catch (error) {
        showToast("复制失败，请手动选中校验值");
      }
      document.body.removeChild(area);
    };
    if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(done).catch(fallback);
    } else {
      fallback();
    }
  }

  let toastNode = null;
  let toastTimer = 0;
  function showToast(message) {
    if (!toastNode) {
      toastNode = document.createElement("div");
      toastNode.className = "pl-toast";
      toastNode.setAttribute("role", "status");
      document.body.appendChild(toastNode);
    }
    toastNode.textContent = message;
    toastNode.classList.add("show");
    window.clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = window.setTimeout(() => toastNode.classList.remove("show"), 2000);
  }

  function bindFilters() {
    filters.forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        filters.forEach((item) => {
          const active = item === button;
          item.classList.toggle("is-active", active);
          item.setAttribute("aria-pressed", active ? "true" : "false");
        });
        applyFilter(button.dataset.filter || "all");
      });
    });
  }

  function observeReveals() {
    const nodes = $$(".reveal");
    if (!("IntersectionObserver" in window)) {
      nodes.forEach((node) => node.classList.add("visible"));
      return;
    }
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach((entry) => {
        if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
        entry.target.classList.add("visible");
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      });
    }, { rootMargin: "0px 0px -8% 0px", threshold: 0.08 });
    nodes.forEach((node) => observer.observe(node));
  }

  function updateCounts(data) {
    const total = data.plugins.length;
    $$("[data-plugin-total]").forEach((node) => { node.textContent = String(total); });
    $$("[data-count-all]").forEach((node) => { node.textContent = String(total); });
    if (data.pet_version) {
      $$("[data-pet-version]").forEach((node) => { node.textContent = data.pet_version; });
    }
  }

  async function loadPlugins() {
    if (!grid) return;
    try {
      const response = await fetch("plugins.json", { cache: "no-store" });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
      const data = await response.json();
      plugins = Array.isArray(data.plugins) ? data.plugins : [];
      updateCounts({ plugins, pet_version: data.pet_version });
      render();
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn("plugins.json 读取失败", error);
      grid.innerHTML =
        '<p class="pl-noscript">插件清单暂时读取失败。可以直接下载：' +
        '<a href="plugins/lfelkeea.qq_bridge-1.8.0.zip">QQ 桥接（SnowLuma）</a>、' +
        '<a href="plugins/lfelkeea.focus_guard-1.0.0.zip">专注时间</a>、' +
        '<a href="plugins/lfelkeea.quiz_helper-1.3.1.zip">做题助手</a>、' +
        '<a href="plugins/lfelkeea.self_dev-1.6.5.zip">自开发工坊</a>、' +
        '<a href="plugins/example.hello-1.0.0.zip">示例：定时问候</a>。' +
        "刷新页面可以重试。</p>";
    }
  }

  async function loadVersion() {
    try {
      const response = await fetch("update.json", { cache: "no-store" });
      if (!response.ok) return;
      const data = await response.json();
      const version = String(data.version || "").replace(/^v/i, "");
      if (!version) return;
      $$("[data-version]").forEach((node) => { node.textContent = version; });
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn("update.json 读取失败", error);
    }
  }

  bindFilters();
  observeReveals();
  loadVersion();
  loadPlugins();
})();

              <li>使用 <code>lfelkeea.</code> / <code>example.</code> 保留前缀。</li>
              <li>覆盖官方插件或别人的插件 id。</li>

################################################################################
# FILE: website/public/submit-plugin.js

(function () {
  "use strict";

  const MAX_ZIP = 6 * 1024 * 1024;
  const MAX_UNCOMPRESSED = 30 * 1024 * 1024;
  const MAX_ENTRIES = 300;
  const MAX_MANIFEST = 64 * 1024;
  const MAX_SETTINGS = 8 * 1024;
  const MAX_FILE = 8 * 1024 * 1024;
  const MAX_DESCRIPTION = 4000;
  const MAX_NAME = 80;
  const MAX_AUTHOR = 80;

  const ID_RE = /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.-]{1,63}$/;
  const VERSION_RE = /^\d+\.\d+\.\d+(?:[-+][0-9A-Za-z.-]{1,32})?$/;
  const RESERVED_PREFIXES = ["lfelkeea.", "example."];
  const PERMISSIONS = {
    "pet.say": "让桌宠说话",
    "pet.action": "触发桌宠动作",
    "ai.chat": "调用 AI 对话",
    "screen.capture": "截取屏幕",
    "timer": "创建定时器",
    "events": "订阅事件",
    "settings": "读写插件设置",
    "storage": "读写插件存储"
  };
  const DANGEROUS_PARTS = new Set(["__pycache__", ".git", ".idea", ".vscode", "node_modules", "data"]);
  const DANGEROUS_NAMES = new Set([
    ".env", ".env.local", "config.json", "social.json", "credentials.json",
    "secrets.json", "id_rsa", "id_ed25519"
  ]);
  const DANGEROUS_SUFFIXES = new Set([
    ".pyc", ".pyo", ".log", ".pem", ".key", ".p12", ".pfx",
    ".exe", ".dll", ".so", ".dylib", ".msi", ".scr", ".com",
    ".bat", ".cmd", ".ps1", ".sh", ".jar"
  ]);

  const $ = (selector, root = document) => root.querySelector(selector);
  const dropZone = $("#dropZone");
  const fileInput = $("#zipFile");
  const pickFile = $("#pickFile");
  const clearFile = $("#clearFile");
  const fileSummary = $("#fileSummary");
  const formErrors = $("#formErrors");
  const formWarnings = $("#formWarnings");
  const formStatus = $("#formStatus");
  const submitButton = $("#createIssue");
  const agree = $("#agree");
  const notes = $("#notes");
  const handoff = $("#handoff");
  const openIssue = $("#openIssue");
  const copyBody = $("#copyBody");
  const issueBody = $("#issueBody");
  const handoffFileName = $("#handoffFileName");

  const state = {
    file: null,
    plugin: null,
    sha256: "",
    size: 0,
    body: "",
    busy: false
  };

  function text(node, value) {
    if (node) node.textContent = value == null ? "" : String(value);
  }

  function formatBytes(bytes) {
    const value = Number(bytes || 0);
    if (!value) return "—";
    if (value >= 1024 * 1024) return (value / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2) + " MB";
    if (value >= 1024) return (value / 1024).toFixed(1) + " KB";
    return value + " B";
  }

  function showErrors(errors) {
    formErrors.innerHTML = "";
    if (!errors || !errors.length) {
      formErrors.hidden = true;
      return;
    }
    const title = document.createElement("strong");
    title.textContent = "这个插件包还不能提交：";
    formErrors.appendChild(title);
    const list = document.createElement("ul");
    errors.forEach((message) => {
      const item = document.createElement("li");
      item.textContent = message;
      list.appendChild(item);
    });
    formErrors.appendChild(list);
    formErrors.hidden = false;
  }

  function showWarnings(warnings) {
    formWarnings.innerHTML = "";
    if (!warnings || !warnings.length) {
      formWarnings.hidden = true;
      return;
    }
    const title = document.createElement("strong");
    title.textContent = "可以提交，但请留意：";
    formWarnings.appendChild(title);
    const list = document.createElement("ul");
    warnings.forEach((message) => {
      const item = document.createElement("li");
      item.textContent = message;
      list.appendChild(item);
    });
    formWarnings.appendChild(list);
    formWarnings.hidden = false;
  }

  function updateSubmitState() {
    submitButton.disabled = !(state.plugin && !state.busy && agree.checked);
  }

  function setBusy(value) {
    state.busy = Boolean(value);
    updateSubmitState();
  }

  function resetFile() {
    state.file = null;
    state.plugin = null;
    state.sha256 = "";
    state.size = 0;
    state.body = "";
    fileInput.value = "";
    fileSummary.hidden = true;
    handoff.hidden = true;
    showErrors([]);
    showWarnings([]);
    text(formStatus, "");
    agree.checked = false;
    updateSubmitState();
  }

  function readU16(view, offset) {
    return view.getUint16(offset, true);
  }

  function readU32(view, offset) {
    return view.getUint32(offset, true);
  }

  function decodeText(bytes) {
    return new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: false }).decode(bytes);
  }

  function pathError(name) {
    if (!name) return "ZIP 里有空文件名。";
    if (name.includes("\0")) return "文件名包含空字符。";
    if (name.includes("\\")) return "文件名不能使用反斜杠：" + name;
    if (name.startsWith("/") || /^[A-Za-z]:/.test(name)) return "文件名不能是绝对路径：" + name;
    const parts = name.split("/");
    if (parts.some((part) => part === "" || part === "." || part === "..")) {
      return "文件名包含空段、`.` 或 `..`：" + name;
    }
    if (parts.some((part) => part.includes(":"))) return "文件名不能包含冒号：" + name;
    if (parts.some((part) => part.endsWith(" ") || part.endsWith("."))) {
      return "文件名不能以空格或点结尾：" + name;
    }
    return "";
  }

  function checkDangerous(name) {
    const parts = name.split("/");
    const lowered = parts.map((part) => part.toLowerCase());
    if (lowered.some((part) => DANGEROUS_PARTS.has(part))) {
      return "不能包含运行数据或开发缓存：" + name;
    }
    const base = lowered[lowered.length - 1];
    if (DANGEROUS_NAMES.has(base)) return "不能包含可能带密钥的配置文件：" + name;
    const dot = base.lastIndexOf(".");
    const suffix = dot >= 0 ? base.slice(dot) : "";
    if (DANGEROUS_SUFFIXES.has(suffix)) return "不能包含可执行文件、脚本或密钥：" + name;
    return "";
  }

  async function inflateRaw(bytes) {
    if (typeof DecompressionStream === "undefined") {
      throw new Error("当前浏览器不支持 ZIP 解压，请换最新版 Chrome、Edge 或 Firefox。");
    }
    const stream = new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream("deflate-raw"));
    const output = await new Response(stream).arrayBuffer();
    return new Uint8Array(output);
  }

  function findEntry(entries, name) {
    return entries.find((entry) => entry.name === name) || null;
  }

  async function extractEntry(bytes, view, entry) {
    const offset = entry.localOffset;
    if (offset + 30 > bytes.length || readU32(view, offset) !== 0x04034b50) {
      throw new Error("ZIP 的本地文件头损坏：" + entry.name);
    }
    const nameLength = readU16(view, offset + 26);
    const extraLength = readU16(view, offset + 28);
    const localName = decodeText(bytes.slice(offset + 30, offset + 30 + nameLength));
    if (localName !== entry.name) {
      throw new Error("ZIP 的本地文件名和目录不一致：" + entry.name);
    }
    const dataStart = offset + 30 + nameLength + extraLength;
    const dataEnd = dataStart + entry.compressedSize;
    if (dataEnd > bytes.length) throw new Error("ZIP 文件数据越界：" + entry.name);
    const raw = bytes.slice(dataStart, dataEnd);
    let output;
    if (entry.method === 0) {
      output = raw;
    } else if (entry.method === 8) {
      output = await inflateRaw(raw);
    } else {
      throw new Error("只支持 stored/deflate 压缩：" + entry.name);
    }
    if (entry.uncompressedSize && output.length !== entry.uncompressedSize) {
      throw new Error("解压后大小不一致：" + entry.name);
    }
    return output;
  }

  async function parseZip(buffer) {
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(buffer);
    if (bytes.length < 22) throw new Error("ZIP 太小，不像一个完整的插件包。");
    if (!(bytes[0] === 0x50 && bytes[1] === 0x4b && bytes[2] === 0x03 && bytes[3] === 0x04)) {
      throw new Error("文件不是 ZIP（缺少 PK 文件头）。");
    }
    const view = new DataView(buffer);
    let eocd = -1;
    const minOffset = Math.max(0, bytes.length - 0xffff - 22);
    for (let i = bytes.length - 22; i >= minOffset; i -= 1) {
      if (readU32(view, i) === 0x06054b50) {
        eocd = i;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (eocd < 0) throw new Error("找不到 ZIP 的中央目录结尾。");
    const disk = readU16(view, eocd + 4);
    const cdDisk = readU16(view, eocd + 6);
    const entriesOnDisk = readU16(view, eocd + 8);
    const totalEntries = readU16(view, eocd + 10);
    const cdSize = readU32(view, eocd + 12);
    const cdOffset = readU32(view, eocd + 16);
    if (disk !== 0 || cdDisk !== 0 || entriesOnDisk !== totalEntries) {
      throw new Error("不支持分卷 ZIP。");
    }
    if (totalEntries === 0xffff || cdSize === 0xffffffff || cdOffset === 0xffffffff) {
      throw new Error("不支持 ZIP64，请用普通 ZIP 重新打包。");
    }
    if (!totalEntries) throw new Error("ZIP 里没有文件。");
    if (totalEntries > MAX_ENTRIES) throw new Error("ZIP 最多 " + MAX_ENTRIES + " 个条目。");
    if (cdOffset + cdSize > eocd) throw new Error("ZIP 中央目录位置异常。");

    let pointer = cdOffset;
    const entries = [];
    const names = [];
    let total = 0;
    for (let index = 0; index < totalEntries; index += 1) {
      if (pointer + 46 > bytes.length || readU32(view, pointer) !== 0x02014b50) {
        throw new Error("ZIP 中央目录损坏。");
      }
      const flags = readU16(view, pointer + 8);
      const method = readU16(view, pointer + 10);
      const compressedSize = readU32(view, pointer + 20);
      const uncompressedSize = readU32(view, pointer + 24);
      const nameLength = readU16(view, pointer + 28);
      const extraLength = readU16(view, pointer + 30);
      const commentLength = readU16(view, pointer + 32);
      const externalAttr = readU32(view, pointer + 38);
      const localOffset = readU32(view, pointer + 42);
      const nameStart = pointer + 46;
      const nameEnd = nameStart + nameLength;
      if (nameEnd > bytes.length) throw new Error("ZIP 文件名越界。");
      const name = decodeText(bytes.slice(nameStart, nameEnd));
      if (name.includes("\ufffd")) throw new Error("ZIP 文件名不是 UTF-8：" + name);
      const isDir = name.endsWith("/");
      const error = pathError(isDir ? name.slice(0, -1) : name);
      if (error) throw new Error(error);
      if (flags & 0x1) throw new Error("ZIP 不能包含加密文件：" + name);
      if (compressedSize === 0xffffffff || uncompressedSize === 0xffffffff) {
        throw new Error("不支持 ZIP64：" + name);
      }
      if (!isDir) {
        if (method !== 0 && method !== 8) throw new Error("只支持 stored/deflate 压缩：" + name);
        if (((externalAttr >>> 16) & 0xf000) === 0xa000) {
          throw new Error("ZIP 不能包含符号链接：" + name);
        }
        const danger = checkDangerous(name);
        if (danger) throw new Error(danger);
        if (uncompressedSize > MAX_FILE) {
          throw new Error("单个文件不能超过 8 MB：" + name);
        }
        if (names.includes(name)) throw new Error("ZIP 里有重名文件：" + name);
        total += uncompressedSize;
        if (total > MAX_UNCOMPRESSED) throw new Error("ZIP 解压后总大小超过 30 MB。");
        names.push(name);
      }
      entries.push({
        name,
        isDir,
        flags,
        method,
        compressedSize,
        uncompressedSize,
        localOffset
      });
      pointer = nameEnd + extraLength + commentLength;
    }
    if (pointer !== cdOffset + cdSize) throw new Error("ZIP 中央目录长度不一致。");
    if (!names.length) throw new Error("ZIP 里没有文件。");

    const roots = Array.from(new Set(names.map((name) => name.split("/")[0])));
    if (roots.length !== 1) throw new Error("ZIP 里必须只有一个顶层插件文件夹。");
    const root = roots[0];
    if (names.some((name) => !name.startsWith(root + "/"))) {
      throw new Error("所有文件都必须放在插件 id 文件夹里。");
    }

    const manifestName = root + "/plugin.json";
    const manifestEntry = findEntry(entries, manifestName);
    if (!manifestEntry) throw new Error("缺少 " + manifestName);
    if (manifestEntry.uncompressedSize > MAX_MANIFEST) throw new Error("plugin.json 不能超过 64 KB。");
    const manifestBytes = await extractEntry(bytes, view, manifestEntry);
    if (manifestBytes.length > MAX_MANIFEST) throw new Error("plugin.json 不能超过 64 KB。");
    let manifest;
    try {
      manifest = JSON.parse(decodeText(manifestBytes).replace(/^\ufeff/, ""));
    } catch (error) {
      throw new Error("plugin.json 不是合法的 JSON：" + error.message);
    }
    if (!manifest || typeof manifest !== "object" || Array.isArray(manifest)) {
      throw new Error("plugin.json 顶层必须是对象。");
    }

    const issues = [];
    const warnings = [];
    const id = String(manifest.id || "").trim();
    if (!ID_RE.test(id)) issues.push("id 只能使用小写字母、数字、点、下划线、短横线，长度 2-64。");
    if (id !== root) issues.push("ZIP 根目录名必须等于插件 id：" + (id || "未知"));
    if (RESERVED_PREFIXES.some((prefix) => id.startsWith(prefix))) {
      issues.push("lfelkeea. 和 example. 前缀由维护者保留，投稿请换一个 id。");
    }
    const version = String(manifest.version || "").trim();
    if (!VERSION_RE.test(version)) issues.push("version 必须是 1.0.0 这样的语义化版本。");
    const apiVersion = Number(manifest.api_version == null ? 1 : manifest.api_version);
    if (!Number.isInteger(apiVersion) || apiVersion !== 1) issues.push("api_version 必须是 1。");
    const entry = String(manifest.entry || "main.py").trim() || "main.py";
    const entryError = pathError(entry);
    if (entryError) issues.push("entry 不合法：" + entryError);
    else if (!entry.toLowerCase().endsWith(".py")) issues.push("entry 必须是 Python 文件（.py）。");
    else if (!names.includes(root + "/" + entry)) issues.push("找不到入口文件：" + entry);

    const name = String(manifest.name || "").trim().slice(0, MAX_NAME);
    if (!name) issues.push("name 不能为空。");
    const description = String(manifest.description || "").trim().slice(0, MAX_DESCRIPTION);
    const author = String(manifest.author || "").trim().slice(0, MAX_AUTHOR);

    const permissionList = [];
    if (manifest.permissions != null && !Array.isArray(manifest.permissions)) {
      issues.push("permissions 必须是数组。");
    } else {
      (manifest.permissions || []).forEach((item, index) => {
        const permission = String(item || "").trim();
        if (!permission) return;
        if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(PERMISSIONS, permission)) {
          issues.push("permissions 第 " + (index + 1) + " 项不是 v1 已知权限：" + permission);
        }
        if (permissionList.includes(permission)) issues.push("permissions 重复：" + permission);
        permissionList.push(permission);
      });
    }

    const settings = manifest.settings == null ? {} : manifest.settings;
    if (!settings || typeof settings !== "object" || Array.isArray(settings)) {
      issues.push("settings 必须是对象。");
    } else if (new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(settings)).length > MAX_SETTINGS) {
      issues.push("settings 不能超过 8 KB。");
    }

    const requires = [];
    if (manifest.requires != null) {
      if (!Array.isArray(manifest.requires)) {
        issues.push("requires 必须是数组。");
      } else if (manifest.requires.length > 10) {
        issues.push("requires 最多 10 项。");
      } else {
        manifest.requires.forEach((item, index) => {
          if (!item || typeof item !== "object" || Array.isArray(item)) {
            issues.push("requires 第 " + (index + 1) + " 项必须是对象。");
            return;
          }
          const itemName = String(item.name || "").trim().slice(0, 60);
          if (!itemName) issues.push("requires 第 " + (index + 1) + " 项缺少 name。");
          const itemVersion = String(item.version || "").trim().slice(0, 40);
          const itemUrl = String(item.url || "").trim().slice(0, 300);
          const itemNote = String(item.note || "").trim().slice(0, 200);
          if (itemUrl && !/^https?:\/\//i.test(itemUrl)) {
            issues.push("requires 第 " + (index + 1) + " 项的 url 只能是 http(s)。");
          }
          requires.push({ name: itemName, version: itemVersion, url: itemUrl, note: itemNote });
        });
      }
    }

    const highlights = [];
    if (manifest.highlights != null) {
      if (!Array.isArray(manifest.highlights)) {
        issues.push("highlights 必须是数组。");
      } else if (manifest.highlights.length > 10) {
        issues.push("highlights 最多 10 项。");
      } else {
        manifest.highlights.forEach((item, index) => {
          if (!item || typeof item !== "object" || Array.isArray(item)) {
            issues.push("highlights 第 " + (index + 1) + " 项必须是对象。");
            return;
          }
          const label = String(item.label || "").trim().slice(0, 40);
          const value = String(item.value || "").trim().slice(0, 80);
          if (label || value) highlights.push({ label: label || "说明", value });
        });
      }
    }

    if (!permissionList.length) warnings.push("插件没有声明任何权限，运行时只能使用 api.log()。");
    if (issues.length) {
      const error = new Error("插件清单没有通过检查。");
      error.issues = issues;
      error.warnings = warnings;
      throw error;
    }

    return {
      manifest,
      id,
      name: name || id,
      version,
      author,
      description,
      permissions: permissionList,
      requires,
      highlights,
      settings,
      entry,
      files: names
    };
  }

  async function sha256(buffer) {
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", buffer);
    return Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest))
      .map((byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
      .join("");
  }

  function renderSummary(plugin) {
    text($("#pluginName"), plugin.name);
    text($("#pluginId"), plugin.id);
    text($("#pluginDescription"), plugin.description || "（没有填写描述）");
    text($("#pluginVersion"), "v" + plugin.version);
    text($("#pluginAuthor"), plugin.author || "未署名");
    text($("#pluginSize"), formatBytes(state.size));
    text($("#pluginFiles"), plugin.files.length + " 个文件");
    text($("#pluginSha"), state.sha256);

    const permRoot = $("#pluginPerms");
    permRoot.innerHTML = "";
    const label = document.createElement("span");
    label.className = "submit-perms-label";
    label.textContent = "权限";
    permRoot.appendChild(label);
    if (plugin.permissions.length) {
      plugin.permissions.forEach((permission) => {
        const chip = document.createElement("span");
        chip.className = "submit-perm";
        chip.title = permission;
        chip.textContent = PERMISSIONS[permission] || permission;
        permRoot.appendChild(chip);
      });
    } else {
      const chip = document.createElement("span");
      chip.className = "submit-perm submit-perm-empty";
      chip.textContent = "无特殊权限";
      permRoot.appendChild(chip);
    }
    if (plugin.requires.length) {
      const row = document.createElement("p");
      row.className = "submit-requires";
      row.textContent = "外部依赖：" + plugin.requires.map((item) => {
        return item.name + (item.version ? " " + item.version : "");
      }).join("；");
      permRoot.appendChild(row);
    }
    fileSummary.hidden = false;
  }

  async function handleFile(file) {
    if (!file) return;
    resetFile();
    if (!/\.zip$/i.test(file.name)) {
      showErrors(["请选择 .zip 文件。"]);
      return;
    }
    if (file.size > MAX_ZIP) {
      showErrors(["ZIP 不能超过 6 MB，当前 " + formatBytes(file.size) + "。"]);
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    text(formStatus, "正在读取并检查插件包…");
    try {
      const buffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
      const plugin = await parseZip(buffer);
      const digest = await sha256(buffer);
      state.file = file;
      state.plugin = plugin;
      state.sha256 = digest;
      state.size = buffer.byteLength;
      renderSummary(plugin);
      showErrors([]);
      showWarnings([]);
      text(formStatus, "检查通过。确认下面的权限和说明后，点「生成投稿 Issue」。");
      handoffFileName.textContent = file.name;
    } catch (error) {
      state.plugin = null;
      const messages = error && Array.isArray(error.issues) ? error.issues : [error.message || String(error)];
      showErrors(messages);
      if (error && Array.isArray(error.warnings)) showWarnings(error.warnings);
      text(formStatus, "检查没有通过，请按上面的提示修改后重新选择。");
      fileSummary.hidden = true;
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
      updateSubmitState();
    }
  }

  function buildMetadata(plugin) {
    return {
      schema: 1,
      id: plugin.id,
      name: plugin.name,
      version: plugin.version,
      author: plugin.author,
      description: plugin.description,
      permissions: plugin.permissions,
      requires: plugin.requires,
      sha256: state.sha256,
      size: state.size,
      archive_name: state.file ? state.file.name : "",
      notes: notes.value.trim().slice(0, 2000),
      submitted_at: new Date().toISOString()
    };
  }

  function buildIssueBody(plugin) {
    const meta = buildMetadata(plugin);
    const noteText = meta.notes || "（未填写）";
    return [
      "<!-- dkl-plugin-submission:v1 -->",
      "",
      "### 插件投稿",
      "",
      "感谢投稿。请把 ZIP 拖到下面「插件包」区域，等 GitHub 上传完成后再提交。",
      "",
      "```json",
      JSON.stringify(meta, null, 2),
      "```",
      "",
      "### 插件包",
      "<!-- 把 ZIP 拖到这一行下面，等上传完成 -->",
      "",
      "### 投稿说明",
      noteText,
      "",
      "### 投稿人确认",
      "- [x] 这是我自己制作或有权分发的插件",
      "- [x] 插件只使用上面声明的权限",
      "- [x] 我理解审核通过后插件会公开下载",
      ""
    ].join("\n");
  }

  function issueUrl(plugin, body) {
    const title = "[插件投稿] " + plugin.name + " v" + plugin.version + " (" + plugin.id + ")";
    const base = "https://github.com/LFELKEEA/darkitten-launcher/issues/new";
    const titlePart = "labels=plugin-submission&title=" + encodeURIComponent(title);
    const bodyPart = encodeURIComponent(body);
    if (bodyPart.length <= 6000) return base + "?" + titlePart + "&body=" + bodyPart;
    return base + "?" + titlePart;
  }

  async function copyText(value) {
    if (!value) return false;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      issueBody.focus();
      issueBody.select();
      try {
        return document.execCommand("copy");
      } catch (fallbackError) {
        return false;
      }
    }
  }

  async function onSubmit(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!state.plugin || !state.file || !agree.checked || state.busy) return;
    const body = buildIssueBody(state.plugin);
    state.body = body;
    issueBody.value = body;
    const url = issueUrl(state.plugin, body);
    openIssue.href = url;
    handoff.hidden = false;
    handoff.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
    // 先同步打开新窗口，避免 await 剪贴板后触发浏览器的弹窗拦截。
    window.open(url, "_blank", "noopener");
    const copied = await copyText(body);
    if (copied) {
      text(formStatus, "投稿正文已复制。打开 GitHub 页面后直接粘贴，再把 ZIP 拖进正文。");
    } else {
      text(formStatus, "请手动复制下面的 Issue 正文，粘贴到 GitHub 页面。");
    }
  }

  dropZone.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
    if (event.target.closest("button")) return;
    fileInput.click();
  });
  pickFile.addEventListener("click", () => fileInput.click());
  fileInput.addEventListener("change", () => {
    const file = fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0];
    if (file) handleFile(file);
  });
  clearFile.addEventListener("click", resetFile);
  agree.addEventListener("change", updateSubmitState);
  notes.addEventListener("input", () => {
    if (state.plugin) text(formStatus, "说明已记录。修改说明后重新点「生成投稿 Issue」即可更新正文。");
  });
  $("#submitForm").addEventListener("submit", onSubmit);
  copyBody.addEventListener("click", async () => {
    if (!state.body) return;
    const copied = await copyText(state.body);
    text(formStatus, copied ? "正文已复制。" : "复制失败，请手动选择文本框内容。");
  });

  ["dragenter", "dragover"].forEach((name) => {
    dropZone.addEventListener(name, (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      dropZone.classList.add("is-dragover");
    });
  });
  ["dragleave", "drop"].forEach((name) => {
    dropZone.addEventListener(name, (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      dropZone.classList.remove("is-dragover");
    });
  });
  dropZone.addEventListener("drop", (event) => {
    const file = event.dataTransfer.files && event.dataTransfer.files[0];
    if (file) handleFile(file);
  });

  updateSubmitState();
})();

# FILE: website/serve.py

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import functools
import os
import posixpath
import socket
import threading
import webbrowser
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = BASE / "public"
STATIC_FILES = {
    "/",
    "/index.html",
    "/plugins.html",
    "/submit-plugin.html",
    "/submit-plugin.css",
    "/submit-plugin.js",
    "/plugin-review.html",
    "/plugin-review.css",
    "/plugin-review.js",
    "/plugin-queue.json",
    "/feedback.html",
    "/style.css",
    "/plugins.css",
    "/app.js",
    "/plugins.js",
    "/feedback-admin.css",
    "/feedback-admin.js",
    "/plugins.json",
    "/update.json",
    "/mod_agent_release.json",
    "/robots.txt",
}
ASSET_SUFFIXES = {".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".webp", ".gif", ".svg", ".ico"}
DOWNLOAD_SUFFIXES = {".zip", ".txt"}
CSP = (
    "default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self'; "
    "script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://api.github.com; "
    "base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self' mailto:; frame-ancestors 'none'"
)


def _allowed_path(raw_path: str) -> bool:
    decoded = unquote(urlsplit(raw_path).path)
    if "\\" in decoded or "\x00" in decoded:
        return False
    path = posixpath.normpath(decoded)
    if path in STATIC_FILES:
        return True
    parts = [part for part in path.split("/") if part]
    if len(parts) < 2:
        return False
    folder, name = parts[0], parts[-1]
    suffix = Path(name).suffix.lower()
    if folder == "assets":
        # 允许 assets/screenshots/*.webp 这类子目录，仍然只放行图片后缀。
        return suffix in ASSET_SUFFIXES and all(part not in (".", "..") for part in parts[1:])
    if len(parts) == 2 and folder == "downloads":
        return suffix in DOWNLOAD_SUFFIXES
    if folder == "plugins":
        return suffix in {".zip", ".md"} and all(part not in (".", "..") for part in parts[1:])
    return False


class DownloadHandler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    server_version = "DKLDownloadSite/1.1"

    def end_headers(self) -> None:
        self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store, max-age=0")
        self.send_header("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
        self.send_header("X-Frame-Options", "DENY")
        self.send_header("Referrer-Policy", "strict-origin-when-cross-origin")
        self.send_header("Permissions-Policy", "geolocation=(), microphone=(), camera=()")
        self.send_header("Content-Security-Policy", CSP)
        super().end_headers()

    def log_message(self, fmt: str, *args) -> None:
        print(f"[site] {self.address_string()} {fmt % args}")

    def send_head(self):
        if not _allowed_path(self.path):
            self.send_error(404)
            return None
        if urlsplit(self.path).path in ("", "/"):
            self.path = "/index.html"
        return super().send_head()

    def list_directory(self, path):
        self.send_error(404)
        return None


def lan_ip() -> str:
    sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
    try:
        sock.connect(("8.8.8.8", 80))
        return str(sock.getsockname()[0])
    except Exception:
        return "127.0.0.1"
    finally:
        sock.close()


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="DKL 下载站本地服务器")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8765)
    parser.add_argument("--lan", action="store_true", help="允许局域网访问")
    parser.add_argument("--no-browser", action="store_true", help="不自动打开浏览器")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    bind = "0.0.0.0" if args.lan else "127.0.0.1"
    os.chdir(ROOT)
    handler = functools.partial(DownloadHandler, directory=str(ROOT))
    try:
        server = ThreadingHTTPServer((bind, args.port), handler)
    except OSError as exc:
        print(f"无法启动下载站：{exc}")
        print("端口可能已被占用。可以换一个端口，例如：")
        print(f"  python serve.py --port {args.port + 1}")
        return 1

    server.daemon_threads = True
    local_url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{args.port}/"
    print("=" * 58)
    print("Darkitten Launcher 下载站已启动")
    print(f"本机地址：{local_url}")
    print("反馈入口：GitHub Issues；开发者反馈表需从启动器打开")
    if args.lan:
        print(f"局域网地址：http://{lan_ip()}:{args.port}/")
    print("按 Ctrl+C 停止服务")
    print("=" * 58)

    if not args.no_browser:
        threading.Timer(0.8, lambda: webbrowser.open(local_url)).start()

    try:
        server.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\n下载站已停止")
    finally:
        server.server_close()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

# FILE: website/tests/test_plugin_submission.py

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import io
import json
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SCRIPT = ROOT / "tools" / "plugin_submission.py"
SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("plugin_submission", SCRIPT)
assert SPEC and SPEC.loader
submission = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
sys.modules["plugin_submission"] = submission
SPEC.loader.exec_module(submission)


def manifest(**overrides):
    data = {
        "id": "test.demo",
        "name": "测试插件",
        "version": "1.0.0",
        "api_version": 1,
        "entry": "main.py",
        "description": "一个用于测试投稿流程的插件。",
        "author": "Alice",
        "permissions": ["pet.say"],
        "settings": {"interval": 10},
    }
    data.update(overrides)
    return data


def build_zip(files: dict[str, bytes | str], *, directories: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> bytes:
    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(buffer, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
        for name in directories:
            archive.writestr(name.rstrip("/") + "/", b"")
        for name, content in files.items():
            if isinstance(content, str):
                content = content.encode("utf-8")
            archive.writestr(name, content)
    return buffer.getvalue()


def plugin_zip(**overrides) -> bytes:
    manifest_data = manifest(**overrides)
    root = str(manifest_data["id"])
    return build_zip(
        {
            f"{root}/plugin.json": json.dumps(manifest_data, ensure_ascii=False),
            f"{root}/main.py": "def setup(api):\n    api.say('hello')\n",
            f"{root}/README.md": "# demo\n",
        },
        directories=(f"{root}/",),
    )


def zip_manifest(data: bytes) -> dict:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data)) as archive:
        name = next(item for item in archive.namelist() if item.endswith("/plugin.json"))
        return json.loads(archive.read(name).decode("utf-8"))


def body_for(data: bytes, *, user="alice", extra=None) -> str:
    manifest_data = zip_manifest(data)
    meta = {
        "schema": 1,
        "id": manifest_data["id"],
        "name": manifest_data.get("name", manifest_data["id"]),
        "version": manifest_data["version"],
        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
        "size": len(data),
        "archive_name": f"{manifest_data['id']}-{manifest_data['version']}.zip",
        "notes": "测试投稿",
    }
    if extra:
        meta.update(extra)
    return (
        submission.MARKER
        + "\n\n### 插件投稿\n\n```json\n"
        + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        + "\n```\n\n### 插件包\n\n"
        + "[test.demo-1.0.0.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000)\n"
    )


def event_for(data: bytes, *, user="alice", extra=None) -> dict:
    return {
        "issue": {
            "number": 42,
            "title": "[插件投稿] 测试插件",
            "body": body_for(data, user=user, extra=extra),
            "user": {"login": user},
            "created_at": "2026-11-01T00:00:00Z",
            "labels": [{"name": "plugin-submission"}],
        }
    }


class ZipValidationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_valid_plugin(self):
        data = plugin_zip()
        result = submission.validate_zip(data)
        self.assertTrue(result.ok, result.errors)
        self.assertEqual(result.plugin["id"], "test.demo")
        self.assertEqual(result.plugin["version"], "1.0.0")
        self.assertEqual(result.plugin["permissions"], ["pet.say"])
        self.assertEqual(result.plugin["file"], "plugins/test.demo-1.0.0.zip")
        self.assertEqual(result.sha256, hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest())

    def test_directory_entries_are_allowed(self):
        data = plugin_zip()
        # plugin_zip 已经包含目录条目，这里再确认不会因为尾部斜杠被拒绝。
        self.assertTrue(submission.validate_zip(data).ok)

    def test_wrong_sha(self):
        result = submission.validate_zip(plugin_zip(), expected_sha="0" * 64)
        self.assertFalse(result.ok)
        self.assertIn("SHA-256", " ".join(result.errors))

    def test_wrong_size(self):
        result = submission.validate_zip(plugin_zip(), expected_size=1)
        self.assertFalse(result.ok)
        self.assertIn("大小", " ".join(result.errors))

    def test_root_must_match_id(self):
        data = build_zip(
            {
                "other/plugin.json": json.dumps(manifest(), ensure_ascii=False),
                "other/main.py": "def setup(api): pass\n",
            }
        )
        result = submission.validate_zip(data)
        self.assertFalse(result.ok)
        self.assertIn("根目录名", " ".join(result.errors))

    def test_reserved_prefix(self):
        result = submission.validate_zip(plugin_zip(id="lfelkeea.demo"))
        self.assertFalse(result.ok)
        self.assertIn("保留", " ".join(result.errors))

    def test_unknown_permission(self):
        result = submission.validate_zip(plugin_zip(permissions=["pet.say", "root.everything"]))
        self.assertFalse(result.ok)
        self.assertIn("已知权限", " ".join(result.errors))

    def test_missing_entry(self):
        manifest_data = manifest()
        data = build_zip(
            {
                "test.demo/plugin.json": json.dumps(manifest_data, ensure_ascii=False),
            }
        )
        result = submission.validate_zip(data)
        self.assertFalse(result.ok)
        self.assertIn("入口文件", " ".join(result.errors))

    def test_path_traversal(self):
        data = plugin_zip()
        data = build_zip(
            {
                "test.demo/plugin.json": json.dumps(manifest(), ensure_ascii=False),
                "test.demo/main.py": "def setup(api): pass\n",
                "test.demo/../evil.py": "print('evil')\n",
            }
        )
        result = submission.validate_zip(data)
        self.assertFalse(result.ok)
        self.assertIn("..", " ".join(result.errors))

    def test_dangerous_suffix(self):
        manifest_data = manifest()
        data = build_zip(
            {
                "test.demo/plugin.json": json.dumps(manifest_data, ensure_ascii=False),
                "test.demo/main.py": "def setup(api): pass\n",
                "test.demo/tool.exe": b"MZ",
            }
        )
        result = submission.validate_zip(data)
        self.assertFalse(result.ok)
        self.assertIn("可执行", " ".join(result.errors))

    def test_dangerous_config(self):
        manifest_data = manifest()
        data = build_zip(
            {
                "test.demo/plugin.json": json.dumps(manifest_data, ensure_ascii=False),
                "test.demo/main.py": "def setup(api): pass\n",
                "test.demo/config.json": "{}",
            }
        )
        result = submission.validate_zip(data)
        self.assertFalse(result.ok)
        self.assertIn("配置文件", " ".join(result.errors))

    def test_too_many_entries(self):
        manifest_data = manifest()
        files = {
            "test.demo/plugin.json": json.dumps(manifest_data, ensure_ascii=False),
            "test.demo/main.py": "def setup(api): pass\n",
        }
        for index in range(300):
            files[f"test.demo/files/{index}.txt"] = "x"
        result = submission.validate_zip(build_zip(files))
        self.assertFalse(result.ok)
        self.assertIn("300", " ".join(result.errors))


class IssueParsingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_parse_meta_and_attachment(self):
        data = plugin_zip()
        body = body_for(data)
        meta, errors = submission.parse_issue_body(body)
        self.assertFalse(errors)
        self.assertEqual(meta["id"], "test.demo")
        urls = submission.attachment_urls(body)
        self.assertEqual(len(urls), 1)
        self.assertIn("user-attachments", urls[0])

    def test_missing_marker(self):
        meta, errors = submission.parse_issue_body("```json\n{}\n```")
        self.assertIsNone(meta)
        self.assertTrue(errors)

    def test_invalid_json(self):
        body = submission.MARKER + "\n```json\n{oops}\n```"
        meta, errors = submission.parse_issue_body(body)
        self.assertIsNone(meta)
        self.assertTrue(errors)


class PublishTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.public = self.root / "website" / "public"
        self.plugins = self.public / "plugins"
        self.plugins.mkdir(parents=True)
        (self.root / "website" / "community_plugins.json").write_text(
            json.dumps({"schema": 1, "plugins": []}, ensure_ascii=False),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        (self.public / "plugins.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "updated": "2026-10-31",
                    "api_version": 1,
                    "pet_version": "1.3.3",
                    "plugins": [
                        {
                            "id": "lfelkeea.focus_guard",
                            "name": "专注时间",
                            "version": "1.0.0",
                            "file": "plugins/lfelkeea.focus_guard-1.0.0.zip",
                            "size": 1,
                            "sha256": "f" * 64,
                            "featured": True,
                            "bundled": False,
                        }
                    ],
                },
                ensure_ascii=False,
            ),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        self.zip_path = self.root / "submission.zip"

    def tearDown(self):
        self.temp.cleanup()

    def publish(self, data: bytes, *, user="alice", extra=None):
        self.zip_path.write_bytes(data)
        return submission.publish_event(
            event_for(data, user=user, extra=extra),
            repo_root=self.root,
            attachment=str(self.zip_path),
        )[0]

    def test_publish_adds_plugin(self):
        result = self.publish(plugin_zip())
        self.assertTrue(result["ok"], result["errors"])
        self.assertEqual(result["zip_rel"], "plugins/test.demo-1.0.0.zip")
        self.assertTrue((self.plugins / "test.demo-1.0.0.zip").is_file())

        registry = json.loads((self.public / "plugins.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        ids = [item["id"] for item in registry["plugins"]]
        self.assertIn("test.demo", ids)
        entry = next(item for item in registry["plugins"] if item["id"] == "test.demo")
        self.assertEqual(entry["version"], "1.0.0")
        self.assertEqual(entry["sha256"], hashlib.sha256(plugin_zip()).hexdigest())
        self.assertFalse(entry["featured"])
        self.assertTrue(entry["community"])

        community = json.loads((self.root / "website" / "community_plugins.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.assertEqual(community["plugins"][0]["submitted_by"], "alice")
        self.assertEqual(community["plugins"][0]["entry"]["name"], "测试插件")
        self.assertTrue(community["plugins"][0]["entry"]["community"])

    def test_same_version_is_rejected(self):
        self.assertTrue(self.publish(plugin_zip())["ok"])
        result = self.publish(plugin_zip())
        self.assertFalse(result["ok"])
        self.assertIn("新版本必须更高", " ".join(result["errors"]))

    def test_update_replaces_entry_and_keeps_registry(self):
        self.assertTrue(self.publish(plugin_zip())["ok"])
        result = self.publish(plugin_zip(version="1.1.0"))
        self.assertTrue(result["ok"], result["errors"])
        registry = json.loads((self.public / "plugins.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        entry = next(item for item in registry["plugins"] if item["id"] == "test.demo")
        self.assertEqual(entry["version"], "1.1.0")
        self.assertEqual(len([item for item in registry["plugins"] if item["id"] == "test.demo"]), 1)
        self.assertTrue(any(item["id"] == "lfelkeea.focus_guard" for item in registry["plugins"]))

    def test_official_id_cannot_be_replaced(self):
        registry_path = self.public / "plugins.json"
        registry = json.loads(registry_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        registry["plugins"].append(
            {
                "id": "official.demo",
                "name": "官方插件",
                "version": "1.0.0",
                "file": "plugins/official.demo-1.0.0.zip",
                "size": 1,
                "sha256": "e" * 64,
            }
        )
        registry_path.write_text(json.dumps(registry, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
        result = self.publish(plugin_zip(id="official.demo", name="劫持"))
        self.assertFalse(result["ok"])
        self.assertIn("官方", " ".join(result["errors"]))

    def test_other_submitter_warns(self):
        self.assertTrue(self.publish(plugin_zip())["ok"])
        result = self.publish(plugin_zip(version="1.1.0"), user="bob")
        self.assertTrue(result["ok"], result["errors"])
        self.assertTrue(any("别人提交过" in item for item in result["warnings"]))

                "community": True,
            }
            (site / "community_plugins.json").write_text(
                json.dumps(
                    {
                        "schema": 1,
                        "plugins": [
                            {
                                "id": "test.demo",
                                "version": "1.0.0",
                                "file": "plugins/test.demo-1.0.0.zip",
                                "submitted_by": "alice",
                                "entry": entry,
                            }
                        ],
                    },
                    ensure_ascii=False,
                ),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            (site / "pet_release.json").write_text(
                json.dumps({"version": "1.3.3"}), encoding="utf-8"
            )

            old = {
                "SITE": build.SITE,
                "PUBLIC": build.PUBLIC,
                "PET": build.PET,
                "SOURCE": build.SOURCE,
                "DOCS": build.DOCS,
                "DEST": build.DEST,
                "REGISTRY": build.REGISTRY,
                "COMMUNITY": build.COMMUNITY,
            }
            try:
                build.SITE = site
                build.PUBLIC = public
                build.PET = pet
                build.SOURCE = source
                build.DOCS = docs
                build.DEST = dest
                build.REGISTRY = public / "plugins.json"
                build.COMMUNITY = site / "community_plugins.json"
                build.main()
            finally:
                for key, value in old.items():
                    setattr(build, key, value)

            registry = json.loads((public / "plugins.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            self.assertEqual(len(registry["plugins"]), 1)
            item = registry["plugins"][0]
            self.assertEqual(item["name"], "测试插件")
            self.assertEqual(item["description"], "社区插件")
            self.assertEqual(item["permissions"], ["pet.say"])
            self.assertTrue(item["community"])
            self.assertEqual(item["sha256"], hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest())


class ReportTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_validate_report_mentions_next_steps(self):
        data = plugin_zip()
        validation = submission.validate_zip(data)
        self.assertTrue(validation.ok, validation.errors)
        result = {
            "ok": True,
            "errors": [],
            "warnings": [],
            "plugin": validation.plugin,
            "sha256": validation.sha256,
            "size": validation.size,
            "archive_name": "test.demo-1.0.0.zip",
            "issue": {"number": 12, "user": "alice"},
            "attachment_url": "https://github.com/user-attachments/files/1/test.zip",
        }
        markdown = submission.markdown_report(result, "validate")
        self.assertTrue(markdown.startswith("<!-- dkl-plugin-check:v1 -->"))
        self.assertIn("自动校验：✅ 通过", markdown)
        self.assertIn("`test.demo`", markdown)
        self.assertIn("`pet.say`", markdown)
        self.assertIn("/approve", markdown)
        self.assertIn(validation.sha256, markdown)
        self.assertIn("https://github.com/user-attachments", markdown)

    def test_validate_report_lists_errors(self):
        result = {
            "ok": False,
            "errors": ["ZIP 里只有一个顶层插件文件夹。"],
            "warnings": [],
            "plugin": {},
            "issue": {"number": 3, "user": "bob"},
        }
        markdown = submission.markdown_report(result, "validate")
        self.assertIn("自动校验：❌ 未通过", markdown)
        self.assertIn("ZIP 里只有一个顶层插件文件夹", markdown)
        self.assertIn("修改后编辑本 Issue", markdown)

    def test_publish_report_uses_separate_marker(self):
        result = {
            "ok": True,
            "errors": [],
            "warnings": [],
            "plugin": {"id": "test.demo", "name": "测试插件", "version": "1.0.0"},
            "sha256": "a" * 64,
            "size": 2048,
            "zip_rel": "plugins/test.demo-1.0.0.zip",
            "issue": {"number": 9, "user": "alice"},
        }
        markdown = submission.markdown_report(result, "publish")
        self.assertTrue(markdown.startswith("<!-- dkl-plugin-publish:v1 -->"))
        self.assertIn("发布结果：✅ 已发布", markdown)
        self.assertIn("plugins/test.demo-1.0.0.zip", markdown)
        self.assertIn("plugins.html", markdown)


class QueueSnapshotTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def issue(self, number=1, labels=("plugin-submission",), state="open", body=None):
        data = manifest(id="test.demo", version="1.0.0")
        body = body if body is not None else (
            submission.MARKER + "\n\n```json\n" + json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n```\n"
        )
        return {
            "number": number,
            "title": "[插件投稿] 测试插件",
            "state": state,
            "html_url": f"https://github.com/LFELKEEA/darkitten-launcher/issues/{number}",
            "created_at": f"2026-11-0{number}T10:00:00Z",
            "user": {"login": "alice"},
            "labels": [{"name": name} for name in labels],
            "body": body,
        }

    def test_snapshot_keeps_metadata_and_status(self):
        snapshot = submission.build_queue(
            [self.issue(1), self.issue(2, ("plugin-submission", "plugin-validated"))],
            repo="LFELKEEA/darkitten-launcher",
        )
        self.assertEqual(snapshot["schema"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(snapshot["count"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(snapshot["generated_at"][-1], "Z")
        self.assertEqual(snapshot["items"][0]["number"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(snapshot["items"][0]["status"], "validated")
        self.assertEqual(snapshot["items"][1]["status"], "pending")
        self.assertEqual(snapshot["items"][0]["plugin"]["id"], "test.demo")
        self.assertEqual(snapshot["items"][0]["plugin"]["permissions"], ["pet.say"])

    def test_snapshot_status_precedence_and_filters(self):
        snapshot = submission.build_queue(
            [
                self.issue(1, ("plugin-submission", "plugin-published"), state="closed"),
                self.issue(2, ("plugin-submission", "plugin-invalid", "plugin-rejected"), state="closed"),
                self.issue(3, ("plugin-submission",), state="closed"),
                self.issue(4, ("other",)),
                dict(self.issue(5), pull_request={}),
            ]
        )
        statuses = {item["number"]: item["status"] for item in snapshot["items"]}
        self.assertEqual(statuses, {1: "published", 2: "rejected", 3: "closed"})

    def test_snapshot_tolerates_broken_body(self):
        snapshot = submission.build_queue([self.issue(1, body="没有元数据")])
        self.assertEqual(snapshot["count"], 1)
        self.assertIsNone(snapshot["items"][0]["plugin"])

    def test_write_snapshot_skips_unchanged(self):
        snapshot = submission.build_queue([self.issue(1)])
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            path = Path(tmp) / "plugin-queue.json"
            self.assertTrue(submission.write_queue_snapshot(snapshot, path=path))
            before = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            self.assertFalse(submission.write_queue_snapshot(snapshot, path=path))
            self.assertEqual(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), before)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

@echo off

################################################################################
# FILE: 启动.bat
################################################################################
@echo off
setlocal EnableExtensions
cd /d "%~dp0"

set "DEBUG_MODE="
if /I "%~1"=="--debug" set "DEBUG_MODE=1"

rem 1) Launcher-local runtime created by bootstrap_runtime.ps1
call :probe "%~dp0pyruntime\Scripts\pythonw.exe"
if defined PYEXE goto run
call :probe "%~dp0pyruntime\pythonw.exe"
if defined PYEXE goto run
call :probe "%~dp0.venv\Scripts\pythonw.exe"
if defined PYEXE goto run

rem 2) Any installed Python that already has PySide6
for %%P in (pythonw.exe) do call :probe "%%~$PATH:P"
if defined PYEXE goto run
for %%P in ("%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Python\Python3*\pythonw.exe") do call :probe "%%~fP"
if defined PYEXE goto run
for %%P in ("C:\Python3*\pythonw.exe") do call :probe "%%~fP"
if defined PYEXE goto run
for %%P in ("C:\ProgramData\Lenovo\AIAgent\MCPEnv\python-*\pythonw.exe") do call :probe "%%~fP"
if defined PYEXE goto run
for %%P in ("%LOCALAPPDATA%\uv\python\cpython-*\pythonw.exe") do call :probe "%%~fP"
if defined PYEXE goto run
for %%P in ("%USERPROFILE%\.local\share\uv\python\cpython-*\pythonw.exe") do call :probe "%%~fP"
if defined PYEXE goto run

rem 3) The py launcher, if present
where py >nul 2>nul
if errorlevel 1 goto bootstrap
for /f "delims=" %%P in ('py -3 -c "import sys;print(sys.executable)" 2^>nul') do call :probe_exe "%%~fP"
if defined PYEXE goto run

:bootstrap
echo.
echo Darkitten Launcher needs Python with PySide6.
if not exist "%~dp0bootstrap_runtime.ps1" goto no_bootstrap
echo Setting up a private runtime now: one-time download, about 100 MB.
echo.
where powershell >nul 2>nul
if errorlevel 1 goto no_powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "%~dp0bootstrap_runtime.ps1"
if errorlevel 1 goto failed
call :probe "%~dp0pyruntime\Scripts\pythonw.exe"
if not defined PYEXE call :probe "%~dp0pyruntime\pythonw.exe"
if not defined PYEXE goto failed
goto run

:no_bootstrap
echo bootstrap_runtime.ps1 is missing from this folder.
echo Re-download the launcher package, or install Python 3.12+ and run:
echo     python -m pip install PySide6-Essentials==6.12.0
goto failed

:no_powershell
echo Windows PowerShell was not found.
echo Install Python 3.12+ and run:
echo     python -m pip install PySide6-Essentials==6.12.0
goto failed

:failed
echo.
echo Launcher could not start. See the messages above.
pause
exit /b 1

:run
if defined DEBUG_MODE goto run_debug
start "" "%PYEXE%" "%~dp0app.py" %*
exit /b 0

:run_debug
for %%I in ("%PYEXE%") do set "PYCON=%%~dpIpython.exe"
if not exist "%PYCON%" set "PYCON=%PYEXE%"
echo Using: %PYCON%
"%PYCON%" "%~dp0app.py" --debug %*
set "CODE=%errorlevel%"
echo.
echo Launcher exited with code %CODE%.
pause
exit /b %CODE%

:probe
set "PYEXE="
if "%~1"=="" exit /b 0
if not exist "%~1" exit /b 0
"%~1" -c "import PySide6" >nul 2>nul
if errorlevel 1 exit /b 0
set "PYEXE=%~1"
exit /b 0

:probe_exe
if "%~1"=="" exit /b 0
for %%I in ("%~1") do call :probe "%%~dpIpythonw.exe"
exit /b 0
